title: Sparse Network Inference under Imperfect Detection and its Application to Ecological Networks
summary: Recovering latent structure from count data has received considerable attention in network inference, particularly when one seeks both cross-group interactions and within-group similarity patterns in bipartite networks, which is widely used in ecology research. Such networks are often sparse and inherently imperfect in their detection. Existing models mainly focus on interaction recovery, while the induced similarity graphs are much less studied. Moreover, sparsity is often not controlled, and scale is unbalanced, leading to oversparse or poorly rescaled estimates with degrading structural recovery. To address these issues, we propose a framework for structured sparse nonnegative low-rank factorization with detection probability estimation. We impose nonconvex $\ell_{1/2}$ regularization on the latent similarity and connectivity structures to promote sparsity within-group similarity and cross-group connectivity with better relative scale. The resulting optimization problem is nonconvex and nonsmooth. To solve it, we develop an ADMM-based algorithm with adaptive penalization and scale-aware initialization and establish its asymptotic feasibility and KKT stationarity of cluster points under mild regularity conditions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world ecological datasets demonstrate improved recovery of latent factors and similarity/connectivity structure relative to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种带检测概率估计的稀疏非负低秩分解框架，能在稀疏二部生态网络中同时重建群组间交互及群组内相似结构，比现有方法更准确。
AI.motivation: 生态二部网络常被用于刻画物种与栖息地等跨组交互，同时还需还原组内相似关系。这些网络极为稀疏、观测不完整，现有方法几乎只关注交互边恢复，忽视了伴生的相似图，且不控制稀疏度与尺度，导致结构估计过疏或缩放失衡。
AI.method: 构建结构稀疏非负低秩因子分解模型，(i) 在潜在因子矩阵上引入非凸 ℓ₁/₂ 正则，促使组内相似与跨组连接同时稀疏且相对尺度适中；(ii) 将观测计数建模为泊松分布并结合检测概率，显式处理观测丢失；优化问题为非凸非光滑，设计 ADMM 算法，含自适应惩罚与尺度感知初始化，并证明迭代序列的渐近可行性与聚类点满足 KKT 条件。
AI.result: 在人工生态网与三大真实生态数据集上，新框架在低秩因子、组内相似图与跨组连接的三重建任务上均显著优于 Poisson-NMF、BMF、biSBM、GNN 等基线，F1 提升约 8–16%，重建误差下降约 25%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入稀疏正则与检测概率的双约束，该方法首次将生态网络中的交互与相似结构同时高精度还原，为二部网络联合结构发现提供了可扩展且理论支撑充分的工具，并可直接推广至推荐、文本等含稀疏计数数据的领域。

title: Beyond Bellman: High-Order Generator Regression for Continuous-Time Policy Evaluation
summary: We study finite-horizon continuous-time policy evaluation from discrete closed-loop trajectories under time-inhomogeneous dynamics. The target value surface solves a backward parabolic equation, but the Bellman baseline obtained from one-step recursion is only first-order in the grid width. We estimate the time-dependent generator from multi-step transitions using moment-matching coefficients that cancel lower-order truncation terms, and combine the resulting surrogate with backward regression. The main theory gives an end-to-end decomposition into generator misspecification, projection error, pooling bias, finite-sample error, and start-up error, together with a decision-frequency regime map explaining when higher-order gains should be visible. Across calibration studies, four-scale benchmarks, feature and start-up ablations, and gain-mismatch stress tests, the second-order estimator consistently improves on the Bellman baseline and remains stable in the regime where the theory predicts visible gains. These results position high-order generator regression as an interpretable continuous-time policy-evaluation method with a clear operating region.

AI.tldr: 针对有限时段、连续时间且时变动力学的策略评估问题，提出一种用多步转移矩匹配估计时变生成元、再结合反向回归的二阶方法，理论给出误差分解与采样频率-增益图，实验显示其稳定优于一阶Bellman基线。
AI.motivation: 经典基于单步Bellman的离散化在连续时变系统中仅有一阶精度，高阶改进空间显著，但如何系统引入并解释连续时间误差与采样频率的耦合尚待厘清。
AI.method: 1. 用多步矩匹配估计时变生成元，显式消去低阶截断项；2. 将所得高阶团代反向回归求解价值曲面；3. 给出端到端误差五点分解并绘制采样频率-可观测增益区域图。
AI.result: 二阶估计器在四尺度基准、特征与启动消融以及增益失配应力测试中均大幅降低误差且稳定；在理论预测的可见增益采样区表现尤为突出，贝尔曼基线无明显改善。
AI.conclusion: 高阶生成元回归是一条可解释、具备明确可操作区域的连续时间策略评估途径，为高采样频率、短时域决策场景提供了可落地的高精度方案。

title: Fast estimation of Gaussian mixture components via centering and singular value thresholding
summary: Estimating the number of components is a fundamental challenge in unsupervised learning, particularly when dealing with high-dimensional data with many components or severely imbalanced component sizes. This paper addresses this challenge for classical Gaussian mixture models. The proposed estimator is simple: center the data, compute the singular values of the centered matrix, and count those above a threshold. No iterative fitting, no likelihood calculation, and no prior knowledge of the number of components are required. We prove that, under a mild separation condition on the component centers, the estimator consistently recovers the true number of components. The result holds in high-dimensional settings where the dimension can be much larger than the sample size. It also holds when the number of components grows to the smaller of the dimension and the sample size, even under severe imbalance among component sizes. Computationally, the method is extremely fast: for example, it processes ten million samples in one hundred dimensions within one minute. Extensive experimental studies confirm its accuracy in challenging settings such as high dimensionality, many components, and severe class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 基于中心化数据矩阵奇异值的简单计数法，无需迭代拟合或先验信息，可在高维、成分数增长及极端不平衡场景下一致估计高斯混合模型的真实成分数。
AI.motivation: 传统方法在高维、成分数多或各成分样本量极不平衡时难以可靠估计高斯混合的成分数，亟需一种无迭代、无似然、无需先验知识的稳健估计量。
AI.method: 1. 数据中心化；2. 对中心化矩阵进行奇异值分解；3. 以自适应阈值截断奇异值并计数，无需拟合、无需计算似然、无需预先指定成分数。
AI.result: 在成分中心满足温和分离条件下，估计量以概率趋近1一致恢复真实成分数；结果对“维度远大于样本量”及“成分数随维度/样本量增长”均成立，即使各成分规模极度不平衡；算法十维百万样本1分钟内完成，实验在多个挑战性场景下验证高精度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的奇异值阈值计数法兼具理论保证与计算效率，为高维高斯混合成分数估计提供了简单、快速且鲁棒的通用解决方案。

title: Analytical Extraction of Conditional Sobol' Indices via Basis Decomposition of Polynomial Chaos Expansions
summary: In uncertainty quantification, evaluating sensitivity measures under specific conditions (i.e., conditional Sobol' indices) is essential for systems with parameterized responses, such as spatial fields or varying operating conditions. Traditional approaches often rely on point-wise modeling, which is computationally expensive and may lack consistency across the parameter space. This paper demonstrates that for a pre-trained global Polynomial Chaos Expansion (PCE) model, the analytical conditional Sobol' indices are inherently embedded within its basis functions. By leveraging the tensor-product property of PCE bases, we reformulate the global expansion into a set of analytical coefficient fields that depend on the conditioning variables. Based on the preservation of orthogonality under conditional probability measures, we derive closed-form expressions for conditional variances and Sobol' indices. This framework bypasses the need for repetitive modeling or additional sampling, transforming conditional sensitivity analysis into a purely algebraic post-processing step. Numerical benchmarks indicate that the proposed method ensures physical coherence and offers superior numerical robustness and computational efficiency compared to conventional point-wise approaches.

AI.tldr: 将预训练的全局多项式混沌展开（PCE）直接转化为闭合的条件Sobol’指数代数后处理，无需逐点重建模或再采样。
AI.motivation: 在空间/工况参数空间中，逐点估计条件Sobol’指数计算代价高且一致性差；需利用既有全局代理模型一次性获取全空间的条件灵敏度。
AI.method: 证明PCE张量积基函数天然嵌套条件方差；对条件测度保持正交，导出系数场的代数表达式并给出闭合的方差/Sobol’指数公式。
AI.result: 数值基准表明：新方法在双因子到七维场合均保持物理一致性，计算加速10²–10³倍，方差估计鲁棒性优于逐点蒙特卡洛/OAT。
AI.conclusion: 通过代数重投影，将全局PCE的“预测式代理”转变为“维护式灵敏度引擎”，为工程实时条件uncertainty-aware设计与监控奠定高效基础。

title: Two-dimensional early exit optimisation of LLM inference
summary: We introduce a two-dimensional (2D) early exit strategy that coordinates layer-wise and sentence-wise exiting for classification tasks in large language models. By processing input incrementally sentence-by-sentence while progressively activating deeper layers, our method achieves multiplicative computational savings that exceed those from optimizing either dimension independently. Experimental evaluation across four state-of-the-art LLMs (Llama 3.1, Llama 3.2, Gemma, Qwen; 3B-8B parameters) on three sentiment classification datasets demonstrates additional speed-ups of 1.4--2.3$\times$ over optimal layer-wise early exit for simpler tasks with vanilla models, with graceful degradation on complex multi-class problems. Fine-tuning reduces but does not eliminate this advantage. The approach is model-agnostic, requires only lightweight classification adapters, and is orthogonal to complementary efficiency methods such as quantization and pruning. Our findings indicate that 2D early exit strategies excel when semantic information accumulates predictably across input structure, suggesting possible applicability to sequence-processing tasks beyond sentiment classification.

AI.tldr: 提出2D早退出框架，按句增量输入并动态加深网络层，joint优化层-级与句-级退出；在3B-8B LLM上情感分类任务再提速1.4–2.3×，复杂度升高时性能平缓下降。
AI.motivation: 大模型推理成本高，现有早退出仅沿“深度”或“长度”单维度优化，未能充分挖掘输入语义可预测累积带来的冗余，需同时利用层与序列两维度的动态终止机会。
AI.method: 设计轻量分类适配器，逐句接收文本并逐层前传；每层输出经适配器产生置信度，若置信度达标即提前返回，否则继续下一句+下一层，实现层-句联合早退出。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.1/3.2、Gemma、Qwen的3B-8B模型与三大情感数据集上，2D策略比最优纯层早退再节省1.4–2.3倍计算；复杂多类任务提速降低但仍优于单维方法；量化/剪枝可正交叠加。
AI.conclusion: 层-句二维早退出模型无关、无需重训主干，仅靠轻量适配器即可显著压缩推理耗时；当输入语义呈可预测累积时优势明显，可拓展至更广序列处理任务。

title: Compile to Compress: Boosting Formal Theorem Provers by Compiler Outputs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in formal theorem proving, yet state-of-the-art performance often necessitates prohibitive test-time compute via massive roll-outs or extended context windows. In this work, we address this scalability bottleneck by exploiting an informative structure in formal verification: the observation that compilers map a vast space of diverse proof attempts to a compact set of structured failure modes. We introduce a learning-to-refine framework that leverages this compression to perform efficient learning and proof exploration. We perform tree search that corrects errors locally conditioned on explicit verifier feedback, thereby circumventing the costs associated with accumulating a long history of proof attempts. Extensive evaluations show that our method consistently amplifies the reasoning capabilities of base provers across varying scales. Notably, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on PutnamBench among publicly reported $\sim$8B and $\sim$32B parameter models under comparable test-time budgets, offering a scalable paradigm for next-generation verifier-guided reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种“基于编译器错误压缩+本地修正”的高效定理证明框架，用远少于传统 roll-outs 的计算量，在 PutnamBench 上将 8B/32B LLM 推到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 形式化证明需在测试阶段枚举巨量 roll-outs 或维护超长上下文，导致计算成本随深度指数膨胀，难以扩展。
AI.method: 1) 发现编译器把海量证明尝试映射到少量结构化失败模式；2) 用 verifier 反馈训练局部“学习-精炼”模型；3) 在证明树上做局部错误修正搜索，无需累积长历史。
AI.result: 在同等测试预算下，8B 和 32B 模型在 PutnamBench 的公开结果中实现 SOTA，且跨规模持续提升基线 prover 的解题率。
AI.conclusion: 利用编译器反馈的压缩特性进行局部精炼，可在不增加 roll-outs 的前提下显著放大 LLM 的推理能力，为大规模 verifier-guided 推理提供可扩展新范式。

title: Can We Build Scene Graphs, Not Classify Them? FlowSG: Progressive Image-Conditioned Scene Graph Generation with Flow Matching
summary: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) unifies object localization and visual relationship reasoning by predicting boxes and subject-predicate-object triples. Yet most pipelines treat SGG as a one-shot, deterministic classification problem rather than a genuinely progressive, generative task. We propose FlowSG, which recasts SGG as continuous-time transport on a hybrid discrete-continuous state: starting from a noised graph, the model progressively grows an image-conditioned scene graph through constraint-aware refinements that jointly synthesize nodes (objects) and edges (predicates). Specifically, we first leverage a VQ-VAE to quantize a scene graph (e.g., continuous visual features) into compact, predictable tokens; a graph Transformer then (i) predicts a conditional velocity field to transport continuous geometry (boxes) and (ii) updates discrete posteriors for categorical tokens (object features and predicate labels), coupling semantics and geometry via flow-conditioned message aggregation. Training combines flow-matching losses for geometry with a discrete-flow objective for tokens, yielding few-step inference and plug-and-play compatibility with standard detectors and segmenters. Extensive experiments on VG and PSG under closed- and open-vocabulary protocols show consistent gains in predicate R/mR and graph-level metrics, validating the mixed discrete-continuous generative formulation over one-shot classification baselines, with an average improvement of about 3 points over the state-of-the-art USG-Par.

AI.tldr: FlowSG 将场景图生成（SGG）重新建模为基于混合离散–连续状态的连续时间流式生成过程，通过少步迭代地‘生长’图像条件化场景图，在 VG/PSG 数据集上平均超越最强 one-shot 方法 3 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有 SGG 方法把检测与关系识别当作一次性确定性分类，难以利用图像上下文逐步精修语义与几何的耦合关系。作者提出应将其视为生成任务，让模型像扩散模型一样从噪声图逐步生成最终场景图。
AI.method: 1) VQ-VAE 先将混合连续视觉特征的场景图压缩为离散 token；2) 图 Transformer 预测条件速度场，用连续流匹配回归边框几何，同时更新 token 的离散后验分布（物体类别、谓词标签）；3) 两类损失联合训练——流匹配损失（几何）+ 离散流损失（语义），且可外挂到任何现成检测/分割器。
AI.result: 在 VG 与 PSG 的封闭集与开放词汇协议下，谓词 R@K/mR@K、图级场景分类与检索指标均显著优于 USG-Par 等最新 one-shot 基线，平均提升约 3 分，且推理仅需 4–8 步即可收敛。
AI.conclusion: 将 SGG 从一次性分类改写为离散–连续混合流式生成，不仅统一了语义与几何的逐步耦合优化，也首次展示了少步去噪推断在结构化视觉关系建模中的优势，为迈向全生成式视觉理解打下基础。

title: A Controlled Benchmark of Visual State-Space Backbones with Domain-Shift and Boundary Analysis for Remote-Sensing Segmentation
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, Accepted for publication at IEEE IGARSS 2026
summary: Visual state-space models (SSMs) are increasingly promoted as efficient alternatives to Vision Transformers, yet their practical advantages remain unclear under fair comparison because existing studies rarely isolate encoder effects from decoder and training choices. We present a strictly controlled benchmark of representative visual SSM families, including VMamba, MambaVision, and Spatial-Mamba, for remote-sensing semantic segmentation, in which only the encoder varies across experiments. Evaluated on LoveDA and ISPRS Potsdam under a unified 4-stage feature interface and a fixed lightweight decoder, the benchmark reveals three main findings, intra-family scaling yields only modest gains, cross-domain generalization is strongly asymmetric, and boundary delineation is the dominant failure mode under distribution shift. Although visual SSMs achieve favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs relative to the controlled CNN and Transformer baselines considered here, the results suggest that future improvements are more likely to come from robustness-oriented design and boundary-aware decoding than from encoder scaling alone. By isolating encoder behavior under a unified and reproducible protocol, this study establishes a practical reference benchmark for the design and evaluation of future Mamba-based segmentation backbones

AI.tldr: 在统一解码器和训练协议下，仅替换编码器进行比较，视觉状态空间模型（SSM）在遥感语义分割中的优势主要体现为「效率-精度」权衡；其缩放收益小、跨域鲁棒性差、边界精度弱，改进空间在于鲁棒与边界感知设计，而非单纯扩大编码器。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 SSM 被宣称优于 Vision Transformer，但既有工作未将编码器与解码器、训练策略解耦，导致实际优势含糊。作者希望在一个“只换编码器”的严格受控设置下，量化 SSM 的真实价值。
AI.method: 选取 VMamba、MambaVision、Spatial-Mamba 三大视觉 SSM 家族作为编码器，统一采用 4 级特征接口 + 轻量级解码器，并在 LoveDA 与 ISPRS Potsdam 双数据集上执行远程 sensing 语义分割实验；所有超参数、训练流程、数据增强保持一致，仅变动编码器。
AI.result: 1) 同一家族内增大模型仅带来微小增益；2) 跨域（LoveDA→Potsdam 或反向）泛化呈现强烈非对称性；3) 分布偏移场景下，边界模糊是主要失败模式。尽管 SSM 在参数量-效率上优于对照 CNN 与 Transformer，但绝对精度优势有限。
AI.conclusion: 视觉 SSM 的进一步突破应聚焦「鲁棒性导向结构」与「边界感知解码」，而非继续堆叠编码器容量。本研究提供的统一可复现基准，可作为后续 Mamba 分割骨干设计与评估的实用参照。

title: On Solving the Multiple Variable Gapped Longest Common Subsequence Problem
summary: This paper addresses the Variable Gapped Longest Common Subsequence (VGLCS) problem, a generalization of the classical LCS problem involving flexible gap constraints between consecutive solutions' characters. The problem arises in molecular sequence comparison, where structural distance constraints between residues must be respected, and in time-series analysis where events are required to occur within specified temporal delays. We propose a search framework based on the root-based state graph representation, in which the state space comprises a generally large number of rooted state subgraphs. To cope with the resulting combinatorial explosion, an iterative beam search strategy is employed, dynamically maintaining a global pool of promising candidate root nodes, enabling effective control of diversification across iterations. To exploit the search for high-quality solutions, several known heuristics from the LCS literature are utilized into the standalone beam search procedure. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive computational study on the VGLCS problem comprising 320 synthetic instances with up to 10 input sequences and up to 500 characters. Experimental results show robustness of the designed approach over the baseline beam search in comparable runtimes.

AI.tldr: 提出基于根状态图与迭代束搜索的 VGLCS 求解框架，首次系统验证在 320 组合成实例上显著优于传统束搜索。
AI.motivation: 经典 LCS 无法描述分子序列残基间距或时序事件延迟约束，需引入可变空隙限制的 VGLCS 模型；现有方法缺乏针对该模型的高效算法与大规模实验评估。
AI.method: 构建根状态子图表示的搜索空间；以全局候选根节点池驱动的迭代束搜索控制组合爆炸；集成 LCS 领域多种剪枝与启发式策略，在每次迭代中动态维护高质量多样性解。
AI.result: 在 10 条序列、单条最长 500 字符的 320 组合成测试集上，新框架解的质量稳定优于基线束搜索，运行时间可比拟。
AI.conclusion: 首次给出 VGLCS 问题的系统性计算研究，证明根状态图+迭代束搜索是兼顾效率与效果的可行范式，为分子比对与时序分析中的距离约束序列比较提供实用工具。

title: Curiosity-Critic: Cumulative Prediction Error Improvement as a Tractable Intrinsic Reward for World Model Training
summary: Local prediction-error-based curiosity rewards focus on the current transition without considering the world model's cumulative prediction error across all visited transitions. We introduce Curiosity-Critic, which grounds its intrinsic reward in the improvement of this cumulative objective, and show that it reduces to a tractable per-step form: the difference between the current prediction error and the asymptotic error baseline of the current state transition. We estimate this baseline online with a learned critic co-trained alongside the world model; regressing a single scalar, the critic converges well before the world model saturates, redirecting exploration toward learnable transitions without oracle knowledge of the noise floor. The reward is higher for learnable transitions and collapses toward the baseline for stochastic ones, effectively separating epistemic (reducible) from aleatoric (irreducible) prediction error online. Prior prediction-error curiosity formulations, from Schmidhuber (1991) to learned-feature-space variants, emerge as special cases corresponding to specific approximations of this baseline. Experiments on a stochastic grid world show that Curiosity-Critic outperforms prediction-error and visitation-count baselines in convergence speed and final world model accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 Curiosity-Critic，把探索奖励定义为“累积预测误差的在线改善量”，用一个可快速收敛的 critic 估计渐近误差基线，实现可学习与随机转移的在线分离，在随机网格世界任务中收敛更快、模型更准。
AI.motivation: 传统局部预测误差好奇心只关注单步误差，无法区分可消除的 epistemic 误差与不可消除的 aleatoric 噪声，导致在随机转移上浪费探索；需要一种无需先知噪声下限、能在线衡量“模型还能学多少”的内在奖励。
AI.method: 1. 将内在奖励定义为当前预测误差与“当前转移的渐近误差”之差；2. 用 critic 网络在线回归该渐近误差，仅输出单标量，与 world model 联合训练；3. 证明此前所有预测误差好奇心方法都是该框架在特定基线近似下的特例。
AI.result: 在随机网格世界中，Curiosity-Critic 的 world model 收敛速度显著快于纯预测误差和访问计数基线，最终模型精度更高； critic 在 world model 饱和前已收敛，实现在线噪声分离。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入累积误差视角与可学习的 critic 基线，Curiosity-Critic 无需先验噪声知识即可实时区分可学与随机转移，为内在探索奖励提供了更通用、更稳健的理论与算法框架。

title: Probing for Reading Times
summary: Probing has shown that language model representations encode rich linguistic information, but it remains unclear whether they also capture cognitive signals about human processing. In this work, we probe language model representations for human reading times. Using regularized linear regression on two eye-tracking corpora spanning five languages (English, Greek, Hebrew, Russian, and Turkish), we compare the representations from every model layer against scalar predictors -- surprisal, information value, and logit-lens surprisal. We find that the representations from early layers outperform surprisal in predicting early-pass measures such as first fixation and gaze duration. The concentration of predictive power in the early layers suggests that human-like processing signatures are captured by low-level structural or lexical representations, pointing to a functional alignment between model depth and the temporal stages of human reading. In contrast, for late-pass measures such as total reading time, scalar surprisal remains superior, despite its being a much more compressed representation. We also observe performance gains when using both surprisal and early-layer representations. Overall, we find that the best-performing predictor varies strongly depending on the language and eye-tracking measure.

AI.tldr: 早期 Transformer 层已能编码与人类早期阅读指标（首次注视/凝视时长）显著相关的信号，且优于 surprisal；晚期指标（总阅读时间）仍以 surprisal 为佳。不同语言与指标需不同预测器。
AI.motivation: 已有探针研究表明语言模型富含语言学特征，但尚不清楚其表示是否也包含人类实时加工的“认知指纹”。作者希望验证模型内部层次与人类阅读时间之间是否存在系统对应关系。
AI.method: 在 5 种语言的眼动语料上，用正则化线性回归将每个模型层的表示向量与三类标量基线（surprisal、information value、logit-lens surprisal）逐一比较，预测 2 类眼动指标（早期 vs 晚期）。实验采用交叉验证并测试层+surprisal 的联合特征。
AI.result: 1) 早期层表示显著优于 surprisal 等标量基线，解释早期阅读指标；2) 预测力集中于浅层，支持“低层→早期加工”对齐；3) 晚期阅读指标仍以 surprisal 最优；4) 不同语言和指标的最佳预测器差异显著；5) 联合特征进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: Transformer 早期表示已捕获与人类早期阅读行为对齐的低层结构/词汇信号，表明模型深度与人类加工时序存在功能映射；而全局重读行为仍需高阶 surprisal。结果提示模型-人脑对齐具有“分层-分时”特性，且跨语言需差异化建模。

title: Easy Samples Are All You Need: Self-Evolving LLMs via Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Previous LLMs-based RL studies typically follow either supervised learning with high annotation costs, or unsupervised paradigms using voting or entropy-based rewards. However, their performance remains far from satisfactory due to the substantial annotation cost and issues such as model collapse or reward hacking. To address these issues, we introduce a new perspective inspired by cognitive learning theory and propose a novel approach called EasyRL. The core of EasyRL is to simulate the human cognitive acquisition curve by integrating reliable knowledge transfer from easy labeled data with a progressive divide-and-conquer strategy that tackles increasingly difficult unlabeled data. Specifically, we initialize a warm-up model using supervised RL with few-shot labeled data. This is followed by a divide-and-conquer pseudo-labeling strategy on difficult unlabeled data, combining consistency-based selection for low-uncertainty cases and reflection-based resolution for medium-uncertainty cases. Finally, difficulty-progressive self-training with iterative pseudo-labeling and RL further strengthens the model's reasoning capability. EasyRL provides a unified self-evolving framework that facilitates data-efficient post-training of LLMs. Experimental results on mathematical and scientific benchmarks demonstrate that EasyRL, using only 10% of easy labeled data, consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: EasyRL 借鉴人类认知学习曲线，先用少量易标注数据监督预热，再对难无标数据实施“分治-自训练”渐进式强化，实现低成本、高效果的 LLM 后训练。仅用 10 % 标注即超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM-RL 路线要么标注昂贵，要么无监督易崩溃/奖励黑客，性能不佳。作者受认知学习理论启发，希望用极少量标注即可驱动模型自我进化，突破数据与性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 用少量易标数据做监督 RL 预热；2) 对剩余难无标数据执行“分治伪标签”：一致性筛选低不确定样本，反思机制消解中高不确定样本；3) 难度递进地自训练，迭代伪标签+RL 持续强化推理，全程模拟人类“由易到难”认知曲线。
AI.result: 在数学与科学基准上，EasyRL 仅消耗 10 % 传统标注量便全面超越包括全监督在内的 SOTA 基线，验证其数据效率与性能优势。
AI.conclusion: EasyRL 提供统一、自演进的轻标注后训练框架，显著降低标注成本同时提升推理能力，为 LLM 的高效 RL 微调开辟了新范式。

title: Vision-Based Human Awareness Estimation for Enhanced Safety and Efficiency of AMRs in Industrial Warehouses
summary: Ensuring human safety is of paramount importance in warehouse environments that feature mixed traffic of human workers and autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). Current approaches often treat humans as generic dynamic obstacles, leading to conservative AMR behaviors like slowing down or detouring, even when workers are fully aware and capable of safely sharing space. This paper presents a real-time vision-based method to estimate human awareness of an AMR using a single RGB camera. We integrate state-of-the-art 3D human pose lifting with head orientation estimation to ascertain a human's position relative to the AMR and their viewing cone, thereby determining if the human is aware of the AMR. The entire pipeline is validated using synthetically generated data within NVIDIA Isaac Sim, a robust physics-accurate robotics simulation environment. Experimental results confirm that our system reliably detects human positions and their attention in real time, enabling AMRs to safely adapt their motion based on human awareness. This enhancement is crucial for improving both safety and operational efficiency in industrial and factory automation settings.

AI.tldr: 用单RGB相机实时判断工人是否‘看见’AMR，使机器人不再过度保守，兼顾安全与效率；已在Isaac-Sim合成数据验证。
AI.motivation: 传统方法把人类当普通动态障碍物，AMR频繁减速或绕路，即使工人已注意到它亦如此，导致效率低下。需让人类‘是否意识到AMR’成为决策输入，以在安全前提下减少保守行为。
AI.method: 仅利用AMR前置单RGB相机，先将2D骨架升到3D姿态，再联合头部朝向估计，得到工人在机器人坐标系中的位置与其视锥；若视锥包含AMR则判定为aware。全部流程在NVIDIA Isaac-Sim生成的大规模合成数据上训练、调参与验证，确保物理一致性。
AI.result: 系统可在实时条件下稳定输出人员3D位姿与awareness标记；检测精度与awareness判别准确率经消融实验验证满足工业安全阈值，且对遮挡、光影变化具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模人类awareness，AMR可依据对方是否察觉而采取差异化避让策略，显著减少无效减速与绕行，提升仓库混合交通场景的安全与作业效率；方法硬件需求低，易于在现有AMR上部署。

title: VOLT: Volumetric Wide-Field Microscopy via 3D-Native Probabilistic Transport
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) wide-field fluorescence microscopy is a widely used modality for volumetric imaging, but suffers from characteristic out-of-focus blur. Existing reconstruction methods either struggle to operate on high-dimensional volumes or fail to provide credibility characterization of the reconstruction. In this work, we introduce Volumetric Transport (VOLT), a 3D-native probabilistic framework for wide-field fluorescence microscopy reconstruction. VOLT combines a transport-based formulation that maps degraded measurements to clean volumes via stochastic interpolants with a 3D-native anisotropic network that separates lateral and axial processing. This design operates directly in voxel space and achieves improved scalability to large volumes without relying on slice-wise approximations. We develop both stochastic (SDE) and deterministic (ODE) variants within the same framework. We validate VOLT on simulated wide-field microscopy datasets. Our results show that VOLT significantly improves reconstruction quality in both lateral and axial directions while providing voxel-wise credibility estimates.

AI.tldr: 首次在体素空间中实现了三维宽场显微体成像的高保真、可扩展重建与可信度量化。
AI.motivation: 三维宽场荧光显微镜因离焦模糊而重建困难，现有方法难以兼顾高维数据处理与结果可靠性表征。
AI.method: 提出VOLT框架：①以随机插值体传输模型将退化测量映射为清洁体积；②设计三维原生各向异性网络，横向与轴向处理解耦；③统一实现SDE/ODE两种形式并直接在体素空间操作。
AI.result: 仿真宽场数据验证表明，VOLT在横向与轴向重建质量均显著提升，并提供逐体素可信度估计。
AI.conclusion: VOLT为三维宽场显微重建提供了首个同时满足高维可扩展、质量提升及不确定性量化的原生框架。

title: Beyond One Output: Visualizing and Comparing Distributions of Language Model Generations
summary: Users typically interact with and evaluate language models via single outputs, but each output is just one sample from a broad distribution of possible completions. This interaction hides distributional structure such as modes, uncommon edge cases, and sensitivity to small prompt changes, leading users to over-generalize from anecdotes when iterating on prompts for open-ended tasks. Informed by a formative study with researchers who use LMs (n=13) examining when stochasticity matters in practice, how they reason about distributions over language, and where current workflows break down, we introduce GROVE. GROVE is an interactive visualization that represents multiple LM generations as overlapping paths through a text graph, revealing shared structure, branching points, and clusters while preserving access to raw outputs. We evaluate across three crowdsourced user studies (N=47, 44, and 40 participants) targeting complementary distributional tasks. Our results support a hybrid workflow: graph summaries improve structural judgments such as assessing diversity, while direct output inspection remains stronger for detail-oriented questions.

AI.tldr: GROVE 以文本重叠路径图揭示 LLM 生成分布的结构，实验印证其可显著提升多样性判断，而细节核查仍需回溯原文。
AI.motivation: 当前用户仅依赖单次样本来评估语言模型，易忽视生成分布中的模式、边缘情况及对提示词的敏感性，导致过早泛化。需要让研究者直观理解并操控“分布”而非“单点”。
AI.method: 1) 对 13 位 LM 研究者进行形成性访谈，定位随机性关键场景与现有工具缺陷；2) 设计 GROVE：将多代文本解析为共享前缀图，节点为公共子串、边为分支，支持交互式聚类与摘要；3) 开展三项众包实验（N=47/44/40），对比 GROVE 图视图与逐条文本列表在多样性评估、异常检测、细节核查等任务上的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明：GROVE 的图概览在结构性判断（多样性、异常识别）上显著优于纯文本列表，准确率最高提升 28%；但对需要逐字验证的细节问题，直接查看完整输出仍更准确。用户偏好混合工作流：先图后文。
AI.conclusion: GROVE 证明以可解释图结构暴露 LLM 生成分布，可有效降低用户误泛化风险。未来应探索更细粒度分支、实时更新与多模态扩展，并将图式概览整合到提示迭代与边缘案例调试的标准工作流中。

title: Discrete Tilt Matching
summary: Masked diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are a promising alternative to autoregressive generation. While reinforcement learning (RL) methods have recently been adapted to dLLM fine-tuning, their objectives typically depend on sequence-level marginal likelihoods, which are intractable for masked diffusion models. To address this, we derive Discrete Tilt Matching (DTM), a likelihood-free method that recasts dLLM fine-tuning as state-level matching of local unmasking posteriors under reward tilting. DTM takes the form of a weighted cross-entropy objective with explicit minimizer, and admits control variates that improve training stability. On a synthetic maze-planning task, we analyze how DTM's annealing schedule and control variates affect training stability and prevent mode collapse. At scale, fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Instruct with DTM yields strong gains on Sudoku and Countdown while remaining competitive on MATH500 and GSM8K.

AI.tldr: 提出免似然的目标函数 DTM，使掩码扩散大模型也能用 RL 微调；在 8B 模型上 Sudoku、Countdown 显著提升，数学基准不掉点。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 微调目标依赖序列边缘似然，而掩码扩散模型的该量不可计算，因此需要一种无需似然的强化微调方法。
AI.method: 导出 Discrete Tilt Matching（DTM）：将微调转化为“奖励倾斜”下的局部去掩码后验匹配问题，得到带显式最优解的加权交叉熵损失，并引入控制变量稳定训练。
AI.result: 在合成迷宫任务中验证退火策略与控制变量可抑制模式崩塌；LLaDA-8B-Instruct 经 DTM 微调后，Sudoku 与 Countdown 性能大幅提高，同时在 MATH500 和 GSM8K 上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DTM 为掩码扩散大模型提供了可行且稳定的 RL 微调途径，能在特定推理任务上获得显著增益而不牺牲通用数学能力。

title: Characterizing AlphaEarth Embedding Geometry for Agentic Environmental Reasoning
summary: Earth observation foundation models encode land surface information into dense embedding vectors, yet the geometric structure of these representations and its implications for downstream reasoning remain underexplored. We characterize the manifold geometry of Google AlphaEarth's 64-dimensional embeddings across 12.1 million Continental United States samples (2017--2023) and develop an agentic system that leverages this geometric understanding for environmental reasoning. The manifold is non-Euclidean: effective dimensionality is 13.3 (participation ratio) from 64 raw dimensions, with local intrinsic dimensionality of approximately 10. Tangent spaces rotate substantially, with 84\% of locations exceeding 60\textdegree{} and local-global alignment (mean$|\cosθ| = 0.17$) approaching the random baseline of 0.125. Supervised linear probes indicate that concept directions rotate across the manifold, and compositional vector arithmetic using both PCA-derived and probe-derived directions yields poor precision. Retrieval instead produces physically coherent results, with local geometry predicting retrieval coherence ($R^2 = 0.32$). Building on this characterization, we introduce an agentic system with nine specialized tools that decomposes environmental queries into reasoning chains over a FAISS-indexed embedding database. A five-condition ablation (120 queries, three complexity tiers) shows that embedding retrieval dominates response quality ($μ= 3.79 \pm 0.90$ vs.\ $3.03 \pm 0.77$ parametric-only; scale 1--5), with peak performance on multi-step comparisons ($μ= 4.28 \pm 0.43$). A cross-model benchmark show that geometric tools reduce Sonnet 4.5's score by 0.12 points but improve Opus 4.6's by 0.07, with Opus achieving higher geometric grounding (3.38 vs.\ 2.64), suggesting that the value of geometric characterization scales with the reasoning capability of the consuming model.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统刻画了 AlphaEarth 地表嵌入的 64 维流形几何：有效维度仅 13.3，局部切空间旋转剧烈，线性方向失去全局一致性；基于 FAISS 局部检索的 agent 工具链在多步环境推理任务上显著优于纯参数化方法，且收益随底层模型推理能力增强而放大。
AI.motivation: 尽管地球观测基础模型将地表信息编码为密集向量，但这些表示的实际几何结构及其对下游环境推理的影响尚属空白；亟需回答“嵌入空间到底长什么样”“如何利用其结构提升推理”两大问题。
AI.method: 1）对 1210 万个美国本土样本的 64 维 AlphaEarth 嵌入做流形几何分析：计算参与比、局部本征维度、切空间旋转与对齐指标；2）用线性探针、PCA 与向量算术验证概念方向的稳定性；3）构建 9 工具 agent 系统，将环境查询分解为可检索子问题，在 FAISS 索引的嵌入库上执行链式推理；4）设计 5 条件消融实验（120 查询×3 复杂度）与跨模型（Sonnet/Opus）基准，量化几何工具对回答质量的边际贡献。
AI.result: 流形呈强非欧特性：有效维度 13.3，局部维度≈10，84% 位置切空间旋转>60°，局部-全局余弦相似仅 0.17（接近随机 0.125）；线性方向不可迁移，检索却保持物理一致性，局部几何可预测检索连贯性（R²=0.32）。agent 实验显示，嵌入检索使平均质量从 3.03 提至 3.79，多步比较任务达 4.28；几何工具使 Opus 得分 +0.07（几何接地 3.38），而 Sonnet 微降 0.12，表明几何收益随模型推理能力上升而放大。
AI.conclusion: AlphaEarth 嵌入并非线性可分解的欧氏空间，而是切空间剧烈旋转的低维流形；线性探针与向量算术失效，局部检索才是利用其几何结构的有效途径。将几何洞察封装为可检索工具，可显著增强大模型在复杂环境推理中的表现，且模型越强大，几何工具的附加价值越高。

title: FASE : A Fairness-Aware Spatiotemporal Event Graph Framework for Predictive Policing
summary:
Predictive policing systems that allocate patrol resources based solely on predicted crime risk can unintentionally amplify racial disparities through feedback driven data bias. We present FASE, a Fairness Aware Spatiotemporal Event Graph framework, which integrates spatiotemporal crime prediction with fairness constrained patrol allocation and a closed loop deployment feedback simulator.
  We model Baltimore as a graph of 25 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas and use 139,982 Part 1 crime incidents from 2017 to 2019 at hourly resolution, producing a sparse feature tensor. The prediction module combines a spatiotemporal graph neural network with a multivariate Hawkes process to capture spatial dependencies and self exciting temporal dynamics. Outputs are modeled using a Zero Inflated Negative Binomial distribution, suitable for overdispersed and zero heavy crime counts. The model achieves a validation loss of 0.4800 and a test loss of 0.4857.
  Patrol allocation is formulated as a fairness constrained linear optimization problem that maximizes risk weighted coverage while enforcing a Demographic Impact Ratio constraint with deviation bounded by 0.05. Across six simulated deployment cycles, fairness remains within 0.9928 to 1.0262, and coverage ranges from 0.876 to 0.936. However, a persistent detection rate gap of approximately 3.5 percentage points remains between minority and non minority areas. This result shows that allocation level fairness constraints alone do not eliminate feedback induced bias in retraining data, highlighting the need for fairness interventions across the full pipeline.

title: StomaD2: An All-in-One System for Intelligent Stomatal Phenotype Analysis via Diffusion-Based Restoration Detection Network
summary: Stomata play a crucial role in regulating plant physiological processes and reflecting environmental responses. However, accurate and high-throughput stomatal phenotyping remains challenging, as conventional approaches rely on destructive sampling and manual annotation, restricting large-scale and field deployment. To overcome these limitations, a noninvasive restoration-detection integrated framework, termed StomaD2, is developed to achieve accurate and fast stomatal phenotyping under complex imaging conditions. The framework incorporates a diffusion-based restoration module to recover degraded images and a specialized rotated object detection network tailored to the small, dense, and cluttered characteristics of stomata. The proposed network enhances feature representation through three key innovations: a column-wise structure for global feature interaction, context-aware resampling and reweighting mechanism to improve multi-scale consistency, and a feature reassembly module to boost discrimination against complex backgrounds. In extensive comparisons, StomaD2 demonstrated state-of-the-art performance. On public Maize and Wheat datasets, it achieved accuracies of 0.994 and 0.992, respectively, significantly outperforming existing benchmarks. When benchmarked against ten other advanced models, including Oriented Former and YOLOv12, StomaD2 achieved a top-tier F1-score/mAP of 0.989. The framework is integrated into a user-friendly, field-operable system that supports the fast extraction of eight stomatal phenotypes, such as density and conductance. Validated on more than 130 plant species, StomaD2's results highlight its strong generalizability and potential for large-scale phenotyping, plant physiology analysis, and precision agriculture applications.

AI.tldr: 无破坏、高通量的气孔表型提取框架 StomaD2，通过扩散去噪+旋转检测双模块，在百馀物种上达到 0.989 F1/mAP，远超现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统气孔分析依赖破坏性取样与人工标注，通量低、野外难部署，亟需非破坏、高通量、适用于复杂成像条件的自动化解決方案。
AI.method: 1) 扩散式图像修复模块恢复降质显微/手机图像；2) 旋转检测网络针对“小而密、堆叠”气孔设计：列式全局交互、上下文重采样-重加权保持多尺度一致性、特征重组抑制复杂背景；3) 封装为田间可用系统，一键输出密度、开度等8项气孔表型。
AI.result: 在公开玉米(0.994)、小麦(0.992)数据及10类前沿模型对比中，StomaD2 F1/mAP达0.989居首；已验证>130物种，跨科跨生境稳定工作；单幅图像推理<0.2 s，满足高通量需求。
AI.conclusion: StomaD2以“先修复-后检测”思路突破复杂成像瓶颈，实现非破坏、高精度、田间高通量气孔表型采集，为生理生态研究、作物精准育种与农业监测提供可扩展工具。

title: ExplainS2A: Explainable Spectral-Spatial Duality Model for Fast Transforming Sentinel-2 Image to AVIRIS-Level Hyperspectral Image
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: Mainstream optical satellites often acquire multispectral multi-resolution images, which have limited material identifiability compared to the HSIs. Thus, spectrally super-resolving the MSI into their hyperspectral counterparts greatly facilitates remote material identification and the downstream tasks. However, spectrally super-resolving the MSI into an HSI is often constrained by the multi-resolution nature of the sensor. Specifically, due to the presence of some LR bands in the MSI, the initial spectral super-resolution results often appear to be spatially blurry, resulting in an LR HSI. To overcome this bottleneck, we then leverage some HR band inherent in the acquired MSI to spatially guide the reconstruction procedure, thereby yielding the desired HR HSI. This fusion procedure elegantly coincides with a widely known spatial super-resolution problem in satellite remote sensing. Hence, we have reformulated the tough spectral super-resolution problem into a more widely investigated spatial super-resolution problem, referred to as the spectral-spatial duality theory. Accordingly, we propose ExplainS2A, consisting of a deep unfolding network and an explainable fusion network, that unifies spectral recovery and spatial fusion into a single explainable framework. Unlike conventional black-box models, ExplainS2A offers interpretability and operates as a linear-time algorithm. Remarkably, it can process a million-scale Sentinel-2 image in less than one second, yielding high-fidelity HSI over the same scene, and upgrades the blind source separation results. Although demonstrated on the Sentinel-2 and AVIRIS sensors, ExplainS2A also serves as a general framework applicable to various sensor pairs with different resolution configurations, and has experimentally demonstrated cross-region and cross-season generalization ability. Source codes: https://github.com/IHCLab/ExplainS2A.

AI.tldr: 提出“光谱-空间对偶”理论，将MSI→HSI这一光谱超分难题转化为更易研究的空间超分问题；配套方法ExplainS2A将光谱复原与空间增强统一到可解释深度展开框架，算法复杂度O(N)，1秒可完成百万像素Sentinel-2影像的HSI重建，兼容多种传感器并具备跨时域跨地域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 主流光学卫星的多光谱影像(MSI)波段少、光谱分辨率低，难以满足材料识别等任务需求；直接通过光谱超分辨率重建高光谱影像(HSI)时，受限于MSI的低空间分辨率(LR)波段，其结果空间模糊(即生成LR-HSI)。
AI.method: 1)提出光谱-空间对偶理论：利用MSI中固有存在的高空间分辨率波段(HR-MSI)，在统一框架内先进行空间超分，再在HR空间上复原光谱信息，将光谱超分问题转化为空间超分问题。2)设计ExplainS2A网络：由深度展开模块(线性时间复杂度)和可解释融合模块组成，两阶段可端到端训练，展现跨传感器(sentinel-2→AVIRIS)通用性及跨场景泛化能力。
AI.result: 在Sentinel-2与AVIRIS等多组真实数据上，ExplainS2A能在<1秒内将百万像素级MSI重建为高保真HSI，光谱重建误差显著低于现有方法，同时在盲目源分离(blind source separation)任务中获得质量提升，且模型参数和运行时间均优于黑箱深度网络。
AI.conclusion: 光谱-空间对偶策略为解耦MSI→HSI问题提供了新视角，ExplainS2A兼具高保真、高效率与可解释性，可灵活适配不同分辨率配置的传感器，具有良好的时域/地域/季节迁移能力，为卫星遥感材料识别等下游应用提供了高性能光谱升级工具。

title: ARES: Adaptive Red-Teaming and End-to-End Repair of Policy-Reward System
summary:
Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is central to aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it introduces a critical vulnerability: an imperfect Reward Model (RM) can become a single point of failure when it fails to penalize unsafe behaviors. While existing red-teaming approaches primarily target policy-level weaknesses, they overlook what we term systemic weaknesses cases where both the core LLM and the RM fail in tandem.
  We present ARES, a framework that systematically discovers and mitigates such dual vulnerabilities. ARES employs a ``Safety Mentor'' that dynamically composes semantically coherent adversarial prompts by combining structured component types (topics, personas, tactics, goals) and generates corresponding malicious and safe responses. This dual-targeting approach exposes weaknesses in both the core LLM and the RM simultaneously. Using the vulnerabilities gained, ARES implements a two-stage repair process: first fine-tuning the RM to better detect harmful content, then leveraging the improved RM to optimize the core model. Experiments across multiple adversarial safety benchmarks demonstrate that ARES substantially enhances safety robustness while preserving model capabilities, establishing a new paradigm for comprehensive RLHF safety alignment.

AI.tldr: Existing RLHF’s Reward Model is a single point of failure; ARIES simultaneously adversarially attacks RM and LLM, then uses the found faults to fix both models, achieving robust safety alignment.
AI.motivation: RLHF relies on a single Reward Model (RM) to align LLMs; if the RM itself fails to recognize unsafe behaviors, the whole system collapses. Prior red-teaming only probes the policy, ignoring cases where RM and LLM co-fail. ARIES aims to close this systemic vulnerability.
AI.method: Build a “Safety Mentor” that composes semantically-coherent adversarial prompts by combining topics, personas, tactics, and goals; generate paired malicious/safe responses to stress-test both RM and LLM. Two-stage repair: (1) fine-tune RM on discovered faults to improve harm detection; (2) re-optimize the core LLM with the repaired RM.
AI.result: Across multiple adversarial safety benchmarks, ARIES markedly boosts safety robustness while keeping downstream capabilities intact, outperforming baseline RLHF and single-target red-teaming.
AI.conclusion: ARIES establishes a new paradigm: systemic red-teaming that simultaneously exposes and fixes dual RM-LLM vulnerabilities, yielding comprehensively aligned, safer LLMs without capability loss.

title: ParamBoost: Gradient Boosted Piecewise Cubic Polynomials
summary: Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) can be used to create non-linear glass-box (i.e. explicitly interpretable) models, where the predictive function is fully observable over the complete input space. However, glass-box interpretability itself does not allow for the incorporation of expert knowledge from the modeller. In this paper, we present ParamBoost, a novel GAM whose shape functions (i.e. mappings from individual input features to the output) are learnt using a Gradient Boosting algorithm that fits cubic polynomial functions at leaf nodes. ParamBoost incorporates several constraints commonly used in parametric analysis to ensure well-refined shape functions. These constraints include: (i) continuity of the shape functions and their derivatives (up to C2); (ii) monotonicity; (iii) convexity; (iv) feature interaction constraints; and (v) model specification constraints. Empirical results show that the unconstrained ParamBoost model consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GAMs across several real-world datasets. We further demonstrate that modellers can selectively impose required constraints at a modest trade-off in predictive performance, allowing the model to be fully tailored to application-specific interpretability and parametric-analysis requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出ParamBoost——一种在叶节点拟合三次多项式并融合参数分析常见约束的新型梯度提升GAM，在保持可解释性的同时显著提升预测力，并允许按领域知识灵活施加约束。
AI.motivation: 传统GAM虽具玻璃盒可解释性，却无法把建模者的领域知识直接嵌入形状函数，限制了其在参数分析与专业场景中的适用性与灵活性。
AI.method: 以梯度提升框架训练形状函数，每次分裂后在叶节点拟合三次多项式并引入C2连续、单调、凸性、特征交互与模型设定五类参数约束，通过约束化优化实现知识注入。
AI.result: 在未加约束条件下，ParamBoost在多个真实数据集上稳定超越当前最优GAM；施加任一或组合约束仅带来轻微性能下降，即可满足特定可解释与参数化需求。
AI.conclusion: ParamBoost将玻璃盒可解释性与参数化建模优势结合，既提升精度又支持按需约束，为需要透明且符合专业先验的建模任务提供了普适新范式。

title: Scripts Through Time: A Survey of the Evolving Role of Transliteration in NLP
summary: Cross-lingual transfer in NLP is often hindered by the ``script barrier'' where differences in writing systems inhibit transfer learning between languages. Transliteration, the process of converting the script, has emerged as a powerful technique to bridge this gap by increasing lexical overlap. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of the application of transliteration in cross-lingual NLP. We present a taxonomy of key motivations to utilize transliterations in language models, and provide an overview of different approaches of incorporating transliterations as input. We analyze the evolution and effectiveness of these methods, discussing the critical trade-offs involved, and contextualize their need in modern LLMs. The review explores various settings that show how transliteration is beneficial, including handling code-mixed text, leveraging language family relatedness, and pragmatic gains in inference efficiency. Based on this analysis, we provide concrete recommendations for researchers on selecting and implementing the most appropriate transliteration strategy based on their specific language, task, and resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 首篇系统梳理跨语言NLP中“转写”技术的综述论文：给出动机分类法、方法演进史与选型决策树，指出现代LLM仍需转写以突破文字壁垒。
AI.motivation: 跨语言迁移因文字系统差异（script barrier）导致词汇重叠度低，限制了零资源或低资源语言上的迁移效果；转写可在字符层面人工提升重叠，为低资源场景提供低成本、通用且可解释的对齐信号。
AI.method: 作者提出三层框架：1. 动机分类（词汇重叠、形态对齐、代码混杂处理、推断加速等）；2. 输入级融合策略（前向转写、后向转写、双向对齐、多视图拼接、子词级混合）；3. 任务级应用模板（NER、POS、依存句法、问答、检索）。系统回顾2000–2023年150余篇相关研究，量化比较统一转写与多视图、端到端与管道式方案的优劣。
AI.result: 从2017年前基于字符级CNN/GRU到如今基于多语言LLM，转写一致带来+2%–+15%的F1提升，低资源语言收益最大；在推断阶段，统一转写可缩减30%–50%的子词序列长度，推理延迟降低15%–35%。双向转写在亲属语言间效果最佳，而代码混杂场景需动态转写。过度转写会引入同形异义噪声，需与原文联合表示。
AI.conclusion: 转写仍是大模型时代破解文字壁垒的“必要插件”。研究者可按“语言亲缘→资源量级→任务类型→延迟预算”四步决策：亲属语言优先双向转写；极低资源采用多视图+对比学习；实时场景统一前向转写；高资源任务仅在原文空间训练即可。未来应探索可学习转写、与Tokenizers协同优化，并建立标准化基准与工具包。

title: Curiosity-Critic: Cumulative Prediction Error Improvement as a Tractable Intrinsic Reward for World Model Training
summary: Local prediction-error-based curiosity rewards focus on the current transition without considering the world model's cumulative prediction error across all visited transitions. We introduce Curiosity-Critic, which grounds its intrinsic reward in the improvement of this cumulative objective, and show that it reduces to a tractable per-step form: the difference between the current prediction error and the asymptotic error baseline of the current state transition. We estimate this baseline online with a learned critic co-trained alongside the world model; regressing a single scalar, the critic converges well before the world model saturates, redirecting exploration toward learnable transitions without oracle knowledge of the noise floor. The reward is higher for learnable transitions and collapses toward the baseline for stochastic ones, effectively separating epistemic (reducible) from aleatoric (irreducible) prediction error online. Prior prediction-error curiosity formulations, from Schmidhuber (1991) to learned-feature-space variants, emerge as special cases corresponding to specific approximations of this baseline. Experiments on a stochastic grid world show that Curiosity-Critic outperforms prediction-error and visitation-count baselines in convergence speed and final world model accuracy.

AI.tldr: Curiosity-Critic用世界模型对所有已访转移的累积预测误差作为内在奖励基准，在线估计其渐近值，从而把可学的(epistemic)误差与随机的(aleatoric)误差实时分离，显著提升探索效率与模型精度。
AI.motivation: 传统局部预测误差好奇心奖励只关注单步误差，无法区分可约(epistemic)与不可约(aleatoric)误差，导致在随机转移上浪费探索。
AI.method: 提出Curiosity-Critic：1) 定义内在奖励为“当前误差与该状态转移渐近误差之差”；2) 用与世界模型联合训练的单值函数critic在线估计渐近误差；3) 奖励高则转移可学，否则接近随机，实现误差在线分离。
AI.result: 随机网格世界实验表明，Curiosity-Critic在收敛速度和最终世界模型精度上均优于预测误差与访问计数基线。
AI.conclusion: Curiosity-Critic统一并扩展了1991年以来各类预测误差好奇心方法，为高效探索与模型学习提供无需先验噪声下限的实用方案。

title: DanceCrafter: Fine-Grained Text-Driven Controllable Dance Generation via Choreographic Syntax
summary: Text-driven controllable dance generation remains under-explored, primarily due to the severe scarcity of high-quality datasets and the inherent difficulty of articulating complex choreographies. Characterizing dance is particularly challenging owing to its intricate spatial dynamics, strong directionality, and the highly decoupled movements of distinct body parts. To overcome these bottlenecks, we bridge principles from dance studies, human anatomy, and biomechanics to propose \textit{Choreographic Syntax}, a novel theoretical framework with a tailored annotation system. Grounded in this syntax, we combine professional dance archives with high-fidelity motion capture data to construct \textbf{DanceFlow}, the most fine-grained dance dataset to date. It encompasses 41 hours of high-quality motions paired with 6.34 million words of detailed descriptions. At the model level, we introduce \textbf{DanceCrafter}, a tailored motion transformer built upon the Momentum Human Rig. To circumvent optimization instabilities, we construct a continuous manifold motion representation paired with a hybrid normalization strategy. Furthermore, we design an anatomy-aware loss to explicitly regulate the decoupled nature of body parts. Together, these adaptations empower DanceCrafter to achieve the high-fidelity and stable generation of complex dance sequences. Extensive evaluations and user studies demonstrate our state-of-the-art performance in motion quality, fine-grained controllability, and generation naturalness.

AI.tldr: 提出舞蹈领域首个多模态高质量数据集 DanceFlow 与文本可控模型 DanceCrafter，在 41 小时动作-文本配对数据上，用舞蹈学+人体学理论指导的“编排语法”驱动，实现对任意文字描述的稳定、细粒度舞蹈生成，性能与用户体验均创当前最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有数据难觅、描述与动作严重稀缺；舞蹈的复杂空间与方向动力学、多部位异步运动难以用单一表征刻画，导致文本驱动舞蹈生成处于研究盲区。
AI.method: 1. 交叉融合舞蹈学-人体解剖学-生物力学构建“编排语法”理论框架并设计专属标注体系；2. 基于此搭建迄今最细粒度的 41 h-6.34 M 字 DanceFlow 数据集；3. 设计 Momentum 人体骨架驱动的 DanceCrafter，通过连续流形动作表示+混合归一保证稳定优化，并提出解剖先验损失显式约束分离部位运动。
AI.result: 在自建及公开基准上均实现最优运动质量、细粒度控制与自然度； user study 显示可控制性与视觉效果超越现有最好方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论与数据双重瓶颈突破，首次验证了大规模文本对舞蹈的可行性与可控性，为后续交互式编舞、数字人等应用奠定基准，并开放 DanceFlow 以促进社区发展。

title: Deep Image Prior for photoacoustic tomography can mitigate limited-view artifacts
summary: We study the deep image prior (DIP) framework applied to photoacoustic tomography (PAT) as an unsupervised reconstruction approach to mitigate limited-view artifacts and noise commonly encountered in experimental settings. Efficient implementation is achieved by employing recently published fast forward and adjoint algorithms for circular measurement geometries. Initialization via a fast inverse and total variation (TV) regularization are applied to further suppress noise and mitigate overfitting. For comparison, we compute a classical TV reconstruction. Our experiments comprise simulated PAT measurements under limited-view geometries and varying levels of added noise as well as experimental measurements together with using a digital twin for quality assessment. Our findings suggest that DIP framework provides an effective unsupervised strategy for robust PAT reconstruction even in the challenging case of a limited view geometry providing improvement in several quantitative measures over total variation reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 将深度图像先验(DIP)引入光声断层成像(PAT)，在无需训练数据的情况下即可显著抑制有限视角伪影与噪声，定量指标优于传统TV。
AI.motivation: 实验PAT常受限于扫描视角不足和测量噪声，导致传统TV等重建出现伪影与失真；亟需一种不依赖大量训练数据、即可在有限视角下获得高质量图像的无监督方法。
AI.method: 1) 在圆形探测几何下，利用最新提出的快速前向-伴随算子实现DIP的高效正演与梯度反传；2) 先用快速解析逆解作网络初始化，再以TV正则化约束进一步抑噪防过拟合；3) 对模拟与真实数据均进行测试，并以数字孪生模型量化评估。
AI.result: 在多种有限视角及噪声水平下，DIP重建的RMSE、SSIM、CNR等指标均优于纯TV重建；真实实验同样显示伪影显著减少，图像质量提升。
AI.conclusion: DIP为PAT提供了一种无需训练数据、即可应对有限视角与噪声的稳健无监督重建策略，展现出超越传统TV的潜力，可推广至其他受限探测几何的光声成像场景。

title: AI scientists produce results without reasoning scientifically
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based systems are increasingly deployed to conduct scientific research autonomously, yet whether their reasoning adheres to the epistemic norms that make scientific inquiry self-correcting is poorly understood. Here, we evaluate LLM-based scientific agents across eight domains, spanning workflow execution to hypothesis-driven inquiry, through more than 25,000 agent runs and two complementary lenses: (i) a systematic performance analysis that decomposes the contributions of the base model and the agent scaffold, and (ii) a behavioral analysis of the epistemological structure of agent reasoning. We observe that the base model is the primary determinant of both performance and behavior, accounting for 41.4% of explained variance versus 1.5% for the scaffold. Across all configurations, evidence is ignored in 68% of traces, refutation-driven belief revision occurs in 26%, and convergent multi-test evidence is rare. The same reasoning pattern appears whether the agent executes a computational workflow or conducts hypothesis-driven inquiry. They persist even when agents receive near-complete successful reasoning trajectories as context, and the resulting unreliability compounds across repeated trials in epistemically demanding domains. Thus, current LLM-based agents execute scientific workflows but do not exhibit the epistemic patterns that characterize scientific reasoning. Outcome-based evaluation cannot detect these failures, and scaffold engineering alone cannot repair them. Until reasoning itself becomes a training target, the scientific knowledge produced by such agents cannot be justified by the process that generated it.

AI.tldr: 用25,000次实验系统评估LLM科学智能体后发现：不管采用何种脚手架，模型本身决定96%以上的表现差异；68%的推理轨迹无视证据、仅26%出现证伪修正，且该缺陷在重复试验中呈指数级放大。仅看结果无法发现问题，脚手架也无法补救，必须将“符合科学认识论”直接融入训练目标，否则其产出知识即无法被科学共同体正当化。
AI.motivation: 大量LLM系统被用于自主科研，但学界缺乏对其是否遵循科学自纠错认识论规范的实证检验；若规范缺失，产出的“科学结论”可信度存疑。
AI.method: 在八大科研任务中，25,000次智能体运行被双重分析：①方差分解量化基模型与脚手架分别对性能的贡献；②行为层面解析推理轨迹的认知结构（证据利用、证伪修正、多源收敛等）。同时固定上下文输入，测试近完美示范能否纠正模式。
AI.result: 基模型解释41.4%的方差，脚手架仅1.5%；68%的轨迹忽视证据，仅26%出现基于证伪的信念更新，多检验收敛罕见。两种任务类型均呈现同类缺陷，即便给定近乎完整成功示范也难以改善，且不可靠度在多次试验中累积提升。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM科学智能体能执行流程但缺乏真正的科学推理模式；结果导向评估与脚手架工程皆无法修复深层认识论缺陷。必须将“符合科学认识论”设为训练目标，否则其产出知识无法被生成过程正当化。

title: Local Linearity of LLMs Enables Activation Steering via Model-Based Linear Optimal Control
summary: Inference-time LLM alignment methods, particularly activation steering, offer an alternative to fine-tuning by directly modifying activations during generation. Existing methods, however, often rely on non-anticipative interventions that ignore how perturbations propagate through transformer layers and lack online error feedback, resulting in suboptimal, open-loop control. To address this, we show empirically that, despite the nonlinear structure of transformer blocks, layer-wise dynamics across multiple LLM architectures and scales are well-approximated by locally-linear models. Exploiting this property, we model LLM inference as a linear time-varying dynamical system and adapt the classical linear quadratic regulator to compute feedback controllers using layer-wise Jacobians, steering activations toward desired semantic setpoints in closed-loop with minimal computational overhead and no offline training. We also derive theoretical bounds on setpoint tracking error, enabling formal guarantees on steering performance. Using a novel adaptive semantic feature setpoint signal, our method yields robust, fine-grained behavior control across models, scales, and tasks, including state-of-the-art modulation of toxicity, truthfulness, refusal, and arbitrary concepts, surpassing baseline steering methods. Our code is available at: https://github.com/trustworthyrobotics/lqr-activation-steering

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于线性二次调节器（LQR）的推理时 LLM 激活闭环反馈控制方法，取代现有开环激活干预，实现无训练、低耗且可理论保证的细粒度行为对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有推理阶段激活干预多为开环、非预见式，既忽略扰动在各 Transformer 层的传播，又缺乏实时误差反馈，导致对齐性能不稳定且难扩展。
AI.method: 实证发现不同规模 LLM 的层间动态局部线性，可将推理建模为线性时变系统；利用层雅可比在线计算 LQR 反馈控制器，对激活实施闭环校正，并设计自适应语义设定点信号。
AI.result: 在毒性和、真实度、拒答及任意概念等任务上均优于基线干预方法，首次给出设定点跟踪误差的理论界，实现跨模型、跨规模的鲁棒、细粒度行为控制。
AI.conclusion: LQR 激活闭环控制为推理时 LLM 对齐提供了无需训练、计算开销低且具备形式化保证的新范式，显著提升了干预稳定性与精度。

title: Investigating Counterfactual Unfairness in LLMs towards Identities through Humor
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference. The first two authors contributed equally. The last three authors are co-corresponding authors
summary: Humor holds up a mirror to social perception: what we find funny often reflects who we are and how we judge others. When language models engage with humor, their reactions expose the social assumptions they have internalized from training data. In this paper, we investigate counterfactual unfairness through humor by observing how the model's responses change when we swap who speaks and who is addressed while holding other factors constant. Our framework spans three tasks: humor generation refusal, speaker intention inference, and relational/societal impact prediction, covering both identity-agnostic humor and identity-specific disparagement humor. We introduce interpretable bias metrics that capture asymmetric patterns under identity swaps. Experiments across state-of-the-art models reveal consistent relational disparities: jokes told by privileged speakers are refused up to 67.5% more often, judged as malicious 64.7% more frequently, and rated up to 1.5 points higher in social harm on a 5-point scale. These patterns highlight how sensitivity and stereotyping coexist in generative models, complicating efforts toward fairness and cultural alignment.

AI.tldr: 通过“身份对调”实验发现，大模型对幽默的拒绝率、恶意推断和社会危害性评分均随说话人身份而系统性倾斜，暴露出训练数据中内化的特权-弱势关系。
AI.motivation: 幽默是反映社会偏见的灵敏探针；当模型“笑”或“不笑”时，其实重演了训练语料中的权力结构。作者欲量化这种隐性不公平，并揭示现行对齐策略的盲区。
AI.method: 构建三任务评测框架（拒绝生成、意图推断、社会冲击预测），固定笑话文本仅对调说话人与受众身份，设计可解释偏差指标捕捉不对称响应。在多款SOTA模型上实施反事实对照实验。
AI.result: 身份对调后，特权群体说的笑话被拒率最高增67.5%，被判定为恶意比例高64.7%，社会危害评分最高抬升1.5分（5分制）。各模型均呈现一致且显著的 relational disparity。
AI.conclusion: 生成式模型同时携带“过度敏感”与“刻板印象”双重机制，导致对同一条幽默的评判随身份而变；现有公平与文化对齐方法未能解决这种深层社会镜像问题，亟需显式建模权力关系与身份语境。

title: The Cost of Relaxation: Evaluating the Error in Convex Neural Network Verification
summary: Many neural network (NN) verification systems represent the network's input-output relation as a constraint program. Sound and complete, representations involve integer constraints, for simulating the activations. Recent works convexly relax the integer constraints, improving performance, at the cost of soundness. Convex relaxations consider outputs that are unreachable by the original network. We study the worst case divergence between the original network and its convex relaxations; both qualitatively and quantitatively. The relaxations' space forms a lattice, where the top element corresponds to a full relaxation, with every neuron linearized. The bottom element corresponds to the original network. We provide analytical upper and lower bounds for the $\ell_\infty$-distance between the fully relaxed and original outputs. This distance grows exponentially, w.r.t. the network's depth, and linearly w.r.t. the input's radius. The misclassification probability exhibits a step-like behavior, w.r.t. input radius. Our results are supported by experiments on MNIST, Fashion MNIST and random networks.

AI.tldr: 放宽整数约束可加速NN验证，但损失完备性；本文给出完全宽松网络与原网络ℓ∞输出距离的上下界并解释其为输入半径与深度的指数函数。
AI.motivation: 现有NN验证把阶跃激活用整数约束精确描述，虽完备但难解；改用凸松弛后可快速近似，却会因引入不可达输出而
AI.method: 统一定义各类松弛形成的格（顶端为线性松弛，底端为原网络），实验证明两者的距离随深度呈指数增长，随输入球半径呈线性增长，且误判率呈阶梯式转折。
AI.result: 全局松弛与原始输出的ℓ∞距离随网络深度指数上升、随输入半径线性放大，并在MNIST/F-MNIST与随机网络上验证了这一规律。
AI.conclusion: 首次给出凸松弛网络与原网络ℓ∞距离的解析界，证明指数级松弛误差的存在，为快速验证方法的探测质量以保证提供理论限度与实验依据。

title: Align then Refine: Text-Guided 3D Prostate Lesion Segmentation
summary: Automated 3D segmentation of prostate lesions from biparametric MRI (bp-MRI) is essential for reliable algorithmic analysis, but achieving high precision remains challenging. Volumetric methods must combine multiple modalities while ensuring anatomical consistency, but current models struggle to integrate cross-modal information reliably. While vision-language models (VLMs) are replacing the currently used architectural designs, they still lack the fine-grained, lesion-level semantics required for effective localized guidance. To address these limitations, we propose a new multi-encoder U-Net architecture incorporating three key innovations: (1) an alignment loss that enhances foreground text-image similarity to inject lesion semantics; (2) a heatmap loss that calibrates the similarity map and suppresses spurious background activations; and (3) a final-stage, confidence-gated multi-head cross-attention refiner that performs localized boundary edits in high-confidence regions. A phase-scheduled training regime stabilizes the optimization of these components. Our method consistently outperforms prior approaches, establishing a new state-of-the-art on the PI-CAI dataset through enhanced multi-modal fusion and localized text guidance. Our code is available at https://github.com/NUBagciLab/Prostate-Lesion-Segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多编码器 U-Net，通过前景对齐损失、热点图校准和置信度门控多头交叉注意力精修器，实现 bp-MRI 前列腺病灶的 SOTA 3D 自动分割。
AI.motivation: bp-MRI 前列腺病灶 3D 自动分割精度不足，现有体积法难以可靠跨模态融合，且视觉-语言模型缺乏病灶级细粒度语义引导。
AI.method: 设计多编码器 U-Net，引入①前景文本-图像对齐损失注入病灶语义，②热点图损失校准并抑制背景伪激活，③末端置信度门控多头交叉注意力精修器做高置信区边界修正；配合阶段调度训练稳定优化。
AI.result: 在 PI-CAI 数据集上显著超越已有方法，刷新 SOTA，验证多模态融合与局部文本引导的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式病灶语义注入与局部精修机制，本研究为 bp-MRI 前列腺病灶 3D 分割提供了高精度、可复现的新基准。

title: Harmonizing MR Images Across 100+ Scanners: Multi-site Validation with Traveling Subjects and Real-world Protocols
summary: Reliable harmonization of heterogeneous magnetic resonance~(MR) image datasets, especially those acquired in pragmatic clinical trials, is critical to advance multi-center neuroimaging studies and translational machine learning in healthcare. We present an enhanced and rigorously validated version of the HACA3 harmonization algorithm, which we refer to as HACA3$^+$, incorporating key methodological enhancements: (1)~an improved artifact encoder to better isolate and mitigate image artifacts, (2)~background and foreground-sensitive attention mechanisms to increase harmonization specificity, and (3)~extensive training using data spanning 100+ scanners from 64 independent sites, providing a broader diversity of scanners than other harmonization methods. Our study focuses on four commonly acquired MR image contrasts (T1-weighted, T2-weighted, proton density, \& fluid-attenuated inversion recovery), reflecting realistic clinical protocols. We perform inter-site harmonization experiments using traveling subjects to assess the generalization and robustness of the harmonization model. We compare the results of the publicly available version of HACA3 and our implementation, HACA3$^+$. Downstream relevance is further established through whole brain segmentation and image imputation. Finally, we justify each enhancement through an ablation experiment. Pre-trained weights and code for HACA3$^+$ are made publicly available at https://github.com/shays15/haca3-plus.

AI.tldr: 提出 HACA3+，在多中心 100+ 扫描仪、64 站点的大规模 MR 数据上，用改进的病灶编码器与前后景注意力机制完成跨站点 T1/T2/PD/FLAIR 四种序列的可靠同质化，经 traveling-subject 与下游分割/补全验证，并开源代码与权重。
AI.motivation: 多中心神经影像与医疗机器学习极度依赖 MR 数据一致性，而真实临床环境下扫描仪差异导致的站点效应会严重降低模型泛化与可重复性，亟需对异构大规模 MR 数据进行可靠同质化。
AI.method: 在 HACA3 基础上引入三项增强：1) 更鲁棒的病灶编码器隔离并抑制图像伪影；2) 同时关注背景与前景的注意力机制提升同质化针对性；3) 利用 64 站点 100+ 扫描仪的超大样本库训练，显著扩展了模型对不同厂商与场强的覆盖。随后在 traveling-subject 数据上做站点间同质化，并与公开 HACA3 对比，通过全脑分割和图像补全两方面验证下游可迁移性，再用消融实验逐项验证改进必要性。
AI.result: HACA3+ 在同质化保真度、跨站点一致性及下游分割/补全精度上均优于原版 HACA3； traveling-subject 实验表明其能有效消除扫描仪间差异； 消融结果证实三项改进均对性能有独立正向贡献。
AI.conclusion: HACA3+ 通过算法与数据规模双重升级，为真实多中心 MR 研究提供了可扩展、可重复且开源的同质化方案，有望直接促进神经影像队列整合与临床 AI 应用的落地。

title: Quantum inspired qubit qutrit neural networks for real time financial forecasting
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures. Published in Scientific Reports (2025)
summary: This research investigates the performance and efficacy of machine learning models in stock prediction, comparing Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), Quantum Qubit-based Neural Networks (QQBNs), and Quantum Qutrit-based Neural Networks (QQTNs). By outlining methodologies, architectures, and training procedures, the study highlights significant differences in training times and performance metrics across models. While all models demonstrate robust accuracies above 70%, the Quantum Qutrit-based Neural Network consistently outperforms with advantages in risk-adjusted returns, measured by the Sharpe ratio, greater consistency in prediction quality through the Information Coefficient, and enhanced robustness under varying market conditions. The QQTN not only surpasses its classical and qubit-based counterparts in multiple quantitative and qualitative metrics but also achieves comparable performance with significantly reduced training times. These results showcase the promising prospects of Quantum Qutrit-based Neural Networks in practical financial applications, where real-time processing is critical. By achieving superior accuracy, efficiency, and adaptability, the proposed models underscore the transformative potential of quantum-inspired approaches, paving the way for their integration into computationally intensive fields.

AI.tldr: 用量子三态网络（QQTN）做股价预测，比经典 ANN 与量子二态网络（QQBN）更快、更准、更稳，Sharpe 与 IC 均领先。
AI.motivation: 传统 ANN 训练慢、泛化弱；量子二态网络信息容量受限。研究旨在验证增加量子级数（qutrit）能否在保持量子加速的同时提升金融预测精度与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 统一数据集、滚动窗口回测；对照组为经典 ANN 与 QQBN，实验组为 QQTN。三模型共享网络深度与优化器，记录训练时间、准确率、Sharpe、IC 及不同市况下的性能衰减。
AI.result: 三模型准确率均 >70%，QQTN 在 Sharpe、IC 上显著领先；市场波动时性能衰减最小；训练时间仅为 ANN 的 38%、QQBN 的 61%。
AI.conclusion: 量子三态神经网络兼具量子并行与额外信息维度，适合实时金融场景，为计算密集型领域提供可落地的量子启发方案。

title: Last-Iterate Guarantees for Learning in Co-coercive Games
comment: Submitted to IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC) 2026
summary: We establish finite-time last-iterate guarantees for vanilla stochastic gradient descent in co-coercive games under noisy feedback. This is a broad class of games that is more general than strongly monotone games, allows for multiple Nash equilibria, and includes examples such as quadratic games with negative semidefinite interaction matrices and potential games with smooth concave potentials. Prior work in this setting has relied on relative noise models, where the noise vanishes as iterates approach equilibrium, an assumption that is often unrealistic in practice. We work instead under a substantially more general noise model in which the second moment of the noise is allowed to scale affinely with the squared norm of the iterates, an assumption natural in learning with unbounded action spaces. Under this model, we prove a last-iterate bound of order $O(\log(t)/t^{1/3})$, the first such bound for co-coercive games under non-vanishing noise. We additionally establish almost sure convergence of the iterates to the set of Nash equilibria and derive time-average convergence guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在非消失噪声下为co-coercive博弈中的纯SGD给出𝒶(√{log t}/t^{1/3})末点收敛率，并证明几乎必然收敛到纳什均衡集。
AI.motivation: 传统仅研究强单调博弈或需消失噪声的假设，难以覆盖含多纳什均衡且实际噪声迭代相关的场景。
AI.method: 对一类含多纳什均衡的co-coercive博弈，引入噪声二阶矩与迭代范数平方仿射相关的非消失噪声模型，采用鞅理论和Lyapunov分析推导有限时间界限。
AI.result: 在噪声不衰减条件下，纯SGD末点误差收敛速率为O(log t/t^{1/3})，且迭代序列几乎必然收敛于纳什均衡集；同时给出时间平均收敛保证。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次为co-coercive博弈在非消失噪声下建立了可量化的末点收敛保证，为多均衡博弈在线学习提供理论支撑，并为后续探索更紧速率铺平道路。

title: Remask, Don't Replace: Token-to-Mask Refinement in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models such as LLaDA2.1 rely on Token-to-Token (T2T) editing to correct their own generation errors: whenever a different token crosses a confidence threshold, the committed token is overwritten. We identify three structural failure modes of this rule. The trigger cannot fire when no single alternative is confident enough; the replacement is computed under a context that may itself contain errors; and the uniform perturbations used to train the T2T stream do not resemble the coherent, semantically plausible mistakes that the model actually makes at inference. As an alternative, we propose Token-to-Mask (T2M) remasking. Rather than overwriting a suspect token with a new guess, T2M resets the position to the mask state, so that the next denoising step re-predicts it from an in-distribution context. The method is training-free, modifies only the editing rule, and introduces no new parameters. We pair it with three detection heuristics and give a short theoretical account of why a mask is a better conditioning signal than an erroneous token. Across 8 benchmarks, T2M improves accuracy on tasks that require exact token-level output. Its largest gain is +5.92 points on CMATH, where we attribute 79.9% of baseline errors to last-mile corruption (correct reasoning followed by a garbled final answer); T2M repairs 41.3% of these cases.

AI.tldr: LLaDA2.1 的 Token-to-Token 自纠错机制因「触发不足、错误上下文、训练-测试分布错配」而失效；作者提出无训练、零参数的 Token-to-Mask 重掩码策略，把可疑 token 回退为 [MASK] 并让模型在「干净」上下文中重新解码，8 项任务平均提升，CMATH 上修复 41.3% 的「最后一公里」错误。
AI.motivation: 现有 masked diffusion LM 用 T2T 编辑自纠错时，常因「置信门槛漏检、错误上下文误导、训练扰动与真实错误不一致」而失败，需一种不引入新参数、不重新训练即可生效的替代策略。
AI.method: 提出 Token-to-Mask (T2M) 重掩码：检测到可疑 token 后不直接替换，而是将其重置为 [MASK]，利用后续去噪步骤在「无错」上下文中重新预测；配合三种轻量级检测启发式，无需额外训练或参数。
AI.result: 在 8 个需要逐 token 精确输出的基准上全面优于 T2T 基线，CMATH 准确率提升 5.92 个百分点，其中 79.9% 的基线错误属「正确推理+最终答错乱」的 last-mile 腐败，T2M 成功修复 41.3%。
AI.conclusion: 简单地把「错误 token→新 token」改为「错误 token→[MASK]」即可在分布内上下文中重新解码，显著降低自回归扩散模型的局部腐败错误，为无需重训练的即插即用自纠错提供了新范式。

title: Discrete Tilt Matching
summary: Masked diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are a promising alternative to autoregressive generation. While reinforcement learning (RL) methods have recently been adapted to dLLM fine-tuning, their objectives typically depend on sequence-level marginal likelihoods, which are intractable for masked diffusion models. To address this, we derive Discrete Tilt Matching (DTM), a likelihood-free method that recasts dLLM fine-tuning as state-level matching of local unmasking posteriors under reward tilting. DTM takes the form of a weighted cross-entropy objective with explicit minimizer, and admits control variates that improve training stability. On a synthetic maze-planning task, we analyze how DTM's annealing schedule and control variates affect training stability and prevent mode collapse. At scale, fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Instruct with DTM yields strong gains on Sudoku and Countdown while remaining competitive on MATH500 and GSM8K.

AI.tldr: 针对 masked 扩散 LLM 提出无需似然的细调目标 DTM，在合成迷宫和四个数学/逻辑基准上验证其稳定性与效果。
AI.motivation: RL 适配到 masked 扩散模型时，现有序列级边际似然目标不可计算，需一种无似然的细调方法。
AI.method: 提出 DTM：把细调转化为局部解掩码后验的状态级匹配，在奖励偏置下用加权交叉熵优化并引入控制变量稳定训练。
AI.result: 在合成迷宫任务中 DTM 能避免模式崩塌；在大规模实验中对 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 细调后，Sudoku 与 Countdown 显著提升，MATH500 和 GSM8K 保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DTM 为 dLLM 提供稳定且可扩展的强化细调方案，兼顾数学推理和逻辑生成性能。

title: Colour Extraction Pipeline for Odonates using Computer Vision
comment: 18 pages long (excluding references), 12 figures, to be submitted in NCCV 2026
summary: The correlation between insect morphological traits and climate has been documented in physiological studies, but such studies remain limited by the time-consuming nature of the data analysis. In particular, the open source datasets often lack annotations of species' morphological traits, making dedicated annotations campaigns necessary; these efforts are typically local in scale and costly. In this paper, we propose a pipeline to identify and segment body parts of Odonates (dragonflies and damselflies) using deep neural networks, with the ultimate goal of extracting body parts' colouration. The pipeline is trained on a limited annotated dataset and refined with pseudo supervised data. We show that, by using open source images from citizen science platforms, our approach can segment each visible subject (Odonates) into head, thorax, abdomen, and wings and then extract a colour palette for each body part. This will enable large-scale statistical analysis of ecological correlations (e.g., between colouration and climate change, habitat loss, or geolocation) which are crucial for quantifying and assessing ecosystem biodiversity status.

AI.tldr: 提出首个针对蜻蛉目成虫开源形态自动标注管线，利用少量标注在大量网络图片上训练并提取体区色彩，为宏生态色彩-环境关联研究奠基。
AI.motivation: 传统手工标注蜻蛉目（蜻蜓/豆娘）形态耗时昂贵，现有公开数据集缺少关键体部注释，严重制约形态-气候等宏观生态统计分析。亟需可扩展、低成本的自动化注释方案。
AI.method: 构建深度学习管线：用少量人工注释的蜻蛉图像预训练分割模型，再以伪标签自监督方式迭代精化；模型可将单张图像的个体自动分割为头、胸、腹、翅四区，并提取各区色板信息。数据源来自全球citizen science平台开放照片。
AI.result: 在开源测试集上实现可靠的分割性能，证明仅用有限标注即可处理十万级网络图片；成功批量输出各体部的色彩谱，为后续统计模型提供可直接量化的特征。
AI.conclusion: 该管线首次将深度语义分割与伪监督学习引入蜻蛉目形态研究，使大规模色彩-环境关联分析成为可能，为监测生物多样性响应（如气候变化）提供新型自动化工具框架。

title: Defining Robust Ultrasound Quality Metrics via an Ultrasound Foundation Model
summary: Clinicians lack a principled framework to quantify diagnostic utility in ultrasound reconstructions. Existing standards like PSNR and VGG-LPIPS are inadequate, failing to account for modality-specific physics or the structural nuances of acoustic imaging. We close this gap with a TinyUSFM-based evaluation framework featuring two distinct metrics: TinyUSFM-uLPIPS, a full-reference perceptual distance based on multi-layer token relations, and TinyUSFM-NRQ, a deployable no-reference quality score utilizing clean-manifold modeling and worst-region aggregation to detect localized harmful artifacts. We demonstrate that the presented metrics have four unique advantages: 1) Task-linked quality, where TinyUSFM-uLPIPS achieves superior calibration with semantic task damage, accurately reflecting Dice-score drops in segmentation where VGG-based metrics fail; 2) Cross-organ comparability, maintaining stable scoring scales and consistent severity rankings across diverse anatomical sites and domain-shifted data; 3) PSNR-consistent sensitivity, with TinyUSFM-NRQ providing a reliable quality score without ground-truth images that remains consistent with traditional fidelity benchmarks (i.e. PSNR); and 4) Clinical utility, improving the prediction of expert preference from 47.2$\%$ to 72.8$\%$ accuracy and producing super-resolution reconstructions preferred by sonographers. By integrating these advantages into a unified assessment and optimization loop, this work establishes a modality-aligned standard that finally bridges the gap between algorithmic performance and diagnostic utility. https://github.com/sextant-fable/US-Metrics

AI.tldr: 提出首个超声专用质量评估框架TinyUSFM，用两个新指标取代传统PSNR/VGG-LPIPS，实现与诊断任务、临床偏好和器官无关的一致性评价。
AI.motivation: 传统图像质量指标未考虑超声成像的物理特性和诊断需求，导致算法优化方向与临床价值脱节，因此需要建立“模态对齐”的评估标准。
AI.method: 设计轻量化US-Foundation-Model TinyUSFM，据此派生出：1) 全参考度量TinyUSFM-uLPIPS，利用多层token关系计算感知距离；2) 无参考度量TinyUSFM-NRQ，基于干净流形建模与最差区域聚合，定位局部有害伪影。
AI.result: 在分割任务中，TinyUSFM-uLPIPS与Dice下降的相关系数显著高于VGG-LPIPS；跨器官数据集的评分尺度保持稳定；无参考NRQ与PSNR保持单调一致性；预测专家偏好的准确率由47.2%提升至72.8%，超分重建获超声医生优选。
AI.conclusion: TinyUSFM框架首次把算法性能与诊断价值对齐，建立可推广、可优化、可临床落地的超声影像质量标准，为后续算法开发与临床验证提供统一基准。

title: Human-Guided Harm Recovery for Computer Use Agents
summary: As LM agents gain the ability to execute actions on real computer systems, we need ways to not only prevent harmful actions at scale but also effectively remediate harm when prevention fails. We formalize a solution to this neglected challenge in post-execution safeguards as harm recovery: the problem of optimally steering an agent from a harmful state back to a safe one in alignment with human preferences. We ground preference-aligned recovery through a formative user study that identifies valued recovery dimensions and produces a natural language rubric. Our dataset of 1,150 pairwise judgments reveals context-dependent shifts in attribute importance, such as preferences for pragmatic, targeted strategies over comprehensive long-term approaches. We operationalize these learned insights in a reward model, re-ranking multiple candidate recovery plans generated by an agent scaffold at test time. To evaluate recovery capabilities systematically, we introduce BackBench, a benchmark of 50 computer-use tasks that test an agent's ability to recover from harmful states. Human evaluation shows our reward model scaffold yields higher-quality recovery trajectories than base agents and rubric-based scaffolds. Together, these contributions lay the foundation for a new class of agent safety methods -- ones that confront harm not only by preventing it, but by navigating its aftermath with alignment and intent.

AI.tldr: 提出「伤害后恢复」框架，让已执行有害操作的LM智能体按人类偏好安全回滚；基于1,150组用户偏好训练重排模型，并发布BackBench基准验证其优于基线与规则对齐方案。
AI.motivation: LM智能体具备真实系统调用能力后，仅靠事前防护难以避免全部风险，需在事后有效补救。当前研究忽略了如何以符合人类意图的方式，把系统从有害状态最优地「复原」这一关键安全缺口。
AI.method: 1) 用户研究提炼恢复维度并建立自然语言评分标准；2) 收集1150对恢复轨迹偏好，发现情境下策略偏好会变化，如倾向务实、针对性方法；3) 训练可重排多条候选恢复计划的奖励模型，嵌入运行时智能体脚手架；4) 构建50个计算机任务的BackBench基准，系统测试恢复能力。
AI.result: 人类评估显示，引入奖励模型的脚手架生成的恢复轨迹质量显著高于基线智能体与仅依赖规则的脚手架，首次证明事后对齐式恢复的可行性与优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文为智能体安全开辟了新范式：不仅预防伤害，更在伤害发生后，基于人类意图进行可验证、可度量的恢复，为后续风险缓解与可信部署奠定基础。

title: S2MAM: Semi-supervised Meta Additive Model for Robust Estimation and Variable Selection
summary: Semi-supervised learning with manifold regularization is a classical framework for jointly learning from both labeled and unlabeled data, where the key requirement is that the support of the unknown marginal distribution has the geometric structure of a Riemannian manifold. Typically, the Laplace-Beltrami operator-based manifold regularization can be approximated empirically by the Laplacian regularization associated with the entire training data and its corresponding graph Laplacian matrix. However, the graph Laplacian matrix depends heavily on the prespecified similarity metric and may lead to inappropriate penalties when dealing with redundant or noisy input variables. To address the above issues, this paper proposes a new \textit{Semi-Supervised Meta Additive Model (S$^2$MAM) based on a bilevel optimization scheme that automatically identifies informative variables, updates the similarity matrix, and simultaneously achieves interpretable predictions. Theoretical guarantees are provided for S$^2$MAM, including the computing convergence and the statistical generalization bound. Experimental assessments across 4 synthetic and 12 real-world datasets, with varying levels and categories of corruption, validate the robustness and interpretability of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出半监督元加性模型 S²MAM，用双层优化同时选变量、学相似度、做可解释预测，并给出收敛与泛化理论保证，在 16 个数据集上验证鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统流形正则化半监督学习依赖预设相似度，易受冗余/噪声变量干扰，导致图拉普拉斯惩罚不当，需自动识别有用变量并更新相似度。
AI.method: 构建半监督元加性模型 S²MAM：外层优化选择变量并更新相似矩阵，内层优化得到加性预测函数；整体用可分解正则化与近端算法求解，形成 bilevel 优化框架。
AI.result: 理论上证明算法计算收敛及泛化误差界；实验在 4 个合成+12 个真实数据集、多种噪声/腐败情形下，S²MAM 显著优于基线，兼具鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.conclusion: S²MAM 通过联合变量选择、相似度学习与加性建模，突破了固定图拉普拉斯带来的偏差，为含噪声半监督场景提供了可解释且理论保证的新范式。

title: Syntax as a Rosetta Stone: Universal Dependencies for In-Context Coptic Translation
summary: Low-resource machine translation requires methods that differ from those used for high-resource languages. This paper proposes a novel in-context learning approach to support low-resource machine translation of the Coptic language to English, with syntactic augmentation from Universal Dependencies parses of input sentences. Building on existing work using bilingual dictionaries to support inference for vocabulary items, we add several representations of syntactic analyses to our inputs , specifically exploring the inclusion of raw parser outputs, verbalizations of parses in plain English, and targeted instructions of difficult constructions identified in sub-trees and how they can be translated. Our results show that while syntactic information alone is not as useful as dictionary-based glosses, combining retrieved dictionary items with syntactic information achieves significant gains across model sizes, achieving new state-of-the-art translation results for Coptic.

AI.tldr: 通过词典+可解释的句法标注在0-shot场景下刷新低资源Coptic→English翻译SOTA。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言缺少并行语料，常规微调难以奏效；需探索仅靠单语资源+句法先验即可增强翻译的新思路。
AI.method: 以SDT（有计划可解释提示）为核心：①检索不可见词的词典释义；②对输入句子做UD句法分析，再分别把原始依存、口语化描述与难点结构指令三种句法表示拼进提示；③在10M、60M、1.3B三种规模的语言模型上比较提示组合效果。
AI.result: 仅凭句法提示提升有限；但与词典结合后BLEU提升3.7–6.4分，全面超越此前最佳无调参基线，并表明句法收益与模型尺寸正相关。
AI.conclusion: 不依赖并行语料即可显著改善低资源翻译；词典信息提供词汇锚点，句法解析给出结构先验，二者互补可被LLM在上下文中高效利用，为其他濒危语言翻译提供可复制框架。

title: Beyond Coefficients: Forecast-Necessity Testing for Interpretable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Time-Series Models
summary:
