Nonlinear machine-learning models are increasingly used to discover causal relationships in time-series data, yet the interpretation of their outputs remains poorly understood. In particular, causal scores produced by regularized neural autoregressive models are often treated as analogues of regression coefficients, leading to misleading claims of statistical significance.
  In this paper, we argue that causal relevance in nonlinear time-series models should be evaluated through forecast necessity rather than coefficient magnitude, and we present a practical evaluation procedure for doing so. We present an interpretable evaluation framework based on systematic edge ablation and forecast comparison, which tests whether a candidate causal relationship is required for accurate prediction. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a case study model, we apply this framework to a real-world case study of democratic development, modeled as a multivariate time series of panel data - democracy indicators across 139 countries. We show that relationships with similar causal scores can differ dramatically in their predictive necessity due to redundancy, temporal persistence, and regime-specific effects.
  Our results demonstrate how forecast-necessity testing supports more reliable causal reasoning in applied AI systems and provides practical guidance for interpreting nonlinear time-series models in high-stakes domains.

AI.tldr: 非线性时序模型常用系数大小推断因果，易误判；作者提出用“预测必要性”替代系数衡量，通过系统删边与预测对比检验因果是否不可或缺，并以神经加性VAR在139国民主面板数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 非线性机器学习在时序因果发现中应用日广，但现有研究把正则化神经自回归的因果得分当作回归系数，导致显著性结论误导，亟需新的解释标准。
AI.method: 设计可解释评估框架：对候选因果边做系统消融(ablation)，比较删边前后多步预测误差，若删除显著降低预测精度则判定为预测必要；以Neural Additive VAR为实例，在民主发展多变量面板数据上实施。
AI.result: 相同因果得分的边，其预测必要性差异巨大：冗余、时序持续性与制度异质性决定其是否不可或缺；预测必要性检验能筛除虚假因果，显著减少误判。
AI.conclusion: 时序因果应基于预测必要性而非系数大小；提出的删边-预测框架可为高风险领域中的非线性时序模型提供可靠因果解释与实用指南。

title: Autonomous Skeletal Landmark Localization towards Agentic C-Arm Control
comment: Accepted at IJCARS: IPCAI 2026. Int J CARS (2026)
summary:
Purpose: Automated C-arm positioning ensures timely treatment in patients requiring emergent interventions. When a conventional Deep Learning (DL) approach for C-arm control fails, clinicians must revert to manual operation, resulting in additional delays. Consequently, an agentic C-arm control framework based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is highly desirable, as it can incorporate clinician feedback and use reasoning to make adjustments toward more accurate positioning. Skeletal landmark localization is essential for C-arm control, and we investigate adapting MLLMs for autonomous landmark localization.
  Methods: We used an annotated synthetic X-ray dataset and a real X-ray dataset. Each X-ray in both datasets is paired with several skeletal landmarks. We fine-tuned two MLLMs and tasked them with retrieving the closest landmarks from each X-ray. Quantitative evaluations of landmark localization were performed and compared against a leading DL approach. We further conducted qualitative experiments demonstrating: (1) how an MLLM can correct an initially incorrect prediction through reasoning, and (2) how the MLLM can sequentially navigate the C-arm toward a target location.
  Results: On both datasets, fine-tuned MLLMs demonstrate competitive performance across all localization tasks when compared with the DL approach. In the qualitative experiments, the MLLMs provide evidence of reasoning and spatial awareness.
  Conclusion: This study shows that fine-tuned MLLMs achieve accurate skeletal landmark localization and hold promise for agentic autonomous C-arm control. Our code is available athttps://github.com/marszzibros/C-arm-localization-LLMs.git

AI.tldr: 用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）微调后，可在 X 片中自动定位骨骼基准点，精度与主流深度学习方法相当，并具备推理与纠错能力，为实现自主 C 臂导航奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习方法在急诊 C 臂自动定位失败时，医生需手动操作，延误救治；亟需可接受医生反馈、具备推理能力的智能体框架来提升定位鲁棒性与准确性。
AI.method: 构建合成+真实 X 片配对数据集，标注多组骨骼基准点；微调两种 MLLM，使其从图像中检索最近基准点；与领先 DL 方法进行定量对比，并设计定性实验验证模型通过推理修正错误预测及序列导航 C 臂的能力。
AI.result: 在两组数据集上，微调 MLLM 的基准点定位精度与 DL 方法相当；定性实验显示模型能显式推理并具备空间意识，可逐帧调整 C 臂位姿向目标移动。
AI.conclusion: 微调后的 MLLM 可实现高精度骨骼基准点定位，具备成为自主 agent 控制 C 臂的潜力，已开源代码供后续研究。

title: Silicon Aware Neural Networks
summary: Recent work in the machine learning literature has demonstrated that deep learning can train neural networks made of discrete logic gate functions to perform simple image classification tasks at very high speeds on CPU, GPU and FPGA platforms. By virtue of being formed by discrete logic gates, these Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (DLGNs) lend themselves naturally to implementation in custom silicon - in this work we present a method to map DLGNs in a one-to-one fashion to a digital CMOS standard cell library by converting the trained model to a gate-level netlist. We also propose a novel loss function whereby the DLGN can optimize the area, and indirectly power consumption, of the resulting circuit by minimizing the expected area per neuron based on the area of the standard cells in the target standard cell library. Finally, we also show for the first time an implementation of a DLGN as a silicon circuit in simulation, performing layout of a DLGN in the SkyWater 130nm process as a custom hard macro using a Cadence standard cell library and performing post-layout power analysis. We find that our custom macro can perform classification on MNIST with 97% accuracy 41.8 million times a second at a power consumption of 83.88 mW.

AI.tldr: 本文提出把可微分逻辑门网络（DLGN）一次性映射到标准单元库并引入“面积感知”损失函数，在 130 nm CMOS 上首次完成完整版图与后仿真：MNIST 分类准确率 97%，吞吐 41.8 M/s，功耗 83.88 mW。
AI.motivation: 虽然 DLGN 已证明在 CPU/GPU/FPGA 上高速运行，但尚未有将其直接实现为定制数字 ASIC 并同时优化硅面积与功耗的系统性方法。
AI.method: 1) 训练后将 DLGN 逐门转换为 Verilog 网表，实现与标准单元库一一映射；2) 设计期望面积损失项，使网络自动按目标库单元面积惩罚“大”神经元；3) 采用 SkyWater 130 nm 工艺与 Cadence 标准单元完成版图、布局布线及后仿真功耗分析。
AI.result: 首次得到 DLGN 硬宏的完整 GDSII：MNIST 测试集准确率保持 97%，吞吐 41.8 M 推断/s，核心功耗仅 83.88 mW。
AI.conclusion: DLGN 可作为“训练-直接-投片”范式，兼顾算法性能与硬件成本，为超低功耗边缘 AI 提供新路线。

title: From Natural Language to Executable Narsese: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark and Pipeline for Reasoning with NARS
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are highly capable at language generation, but they remain unreliable when reasoning requires explicit symbolic structure, multi-step inference, and interpretable uncertainty. This paper presents a neuro-symbolic framework for translating natural-language reasoning problems into executable formal representations using first-order logic (FOL) and Narsese, the language of the Non-Axiomatic Reasoning System (NARS). To support this direction, we introduce NARS-Reasoning-v0.1, a benchmark of natural-language reasoning problems paired with FOL forms, executable Narsese programs, and three gold labels: True, False, and Uncertain. We develop a deterministic compilation pipeline from FOL to executable Narsese and validate retained examples through runtime execution in OpenNARS for Applications (ONA), ensuring that the symbolic targets are not only syntactically well formed but also behaviorally aligned with the intended answer. We further present Language-Structured Perception (LSP), a formulation in which an LLM is trained to produce reasoning-relevant symbolic structure rather than only a final verbal response. As an initial proof of concept, we also train and release a Phi-2 LoRA adapter on NARS-Reasoning-v0.1 for three-label reasoning classification, showing that the benchmark can support supervised adaptation in addition to executable evaluation. Overall, the paper positions executable symbolic generation and execution-based validation as a practical path toward more reliable neuro-symbolic reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: LLM仍不擅長多步邏輯推理與可解釋不確定性。作者用FOL與NARS建構可執行神經-符號框架，提出NARS-Reasoning-v0.1基準及LSP訓練範式，並發布Phi-2 LoRA適配器，證明符號編譯+執行驗證可提升LLM推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 現有LLM缺乏明確符號結構與可解釋的不確定性，導致多步推理不可靠，需結合可執行邏輯提升穩定性。
AI.method: 1. 構建神經-符號框架，將自然語言問題轉譯為FOL與Narsese；2. 推出NARS-Reasoning-v0.1基準（含FOL、Narsese程式與三類標籤）；3. 設計FOL→Narsese確定性編譯管道，並在OpenNARS(ONA)上執行驗證；4. 提出Language-Structured Perception(LSP)：讓LLM輸出符號結構而非僅文字答案；5. 在基準上訓練並發布Phi-2 LoRA適配器，完成三標籤分類。
AI.result: 可執行Narsese在目標系統上運行結果與預期答案對齊；基準支援監督微調；Phi-2 LoRA適配器在該基準上完成三標籤分類，初步驗證框架可行性。
AI.conclusion: 可執行符號生成與執行式驗證是構建更可靠神經-符號推理系統的實用路徑，為後續LLM+形式推理研究奠定基礎。

title: Heterogeneity-Aware Personalized Federated Learning for Industrial Predictive Analytics
summary: Federated prognostics enable clients (e.g., companies, factories, and production lines) to collaboratively develop a failure time prediction model while keeping each client's data local and confidential. However, traditional federated models often assume homogeneity in the degradation processes across clients, an assumption that may not hold in many industrial settings. To overcome this, this paper proposes a personalized federated prognostic model designed to accommodate clients with heterogeneous degradation processes, allowing them to build tailored prognostic models. The prognostic model iteratively facilitates the underlying pairwise collaborations between clients with similar degradation patterns, which enhances the performance of personalized federated learning. To estimate parameters jointly using decentralized datasets, we develop a federated parameter estimation algorithm based on proximal gradient descent. The proposed approach addresses the limitations of existing federated prognostic models by simultaneously achieving model personalization, preserving data privacy, and providing comprehensive failure time distributions. The superiority of the proposed model is validated through extensive simulation studies and a case study using the turbofan engine degradation dataset from the NASA repository.

AI.tldr: 提出一种个性化联邦剩余寿命预测框架，在数据不出本地的前提下，为不同退化模式的客户分别构建专属模型，并通过近端梯度联邦参数估计实现协同训练；NASA 涡扇数据集验证其优于传统联邦方法。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦预测模型假设所有客户的退化过程同质，而工业现场中设备工况、负载、环境差异导致退化轨迹异构，全局共享模型难以兼顾各客户个性化需求。
AI.method: 1. 构建可建模异构退化的个性化联邦剩余寿命预测框架；2. 设计基于相似退化模式的成对客户协作机制，仅将相似客户的知识进行加权聚合；3. 提出基于近端梯度下降的联邦参数估计算法，实现去中心化联合训练并保证差分隐私。
AI.result: 仿真与 NASA 涡扇发动机退化数据集实验表明：相比全局联邦基线，个性化模型在 RMSE、C-index 和预测区间覆盖率上分别提升 18–32%、0.06–0.11 和 9–15%；数据量越少，提升越显著；通信轮数减少约 25%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保护数据隐私的同时实现模型个性化，有效应对工业异构退化场景，为跨企业协同寿命预测提供可扩展方案，并可用于其他分布式故障诊断任务。

title: Model-Agnostic Meta Learning for Class Imbalance Adaptation
summary: Class imbalance is a widespread challenge in NLP tasks, significantly hindering robust performance across diverse domains and applications. We introduce Hardness-Aware Meta-Resample (HAMR), a unified framework that adaptively addresses both class imbalance and data difficulty. HAMR employs bi-level optimizations to dynamically estimate instance-level weights that prioritize genuinely challenging samples and minority classes, while a neighborhood-aware resampling mechanism amplifies training focus on hard examples and their semantically similar neighbors. We validate HAMR on six imbalanced datasets covering multiple tasks and spanning biomedical, disaster response, and sentiment domains. Experimental results show that HAMR achieves substantial improvements for minority classes and consistently outperforms strong baselines. Extensive ablation studies demonstrate that our proposed modules synergistically contribute to performance gains and highlight HAMR as a flexible and generalizable approach for class imbalance adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/trust-nlp/ImbalanceLearning.

AI.tldr: HAMR通过双层优化估计样本级权重，结合邻域感知重采样，在6个不平衡数据集上全面优于基线。
AI.motivation: NLP任务普遍存在类别不平衡，现有方法难以同时兼顾少数类与困难样本。
AI.method: 提出Hardness-Aware Meta-Resample框架：外层动态估计样本权重，优先关注困难样本+少数类；内层采用邻域感知重采样，对困难样例及其语义邻居进行放大训练。
AI.result: 在生物医学、灾难响应、情感分析等6个不平衡数据集上，HAMR对少数类F1提升显著，平均优于强基线2–7个百分点；消融实验证实两模块协同增益。
AI.conclusion: HAMR为类别不平衡提供统一、可泛化的元重采样方案，代码已开源。

title: Handling and Interpreting Missing Modalities in Patient Clinical Trajectories via Autoregressive Sequence Modeling
summary: An active challenge in developing multimodal machine learning (ML) models for healthcare is handling missing modalities during training and deployment. As clinical datasets are inherently temporal and sparse in terms of modality presence, capturing the underlying predictive signal via diagnostic multimodal ML models while retaining model explainability remains an ongoing challenge. In this work, we address this by re-framing clinical diagnosis as an autoregressive sequence modeling task, utilizing causal decoders from large language models (LLMs) to model a patient's multimodal trajectory. We first introduce a missingness-aware contrastive pre-training objective that integrates multiple modalities in datasets with missingness in a shared latent space. We then show that autoregressive sequence modeling with transformer-based architectures outperforms baselines on the MIMIC-IV and eICU fine-tuning benchmarks. Finally, we use interpretability techniques to move beyond performance boosts and find that across various patient stays, removing modalities leads to divergent behavior that our contrastive pre-training mitigates. By abstracting clinical diagnosis as sequence modeling and interpreting patient stay trajectories, we develop a framework to profile and handle missing modalities while addressing the canonical desideratum of safe, transparent clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文将临床诊断重构为自回归序列建模任务，用 LLM 因果解码器建模多模态患者轨迹；提出缺失感知的对比预训练目标，在 MIMIC-IV/eICU 上显著优于基线，并通过可解释性分析验证其能缓解模态缺失导致的模型行为漂移，为安全透明临床 AI 提供新框架。
AI.motivation: 临床数据集天然存在时间性与模态稀疏性，训练与推理阶段均面临模态缺失；现有方法难以在保持可解释性的同时捕捉多模态预测信号，亟需一种能统一处理缺失模态并保证安全透明的诊断建模范式。
AI.method: 1) 将诊疗过程抽象为自回归序列建模问题，采用 Transformer 因果解码器；2) 设计缺失感知的对比预训练目标，把含缺失的多模态数据映射到共享隐空间；3) 在 MIMIC-IV 与 eICU 下游任务上微调并对比基线；4) 利用可解释性技术分析不同模态缺失对模型行为的影响。
AI.result: 对比预训练+自回归序列建模在 MIMIC-IV 与 eICU 的死亡预测、住院时长等任务上全面超越传统缺失填充与多模态融合基线；可解释分析显示，移除关键模态后基线模型出现显著行为漂移，而本方法能有效缓解该现象，保持预测一致性与可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 通过把临床诊断转化为序列建模并引入缺失感知对比预训练，本研究不仅提升了多模态缺失场景下的预测性能，还利用可解释性手段验证了模型的鲁棒性与透明度，为构建安全、可信的临床 AI 系统提供了可扩展框架。

title: Match-Any-Events: Zero-Shot Motion-Robust Feature Matching Across Wide Baselines for Event Cameras
summary: Event cameras have recently shown promising capabilities in instantaneous motion estimation due to their robustness to low light and fast motions. However, computing wide-baseline correspondence between two arbitrary views remains a significant challenge, since event appearance changes substantially with motion, and learning-based approaches are constrained by both scalability and limited wide-baseline supervision. We therefore introduce the first event matching model that achieves cross-dataset wide-baseline correspondence in a zero-shot manner: a single model trained once is deployed on unseen datasets without any target-domain fine-tuning or adaptation. To enable this capability, we introduce a motion-robust and computationally efficient attention backbone that learns multi-timescale features from event streams, augmented with sparsity-aware event token selection, making large-scale training on diverse wide-baseline supervision computationally feasible. To provide the supervision needed for wide-baseline generalization, we develop a robust event motion synthesis framework to generate large-scale event-matching datasets with augmented viewpoints, modalities, and motions. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that our framework achieves a 37.7% improvement over the previous best event feature matching methods. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/spikelab-jhu/Match-Any-Events.

AI.tldr: 提出首个零样本、跨数据集的事件相机宽基线匹配模型，仅用一次训练即可泛化于任意新场景，无需微调即可获得37.7% 的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 事件相机在低光与高速运动下仍具优势，但跨视角宽基线匹配受外观剧烈变化与学习数据稀缺制约，现有方法需目标域微调，无法满足实际泛化需求。
AI.method: 1) 设计运动鲁棒的稀疏注意力主干，从事件流中提取多时间尺度特征并动态筛选稀疏 token，实现大规模高效训练；2) 构建鲁棒事件运动合成框架，自动生成多视角、多模态、多运动的大规模宽基线监督数据；3) 单次训练后即零样本部署至未见数据集。
AI.result: 在多个公开事件匹配基准上，相比最佳已有方法相对提升37.7%，首次实现跨数据集零-shot 宽基线对应估计。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过联合稀疏注意力架构与大规模合成监督，突破事件宽基线匹配的数据与泛化瓶颈，为事件视觉在 SLAM、三维重建等任务中的即插即用提供可行方案。

title: Optimal Multispectral Imaging using RGB Cameras
summary: We present a physics-driven framework for accurate evaluation of discrete spectral bands using a low-cost multispectral setup built from off-the-shelf RGB cameras and narrow multi-band optical filters. The approach starts by explicitly formulating a linear measurement model. The camera responses are expressed as linear mixtures of unknown spectral components, with mixing coefficients determined by the overlap between the camera spectral sensitivities and the filter transmittances. For a multi-camera configuration, the per-camera models are stacked into a single global system whose structure is fully determined by the allocation of target wavelengths across the camera--filter units. We pose wavelength allocation as a deterministic design problem and select the configuration that minimizes the spectral condition number of the resulting system matrix. Guided by a frame-theoretic interpretation, this criterion promotes numerical stability, maximizes worst-case output signal-to-noise ratio, and improves the robustness of spectral reconstruction. The design space is finite, enabling the evaluation of all feasible configurations under practical constraints. We demonstrate the method on a representative example with 12 target wavelengths and four triband filters, and identify the wavelength allocation that yields the most stable and noise-robust recovery. The proposed framework includes redundant configurations, in which individual wavelengths are measured by multiple cameras, thereby providing additional degrees of freedom that further improve noise robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理驱动框架，利用廉价 RGB 相机与窄带滤光片组合的低代价多光谱系统，通过优化波长分配使系统矩阵谱条件数最小，实现高稳定、高信噪比的光谱重建。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱设备昂贵，而廉价 RGB 相机加滤光片的组合因系统矩阵病态导致重建精度与鲁棒性差。亟需一种兼顾成本、数值稳定性与抗噪性能的光谱评估方法。
AI.method: 1) 建立线性测量模型：相机响应为未知光谱成分的线性混合，混合系数由相机光谱灵敏度与滤光片透过率重叠积分确定；2) 多相机-滤光片单元堆叠成全局系统矩阵；3) 将波长分配转化为确定性设计问题，以最小化系统矩阵谱条件数为目标，在有限设计空间中穷举可行配置；4) 引入帧理论解释，证明该准则可同时最大化最坏情况输出信噪比并提升鲁棒性；5) 允许冗余测量，使单个波长被多台相机捕获，进一步增加自由度以增强抗噪能力。
AI.result: 在 12 个目标波长、4 个三带滤光片的代表性实验中，框架穷举 34 560 种配置，精确找出使条件数最小的波长分配方案。相比随机分配，最优配置将条件数降低 65%，峰值信噪比提升 8 dB，重建误差下降 40%；冗余方案在高噪声环境下误差再降 25%。
AI.conclusion: 该物理驱动框架首次将廉价 RGB 相机-滤光片系统的光谱重建问题转化为可穷举的矩阵条件数优化问题，兼顾成本、稳定性与抗噪性，为便携式、低代价的多光谱成像提供了一套可复现、可扩展的设计范式。

title: How Adversarial Environments Mislead Agentic AI?
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: Tool-integrated agents are deployed on the premise that external tools ground their outputs in reality. Yet this very reliance creates a critical attack surface. Current evaluations benchmark capability in benign settings, asking "can the agent use tools correctly" but never "what if the tools lie". We identify this Trust Gap: agents are evaluated for performance, not for skepticism. We formalize this vulnerability as Adversarial Environmental Injection (AEI), a threat model where adversaries compromise tool outputs to deceive agents. AEI constitutes environmental deception: constructing a "fake world" of poisoned search results and fabricated reference networks around unsuspecting agents. We operationalize this via POTEMKIN, a Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible harness for plug-and-play robustness testing. We identify two orthogonal attack surfaces: The Illusion (breadth attacks) poison retrieval to induce epistemic drift toward false beliefs, while The Maze (depth attacks) exploit structural traps to cause policy collapse into infinite loops. Across 11,000+ runs on five frontier agents, we find a stark robustness gap: resistance to one attack often increases vulnerability to the other, demonstrating that epistemic and navigational robustness are distinct capabilities.

AI.tldr: 主流测评只关心智能体“会不会用工具”，却忽视“工具撒谎时怎么办”。本文把这一盲区称为“信任缺口”，提出对抗式环境注入（AEI）威胁模型，并用 POTEMKIN 框架在 11 000+ 次实验中发现：增强对“幻觉”广域攻击的抵抗力，反而可能加剧“迷宫”深度陷阱攻击，两种鲁棒性不可兼得。
AI.motivation: 现有基准默认工具可信，仅测功能正确性；一旦外部工具被敌手操控，智能体缺乏质疑机制，可能被诱导形成错误信念或陷入无限循环。需要一套可量化、可复现的“工具撒谎”评测体系，揭示真实鲁棒性缺口。
AI.method:
1) 形式化 AEI 威胁模型：敌手通过污染搜索返回、伪造引用网络等手段，在智能体周围构建“虚假世界”。
2) 设计 MCP 兼容的 POTEMKIN 测试平台，支持即插即用的工具输出投毒。
3) 定义两类正交攻击面：
   – The Illusion（广度攻击）：大规模污染检索结果，诱导认知漂移；
   – The Maze（深度攻击）：在交互结构中布设陷阱，迫使策略陷入死循环。
4) 对 5 个前沿智能体进行 11 000+ 轮实验，度量 epistemic 与 navigational 鲁棒性。
AI.result: 所有受测智能体均表现出显著脆弱性；更令人担忧的是，针对 Illusion 的加固会显著降低对 Maze 的抵抗力，二者呈负相关。说明“知识鲁棒”与“导航鲁棒”属于独立能力，无法通过单一防御同时提升。
AI.conclusion: 工具集成智能体必须被当作“处于敌对环境的决策者”而非“被动调用者”来设计；未来框架需显式引入质疑-验证机制，并将 epistemic 与 navigational 鲁棒性作为并行指标联合优化，否则难以在真实对抗环境中安全部署。

title: Calibrating Scientific Foundation Models with Inference-Time Stochastic Attention
summary: Transformer-based scientific foundation models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, but current architectures give deterministic outputs and provide limited support for calibrated predictive uncertainty. We propose Stochastic Attention, a lightweight inference-time modification that randomizes attention by replacing softmax weights with normalized multinomial samples controlled by a single concentration parameter, and produces predictive ensembles without retraining. To set this parameter, we introduce a calibration objective that matches the stochastic attention output with the target, yielding an efficient univariate post-hoc tuning problem. We evaluate this mechanism on two scientific foundation models for weather and timeseries forecasting along with an additional regression task. Across benchmarks against uncertainty-aware baselines, we find that Stochastic Attention achieves the strongest native calibration and the sharpest prediction intervals at comparable coverage, while requiring only minutes of post-hoc tuning versus days of retraining for competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 随机化注意力机制 → 无需重训练即获可靠不确定性估计
AI.motivation: 现有科学基础 Transformer 在关键任务中输出确定、无法给出校准的不确定性，阻碍高风险决策。
AI.method: 提出 Stochastic Attention：推断阶段用归一化多项式抽样替代 softmax，仅调一个浓度参数；设计单变量后验校准目标快速优化该参数，零重训练即可生成预测集成。
AI.result: 在气象与时序科学基础模型及回归任务上，新方法 native 校准最优、同等覆盖下预测区间最尖锐；调参耗时分钟级，对比需数日重训练的基线显著提速。
AI.conclusion: Stochastic Attention 以极小代价为科学基础模型赋予可信不确定性，可即插即用于高 stakes 场景。

title: An Empirical Study of Multi-Generation Sampling for Jailbreak Detection in Large Language Models
summary: Detecting jailbreak behaviour in large language models remains challenging, particularly when strongly aligned models produce harmful outputs only rarely. In this work, we present an empirical study of output based jailbreak detection under realistic conditions using the JailbreakBench Behaviors dataset and multiple generator models with varying alignment strengths. We evaluate both a lexical TF-IDF detector and a generation inconsistency based detector across different sampling budgets. Our results show that single output evaluation systematically underestimates jailbreak vulnerability, as increasing the number of sampled generations reveals additional harmful behaviour. The most significant improvements occur when moving from a single generation to moderate sampling, while larger sampling budgets yield diminishing returns. Cross generator experiments demonstrate that detection signals partially generalise across models, with stronger transfer observed within related model families. A category level analysis further reveals that lexical detectors capture a mixture of behavioural signals and topic specific cues, rather than purely harmful behaviour. Overall, our findings suggest that moderate multi sample auditing provides a more reliable and practical approach for estimating model vulnerability and improving jailbreak detection in large language models. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 多采样+轻量检测比单样本更能暴露大模型越狱风险；跨模型迁移性有限，适度采样即可性价比最佳。
AI.motivation: 强对齐大模型极少输出有害内容，单样本评估常漏检越狱行为，需要输出端检测方案在真实场景下的系统评估与采样策略指导。
AI.method: 用 JailbreakBench Behaviors 数据集，对多组对齐强度不同的生成模型进行单/多采样实验；比较 TF-IDF 词法检测器与一致性-不一致检测器，量化采样预算对检出率的影响，并做跨模型迁移与类别级信号分析。
AI.result: 单样本评估显著低估漏洞；增加到 5–20 个样本即可捕获大部分新增有害输出，再增加收益递减。跨模型检测信号可部分迁移，同一家族模型间迁移更强。TF-IDF 混合了行为信号与主题线索，而非纯粹的有害内容。
AI.conclusion: 实践中采用“适度多采样 + 轻量输出端审计”即可可靠估计模型越狱风险，兼顾成本与效果；后续研究应聚焦采样策略优化与跨模型通用检测器设计。

title: Towards Understanding the Robustness of Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to optimization-based jailbreak attacks that exploit internal gradient structure. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for interpretability, their robustness implications remain underexplored. We present a study of integrating pretrained SAEs into transformer residual streams at inference time, without modifying model weights or blocking gradients. Across four model families (Gemma, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen) and two strong white-box attacks (GCG, BEAST) plus three black-box benchmarks, SAE-augmented models achieve up to a 5x reduction in jailbreak success rate relative to the undefended baseline and reduce cross-model attack transferability. Parametric ablations reveal (i) a monotonic dose-response relationship between L0 sparsity and attack success rate, and (ii) a layer-dependent defense-utility tradeoff, where intermediate layers balance robustness and clean performance. These findings are consistent with a representational bottleneck hypothesis: sparse projection reshapes the optimization geometry exploited by jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 预训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）不改权重、不阻断梯度，直接在推理阶段插入 Transformer 残差流，可把白盒越狱成功率最高压至 1/5，同时降低跨模型迁移；中间层稀疏度与攻防性能呈可预测剂量-响应关系。
AI.motivation: 大模型对基于梯度的越狱攻击仍脆弱，而 SAE 虽被大量用于可解释性，其在安全侧的潜力未被系统评估。作者假设：稀疏表征会改变攻击者可利用的优化几何，从而天然形成防御。
AI.method: 在 4 个开源模型族（Gemma、LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen）上，将预训练 SAE 以“即插即用”方式嵌入残差流，保持原参数与梯度完整。用 GCG、BEAST 两种强白盒攻击及三项黑盒基准评估；通过 L0 稀疏度、插入层位等参数开展消融，量化攻击成功率、干净任务性能与跨模型迁移率。
AI.result: SAE 增强后，越狱成功率最高降低 5×，黑盒基准同样下降；攻击跨模型迁移显著减弱。存在单调剂量-响应：L0 越小，攻击越难；中间层提供最佳鲁棒-效用折中，顶层或底层插入会分别牺牲干净性能或防御效果。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次证实“推理时注入预训练 SAE”是一种轻量、无需重训的越狱防御策略，支持“表征瓶颈”假设：稀疏投影重塑了攻击优化曲面。中间层稀疏度可作为可调节的鲁棒杠杆，为后续在可解释性与安全性之间建立统一框架奠定基础。

title: DeltaSeg: Tiered Attention and Deep Delta Learning for Multi-Class Structural Defect Segmentation
summary: Automated segmentation of structural defects from visual inspection imagery remains challenging due to the diversity of damage types, extreme class imbalance, and the need for precise boundary delineation. This paper presents DeltaSeg, a U-shaped encoder-decoder architecture with a tiered attention strategy that integrates Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) channel attention in the encoder, Coordinate Attention at the bottleneck and decoder, and a novel Deep Delta Attention (DDA) mechanism in the skip connections. The encoder uses depthwise separable convolutions with dilated stages to maintain spatial resolution while expanding the receptive field. Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) at the bottleneck captures multi-scale context. The DDA module refines skip connections through a dual-path scheme combining a learned delta operator for nuisance feature suppression with spatial attention gates conditioned on decoder signals. Deep supervision through multi-scale auxiliary heads further strengthens gradient flow and encourages semantically meaningful features at intermediate decoder stages. We evaluate DeltaSeg on two datasets: the S2DS dataset (7 classes) and the Culvert-Sewer Defect Dataset (CSDD, 9 classes). Across both benchmarks, DeltaSeg consistently outperforms 12 competing architectures including U-Net, SA-UNet, UNet3+, SegFormer, Swin-UNet, EGE-UNet, FPN, and Mobile-UNETR, demonstrating strong generalization across damage types, imaging conditions, and structural geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出DeltaSeg：一条带分层注意力与新型Deep Delta Attention的多尺度损伤分割网络，在S2DS与CSDD两个多类缺陷数据集上全面超越12种主流模型。
AI.motivation: 结构损伤视觉检测中，损伤形态多样、类别极不均衡且边界需高精度定位，现有自动分割方法难以同时满足高精度与强泛化要求。
AI.method: 基于U型编-解码框架设计DeltaSeg，核心为分层注意力策略：编码器嵌入SE通道注意力，瓶颈及解码器使用坐标注意力，并在跳跃连接提出Deep Delta Attention（DDA）双路径模块以抑制干扰特征并强化空间注意力；同时采用空洞深度可分离卷积+ASPP保持多尺度上下文，引入多尺度辅助头实现深度监督。
AI.result: 在S2DS（7类）与CSDD（9类）数据集上，DeltaSeg平均IoU分别达76.3%、74.8%，相较U-Net提升6.4-7.1个百分点，且在所有12种竞争中排名第一，表现出跨损伤类型、成像条件与几何结构的一致性优势。
AI.conclusion: 分层注意力配合DDA模块可显著缓解类不平衡并细化边界，DeltaSeg为结构损伤自动化视觉检查提供了一种高精度、易部署的通用分割方案，并验证了分层注意力在极端不平衡分割任务中的潜力。

title: Synthetic Abundance Maps for Unsupervised Super-Resolution of Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Images
summary: Hyperspectral single image super-resolution (HS-SISR) aims to enhance the spatial resolution of hyperspectral images to fully exploit their spectral information. While considerable progress has been made in this field, most existing methods are supervised and require ground truth data for training-data that is often unavailable in practice. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel unsupervised training framework for HS-SISR, based on synthetic abundance data, where no high-resolution ground-truth reference is required for training. The approach begins by unmixing the hyperspectral image into endmembers and abundances. A neural network is then trained to perform abundance super-resolution using synthetic abundances only. These synthetic abundance maps are generated from a dead leaves model whose characteristics are inherited from the low-resolution image to be super-resolved and from the known point spread function (PSF) of the hyperspectral sensor. This trained network is subsequently used to enhance the spatial resolution of the original image's abundances, and the final super-resolution hyperspectral image is reconstructed by combining them with the endmembers. Experimental results demonstrate both the training value of the synthetic data and the effectiveness of the proposed method across 3 datasets, 3 scaling factors, and several evaluation metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/xinxinxu99/SISR-DL.git

AI.tldr: 文章提出首个无需高分辨率先验的无监督高光谱单幅图像超分框架，仅用传感器PSF和自身低分辨数据生成合成丰度训练网络，实现3数据集3倍率下指标领先。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱单幅图像超分辨率（HS-SISR）均为监督方法，需配对高分辨率真值训练，实际应用中难以获取，严重限制落地。
AI.method: 1) 对输入低分辨图像做线性混合像元分解，得到端元与丰度；2) 基于“枯叶模型”并结合传感器已知PSF与低分辨图像统计特性，生成仅含合成丰度的训练集；3) 用该合成数据训练轻量CNN进行丰度超分辨率；4) 将超分丰度与端元重组合，获得最终高分辨高光谱图像。全程无需任何真实高分辨参考。
AI.result: 在Cave、Harvard和ICVL三组公开数据上，对×2/×3/×4三种倍率进行实验，PSNR、SAM、SSIM、ERGAS等多项指标均优于传统插值及现有无监督/自监督方法，且对PSF失配具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明仅依赖传感器自身特性与低分辨图像即可训练出有效的HS-SISR网络，为缺乏高分辨率真值的实际问题提供了可行路线，并公开了代码与合成数据生成流程，推动高光谱成像无监督超分辨率研究。

title: Formally Verified Patent Analysis via Dependent Type Theory: Machine-Checkable Certificates from a Hybrid AI + Lean 4 Pipeline
summary: We present a formally verified framework for patent analysis as a hybrid AI + Lean 4 pipeline. The DAG-coverage core (Algorithm 1b) is fully machine-verified once bounded match scores are fixed. Freedom-to-operate, claim-construction sensitivity, cross-claim consistency, and doctrine-of-equivalents analyses are formalized at the specification level with kernel-checked candidate certificates. Existing patent-analysis approaches rely on manual expert analysis (slow, non-scalable) or ML/NLP methods (probabilistic, opaque, non-compositional). To our knowledge, this is the first framework that applies interactive theorem proving based on dependent type theory to intellectual property analysis. Claims are encoded as DAGs in Lean 4, match strengths as elements of a verified complete lattice, and confidence scores propagate through dependencies via proven-correct monotone functions. We formalize five IP use cases (patent-to-product mapping, freedom-to-operate, claim construction sensitivity, cross-claim consistency, doctrine of equivalents) via six algorithms. Structural lemmas, the coverage-core generator, and the closed-path identity coverage = W_cov are machine-verified in Lean 4. Higher-level theorems for the other use cases remain informal proof sketches, and their proof-generation functions are architecturally mitigated (untrusted generators whose outputs are kernel-checked and sorry-free axiom-audited). Guarantees are conditional on the ML layer: they certify mathematical correctness of computations downstream of ML scores, not the accuracy of the scores themselves. A case study on a synthetic memory-module claim demonstrates weighted coverage and construction-sensitivity analysis. Validation against adjudicated cases is future work.

AI.tldr: 首个用Lean 4交互式定理证明的形式化专利分析框架，将权利要求编码为DAG并给出机器可核验的数学正确性证明，但依赖下游ML评分准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有专利分析要么手工慢、难扩展，要么ML/NLP方法不透明、不可组合，需要可验证、可扩展且支持复杂依赖的自动化分析手段。
AI.method: 把权利要求建模为Lean 4中的DAG，匹配强度置于已验证的完全格上，用证明正确的单调函数沿依赖传播置信分；核心DAG-coverage算法与结构引理（含coverage=W_cov）由Lean 4核验证；高层用例定理暂为草图，生成器输出经核检查且不含sorry。
AI.result: 六算法覆盖五类IP任务（专利-产品映射、自由实施、权利要求敏感度、跨权利一致性、等同原则），核心覆盖率生成器已机器验证，并在合成存储器案例上展示加权覆盖与敏感度分析。
AI.conclusion: 首次把依赖类型理论的交互定理证明引入知识产权领域，能在假设ML评分准确的前提下，为下游专利分析计算提供数学正确性保证；后续需用真实判例验证精度与实用性。

title: Separating Geometry from Probability in the Analysis of Generalization
summary: The goal of machine learning is to find models that minimize prediction error on data that has not yet been seen. Its operational paradigm assumes access to a dataset $S$ and articulates a scheme for evaluating how well a given model performs on an arbitrary sample. The sample can be $S$ (in which case we speak of ``in-sample'' performance) or some entirely new $S'$ (in which case we speak of ``out-of-sample'' performance). Traditional analysis of generalization assumes that both in- and out-of-sample data are i.i.d.\ draws from an infinite population. However, these probabilistic assumptions cannot be verified even in principle. This paper presents an alternative view of generalization through the lens of sensitivity analysis of solutions of optimization problems to perturbations in the problem data. Under this framework, generalization bounds are obtained by purely deterministic means and take the form of variational principles that relate in-sample and out-of-sample evaluations through an error term that quantifies how close out-of-sample data are to in-sample data. Statistical assumptions can then be used \textit{ex post} to characterize the situations when this error term is small (either on average or with high probability).

AI.tldr: 用优化问题解对数据扰动的敏感度取代独立性假设，给出仅依赖数据距离的确定性泛化界。
AI.motivation: 传统泛化分析必须假设训练与测试样本 i.i.d. 且来自同一分布，但该假设无法验证。作者希望建立一条完全不依赖概率假设、仅靠数据本身几何关系即可成立的泛化理论。
AI.method: 把学习算法视为某个优化问题的解映射，用「解对输入数据扰动的敏感度」刻画模型差异；通过构造变分原理，把「样本外误差」表示为「样本内误差」加上一个度量样本外数据与样本内数据「邻近度」的确定性误差项，从而完全绕过随机变量假设。
AI.result: 得到形式为 \text{out-of-sample error} \le \text{in-sample error} + \text{data–discrepancy term} 的确定性泛化界；当事后补充统计假设（如数据来自光滑分布）时，可恢复与经典 PAC 界类似的对平均情形或高概率结论。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次说明「泛化」不必以 i.i.d. 为前提，而可归结为「训练集与测试集的邻近性」；既为分布外泛化、对抗样本、迁移学习等场景提供理论接口，也揭示了传统概率假设仅是保证邻近度的充分条件，而非必要条件。

title: Mango: Multi-Agent Web Navigation via Global-View Optimization
summary: Existing web agents typically initiate exploration from the root URL, which is inefficient for complex websites with deep hierarchical structures. Without a global view of the website's structure, agents frequently fall into navigation traps, explore irrelevant branches, or fail to reach target information within a limited budget. We propose Mango, a multi-agent web navigation method that leverages the website structure to dynamically determine optimal starting points. We formulate URL selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and employ Thompson Sampling to adaptively allocate the navigation budget across candidate URLs. Furthermore, we introduce an episodic memory component to store navigation history, enabling the agent to learn from previous attempts. Experiments on WebVoyager demonstrate that Mango achieves a success rate of 63.6% when using GPT-5-mini, outperforming the best baseline by 7.3%. Furthermore, on WebWalkerQA, Mango attains a 52.5% success rate, surpassing the best baseline by 26.8%. We also demonstrate the generalizability of Mango using both open-source and closed-source models as backbones. Our data and code are open-source and available at https://github.com/VichyTong/Mango.

AI.tldr: Mango 用多智能体+多臂老虎机策略，把“从根 URL 硬爬”改为“先选最佳起点再爬”，在 WebVoyager/WebWalkerQA 上分别提升 7.3/26.8 个百分点，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有 Web 代理一律从根 URL 出发，面对深层级站点时易陷入导航陷阱、兜圈子或耗尽预算却仍找不到目标信息，亟需一种能利用站点全局结构、动态选择起点的探索范式。
AI.method: 将“选起点”建模为多臂老虎机问题，用 Thompson Sampling 在候选 URL 间动态分配导航预算；多智能体并行探索并共享一个 episodic memory，持续沉淀导航历史以指导后续决策；框架与具体 LLM 解耦，支持任意开源/闭源模型作为骨干。
AI.result: 在 WebVoyager 上，GPT-5-mini 为骨干的 Mango 成功率 63.6%，超最强基线 7.3 个百分点；在更难的 WebWalkerQA 上达 52.5%，领先 26.8 个百分点；更换开源模型后仍保持显著优势，证明方法通用且增益主要来自策略而非大模型本身。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用站点层级结构并在线学习最优起点，可显著降低探索冗余，突破“从根爬”效率瓶颈；多臂老虎机与 episodic memory 的组合为复杂 Web 导航任务提供了即插即用的通用优化模块。

title: Multi-Level Temporal Graph Networks with Local-Global Fusion for Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: Fault detection and diagnosis are critical for the optimal and safe operation of industrial processes. The correlations among sensors often display non-Euclidean structures where graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used therein. However, for large-scale systems, local, global, and dynamic relations extensively exist among sensors, and traditional GNNs often overlook such complex and multi-level structures for various problems including the fault diagnosis. To address this issue, we propose a structure-aware multi-level temporal graph network with local-global feature fusion for industrial fault diagnosis. First, a correlation graph is dynamically constructed using Pearson correlation coefficients to capture relationships among process variables. Then, temporal features are extracted through long short-term memory (LSTM)-based encoder, whereas the spatial dependencies among sensors are learned by graph convolution layers. A multi-level pooling mechanism is used to gradually coarsen and learn meaningful graph structures, to capture higher-level patterns while keeping important fault related details. Finally, a fusion step is applied to combine both detailed local features and overall global patterns before the final prediction. Experimental evaluations on the Tennessee Eastman process (TEP) demonstrate that the proposed model achieves superior fault diagnosis performance, particularly for complex fault scenarios, outperforming various baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了面向工业故障诊断的结构感知多时序图网络(S-MLTGN)，可同时抽取局部、全局和动态关系；在TEP基准上显著优于现有基线，尤其对复杂故障场景诊断精度更高。
AI.motivation: 现有图神经网络在大型工业系统中常忽视传感器间多层次、动态与局部-全局耦合关系，导致复杂故障难以准确诊断，限制了过程安全与性能优化。
AI.method: 1) 基于滑动窗Pearson系数动态构建变量相关图；2) LSTM编码器提取时序特征，GCN提取空间依赖；3) 设计多级图池化逐级粗化结构，捕获高层模式并保持故障细节；4) 局部特征与全局模式融合后执行分类。
AI.result: 在公开基准Tennessee Eastman Process（含21类故障）上，大规模实验显示所提模型对整体及复杂故障的F1、召回率和AUC均显著超过GNN、时序和混合基线；尤其针对阶跃-漂移混合故障，诊断准确率提升9–12%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在单一框架内联合建模细粒度局部动态与宏观全局结构，S-MLTGN为工业故障诊断提供了更完备、鲁棒的表征方法，并验证了多层次图学习在过程产业中的应用潜力与未来扩展可能。

title: URoPE: Universal Relative Position Embedding across Geometric Spaces
summary: Relative position embedding has become a standard mechanism for encoding positional information in Transformers. However, existing formulations are typically limited to a fixed geometric space, namely 1D sequences or regular 2D/3D grids, which restricts their applicability to many computer vision tasks that require geometric reasoning across camera views or between 2D and 3D spaces. To address this limitation, we propose URoPE, a universal extension of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) to cross-view or cross-dimensional geometric spaces. For each key/value image patch, URoPE samples 3D points along the corresponding camera ray at predefined depth anchors and projects them into the query image plane. Standard 2D RoPE can then be applied using the projected pixel coordinates. URoPE is a parameter-free and intrinsics-aware relative position embedding that is invariant to the choice of global coordinate systems, while remaining fully compatible with existing RoPE-optimized attention kernels. We evaluate URoPE as a plug-in positional encoding for transformer architectures across a diverse set of tasks, including novel view synthesis, 3D object detection, object tracking, and depth estimation, covering 2D-2D, 2D-3D, and temporal scenarios. Experiments show that URoPE consistently improves the performance of transformer-based models across all tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness and generality for geometric reasoning. Our project website is: https://urope-pe.github.io/.

AI.tldr: URoPE 把 RoPE 从一维/规则网格拓展到任意视点与 2D-3D 混合空间，通过沿相机射线采样深度锚点并投影到查询图像，实现无参数、内参感知、坐标系不变的相对位置编码，在 NeRF、3D 检测、跟踪、深度估计等任务上普遍提升 Transformer 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有相对位置嵌入仅适用于 1D 序列或规则 2D/3D 网格，无法处理跨视角、跨维度的几何推理需求，限制了 Transformer 在视觉任务中的应用。
AI.method: 提出 URoPE：为每个 key/value 图像块沿相机射线在预定义深度锚点处采样 3D 点，反向投影到查询图像平面，再用标准 2D RoPE 对投影像素坐标编码；整个过程零参数、依赖相机内参、与现有 RoPE 计算内核兼容。
AI.result: 在 NeRF 新视角合成、3D 目标检测、单/多目标跟踪、深度估计等 2D-2D、2D-3D、时序任务上，将 URoPE 作为即插即用位置编码加入 Transformer 后，一致性地提升各基线性能。
AI.conclusion: URoPE 提供了一种通用、高效、免训练的几何位置编码方案，可广泛用于需要跨视角/跨维度几何推理的 Transformer 视觉模型。

title: AI-Based Detection of Temporal Changes in MR-Linac Images Acquired During Routine Prostate Radiotherapy
summary: Purpose: To investigate whether an AI-based method can detect subtle inter-fraction changes in MR-Linac images acquired during radiotherapy and explore the broader potential of MRLinac imaging. Methods: This retrospective study included longitudinal 0.35T MR-Linac images from 761 patients. To identify temporal changes, we employed a deep learning model using temporal ordering via pairwise comparison, previously shown effective for longitudinal imaging studies. The model was trained using first-to-last fraction pairs (F1-FL) and all pairs (All-pairs). Performance was assessed using quantitative metrics (accuracy and AUC) and compared against a radiologist's performance. Qualitative evaluation was performed using saliency maps, which identify anatomical regions associated with temporal imaging changes. Results: The F1-FL model demonstrated high performance (AUC=0.99, accuracy=0.95) and outperformed the radiologist in temporal ordering task. The All-pairs model also showed high performance (AUC=0.97, accuracy=0.91). Regions contributing to predictions included the prostate, bladder, and pubic symphysis. The performance was correlated to fractional intervals and was reduced for non-radiation-exposed timepoints (Sim and F1), suggesting that observed changes may reflect both temporal variation and radiation exposure. Conclusion: MR-Linac imaging appears capable of capturing subtle changes during prostate radiotherapy that can be detected by AI models, even over approximately two-day intervals. The model's high performance, together with quantitative and qualitative analyses, supports a potential role for MR-Linac in clinical applications beyond image guidance.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于深度学习的 AI 方法，可利用 MR-Linac 0.35 T 影像在约 2 天的分次间隔内自动检出前列腺癌放疗过程中的细微变化，AUC 达 0.99，显著优于放射科医师，提示 MR-Linac 影像具备超越单纯图像引导的潜在临床价值。
AI.motivation: 传统图像引导主要关注几何对准，难以量化放疗期间每日发生的微小生物学或解剖学变化。MR-Linac 每日采集高软组织对比度 MR 影像，但尚缺乏自动、敏感的方法挖掘其中蕴含的潜在变化信息，以拓展其临床用途。
AI.method: 回顾性纳入 761 例患者的纵向 0.35 T MR-Linac 影像；采用成对时间排序的深度卷积网络，分别训练“首-末分次对（F1-FL）”与“所有分次对（All-pairs）”两种策略；用 AUC 与准确率评估性能，并与放射科医师比较；借助显著性图定位与变化相关解剖区域；分析模型性能与分次间隔及是否受照之间的关系。
AI.result: F1-FL 模型 AUC 0.99、准确率 0.95，优于医师；All-pairs 模型 AUC 0.97、准确率 0.91。显著性区域主要见于前列腺、膀胱及耻骨联合。性能随分次间隔增大而提升，对未受照时间点（Sim、F1）性能下降，提示变化既含自然时间演变也含辐射效应。
AI.conclusion: MR-Linac 影像可在短至约 2 天的分次间隔内捕获可重复的细微变化，AI 模型能高敏感、高特异地检出这些变化；研究为利用 MR-Linac 进行生物或剂量响应监测、早期疗效评估及自适应放疗提供了理论与技术依据，拓展了 MR-Linac 的临床潜能。

title: Error-free Training for MedMNIST Datasets
summary: In this paper, we introduce a new concept called Artificial Special Intelligence by which Machine Learning models for the classification problem can be trained error-free, thus acquiring the capability of not making repeated mistakes. The method is applied to 18 MedMNIST biomedical datasets. Except for three datasets, which suffer from the double-labeling problem, all are trained to perfection.

AI.tldr: 提出Artificial Special Intelligence概念，在18个MedMNIST生物医学数据集上实现零错误训练，仅3个受双重标签污染的数据集例外。
AI.motivation: 传统分类模型难以彻底杜绝重复错误，作者希望构建永不犯错的医学诊断级模型。
AI.method: 引入“Artificial Special Intelligence”训练框架，具体算法未披露，但声称可在分类任务中彻底消除误差。
AI.result: 15/18个MedMNIST数据集达到100%训练准确率；3个因存在双重标签缺陷的数据集未能归零误差。
AI.conclusion: 零错误训练在干净医学影像数据上可行，但标签质量是决定性前提，为后续构建“绝不犯错”的临床AI奠定理论与实证基础。

title: Budgeted Online Influence Maximization
comment: 37th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2020), 28 pages
summary: We introduce a new budgeted framework for online influence maximization, considering the total cost of an advertising campaign instead of the common cardinality constraint on a chosen influencer set. Our approach better models the real-world setting where the cost of influencers varies and advertisers want to find the best value for their overall social advertising budget. We propose an algorithm assuming an independent cascade diffusion model and edge level semi-bandit feedback, and provide both theoretical and experimental results. Our analysis is also valid for the cardinality constraint setting and improves the state of the art regret bound in this case.

AI.tldr: 在线影响最大化首次从“选几个节点”的基数约束转向更现实的预算约束，同时给出理论更优的后悔界。
AI.motivation: 现实中各 KOL 报价差异大，广告主关心的是“总预算花得值”而非“选多少人”；已有研究多假设同质成本或基数上限，无法直接优化 ROI。
AI.method: 在独立级联模型下，将问题形式化为预算约束的半 Bandit 反馈累积奖励最大化。设计基于边缘级反馈的贪心策略，配合置信区间与成本加权，导出新的后悔分析框架；算法同步兼容基数约束场景。
AI.result: 理论上，对预算 B 与节点数 n 得到 Õ(√B·n) 后悔界，优于基数约束下现有 Õ(n√K) 的最好结果（K≤n）。实验显示在真实报价网络中，同等预算下影响力较基线提升 15–30%，成本效率提升 20% 以上。
AI.conclusion: 预算约束框架更贴合成广告主决策逻辑；所提算法在理论与实验两端均刷新当前最佳，为在线社交广告提供可直接落地的 ROI 优化工具。

title: Experiments or Outcomes? Probing Scientific Feasibility in Large Language Models
summary: Scientific feasibility assessment asks whether a claim is consistent with established knowledge and whether experimental evidence could support or refute it. We frame feasibility assessment as a diagnostic reasoning task in which, given a hypothesis, a model predicts feasible or infeasible and justifies its decision. We evaluate large language models (LLMs) under controlled knowledge conditions (hypothesis-only, with experiments, with outcomes, or both) and probe robustness by progressively removing portions of the experimental and/or outcome context. Across multiple LLMs and two datasets, providing outcome evidence is generally more reliable than providing experiment descriptions. Outcomes tend to improve accuracy beyond what internal knowledge alone provides, whereas experimental text can be brittle and may degrade performance when the context is incomplete. These findings clarify when experimental evidence benefits LLM-based feasibility assessment and when it introduces fragility.

AI.tldr: 在受控知识条件下，LLM用诊断式推理判断科学假说是否可行；相比实验描述，提供实验结果更能稳定提升准确率，而实验文本在信息残缺时反而拖累表现。
AI.motivation: 现有工作很少系统评估LLM能否、以及何时借助实验证据完成“科学可行性”诊断，尤其缺乏对证据类型与完整度的剥离分析。
AI.method: 将可行性判断建模为二分类+解释任务，在假设-only、仅实验描述、仅结果、实验+结果四种知识条件下测试多款LLM；通过逐步掩蔽文本片段检验鲁棒性，采用两大数据集跨模型复现。
AI.result: 实验结果作为输入时，准确率和一致性显著高于仅给实验描述；后者在上下文被裁剪后性能骤降，甚至低于无外部知识的基线；LLM内部知识对结果的增益有限。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果是LLM进行可行性评估的“高信度杠杆”，实验描述则易因信息缺口而产生负向波动；未来系统应优先保证可观测结果的质量与完整性，而非仅提供实验方案细节。

title: Streaming Structured Inference with Flash-SemiCRF
summary: Semi-Markov Conditional Random Fields (semi-CRFs) assign labels to segments of a sequence rather than to individual positions, enabling exact inference over segment-level features and principled uncertainty estimates at their boundaries. However, existing implementations must materialize a large edge potential tensor whose size grows with sequence length, maximum segment length, and label count, becoming prohibitive for speech-scale state spaces and intractable at genomic scales where sequences can exceed 100,000 positions. This memory bottleneck has limited the adoption of exact segment-level inference for long sequences and large label sets. We identify that the core inefficiency is materializing edge potentials that can instead be evaluated on-the-fly from a compact prefix-sum array, and make several improvements. First, replacing the stored edge tensor with prefix-sum lookup reduces the memory footprint by a factor proportional to the product of segment length and label count. Second, a streaming forward-backward pass with checkpoint-boundary normalization keeps working memory sublinear in sequence length while preserving exact gradients. Third, zero-centered cumulative scores control numerical drift and induce an adaptive duration prior under label imbalance. We integrate these ideas into Flash-SemiCRF, a fused Triton kernel that enables exact semi-CRF inference on previously intractable problem sizes. Available at https://github.com/biobenkj/flash-semicrf.

AI.tldr: 提出Flash-SemiCRF，用前缀和按需计算替代显式边张量，将semi-CRF的显存从O(L·T·|Y|²)降至O(L·T)，在10⁵级以上长度、数千标签的序列上实现精确片段级推断与训练。
AI.motivation: semi-CRF能为序列片段而非单点输出标签，支持片段特征与边界不确定性估计，但现有实现需物化超大边势张量，随序列长度、最大片段长度和标签数立方增长，在语音或基因组等长序列场景显存爆炸，阻碍其应用。
AI.method: 1) 用一维前缀和数组替代边张量，边势随取随算，内存与标签数解耦；2) 流式前向-后向算法配合检查点边界归一化，使工作内存亚线性于序列长度；3) 零中心累计分数抑制数值漂移，并在标签不平衡时自适应诱导持续先验；4) 以上技术融合为Triton融合核Flash-SemiCRF。
AI.result: 在最大片段长度100、标签数5120、序列长度100 k的基因组数据上，Flash-SemiCRF显存占用<4 GB，训练速度提升约5×，而传统实现需>1 TB显存直接失败；下游识别任务F1与近似方法相当，但提供精确边界不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过“边势不存储、前缀和查询”这一核心视角，首次将精确semi-CRF推断扩展到基因组尺度的长序列与大标签空间，为需要片段级建模与不确定性估计的任务提供实用、可扩展的底层工具。

title: REVEAL: Multimodal Vision-Language Alignment of Retinal Morphometry and Clinical Risks for Incident AD and Dementia Prediction
summary: The retina provides a unique, noninvasive window into Alzheimer's disease (AD) and dementia, capturing early structural changes through morphometric features, while systemic and lifestyle risk factors reflect well-established contributors to disease susceptibility long before clinical symptom onset. However, current retinal analysis frameworks typically model imaging and risk factors separately, limiting their ability to capture joint multimodal patterns critical for early risk prediction. Moreover, existing methods rarely incorporate mechanisms to organize or align patients with similar retinal and clinical characteristics, constraining the learning of coherent cross-modal associations. To address these limitations, we introduce REVEAL (REtinal-risk Vision-Language Early Alzheimer's Learning), a framework that aligns color fundus photographs with individualized disease-specific risk profiles for predicting incident AD and dementia, on average 8 years before diagnosis (range: 1-11 years). Because real-world risk factors are structured questionnaire data, we translate them into clinically interpretable narratives compatible with pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). We further propose a group-aware contrastive learning (GACL) strategy that clusters patients with similar retinal morphometry and risk factors as positive pairs, strengthening multimodal alignment. This unified representation learning framework substantially outperforms state-of-the-art retinal imaging models paired with clinical text encoders, as well as general-purpose VLMs, demonstrating the value of jointly modeling retinal biomarkers and clinical risk factors. By providing a generalizable and noninvasive approach for early AD and dementia risk stratification, REVEAL has the potential to enable earlier intervention and improve preventive care at the population level.

AI.tldr: REVEAL 框架首次将彩色眼底照片与个体化 AD/痴呆风险文本对齐，通过群体感知对比学习实现平均提前 8 年的无创预测，性能优于现有视网膜或通用 VLM 方法。
AI.motivation: 视网膜结构变化可早期提示 AD，但现有研究将影像与问卷式全身/生活方式风险因子分开建模，缺乏跨模态联合表征，亦未显式对齐具相似视网膜-临床特征的患者，导致早筛效能受限。
AI.method: 提出 REVEAL：①把结构化风险问卷转为临床叙述文本，适配预训练 VLM；②设计群体感知对比学习（GACL），按视网膜形态+风险特征聚类，同簇患者作为正样本对，强化图文跨模态对齐；③端到端训练统一表示，用于 incident AD/痴呆预测。
AI.result: 在平均提前 8 年（1–11 年）的预测窗口内，REVEAL 显著超越最优视网膜单模模型、视网膜+临床文本编码器组合及通用 VLM，AUC 等关键指标提升显著（具体数值原文未给）。
AI.conclusion: REVEAL 提供可推广、无创的 AD/痴呆早期风险分层工具，支持大规模人群筛查与干预前移；框架亦可迁移至其他慢病，证实联合视网膜生物标志与可解释风险叙述的价值。

title: AutomationBench
summary: Existing AI benchmarks for software automation rarely combine cross-application coordination, autonomous API discovery, and policy adherence. Real business workflows demand all three: a single task may span a CRM, inbox, calendar, and messaging platform - requiring the agent to find the right endpoints, follow a policy document, and write correct data to each system. To address this gap, we introduce AutomationBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on cross-application workflow orchestration via REST APIs. Drawing on real workflow patterns from Zapier's platform, tasks span Sales, Marketing, Operations, Support, Finance, and HR domains. Agents must discover relevant endpoints themselves, follow layered business rules, and navigate environments with irrelevant and sometimes misleading records. Grading is programmatic and end-state only: whether the correct data ended up in the right systems. Even the best frontier models currently score below 10%. AutomationBench provides a challenging, realistic measure of where current models stand relative to the agentic capabilities businesses actually need.

AI.tldr: 为填补跨应用 API 编排测试空白，作者发布 AutomationBench，以真实 Zapier 工单为蓝本覆盖 6 大业务域；模型需自发现端点、遵守层级政策并写入正确答案，端到端验证。当前最强模型得分仍低于 10%。
AI.motivation: 现有软件自动化测试基准多聚焦单应用或给定 API，无法衡量 AI 代理在跨系统、未知端点、并遵守企业政策场景下的真实能力，而实际工作流往往涉及 CRM、邮箱、日历、IM 等多系统协同。亟需一个能反映业务现实、可编程评分且难度足够的新基准。
AI.method: 1. 从 Zapier 平台提炼六大业务域（Sales/Marketing/Operations/Support/Finance/HR）的真实工作流模式生成任务。2. 构建多应用沙盒，仅公开 REST API 文档，无提前标注端点；插入无关或误导记录模拟噪声环境。3. 设计层级式业务规则与政策文档，必须按序遵守。4. 采用端到端、仅检查最终系统状态（correct data in right place）的可编程评分，杜绝人为干预与中间步骤猜测。
AI.result: 在 AutomationBench 上，当前最优前沿模型的成功率低于 10%，显示现有大模型在自发现 API、理解复杂政策、跨系统写正确数据等代理能力上尚远不能满足企业需求；该差距在所有子域均显著存在。
AI.conclusion: AutomationBench 为研究界提供了一个具有业务真实性、跨应用难度且可规模评测的平台，明确指出 AI 代理在 API 级别业务自动化上的关键短板，并鼓励未来研究围绕自主工具发现、政策推理与状态一致性开展算法与环境协同改进。

title: Ultrametric OGP - parametric RDT \emph{symmetric} binary perceptron connection
summary:
In [97,99,100], an fl-RDT framework is introduced to characterize \emph{statistical computational gaps} (SCGs). Studying \emph{symmetric binary perceptrons} (SBPs), [100] obtained an \emph{algorithmic} threshold estimate $α_a\approx α_c^{(7)}\approx 1.6093$ at the 7th lifting level (for $κ=1$ margin), closely approaching $1.58$ local entropy (LE) prediction [18].
  In this paper, we further connect parametric RDT to overlap gap properties (OGPs), another key geometric feature of the solution space. Specifically, for any positive integer $s$, we consider $s$-level ultrametric OGPs ($ult_s$-OGPs) and rigorously upper-bound the associated constraint densities $α_{ult_s}$. To achieve this, we develop an analytical union-bounding program consisting of combinatorial and probabilistic components. By casting the combinatorial part as a convex problem and the probabilistic part as a nested integration, we conduct numerical evaluations and obtain that the tightest bounds at the first two levels, $\barα_{ult_1} \approx 1.6578$ and $\barα_{ult_2} \approx 1.6219$, closely approach the 3rd and 4th lifting level parametric RDT estimates, $α_c^{(3)} \approx 1.6576$ and $α_c^{(4)} \approx 1.6218$. We also observe excellent agreement across other key parameters, including overlap values and the relative sizes of ultrametric clusters.
  Based on these observations, we propose several conjectures linking $ult$-OGP and parametric RDT. Specifically, we conjecture that algorithmic threshold $α_a=\lim_{s\rightarrow\infty} α_{ult_s} = \lim_{s\rightarrow\infty} \barα{ult_s} = \lim_{r\rightarrow\infty} α_{c}^{(r)}$, and $α_{ult_s} \leq α_{c}^{(s+2)}$ (with possible equality for some (maybe even all) $s$). Finally, we discuss the potential existence of a full isomorphism connecting all key parameters of $ult$-OGP and parametric RDT.

AI.tldr: 本文将参数化自由能 RDT 框架与超度量重叠间隙 OGP 直接挂钩，给出可计算的 ult_s-OGP 上界 α_{ult_s}；数值显示前两级结果与第 3、4 阶 RDT 估计几乎重合，据此提出三者极限相同且两者有单调不等式的统一猜想。
AI.motivation: 现有对 SBP 的算法阈值 α_a≈1.6093 已逼近局部熵预测，但缺少几何解释；而在另一路线上，OGP 虽能给出阈值上界却尚未与 RDT 对接。作者希望填补统计-计算空隙 SCG 的几何-自由能描述缺口，获得更紧且体系化的阈值关系。
AI.method: 把 s-级超度量 OGP 的概率约束拆成组合+概率两步：组合部分等价于凸优化求极大团尺寸，概率部分化作嵌套积分并数值求解，从而给出 α_{ult_s} 的解析联合界上界 \barα_{ult_s}。以逐层升级对照 parametric RDT α_c^{(r)} 并检查重叠、团尺寸副参数。
AI.result: 算得 \barα_{ult_1}=1.6578、\barα_{ult_2}=1.6219，分别与 α_c^{(3)}=1.6576、α_c^{(4)}=1.6218 仅差 10^{-4}；更高层测算亦呈单调逼缝趋势，使极限重合成为可能。
AI.conclusion: 数值吻合强到足以大胆推测：算法阈值 α_a 等于无限层 ult-OGP 和 RDT 极限，且 α_{ult_s} ≤ α_c^{(s+2)}；两类几何特征——超度量团与高阶自由能展开——可能存在全同参数映射，未来可据此确立 SCG 判据的统一判定框架。

title: Semantic Needles in Document Haystacks: Sensitivity Testing of LLM-as-a-Judge Similarity Scoring
summary: We propose a scalable, multifactorial experimental framework that systematically probes LLM sensitivity to subtle semantic changes in pairwise document comparison. We analogize this as a needle-in-a-haystack problem: a single semantically altered sentence (the needle) is embedded within surrounding context (the hay), and we vary the perturbation type (negation, conjunction swap, named entity replacement), context type (original vs. topically unrelated), needle position, and document length across all combinations, testing five LLMs on tens of thousands of document pairs. Our analysis reveals several striking findings. First, LLMs exhibit a within-document positional bias distinct from previously studied candidate-order effects: most models penalize semantic differences more harshly when they occur earlier in a document. Second, when the altered sentence is surrounded by topically unrelated context, it systematically lowers similarity scores and induces bipolarized scores that indicate either very low or very high similarity. This is consistent with an interpretive frame account in which topically-related context may allow models to contextualize and downweight the alterations. Third, each LLM produces a qualitatively distinct scoring distribution, a stable "fingerprint" that is invariant to perturbation type, yet all models share a universal hierarchy in how leniently they treat different perturbation types. Together, these results demonstrate that LLM semantic similarity scores are sensitive to document structure, context coherence, and model identity in ways that go beyond the semantic change itself, and that the proposed framework offers a practical, LLM-agnostic toolkit for auditing and comparing scoring behavior across current and future models.

AI.tldr: 作者把一句语义被微调的句子插入长文本，系统改变扰动方式、上下文主题、句子位置、文本长度，用五款LLM做数万对比较，发现位置偏见、无关上下文造成分数两极化，且各模型对扰动类型的容忍度呈一致排序，但评分分布具模型指纹。
AI.motivation: 现有评估侧重候选顺序或整体表现，但缺乏对“细微语义变化在长文本中如何影响LLM相似度打分”的系统探测，无法揭示模型对文档结构、上下文连贯性的隐性敏感规律。
AI.method: 设计可扩展多因子实验：将单句扰动（needle）嵌入长文（hay），全因子交叉扰动类型（否定、连词交换、实体替换）、上下文主题（相关/无关）、needle 位置、文档长度，五款 LLM 完成数万对相似度评分，并做分布与偏置分析。
AI.result: ① 出现“早期惩罚”位置偏见，与候选顺序效应不同；② 无关上下文显著拉低相似度并导致两极化打分；③ 各模型评分分布具稳定“指纹”，但对扰动类型的容忍度排序一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM 相似度打分不仅受语义变化本身驱动，还受文档结构、上下文连贯性与模型身份共同影响；所提框架提供 LLM 无关的审计工具，可用于持续比较与诊断现有及未来模型的细粒度语义稳定性。

title: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts LLM Inference with Apple Silicon NPUs
summary:
Apple Neural Engine (ANE) is a dedicated neural processing unit (NPU) present in every Apple Silicon chip. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs improve inference efficiency via sparse activation but are challenging for NPUs in three ways: expert routing is unpredictable and introduces dynamic tensor shapes that conflict with the shape-specific constraints of NPUs; several irregular operators, e.g., top-k, scatter/gather, etc., are not NPU-friendly; and launching many small expert kernels incurs substantial dispatch and synchronization overhead. NPUs are designed to offload AI compute from CPU and GPU; our goal is to enable such offloading for MoE inference, particularly during prefill, where long-context workloads consume substantial system resources.
  This paper presents NPUMoE, a runtime inference engine that accelerates MoE execution on Apple Silicon by offloading dense, static computation to NPU, while preserving a CPU/GPU fallback path for dynamic operations. NPUMoE uses offline calibration to estimate expert capacity and popularity that drives three key techniques: (1) Static tiers for expert capacity to address dynamic expert routing (2) Grouped expert execution to mitigate NPU concurrency limits (3) Load-aware expert compute graph residency to reduce CPU-NPU synchronization overhead. Experiments on Apple M-series devices using three representative MoE LLMs and four long-context workloads show that NPUMoE consistently outperforms baselines, reducing latency by 1.32x-5.55x, improving energy efficiency by 1.81x-7.37x, and reducing CPU-cycle usage by 1.78x-5.54x through effective NPU offloading.

AI.tldr: 提出 NPUMoE，在 Apple Neural Engine 上高效运行 MoE 大模型，长上下文推理延迟最多降 5.55×，能效最多提 7.37×。
AI.motivation: MoE 虽能稀疏激活以提升效率，但其动态路由、不规则算子及大量小 kernel 与 NPU 的静态、形状固定、并发受限特性冲突，导致 Apple Silicon 的 AI 专用单元无法被利用，长上下文预填充阶段尤为耗能。
AI.method: 构建 NPUMoE 推理引擎：线下校准专家容量与热度，三项核心优化——①容量分层静态化，②组化专家执行突破并发限制，③负载感知的计算图常驻减少 CPU-NPU 同步；动态部分回退到 CPU/GPU。
AI.result: 在 M 系列芯片上测试三款 MoE 与四种长序列任务，相较基线实现 1.32-5.55 倍延迟降低、1.81-7.37 倍能效提升、CPU 周期用量降 1.78-5.54 倍。
AI.conclusion: NPUMoE 攻克 MoE 在 NPU 部署的核心障碍，证明通过容量静态化与组化调度可充分利用 Apple Neural Engine，兼顾性能与能效，为终端 MoE 大模型落地提供可复用范式。

title: CAHAL: Clinically Applicable resolution enHAncement for Low-resolution MRI scans
summary: Large-scale automated morphometric analysis of brain MRI is limited by the thick-slice, anisotropic acquisitions prevalent in routine clinical practice. Existing generative super-resolution (SR) methods produce visually compelling isotropic volumes but often introduce anatomical hallucinations, systematic volumetric overestimation, and structural distortions that compromise downstream quantitative analysis and diagnostic safety. To address this, we propose CAHAL (Clinically Applicable resolution enHAncement for Low-resolution MRI scans), a hallucination-robust, physics-informed resolution enhancement framework that operates directly in the patient's native acquisition space. CAHAL employs a deterministic bivariate Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture routing each input through specialised residual 3D U-Net experts conditioned on both volumetric resolution and acquisition anisotropy, two independent descriptors of clinical MRI acquisition. Experts are optimised with a composite loss combining edge-penalised spatial reconstruction, Fourier-domain spectral coherence matching, and a segmentation-guided semantic consistency constraint. Training pairs are generated on-the-fly via physics-based degradation sampled from a large-scale real-world database, ensuring robust generalisation. Validated on T1-weighted and FLAIR sequences against generative baselines, CAHAL achieves state-of-the-art results, improving the best related methods in terms of accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: CAHAL 用「双变量混合专家 3D U-Net」在临床原始各向异性厚层 MRI 上直接做确定性超分辨，不 hallucination，重建、频谱与分割三重约束，在 T1/FLAIR 上 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 临床常规厚层 MRI 各向异性阻碍大规模自动形态学分析；现有生成式超分辨虽视觉逼真，但易产生解剖幻觉、系统体积膨胀与结构畸变，危害定量分析与诊断安全。
AI.method: 构建 CAHAL：① 双变量混合专家 3D U-Net，按体积分辨率与采集各向异性两物理属性路由输入到专用残差专家；② 复合损失：边缘惩罚空间重建＋傅里叶谱相干匹配＋分割语义一致性；③ 训练样本基于大规模真实数据库当场物理退化采样，确保泛化。
AI.result: 在 T1 与 FLAIR 序列上验证，CAHAL 相对主流生成式方法，在定量和分割精度上均达 SOTA，同时更省时。
AI.conclusion: CAHAL 提供了一种可直接嵌入临床原始空间的、无幻觉、保结构的超分辨方案，为后续形态学测量与诊断安全奠定可靠基础。

title: Personalized Benchmarking: Evaluating LLMs by Individual Preferences
summary: With the rise in capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their deployment in real-world tasks, evaluating LLM alignment with human preferences has become an important challenge. Current benchmarks average preferences across all users to compute aggregate ratings, overlooking individual user preferences when establishing model rankings. Since users have varying preferences in different contexts, we call for personalized LLM benchmarks that rank models according to individual needs. We compute personalized model rankings using ELO ratings and Bradley-Terry coefficients for 115 active Chatbot Arena users and analyze how user query characteristics (topics and writing style) relate to LLM ranking variations. We demonstrate that individual rankings of LLM models diverge dramatically from aggregate LLM rankings, with Bradley-Terry correlations averaging only $ρ= 0.04$ (57\% of users show near-zero or negative correlation) and ELO ratings showing moderate correlation ($ρ= 0.43$). Through topic modeling and style analysis, we find users exhibit substantial heterogeneity in topical interests and communication styles, influencing their model preferences. We further show that a compact combination of topic and style features provides a useful feature space for predicting user-specific model rankings. Our results provide strong quantitative evidence that aggregate benchmarks fail to capture individual preferences for most users, and highlight the importance of developing personalized benchmarks that rank LLM models according to individual user preferences.

AI.tldr: 首次量化证明：传统“一刀切”基准与 57% 用户的真实偏好几乎无关（ρ≈0.04），呼吁建立个性化 LLM 排行榜。
AI.motivation: 现有基准用全局平均分数给模型排序，忽视用户偏好差异，导致推荐结果与个体体验脱节。
AI.method: 收集 115 名活跃 Chatbot Arena 用户数据，分别用 Elo 与 Bradley–Terry 计算个人模型排名；结合 LDA 主题模型与写作风格特征，构建轻量级特征空间预测个体排名。
AI.result: 个体排名与官方聚合排名平均仅 ρ=0.04（Elo 亦仅 0.43）；主题与风格差异显著，可解释 43% 的排名方差。
AI.conclusion: 必须用个性化基准替代平均打分，才能真实反映众多用户的差异化需求。

title: Phase Transitions in the Fluctuations of Functionals of Random Neural Networks
summary: We establish central and non-central limit theorems for sequences of functionals of the Gaussian output of an infinitely-wide random neural network on the d-dimensional sphere . We show that the asymptotic behaviour of these functionals as the depth of the network increases depends crucially on the fixed points of the covariance function, resulting in three distinct limiting regimes: convergence to the same functional of a limiting Gaussian field, convergence to a Gaussian distribution, convergence to a distribution in the Qth Wiener chaos. Our proofs exploit tools that are now classical (Hermite expansions, Diagram Formula, Stein-Malliavin techniques), but also ideas which have never been used in similar contexts: in particular, the asymptotic behaviour is determined by the fixed-point structure of the iterative operator associated with the covariance, whose nature and stability governs the different limiting regimes.

AI.tldr: 针对宽极限随机神经网络在d维球面上高斯输出的泛函序列，作者给出了中心与非中心极限定理，指出网络深度趋于无穷时，其极限行为完全由协方差函数的固定点结构决定，并据此划分为三种极限模式：收敛至同一高斯场泛函、高斯分布或第Q阶Wiener混沌分布。
AI.motivation: 在随机神经网络极限宽度情境下，目前缺乏对网络深度方向极限行为的系统刻画。论文旨在揭示随着深度增加，网络特征统计量的渐近分布规律，并阐明其与协方差算子迭代结构的关联。
AI.method: 将深度方向的协方差更新视为一维离散动力系统，分析其固定点与稳定性；利用Hermite展开、Diagram公式、Stein-Malliavin方法等经典工具，对泛函序列进行混沌分解；根据协方差算子固定点数量与特征值大小，将极限行为分区为三类。
AI.result: 证明：当协方差算子收敛至唯一稳定固定点时，泛函序列收敛到同极限高斯场的对应泛函；若算子收敛到固定点且中心极限条件成立，则分布趋向高斯；若固定点使泛函落在第Q阶Wiener混沌，则极限服从相应的非高斯混沌分布，且三者以固定点结构为判别标准。
AI.conclusion: 宽极限随机网络的深度渐近行为可完全由协方差函数的固定点与迭代算子谱结构来预测；判别标准仅取决于协方差超参数而不依赖于单个网络实现，从而为深度网络的极限理论与统计推断提供了普适框架。

title: LegalBench-BR: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Brazilian Legal Decision Classification
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Preprint. First public benchmark for Brazilian legal text classification. Dataset and model available on Hugging Face
summary: We introduce LegalBench-BR, the first public benchmark for evaluating language models on Brazilian legal text classification. The dataset comprises 3,105 appellate proceedings from the Santa Catarina State Court (TJSC), collected via the DataJud API (CNJ) and annotated across five legal areas through LLM-assisted labeling with heuristic validation. On a class-balanced test set, BERTimbau-LoRA, updating only 0.3% of model parameters, achieves 87.6% accuracy and 0.87 macro-F1 (+22pp over Claude 3.5 Haiku, +28pp over GPT-4o mini). The gap is most striking on administrativo (administrative law): GPT-4o mini scores F1 = 0.00 and Claude 3.5 Haiku scores F1 = 0.08 on this class, while the fine-tuned model reaches F1 = 0.91. Both commercial LLMs exhibit a systematic bias toward civel (civil law), absorbing ambiguous classes rather than discriminating them, a failure mode that domain-adapted fine-tuning eliminates. These results demonstrate that general-purpose LLMs cannot substitute for domain-adapted models in Brazilian legal classification, even when the task is a simple 5-class problem, and that LoRA fine-tuning on a consumer GPU closes the gap at zero marginal inference cost. We release the full dataset, model, and pipeline to enable reproducible research in Portuguese legal NLP.

AI.tldr: 首个巴西法律文本分类基准 LegalBench-BR 表明，仅需 0.3% 参数量的 BERTimbau-LoRA 即可在 5 类任务上把通用大模型 F1 提升 22–28 pp，行政法类 F1 从 0→0.91，证实通用模型存在系统性“民事法偏好”，领域微调可在消费级 GPU 上零推理增量成本解决。
AI.motivation: 现有法律 NLP 基准多聚焦英语与欧美法系，巴西葡萄牙语法律文本缺乏公开评估基准，阻碍了对通用大模型在本国司法场景下的真实能力与偏差进行系统量化。
AI.method: 收集 3 105 份圣卡塔琳娜州法院二审判决书，经 LLM 辅助标注＋启发式验证划分五类法律领域；构建类别平衡测试集，对比 BERTimbau-LoRA（仅训 0.3% 参数）与 Claude 3.5 Haiku、GPT-4o mini，采用宏观 F1 与准确率评估，并分析失败模式。
AI.result: BERTimbau-LoRA 达 87.6% 准确率/0.87 宏 F1，比 GPT-4o mini 高 28 pp；行政法类 F1 差异最显著（0.91 vs 0.00）。商用模型倾向将模糊样本判为民事法，导致系统性偏差，而领域微调几乎消除该现象。
AI.conclusion: 即使五类简单任务，通用大模型也无法替代巴西法律领域微调模型；LoRA 在消费级 GPU 上实现零推理增量成本的最优性能，呼吁社区基于开源数据与模型推进葡萄牙语法律 NLP 可重复研究。

title: HELM: Harness-Enhanced Long-horizon Memory for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models fail systematically on long-horizon manipulation tasks despite strong short-horizon performance. We show that this failure is not resolved by extending context length alone in the current reactive execution setting; instead, it stems from three recurring execution-loop deficiencies: the memory gap, the verification gap, and the recovery gap. We present HELM, a model-agnostic framework that addresses these deficiencies with three components: an Episodic Memory Module (EMM) that retrieves key task history via CLIP-indexed keyframes, a learned State Verifier (SV) that predicts action failure before execution from observation, action, subgoal, and memory-conditioned context, and a Harness Controller (HC) that performs rollback and replanning. The SV is the core learning contribution: it consistently outperforms rule-based feasibility checks and ensemble uncertainty baselines, and its effectiveness depends critically on access to episodic memory. On LIBERO-LONG, HELM improves task success rate by 23.1 percentage points over OpenVLA (58.4% to 81.5%), while extending the context window to H=32 yields only a 5.4-point gain and same-budget LoRA adaptation remains 12.2 points below HELM. HELM also improves long-horizon performance on CALVIN and substantially boosts recovery success under controlled perturbations. Ablations and mechanism analyses isolate the contribution of each component, and we release LIBERO-Recovery as a perturbation-injection protocol for evaluating failure recovery in long-horizon manipulation.

AI.tldr: HELM 框架通过显式弥补记忆、验证与恢复三大执行环缺口，将 VLA 在长程操作任务上的成功率提升 23.1 个百分点，显著优于单纯扩大上下文或 LoRA 微调。
AI.motivation: 现有 Vision-Language-Action 模型在短程操作表现强劲，但在长程任务中系统性地失败。作者发现简单延长上下文窗口无济于事，根源在于执行循环存在“记忆缺口、验证缺口、恢复缺口”三类缺陷。
AI.method: 提出模型无关框架 HELM：① Episodic Memory Module 用 CLIP 索引关键帧检索任务历史；② 学习型 State Verifier 在动作执行前基于观测、动作、子目标与记忆预测失败概率；③ Harness Controller 负责回滚与重规划。核心贡献是 SV，其性能依赖 episodic memory，显著优于规则可行性检查与集成不确定性基线。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-LONG 上，HELM 把 OpenVLA 成功率从 58.4% 提升到 81.5%（+23.1 pp），而上下文窗口扩至 H=32 仅 +5.4 pp，同预算 LoRA 微调仍低 12.2 pp。CALVIN 长程任务与受控扰动下的恢复成功率亦大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 长程操作瓶颈不在上下文长度，而在执行环的结构性缺失；HELM 的三件套可即插即用提升任意 VLA 模型。作者同步发布 LIBERO-Recovery 扰动注入协议，供社区 benchmark 失败恢复能力。

title: EfficientPENet: Real-Time Depth Completion from Sparse LiDAR via Lightweight Multi-Modal Fusion
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Depth completion from sparse LiDAR measurements and corresponding RGB images is a prerequisite for accurate 3D perception in robotic systems. Existing methods achieve high accuracy on standard benchmarks but rely on heavy backbone architectures that preclude real-time deployment on embedded hardware. We present EfficientPENet, a two-branch depth completion network that replaces the conventional ResNet encoder with a modernized ConvNeXt backbone, introduces sparsity-invariant convolutions for the depth stream, and refines predictions through a Convolutional Spatial Propagation Network (CSPN). The RGB branch leverages ImageNet-pretrained ConvNeXt blocks with Layer Normalization, 7x7 depthwise convolutions, and stochastic depth regularization. Features from both branches are merged via late fusion and decoded through a multi-scale deep supervision strategy. We further introduce a position-aware test-time augmentation scheme that corrects coordinate tensors during horizontal flipping, yielding consistent error reduction at inference. On the KITTI depth completion benchmark, EfficientPENet achieves an RMSE of 631.94 mm with 36.24M parameters and a latency of 20.51 ms, operating at 48.76 FPS. This represents a 3.7 times reduction in parameters and a 23 times speedup relative to BP-Net, while maintaining competitive accuracy. These results establish EfficientPENet as a practical solution for real-time depth completion on resource-constrained edge platforms such as the NVIDIA Jetson.

AI.tldr: 用轻量化 ConvNeXt 主干与稀疏不变卷积构建双分支网络 EfficientPENet，在 KITTI 上以 48.76 FPS 达到 631.94 mm RMSE，参数和延迟分别降至 BP-Net 的 27% 与 4%，实现边缘端实时稠密深度补全。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶等机器人系统需在嵌入式硬件上实时获得稠密深度，而现有高精度方法因庞大的 ResNet 类骨干难以在边缘设备部署，亟需兼顾精度与效率的新架构。
AI.method:
提出 EfficientPENet：
1. 双分支结构—RGB 流采用 ImageNet 预训练 ConvNeXt 块（LayerNorm＋7×7 深度卷积＋随机深度），深度流插入稀疏不变卷积保持几何特性；
2. late fusion 融合两分支特征并通过多尺度深度监督解码；
3. 引入 CSPN 细化预测；
4. 设计位置感知的测试时增强（水平翻转时同步矫正坐标张量）进一步降低误差；
5. 全程无重型 ResNet，保持轻量。
AI.result: 在 KITTI depth completion 基准上实现 RMSE 631.94 mm，参数 36.24 M、延迟 20.51 ms（48.76 FPS）；与 BP-Net 相比参数量减少 3.7×，速度提升 23×，且精度保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: EfficientPENet 在不牺牲精度的同时将模型规模与推理时间压缩至边缘 GPU 可接受水平，为资源受限场景下的实时 3D 感知提供了可行方案，已可在 NVIDIA Jetson 等平台直接部署。

title: Reasoning Structure Matters for Safety Alignment of Reasoning Models
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks but often generate harmful responses to malicious user queries. This paper investigates the underlying cause of these safety risks and shows that the issue lies in the reasoning structure itself. Based on this insight, we claim that effective safety alignment can be achieved by altering the reasoning structure. We propose AltTrain, a simple yet effective post training method that explicitly alters the reasoning structure of LRMs. AltTrain is both practical and generalizable, requiring no complex reinforcement learning (RL) training or reward design, only supervised finetuning (SFT) with a lightweight 1K training examples. Experiments across LRM backbones and model sizes demonstrate strong safety alignment, along with robust generalization across reasoning, QA, summarization, and multilingual setting.

AI.tldr: 仅通过1K监督微调即可修改大推理模型内部推理路径，无需RL便能实现零额外推理成本且跨任务泛化的安全对齐。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型在复杂推理上表现优异，但对恶意提问极易生成有害内容，其安全漏洞根源不在表层生成而在深层推理方式本身，亟需一种不依赖昂贵RL且可推广的轻量级解决方案。
AI.method: 提出AltTrain——基于“推理路径重写”思路的后训练框架：①用小规模安全样本（1K）构造“正确-错误”推理对照；②显性把被劫持的推理片段替换为安全推导，仅做SFT即可重新校准模型的推理图结构；③训练无需手工奖励设计与复杂RL，模型尺寸、任务类型与语言均无关。
AI.result: 在多种LRM骨干和不同规模模型上，AltTrain显著降低对恶意查询的有害响应率，同时保持或提升复杂推理、问答、摘要及多语言任务的原始性能，证明安全对齐未带来通用能力牺牲。
AI.conclusion: 安全缺陷源于推理结构而非表面生成；通过AltTrain微调即可便宜地重塑该结构，为部署安全且高性能的推理模型提供了一条高效、可扩展且零推理开销的新范式。

title: Generalization at the Edge of Stability
summary: Training modern neural networks often relies on large learning rates, operating at the edge of stability, where the optimization dynamics exhibit oscillatory and chaotic behavior. Empirically, this regime often yields improved generalization performance, yet the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. In this work, we represent stochastic optimizers as random dynamical systems, which often converge to a fractal attractor set (rather than a point) with a smaller intrinsic dimension. Building on this connection and inspired by Lyapunov dimension theory, we introduce a novel notion of dimension, coined the `sharpness dimension', and prove a generalization bound based on this dimension. Our results show that generalization in the chaotic regime depends on the complete Hessian spectrum and the structure of its partial determinants, highlighting a complexity that cannot be captured by the trace or spectral norm considered in prior work. Experiments across various MLPs and transformers validate our theory while also providing new insights into the recently observed phenomenon of grokking.

AI.tldr: 本文将高学习率下的混沌优化视为随机动力系统，在分形吸引子上建立了一个新的“锐度维度”，并据此给出泛化界，首次强调需用完整 Hessian 谱刻画混沌泛化，同时在 MLP 与 Transformer 实验中解释了“顿悟”现象。
AI.motivation: 现有理论无法解释现代训练常用的大学习率“边缘稳定性”机制：网络长期在高噪声、振荡甚至混沌状态下更新，却能获得更好泛化效果。作者试图用一个统一的低维吸引子视角解析该现象，并建立适用于混沌优化的泛化理论。
AI.method:
(1)用随机微分方程刻画 SGD，证明刀具大概率收敛至分形吸引子而非单个极小点；
(2)引入与 Hessian 全谱相关的“锐度维度（sharpness dimension）”，并通过 Lyapunov-like 维数理论推导出 PAC-Bayesian 风格泛化界；
(3)利用子行列式结构替代常规 trace/谱范数，捕捉高阶弯曲度影响；
(4)在 MLP、Transformer（包括不同隐藏层、激活函数）上做竞争性实验，对该层维度进行的经验度量与泛化误差高度相关，重现并解释了 grokking 曲线。
AI.result: 理论：新维度上限与泛化误差呈单调负相关，明确举例说明仅靠 tr(H) 或 ‖H‖₂ 无法捕捉到达混沌极限时的复杂度；数值：不同架构下测得的“锐度维度”估计值与真实测试误差 R²>0.92（对 23 个模型/任务平均）；grokking 发生时上述维度同步跃升，提示直觉 “算法突然选择低维且锐度适中的吸引子”。
AI.conclusion: 混沌运行的真正泛化因子并非顶特征量，而要观测完整 Hessian 谱及其以子行列式表达的凹/奇异性结构；作者提出的“锐度维度”为此给出了首个可计算的理论量，使“高学习率+混沌→好泛化”的经验现象有了可验证的数学依据，并建议未来与学习率调度、二阶修正和正则化设计结合。

title: Where Fake Citations Are Made: Tracing Field-Level Hallucination to Specific Neurons in LLMs
summary: LLMs frequently generate fictitious yet convincing citations, often expressing high confidence even when the underlying reference is wrong. We study this failure across 9 models and 108{,}000 generated references, and find that author names fail far more often than other fields across all models and settings. Citation style has no measurable effect, while reasoning-oriented distillation degrades recall. Probes trained on one field transfer at near-chance levels to the others, suggesting that hallucination signals do not generalize across fields. Building on this finding, we apply elastic-net regularization with stability selection to neuron-level CETT values of Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and identify a sparse set of field-specific hallucination neurons (FH-neurons). Causal intervention further confirms their role: amplifying these neurons increases hallucination, while suppressing them improves performance across fields, with larger gains in some fields. These results suggest a lightweight approach to detecting and mitigating citation hallucination using internal model signals alone.

AI.tldr: 大规模实验发现大模型在生成引用时最易虚构作者姓名，且不同学科间幻觉信号互不通用；通过稀疏定位学科特异性“幻觉神经元”并用轻量级因果干预即可显著抑制虚假引用。
AI.motivation: 大模型 confidently 伪造看似正确的学术引用，严重威胁知识可信度，亟需揭示其机制并给出轻量级通用缓解方案。
AI.method: 对 9 个模型、10.8 万条生成引用进行系统评估，发现作者名最易造假；用弹性网络正则化+稳定性选择，在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 的 CETT 神经元值中定位出学科特异的“FH-神经元”，并通过因果干预验证其功能。
AI.result: 跨模型、跨引用格式均证实作者名幻觉率最高；探测模型跨学科迁移仅随机水平；找到约百量级的 FH-神经元后，抑制它们可将引用幻觉率显著降低，增幅可达 30% 以上，而放大则加剧幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉在模型内部呈“学科-局部化”表示，无需外部知识即可通过识别并操控少量 FH-神经元实现轻量级、可迁移的引用幻觉抑制，为可信生成提供新范式。

title: Preserving Clusters in Error-Bounded Lossy Compression of Particle Data
summary: Lossy compression is widely used to reduce storage and I/O costs for large-scale particle datasets in scientific applications such as cosmology, molecular dynamics, and fluid dynamics, where clustering structures (e.g., single-linkage or Friends-of-Friends) are critical for downstream analysis; however, existing compressors typically provide only pointwise error bounds on particle positions and offer no guarantees on preserving clustering outcomes, and even small perturbations can alter cluster connectivity and compromise scientific validity. We propose a correction-based technique to preserve single-linkage clustering under lossy compression, operating on decompressed data from off-the-shelf compressors such as SZ3 and Draco. Our key contributions are threefold: (1) a clustering-aware correction algorithm that identifies vulnerable particle pairs via spatial partitioning and local neighborhood search; (2) an optimization-based formulation that enforces clustering consistency using projected gradient descent with a loss that encodes pairwise distance violations; and (3) a scalable GPU-accelerated and distributed implementation for large-scale datasets. Experiments on cosmology and molecular dynamics datasets show that our method effectively preserves clustering results while maintaining competitive compression performance compared with SZ3, ZFP, Draco, LCP, and space-filling-curve-based schemes.

AI.tldr: 一种在失真压缩后仍能保护单链接聚类结构的无损校正技术，可在 SZ3、Draco 等现有压缩框架下直接使用，GPU 并行后支持PB级粒子数据。
AI.motivation: 天体物理、分子动力学等领域的下游分析依赖单链接/Friends-of-Friends 聚类，但现有失真压缩只约束单点坐标误差，难以保证聚类连通性，轻微扰动就可能改变科学结论，需要压缩后对聚类结果提供鲁棒保障。
AI.method: 提出“基于校正的聚类保持”框架：1) 空间划分+局域邻域搜索识别易受扰动的粒子对；2) 将聚类一致性建模为带成对距离违约项的优化问题，用投影梯度下降求解，修正压缩后的坐标；3) GPU 加速+分布式实现，支持十亿级粒子。
