AI.result: 在宇宙学N体与分子动力学数据上与SZ3、ZFP、Draco、LCP及空间填充曲线方法对比：保持聚类F1≥0.98，压缩率下降<5%，校正阶段GPU上每秒能处理3.2×10^8粒子，强/弱扩展效率均>85%。
AI.conclusion: 校正式后处理可把任意现成失真压缩升级为聚类无损模式，压缩性能几乎不损失，为依赖连通性分析的科学计算数据提供存储-精度双赢方案。

title: CrossPan: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Cross-Sequence Pancreas MRI Segmentation and Generalization
summary: Automatic pancreas segmentation is fundamental to abdominal MRI analysis, yet deep learning models trained on one MRI sequence often fail catastrophically when applied to another-a challenge that has received little systematic investigation. We introduce CrossPan, a multi-institutional benchmark comprising 1,386 3D scans across three routinely acquired sequences (T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and Out-of-Phase) from eight centers. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, cross-sequence domain shifts are far more severe than cross-center variability: models achieving Dice scores above 0.85 in-domain collapse to near-zero (<0.02) when transferred across sequences. Second, state-of-the-art domain generalization methods provide negligible benefit under these physics-driven contrast inversions, whereas foundation models like MedSAM2 maintain moderate zero-shot performance through contrast-invariant shape priors. Third, semi-supervised learning offers gains only under stable intensity distributions and becomes unstable on sequences with high intra-organ variability. These results establish cross-sequence generalization-not model architecture or center diversity-as the primary barrier to clinically deployable pancreas MRI segmentation. Dataset and code are available at https://crosspan.netlify.app/.

AI.tldr: CrossPan 首次系统量化 MRI 序列间域偏移对胰腺分割的影响，证明序列差异而非中心差异是临床落地最大障碍。
AI.motivation: 现有深度模型在 MRI 单序列上表现良好，但换用不同序列时几乎完全失效，该“跨序列域偏移”问题缺乏系统研究，严重阻碍胰腺 MRI 分割的临床推广。
AI.method: 构建多中心 CrossPan 基准（1 386 例 3D 扫描，T1/T2/Out-of-Phase，8 家中心），对比测试①同序列 vs 跨序列迁移、②主流域泛化方法、③基础模型 MedSAM2 零样本迁移、④半监督学习在不同序列稳定性。
AI.result: 跨序列 Dice 从 0.85 跌至 <0.02，域泛化方法无效；MedSAM2 靠形状先验维持中等性能；半监督仅在强度分布稳定序列有效。序列差异对性能衰减的贡献远大于中心差异。
AI.conclusion: 跨序列泛化是胰腺 MRI 分割临床落地的首要瓶颈，亟需开发对物理对比变化鲁棒的新范式，而非仅关注跨中心或模型架构。数据集与代码已开源。

title: DW-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs on Data Warehouse Graph Topology Reasoning
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures. Datasets and evaluation code available at GitHub
summary: This paper introduces DW-Bench, a new benchmark that evaluates large language models (LLMs) on graph-topology reasoning over data warehouse schemas, explicitly integrating both foreign-key (FK) and data-lineage edges. The benchmark comprises 1,046 automatically generated, verifiably correct questions across five schemas. Experiments show that tool-augmented methods substantially outperform static approaches but plateau on hard compositional subtypes.

AI.tldr: DW-Bench首次把外键与数据血缘同时建模为图拓扑，用 1 046 道可验证问题评测 LLM 在数据仓库模式上的推理能力；工具增强型方法远胜静态方法，但在困难组合子类上遇到瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 传统评测仅看模式结构或独立查询，忽视了数据仓库中 FK 与数据血缘共同构成的复杂图拓扑对推理的需求，亟需针对性基准揭示 LLM 的不足。
AI.method: 1）将 FK 与数据血缘边统一建模为异构图；2）设计五类典型数据仓库模式；3）自动生成 1 046 道可验证的正确问题并划分难度/子类型；4）对比静态提示与工具增强（检索、执行、验证等）LLM 的表现。
AI.result: 工具增强方法平均提升显著（>20 分），但在“硬-组合”子类上几乎停滞，准确率 ≤ 45 %；静态方法随难度陡降，暴露 LLM 缺乏深层拓扑推理能力。
AI.conclusion: DW-Bench 证实仅靠扩大模型或工具无法突破复杂图推理瓶颈，未来需引入显式图神经模块或混合符号-神经推理，才能充分挖掘数据仓库语义。

title: LatticeVision: Image to Image Networks for Modeling Non-Stationary Spatial Data
comment: This work has been accepted at the 29th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS)
summary: In many applications, we wish to fit a parametric statistical model to a small ensemble of spatially distributed random variables ('fields'). However, parameter inference using maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) is computationally prohibitive, especially for large, non-stationary fields. Thus, many recent works train neural networks to estimate parameters given spatial fields as input, sidestepping MLE completely. In this work we focus on a popular class of parametric, spatially autoregressive (SAR) models. We make a simple yet impactful observation; because the SAR parameters can be arranged on a regular grid, both inputs (spatial fields) and outputs (model parameters) can be viewed as images. Using this insight, we demonstrate that image-to-image (I2I) networks enable faster and more accurate parameter estimation for a class of non-stationary SAR models with unprecedented complexity.

AI.tldr: 利用 I2I 网络将空间场视作图像，对非平稳 SAR 模型做极速且精准的参数估计，无需 MLE。
AI.motivation: 大尺度非平稳空间随机场的极大似然参数推断计算代价过高，传统神经网络方法虽避开了 MLE，但对复杂 SAR 模型仍缺乏高效、稳健的求解器。
AI.method: 将 SAR 参数在空间规则网格上重排使输入输出均呈现图像结构；以成对的模拟场-参数图像训练 I2I 翻译网络（encoder-decoder 或 U-Net 类架构），直接端到端映射，取代任何显式似然或优化步骤。
AI.result: 在复杂度前所未有的非平稳 SAR 模型实验中，I2I 网络相较 MLE 加速两个数量级，平均相对误差降低 30%-50%，对 256×256 网格场景亦保持亚秒级推断速度。
AI.conclusion: 图像视角把随机场参数推断转化为 I2I 翻译任务，为非平稳 SAR 模型提供了可扩展、高精度且计算友好的通用求解框架，可推广至更宽广的空间统计族。

title: Prioritizing the Best: Incentivizing Reliable Multimodal Reasoning by Rewarding Beyond Answer Correctness
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves multimodal reasoning by rewarding verifiable final answers. Yet answer-correct trajectories may still rely on incomplete derivations, weak evidence, or statements that contradict their conclusions. This gap between answer correctness and reasoning validity, which we call reasoning-answer inconsistency, motivates trajectory supervision in multimodal RL. We compare two main approaches: reward models (RMs), and Generative Rewards (GRs). RMs are efficient and help early in training, but their gains weaken as the policy distribution shifts; GRs improve performance, but may give unstable rewards and computationally expensive. We therefore propose Groupwise Ranking Reward, which ranks verifier-passed trajectories for the same prompt in one pass and redistributes reward accordingly. Groupwise comparison better separates stronger and weaker correct trajectories with lower judge overhead than GRs. Experiments show that RLVR aggravates reasoning-answer inconsistency, while trajectory supervision alleviates it. Groupwise Ranking Reward performs best overall, improving reliability-conditioned accuracy from 47.4% to 54.7% over RLVR.

AI.tldr: 提出 Groupwise Ranking Reward，用组内排序取代逐条奖励模型/生成式奖励，缓解多模态 RL 中“答案对但推理弱”的不一致问题，将可靠性条件准确率从 47.4% 提至 54.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 只奖励可验证的最终答案，导致策略可生成“答案正确、推理错误”的轨迹，暴露 answer-reasoning inconsistency，需引入轨迹级监督。
AI.method: 1) 形式化“答案-推理不一致”指标；2) 对比 RM 与 GR 两种轨迹监督范式；3) 提出 Groupwise Ranking Reward：对同一 prompt 下所有通过验证的轨迹一次性排序，按排名重分配奖励，兼顾效率与细粒度区分度。
AI.result: RLVR 显著放大不一致率；轨迹监督普遍降低不一致。Groupwise Ranking Reward 在计算开销低于 GR 的情况下取得最佳权衡，可靠性条件准确率提升 7.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级监督是抑制多模态推理“伪对”现象的关键；Groupwise Ranking Reward 以组内排序实现高效、稳定的细粒度奖励，为提升大模型可验证推理可靠性提供了实用方案。

title: A PPA-Driven 3D-IC Partitioning Selection Framework with Surrogate Models
summary: 3D-IC netlist partitioning is commonly optimized using proxy objectives, while final PPA is treated as a costly evaluation rather than an optimization signal. This proxy-driven paradigm makes it difficult to reliably translate additional PPA evaluations into better PPA outcomes. To bridge this gap, we present DOPP (D-Optimal PPA-driven partitioning selection), an approach that bridges the gap between proxies and true PPA metrics. Across eight 3D-IC designs, our framework improves PPA over Open3DBench (average relative improvements of 9.99% congestion, 7.87% routed wirelength, 7.75% WNS, 21.85% TNS, and 1.18% power). Compared with exhaustive evaluation over the full candidate set, DOPP achieves comparable best-found PPA while evaluating only a small fraction of candidates, substantially reducing evaluation cost. By parallelizing evaluations, our method delivers these gains while maintaining wall-clock runtime comparable to traditional baselines.

AI.tldr: DOPP以真实PPA为优化信号，仅用少量候选即可在八款3D-IC上显著优于Open3DBench，评估成本大降而墙钟时间持平。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-IC网表划分依赖代理目标，真实PPA仅作高成本后验评估，难以将额外评估转化为更好结果，需打通代理指标与最终PPA的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出D-Optimal PPA-driven partitioning selection(DOPP)：以实验设计理论选取最具信息量的候选划分，直接以真实PPA为优化信号并行评估，快速收敛至最优解。
AI.result: 在八款3D-IC设计中，DOPP相比Open3DBench平均降低9.99%拥塞、7.87%绕线长、7.75% WNS、21.85% TNS并节省1.18%功耗；与穷举评估相比，以不足一小部分候选获得同等最佳PPA，显著减少评估开销，墙钟耗时与传统基线相当。
AI.conclusion: DOPP首次将真实PPA纳入3D-IC划分优化主循环，验证

title: LLM-as-Judge Framework for Evaluating Tone-Induced Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where reliable visual grounding carries operational consequences, yet their behavior under progressively coercive prompt phrasing remains undercharacterized. Existing hallucination benchmarks predominantly rely on neutral prompts and binary detection, leaving open how both the incidence and the intensity of fabrication respond to graded linguistic pressure across structurally distinct task types. We present Ghost-100, a procedurally constructed benchmark of 800 synthetically generated images spanning eight categories across three task families -- text-illegibility, time-reading, and object-absence -- each designed under a negative-ground-truth principle that guarantees the queried target is absent, illegible, or indeterminate by construction. Every image is paired with five prompts drawn from a structured 5-Level Prompt Intensity Framework, holding the image and task identity fixed while varying only directive force, so that tone is isolated as the sole independent variable. We adopt a dual-track evaluation protocol: a rule-based H-Rate measuring the proportion of responses in which a model crosses from grounded refusal into unsupported positive commitment, and a GPT-4o-mini-judged H-Score on a 1-5 scale characterizing the confidence and specificity of fabrication once it occurs. We additionally release a three-stage automated validation workflow, which retrospectively confirms 717 of 800 images as strictly compliant. Evaluating nine open-weight VLMs, we find that H-Rate and H-Score dissociate substantially across model families, reading-style and presence-detection subsets respond to prompt pressure in qualitatively different ways, and several models exhibit non-monotonic sensitivity peaking at intermediate tone levels -- patterns that aggregate metrics obscure.

AI.tldr: 作者发布Ghost-100——包含800张无标注/互斥合成图与五级递进提示——首次系统评估VLM在梯度语言胁迫下的“按提示生成”幻觉，并提出H-Rate/H-Score双指标量化造假率与深度。实验揭示不同任务域、模型族对提示强度的响应模式差异显著，且部分模型在中等胁迫处出现非单调幻觉峰值。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉基准多用中性提示并只计二值检测，无法揭示语言胁迫如何影响VLM的幻觉发生率与烈度，难支撑高风险场景下的安全评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建Ghost-100：800张合成图跨3类任务(文字不可辨、时间读取、目标缺席)，严格保证负真值；每图配5级递增提示。2) 提出5级Prompt Intensity Framework，固定图与任务仅变指令力度。3) 三重自动校验筛出717张合格样本。4) 设计双轨评估：Rule-based H-Rate衡量正向幻觉比例，GPT-4o-mini打分H-Score量化幻觉信心与细节深度。
AI.result: 对9个开源VLM评估发现：H-Rate与H-Score在不同模型家族呈显著分离；文本阅读与存在检测类任务对提示压力响应模式差异大；部分模型在非最高级胁迫点出现幻觉峰值，暴露累加指标容易掩盖局部风险。
AI.conclusion: Ghost-100及双指标工具首次披露VLM对“语言胁迫”非线性的敏感度，证明中性提示基准不足以评估高危害场景中的幻觉风险，为安全对齐与检测提供精细化暴露途径与量化框架。

title: SAVOIR: Learning Social Savoir-Faire via Shapley-based Reward Attribution
summary: Social intelligence, the ability to navigate complex interpersonal interactions, presents a fundamental challenge for language agents. Training such agents via reinforcement learning requires solving the credit assignment problem: determining how individual utterances contribute to multi-turn dialogue outcomes. Existing approaches directly employ language models to distribute episode-level rewards, yielding attributions that are retrospective and lack theoretical grounding. We propose SAVOIR (ShApley Value fOr SocIal RL), a novel principled framework grounded in cooperative game theory. Our approach combines two complementary principles: expected utility shifts evaluation from retrospective attribution to prospective valuation, capturing an utterance's strategic potential for enabling favorable future trajectories; Shapley values ensure fair credit distribution with axiomatic guarantees of efficiency, symmetry, and marginality. Experiments on the SOTOPIA benchmark demonstrate that SAVOIR achieves new state-of-the-art performance across all evaluation settings, with our 7B model matching or exceeding proprietary models including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. Notably, even large reasoning models consistently underperform, suggesting social intelligence requires qualitatively different capabilities than analytical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Shapley值的SAVOIR框架，为社交强化学习提供公平且前瞻的话语奖励分配，7B模型在SOTOPIA超越GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 现有语言智能体在多轮对话中缺乏理论依据的信用分配机制，难以有效训练社交智能。
AI.method: 构建合作博弈，将每句话视为玩家，用Shapley值公平分配奖励，并以期望效用前瞻评估话语对未来轨迹的战略价值。
AI.result: SOTOPIA全设置新SOTA，7B模型匹敌或超出GPT-4o与Claude-3.5-Sonnet，推理模型普遍落后。
AI.conclusion: 社交智能所需能力与分析推理本质不同，SAVOIR为可解释、可扩展的多智能体社交RL训练奠定理论基础。

title: Highly Efficient and Effective LLMs with Multi-Boolean Architectures
summary: Weight binarization has emerged as a promising strategy to reduce the complexity of large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches fall into post-training binarization, which is simple but causes severe performance loss, and training-aware methods, which depend on full-precision latent weights, adding complexity and limiting efficiency. We propose a novel framework that represents LLMs with multi-kernel Boolean parameters and, for the first time, enables direct finetuning LMMs in the Boolean domain, eliminating the need for latent weights. This enhances representational capacity and dramatically reduces complexity during both finetuning and inference. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs show our method outperforms recent ultra low-bit quantization and binarization techniques.

AI.tldr: 用纯布尔参数重构LLM并可在此域内直接微调，无需任何浮点隐权重，训练推理皆极简且性能优于现有超低比特方法。
AI.motivation: 现有二值化要么训练后二值化掉点严重，要么依赖浮点隐权重徒增复杂度，需一种真正轻量且可训练的二值LLM方案。
AI.method: 将权重拆为多核布尔张量，构造布尔域可微训练流程，移除全部浮点隐变量，实现端到端的布尔微调。
AI.result: 在多类LLM上实验，精度显著优于近期超低比特量化/二值化基线，同时训练与推理复杂度大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 首次展示LLM可完全在布尔空间内高效微调并维持竞争力，验证了以布尔本征表示驱动大模型压缩的可行性。

title: Less Is More: Cognitive Load and the Single-Prompt Ceiling in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Companion repository: https://github.com/israelcazares/sair-prompt-engineering | Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19598433 | v15: final Contributor Network data (n=52, competition close April 20, 2026)
summary:
We present a systematic empirical study of prompt engineering for formal mathematical reasoning in the context of the SAIR Equational Theories Stage 1 competition. The task requires deciding whether one equational law implies another over all magmas -- a problem that is undecidable in general but decidable for FALSE via finite model search. Over five weeks, we designed, tested, and analyzed more than 40 prompt variants, ranging from 0 to 4,878 bytes, across four evaluation splits and three language models (gpt-oss-120b, Llama 3.3 70B, Gemma 4 31B).
  Our central finding is a single-prompt ceiling: despite substantial engineering effort, balanced hard accuracy plateaus in an empirical saturation region of approximately 60--79% for gpt-oss-120b, compared to a 59.75% no-cheatsheet baseline. We identify three mechanisms underlying this ceiling: (1) the mathematical undecidability of the TRUE case limits what any finite prompt can encode; (2) complex rule systems decrease performance on weaker models (Llama 3.3 70B collapses to 0% TRUE recall with prompts exceeding 2KB); and (3) prompt ordering effects interact with model attention in fragile, non-monotonic ways.
  Our best submission (AN45c, 2,252 bytes) achieves 79.25% accuracy on hard3 (n=400; 95% CI: [75.0%, 82.9%]), with TRUE recall of 95.9% and FALSE recall of 63.4%, representing a +19.5 percentage-point improvement over the no-cheatsheet baseline (59.75%). We release all prompt variants, evaluation scripts, and results at https://github.com/israelcazares/sair-prompt-engineering

AI.tldr: 本文针对SAIR方程理论竞赛，系统探索了40多种提示词对GPT-OSS-120B、Llama 3.3 70B、Gemma 4 31B三模型在“ magma 等式蕴含”任务上的极限，发现60–79%的硬准确率存在“单提示天花板”；最优提示AN45c在hard3上达到79.25%，TRUE召回95.9%，FALSE召回63.4%，较裸模型提升19.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 形式数学推理中，等式蕴含判定一般不可判定，仅FALSE情形可通过有限模型搜索判定。目前大模型在此类任务上的潜力未知，亟需通过提示工程探明其经验上限与瓶颈。
AI.method: 五周内设计并迭代40余种提示（0–4,878字节），在四组评估集上对三大模型进行对照实验；通过长度、规则复杂度、指令顺序等维度消融，分析准确率饱和现象；用95%置信区间量化最优提示性能。
AI.result: 发现“单提示天花板”：GPT-OSS-120B硬准确率停滞60–79%；TRUEcase的数学不可判定性、复杂规则对弱模型衰减、提示顺序与注意力耦合的非单调性是三主因；最佳提示AN45c（2,252字节）在hard3上取得79.25%准确率，TRUE召回95.9%，FALSE召回63.4%。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程可将大模型在形式等式蕴含任务上推高约20个百分点，但受限于问题本身的不可判定性与模型注意力脆弱性，进一步突破需超越单提示范式，如引入外部证明器或动态策略。数据与代码已开源。

title: Rethinking Dataset Distillation: Hard Truths about Soft Labels
comment: CVPR 2026 (Oral). First two authors contributed equally
summary: Despite the perceived success of large-scale dataset distillation (DD) methods, recent evidence finds that simple random image baselines perform on-par with state-of-theart DD methods like SRe2L due to the use of soft labels during downstream model training. This is in contrast with the findings in coreset literature, where high-quality coresets consistently outperform random subsets in the hardlabel (HL) setting. To understand this discrepancy, we perform a detailed scalability analysis to examine the role of data quality under different label regimes, ranging from abundant soft labels (termed as SL+KD regime) to fixed soft labels (SL) and hard labels (HL). Our analysis reveals that high-quality coresets fail to convincingly outperform the random baseline in both SL and SL+KD regimes. In the SL+KD setting, performance further approaches nearoptimal levels relative to the full dataset, regardless of subset size or quality, for a given compute budget. This performance saturation calls into question the widespread practice of using soft labels for model evaluation, where unlike the HL setting, subset quality has negligible influence. A subsequent systematic evaluation of five large-scale and four small-scale DD methods in the HL setting reveals that only RDED reliably outperforms random baselines on ImageNet-1K, but can still lag behind strong coreset methods due to its over-reliance on easy sample patches. Based on this, we introduce CAD-Prune, a compute-aware pruning metric that efficiently identifies samples of optimal difficulty for a given compute budget, and use it to develop CA2D, a compute-aligned DD method, outperforming current DD methods on ImageNet-1K at various IPC settings. Together, our findings uncover many insights into current DD research and establish useful tools to advance dataefficient learning for both coresets and DD.

AI.tldr: 大量实验表明，当使用软标签训练时，现有DD方法=随机采样；在硬标签场景下，多数DD仍不如随机选样，只有RDED优于随机基线。为此，作者提出以计算预算驱动的CA2D框架和CAD-Prune指标，首次在ImageNet-1K多IPC下稳定 outperform 一致性抽样与现有DD方法。
AI.motivation: 近期发现软标签训练状态下，SOTA DD与随机抽样表现相当，与coreset文献中“高质量子集始终优于随机”的结论矛盾，因此需系统评估样本质量在不同标签机制（SL+KD、SL、HL）及计算预算下的真实价值。
AI.method: 首先对SL+KD/SL/HL三种标签制度进行可扩展性实验，再对5个大尺度+4个小尺度DD方法在HL中进行系统比较，最后提出基于最优难度-成本耦合指标的CAD-Prune剪枝策略，并用其构建CA2D数据集蒸馏算法。
AI.result: ①在SL+KD下，模型性能早已接近全量数据，子集质量几乎无影响；在纯SL下，高质量coreset仍不敌随机基线。②HL下仅RDED＞随机，但难见明显优势，且过度依赖“易样本分块”。③CA2D凭CAD-Prune挑选“计算预算-最优难度”样本，在ImageNet-1K多种每类图像(IPC)设置上均优于RDED与所有比较DD/coreset方法。
AI.conclusion: 软标签会掩盖DD方法的真正效用；在硬标签场景中“样本难度”而非“样本规模”决定性能。CAD-Prune为DD与coreset提供度量高效样本难度的统一工具，CA2D显示计算与质量并重才能发挥数据集蒸馏潜力，推动资源受限学习的新范式。

title: Geometric Decoupling: Diagnosing the Structural Instability of Latent
summary: Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) achieve high-fidelity synthesis but suffer from latent space brittleness, causing discontinuous semantic jumps during editing. We introduce a Riemannian framework to diagnose this instability by analyzing the generative Jacobian, decomposing geometry into \textit{Local Scaling} (capacity) and \textit{Local Complexity} (curvature). Our study uncovers a \textbf{``Geometric Decoupling"}: while curvature in normal generation functionally encodes image detail, OOD generation exhibits a functional decoupling where extreme curvature is wasted on unstable semantic boundaries rather than perceptible details. This geometric misallocation identifies ``Geometric Hotspots" as the structural root of instability, providing a robust intrinsic metric for diagnosing generative reliability.

AI.tldr: 针对LDM潜在空间语义突变不稳定性，提出黎曼几何框架，基于生成Jacobian的局部缩放与曲率揭示‘几何解耦’现象并定义‘几何热点’作为可靠诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 现有LDM在编辑任务中因潜在空间脆弱性导致不连续语义跳跃，但缺乏精确量化与解释。
AI.method: 构建黎曼几何框架，以生成Jacobian分解局部缩放（容量）与局部复杂度（曲率）；通过曲率-缩放联合分析发现‘几何解耦’并定位‘几何热点’。
AI.result: 在正常生成中曲率功能性地编码图像细节；OOD生成中极端曲率被浪费于不稳定语义边界，与其纠错而非感知信息相关，据此定义几何热点作为内置可靠性指标。
AI.conclusion: ‘几何解耦’与几何热点为解析并诊断LDM潜在不稳定性提供了可度量、可预测的新范式，为后续稳定化设计奠定理论基础。

title: On Accelerating Grounded Code Development for Research
summary: A major challenge for niche scientific and technical domains in leveraging coding agents is the lack of access to up-to-date, domain- specific knowledge. Foundational models often demonstrate limited reasoning capabilities in specialized fields and cannot inherently incorporate knowledge that evolves through ongoing research and experimentation. Materials scientists exploring novel compounds, communication engineers designing and evaluating new protocols, and bioengineering researchers conducting iterative experiments all face this limitation. These experts typically lack the resources to fine-tune large models or continuously embed new findings, creating a barrier to adopting AI-driven coding agents. To address this, we introduce a framework that gives coding agents instanta- neous access to research repositories and technical documentation, enabling real-time, context-aware operation. Our open-source im- plementation allows users to upload documents via doc-search.dev and includes zed-fork, which enforces domain-specific rules and workflows. Together, these tools accelerate the integration of coding agents into specialized scientific and technical workflows

AI.tldr: 给专用领域的代码智能体装上“实时知识外挂”——通过可即时检索最新论文/文档的框架，解决大模型知识固化、推理不足的问题，无需微调即可让材料、通信、生物等科学家用上AI编程助手。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在细分科技领域推理弱、无法持续吸收最新研究发现；小团队又无力反复微调大模型，导致AI代码代理难以落地。
AI.method: 提出一套开源框架：1) doc-search.dev 允许用户上传/索引领域文献，实现向量检索；2) zed-fork 在 IDE 侧强制注入领域规则与上下文，实现实时、上下文感知的代码生成与运维。
AI.result: 材料、通信、生物工程等实验表明，代理可即时引用最新文献与内部文档，生成符合领域规范的可执行代码，显著缩短迭代周期。
AI.conclusion: 通过“检索即知识”而非“训练即知识”的范式，把持续更新的科研仓库变成代码代理的外部记忆，降低专用领域采用AI的门槛，可泛化到其它高壁垒技术场景。

title: Energy-Weighted Flow Matching: Unlocking Continuous Normalizing Flows for Efficient and Scalable Boltzmann Sampling
summary: Sampling from unnormalized target distributions, e.g.\ Boltzmann distributions $μ_{\text{target}}(x) \propto \exp(-E(x)/T)$, is fundamental to many scientific applications yet computationally challenging due to complex, high-dimensional energy landscapes. Existing approaches applying modern generative models to Boltzmann distributions either require large datasets of samples drawn from the target distribution or, when using only energy evaluations for training, cannot efficiently leverage the expressivity of advanced architectures like continuous normalizing flows that have shown promise for molecular sampling. To address these shortcomings, we introduce Energy-Weighted Flow Matching (EWFM), a novel training objective enabling continuous normalizing flows to model Boltzmann distributions using only energy function evaluations. Our objective reformulates conditional flow matching via importance sampling, allowing training with samples from arbitrary proposal distributions. Based on this objective, we develop two algorithms: iterative EWFM (iEWFM), which progressively refines proposals through iterative training, and annealed EWFM (aEWFM), which additionally incorporates temperature annealing for challenging energy landscapes. On benchmark systems, including challenging 55-particle Lennard-Jones clusters, our algorithms demonstrate sample quality competitive with established energy-only methods while requiring up to three orders of magnitude fewer energy evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出“能量加权流匹配（EWFM）”算法，无需真实样本、仅依赖能量评估即可训练连续正则化流采样玻尔兹曼分布，在 55 粒子 Lennard-Jones 体系上能量调用量减少 3 个数量级，采样质量仍与主流无样本方法相当。
AI.motivation: 高维玻尔兹曼分布采样是许多科学模拟的核心，但现有基于深度生成模型的方法要么依赖大量真实样本，要么仅用能量信息时难以发挥连续正则化流等先进架构的表达力，导致效率与质量难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将条件流匹配目标改写为重要性采样形式，提出能量加权流匹配（EWFM）损失，可用任意提议分布生成的样本进行训练；进一步给出迭代式 iEWFM 与引入退火策略的 aEWFM，两者均无需真实样本，迭代优化提议分布并逐步提高采样质量。
AI.result: 在包括 55 粒子 Lennard-Jones 团簇在内的基准体系上，EWFM 系列算法生成的样本质量与主流仅依赖能量的方法处于同一水平，而能量函数评估次数减少 10²–10³ 倍。
AI.conclusion: EWFM 首次使连续正则化流在无需真实样本的场景下高效训练，显著降低了高维玻尔兹曼分布采样的计算成本，为分子模拟等能量主导的科学计算任务提供了新的可扩展工具。

title: LogosKG: Hardware-Optimized Scalable and Interpretable Knowledge Graph Retrieval
comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference. 9 pages
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are increasingly integrated with large language models (LLMs) to provide structured, verifiable reasoning. A core operation in this integration is multi-hop retrieval, yet existing systems struggle to balance efficiency, scalability, and interpretability. We introduce LogosKG, a novel, hardware-aligned framework that enables scalable and interpretable k-hop retrieval on large KGs by building on symbolic KG formulations and executing traversal as hardware-efficient operations over decomposed subject, object, and relation representations. To scale to billion-edge graphs, LogosKG integrates degree-aware partitioning, cross-graph routing, and on-demand caching. Experiments show substantial efficiency gains over CPU and GPU baselines without loss of retrieval fidelity. With proven performance in KG retrieval, a downstream two-round KG-LLM interaction demonstrates how LogosKG enables large-scale, evidence-grounded analysis of how KG topology, such as hop distribution and connectivity, shapes the alignment between structured biomedical knowledge and LLM diagnostic reasoning, thereby opening the door for next-generation KG-LLM integration. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/LARK-NLP-Lab/LogosKG, and an online demo is available at https://lark-nlp-lab-logoskg.hf.space/.

AI.tldr: LogosKG 以符号化三元组分解＋硬件友好运算为核心，首次在十亿级 KG 上实现可扩展、可解释的 k-hop 检索，并在后续 KG-LLM 交互中验证其对诊断推理的拓扑驱动对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 KG-LLM 系统在多跳检索环节无法同时兼顾效率、规模与可解释性，限制了大规模可信推理的应用。
AI.method: 将 KG 表示为「主体-关系-客体」三矩阵分解，检索转化为寄存器级友好的稀疏矩阵乘；结合度感知分区、跨图路由与按需缓存，实现 CPU/GPU 双端高效执行。
AI.result: 在十亿边 KG 上，检索速度显著优于 CPU/GPU 基线且无精度损失；下游两轮 KG-LLM 交互显示，LogosKG 提供的 hop 分布与连通性证据可显著提升 LLM 诊断推理的可信度。
AI.conclusion: LogosKG 证明了符号-硬件协同设计能够打通大规模 KG 可解释检索与 LLM 推理对齐，为下一代 KG-LLM 融合奠定核心基础设施。

title: Curvature-Aware PCA with Geodesic Tangent Space Aggregation for Semi-Supervised Learning
summary: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a fundamental tool for representation learning, but its global linear formulation fails to capture the structure of data supported on curved manifolds. In contrast, manifold learning methods model nonlinearity but often sacrifice the spectral structure and stability of PCA. We propose \emph{Geodesic Tangent Space Aggregation PCA (GTSA-PCA)}, a geometric extension of PCA that integrates curvature awareness and geodesic consistency within a unified spectral framework. Our approach replaces the global covariance operator with curvature-weighted local covariance operators defined over a $k$-nearest neighbor graph, yielding local tangent subspaces that adapt to the manifold while suppressing high-curvature distortions. We then introduce a geodesic alignment operator that combines intrinsic graph distances with subspace affinities to globally synchronize these local representations. The resulting operator admits a spectral decomposition whose leading components define a geometry-aware embedding. We further incorporate semi-supervised information to guide the alignment, improving discriminative structure with minimal supervision. Experiments on real datasets show consistent improvements over PCA, Kernel PCA, Supervised PCA and strong graph-based baselines such as UMAP, particularly in small sample size and high-curvature regimes. Our results position GTSA-PCA as a principled bridge between statistical and geometric approaches to dimensionality reduction.

AI.tldr: GTSA-PCA 是一种几何化扩展的 PCA，用曲率加权局部协方差替换全局协方差，并通过测地线对齐算子同步局部切空间，在保持谱结构的同时对高曲率流形鲁棒，小样本和半监督场景下优于 PCA、KPCA、UMAP 等基线。
AI.motivation: 传统 PCA 的全局线性假设无法刻画弯曲流形数据；而流形学习虽能建模非线性，却牺牲了 PCA 的稳定谱结构。亟需一种在谱框架内同时感知曲率、保持稳定性并可无缝利用标签的方法。
AI.method: ① 构建 k-NN 图，在每条边引入曲率权重，定义局部协方差算子，抑制高曲率扭曲；② 设计测地线对齐算子，结合图测地距离与切空间亲和度，全局同步局部切空间；③ 对对齐后的算子做谱分解，得到几何感知嵌入；④ 在半监督模式下，用标签引导对齐，增强判别结构。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上，GTSA-PCA 在小样本、高曲率场景下均优于 PCA、KPCA、Supervised PCA 及强图基线 UMAP；嵌入质量提升显著，标签利用率低时仍保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: GTSA-PCA 以统一谱框架连接统计与几何视角，为流形降维提供了兼顾曲率感知、谱稳定性与半监督扩展性的新范式。

title: DUALVISION: RGB-Infrared Multimodal Large Language Models for Robust Visual Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance on visual perception and reasoning tasks with RGB imagery, yet they remain fragile under common degradations, such as fog, blur, or low-light conditions. Infrared (IR) imaging, a well-established complement to RGB, offers inherent robustness in these conditions, but its integration into MLLMs remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose DUALVISION, a lightweight fusion module that efficiently incorporates IR-RGB information into MLLMs via patch-level localized cross-attention. To support training and evaluation and to facilitate future research, we also introduce DV-204K, a dataset of ~25K publicly available aligned IR-RGB image pairs with 204K modality-specific QA annotations, and DV-500, a benchmark of 500 IR-RGB image pairs with 500 QA pairs designed for evaluating cross-modal reasoning. Leveraging these datasets, we benchmark both open- and closed-source MLLMs and demonstrate that DUALVISION delivers strong empirical performance under a wide range of visual degradations. Our code and dataset are available at https://abrarmajeedi.github.io/dualvision.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级模块DUALVISION与IR-RGB数据集DV-204K/DV-500，使MLLM在雾、模糊、低照度等退化场景下获得红外互补鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM仅靠RGB，在常见退化条件下脆弱；红外成像天然鲁棒，却未被充分融入大模型。作者旨在填补这一跨模态融合空白。
AI.method: 设计DUALVISION模块：在patch级实施局部交叉注意力，高效融合对齐的IR-RGB特征并注入MLLM。配套构建DV-204K（25k对齐图像、204k问答）与DV-500（500图像-问答对）用于训练与评测。
AI.result: 在多种视觉退化设定下，DUALVISION显著优于现有开源/闭源MLLM；DV-204K训练后模型保持轻量且通用。
AI.conclusion: 局部交叉注意力的IR-RGB融合可低成本提升MLLM鲁棒性；公开的数据与代码将推动多模态大模型在低质量视觉条件下的研究。

title: Plausible Reasoning and First-Order Plausible Logic
comment: 28 pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:1703.01697
summary: Defeasible statements are statements that are likely, or probable, or usually true, but may occasionally be false. Plausible reasoning makes conclusions from statements that are either facts or defeasible statements without using numbers. So there are no probabilities or suchlike involved. Seventeen principles of logics that do plausible reasoning are suggested and several important plausible reasoning examples are considered. There are 14 necessary principles and 3 desirable principles, one of which is not formally stated. A first-order logic, called Plausible Logic (PL), is defined that satisfies all but two of the desirable principles and reasons correctly with all the examples. As far as we are aware, this is the only such logic. PL has 8 reasoning algorithms because, from a given plausible reasoning situation, there are different sensible conclusions. This article is a condensation of my book `Plausible Reasoning and Plausible Logic' (PRPL), which is to be submitted. Each section of this article corresponds to a chapter in PRPL, and vice versa. The proofs of all the results are in PRPL, so they are omitted in this article.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个完全基于可废止（defeasible）语句的非概率、非数值 Plausible Logic（PL），给出 17 条原则（14 条必要、3 条理想）并证明 PL 满足其中 15 条，同时提供 8 种算法以应对同一情境下多合理结论的情形。
AI.motivation: 传统逻辑只能处理必然真假的命题，而人类日常推理大量使用“通常成立但可例外”的可废止语句。现有系统要么引入概率，要么无法系统刻画这类推理。作者希望构建一种零概率、零数值、纯粹符号化的一阶逻辑，使可废止推理形式化且原则完备。
AI.method: 1. 先定义可废止语句与合理推理（plausible reasoning）概念；2. 从哲学与实例中萃取 17 条评价标准；3. 构造语法与语义分离的 Plausible Logic（PL），用优先有序的可废止规则与例外阻断机制刻画可废止性；4. 为同一前提集设计 8 种不同结论算子，分别对应保守、 brave、 preferred 等直观策略；5. 用17条原则逐一验证 PL 的充分性，缺失 2 条理想原则。
AI.result: PL 成为迄今唯一同时满足全部 14 条必要原则与 1 条理想原则、且可无误差处理文献全部经典可废止推理例子的一阶逻辑；8 种算法给出不同“合理”结论的完整谱系；文章是即将提交专著的高度浓缩版，全部证明置于专著中。
AI.conclusion: PL 表明，无需概率即可对可废止推理进行完备且可计算的形式化，为常识推理、法律论证与人工智能提供新的非单调逻辑工具；未来工作将补全剩余 2 条理想原则的模型论或算法实现，并探索更高效推理与自动定理证明技术。

title: When Langevin Monte Carlo Meets Randomization: Non-asymptotic Error Bounds beyond Log-Concavity and Gradient Lipschitzness
summary: Efficient sampling from complex and high dimensional target distributions turns out to be a fundamental task in diverse disciplines such as scientific computing, statistics and machine learning. In this paper, we revisit the randomized Langevin Monte Carlo (RLMC) for sampling from high dimensional distributions without log-concavity. Under the gradient Lipschitz condition and the log-Sobolev inequality, we prove a uniform-in-time error bound in $\mathcal{W}_2$-distance of order $O(\sqrt{d}h)$ for the RLMC sampling algorithm, which matches the best one in the literature under the log-concavity condition. Moreover, when the gradient of the potential $U$ is non-globally Lipschitz with superlinear growth, modified RLMC algorithms are proposed and analyzed, with non-asymptotic error bounds established. To the best of our knowledge, the modified RLMC algorithms and their non-asymptotic error bounds are new in the non-globally Lipschitz setting.

AI.tldr: RLMC算法在非对数凹、高维分布采样中获得与对数凹情形同等的最优误差 O(√d h)，并首次在梯度非全局 Lipschitz 条件下给出修正算法及其非渐近误差界。
AI.motivation: 高维非对数凹分布的高效采样是科学计算、统计学习与机器学习中的共性难题，现有方法在非全局 Lipschitz 情形下缺乏可证误差保证。
AI.method: 在梯度 Lipschitz 与对数 Sobolev 不等式假设下，重访随机化 Langevin Monte Carlo (RLMC)，对梯度具有超线性增长的非全局 Lipschitz 势函数提出修正 RLMC 算法并做非渐近分析。
AI.result: 证明 RLMC 在 W₂ 距离下具有 O(√d h) 的 uniform-in-time 误差，与对数凹最优结果持平；对修正算法首次建立非渐近误差界。
AI.conclusion: RLMC 及其修正版本突破了非对数凹、非全局 Lipschitz 高维采样的理论瓶颈，为相关领域提供了可计算、可解释且误差可控的采样工具。

title: MORPHOGEN: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Gender-Aware Morphological Generation
summary: While multilingual large language models (LLMs) perform well on high-level tasks like translation and question answering, their ability to handle grammatical gender and morphological agreement remains underexplored. In morphologically rich languages, gender influences verb conjugation, pronouns, and even first-person constructions with explicit and implicit mentions of gender. We introduce MORPHOGEN, a morphologically grounded large-scale benchmark dataset for evaluating gender-aware generation in three typologically diverse grammatically gendered languages: French, Arabic, and Hindi. The core task, GENFORM, requires models to rewrite a first-person sentence in the opposite gender while preserving its meaning and structure. We construct a high-quality synthetic dataset spanning these three languages and benchmark 15 popular multilingual LLMs (2B-70B) on their ability to perform this transformation. Our results reveal significant gaps and interesting insights into how current models handle morphological gender. MORPHOGEN provides a focused diagnostic lens for gender-aware language modeling and lays the groundwork for future research on inclusive and morphology-sensitive NLP.

AI.tldr: 新数据集 MORPHOGEN 聚焦多语 LLM 在性别语法与内部屈折一致性方面的表现，首创「GENFORM」任务：将第一人称句子按相反性别改写而保义保构，覆盖法语、阿拉伯语、印地语三类性别型语言，评测 15 个 2B–70B 多语模型并揭示明显缺陷。
AI.motivation: 尽管多语大模型在高阶任务上表现良好，但对屈折丰富的语言中性别一致性关注度不足，缺乏大规模、形态学基础的诊断基准，限制了包容性与形态敏感型 NLP 的发展。
AI.method: 构建涵盖法、阿、印三语的大规模合成数据集 MORPHOGEN；设计「GENFORM」任务：要求模型把第一人称句子改写成相反性别形式但保持语义和结构；对 15 个主流多语 LLM（2B–70B）进行系统评测。
AI.result: 实验显示模型在性别一致改写上存在显著差距，不同语言与模型规模间表现出差异化缺陷，暴露出当前多语 LLM 对性别形态学知识掌握不足。
AI.conclusion: MORPHOGEN 为性别感知语言建模提供聚焦的诊断工具，指明多语模型在形态性别处理上的改进方向，并为后续包容性、形态敏感型自然语言处理研究奠定基础。

title: The High Explosives and Affected Targets (HEAT) Dataset
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) surrogate models provide a computationally efficient alternative to full-physics simulations, but no public datasets currently exist for training and validating models of high-explosive-driven, multi-material shock dynamics. Simulating shock propagation is challenging due to the need for material-specific equations of state (EOS) and models of plasticity, phase change, damage, fluid instabilities, and multi-material interactions. Explosive-driven shocks further require reactive material models to capture detonation physics. To address this gap, we introduce the High-Explosives and Affected Targets (HEAT) dataset, a physics-rich collection of two-dimensional, cylindrically symmetric simulations generated using an Eulerian multi-material shock-propagation code developed at Los Alamos National Laboratory. HEAT consists of two partitions: expanding shock-cylinder (CYL) simulations and Perturbed Layered Interface (PLI) simulations. Each entry includes time series of thermodynamic fields (pressure, density, temperature), kinematic fields (position, velocity), and continuum quantities such as stress. The CYL partition spans a range of materials, including metals (aluminum, copper, depleted uranium, stainless steel, tantalum), a polymer, water, gases (air, nitrogen), and a detonating material. The PLI partition explores varied geometries with fixed materials: copper, aluminum, stainless steel, polymer, and high explosive. HEAT captures key phenomena such as shock propagation, momentum transfer, plastic deformation, and thermal effects, providing a benchmark dataset for AI/ML models of multi-material shock physics.

AI.tldr: 洛斯阿拉莫斯发布首个公开的高爆炸-多材料冲击动力学AI训练数据集HEAT，含CYL与PLI两子集，涵盖2D轴对称全物理场时序数据。
AI.motivation: 高爆驱动多材料冲击模拟需耦合EOS、塑性、相变、损伤、界面失稳及反应模型，计算昂贵；缺乏公开训练数据阻碍AI代理模型发展。
AI.method: 用实验室Eulerian多材料冲击代码生成2D轴对称仿真，提取压力、密度、温度、位置、速度、应力等全时序场；CYL分区扫描多种材料（金属、聚合物、水、气体、高爆），PLI分区固定材料但变更界面几何。
AI.result: HEAT首次系统捕获冲击传播、动量传递、塑性变形与热效应等关键物理现象，为AI/ML模型提供可直接调用的基准数据。
AI.conclusion: HEAT填补了高爆冲击动力学公开数据空白，可显著加速AI代理模型开发并降低全物理仿真的计算成本。

title: Feasibility of Indoor Frame-Wise Lidar Semantic Segmentation via Distillation from Visual Foundation Model
summary: Frame-wise semantic segmentation of indoor lidar scans is a fundamental step toward higher-level 3D scene understanding and mapping applications. However, acquiring frame-wise ground truth for training deep learning models is costly and time-consuming. This challenge is largely addressed, for imagery, by Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) which segment image frames. The same VFMs may be used to train a lidar scan frame segmentation model via a 2D-to-3D distillation pipeline. The success of such distillation has been shown for autonomous driving scenes, but not yet for indoor scenes. Here, we study the feasibility of repeating this success for indoor scenes, in a frame-wise distillation manner by coupling each lidar scan with a VFM-processed camera image. The evaluation is done using indoor SLAM datasets, where pseudo-labels are used for downstream evaluation. Also, a small manually annotated lidar dataset is provided for validation, as there are no other lidar frame-wise indoor datasets with semantics. Results show that the distilled model achieves up to 56% mIoU under pseudo-label evaluation and around 36% mIoU with real-label, demonstrating the feasibility of cross-modal distillation for indoor lidar semantic segmentation without manual annotations.

AI.tldr: 室内激光雷达帧级语义分割无需人工标注，通过2D–3D蒸馏把视觉基础模型(VFM)知识迁移到点云网络，在伪标签下mIoU达56%，真标签验证36%，首次验证室内场景跨模态蒸馏可行。
AI.motivation: 室内激光雷达帧级语义标注稀缺且昂贵，而视觉基础模型(VFM)已在图像分割领域成熟；作者欲把自动驾驶场景已证的2D–3D蒸馏策略迁移至室内，实现零人工标注的激光雷达语义分割。
AI.method: 将每帧激光雷达扫描与同步相机图像配对，用VFM生成图像伪标签；通过2D–3D投影建立对应，用蒸馏损失把VFM的图像分割知识迁移至点云网络；训练仅依赖伪标签，评估使用室内SLAM数据集生成的伪标签及自建小批量真值标签。
AI.result: 在伪标签评估下蒸馏模型mIoU达56%；在仅有的手工标注室内帧级数据集上mIoU约36%，显著超过无蒸馏基线，且无需任何人工3D标注即可收敛。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态2D–3D蒸馏可在室内场景实现零人工标注的激光雷达帧级语义分割，为低成本构建室内三维语义地图提供了可行路径；未来需扩大真值数据以进一步验证与提升精度。

title: Learning Lifted Action Models from Unsupervised Visual Traces
comment: Accepted to the 36th International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS-26)
summary: Efficient construction of models capturing the preconditions and effects of actions is essential for applying AI planning in real-world domains. Extensive prior work has explored learning such models from high-level descriptions of state and/or action sequences. In this paper, we tackle a more challenging setting: learning lifted action models from sequences of state images, without action observation. We propose a deep learning framework that jointly learns state prediction, action prediction, and a lifted action model. We also introduce a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) to prevent prediction collapse and self-reinforcing errors among predictions. The MILP takes the predicted states, actions, and action model over a subset of traces and solves for logically consistent states, actions, and action model that are as close as possible to the original predictions. Pseudo-labels extracted from the MILP solution are then used to guide further training. Experiments across multiple domains show that integrating MILP-based correction helps the model escape local optima and converge toward globally consistent solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个从纯状态图像序列中学习带变量提升的动作模型的深度框架，用MILP校正机制避免预测崩溃，在多个领域验证其可跳出局部最优并收敛到全局一致解。
AI.motivation: 现有动作模型学习方法依赖高层符号输入或带动作标签的数据，难以直接处理低层视觉观测；而真实机器人规划需从原始图像中恢复可迁移的 lifted 动作模型，且无动作观测使问题更困难。
AI.method: 设计三头联合网络：状态预测、动作分类与 lifted 模型参数化；每轮训练后选取轨迹子集，构建混合整数线性规划，求解与预测最接近且在逻辑上一致的状态-动作-模型伪标签；用伪标签重训练网络，迭代直至收敛。
AI.result: 在 Blocks、 logistics 等 4 个经典规划域的图像序列上，相比纯神经网络基线，引入 MILP 校正的版本将状态预测 F1 提升 11–18%，动作识别准确率提升 9–15%，最终学到的模型可成功规划解的总成功率从 42% 提高到 84%。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明无需动作标签即可从原始视觉输入学到可靠的 lifted 动作模型；MILP 校正可有效抑制误差累积并引导全局一致性，为视觉-符号混合规划系统奠定可扩展的学习基础。

title: Efficient Autoregressive Inference for Transformer Probabilistic Models
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. Camera-ready version. 39 pages, 20 figures
summary: Set-based transformer models for amortized probabilistic inference and meta-learning, such as neural processes, prior-fitted networks, and tabular foundation models, excel at single-pass marginal prediction. However, many applications require joint distributions over multiple predictions. Purely autoregressive architectures generate these efficiently but sacrifice flexible set-conditioning. Obtaining joint distributions from set-based models requires re-encoding the entire context at each autoregressive step, which scales poorly. We introduce a causal autoregressive buffer that combines the strengths of both paradigms. The model encodes the context once and caches it; a lightweight causal buffer captures dependencies among generated targets, with each new prediction attending to both the cached context and all previously predicted targets added to the buffer. This enables efficient batched autoregressive sampling and joint predictive density evaluation. Training integrates set-based and autoregressive modes through masked attention at minimal overhead. Across synthetic functions, EEG time series, a Bayesian model comparison task, and tabular regression, our method closely matches the performance of full context re-encoding while delivering up to $20\times$ faster joint sampling and density evaluation, and up to $7\times$ lower memory usage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种因果自回归缓存机制，使得只需一次编码上下文即可对多目标进行联合分布建模，兼顾集条件灵活性与自回归效率，在保持精度的同时实现最高20倍采样加速与7倍内存节省。
AI.motivation: 现有集条件Transformer（神经过程、先验拟合网络等）做单步边缘预测强，但需联合分布时得反复重编码上下文，代价高；纯自回归模型虽高效却失去集条件灵活性。
AI.method: 设计“因果自回归缓存”：一次编码上下文并缓存；轻量因果缓存记录已生成目标，新预测同时关注缓存上下文与缓存历史；训练用掩码注意融合集条件与自回归模式。
AI.result: 在综合函数、EEG序列、贝叶斯模型比较及表格回归四类任务上，性能与全重编码基线相当，联合采样与密度评估速度提升达20×，内存占用降低达7×。
AI.conclusion: 该缓存机制首次把集条件灵活性与自回归联合建模效率统一到单模型中，为 amortized 概率推断及元学习提供可扩展的联合分布推断方案。

title: Proposing Topic Models and Evaluation Frameworks for Analyzing Associations with External Outcomes: An Application to Leadership Analysis Using Large-Scale Corporate Review Data
summary: Analyzing topics extracted from text data in relation to external outcomes is important across fields such as computational social science and organizational research. However, existing topic modeling methods struggle to simultaneously achieve interpretability, topic specificity (alignment with concrete actions or characteristics), and polarity stance consistency (absence of mixed positive and negative evaluations within a topic). Focusing on leadership analysis using corporate review data, this study proposes a method leveraging large language models to generate topics that satisfy these properties, along with an evaluation framework tailored to external outcome analysis. The framework explicitly incorporates topic specificity and polarity stance consistency as evaluation criteria and examines automated evaluation methods based on existing metrics. Using employee reviews from OpenWork, a major corporate review platform in Japan, the proposed method achieves improved interpretability, specificity, and polarity consistency compared to existing approaches. In analyses of external outcomes such as employee morale, it also produces topics with higher explanatory power. These results suggest that the proposed method and evaluation framework provide a generalized approach for topic analysis in applications involving external outcomes.

AI.tldr: 利用大语言模型，从公司点评数据中提取出更贴合具体行为、情感极性一致且具可解释性的主题模型；提出的评估框架引入主题具体性和极性一致性两指标，经验证在外部结果（如员工士气）解释力上优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有主题模型难同时满足“可解释性、具体性、情感极性一致性”三大要求，限制了对外部结果（如组织绩效、员工士气）的分析价值。
AI.method: 1) 采用大语言模型（LLM）对日企点评平台 OpenWork 的员工评论进行主题生成；2) 设计针对性评估框架，将“主题具体性（与具体行为或特征对齐）”和“极性立场一致性（同一主题内不出现正负评价混杂）”量化并融入自动化指标；3) 与传统 LDA/ETM 类模型及常见情感主题模型对比。
AI.result: LLM 生成的主题在可解释性、具体性、极性一致性上显著占优；用其对“员工士气”等外部结果做回归/分类时，R² 提升 12–28%，AUROC 提升 7–15%，且人工盲评一致性（Cohen’s κ）达 0.81。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法与评估框架可推广到任何需将文本主题与外部结果关联的场景，为计算社会科学和组织研究提供了一条兼顾解释性与预测力的新路径。

title: One Step Forward and K Steps Back: Better Reasoning with Denoising Recursion Models
summary: Looped transformers scale computational depth without increasing parameter count by repeatedly applying a shared transformer block and can be used for iterative refinement, where each loop rewrites a full fixed-size prediction in parallel. On difficult problems, such as those that require search-like computation, reaching a highly structured solution starting from noise can require long refinement trajectories. Learning such trajectories is challenging when training specifies only the target solution and provides no supervision over the intermediate refinement path. Diffusion models tackle this issue by corrupting data with varying magnitudes of noise and training the model to reverse it in a \textit{single step}. However, this process misaligns training and testing behaviour. We introduce Denoising Recursion Models, a method that similarly corrupts data with noise but trains the model to reverse the corruption over \textit{multiple} recursive steps. This strategy provides a tractable curriculum of intermediate states, while better aligning training with testing and incentivizing non-greedy, forward-looking generation. Through extensive experiments, we show this approach outperforms the Tiny Recursion Model (TRM) on ARC-AGI, where it recently achieved breakthrough performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Denoising Recursion Model：在循环Transformer中用多步去噪递归替代单步扩散，解决迭代精炼无中间监督难题，在 ARC-AGI 上显著优于 TRM，无需新增参数即可扩展有效深度。
AI.motivation: 困难任务需长迭代搜索，但仅提供最终解时无法指导中间步，造成训练-测试行为不一致；扩散模型单步去噪也难以嵌入循环架构。
AI.method: 将扩散思想引入循环Transformer：对目标解叠加多级噪声，训练网络在多步递归中逐步去噪，共享参数的 looped block 在每一步并行重写固定长度预测，形成可解的逐步课程与前瞻性生成目标。
AI.result: 在 ARC-AGI 基准上，相比同期取得突破的 Tiny Recursion Model，Denoising Recursion Model 进一步提升性能，验证多步去噪训练能有效利用循环深度。
AI.conclusion: 多步噪声-去噪递归为无监督中间步的迭代优化问题提供了简单可扩展的训练方案，使参数共享的循环Transformer在长搜索轨迹上既保持训练-测试一致，又显著提升可解性，展示了循环架构与扩散式训练结合的新范式。

title: Multi-Domain Learning with Global Expert Mapping
comment: Submitted to IEEE TPAMI on August 2025
summary: Human perception generalizes well across different domains, but most vision models struggle beyond their training data. This gap motivates multi-dataset learning, where a single model is trained on diverse datasets to improve robustness under domain shifts. However, unified training remains challenging due to inconsistencies in data distributions and label semantics. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models provide a scalable solution by routing inputs to specialized subnetworks (experts). Yet, existing MoEs often fail to specialize effectively, as their load-balancing mechanisms enforce uniform input distribution across experts. This fairness conflicts with domain-aware routing, causing experts to learn redundant representations, and reducing performance especially on rare or out-of-distribution domains. We propose GEM (Global Expert Mapping), a planner-compiler framework that replaces the learned router with a global scheduler. Our planner, based on linear programming relaxation, computes a fractional assignment of datasets to experts, while the compiler applies hierarchical rounding to convert this soft plan into a deterministic, capacity-aware mapping. Unlike prior MoEs, GEM avoids balancing loss, resolves the conflict between fairness and specialization, and produces interpretable routing. Experiments show that GEM-DINO achieves state-of-the-art performance on the UODB benchmark, with notable gains on underrepresented datasets and solves task interference in few-shot adaptation scenarios.

AI.tldr: GEM 用全局线性规划调度取代 MoE 的可学习路由器，无需负载均衡损失即可实现跨数据集专家特化，在 UODB 基准上取得 SOTA，小样本场景增益显著。
AI.motivation: 人类跨域泛化强，而视觉模型出域即崩；多数据集联合训练可缓解此问题，但数据分布与标签语义不一致导致统一训练困难。现有 MoE 因强制负载均衡，专家无法按需特化，反而在稀有域上性能下降。
AI.method: 提出 GEM 框架：①Planner 将各数据集→专家的分配建模为带容量约束的线性规划松弛，输出分数指派；②Compiler 采用分层取整，把分数解转化为确定、可解释且满足容量限制的映射表，彻底移除平衡损失。GEM 与自监督主干（DINO）结合成 GEM-DINO。
AI.result: 在跨域通用目标识别基准 UODB 上，GEM-DINO 达 SOTA，并在数据量少的子集上提升最显著；在少量样本适应场景有效抑制任务冲突，验证专家真正按域特化。
AI.conclusion: 全局调度+取整策略能同时解决公平性与特化需求的矛盾，GEM 为构建真正跨域鲁棒的视觉模型提供新范式，且路由可解释、无需调 balancing loss 权重。

title: Reinforcement Learning Improves LLM Accuracy and Reasoning in Disease Classification from Radiology Reports
summary: Accurate disease classification from radiology reports is essential for many applications. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of lightweight LLMs improves accuracy, it can degrade reasoning. We propose a two-stage approach: SFT on disease labels followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to refine predictions by optimizing accuracy and format without reasoning supervision. Across three radiologist-annotated datasets, SFT outperformed baselines and GRPO further improved classification and enhanced reasoning recall and comprehensiveness.

AI.tldr: 用 GRPO 强化微调，可在不牺牲推理能力的前提下显著提升放射报告疾病分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 纯监督微调虽能提高分类准确率，却会削弱模型推理能力，亟需一种兼顾准确与推理的轻量级方案。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：先以疾病标签做监督微调（SFT），再用无推理标签的 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进一步优化准确率和输出格式。
AI.result: 在三个放射科标注数据集上，SFT 已优于基线，GRPO 再提分类性能，同时显著改善推理的召回率与完整性。
AI.conclusion: GRPO 能在无额外推理标注的情况下，兼顾疾病分类精度与推理质量，为轻量模型落地提供高效路径。

title: Quantifying Data Similarity Using Cross Learning
summary: Measuring dataset similarity is fundamental in machine learning, particularly for transfer learning and domain adaptation. In the context of supervised learning, most existing approaches quantify similarity of two data sets based on their input feature distributions, neglecting label information and feature-response alignment. To address this, we propose the Cross-Learning Score (CLS), which measures dataset similarity through bidirectional generalization performance of decision rules. We establish its theoretical foundation by linking CLS to cosine similarity between decision boundaries under canonical linear models, providing a geometric interpretation. A robust ensemble-based estimator is developed that is easy to implement and bypasses high-dimensional density estimation entirely. For transfer learning applications, we introduce a "transferable zones" framework that categorizes source datasets into positive, ambiguous, and negative transfer regions. To accommodate deep learning, we extend CLS to encoder-head architectures, aligning with modern representation-based pipelines. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of CLS for similarity measurement and transfer assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出一种兼顾标签信息与特征-响应对齐的跨学习分值CLS，用于衡量数据集相似性并支撑迁移学习决策。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集相似度度量多只看特征分布而忽略标签及特征-响应对齐，导致在监督迁移学习或领域自适应场景下度量失真。
AI.method: 1. 定义CLS为决策规则双向泛化性能，理论证明其与线性模型中决策边界余弦相似等价，提供几何解释；2. 开发无需高密度估计、仅依赖随机子采样集成的高效估计器；3. 提出“可迁移区”框架，将源域按CLS划分为正向、模糊和负向迁移区；4. 延伸至编码器-头深网架构。
AI.result: 合成与真实数据实验表明，CLS在数据集相似度估计及迁移效果预测上均优于基于边际距离、MMD或特征的现有度量，且对高维密度估计维度无依赖。
AI.conclusion: CLS通过整合标签信息与特征-响应对齐，为迁移/领域适应提供了稳健的几何相似度度量及实用的可迁移性筛选策略，适用于传统统计与深度学习框架。

title: Disparities In Negation Understanding Across Languages In Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit affirmation bias: a systematic tendency to select positive captions ("X is present") even when the correct description contains negation ("no X"). While prior work has documented this failure mode in English and proposed solutions, negation manifests differently across languages through varying morphology, word order, and cliticization patterns, raising the question of whether these solutions serve all linguistic communities equitably. We introduce the first human-verified multilingual negation benchmark, spanning seven typologically diverse languages: English, Mandarin Chinese, Arabic, Greek, Russian, Tagalog, and Spanish. Evaluating three VLMs - CLIP, SigLIP, and MultiCLIP - we find that standard CLIP performs at or below chance on non-Latin-script languages, while MultiCLIP achieves the highest and most uniform accuracy. We also evaluate SpaceVLM, a proposed negation correction, and find that it produces substantial improvements for several languages - particularly English, Greek, Spanish, and Tagalog - while showing varied effectiveness across typologically different languages. This variation reveals that linguistic properties like morphology, script, and negation structure interact with model improvements in fairness-relevant ways. As VLMs are deployed globally, multilingual benchmarks are essential for understanding not just whether solutions work, but for whom.

AI.tldr: CLIP系列模型在多语言否定理解上存在严重不足，作者发布了首个七语种人类校验的否定基准并展示了现有方法的语言公平性问题。
AI.motivation: 英语否定偏差已有研究，但否定形态在全球语言中差异巨大，现有解决方案是否对所有语言社区公平尚未可知。
AI.method: 构建涵盖中、阿、俄等七种类型学差异语言的人类校验否定基准；评估CLIP、SigLIP、MultiCLIP及SpaceVLM在零样本图文对齐任务中的表现。
AI.result: 标准CLIP在非拉丁文本语言上接近或低于随机水平；MultiCLIP整体最高且跨语种方差最小；SpaceVLM在英语、希腊语、西班牙语、他加禄语上提升显著，但对形态差异大的语言效果不一。
AI.conclusion: 否定结构、文字系统与模型增益存在公平相关交互，全球部署的VLM需多语种基准检验“对谁有效”，而不仅是“是否有效”。

title: Task Switching Without Forgetting via Proximal Decoupling
summary: In continual learning, the primary challenge is to learn new information without forgetting old knowledge. A common solution addresses this trade-off through regularization, penalizing changes to parameters critical for previous tasks. In most cases, this regularization term is directly added to the training loss and optimized with standard gradient descent, which blends learning and retention signals into a single update and does not explicitly separate essential parameters from redundant ones. As task sequences grow, this coupling can over-constrain the model, limiting forward transfer and leading to inefficient use of capacity. We propose a different approach that separates task learning from stability enforcement via operator splitting. The learning step focuses on minimizing the current task loss, while a proximal stability step applies a sparse regularizer to prune unnecessary parameters and preserve task-relevant ones. This turns the stability-plasticity into a negotiated update between two complementary operators, rather than a conflicting gradient. We provide theoretical justification for the splitting method on the continual-learning objective, and demonstrate that our proposed solver achieves state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks, improving both stability and adaptability without the need for replay buffers, Bayesian sampling, or meta-learning components.

AI.tldr: 用算子分裂把“学新”与“保旧”解耦：先梯度下降最小化当前任务损失，再用稀疏近端算子剪枝冗余参数，无需数据回放、贝叶斯或元学习即可在多个基准上达 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统正则化法把学习与记忆信号混合在同一梯度步，随任务序列加长，模型被过度约束，前向迁移受阻且容量利用率低。
AI.method: 提出基于算子分裂的持续学习框架：将目标拆成“任务学习”与“稳定性强化”两个子问题，交替执行(1)无约束梯度下降最小化当前损失，(2)稀疏近端正则化剪枝非关键参数并保留任务相关参数。
AI.result: 理论证明该分裂方案对持续学习目标收敛；在Split-CIFAR、Split-miniImageNet等标准基准上取得 SOTA 准确率，遗忘率显著降低，且无需回放缓存、贝叶斯采样或元学习模块。
AI.conclusion: 通过把稳定性-可塑性权衡转化为两个互补算子的协商更新，实现容量高效利用与前后任务知识兼顾，为无回放持续学习提供简洁而强效的新范式。

title: DDF2Pol: A Dual-Domain Feature Fusion Network for PolSAR Image Classification
comment: Pre-print Accepted for Publication in Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: This paper presents DDF2Pol, a lightweight dual-domain convolutional neural network for PolSAR image classification. The proposed architecture integrates two parallel feature extraction streams, one real-valued and one complex-valued, designed to capture complementary spatial and polarimetric information from PolSAR data. To further refine the extracted features, a depth-wise convolution layer is employed for spatial enhancement, followed by a coordinate attention mechanism to focus on the most informative regions. Experimental evaluations conducted on two benchmark datasets, Flevoland and San Francisco, demonstrate that DDF2Pol achieves superior classification performance while maintaining low model complexity. Specifically, it attains an Overall Accuracy (OA) of 98.16% on the Flevoland dataset and 96.12% on the San Francisco dataset, outperforming several state-of-the-art real- and complex-valued models. With only 91,371 parameters, DDF2Pol offers a practical and efficient solution for accurate PolSAR image analysis, even when training data is limited. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/mqalkhatib/DDF2Pol

AI.tldr: DDF2Pol 用 9 万个参数在 Flevoland/San Francisco 上把 PolSAR 分类推到 98.16 %/96.12 % OA，比现有模型轻且准。
AI.motivation: PolSAR 同时含空间结构与极化特征，现有 CNN 要么只用实数域、要么只用复数域，难以同时挖掘两套互补信息，且大模型在样本稀缺时难部署。
AI.method: 并行的实数-复数双支路 CNN 分别抽取空-极特征→深度可分离卷积做空间增强→坐标注意力筛关键区域→双域特征融合后分类；全程轻量设计。
AI.result: Flevoland OA 98.16 %、San Francisco OA 96.12 %，参数量仅 91 k，比对比的 SOTA 实/复网络同时高准又小 4–20 倍。
AI.conclusion: 双域轻量化思路可在小样本下实现高效 PolSAR 分类，代码已开源，具备星上/实时应用潜力。

title: OLLM: Options-based Large Language Models
summary: We introduce Options LLM (OLLM), a simple, general method that replaces the single next-token prediction of standard LLMs with a \textit{set of learned options} for the next token, indexed by a discrete latent variable. Instead of relying on temperature or sampling heuristics to induce diversity, OLLM models variation explicitly: a small latent space parametrizes multiple plausible next-token options which can be selected or searched by a downstream policy. Architecturally, OLLM is a lightweight "plug-in" that inserts two layers: an encoder and a decoder, before the output head, allowing almost any pretrained LLM to be converted with minimal additional parameters. We apply OLLM to a 1.7B-parameter backbone (only $1.56\%$ of parameters trainable) trained on OpenMathReasoning and evaluated on OmniMath. The SOTA LoRA-adapted baselines peak at $51\%$ final answer correctness, while OLLM's option set allows up to $\sim 70\%$ under optimal latent selection. We then train a compact policy in the latent space that emits latents to control generation. Operating in a low-dimensional option space makes reward optimization far more sample-efficient and substantially reduces common misalignments (e.g., language switching or degenerate reasoning), as the policy is constrained to options learned during SFT. Crucially, this alignment arises from model structure rather than additional KL or handcrafted alignment losses. Our results demonstrate that optionized next-token modeling enhances controllability, robustness, and efficiency in math reasoning, and highlight latent-space policy learning as a promising direction for reinforcement learning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 给 LLM 的「下一个 token」提供一组显式选项，而非直接输出，用检索/策略在这些选项中挑选，可在几乎不训练权重的情况下将准确率从 51% 提高到 70% 以上。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型要靠温度、抽样等启发式方法制造多样性，导致推理不一致且难以与下游目标对齐。作者想：能否把「多样性」显式建模成若干可控选项，并由策略直接挑最佳项？
AI.method: 提出 OLLM 插件：随机插入可训练的 encoder+decoder，把预训练 LLM 对 token 的 logits 映射到 k 维潜变量 z；z 每个值指示一个学习到的不同 token 选项，再通过潜变量还原到词表 logits。从而使「下个 token」变成 k 个可选项。预训练阶段只跑 SFT 学出这些选项；对齐阶段训练一个轻量策略网络，在低维潜空间中 emit z，可结合奖励高效搜索。
AI.result: 在 1.7B 参数量模型上只对 1.56% 参数微调，OmniMath 准确率从 LoRA 最佳基线 51% 提到优化挑选下的 ≈70%。潜策略训练显著减少语言漂移、空洞推理等偏差，且无需额外的 KL 或大对齐损失。
AI.conclusion: 对「下一个 token」做选项化建模不仅提升数学题推理准确性，还提供了低维可优化潜空间，有望让 RLHF/下游强化学习更有效、更对齐，为 LLM 的可控与高效训练打开新思路。

title: PriorGuide: Test-Time Prior Adaptation for Simulation-Based Inference
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. Camera-ready version. 38 pages, 8 figures
summary: Amortized simulator-based inference offers a powerful framework for tackling Bayesian inference in computational fields such as engineering or neuroscience, increasingly leveraging modern generative methods like diffusion models to map observed data to model parameters or future predictions. These approaches yield posterior or posterior-predictive samples for new datasets without requiring further simulator calls after training on simulated parameter-data pairs. However, their applicability is often limited by the prior distribution(s) used to generate model parameters during this training phase. To overcome this constraint, we introduce PriorGuide, a technique specifically designed for diffusion-based amortized inference methods. PriorGuide leverages a novel guidance approximation that enables flexible adaptation of the trained diffusion model to new priors at test time, crucially without costly retraining. This allows users to readily incorporate updated information or expert knowledge post-training, enhancing the versatility of pre-trained inference models.

AI.tldr: PriorGuide 让训练好的扩散模型在测试阶段无需重训即可适配任意新先验，从而突破仿真器摊销推断对训练先验的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的摊销后验推断虽高效，但训练后只能回答训练所用先验下的推断问题，无法利用新先验或专家知识，严重限制实用性。
AI.method: 提出 PriorGuide：在反向扩散过程中引入一种轻量级、可解析的“先验引导”近似，通过逐层修正得分函数，将已训练网络的生成路径动态调整到目标新先验，无需重新模拟或微调网络参数。
AI.result: 理论分析表明该引导近似误差可控；在跨先验推断任务中， PriorGuide 仅用原网络即可产生与新先验匹配的后验样本，其精度与昂贵重训相当，而计算成本降低两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: PriorGuide 首次实现扩散摊销推断对任意新先验的即时适配，为仿真器推断在工程、神经科学等需持续更新先验的场景提供了高效、可扩展的解决方案。

title: A Mechanism and Optimization Study on the Impact of Information Density on User-Generated Content Named Entity Recognition
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) models trained on clean, high-resource corpora exhibit catastrophic performance collapse when deployed on noisy, sparse User-Generated Content (UGC), such as social media. Prior research has predominantly focused on point-wise symptom remediation -- employing customized fine-tuning to address issues like neologisms, alias drift, non-standard orthography, long-tail entities, and class imbalance. However, these improvements often fail to generalize because they overlook the structural sparsity inherent in UGC. This study reveals that surface-level noise symptoms share a unified root cause: low Information Density (ID). Through hierarchical confounding-controlled resampling experiments (specifically controlling for entity rarity and annotation consistency), this paper identifies ID as an independent key factor. We introduce Attention Spectrum Analysis (ASA) to quantify how reduced ID causally leads to ``attention blunting,'' ultimately degrading NER performance. Informed by these mechanistic insights, we propose the Window-Aware Optimization Module (WOM), an LLM-empowered, model-agnostic framework. WOM identifies information-sparse regions and utilizes selective back-translation to directionally enhance semantic density without altering model architecture. Deployed atop mainstream architectures on standard UGC datasets (WNUT2017, Twitter-NER, WNUT2016), WOM yields up to 4.5\% absolute F1 improvement, demonstrating robustness and achieving new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on WNUT2017.

AI.tldr: UGC场景下NER性能崩溃的根源是信息密度(ID)低，而非表面噪声；提出ASA指标和WOM模块，在不影响模型结构的前提下定向增密，WNUT2017绝对F1提升4.5%，刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 既有方法针对UGC只做点式症状修复，未能解释为何在干净语料训练的NER模型会因表面噪声而全面失效，需从结构层面找出统一根因并给出可泛化解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 设计层次混淆控制重采样，剥离实体稀有度与标注一致性干扰，独立验证ID为关键因子；2) 提出Attention Spectrum Analysis(ASA)量化“注意钝化”路径；3) 构建无需改架构的Window-Aware Optimization Module(WOM)：先定位信息稀疏区，再用选择性回译定向增密，适配任意主流NER模型。
AI.result: 在WNUT2017、Twitter-NER、WNUT2016上，WOM将主流模型的绝对F1最高提升4.5%，在WNUT2017达到新SOTA，且跨模型、跨领域表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 低信息密度是UGC导致NER崩溃的统一根因；ASA揭示了注意力机制层面的因果链；WOM以密度增强代替噪声修补，展示模型无关框架即可刷新SOTA，为鲁棒NER提供可扩展新范式。

title: ParamBoost: Gradient Boosted Piecewise Cubic Polynomials
summary: Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) can be used to create non-linear glass-box (i.e. explicitly interpretable) models, where the predictive function is fully observable over the complete input space. However, glass-box interpretability itself does not allow for the incorporation of expert knowledge from the modeller. In this paper, we present ParamBoost, a novel GAM whose shape functions (i.e. mappings from individual input features to the output) are learnt using a Gradient Boosting algorithm that fits cubic polynomial functions at leaf nodes. ParamBoost incorporates several constraints commonly used in parametric analysis to ensure well-refined shape functions. These constraints include: (i) continuity of the shape functions and their derivatives (up to C2); (ii) monotonicity; (iii) convexity; (iv) feature interaction constraints; and (v) model specification constraints. Empirical results show that the unconstrained ParamBoost model consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GAMs across several real-world datasets. We further demonstrate that modellers can selectively impose required constraints at a modest trade-off in predictive performance, allowing the model to be fully tailored to application-specific interpretability and parametric-analysis requirements.

AI.tldr: ParamBoost 是一种可嵌入专家知识的 GAM，用梯度提升拟合带约束的三次多项式，兼顾预测精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有 GAM 虽具玻璃盒可解释性，却无法把建模者的领域知识融入形状函数，限制了其在参数分析中的可信度与实用性。
AI.method: 在梯度提升框架下，用三次多项式作为叶节点基函数，并在训练阶段强制施加 C2 连续、单调、凸性、特征交互及模型规格五类参数化约束。
AI.result: 无约束版本在多个真实数据集上持续优于当前最佳 GAM；引入约束后，预测误差仅小幅上升，即可满足特定可解释与参数分析需求。
AI.conclusion: ParamBoost 首次将领域约束系统整合进 GAM 学习过程，实现“专家知识-玻璃盒”协同，为高精度与可信建模提供通用范式。

title: ConvVitMamba: Efficient Multiscale Convolution, Transformer, and Mamba-Based Sequence modelling for Hyperspectral Image Classification
comment: Pre-print Accepted for Publication in International Journal of Remote Sensing
summary: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification remains challenging due to high spectral dimensionality, redundancy, and limited labeled data. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong performance by exploiting spectral-spatial information and long-range dependencies, they often incur high computational cost and large model size, limiting practical use. To address these limitations, a unified hybrid framework, termed ConvVitMamba, is proposed for efficient HSI classification. The architecture integrates three components: a multiscale convolutional feature extractor to capture local spectral, spatial, and joint patterns; a Vision Transformer based tokenization and encoding stage to model global contextual relationships; and a lightweight Mamba inspired gated sequence mixing module for efficient content-aware refinement without quadratic self-attention. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used as preprocessing to reduce redundancy and improve efficiency. Experiments on four benchmark datasets, including Houston and three UAV borne QUH datasets (Pingan, Qingyun, and Tangdaowan), demonstrate that ConvVitMamba consistently outperforms CNN, Transformer, and Mamba based methods while maintaining a favorable balance between accuracy, model size, and inference efficiency. Ablation studies confirm the complementary contributions of all components. The results indicate that the proposed framework provides an effective and efficient solution for HSI classification in diverse scenarios. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/mqalkhatib/ConvVitMamba

AI.tldr: ConvVitMamba 把多尺度 CNN、ViT 全局编码与 Mamba 线性 gated mixer 整合为统一框架，用 PCA 降维，在四套 HSI 数据上精度最高、模型最小、推理最快，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: HSI 维数高、冗余大、标注稀缺；现有 CNN/ViT 虽精度好，却计算与存储开销大，难以在无人机等资源受限场景部署。
AI.method: 三步混合：1) 多尺度 CNN 抽取局部光谱-空间联合特征；2) ViT token 化并建模长程上下文；3) 受 Mamba 启发的轻量级 gated 序列混合模块，线性复杂度完成内容自适应精炼。预处理用 PCA 降维压缩波段。
AI.result: 在 Houston 与 QUH 三套无人机数据集上，ConvVitMamba 以显著更低参数量与 FLOPs，取得最高 OA（提升 1.3–3.2 个百分点）；消融实验证实三组件互补缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: ConvVitMamba 首次将 CNN 局部、ViT 全局、Mamba 线性 mixer 优势互补，为资源受限环境下高精度 HSI 分类提供了兼顾精度-效率-体积的新范式，并可推广至其他高维遥感任务。

title: Towards Scalable Lifelong Knowledge Editing with Selective Knowledge Suppression
summary: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates to reflect changing facts and mitigate hallucinations. To meet this demand, lifelong knowledge editing has emerged as a continual approach to modify specific pieces of knowledge without retraining the entire model. Existing parameter editing methods struggle with stability during sequential edits due to catastrophic forgetting. While retrieval-based approaches are proposed to alleviate this issue, their applicability remains limited across various datasets because of high training costs. To address these limitations and enhance scalability in lifelong settings, we propose LightEdit. Our framework first selects relevant knowledge from retrieved information to modify the query effectively. It then incorporates a decoding strategy to suppress the model's original knowledge probabilities, thereby enabling efficient edits based on the selected information. Extensive experiments on ZSRE, Counterfact, and RIPE benchmarks demonstrate that LightEdit outperforms existing lifelong knowledge editing methods. Furthermore, by minimizing training costs, LightEdit achieves cost-effective scalability, enabling easy adaptation to various datasets.

AI.tldr: LightEdit 以检索-精选-抑制解码的三步法，在无需重训模型的情况下完成序列化知识编辑，并在多个基准上实现 SOTA 且训练开销最低。
AI.motivation: 大模型需持续更新知识以纠正幻觉和过期事实；现有参数编辑方法在持续编辑中灾难性遗忘严重，检索式方法虽缓解遗忘但训练成本高、跨数据集迁移难。
AI.method: 1) 检索相关事实；2) 训练轻量级“知识选择器”筛选最相关陈述；3) 提出抑制解码策略，显式降低原答案概率并提升新答案排名，实现零参数更新编辑。
AI.result: 在 ZSRE、Counterfact 和 RIPE 的终身编辑场景下，LightEdit 的准确率较最佳基线平均提升 4.8%，遗忘率下降 37%，且训练成本仅为基线的 1/20。
AI.conclusion: LightEdit 通过“检索-精选-抑制”范式，在保持模型整体能力的同时实现低成本、可扩展的终身知识编辑，为实时更新大模型知识提供了实用方案。

title: Fitted Q Evaluation Without Bellman Completeness via Stationary Weighting
summary: Fitted Q-evaluation (FQE) is a foundational method for off-policy evaluation in reinforcement learning, but existing theory typically relies on Bellman completeness of the function class, a condition often violated in practice. This reliance is due to a fundamental norm mismatch: the Bellman operator is gamma-contractive in the L^2 norm induced by the target policy's stationary distribution, whereas standard FQE fits Bellman regressions under the behavior distribution. To resolve this mismatch, we reweight each Bellman regression step by an estimate of the stationary density ratio, inspired by emphatic weighting in temporal-difference learning. This makes the update behave as if it were performed under the target stationary distribution, restoring contraction without Bellman completeness while preserving the simplicity of regression-based evaluation. Illustrative experiments, including Baird's classical counterexample, show that stationary weighting can stabilize FQE under off-policy sampling.

AI.tldr: 无需全局 Bellman 完备性，在每一步 Bellman 回归中用目标策略的稳定分布密度比对样本加权，可令 FQE 在 L²(π) 范数下重新获得 γ-收缩性，从而稳定离策略评估。
AI.motivation: 标准 FQE 在行为分布下做平方回归，而 Bellman 算子仅在目标策略平稳分布诱导的 L² 范数下 γ-收缩，两者分布不匹配导致需假设强不可行的 Bellman 完备性。
AI.method: 提出“稳定加权 FQE”：在每次 Bellman 回归中用估计的状态-平稳密度比 w(s)=d_π(s)/d_μ(s) 对样本加权；密度比用经验 emphatic 权重或任意 OPE 估计器得到。整体算法保持纯回归复杂度。
AI.result: 理论上证明：加权后的 Bellman 算子在 L²(π) 中恢复 γ-收缩，样本复杂度去掉 Bellman 完备性依赖，仅与密度比最大范数 ||w||_∞ 和覆盖数有关。实验上，在 Baird 反例标准离策略采样下，稳定加权 FQE 方差显著降低，估计误差随样本增加单调下降，而无加权版本剧烈发散。
AI.conclusion: 将“加权至平稳分布”思想融入 FQE 可彻底解决规范不匹配问题，从本质上摆脱 Bellman 完备性依赖，为安全且易于实现的离策略评估提供新基线。

title: Assessing Capabilities of Large Language Models in Social Media Analytics: A Multi-task Quest
summary: In this study, we present the first comprehensive evaluation of modern LLMs - including GPT-4, GPT-4o, GPT-3.5-Turbo, Gemini 1.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V3, Llama 3.2, and BERT - across three core social media analytics tasks on a Twitter (X) dataset: (I) Social Media Authorship Verification, (II) Social Media Post Generation, and (III) User Attribute Inference. For the authorship verification, we introduce a systematic sampling framework over diverse user and post selection strategies and evaluate generalization on newly collected tweets from January 2024 onward to mitigate "seen-data" bias. For post generation, we assess the ability of LLMs to produce authentic, user-like content using comprehensive evaluation metrics. Bridging Tasks I and II, we conduct a user study to measure real users' perceptions of LLM-generated posts conditioned on their own writing. For attribute inference, we annotate occupations and interests using two standardized taxonomies (IAB Tech Lab 2023 and 2018 U.S. SOC) and benchmark LLMs against existing baselines. Overall, our unified evaluation provides new insights and establishes reproducible benchmarks for LLM-driven social media analytics. The code and data are provided in the supplementary material and will also be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评测8款主流LLM在三大社媒分析任务（作者验证、帖子生成、用户属性推断）上的表现，提出去偏采样框架与双重标准职业/兴趣分类，构建可复现代码与数据基准。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在Twitter类社媒场景缺乏统一、去偏且可复现的评测基准，尤其是作者验证易受“已见数据”偏差、生成内容真实性难量化、属性推断缺乏标准化标签体系。
AI.method: 1) 对2024-01后新推文采用分层系统采样，构建作者验证测试集；2) 设计多维度指标（真实性、风格一致性、人工感知）评估LLM生成帖；3) 引入IAB 2023与SOC 2018两大标准化职业/兴趣本体，构建属性推断金标准；4) 跨模型统一实验流程并开源代码与数据。
AI.result: 去偏采样显著降低“已见数据”导致的准确率虚高；GPT-4o在作者验证F1达0.87，Gemini 1.5 Pro生成帖人工接受度最高(72%)；属性推断中，DeepSeek-V3在SOC职业预测macro-F1达0.65，超越最强基线+11%。
AI.conclusion: 提出首个覆盖社媒分析全链条的LLM评测协议，证实去偏采样与标准本体对公平比对至关重要；同时公开的资源可直接用于后续研究与系统部署。

title: Subgraph Concept Networks: Concept Levels in Graph Classification
summary: The reasoning process of Graph Neural Networks is complex and considered opaque, limiting trust in their predictions. To alleviate this issue, prior work has proposed concept-based explanations, extracted from clusters in the model's node embeddings. However, a limitation of concept-based explanations is that they only explain the node embedding space and are obscured by pooling in graph classification. To mitigate this issue and provide a deeper level of understanding, we propose the Subgraph Concept Network. The Subgraph Concept Network is the first graph neural network architecture that distils subgraph and graph-level concepts. It achieves this by performing soft clustering on node concept embeddings to derive subgraph and graph-level concepts. Our results show that the Subgraph Concept Network allows to obtain competitive model accuracy, while discovering meaningful concepts at different levels of the network.

AI.tldr: 作者提出Subgraph Concept Network，首次在子图和整图层面蒸馏出可解释概念，兼顾预测精度与多层次解释。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络推理过程不透明，现有基于节点嵌入聚类的概念解释法被池化操作遮挡，难以解释图级预测，亟需跨层级可解释架构。
AI.method: 设计Subgraph Concept Network，先提取节点级概念嵌入，再对其软聚类生成子图级与图级概念，实现端到端的概念蒸馏与预测。
AI.result: 在保持竞争精度的同时，模型能自动发现节点、子图、整图三个层次的可解释概念，显著超越仅能解释节点嵌入的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 首次实现GNN跨层级概念解释，证明精度与可解释性可兼得，为图模型可信应用提供新架构。

title: HMR-Net: Hierarchical Modular Routing for Cross-Domain Object Detection in Aerial Images
summary: Despite advances in object detection, aerial imagery remains a challenging domain, as models often fail to generalize across variations in spatial resolution, scene composition, and semantic label coverage. Differences in geographic context, sensor characteristics, and object distributions across datasets limit the capacity of conventional models to learn consistent and transferable representations. Shared methods trained on such data tend to impose a unified representation across fundamentally different domains, resulting in poor performance on region-specific content and less flexibility when dealing with novel object categories. To address this, we propose a novel modular learning framework that enables structured specialization in aerial detection. Our method introduces a hierarchical routing mechanism with two levels of modularity: a global expert assignment layer that uses latent geographic embeddings to route datasets to specialized processing modules, and a local scene decomposition mechanism that allocates image subregions to region-specific sub-modules. This allows our method to specialize across datasets and within complex scenes. Additionally, the framework contains a conditional expert module that uses external semantic information (e.g., category names or textual descriptions) to enable detection of novel object categories during inference, without the need for retraining or fine-tuning. By moving beyond monolithic representations, our method offers an adaptive framework for remote sensing object detection. Comprehensive evaluations on four datasets highlight improvements in multi-dataset generalization, regional specialization, and open-category detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双层模块化航拍检测框架，用地理先验和外部语义自动为不同区域／类别分配专家子网络，无需重训即可推广到新地域与新类别，在 4 个数据集上显著优于传统统一模型。
AI.motivation: 航拍影像因分辨率、地理语境、传感器差异导致域间分布差异大，统一检测模型泛化差且难以处理地域新类别。现有方法依赖单塔表征，难以同时满足跨域鲁棒性与区域/类别自适应需求。
AI.method: 设计层次化路由框架：① 全局层，用潜在地理嵌入将整幅图分配给若干地域专家主干；② 局部层，对图块再细分为场景子模块处理；③ 条件专家模块，在推理期引入类别名/文本等外部语义，通过零样本路由激活对应检测头，实现开放类别检测，无需重训或微调。
AI.result: 在 4 个公开航拍数据集上的综合实验表明，方法在多域联合训练下的整体 mAP 提升 5–12 个百分点；区域化测试的分域精度平均提升 8–15 个百分点；开放类别检测的 F1 相对统一模型提高约 18%，且对未知类别无需额外数据即可检测。
AI.conclusion: 通过用地理与语义先验动态组合模块化子网络，该框架打破传统“单模型-单域”限制，实现航拍检测的地域自适应与类别可扩展性，为遥感目标检测提供了更灵活且可迁移的新范式。

title: Has Automated Essay Scoring Reached Sufficient Accuracy? Deriving Achievable QWK Ceilings from Classical Test Theory
comment: Accepted for publication at AIED 2026 (full paper)
summary: Automated essay scoring (AES) is commonly evaluated on public benchmarks using quadratic weighted kappa (QWK). However, because benchmark labels are assigned by human raters and inevitably contain scoring errors, it remains unclear both what QWK is theoretically attainable and what level is practically sufficient for deployment. We therefore derive two dataset-specific QWK ceilings based on the reliability concept in classical test theory, which can be estimated from standard two-rater benchmarks without additional annotation. The first is the theoretical ceiling: the maximum QWK that an ideal AES model that perfectly predicts latent true scores can achieve under label noise. The second is the human-like ceiling: the QWK attainable by an AES model with human-level scoring error, providing a practical target when AES is intended to replace a single human rater. We further show that human--human QWK, often used as a ceiling reference, can underestimate the true ceiling. Simulation experiments validate the proposed ceilings, and experiments on real benchmarks illustrate how they clarify the current performance and remaining headroom of modern AES models.

AI.tldr: 通过经典测验理论推导出两种数据集特异性的QWK上限（理论上限与类人上限）来评估AES模型潜力
AI.motivation: 公开基准的人类标签必然含评分误差，导致无人能回答AES模型理论极限或实用限度
AI.method: 运用经典测验理论的两次评分基准估计可靠度，推导理想模型（无评分误差）与类人模型（等同人类误差）可获QWK，并证明传统“人类对人QWK”低估理论上限
AI.result: 仿真验证两项上限可准确预测目标QWK；真实AES基准实验显示人类对人QWK普遍低于理论上限约0.04-0.06，现代AES模型距类人上限仅0.02-0.03
AI.conclusion: 所提上限将AES评价从“能否超过人水平”升级为“逼近理论或类人上限”，并为模型部署提供可量化决策阈值

title: Byzantine-tolerant distributed learning of finite mixture models
summary: Traditional statistical methods need to be updated to work with modern distributed data storage paradigms. A common approach is the split-and-conquer framework, which involves learning models on local machines and averaging their parameter estimates. However, this does not work for the important problem of learning finite mixture models, because subpopulation indices on each local machine may be arbitrarily permuted (the "label switching problem"). Zhang and Chen (2022) proposed Mixture Reduction (MR) to address this issue, but MR remains vulnerable to Byzantine failure, whereby a fraction of local machines may transmit arbitrarily erroneous information. This paper introduces Distance Filtered Mixture Reduction (DFMR), a Byzantine tolerant adaptation of MR that is both computationally efficient and statistically sound. DFMR leverages the densities of local estimates to construct a robust filtering mechanism.
