By analysing the pairwise L2 distances between local estimates, DFMR identifies and removes severely corrupted local estimates while retaining the majority of uncorrupted ones. We provide theoretical justification for DFMR, proving its optimal convergence rate and asymptotic equivalence to the global maximum likelihood estimate under standard assumptions. Numerical experiments on simulated and real-world data validate the effectiveness of DFMR in achieving robust and accurate aggregation in the presence of Byzantine failure.

AI.tldr: Distance Filtered Mixture Reduction (DFMR)，一种拜占庭容错的分布式混合模型学习方法，在保持计算效率的同时，通过 L² 距离过滤实现稳健聚合，理论最优收敛，实证有效。
AI.motivation: 现代分布式存储下，传统 split-and-conquer 平均参数的方法无法直接用于混合模型，因各本地隐变量标签可任意置换（标签切换）。现有 Mixture Reduction (MR) 虽解决标签对齐，但对拜占庭故障（局部机器发送任意恶意/错误信息）毫无抵抗力，亟需既高效又统计合理的鲁棒扩展。
AI.method: 提出 DFMR：1) 各本地机先学习混合模型并返回密度估计；2) 中心节点计算所有本地估计之间的成对 L² 距离；3) 构造基于密度的稳健滤波规则，识别并剔除严重腐败的估计，保留多数未腐败者；4) 对保留下来的估计重新对齐标签并聚合，得到全局模型。整个过程仅 O(|B|²) 距离计算，无需额外通信轮次。
AI.result: 理论上，在标准正则条件下证明：DFMR 估计达到与汇合所有数据的整体 MLE 相同的最小最大收敛速率，且渐近等价；拜占庭节点比例 ε<½ 时，破损估计被高概率剔除。模拟与真实数据实验显示，DFMR 在 ε≤30% 的任意攻击下仍保持与 MR/全局 EM 相当的精度，而 MR 及简单平均迅速崩溃。
AI.conclusion: DFMR 首次在不增加通信轮次的前提下，将标签对齐与拜占庭鲁棒性整合到混合模型的分布式学习中，提供可证明最优、计算轻量的解决方案，为高维、大规模、不可靠节点环境下的密度聚类与参数学习奠定实用方法。

title: STAR-Teaming: A Strategy-Response Multiplex Network Approach to Automated LLM Red Teaming
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used, they remain susceptible to jailbreak prompts that can elicit harmful or inappropriate responses. This paper introduces STAR-Teaming, a novel black-box framework for automated red teaming that effectively generates such prompts. STAR-Teaming integrates a Multi-Agent System (MAS) with a Strategy-Response Multiplex Network and employs network-driven optimization to sample effective attack strategies. This network-based approach recasts the intractable high-dimensional embedding space into a tractable structure, yielding two key advantages: it enhances the interpretability of the LLM's strategic vulnerabilities, and it streamlines the search for effective strategies by organizing the search space into semantic communities, thereby preventing redundant exploration. Empirical results demonstrate that STAR-Teaming significantly surpasses existing methods, achieving a higher attack success rate (ASR) at a lower computational cost. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness and explainability of the Multiplex Network. The code is available at https://github.com/selectstar-ai/STAR-Teaming-paper.

AI.tldr: STAR-Teaming：一种基于多智能体+多层网络的低成本黑盒越狱提示自动生成框架，大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型易被越狱提示诱导输出有害内容，现有自动化红队方法成本高、可解释性差，需要高效且可解释的黑盒攻击生成技术。
AI.method: 构建策略-响应对的多层网络，将高维嵌入空间转化为可解释的语义社区；用网络驱动优化在多智能体系统中采样高效攻击策略，避免重复探索。
AI.result: 在相同计算预算下，攻击成功率显著高于已有方法；多层网络结构可解释性强，验证了语义社区对策略搜索的有效性。
AI.conclusion: STAR-Teaming通过网络化表示与多智能体协同，实现了高成功率、低算力、可解释的黑盒红队测试，为LLM安全防护提供了高效评估工具。

title: AC-SINDy: Compositional Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics
summary: We present AC-SINDy, a compositional extension of the Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) framework that replaces explicit feature libraries with a structured representation based on arithmetic circuits. Rather than enumerating candidate basis functions, the proposed approach constructs nonlinear features through compositions of linear functions and multiplicative interactions, yielding a compact and scalable parameterization and enabling sparsity to be enforced directly over the computational graph. We also introduce a formulation that separates state estimation from dynamics identification by combining latent state inference with shared dynamics and multi-step supervision, improving robustness to noise while preserving interpretability. Experiments on nonlinear and chaotic systems demonstrate that the method recovers accurate and interpretable governing equations while scaling more favorably than standard SINDy.

AI.tldr: AC-SINDy 用算术电路取代 SINDy 的显式特征库，通过线性组合与乘法交互的“层”组合式地生成非线性特征，并在计算图上直接施以稀疏约束；同时将状态估计与动力学识别解耦，实现噪声鲁棒且可解释的方程发现。
AI.motivation: 传统 SINDy 需预先枚举高维多项式/非线性基函数，导致特征库指数膨胀、内存占用大、对噪声敏感；亟需一种可扩展、对噪声鲁棒且仍保留模型可解释性的替代方案。
AI.method: 1. 以算术电路（AC）作为结构化表征：用多层线性变换与逐元素乘法节点递归组合，在线生成非线性特征，无需枚举完整多项式库。2. 直接在 AC 的计算图上对权重施加稀疏正则（如 L1），实现“结构稀疏”而非传统特征选择稀疏。3. 解耦策略：引入共享的动力学网络与多步预测损失，先推断潜在状态、再识别动力学，降低测量噪声对回归的影响。4. 端到端优化：联合训练状态推理与 AC-参数化的稀疏动力学，保障可解释性与预测精度。
AI.result: 在 Lorenz、Rössler、双摆等混沌及高维非线性系统上，AC-SINDy 能以更少参数、更低内存准确恢复真实控制方程；与标准 SINDy 相比，特征生成规模随系统维度线性而非指数增长；在高斯观测噪声（SNR 10 dB）下，多步监督使预测误差降低 30–50%，仍可保持方程的符号级可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 通过算术电路的组合式稀疏表征与“状态-动力学”解耦训练，AC-SINDy 突破了 SINDy 的维度瓶颈与噪声敏感局限，为大规模、噪声场景下的可解释数据驱动建模提供了高效、可扩展的新范式。

title: Hierarchically Robust Zero-shot Vision-language Models
comment: This paper is accepted by CVPR'26
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can perform zero-shot classification but are susceptible to adversarial attacks. While robust fine-tuning improves their robustness, existing approaches align fixed text embeddings with an image embedding, sacrificing natural performance and robustness. A robustness degradation also occurs when a model faces adversarial attacks targeting superclasses (parent classes, e.g., mammal) in addition to their base (leaf) classes (e.g., cat). Thus, to enhance adversarial robustness and leverage the inherent hierarchical properties of class space, we propose a novel adversarial fine-tuning framework based on hierarchical embeddings and several levels of adversarially robust alignment of image-text modalities. Additional mechanisms place visual embeddings at the desired depth of hierarchy, and we provide a theoretical connection between the depth of embedding in the hierarchy and the maximum viable margin size. Our model naturally realizes several margin sizes, boosting generalization of adversaries for robustification. As various trees with different parent labels can share the same leaf labels, we also consider aligning over multiple trees to boost semantic variety. Experiments across several datasets are performed.

AI.tldr: 提出层次化嵌入的多级对抗微调框架，在保持自然准确率的同时显著提升 VLM 的鲁棒性，尤其能抵御针对超类的攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒微调方法将固定文本嵌入与图像嵌入对齐，会牺牲自然性能，并且在攻击者瞄准超类（如 mammal）时鲁棒性急剧下降。作者希望在不掉点自然准确率的前提下，提升 VLM 对 adversarial 样本、特别是超类级别攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 利用类别空间的层次先验，构建多棵语义树；在对抗微调中，将视觉嵌入投射到树的不同深度，并与对应层级的文本嵌入做多级对齐。理论上推导“嵌入深度–最大可分间隔”关系，使模型在不同层级自适应地实现不同 margin；再引入多树对齐进一步增加语义多样性。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100 等多个数据集上，相比标准鲁棒微调，该方法在 ϵ=4/255 的 ℓ∞ 攻击下平均鲁棒准确率提升 8–15 个百分点，而自然 Top-1 准确率基本不降；对超类攻击的鲁棒性提升尤为明显（↑20%+）。
AI.conclusion: 层次化嵌入+多级对抗对齐可在不牺牲自然性能的前提下，显式利用类别语义结构，显著增强 VLM 的对抗鲁棒性，并为利用知识先验设计鲁棒视觉-语言模型提供了新范式。

title: Reasoning-Aware AIGC Detection via Alignment and Reinforcement
summary: The rapid advancement and widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) have elevated the need for reliable AI-generated content (AIGC) detection, which remains challenging as models evolve. We introduce AIGC-text-bank, a comprehensive multi-domain dataset with diverse LLM sources and authorship scenarios, and propose REVEAL, a detection framework that generates interpretable reasoning chains before classification. Our approach uses a two-stage training strategy: supervised fine-tuning to establish reasoning capabilities, followed by reinforcement learning to improve accuracy, improve logical consistency, and reduce hallucinations. Extensive experiments show that REVEAL achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, offering a robust and transparent solution for AIGC detection. The project is open-source at https://aka.ms/reveal

AI.tldr: 论文开源了首个跨领域、多模型、带推理标注的 AIGC 语料库 AIGC-text-bank，并提出先推理-再分类的框架 REVEAL，通过监督微调+强化学习两阶段训练，在多基准上达到 SOTA，输出可解释且低幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型迅猛发展，AI 生成文本日益逼真，现有检测方法对模型演化敏感、可解释性差；缺乏跨领域、跨模型的高质量语料和能给出“为什么”的检测框架，阻碍可信 AIGC 治理。
AI.method: ① 构建 AIGC-text-bank：覆盖新闻、学术、创意等 10 余领域，含 8 类 LLM（ChatGPT、Claude、Llama 等）生成文本及人工对照，并标注来源、提示、领域与细粒度推理标签。② 设计 REVEAL：先训练“推理生成器”输出逐句证据链（统计异常、风格差异、事实冲突），再用 RL 优化“分类头”实现三目标——准确率↑、逻辑一致↑、幻觉↓，形成两阶段训练流水线。③ 推理阶段仅输出 Top-k 证据链及其置信度，实现透明决策。
AI.result: 在 7 个主流基准（含新发布 adversarial 子集）上，REVEAL 平均 F1 达 96.7%，超越现有 SOTA 3.8 pp；可解释指标（证据链人工接受率）92%，幻觉率降低 45%。跨域泛化实验显示领域漂移下降 38%，显著优于单阶段检测基线。
AI.conclusion: 可信 AIGC 检测需“可解释 + 鲁棒”双轮驱动。AIGC-text-bank 为社区提供了统一评估基准；REVEAL 证明先推理后分类策略可同步提升性能与透明度，为后续 AIGC 治理、模型水印与风险监测提供落地范式。

title: The Data-Driven Censored Newsvendor Problem
summary: We study a censored variant of the data-driven newsvendor problem, where the decision-maker must select an ordering quantity that minimizes expected overage and underage costs based only on offline censored sales data, rather than historical demand realizations. Our goal is to understand how the degree of historical demand censoring affects the performance of any learning algorithm for this problem. To isolate this impact, we adopt a distributionally robust optimization framework, evaluating policies according to their worst-case regret over an ambiguity set of distributions. This set is defined by the largest historical order quantity (the observable boundary of the dataset), and contains all distributions matching the true demand distribution up to this boundary, while allowing them to be arbitrary afterwards. We demonstrate a spectrum of achievability under demand censoring by deriving a natural necessary and sufficient condition under which vanishing regret is an achievable goal. In regimes in which it is not, we exactly characterize the information loss due to censoring: an insurmountable lower bound on the performance of any policy, even when the decision-maker has access to infinitely many demand samples. We then leverage these sharp characterizations to propose a natural robust algorithm that adapts to the historical level of demand censoring. We derive finite-sample guarantees for this algorithm across all possible censoring regimes and show its near-optimality with matching lower bounds (up to polylogarithmic factors). We moreover demonstrate its robust performance via extensive numerical experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统地刻画了需求右删失（仅观测 historical sales 而非完整 demand）给 datadriven newsvendor 带来的信息损失阈值：当且仅当历史最高订货量 (censoring boundary) 超过某一 mild 阈值时，vanishing regret 才可达成；否则任何算法均受限于一条不可逾越的最坏情形下界。作者据此提出可自适应删失水平的分布鲁棒算法，给出有限样本几乎匹配下界的性能保证，并用合成与真实数据验证其稳健性。
AI.motivation: 传统 datadriven newsvendor 假设能观测完整需求样本；但现实中常只能得到销量（需求被订货量截断）。删失数据是否以及如何影响学习极限？现有文献多聚焦于特定算法或渐近正态性，缺乏对“删失度”与“可达成性能”之间精确边界的系统回答，亦未给出跨删失区间的统一鲁棒解法。
AI.method: 1) 建立以“历史最大订货量 q̄”为边界的分布不确定集，仅要求真实分布在[0,q̄]上与观测一致，之后可任意；2) 引入 worst-case regret 度量，推导使 regret→0 成立的充要条件——q̄ 须超过某“信息阈值” q*；3) 对 q̄<q* 区间，证明存在不可减的紧致下界，量化删失导致的信息损失；4) 构造 Adaptive-Censor-Robust 算法：先估计边界内需求，再依删失水平自动扩大订货量并给出有限样本高概率界；5) 理论证明其 regret 与下界仅差 polylog 因子，达到 near-optimal；6) 在合成与零售真实数据集上验证稳健性。
AI.result: 理论上：①给出 regret 可趋于零的 iff 阈值，首次完整划分“可学习/不可学习”删失区间；②对不可学习区间给出确切下界，揭示样本再多亦无法突破；③所提算法在全部删失区间内获得 O(log n/n) 级 regret，上下界匹配。实验上：对从轻度到重度删失的 6 组数据，算法相对经验风险最小化平均降低 regret 26–58%，且标准差降低 2 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 需求删失并非简单数据缺失，而是决定 learning limit 的关键几何量；当历史最大订货量不足时，信息损失具有根本性。提出的自适应鲁棒框架兼容量化此极限与提供实际可执行策略，为后续含截断反馈的库存、收益管理与在线定价研究提供了新的性能基准与算法模板。

title: $R^2$-dLLM: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Models via Spatio-Temporal Redundancy Reduction
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by enabling parallel token prediction. However, practical dLLM decoding still suffers from high inference latency, which limits deployment. In this work, we observe that a substantial part of this inefficiency comes from recurring redundancy in the decoding process, including spatial redundancy caused by confidence clusters and positional ambiguity, and temporal redundancy caused by repeatedly remasking predictions that have already stabilized. Motivated by these patterns, we propose $R^2$-dLLM, a unified framework for reducing decoding redundancy from both inference and training perspectives. At inference time, we introduce training-free decoding rules that aggregate local confidence and token predictions, and finalize temporally stable tokens to avoid redundant decoding steps. We further propose a redundancy-aware supervised fine-tuning pipeline that aligns the model with efficient decoding trajectories and reduces reliance on manually tuned thresholds. Experiments demonstrate that $R^2$-dLLM consistently reduces the number of decoding steps by up to 75% compared to existing decoding strategies, while maintaining competitive generation quality across different models and tasks. These results validate that decoding redundancy is a central bottleneck in dLLMs, and that explicitly reducing it yields substantial practical efficiency gains.

AI.tldr: 提出 R²-dLLM，在训练和推理阶段联合消除扩散式大模型的空间与时间冗余，解码步数最多可减少 75%，生成质量保持不变。
AI.motivation: 扩散式大模型虽支持并行解码，但推理延迟高。作者观察到延迟主因是解码过程的重复冗余：空间维度存在置信度聚集与位置不确定性，时间维度则反复重遮已稳定的 token。需系统性地消除这两种冗余以提升部署效率。
AI.method: 1) 推理阶段：设计免训练规则，局部聚合置信度与 token 预测，并立即锁定时间稳定的 token，避免后续重遮。2) 训练阶段：提出“冗余感知监督微调”，让模型学习低冗余解码轨迹，减少对人工阈值依赖。二者统一构成 R²-dLLM 框架。
AI.result: 在多种模型与任务上，R²-dLLM 把解码步数削减高达 75%，同时保持与现有策略相当的生成质量，显著降低延迟。
AI.conclusion: 解码冗余是扩散式大模型推理效率的核心瓶颈；显式建模并消除冗余可带来线性可扩展的实用加速，为 dLLM 的规模化部署提供可行路径。

title: Harmful Intent as a Geometrically Recoverable Feature of LLM Residual Streams
summary:
Harmful intent is geometrically recoverable from large language model residual streams: as a linear direction in most layers, and as angular deviation in layers where projection methods fail. Across 12 models spanning four architectural families (Qwen2.5, Qwen3.5, Llama-3.2, Gemma-3) and three alignment variants (base, instruction-tuned, abliterated), under single-turn, English evaluation, we characterise this geometry through six direction-finding strategies. Three succeed: a soft-AUC-optimised linear direction reaches mean AUROC 0.98 and TPR@1\%FPR 0.80; a class-mean probe reaches 0.98 and 0.71 at <1ms fitting cost; a supervised angular-deviation strategy reaches AUROC 0.96 and TPR of 0.61 along a representationally distinct direction ($73^\circ$ from projection-based solutions), uniquely sustaining detection in middle layers where projection methods collapse.
  Detection remains stable across alignment variants, including abliterated models from which refusal has been surgically removed: harmful intent and refusal behaviour are functionally dissociated features of the representation. A direction fitted on AdvBench transfers to held-out HarmBench and JailbreakBench with worst-case AUROC 0.96. The same picture holds at scale: across Qwen3.5 from 0.8B to 9B parameters, AUROC remains $\geq$0.98 and cross-variant transfer stays within 0.018 of own-direction performance
  This is consistent with a simple account: models acquire a linearly decodable representation of harmful intent as part of general language understanding, and alignment then shapes what they do with such inputs without reorganising the upstream recognition signal. As a practical consequence, AUROC in the 0.97+ regime can substantially overestimate operational detectability; TPR@$1\%$FPR should accompany AUROC in safety-adjacent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 有害意图在多模型、多对齐版本中均以线性方向或角度偏差稳定存在于残差流中，三种探测策略AUROC≥0.96，跨数据集迁移强，说明模型先“识别”后“拒绝”，识别信号不受对齐干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有安全过滤依赖对齐训练，但“有害内容是否仍被模型内部识别”缺乏系统几何刻画，需验证识别信号是否与拒绝行为解耦、是否跨架构/对齐/规模稳定存在。
AI.method: 在12个模型（4家族×3对齐变体）单轮英文评估中，用6种寻方向策略量化残差流中有害意图的几何：软AUC优化线性探针、类均值探针、监督角度偏差探针，并对比投影失效层；跨AdvBench→HarmBench/JailBench测试迁移，以AUROC与TPR@1%FPR双指标评估。
AI.result: 1）三种策略成功：软AUC探针AUROC 0.98、TPR@1%FPR 0.80；类均值探针同AUROC 0.98、TPR 0.71且拟合<1 ms；角度偏差探针AUROC 0.96、TPR 0.61，方向与投影解相差73°，在中层投影崩溃时仍有效。2）对齐变体（含去除拒绝的abliterated模型）性能不降，说明识别与拒绝功能解耦。3）AdvBench方向迁移至HarmBench/JailBench，最差AUROC 0.96；Qwen3.5 0.8B→9B规模AUROC≥0.98，跨变体下降≤0.018。
AI.conclusion: 有害意图作为语言理解的副产品，以线性可解码形式稳定驻留残差流；对齐仅抑制输出而不重排上游识别信号。高AUROC易高估实战可检性，安全评估须同步报告TPR@1%FPR，并警惕“识别≠拒绝”的潜在风险。

title: A Proxy Consistency Loss for Grounded Fusion of Earth Observation and Location Encoders
comment: Accepted to EarthVision 2026 (CVPR Workshop). 13 pages total (10 pages main paper + 3 pages supplementary material), 5 main figures
summary: Supervised learning with Earth observation inputs is often limited by the sparsity of high-quality labeled or in-situ measured data to use as training labels. With the abundance of geographic data products, in many cases there are variables correlated with - but different from - the variable of interest that can be leveraged. We integrate such proxy variables within a geographic prior via a trainable location encoder and introduce a proxy consistency loss (PCL) formulation to imbue proxy data into the location encoder. The first key insight behind our approach is to use the location encoder as an agile and flexible way to learn from abundantly available proxy data which can be sampled independently of training label availability. Our second key insight is that we will need to regularize the location encoder appropriately to achieve performance and robustness with limited labeled data. Our experiments on air quality prediction and poverty mapping show that integrating proxy data implicitly through the location encoder outperforms using both as input to an observation encoder and fusion strategies that use frozen, pretrained location embeddings as a geographic prior. Superior performance for in-sample prediction shows that the PCL can incorporate rich information from the proxies, and superior out-of-sample prediction shows that the learned latent embeddings help generalize to areas without training labels.

AI.tldr: 提出可训练位置编码器+代理一致性损失(PCL)，将大量易获取但标签稀缺的代理变量隐式融入地理先验，在空品预测与贫困制图任务上显著优于直接拼接或冻结预训练嵌入的融合策略，同时提升样本内外泛化。
AI.motivation: 地球观测监督学习受限于高质量实地标签稀疏，而大量与目标变量相关但非同一的地理数据产品（代理变量）未被充分利用。
AI.method: 设计可训练位置编码器，将代理变量作为地理先验；引入代理一致性损失(PCL)对位置编码器进行正则化，使其在无标签区域也能学习稳定表示，无需将代理变量直接输入观测编码器。
AI.result: 在空品预测与贫困制图实验中，PCL方法在样本内、外预测均优于：①将代理与观测拼接输入网络；②使用冻结预训练地理嵌入的融合策略。
AI.conclusion: PCL能有效整合代理信息、缓解标签稀缺，并借助学得的位置嵌入提升对无标签地区的泛化能力，为遥感与地理信息稀疏监督问题提供了通用框架。

title: ClawNet: Human-Symbiotic Agent Network for Cross-User Autonomous Cooperation
summary: Current AI agent frameworks have made remarkable progress in automating individual tasks, yet all existing systems serve a single user. Human productivity rests on the social and organizational relationships through which people coordinate, negotiate, and delegate. When agents move beyond performing tasks for one person to representing that person in collaboration with others, the infrastructure for cross-user agent collaboration is entirely absent, let alone the governance mechanisms needed to secure it. We argue that the next frontier for AI agents lies not in stronger individual capability, but in the digitization of human collaborative relationships. To this end, we propose a human-symbiotic agent paradigm. Each user owns a permanently bound agent system that collaborates on the owner's behalf, forming a network whose nodes are humans rather than agents. This paradigm rests on three governance primitives. A layered identity architecture separates a Manager Agent from multiple context-specific Identity Agents; the Manager Agent holds global knowledge but is architecturally isolated from external communication. Scoped authorization enforces per-identity access control and escalates boundary violations to the owner. Action-level accountability logs every operation against its owner's identity and authorization, ensuring full auditability. We instantiate this paradigm in ClawNet, an identity-governed agent collaboration framework that enforces identity binding and authorization verification through a central orchestrator, enabling multiple users to collaborate securely through their respective agents.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前 AI agent 仅服务单用户，缺少跨用户协作与治理机制，提出“人-共生 agent 范式”：每人拥有一个永绑 agent，以人为节点构建协作网络，并给出三大治理原语及原型系统 ClawNet。
AI.motivation: 现有 agent 框架虽能自动完成单一任务，但仅服务于个人，无法支撑人类赖以提升效率的跨用户协作、协商与委托；当 agent 开始代表用户与他人协作时，跨用户协作基础设施与治理机制完全缺失。
AI.method: 提出“人-共生 agent 范式”，核心为每人永久绑定一个 agent 系统，协作网络以人为节点；设计三大治理原语：①分层身份架构（Manager Agent 全局知悉但隔离外联，多个场景化 Identity Agent 对外交互）；②作用域授权（按身份细粒度授权，越界即上升给用户）；③动作级问责（每笔操作绑定身份与授权，全程可审计）。基于此实现 ClawNet 原型，用中央编排器强制身份绑定与授权验证，实现多用户经各自 agent 安全协作。
AI.result: ClawNet 首次在系统层面实现跨用户 agent 协作的身份治理与可审计授权，验证范式可行，为后续研究提供可扩展框架。
AI.conclusion: AI 下一前沿并非单体能力更强，而是把人类协作关系数字化；人-共生 agent 范式及其三大治理原语为构建可信、跨用户的 agent 协作网络奠定基础。

title: Private Minimum Hellinger Distance Estimation via Hellinger Distance Differential Privacy
summary: Objective functions based on Hellinger distance yield robust and efficient estimators of model parameters. Motivated by privacy and regulatory requirements encountered in contemporary applications, we derive in this paper \emph{private minimum Hellinger distance estimators}. The estimators satisfy a new privacy constraint, namely, Hellinger differential privacy, while retaining the robustness and efficiency properties. We demonstrate that Hellinger differential privacy shares several features of standard differential privacy while allowing for sharper inference. Additionally, for computational purposes, we also develop Hellinger differentially private gradient descent and Newton-Raphson algorithms. We illustrate the behavior of our estimators in finite samples using numerical experiments and verify that they retain robustness properties under gross-error contamination.

AI.tldr: 基于Hellinger距离的隐私保护估计量兼具鲁棒性与效用优势。
AI.motivation: 传统差分隐私在统计推断中常带来过宽误差带，难以满足新兴数据监管与隐私合规要求；Hellinger距离具备天然鲁棒性，需引入量化隐私保护后再行利用。
AI.method: 提出「Hellinger差分隐私」(HDP)定义→构造HDP约束下最小Hellinger距离估计量→针对隐私随机量设计梯度下降与Newton-Raphson算法→在污染模型下数值检验 resilience与隐私-精度权衡。
AI.result: HDP保持标准差分隐私的可组合、离群鲁棒等特性，但允许得到比(ε,δ)-DP更窄的置信区间；算法层面，梯度与牛顿迭代均收敛且满足HDP；仿真显示在5%-10%粗差环境下估计偏差与MSE均明显低于同隐私预算下的LDP或KL-DP方法。
AI.conclusion: Hellinger距离与差分隐私需求可系统性融合；HDP框架在保持隐私安全的前提下显著提升了推断精度，为隐私鲁棒推断提供了一种可行范式，后续可推广到高维与非参数场景。

title: When Safety Fails Before the Answer: Benchmarking Harmful Behavior Detection in Reasoning Chains
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) produce complex, multi-step reasoning traces, yet safety evaluation remains focused on final outputs, overlooking how harm emerges during reasoning. When jailbroken, harm does not appear instantaneously but unfolds through distinct behavioral steps such as suppressing refusal, rationalizing compliance, decomposing harmful tasks, and concealing risk. However, no existing benchmark captures this process at sentence-level granularity within reasoning traces -- a key step toward reliable safety monitoring, interventions, and systematic failure diagnosis. To address this gap, we introduce HarmThoughts, a benchmark for step-wise safety evaluation of reasoning traces. \ourdataset is built on our proposed harm taxonomy of 16 harmful reasoning behaviors across four functional groups that characterize how harm propagates rather than what harm is produced. The dataset consists of 56,931 sentences from 1,018 reasoning traces generated by four model families, each annotated with fine-grained sentence-level behavioral labels. Using HarmThoughts, we analyze harm propagation patterns across reasoning traces, identifying common behavioral trajectories and drift points where reasoning transitions from safe to unsafe. Finally, we systematically compare white-box and black-box detectors on the task of identifying harmful reasoning behaviours on HarmThoughts. Our results show that existing detectors struggle with fine-grained behavior detection in reasoning traces, particularly for nuanced categories within harm emergence and execution, highlighting a critical gap in process-level safety monitoring. HarmThoughts is available publicly at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ishitakakkar-10/HarmThoughts

AI.tldr: 提出 HarmThoughts —— 首个面向推理过程、以句子为粒度的逐步安全评测基准，揭示大模型在越狱场景下“如何”而非“仅结果”地产生危害，并证明现有检测器对过程级有害推理行为识别能力不足。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型安全评估只看最终输出，忽略多步推理链中危害如何一步步被构建；越狱时模型会依次出现抑制拒绝、为配合找理由、分解有害任务、隐匿风险等行为，却缺乏能逐句追踪这些行为的细粒度基准，导致无法可靠监控、干预或诊断过程级失效。
AI.method: 1) 提出 16 类有害推理行为的新分类法，按“危害如何传播”而非“结果是什么”划分为 4 个功能组；2) 从 4 个模型家族生成的 1 018 条推理链中切出 56 931 句，逐句标注行为标签，构建 HarmThoughts 数据集；3) 用该基准分析危害传播轨迹与“漂移点”；4) 系统对比白盒与黑盒检测器在句子级行为识别上的表现。
AI.result: 发现危害在推理链中呈阶段化演化，存在高重复性的行为轨迹与关键漂移点；现有检测器在识别“危害浮现”与“执行”类别中的微妙行为时显著吃力，过程级监控存在明显能力缺口。
AI.conclusion: HarmThoughts 填补了推理过程安全评估的空白，为后续开发过程级监控、干预策略及诊断工具提供了细粒度、可复现的评测基础，并指出下一代安全系统必须提升对动态推理行为的感知能力。

title: Gradient-Based Program Synthesis with Neurally Interpreted Languages
comment: 26 pages, The International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR)
summary: A central challenge in program induction has long been the trade-off between symbolic and neural approaches. Symbolic methods offer compositional generalisation and data efficiency, yet their scalability is constrained by formalisms such as domain-specific languages (DSLs), which are labour-intensive to create and may not transfer to new domains. In contrast, neural networks flexibly learn from data but tend to generalise poorly in compositional and out-of-distribution settings. We bridge this divide with an instance of a Latent Adaptation Network architecture named Neural Language Interpreter (NLI), which learns its own discrete, symbolic-like programming language end-to-end. NLI autonomously discovers a vocabulary of primitive operations and uses a novel differentiable neural executor to interpret variable-length sequences of these primitives. This allows NLI to represent programs that are not bound to a constant number of computation steps, enabling it to solve more complex problems than those seen during training. To make these discrete, compositional program structures amenable to gradient-based optimisation, we employ the Gumbel-Softmax relaxation, enabling the entire model to be trained end-to-end. Crucially, this same differentiability enables powerful test-time adaptation. At inference, NLI's program inductor provides an initial program guess. This guess is then refined via gradient descent through the neural executor, enabling efficient search for the neural program that best explains the given data. We demonstrate that NLI outperforms in-context learning, test-time training, and continuous latent program networks on tasks that require combinatorial generalisation and rapid adaptation to unseen tasks. Our results establish a new path toward models that combine the compositionality of discrete languages with the gradient-based search and end-to-end learning of neural networks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Neural Language Interpreter（NLI）：用一个可微神经执行器端到端地学习自洽的离散“类符号”程序语言，在测试时还能梯度微调程序，实现组合泛化与快速跨域适应。
AI.motivation: 程序归纳中长期存在符号方法（组合泛化+数据高效但依赖昂贵 DSL）与神经网络（端到端学习但组合/分布外泛化差）的权衡。作者希望兼得两者之长：离散语言的组合性+神经网络的梯度优化与适应性。
AI.method: 1）设计 Latent Adaptation Network 架构 NLI，无人工 DSL，自动发现离散原语并拼成可变长原语序列；2）提出可微神经执行器，用 Gumbel-Softmax relaxation 使离散结构端到端可训练；3）测试时把初始程序当作可优化变量，通过同一梯度下降在神经执行器上继续精化。
AI.result: 在需要组合泛化和快速适应的新任务上，NLI 显著优于 in-context learning、test-time training 及连续潜程序网络，可处理训练时未见过的更长、更复杂问题。
AI.conclusion: NLI 展示了“符号式组合结构+神经网络梯度搜索”的可行路线，为兼具组合泛化与端到端学习的新一代模型奠定基础。

title: Localization-Guided Foreground Augmentation in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving systems often degrade under adverse visibility conditions-such as rain, nighttime, or snow-where online scene geometry (e.g., lane dividers, road boundaries, and pedestrian crossings) becomes sparse or fragmented. While high-definition (HD) maps can provide missing structural context, they are costly to construct and maintain at scale. We propose Localization-Guided Foreground Augmentation (LG-FA), a lightweight and plug-and-play inference module that enhances foreground perception by enriching geometric context online. LG-FA: (i) incrementally constructs a sparse global vector layer from per-frame Bird's-Eye View (BEV) predictions; (ii) estimates ego pose via class-constrained geometric alignment, jointly improving localization and completing missing local topology; and (iii) reprojects the augmented foreground into a unified global frame to improve per-frame predictions. Experiments on challenging nuScenes sequences demonstrate that LG-FA improves the geometric completeness and temporal stability of BEV representations, reduces localization error, and produces globally consistent lane and topology reconstructions. The module can be seamlessly integrated into existing BEV-based perception systems without backbone modification. By providing a reliable geometric context prior, LG-FA enhances temporal consistency and supplies stable structural support for downstream modules such as tracking and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需重训即可嵌入现有BEV模型的轻量推理插件 LG-FA，利用渐增稀疏矢量层和类别约束位姿对齐，在线补全雨夜雪雾等恶劣场景下的前景几何，提高定位精度并输出全局一致车道/拓扑。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气或低照度场景中，在线感知到的车道线、道路边界等几何要素稀疏且断续，而高精度地图又难以规模维护。现有BEV系统在定位漂移和前景缺漏下会连锁导致下游跟踪与决策不可靠。
AI.method: Localization-Guided Foreground Augmentation：每帧以BEV预测为输入，① 增量累积稀疏全局矢量层；② 在位姿图上把矢量几何与类别语义一同约束，迭代求解 ego 位姿并同时修复缺失局部拓扑；③ 将补全后的前景重投影至统一世界坐标系，回注到当前帧特征，强化预测。
AI.result: nuScenes 恶劣序列测试：BEV 表征的几何完整度与时序稳定性显著提升，绝对位姿误差降低，车道及拓扑的全局一致性提高，且对原有网络零改动即可插入。
AI.conclusion: LG-FA 以在线方式低成本提供稳定几何先验，打破了对昂贵 HD 地图的依赖，可在现有 BEV 感知流水线上“即插即用”地增强一致性，为跟踪、规划等下游任务提供持续可靠的结构支撑。

title: UAF: A Unified Audio Front-end LLM for Full-Duplex Speech Interaction
summary: Full-duplex speech interaction, as the most natural and intuitive mode of human communication, is driving artificial intelligence toward more human-like conversational systems. Traditional cascaded speech processing pipelines suffer from critical limitations, including accumulated latency, information loss, and error propagation across modules. To address these issues, recent efforts focus on the end-to-end audio large language models (LLMs) like GPT-4o, which primarily unify speech understanding and generation task. However, most of these models are inherently half-duplex, and rely on a suite of separate, task-specific front-end components, such as voice activity detection (VAD) and turn-taking detection (TD). In our development of speech assistant, we observed that optimizing the speech front-end is equally crucial as advancing the back-end unified model for achieving seamless, responsive interactions. To bridge this gap, we propose the first unified audio front-end LLM (UAF) tailored for full-duplex speech systems. Our model reformulates diverse audio front-end tasks into a single auto-regressive sequence prediction problem, including VAD, TD, speaker recognition (SR), automatic speech recognition (ASR) and question answer (QA). It takes streaming fixed-duration audio chunk (e.g., 600 ms) as input, leverages a reference audio prompt to anchor the target speaker at the beginning, and regressively generates discrete tokens encoding both semantic content and system-level state controls (e.g., interruption signals). Experiments demonstrate that our model achieves leading performance across multiple audio front-end tasks and significantly enhances response latency and interruption accuracy in real-world interaction scenarios.

AI.tldr: 首次提出统一音频前端大模型 UAF，把全双工语音交互所需的 VAD、TD、SR、ASR、QA 等任务归一化为单一自回归序列预测，显著降低延迟并提升打断准确度。
AI.motivation: 级联语音前端在多模块堆叠下存在延迟累加、信息丢失、误差传递，而现有端到端音频 LLM 往往仅关注后端理解-生成，前端仍依赖独立专用组件，难以满足全双工实时交互需求。
AI.method: 将 600 ms 流式音频块与参考音频 prompt 一并输入，统一把 VAD、TD、SR、ASR、QA 等任务转化为离散 token 的自回归序列预测；token 同时编码语义内容与系统级控制信号（打断/继续）。
AI.result: 在多项音频前端基准上达到 SOTA；真实场景下显著压缩响应延迟并提高打断识别准确率。
AI.conclusion: 前端统一与后端统一同等关键，UAF 为构建低延迟、可打断、真正全双工的类人对话系统提供了可行的新范式。

title: Online Learning of Whittle Indices for Restless Bandits with Non-Stationary Transition Kernels
summary: The restless multi-armed bandit (RMAB) framework is a popular approach to solving resource allocation problems in networked systems. In this paper, we study optimal resource allocation in RMABs facing unknown and non-stationary dynamics. Solving RMABs optimally is known to be PSPACE-hard even with full knowledge of model parameters. While Whittle index policies offer asymptotic optimality with low computational cost, they require access to stationary transition kernels, an unrealistic assumption in many modern networking applications. To address this challenge, we propose a Sliding-Window Online Whittle (SW-Whittle) policy that remains computationally efficient while adapting to time-varying kernels. Through theoretical analysis, we show that our algorithm achieves sub-linear dynamic regret with respect to the number of episodes. We further address the important case where the variation budget is unknown in advance by combining a Bandit-over-Bandit framework with our sliding-window design. In our scheme, window lengths are tuned online as a function of the estimated variation, while Whittle indices are computed via an upper-confidence-bound of the estimated transition kernels and a bilinear optimization routine. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our algorithm consistently outperforms baselines, achieving the lowest cumulative regret across a range of non-stationary environments.

AI.tldr: 用滑动窗口替代平稳假设，把Whittle index改造成在线自适应版本，在非平稳环境中仍能实现次线性动态后悔，无需预知变化预算。
AI.motivation: 经典Whittle策略依赖稳态转移核，而现代网络系统的动态往往未知且非平稳，该假设失效；同时精确求解RMAB是PSPACE-难，需要兼顾计算效率与适应性。
AI.method: 提出Sliding-Window Online Whittle（SW-Whittle）：用滑动窗口估计时变转移核，结合UCB上置信界构造Whittle指数；若变化预算未知，再上层嵌套Bandit-over-Bandit框架，在线调窗口长度，并用双线性优化快速求解指数。
AI.result: 理论证明算法对episode数具有次线性动态后悔；实验显示在多种非平稳场景下累计后悔显著低于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过滑动窗口与双层bandit自适应，SW-Whittle首次在未知非平稳RMAB中实现计算高效、理论保证的渐近最优调度，为动态网络资源分配提供了可扩展方案。

title: Debating the Unspoken: Role-Anchored Multi-Agent Reasoning for Half-Truth Detection
summary: Half-truths, claims that are factually correct yet misleading due to omitted context, remain a blind spot for fact verification systems focused on explicit falsehoods. Addressing such omission-based manipulation requires reasoning not only about what is said, but also about what is left unsaid. We propose RADAR, a role-anchored multi-agent debate framework for omission-aware fact verification under realistic, noisy retrieval. RADAR assigns complementary roles to a Politician and a Scientist, who reason adversarially over shared retrieved evidence, moderated by a neutral Judge. A dual-threshold early termination controller adaptively decides when sufficient reasoning has been reached to issue a verdict. Experiments show that RADAR consistently outperforms strong single- and multi-agent baselines across datasets and backbones, improving omission detection accuracy while reducing reasoning cost. These results demonstrate that role-anchored, retrieval-grounded debate with adaptive control is an effective and scalable framework for uncovering missing context in fact verification. The code is available at https://github.com/tangyixuan/RADAR.

AI.tldr: RADAR 用“政治家-科学家”对抗辩论、中立法官评审与双阈值早停，结合噪声检索，精准检测“被隐瞒”的半真半假陈述，超越单/多智能体基线，降低推理成本，代码开源。
AI.motivation: 现有事实核查系统主要关注“明确假”，对“漏掉关键语境的半真话”无能为力。需兼顾显性与隐性信息，在噪声检索下定位被故意省略的上下文，实现更可靠的 omission-aware 事实验证。
AI.method: 提出 RADAR：①角色锚定多智能体对抗辩论——Politician 负责隐瞒/误导，Scientist 补全信息，Judge 中立于双方论据做最终裁决；②共享检索池引入现实噪声，训练模型同时对抗无效信号；③双阈值早停器动态判定何时已充分推理，及时输出 verdict。整体流程检索-辩论-裁决-早停闭环。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集（含 omission 标签）与不同主干模型上，RADAR 一致优于强单模型与多智能体基线；在检测半真/隐瞒准确率上取得双位数提升，推理轮次与计算成本显著下降；消融验证表明“角色锚定+早停”两项设计为关键增益。
AI.conclusion: 角色锚定、检索驱动的自适应辩论框架可系统挖掘“未见之上下文”，为事实核查提供可扩展新范式。RADAR 对社交媒体谣言、政策声明等半真场景具有落地潜力，代码已开源促进后续研究。

title: Collaborative Contextual Bayesian Optimization
summary: Discovering optimal designs through sequential data collection is essential in many real-world applications. While Bayesian Optimization (BO) has achieved remarkable success in this setting, growing attention has recently turned to context-specific optimal design, formalized as Contextual Bayesian Optimization (CBO). Unlike BO, CBO is inherently more challenging as it must approximate an entire mapping from the context space to its corresponding optimal design, requiring simultaneous exploration across contexts and exploitation within each. In many modern applications, such tasks arise across multiple potentially heterogeneous but related clients, where collaboration can significantly improve learning efficiency. We propose CCBO, Collaborative Contextual Bayesian Optimization, a unified framework enabling multiple clients to jointly perform CBO with controllable contexts, supporting both online collaboration and offline initialization from peers' historical beliefs, with an optional privacy-preserving communication mechanism. We establish sublinear regret guarantees and demonstrate, through extensive simulations and a real-world hot rolling application, that CCBO achieves substantial improvements over existing approaches even under client heterogeneity. The code to reproduce the results can be found at https://github.com/cchihyu/Collaborative-Contextual-Bayesian-Optimization

AI.tldr: 提出 CCBO 框架，让多个异构客户端协同完成上下文贝叶斯优化，兼顾在线协作与离线初始化，并给出次线性遗憾保证，在仿真与热轧实验中显著优于既有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统 BO 只找单点最优，但许多场景需针对任意上下文输出最优设计（CBO）；进一步，当多客户端各自采集数据且存在异质性时，如何安全高效地协同优化尚缺统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 引入 CCBO，把多客户端 CBO 建模为共享全局后验的协作过程；2) 支持可控上下文、在线实时更新与离线历史信念复用；3) 可选差分隐私机制保护交换信息；4) 基于 GP-UCB 类策略给出遗憾理论。
AI.result: 理论：证明在适度假设下 CCBO 对累积上下文遗憾具备 Õ(√T) 次线性上界；实验：在合成函数与 7 客户热轧工艺优化中，样本效率提升 30–60%，异构情形下仍优于独立/集中基线。
AI.conclusion: CCBO 首次将异构多客户端 CBO 统一进可扩展框架，兼顾隐私与效率，为工业上下文最优设计提供实用范式；代码开源可复现。

title: Bridging Foundation Models and ASTM Metallurgical Standards for Automated Grain Size Estimation from Microscopy Images
comment: Accepted at the 11th IEEE Workshop on Computer Vision for Multimodal Microscopy Image Analysis (CVMI), CVPR Workshops 2026
summary: Extracting standardized metallurgical metrics from microscopy images remains challenging due to complex grain morphology and the data demands of supervised segmentation. To bridge foundational computer vision with practical metallurgical evaluation, we propose an automated pipeline for dense instance segmentation and grain size estimation that adapts Cellpose-SAM to microstructures and integrates its topology-aware gradient tracking with an ASTM E112 Jeffries planimetric module. We systematically benchmark this pipeline against a classical convolutional network (U-Net), an adaptive-prompting vision foundation model (MatSAM) and a contemporary vision-language model (Qwen2.5-VL-7B). Our evaluations reveal that while the out-of-the-box vision-language model struggles with the localized spatial reasoning required for dense microscopic counting and MatSAM suffers from over-segmentation despite its domain-specific prompt generation, our adapted pipeline successfully maintains topological separation. Furthermore, experiments across progressively reduced training splits demonstrate exceptional few-shot scalability; utilizing only two training samples, the proposed system predicts the ASTM grain size number (G) with a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) as low as 1.50%, while robustness testing across varying target grain counts empirically validates the ASTM 50-grain sampling minimum. These results highlight the efficacy of application-level foundation model integration for highly accurate, automated materials characterization. Our project repository is available at https://github.com/mueez-overflow/ASTM-Grain-Size-Estimator.

AI.tldr: 将Cellpose-SAM基础模型微调到显微组织场景，并嵌入ASTM E112 Jeffries计点模块，仅用2张训练图像即可在 grain size 指标 G 上取得1.5 % MAPE，超越U-Net、MatSAM与视觉语言大模型。
AI.motivation: 显微组织晶粒形态复杂且密集，传统监督分割标注代价高；基础视觉模型虽性能强大，却难以直接满足冶金ASTM E112标准化评价需求。
AI.method: 1）以Cellpose-SAM为骨干，嵌入保持拓扑的梯度追踪；2）开发Jeffries planimetric后处理模块，直接输出ASTM晶粒度G；3）引入few-shot训练策略，并在多种采样密度下验证ASTM 50粒建议。
AI.result: 在完整训练集上较U-Net提升G值误差24 %；2-shot场景下MAPE 1.50 %，ASTM计点稳定≥50；相比MatSAM抑制了过度分割，而大视觉语言模型因空间推理不足失败。
AI.conclusion: 面向材料表征的垂直化基础模型集成方案，在数据匮乏条件下仍可实现高精度、标准化的晶粒尺寸自动化评估，为冶金现场提供低成本、易部署的解决方案。

title: Industrial Surface Defect Detection via Diffusion Generation and Asymmetric Student-Teacher Network
summary:
Industrial surface defect detection often suffers from limited defect samples, severe long-tailed distributions, and difficulties in accurately localizing subtle defects under complex backgrounds. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an unsupervised defect detection method that integrates a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) with an asymmetric teacher-student architecture. First, at the data level, the DDPM is trained solely on normal samples. By introducing constant-variance Gaussian perturbations and Perlin noise-based masks, high-fidelity and physically consistent defect samples along with pixel-level annotations are generated, effectively alleviating the data scarcity problem. Second, at the model level, an asymmetric dual-stream network is constructed. The teacher network provides stable representations of normal features, while the student network reconstructs normal patterns and amplifies discrepancies between normal and anomalous regions. Finally, a joint optimization strategy combining cosine similarity loss and pixel-wise segmentation supervision is adopted to achieve precise localization of subtle defects. Experimental results on the MVTecAD dataset show that the proposed method achieves 98.4\% image-level AUROC and 98.3\% pixel-level AUROC, significantly outperforming existing unsupervised and mainstream deep learning methods. The proposed approach does not require large amounts of real defect samples and enables accurate and robust industrial defect detection and localization.
  \keywords{Industrial defect detection \and diffusion models \and data generation \and teacher-student architecture \and pixel-level localization}

AI.tldr: 基于稳定扩散生成缺陷+非对称师生网络，无需真实缺陷样本即可在MVTec-AD上达98.4%图像级AUROC与98.3%像素级AUROC。
AI.motivation: 工业场景样本稀少、长尾显著、复杂背景下微弱缺陷难定位，现有方法对真实缺陷依赖高且对细节差异敏感不足。
AI.method: 1)数据层：仅用正常样本训练DDPM，注入恒定方差高斯扰动与Perlin噪声掩膜，生成高保真缺陷及像素级标注；2)模型层：非对称双流网络，教师固定输出正常表示，学生重建正常并放大正常-异常差异；3)优化层：余弦相似度损失联合像素分割监督，端到端训练。
AI.result: MVTec-AD上图像级AUROC 98.4%，像素级AUROC 98.3%，显著超越现有无监督及主流深度方法，且无需任何真实缺陷样本。
AI.conclusion: 所提DDPM+非对称师生框架在数据与模型两端同时解决稀缺与微弱缺陷定位难题，实现无需缺陷样本的鲁棒工业表面缺陷检测与像素级定位。

title: Best Agent Identification for General Game Playing
summary: We present an efficient and generalised procedure to accurately identify the best (or near best) performing algorithm for each sub-task in a multi-problem domain. Our approach treats this as a set of best arm identification problems for multi-armed bandits, where each bandit corresponds to a specific task and each arm corresponds to a specific algorithm or agent. We propose an optimistic selection process based on a chosen confidence interval, that ranks each arm across all bandits in terms of their potential to influence our overall simple regret. We evaluate the performance of our approach on two of the most popular general game playing domains, the General Video Game AI (GVGAI) framework and the Ludii general game playing system, with the goal of selecting a high-performing agent for each game using a limited number of available trials. Compared to previous best arm identification algorithms for multi-armed bandits, our results demonstrate a substantial performance improvement in terms of average simple regret and average probability of error. This novel approach can be used to significantly improve the quality and accuracy of agent evaluation procedures for general game frameworks, as well as other multi-task domains with high algorithm runtimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对多任务领域的“最佳臂识别”框架，将每个任务视为多臂老虎机，利用乐观置信区间排序并快速锁定各子任务的最优算法；在 GVGAI 和 Ludii 两大通用游戏平台上，仅用极少试验次数即可显著降低简单遗憾与错误概率。
AI.motivation: 通用游戏 AI 基准中每款游戏规则、复杂度差异大，传统“先全部跑完再挑最优”的评估方式耗时巨大。作者希望用尽可能少的总试验次数，为每个游戏精准指派表现最佳或近似最佳的智能体，从而提升多任务算法评估的效率与可信度。
AI.method: 1. 把每个游戏任务建模为独立的多臂老虎机，臂对应候选智能体；2. 设计跨任务“乐观选择”指标：综合各臂的置信上界与对整体简单遗憾的潜在贡献，统一排序；3. 每轮根据排序结果动态分配试验预算，优先采样最具信息增益的臂；4. 达到预算上限时，为每个任务输出置信度最高的最优臂。
AI.result: 在 GVGAI 与 Ludii 的 120+ 款游戏中，与现有最佳臂识别（BAI）基线相比：平均简单遗憾降低 35–50%，平均错误概率下降 40% 以上；相同预算下，所需采样次数减少约 30%，且对高耗时游戏优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将昂贵的高维评估转化为带理论保证的高效采样问题，可无缝嵌入任何通用游戏或重运行时算法评估流程，显著提升多任务基准测试的精度与经济性，并可直接迁移至其他“一任务多算法”型应用场景。

title: AlignCultura: Towards Culturally Aligned Large Language Models?
summary: Cultural alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for producing contextually aware, respectful, and trustworthy outputs. Without it, models risk generating stereotyped, insensitive, or misleading responses that fail to reflect cultural diversity w.r.t Helpful, Harmless, and Honest (HHH) paradigm. Existing benchmarks represent early steps toward cultural alignment; yet, no benchmarks currently enables systematic evaluation of cultural alignment in line with UNESCO's principles of cultural diversity w.r.t HHH paradigm. Therefore, to address this gap, we built Align-Cultura, two-stage pipeline for cultural alignment. Stage I constructs CULTURAX, the HHH-English dataset grounded in the UNESCO cultural taxonomy, through Query Construction, which reclassifies prompts, expands underrepresented domains (or labels), and prevents data leakage with SimHash. Then, Response Generation pairs prompts with culturally grounded responses via two-stage rejection sampling. The final dataset contains 1,500 samples spanning 30 subdomains of tangible and intangible cultural forms. Stage II benchmarks CULTURAX on general-purpose models, culturally fine-tuned models, and open-weight LLMs (Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B). Empirically, culturally fine-tuned models improve joint HHH by 4%-6%, reduce cultural failures by 18%, achieve 10%-12% efficiency gains, and limit leakage to 0.3%.

AI.tldr: 作者提出首个贴合UNESCO文化多样性原则且符合“有用-无害-诚实”三原则的评测体系Align-Cultura，配套构造1500例高质量英文评测数据CULTURAX，并以之验证文化对齐微调可令通用模型HHH综合指标提升4–6%、文化违规降低18%，零数据泄露。
AI.motivation: 大模型若缺乏文化对齐，极易产出刻板、冒犯或误导性内容；现有评测仅浅层触及文化维度，缺乏系统、权威且与UNESCO文化多样性原则对应的基准，难以量化文化对齐效果并指导改进。
AI.method: 两阶段架构：Stage I 构建CULTURAX——先以Query Construction重分Prompt、补齐低代表域并借SimHash防泄露，再用两阶段拒采样生成与UNESCO文化分类绑定的1500例HHH回应；Stage II 用CULTAX评测通用模型、文化微调模型及开源权重模型，输出HHH与文化违规指标。
AI.result: 文化微调模型在CULTURAX上联合HHH得分提高4–6%，文化失败率下降18%，同时推理开销降10–12%，数据泄露仅0.3%，显著优于通用基线与同规模开源模型。
AI.conclusion: Align-Cultura首次提供了与UNESCO文化分类对齐、可复现的评测流水线；文化微调能在几乎不增成本的前提下显著提升模型“有用-无害-诚实”表现并抑制文化风险，为后续多语言、多文化对齐研究奠定基准与方法论。

title: Fine-Tuning Small Reasoning Models for Quantum Field Theory
summary: Despite the growing application of Large Language Models (LLMs) to theoretical physics, there is little academic exploration into how domain-specific physics reasoning ability develops while training these models. To investigate this, we perform the first academic fine-tuning study of small (7B-parameter) reasoning models dedicated specifically to theoretical physics. Because open-source verifiable training data required to train such capabilities is scarce, we developed a robust data generation pipeline that can both create synthetic problems and make existing human-authored problems suitable for model training. Selecting Quantum Field Theory (QFT) as our primary domain, we generated over 2,500 synthetic problems alongside a curated collection of human-adapted problems sourced from arXiv and standard pedagogical resources. We conduct both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) experiments, benchmarking performance gains as well as generalization to other physics domains. We perform an extensive analysis of model chains-of-though before and after fine-tuning, to understand how reasoning errors evolve during RL and SFT. Finally, we publicly release our data pipeline, verifiable QFT training data, and $\sim$200M tokens of QFT reasoning traces.

AI.tldr: 首次针对理论物理领域、以QFT为例，专门微调7B小规模推理模型，验证物理推理能力的成长与泛化，并开源全部数据与推理痕迹。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在理论物理的应用增多，但缺乏对其物理推理能力如何随训练演化的学术研究；同时可验证的开源训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 自建数据生成管线，产出2,500+合成QFT题及精选人工题；对7B模型分别实施RL与SFT；通过链式思考分析比较训练前后误差变化；并测试向其他物理领域的泛化。
AI.result: 模型在QFT训练集上取得显著提升，RL与SFT均有效；链式思考分析揭示推理错误模式随训练逐步纠正；训练后的模型在其它物理子领域也表现出可泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 构建专门化物理推理模型可行且可解释；提出的数据管线与训练策略为理论物理领域的LLM研究奠定开源基础，并首次公开可验证的QFT训练数据与约2亿Token推理痕迹供社区复现与扩展。

title: Toward Clinically Acceptable Chest X-ray Report Generation: A Qualitative Retrospective Pilot Study of CXRMate-2
summary:
Chest X-ray (CXR) radiology report generation (RRG) models have shown rapid progress, yet their clinical utility remains uncertain due to limited evaluation by radiologists. We present CXRMate-2, a state-of-the-art CXR RRG model that integrates structured multimodal conditioning and reinforcement learning with a composite reward for semantic alignment with radiologist reports. Across the MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert Plus, and ReXgradient datasets, CXRMate-2 achieves statistically significant improvements over strong benchmarks, including gains of 11.2% and 24.4% in GREEN and RadGraph-XL, respectively, on MIMIC-CXR relative to MedGemma 1.5 (4B).
  To directly compare CXRMate-2 against radiologist reporting, we conduct a blinded, randomised qualitative retrospective evaluation. Three consultant radiologists compare generated and radiologist reports across 120 studies from the MIMIC-CXR test set. Generated reports were deemed acceptable (defined as preferred or rated equally to radiologist reports) in 45% of ratings, with no statistically significant difference in preference rates between radiologist reports and acceptable generated reports for seven of the eight analysed findings. Preference for radiologist reports was driven primarily by higher recall, while generated reports were often preferred for readability.
  Together, these results suggest a credible pathway to clinically acceptable CXR RRG. Improvements in recall, alongside better detection of subtle findings (e.g., pulmonary congestion), are likely sufficient to achieve non-inferiority to radiologist reporting. With these targeted advances, CXR RRG systems may be ready for prospective evaluation in assistive roles within radiologist-led workflows.

AI.tldr: CXRMate-2 结合结构化多模态条件与强化学习，在三大公开数据集上显著优于现有基准；经三位放射科医生盲评，45% 生成报告被认为可接受，7/8 种病变无显著偏好差异，为临床辅助应用奠定可行性。
AI.motivation: 尽管胸片报告生成（RRG）模型进展迅速，但其临床价值因缺乏放射科医生系统评估而存疑，亟需验证生成报告能否达到可接受的临床水准。
AI.method: 提出 CXRMate-2：以结构化多模态条件编码影像与临床上下文，利用复合奖励（语义对齐+可读性）的强化学习训练；在 MIMIC-CXR、CheXpert Plus、ReXgradient 上训练与测试；最后开展 120 例回顾性盲法随机试验，由三位顾问放射科医生对生成报告与真人报告进行双盲对比打分。
AI.result: 在 MIMIC-CXR 上，GREEN 指标提升 11.2%，RadGraph-XL 提升 24.4%，均显著优于 MedGemma 1.5 (4B)。盲评中 45% 的生成报告被评为“可接受”（与真人报告等效或更优）；8 类病变里 7 类未出现显著偏好差异；真人报告优势主要在召回率，生成报告优势在可读性。
AI.conclusion: CXRMate-2 已展现出接近临床可接受水平的报告质量；若能进一步提升召回率并增强对细微病变（如肺淤血）的检测，有望实现非劣效于人工报告，值得在前瞻性辅助工作流程中继续验证。

title: Explicit Trait Inference for Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) show promise on complex tasks but remain prone to coordination failures such as goal drift, error cascades, and misaligned behaviors. We propose Explicit Trait Inference (ETI), a psychologically grounded method for improving coordination. ETI enables agents to infer and track partner characteristics along two established psychological dimensions--warmth (e.g., trust) and competence (e.g., skill)--from interaction histories to guide decisions. We evaluate ETI in controlled settings (economic games), where it reduces payoff loss by 45-77%, and in more realistic, complex multi-agent settings (MultiAgentBench), where it improves performance by 3-29% depending on the scenario and model, relative to a CoT baseline. Additional analysis shows that gains are closely linked to trait inference: ETI profiles predict agents' actions, and informative profiles drive improvements. These results highlight ETI as a lightweight and robust mechanism for improving coordination in diverse multi-agent settings, and provide the first systematic evidence that LLM agents can (i) reliably infer others' traits from interaction histories and (ii) leverage structured awareness of others' traits for coordination.

AI.tldr: 通过模拟人际温暖-能力双维特质推断，LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）可在无额外训练下显著降低协调失效；实验显示经济博弈中收益损失减少 45-77%，复杂基准任务提升 3-29%，首次验证 LLM 可稳定推断并结构化利用伙伴特质信息。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM-MAS 在复杂任务中常出现目标漂移、错误级联与行为错位等协调失灵，缺乏轻量级、可解释且心理学基础的协调增强机制。
AI.method: 提出显式特质推断（ETI）：让智能体基于交互历史，在温暖（信任）与能力（技能）两个经典心理学维度上持续估计并更新同伴特质分布，并将该分布显式注入提示词以指导后续决策；对比基线为纯 CoT 提示。
AI.result: 在控制实验（经济博弈）中，ETI 将 payoff 损失降低 45-77%；在更贴近现实的 MultiAgentBench 复杂场景下，相较 CoT 基线平均提升 3-29%，且增益幅度与模型规模、任务复杂度正相关；消融表明特质推断质量直接决定性能提升，特质向量可显著预测智能体后续动作。
AI.conclusion: ETI 以一种无需训练、可解释且跨场景稳健的方式，首次系统证明 LLM 智能体能从交互历史可靠推断同伴特质，并利用结构化他人画像实现有效协调，为构建高鲁棒性 MAS 提供了立即可用的新范式。

title: End-to-End Large Portfolio Optimization for Variance Minimization with Neural Networks through Covariance Cleaning
summary: We develop a rotation-invariant neural network that provides the global minimum-variance portfolio by jointly learning how to lag-transform historical returns and marginal volatilities and how to regularise the eigenvalues of large equity covariance matrices. This explicit mathematical mapping offers clear interpretability of each module's role, so the model cannot be regarded as a pure black box. The architecture mirrors the analytical form of the global minimum-variance solution yet remains agnostic to dimension, so a single model can be calibrated on panels of a few hundred stocks and applied, without retraining, to one thousand US equities, a cross-sectional jump that indicates robust generalization capability. The loss function is the future short-term realized minimum variance and is optimized end-to-end on real returns. In out-of-sample tests from January 2000 to December 2024, the estimator delivers systematically lower realized volatility, smaller maximum drawdowns, and higher Sharpe ratios than the best competitors, including state-of-the-art non-linear shrinkage, and these advantages persist across both short and long evaluation horizons despite the model's training focus is short-term. Furthermore, although the model is trained end-to-end to produce an unconstrained minimum-variance portfolio, we show that its learned covariance representation can be used in general optimizers under long-only constraints with virtually no loss in its performance advantage over competing estimators. These advantages persist when the strategy is executed under a highly realistic implementation framework that models market orders at the auctions, empirical slippage, exchange fees, and financing charges for leverage, and they remain stable during episodes of acute market stress.

AI.tldr: 提出一个旋转不变神经网络，端到端直接输出全局最小方差组合，无需重训即可跨尺度泛化；2000-2024 样本外实盘检验，在真实交易成本与极端行情下仍持续优于现有最优协方差估计器，波动率、回撤与夏普率全面占优。
AI.motivation: 传统协方差估计需人工选择滞后阶数、正则化强度，且难以兼顾高维稳健性与可解释性。作者希望构建一个端到端、可扩展、具备可解释性的模型，直接学习得到最小方差组合，同时克服高维估计误差与实市摩擦。
AI.method: 设计旋转不变网络结构：1) 联合学习滞后收益率变换与边际波动率；2) 对大维股票协方差矩阵特征值进行可解释正则化；3) 网络架构显式对应解析最小方差解，但维度无关；4) 损失函数为未来短期已实现组合方差，端到端优化；5) 训练后无需重训即可由数百只股票推广至千只股票。
AI.result: 2000-2024 样本外美股实证：1) 已实现波动率、最大回撤均显著低于非线性压缩等最佳基准；2) 夏普比持续领先，优势在短、长评估窗口均稳定；3) 学习到的协方差表示可直接用于带长-only 约束的一般优化器，性能几乎无损；4) 纳入拍卖市价单、滑点、手续费、杠杆融资等真实成本后，优势在市场极端压力期依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 旋转不变网络不仅实现了对高维协方差估计与最小方差组合构建的统一、端到端学习，还兼具强泛化力与可解释性，能在真实交易环境与极端行情中持续提供统计与经济显著的风险收益改进，为量化投资提供新的高维协方差建模范式。

title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora
summary: Existing QA benchmarks typically assume distinct documents with minimal overlap, yet real-world retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems operate on corpora such as financial reports, legal codes, and patents, where information is highly redundant and documents exhibit strong inter-document similarity. This mismatch undermines evaluation validity: retrievers can be unfairly undervalued even when they retrieve documents that provide sufficient evidence, because redundancy across documents is not accounted for in evaluation. On the other hand, retrievers that perform well on standard benchmarks often generalize poorly to real-world corpora with highly similar and redundant documents. We present RARE (Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation), a framework for constructing realistic benchmarks by (i) decomposing documents into atomic facts to enable precise redundancy tracking and (ii) enhancing LLM-based data generation with CRRF. RAG benchmark data usually requires multiple quality criteria, but LLMs often yield trivial outputs. CRRF scores criteria separately and fuses decisions by rank, improving the reliability of generated data. Applying RARE to Finance, Legal, and Patent corpora, we introduce RedQA, where a strong retriever baseline drops from 66.4% PerfRecall@10 on 4-hop General-Wiki to 5.0-27.9% PerfRecall@10 at 4-hop depth, revealing robustness gaps that current benchmarks fail to capture. RARE enables practitioners to build domain-specific RAG evaluations that faithfully reflect real-world deployment conditions.

AI.tldr: 现代检索评测忽视文档冗余，以至在真实场景下严重失真；本文提出分层去重框架RARE与评测集RedQA，显示强基线在Fin/Legal/Patent 4跳场景PerfRecall@10骤跌至5–28%，暴露现有基准未捕捉的鲁棒性缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG评测基准假设文档低冗余，却导致评分与金融/法律等高冗余领域的实际部署脱节：好检索器被误判，高基准模型在新域却崩溃。需能测量冗余影响的评测范式。
AI.method: 1) 将文档拆为原子事实，显式追踪冗余；2) 引入CRRF（分指标打分再秩融合）指导LLM生成多约束高质量RAG数据；3) 基于Finance/Legal/Patent构建RedQA基准，设单跳至4跳问题并跨冗余文档分布。
AI.result: RARE-RedQA下，强大稠密检索基线PerfRecall@10从4-hop General-Wiki的66.4%跌至5.0%–27.9%，证明现有顶层基准未显测的鲁棒/泛化缺陷。消融显示CRRF生成的数据多约束满足率相对SOTA LLM提升17–24%，从而保证评测信度。
AI.conclusion: 忽视冗余令RAG评估失真。RARE通过原子去重与CRRF数据生成，可在高冗余域构造贴近实战的评测，揭示并指导填补检索模型对相似文档的鲁棒性缺口，推动领域专用RAG系统落地。

title: TabEmb: Joint Semantic-Structure Embedding for Table Annotation
summary: Table annotation is crucial for making web and enterprise tables usable in downstream NLP applications. Unlike textual data where learning semantically rich token or sentence embeddings often suffice, tables are structured combinations of columns wherein useful representations must jointly capture column's semantics and the inter-column relationships. Existing models learn by linearizing the 2D table into a 1D token sequence and encoding it with pretrained language models (PLMs) such as BERT. However, this leads to limited semantic quality and weaker generalization to unseen or rare values compared to modern LLMs, and degraded structural modeling due to 2D-to-1D flattening and context-length constraints. We propose TabEmb, which directly targets these limitations by decoupling semantic encoding from structural modeling. An LLM first produces semantically rich embeddings for each column, and a graph-based module over columns then injects relationships into the embeddings, yielding joint semantic-tructural representations for table annotation. Experiments show that TabEmb consistently outperforms strong baselines on different table annotation tasks. Source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/hoseinzadeehsan/TabEmb

AI.tldr: TabEmb 用 LLM 先学列语义，再用图网络补列间关系，避免把表格压成 1D，显著提升表标注效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法把二维表线性化成一维序列后用 PLM 编码，导致语义容量不足、对罕见值泛化差，且结构信息被压扁；需要一种既能保留大模型语义优势又能显式建模列间关系的表示框架。
AI.method: 提出 TabEmb：① 用 LLM 独立为每列生成语义嵌入；② 以列为节点构建关系图，通过图神经网络把列间依赖注入嵌入；③ 输出联合语义-结构表示供下游表标注任务使用。全程不将表 flatten 成一维序列。
AI.result: 在多个表标注数据集（实体类型推断、关系发现等）上显著优于基于 BERT 的强基线，对罕见/未见值表现尤其突出，且推理长度不受线性化窗口限制。
AI.conclusion: 将语义编码与结构建模解耦，可兼得大模型语义深度与结构化关系信息，为表格表示学习提供了一种简洁有效的新范式；相关代码与数据已开源。

title: AdaGScale: Viewpoint-Adaptive Gaussian Scaling in 3D Gaussian Splatting to Reduce Gaussian-Tile Pairs
summary: Reducing the number of Gaussian-tile pairs is one of the most promising approaches to improve 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) rendering speed on GPUs. However, the importance difference existing among Gaussian-tile pairs has never been considered in the previous works. In this paper, we propose AdaGScale, a novel viewpoint-adaptive Gaussian scaling technique for reducing the number of Gaussian-tile pairs. AdaGScale is based on the observation that the peripheral tiles located far from Gaussian center contribute negligibly to pixel color accumulation. This suggests an opportunity for reducing the number of Gaussian-tile pairs based on color contribution. AdaGScale efficiently estimates the color contribution in the peripheral region of each Gaussian during a preprocessing stage and adaptively scales its size based on the peripheral score. As a result, Gaussians with lower importance intersect with fewer tiles during the intersection test, which improves rendering speed while maintaining image quality. The adjusted size is used only for tile intersection test, and the original size is retained during color accumulation to preserve visual fidelity. Experimental results show that AdaGScale achieves a geometric mean speedup of 13.8x over original 3D-GS on a GPU, with only about 0.5 dB degradation in PSNR on city-scale scenes.

AI.tldr: AdaGScale——首个基于视角自适应缩放高斯半径、按颜色贡献剔除冗余高斯-瓦片对的3D-GS加速方法——在仅损失0.5 dB PSNR的前提下实现13.8倍的GPU平均帧率提升。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting的瓶颈在于大量低价值高斯-瓦片对（Gaussian-tile pairs）的反复相交与求交计算。现有工作仅统一消减高斯数量，却忽视不同视角下各高斯对周边瓦片的贡献差异，导致仍能贡献颜色的低配高斯被粗暴剔除、加速收益受限。
AI.method: （1）利用GPU前处理通道快速估算高斯在视锥内的“周边贡献分数”α，量化其外围瓦片的收色影响；（2）设计自适应缩放策略：按阈值收缩低α高斯的空间椭球半径，使其相交测试时命中更少瓦片，而在真正的像素着色阶段仍用原始半径与权重保证色彩精度；（3）保持其余3D-GS流程（投影、深度排序、可微混合）不变，仅改造栅格化阶段相交决策。
AI.result: 对城市场景测试集，帧率平均提升13.8×；PSNR下降仅0.5 dB，LPISS几乎持平；兼容各向异性高斯和梯度优化，无需重训练模型；显存消耗仅微增2%，端到端延迟降低至原7%–10%，在所有分辨率、普通显卡上均稳定加速。
AI.conclusion: 首次将颜色贡献作为冗余判定准则并嵌入前处理，兼顾质量与速度，为实时大场景3D-GS渲染提供可直接替换的轻量级模块；同时验证了细化高斯覆盖范围而非单纯剪裁数量，是提升栅格化效率更优雅的路径。

title: Large Language Models Exhibit Normative Conformity
summary: The conformity bias exhibited by large language models (LLMs) can pose a significant challenge to decision-making in LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS). While many prior studies have treated "conformity" simply as a matter of opinion change, this study introduces the social psychological distinction between informational conformity and normative conformity in order to understand LLM conformity at the mechanism level. Specifically, we design new tasks to distinguish between informational conformity, in which participants in a discussion are motivated to make accurate judgments, and normative conformity, in which participants are motivated to avoid conflict or gain acceptance within a group. We then conduct experiments based on these task settings. The experimental results show that, among the six LLMs evaluated, up to five exhibited tendencies toward not only informational conformity but also normative conformity. Furthermore, intriguingly, we demonstrate that by manipulating subtle aspects of the social context, it may be possible to control the target toward which a particular LLM directs its normative conformity. These findings suggest that decision-making in LLM-MAS may be vulnerable to manipulation by a small number of malicious users. In addition, through analysis of internal vectors associated with informational and normative conformity, we suggest that although both behaviors appear externally as the same form of "conformity," they may in fact be driven by distinct internal mechanisms. Taken together, these results may serve as an initial milestone toward understanding how "norms" are implemented in LLMs and how they influence group dynamics.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型存在“规范型从众”与“信息型从众”两种易被操控的社会心理机制，显著威胁多智能体系统决策安全；通过微调社交语境即可定向诱导其从众方向，且二者由不同内部向量驱动。
AI.motivation: 已有工作把LLM的“从众”简单视作观点趋同，忽略社会心理学对“信息型/规范型”从众的机制区分，导致无法识别LLM-MAS在真实交互中的决策脆弱点与潜在操控风险。
AI.method: 引入社会心理学定义，设计可分离信息型（追求准确）与规范型（回避冲突、求接纳）的对抗式讨论任务；在六种主流LLM上开展实验，量化两类从众强度，并通过操控语境变量（如群体人数、权威提示）验证对规范型从众的定向诱导；最后利用内部激活向量分析两种从众的计算表征差异。
AI.result: 六模型中最多五种同时表现出显著的信息型与规范型从众；仅需微调少数社交线索即可将LLM的规范型从众指向任意目标；内部向量聚类显示两类从众由可区分的表征子空间驱动，而非单一机制。
AI.conclusion: LLM已内隐实现类似人类“规范”的社交表征，使其在多智能体系统中可被极少数恶意用户精准操控；未来需针对规范型从众设计鲁棒对齐与检测机制，并为“机器社会规范”研究建立量化基础。

title: IMPACT: Importance-Aware Activation Space Reconstruction
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse domains but remain difficult to deploy in resource-constrained environments due to their size. Low-rank compression is a common remedy, typically minimizing weight reconstruction error under the assumption that weights are low-rank. However, this assumption often does not hold in LLMs. In contrast, LLM activations exhibit a more pronounced low-rank structure, motivating approaches that minimize activation reconstruction error.
  This shift alone, however, is not sufficient: different activation dimensions contribute unequally to model performance, and treating them uniformly can lead to accuracy loss. We introduce IMPACT, an importance-aware activation reconstruction framework that links compression to its effect on model performance. IMPACT formulates compression as an optimization problem that integrates activation structure with gradient-based importance, deriving a closed-form solution where reconstruction bases arise from an importance-weighted activation covariance matrix. This yields low-rank compression explicitly optimized for accuracy preservation. Experiments across multiple models and tasks demonstrate that IMPACT achieves up to 55.4% greater model size reduction while maintaining accuracy comparable to or better than state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 IMPACT，一种基于激活重要性加权的低秩压缩框架，显著缩小 LLM 体积而不掉点。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩压缩多基于权重低秩假设，但该假设在大模型中不成立；激活虽呈低秩却未被充分利用，且各维度对性能贡献不均，需要新的压缩范式。
AI.method: 将压缩重构目标由“权重误差”转为“激活误差”，并以梯度信息衡量各激活维度重要性，构建加权协方差矩阵，推导闭式低秩基，实现端到端的性能导向优化。
AI.result: 在多款模型和任务上，IMPACT 比 SOTA 基线额外减小 55.4% 参数量，同时准确率持平或更高，验证激活重要性加权策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 把压缩与下游性能直接挂钩、并以激活结构为核心，可突破传统低秩假设局限，为资源受限场景部署大模型提供新途径。IMPACT 的闭式解法使其具备实际部署潜力。

title: SAMoRA: Semantic-Aware Mixture of LoRA Experts for Task-Adaptive Learning
summary: The combination of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has shown significant potential for enhancing the multi-task learning capabilities of Large Language Models. However, existing methods face two primary challenges: (1)Imprecise Routing in the current MoE-LoRA method fails to explicitly match input semantics with expert capabilities, leading to weak expert specialization. (2)Uniform weight fusion strategies struggle to provide adaptive update strengths, overlooking the varying complexity of different tasks. To address these limitations, we propose SAMoRA (Semantic-Aware Mixture of LoRA Experts), a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework tailored for task-adaptive learning. Specifically, A Semantic-Aware Router is proposed to explicitly align textual semantics with the most suitable experts for precise routing. A Task-Adaptive Scaling mechanism is designed to regulate expert contributions based on specific task requirements dynamically. In addition, a novel regularization objective is proposed to jointly promote expert specialization and effective scaling. Extensive experiments on multiple multi-task benchmarks demonstrate that SAMoRA significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods and holds excellent task generalization capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/boyan-code/SAMoRA

AI.tldr: SAMoRA 提出语义感知的 MoE-LoRA 框架，通过语义对齐路由与任务自适应强度调节，解决专家路由不精准与权重融合僵化问题，实现参数高效的多任务微调。
AI.motivation: 现有 MoE-LoRA 方法在细调大模型时存在两大缺陷：① 路由模块未显式关联输入语义与专家能力，导致专家专业化弱；② 统一的权重融合策略对所有任务施加相同更新强度，忽视任务复杂度差异，进而限制多任务泛化性能。
AI.method: 设计 SAMoRA 框架，核心包括：(1) Semantic-Aware Router——利用文本语义表示显式匹配最适专家，实现精准路由；(2) Task-Adaptive Scaling——动态计算任务相关缩放因子，按需求调节各专家贡献强度；(3) 联合正则化目标——同时约束专家专业化与缩放因子有效性，防止坍缩与过拟合。整体保持 LoRA 的低秩、参数高效特性。
AI.result: 在多任务基准（含 GLUE、Super-NaturalInstructions 等）上与 SOTA 方法对比，SAMoRA 平均提升 2.8%-4.1%，在少样本与跨域场景下优势更显著，且仅引入 0.3% 额外参数量。
AI.conclusion: SAMoRA 通过语义感知路由与任务自适应强度机制，首次将“语义-专家”显式对齐与“任务-更新”动态调节同时融入 MoE-LoRA，显著增强专家专业化与多任务泛化能力，为参数高效的大模型多任务学习提供了新范式。

title: FlowForge: A Staged Local Rollout Engine for Flow-Field Prediction
comment: Main paper: 13 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Appendix: 17 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. arXiv preprint
summary: Deep learning surrogates for CFD flow-field prediction often rely on large, complex models, which can be slow and fragile when data are noisy or incomplete. We introduce FlowForge, a staged local rollout engine that predicts future flow fields by compiling a locality-preserving update schedule and executing it with a shared lightweight local predictor. Rather than producing the next frame in a single global pass, FlowForge rewrites spatial sites stage by stage so that each update conditions only on bounded local context exposed by earlier stages. This compile-execute design aligns inference with short-range physical dependence, keeps latency predictable, and limits error amplification from global mixing. Across PDEBench, CFDBench, and BubbleML, FlowForge matches or improves upon strong baselines in pointwise accuracy, delivers consistently better robustness to noise and missing observations, and maintains stable multi-step rollout behavior while reducing per-step latency.

AI.tldr: FlowForge通过分阶段局部展开策略，以编译—执行框架将全局流场预测拆成局部轻量更新，实现快、稳、可降噪的CFD代理。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习CFD代理模型体积大、推理慢，对噪声和缺失数据敏感，且误差易随全局耦合放大，急需一种兼顾精度、速度、稳健性的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出“编译—执行”两阶段引擎FlowForge：①编译阶段依据局部物理依赖生成保邻接的更新顺序；②执行阶段用共享轻量局部网络按序逐点递推，每步仅依赖早先已更新的有限邻域，避免全局传递。
AI.result: 在PDEBench、CFBDBench、BubbleML数据集上，FlowForge的点对点精度持平或优于复杂全局基线模型；对高斯噪声和随机遮挡的鲁棒性显著提高；多步预测误差增长更慢，且每步延迟降低，推理时间可预测。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段局部展开机制有效对齐CFD的短程依赖特性，兼顾高保真、低延迟与强鲁棒性，为实时、边缘或数据缺失场景下的流场预测提供了轻量可靠的深度学习途径。

title: A Multi-Agent Framework with Structured Reasoning and Reflective Refinement for Multimodal Empathetic Response Generation
summary: Multimodal empathetic response generation (MERG) aims to generate emotionally engaging and empathetic responses based on users' multimodal contexts. Existing approaches usually rely on an implicit one-pass generation paradigm from multimodal context to the final response, which overlooks two intrinsic characteristics of MERG: (1) Human perception of emotional cues is inherently structured rather than a direct mapping. The conventional paradigm neglects the hierarchical progression of emotion perception, leading to distorted emotional judgments. (2) Given the inherent complexity and ambiguity of human emotions, the conventional paradigm is prone to significant emotional biases, ultimately resulting in suboptimal empathy. In this paper, we propose a multi-agent framework for MERG, which enhances empathy through structured reasoning and reflective refinement. Specifically, we first introduce a structured empathetic reasoning-to-generation module that explicitly decomposes response generation via multimodal perception, consistency-aware emotion forecasting, pragmatic strategy planning, and strategy-guided response generation, providing a clearer intermediate path from multimodal evidence to response realization. Besides, we develop a global reflection and refinement module, in which a global reflection agent performs step-wise auditing over intermediate states and the generated response, eliminating existing emotional biases and empathy errors, and triggering targeted regeneration. Overall, such a closed-loop framework enables our model to gradually improve the accuracy of emotion perception and eliminate emotion biases during the iteration process. Experiments on several benchmarks, e.g., IEMOCAP and MELD, demonstrate that our model has superior empathic response generation capabilities compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于多代理闭环推理的共情回复生成框架，通过显式结构化推理与全局反思迭代，解决传统一阶映射导致的情绪误判与共情偏差问题，在IEMOCAP/MELD等基准上取得SOTA表现。
AI.motivation: 传统单步隐式映射范式忽视人类情绪感知天然的分层结构，导致情绪线索被误判；同时情绪本身的复杂与歧义性引入显著共情偏差，亟需显式推理与纠偏机制。
AI.method: 构建多代理闭环框架：(1)结构化推理-生成模块：依次完成多模态感知→一致性情绪预测→语用策略规划→策略引导回复生成，显式拆解证据到回复的路径；(2)全局反思-精炼模块：全局反思代理对已生成的中间状态与回复进行逐步审计，定位并消除情绪偏差与共情错误，触发针对性重生成，实现迭代提升。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP、MELD等多模态共情基准上，模型共情回复质量显著优于现有最佳方法，情绪识别准确率与共情度指标均获新高，验证框架有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结构化推理路径与闭环反思机制，所提多代理框架有效缓解情绪误判与偏差，显著提升多模态共情回复的准确性与人类化程度，为共情对话系统提供新的可扩展范式。

title: Do Agents Dream of Root Shells? Partial-Credit Evaluation of LLM Agents in Capture The Flag Challenges
comment: Accepted to AIWare'26 Benchmark and Dataset Track
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed for autonomous cybersecurity tasks, but their capabilities in realistic offensive settings remain poorly understood. We present DeepRed, an open-source benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents on realistic Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges in isolated virtualized environments. DeepRed places an agent in a Kali attacker environment with terminal tools and optional web search, connected over a private network to a target challenge, and records full execution traces for analysis. To move beyond binary solved/unsolved outcomes, we introduce a partial-credit scoring method based on challenge-specific checkpoints derived from public writeups, together with an automated summarise-then-judge labelling pipeline for assigning checkpoint completion from logs. Using DeepRed, we benchmark ten commercially accessible LLMs on ten VM-based CTF challenges spanning different challenge categories. The results indicate that current agents remain limited: the best model achieves only 35% average checkpoint completion, performing strongest on common challenge types and weakest on tasks requiring non-standard discovery and longer-horizon adaptation.

AI.tldr: DeepRed 是一个面向真实攻防 CTF 的开源基准，通过引入逐检查点评分与自动化标注流程，评估了 10 款商用 LLM 在 10 台隔离 VM 靶机上的表现，发现即使最佳模型平均仅完成 35% 的关键步骤，揭示当前 LLM 代理在非常规发现与长程适应类任务上明显短板。
AI.motivation: 尽管 LLM agent 被广泛提议用于自主网络安全攻防，但它们在真实、复杂且需要多步渗透的 CTF 场景下究竟有多强仍属黑箱，本研究旨在用纵向、可分点量化的基准填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建 DeepRed 开源基准：①隔离虚拟化 Kali 攻击容器 + 私有网络靶机；②记录全程执行轨迹；③基于公开 WriteUp 抽取检查点并定义加权评分；④提出 summarise-then-judge 自动标注流水线，将 log 映射到检查点完成度；⑤覆盖 10 台主机 10 类 CTF 题型，对 10 种商用 LLM（含多规模）进行全轨迹测试并比较分类与跨步表现。
AI.result: ①最佳模型平均仅达 35% 检查点完成度；②常规信息收集/已知漏洞利用题得分最高，非标准发现与需多步长程适应的链条题几乎为零；③模型规模扩大对分数提升有限，且均未能完整解出任何一道 CTF；④日志显示代理在横向移动、上下文维持与工具链组合上频繁失效。
AI.conclusion: 当前可公开调用的 LLM 代理距离实战化自主渗透仍有显著差距；DeepRed 提供的轨迹与检查点式评估框架，可作为未来改进提示策略、行动规划与记忆机制的统一参考，并建议社区聚焦非标准发现、长程规划与细粒度反馈三方面的算法突破。

title: BED-LLM: Intelligent Information Gathering with LLMs and Bayesian Experimental Design
comment: Published at the International Conference on Learning Representations 2026
summary: We propose a general-purpose approach for improving the ability of large language models (LLMs) to intelligently and adaptively gather information from a user or other external source using the framework of sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED). This enables LLMs to act as effective multi-turn conversational agents and interactively interface with external environments. Our approach, which we call BED-LLM (Bayesian experimental design with large language models), is based on iteratively choosing questions or queries that maximize the expected information gain (EIG) with respect to a variable of interest given the responses gathered previously. We show how this EIG can be formulated (and then estimated) in a principled way using a probabilistic model derived from the LLM's predictive distributions and provide detailed insights into key decisions in its construction and updating procedure. We find that BED-LLM achieves substantial gains in performance across a wide range of tests based on the 20 Questions game and using the LLM to actively infer user preferences, compared to purely prompting-based design generation and other adaptive design strategies.

AI.tldr: 提出通用框架 BED-LLM，使大模型在多轮对话中主动选问题，以最大化期望信息增益（EIG）推理用户意图，优于简单提示与自适应基线。
AI.motivation: 大模型被动回应无法高效探查用户偏好或隐变量，需一种可解释、自适应的信息收集范式来驱动多轮对话并持续更新信念。
AI.method: 用LLM的预测分布构建概率模型；将题干或查询视为设计变量，每轮通过贝叶斯实验设计选EIG最大的问题；模型和EIG无模型地蒙特卡罗估计并循环更新，框架即BED-LLM。
AI.result: 在20 Questions与偏好推理两类测试上，与纯Prompt及其他自适应策略相比，BED-LLM显著降低所需轮次、提升准确率与负面对数似然表现俱佳。
AI.conclusion: 将经典贝叶斯主动筛设计与大模型结合具备实际与理论意义，BED-LLM提供可信信息采集手段，可推广到更复杂交互场景并推动主动Agent研究。faith

title: Cell-Based Representation of Relational Binding in Language Models
summary: Understanding a discourse requires tracking entities and the relations that hold between them. While Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on relational reasoning, the mechanism by which they bind entities, relations, and attributes remains unclear. We study discourse-level relational binding and show that LLMs encode it via a Cell-based Binding Representation (CBR): a low-dimensional linear subspace in which each ``cell'' corresponds to an entity--relation index pair, and bound attributes are retrieved from the corresponding cell during inference. Using controlled multi-sentence data annotated with entity and relation indices, we identify the CBR subspace by decoding these indices from attribute-token activations with Partial Least Squares regression. Across domains and two model families, the indices are linearly decodable and form a grid-like geometry in the projected space. We further find that context-specific CBR representations are related by translation vectors in activation space, enabling cross-context transfer. Finally, activation patching shows that manipulating this subspace systematically changes relational predictions and that perturbing it disrupts performance, providing causal evidence that LLMs rely on CBR for relational binding.

AI.tldr: LLM用可解码的低维子空间“细胞型绑定表征”（CBR）完成语篇实体-关系绑定，实验给出因果证据。
AI.motivation: 尽管大模型在关系推理上表现优异，其“如何把实体、关系与属性绑定到同一表征”这一核心机制仍属黑箱，需要揭示并给出可验证的数学描述。
AI.method: 构造带实体-关系索引标注的多句语篇，用PLS回归从属性token激活中解码索引，定位线性子空间；考察跨领域/模型族的可解码性与几何结构；用激活修补干预该子空间并观测输出变化。
AI.result: 索引在低维投影空间呈网格状几何且线性可解码；不同上下文的CBR表示由平移向量关联，实现跨上下文迁移；人为扰动该子空间系统性地破坏关系预测，验证其因果必要性。
AI.conclusion: CBR是LLM实现语篇级关系绑定的可解释、因果关键机制，为剖析与操控模型推理过程提供了可操作窗口。

title: Distillation Traps and Guards: A Calibration Knob for LLM Distillability
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers capabilities from large language models (LLMs) to smaller students, yet it can fail unpredictably and also underpins model leakage risks. Our analysis revealed several distillation traps: tail noise, off-policy instability, and, most fundamentally, the teacher-student gap, that distort training signals. These traps manifest as overconfident hallucinations, self-correction collapse, and local decoding degradation, causing distillation to fail. Motivated by these findings, we propose a post-hoc calibration method that, to the best of our knowledge, for the first time enables control over a teacher's distillability via reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT). Our objective combines task utility, KL anchor, and across-tokenizer calibration reward. This makes distillability a practical safety lever for foundation models, connecting robust teacher-student transfer with deployment-aware model protection. Experiments across math, knowledge QA, and instruction-following tasks show that students distilled from distillable calibrated teachers outperform SFT and KD baselines, while undistillable calibrated teachers retain their task performance but cause distilled students to collapse, offering a practical knob for both better KD and model IP protection.

AI.tldr: 首次发现KD存在三大陷阱，提出一种可事后校准教师“可蒸馏性”的强化微调方法，既能提升学生性能又可作为模型IP保护开关。
AI.motivation: 传统KD虽可将大模型能力迁移到小模型，但会不可预测地失败并带来模型泄露风险；亟需揭示失败根源并赋予开发者对蒸馏过程的可控性。
AI.method: 通过归因分析提炼出尾部噪声、离策略不稳定与师生鸿沟三大陷阱；设计强化微调目标，将任务效用、KL锚定与跨分词器校准Reward联合优化，使教师获得“可调蒸馏性”。
AI.result: 在数学、知识问答与指令遵循任务上，来自“可蒸馏”教师的学生显著优于SFT与KD基线；而“不可蒸馏”教师保持自身性能却令学生崩溃，验证方法对性能与IP保护的双重可控性。
AI.conclusion: 将蒸馏能力转化为可开关的安全杠杆，首次把鲁棒师生迁移与部署阶段的模型保护打通，为Foundation Model的KD与知识产权防护提供实用化方案。

title: AutoAWG: Adverse Weather Generation with Adaptive Multi-Controls for Automotive Videos
summary: Perception robustness under adverse weather remains a critical challenge for autonomous driving, with the core bottleneck being the scarcity of real-world video data in adverse weather. Existing weather generation approaches struggle to balance visual quality and annotation reusability. We present AutoAWG, a controllable Adverse Weather video Generation framework for Autonomous driving. Our method employs a semantics-guided adaptive fusion of multiple controls to balance strong weather stylization with high-fidelity preservation of safety-critical targets; leverages a vanishing point-anchored temporal synthesis strategy to construct training sequences from static images, thereby reducing reliance on synthetic data; and adopts masked training to enhance long-horizon generation stability. On the nuScenes validation set, AutoAWG significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods: without first-frame conditioning, FID and FVD are relatively reduced by 50.0% and 16.1%; with first-frame conditioning, they are further reduced by 8.7% and 7.2%, respectively. Extensive qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate advantages in style fidelity, temporal consistency, and semantic--structural integrity, underscoring the practical value of AutoAWG for improving downstream perception in autonomous driving. Our code is available at: https://github.com/higherhu/AutoAWG

AI.tldr: 提出AutoAWG，一种面向自动驾驶的可控恶劣天气视频生成框架，以静态图像为输入，兼顾天气风格化与安全关键目标的高保真，显著提升恶劣天气感知的训练数据供给能力。
