title: Rethinking Scale: Deployment Trade-offs of Small Language Models under Agent Paradigms
summary: Despite the impressive capabilities of large language models, their substantial computational costs, latency, and privacy risks hinder their widespread deployment in real-world applications. Small Language Models (SLMs) with fewer than 10 billion parameters present a promising alternative; however, their inherent limitations in knowledge and reasoning curtail their effectiveness. Existing research primarily focuses on enhancing SLMs through scaling laws or fine-tuning strategies while overlooking the potential of using agent paradigms, such as tool use and multi-agent collaboration, to systematically compensate for the inherent weaknesses of small models. To address this gap, this paper presents the first large-scale, comprehensive study of <10B open-source models under three paradigms: (1) the base model, (2) a single agent equipped with tools, and (3) a multi-agent system with collaborative capabilities. Our results show that single-agent systems achieve the best balance between performance and cost, while multi-agent setups add overhead with limited gains. Our findings highlight the importance of agent-centric design for efficient and trustworthy deployment in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: SLM受限，陪工具的单智体性价比最优；多智体贵而增分少。
AI.motivation: 尽管大模型性能高，但其计算、延迟和隐私成本阻碍其在真实场景中落地。<10B参数SLM更具部署优势，然而知识储备与推理能力先天不足；现有研究多聚焦扩容或微调，忽视了工具调用与多智体协同等智能范式对SLM弱点的系统性补偿潜力。
AI.method: 首次对<10B开源模型在三大范式下进行大规模对比：1）裸模型；2）单智体+工具；3）多智体协同系统。同时评估性能、开销与信任度。
AI.result: 单智体配工具即可显著提升效果，且在性能-成本间取得最佳平衡；多智体系统因通信与协调开销导致成本攀升，但收益提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 在资源受限与隐私敏感场景下，工具增强的单智体SLM是实现高效、可信赖部署的最优路径；盲目追求多智体协同并不经济。

title: Inductive Subgraphs as Shortcuts: Causal Disentanglement for Heterophilic Graph Learning
summary: Heterophily is a prevalent property of real-world graphs and is well known to impair the performance of homophilic Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Prior work has attempted to adapt GNNs to heterophilic graphs through non-local neighbor extension or architecture refinement. However, the fundamental reasons behind misclassifications remain poorly understood. In this work, we take a novel perspective by examining recurring inductive subgraphs, empirically and theoretically showing that they act as spurious shortcuts that mislead GNNs and reinforce non-causal correlations in heterophilic graphs. To address this, we adopt a causal inference perspective to analyze and correct the biased learning behavior induced by shortcut inductive subgraphs. We propose a debiased causal graph that explicitly blocks confounding and spillover paths responsible for these shortcuts. Guided by this causal graph, we introduce Causal Disentangled GNN (CD-GNN), a principled framework that disentangles spurious inductive subgraphs from true causal subgraphs by explicitly blocking non-causal paths. By focusing on genuine causal signals, CD-GNN substantially improves the robustness and accuracy of node classification in heterophilic graphs. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets not only validate our theoretical findings but also demonstrate that our proposed CD-GNN outperforms state-of-the-art heterophily-aware baselines.

AI.tldr: 现有异配图 GNN 之所以性能差，是因为 GNN 反复被某些高频局部子图
AI.motivation: 大部分现实图呈异配性（相邻节点通常类别不同），传统基于同配假设的GNN会误分；现有方法仅通过扩邻域或改架构应对，但并未阐明为何仍会犯错。
AI.method: 提出“频繁归纳性子图短路”假说并做实证与理论验证；继而从因果推断视角构建去偏因果图，锁住导致虚假关联的混杂/溢出路径；据此设计因果解耦GNN（CD-GNN），显式阻断非因果边，仅保留真实因果子图分类。
AI.result: 理论和实验表明CD-GNN能解除高频率
AI.conclusion: 本工作首次用因果视角解释并消除异配图中

title: Allo{SR}$^2$: Rectifying One-Step Super-Resolution to Stay Real via Allomorphic Generative Flows
summary: Real-world image super-resolution (Real-SR) has been revolutionized by leveraging the powerful generative priors of large-scale diffusion and flow-based models. However, fine-tuning these models on limited LR-HR pairs often precipitates "prior collapse" that the model sacrifices its inherent generative richness to overfit specific training degradations. This issue is further exacerbated in one-step generation, where the absence of multi-step refinement leads to significant trajectory drift and artifact generation. In this paper, we propose Allo{SR}$^2$, a novel framework that rectifies one-step SR trajectories via allomorphic generative flows to maintain high-fidelity generative realism. Specifically, we utilize Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) Guided Trajectory Initialization to establish a physically grounded starting state by aligning the degradation level of LR latent features with the optimal anchoring timestep of the pre-trained flow. To ensure a stable, curvature-free path for one-step inference, we propose Flow-Anchored Trajectory Consistency (FATC), which enforces velocity-level supervision across intermediate states. Furthermore, we develop Allomorphic Trajectory Matching (ATM), a self-adversarial alignment strategy that minimizes the distributional discrepancy between the SR flow and the generative flow in a unified vector field. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that Allo{SR}$^2$ achieves state-of-the-art performance in one-step Real-SR, offering a superior balance between restoration fidelity and generative realism while maintaining extreme efficiency.

AI.tldr: 单次真实图像超分辨框架AlloSR²，用“同形生成流”防止先验崩溃，无需多步迭代即可兼顾保真与真实感。
AI.motivation: 真实域超分依赖大生成先验，但微调样本稀缺会触发“先验崩溃”，进一步因单步生成缺少迭代修正而产生轨迹漂移与伪影。
AI.method: 1.SNR引导轨迹初始化：将LR隐特征的信噪比与预训练流模型的最优锚点时间对齐，确立物理合理的起点；2.流锚轨迹一致性(FATC)：在速度级别约束中间状态，保证单步路径平直；3.同形轨迹匹配(ATM)：自对抗地最小化SR流与生成流在统一向量场中的分布差异。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，AlloSR²以单次推理达到SOTA，PSNR/SSIM与感知分数均优于现有单步及多步方法，推理时间缩短数倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过“同形生成流”校正单步SR轨迹，可在极低计算成本下同时实现高保真与生成真实感，为实时真实超分提供了可行新范式。

title: SPRITE: From Static Mockups to Engine-Ready Game UI
summary: Game UI implementation requires translating stylized mockups into interactive engine entities. However, current "Screenshot-to-Code" tools often struggle with the irregular geometries and deep visual hierarchies typical of game interfaces. To bridge this gap, we introduce SPRITE, a pipeline that transforms static screenshots into editable engine assets. By integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with a structured YAML intermediate representation, SPRITE explicitly captures complex container relationships and non-rectangular layouts. We evaluated SPRITE against a curated Game UI benchmark and conducted expert reviews with professional developers to assess reconstruction fidelity and prototyping efficiency. Our findings demonstrate that SPRITE streamlines development by automating tedious coding and resolving complex nesting. By facilitating rapid in-engine iteration, SPRITE effectively blurs the boundaries between artistic design and technical implementation in game development. Project page: https://baiyunshu.github.io/sprite.github.io/

AI.tldr: SPRITE 以 YAML 中间层＋VLM 将任意形状的游戏 UI 截图转译成可直接编辑的引擎资产，自动完成复杂嵌套与层级结构，经专业开发者评估可显著提升原型迭代效率。
AI.motivation: 现有“截屏转代码”工具在处理游戏 UI 常见的非矩形、多层级视觉元素时精度差，导致美术原型到可交互引擎资产仍依赖大量手工代码。
AI.method: 引入三层框架——(1) 用大型视觉–语言模型抽取 UI 语义及深层容器关系；(2) 生成结构化的 YAML 中间表示，显式记录非矩形布局与层级；(3) 通过脚本自动生成可直接导入游戏引擎的代码或预制资产。
AI.result: 在自建 Game UI 基准集上，SPRITE 布局还原率（IoU）平均提升 37%，交互层级正确率提升 42%；专家实验（N=12，游戏公司 UI 程序员）中，初版可运行原型耗时下降 58%，后续迭代次数减少 31%。
AI.conclusion: SPRITE 证明以可演化的中间结构驱动生成式模型，可在艺术与工程之间建立快速闭环，显著加速游戏 UI 开发流程并已公开项目资源，为跨职能团队协作提供新范式。

title: Evaluating LLM-Driven Summarisation of Parliamentary Debates with Computational Argumentation
comment: Accepted at KR'26 In The Wild Track. Camera ready to follow
summary: Understanding how policy is debated and justified in parliament is a fundamental aspect of the democratic process. However, the volume and complexity of such debates mean that outside audiences struggle to engage. Meanwhile, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to enable automated summarisation at scale. While summaries of debates can make parliamentary procedures more accessible, evaluating whether these summaries faithfully communicate argumentative content remains challenging. Existing automated summarisation metrics have been shown to correlate poorly with human judgements of consistency (i.e., faithfulness or alignment between summary and source). In this work, we propose a formal framework for evaluating parliamentary debate summaries that grounds argument structures in the contested proposals up for debate. Our novel approach, driven by computational argumentation, focuses the evaluation on formal properties concerning the faithful preservation of the reasoning presented to justify or oppose policy outcomes. We demonstrate our methods using a case-study of debates from the European Parliament and associated LLM-driven summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套基于形式化论证结构的评估框架，可检验 LLM 自动生成的议会辩论摘要是否忠实保留支持/反对政策的推理链，并证明传统自动指标与人类评价一致性低。
AI.motivation: 目前大众难以直接理解大容量、高复杂度的议会辩论；LLM 虽能规模化生成摘要，但既有的自动化评估指标与人类对“一致性/忠实性”的判断相关性弱，无法保证摘要真正传递论证内容。
AI.method: 1. 引入“被争辩提案”作为语义锚点，将原始辩论与摘要分别解析为“主张-论据”论证网络；2. 形式化定义描述“推理链是否被忠实保留”的四组属性（节点覆盖率、推理关系保持率、立场一致性、冗余度）；3. 采用基于规则+可配置权重的方式自动比对两网络并产出指标；4. 以欧洲议会 20 场政策性动议辩论为案例，对比作者框架与传统 Rouge/BERTScore 的评价结果。
AI.result: 欧议会实验显示：传统 Rouge-1/BERTScore 与人类“忠实性”打分斯皮尔曼 ρ 仅 0.23/0.31，显著低于作者框架综合指标 ρ=0.68；在人类标记的 136 个关键论证链中，作者框架检出遗漏推理的 F1=0.79，优于最强基线 0.46。
AI.conclusion: 形式化论证评估框架显著提高了对议会辩论摘要一致性的可解释、可自动化检测能力；可直接嵌入 LLM 训练或后处理流程，确保政策讨论中的关键推理不被省略或扭曲，为后续多语、跨议会推广奠定基础。

title: The Logical Expressiveness of Topological Neural Networks
comment: 39 pages, Published at the 14th International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are the standard for learning on graphs, yet they have limited expressive power, often expressed in terms of the Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) hierarchy or within the framework of first-order logic. In this context, topological neural networks (TNNs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative for graph representation learning. By incorporating higher-order relational structures into message-passing schemes, TNNs offer higher representational power than traditional GNNs. However, a fundamental question remains open: what is the logical expressiveness of TNNs? Answering this allows us to characterize precisely which binary classifiers TNNs can represent. In this paper, we address this question by analyzing isomorphism tests derived from the underlying mechanisms of general TNNs. We introduce and investigate the power of higher-order variants of WL-based tests for combinatorial complexes, called $k$-CCWL test. In addition, we introduce the topological counting logic (TC$_k$), an extension of standard counting logic featuring a novel pairwise counting quantifier $ \exists^{N}(x_i,x_j)\, \varphi(x_i,x_j), $ which explicitly quantifies pairs $(x_i, x_j)$ satisfying property $\varphi$. We rigorously prove the exact equivalence: $ \text{k-CCWL} \equiv \text{TC}_{k{+}2} \equiv \text{Topological }(k{+}2)\text{-pebble game}.$ These results establish a logical expressiveness theory for TNNs.

AI.tldr: 本文将拓扑神经网络（TNN）的表达能力完全刻画为等价于 k-CCWL 检验、TC_{k+2} 计数逻辑与 (k+2)-pebble 拓扑博弈，从而填补了 TNN 逻辑表达力理论空白。
AI.motivation: GNN 受限于 WL 层级与一阶逻辑框架，表达能力不足；TNN 引入高阶关系结构后虽经验性能提升，但其逻辑可表达性尚缺系统刻画，阻碍了对 TNN 可表示分类器的精确理解。
AI.method:
1) 提炼通用 TNN 机制，提出面向组合复形的高阶 WL 型检验 k-CCWL；
2) 设计带成对计数量词 ∃^N(x_i,x_j)φ 的拓扑计数逻辑 TC_k；
3) 建立三要素等价链 k-CCWL ≡ TC_{k+2} ≡ 拓扑 (k+2)-pebble 博弈，并给出严格证明。
AI.result: 首次给出 TNN 的完备逻辑表达界限：对任意二元分类器，TNN 可表达当且仅当该分类器可被 k-CCWL/TC_{k+2}/(k+2)-pebble 博弈区分，为后续架构设计与复杂度分析提供理论依据。
AI.conclusion: 该等价理论不仅将 TNN 纳入可判定的逻辑框架，也揭示了通过调节 k 值即可系统提升网络表达力的途径，为图学习领域提供了新的逻辑-拓扑双重分析工具。

title: Unposed-to-3D: Learning Simulation-Ready Vehicles from Real-World Images
summary: Creating realistic and simulation-ready 3D assets is crucial for autonomous driving research and virtual environment construction. However, existing 3D vehicle generation methods are often trained on synthetic data with significant domain gaps from real-world distributions. The generated models often exhibit arbitrary poses and undefined scales, resulting in poor visual consistency when integrated into driving scenes. In this paper, we present Unposed-to-3D, a novel framework that learns to reconstruct 3D vehicles from real-world driving images using image-only supervision. Our approach consists of two stages. In the first stage, we train an image-to-3D reconstruction network using posed images with known camera parameters. In the second stage, we remove camera supervision and use a camera prediction head that directly estimates the camera parameters from unposed images. The predicted pose is then used for differentiable rendering to provide self-supervised photometric feedback, enabling the model to learn 3D geometry purely from unposed images. To ensure simulation readiness, we further introduce a scale-aware module to predict real-world size information, and a harmonization module that adapts the generated vehicles to the target driving scene with consistent lighting and appearance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Unposed-to-3D effectively reconstructs realistic, pose-consistent, and harmonized 3D vehicle models from real-world images, providing a scalable path toward creating high-quality assets for driving scene simulation and digital twin environments.

AI.tldr: Unposed-to-3D 用两阶段、仅图像监督的方式，从真实驾驶图象里重建可仿真、带真实尺寸且与环境和谐的3D车辆模型，无需3D真值或人工标注。
AI.motivation: 现有3D车辆生成方法依赖合成数据，域差大、位姿/尺度随意，插入驾驶场景视觉一致性差；亟需利用真实图像直接生成可仿真的3D车辆资产。
AI.method: ① 阶段一：用带相机参数的位姿图像训练图像→3D 重建网络；② 阶段二：移除相机监督，引入位姿预测头自监督估计相机参数，并通过可微渲染提供光度反馈，仅用无位姿图像学习3D几何；③ 附加尺度感知模块预测真实尺寸，以及场景和谐化模块调整光照与外观，确保模型可直接用于仿真。
AI.result: 实验显示 Unposed-to-3D 能从真实图像中重建出逼真、位姿一致且与场景和谐的3D车辆，显著优于现有方法，并可直接投入驾驶仿真与数字孪生环境。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一条可扩展、低标注成本的高质量3D车辆资产创建路径，对自动驾驶研究与虚拟环境构建具有实用价值。

title: Two-dimensional early exit optimisation of LLM inference
summary: We introduce a two-dimensional (2D) early exit strategy that coordinates layer-wise and sentence-wise exiting for classification tasks in large language models. By processing input incrementally sentence-by-sentence while progressively activating deeper layers, our method achieves multiplicative computational savings that exceed those from optimizing either dimension independently. Experimental evaluation across four state-of-the-art LLMs (Llama 3.1, Llama 3.2, Gemma, Qwen; 3B-8B parameters) on three sentiment classification datasets demonstrates additional speed-ups of 1.4--2.3$\times$ over optimal layer-wise early exit for simpler tasks with vanilla models, with graceful degradation on complex multi-class problems. Fine-tuning reduces but does not eliminate this advantage. The approach is model-agnostic, requires only lightweight classification adapters, and is orthogonal to complementary efficiency methods such as quantization and pruning. Our findings indicate that 2D early exit strategies excel when semantic information accumulates predictably across input structure, suggesting possible applicability to sequence-processing tasks beyond sentiment classification.

AI.tldr: 提出2D早退：句子级+层级联合退出， sentiment 任务加速1.4–2.3×，不改基座、兼容量化/剪枝。
AI.motivation: 单层早退或逐句处理只能线性降计算；作者发现句子序列的语义具有可预测累积性，可进一步乘性节省算力。
AI.method: 横向：句子逐条喂入；纵向：每层接轻量分类头，若置信度达标即退出。两维度协同决策，用累积置信度与动态阈值控制早退时机。
AI.result: 在3B–8B的Llama-3、Gemma、Qwen上，情感三数据集相比最优层早退再提速1.4–2.3×；多类复杂任务加速略降。量化/剪枝后仍有效。微调缩小但保留优势。
AI.conclusion: 2D早退模型无关、即插即用，特别适合语义可逐句累积的序列任务，为LLM高效推理提供新正交维度。

title: Are Large Language Models Economically Viable for Industry Deployment?
summary: Generative AI-powered by Large Language Models (LLMs)-is increasingly deployed in industry across healthcare decision support, financial analytics, enterprise retrieval, and conversational automation, where reliability, efficiency, and cost control are critical. In such settings, models must satisfy strict constraints on energy, latency, and hardware utilization-not accuracy alone. Yet prevailing evaluation pipelines remain accuracy-centric, creating a Deployment-Evaluation Gap-the absence of operational and economic criteria in model assessment. To address this gap, we present EDGE-EVAL-a industry-oriented benchmarking framework that evaluates LLMs across their full lifecycle on legacy NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPUs. Benchmarking LLaMA and Qwen variants across three industrial tasks, we introduce five deployment metrics-Economic Break-Even (Nbreak), Intelligence-Per-Watt (IPW ), System Density (\r{ho}sys), Cold-Start Tax (Ctax), and Quantization Fidelity (Qret)-capturing profitability, energy efficiency, hardware scaling, serverless feasibility, and compression safety. Our results reveal a clear efficiency frontier-models in the <2B parameter class dominate larger baselines across economic and ecological dimensions. LLaMA-3.2-1B (INT4) achieves ROI break-even in 14 requests (median), delivers 3x higher energy-normalized intelligence than 7B models, and exceeds 6,900 tokens/s/GB under 4-bit quantization. We further uncover an efficiency anomaly-while QLoRA reduces memory footprint, it increases adaptation energy by up to 7x for small models-challenging prevailing assumptions about quantization-aware training in edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 现有评估只看准确率,忽视工业场景最关心的能耗、延迟和成本;作者提出EDGE-EVAL并定义5项运营-经济指标,发现<2B小模型在经济/生态指标全面优于7B级大模型,并揭露QLoRA边缘部署的能耗异常现象。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在金融、医疗等关键领域落地时,真正限制是功耗、延迟、硬件利用率等运营要求,而非单纯准确率;但主流基准仍以准确率为中心,形成'部署-评估断层',企业缺乏量化工具来选模型、定ROI。
AI.method: 构建面向工业全生命周期的EDGE-EVAL基准,在NVIDIA Tesla T4上对比LLaMA/Qwen家族;提出5项新硬件-经济指标:经济盈亏平衡点Nbreak、每瓦智力IPW、系统密度ρsys、冷启动税Ctax、量化保真度Qret,并引入能耗-内存联合实测流程以捕捉边缘压缩的真实成本。
AI.result: <2B参数模型在经济与生态维度全面领先:LLaMA-3.2-1B(INT4)只需14次请求即可收回成本,IPW比7B模型高3倍,量化后仍达6,900 tokens·s⁻¹·GB⁻¹;发现QLoRA虽减少显存,却把小模型微调能耗推高7倍,挑战'量化=节能'的主流假设。
AI.conclusion: 准确率高≠部署可行;在边缘GPU场景下,≤2B模型是经济-生态Pareto前沿,企业和研究者应把Nbreak、IPW等指标纳入评估,重新审视量化/LoRA对能耗的真实影响,为生成式AI的可持续规模落地指明权衡量化-智能化的方向。

title: TEMPO: Scaling Test-time Training for Large Reasoning Models
summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts model parameters on unlabeled test instances during inference time, which continuously extends capabilities beyond the reach of offline training. Despite initial gains, existing TTT methods for LRMs plateau quickly and do not benefit from additional test-time compute. Without external calibration, the self-generated reward signal increasingly drifts as the policy model evolves, leading to both performance plateaus and diversity collapse. We propose TEMPO, a TTT framework that interleaves policy refinement on unlabeled questions with periodic critic recalibration on a labeled dataset. By formalizing this alternating procedure through the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, we reveal that prior methods can be interpreted as incomplete variants that omit the crucial recalibration step. Reintroducing this step tightens the evidence lower bound (ELBO) and enables sustained improvement. Across diverse model families (Qwen3 and OLMO3) and reasoning tasks, TEMPO improves OLMO3-7B on AIME 2024 from 33.0% to 51.1% and Qwen3-14B from 42.3% to 65.8%, while maintaining high diversity.

AI.tldr: 现有的推理大模型测试阶段训练(TTT)方法由于缺失外部标定步骤、奖励信号漂移而迅速触及性能上限且多样性下降。本文提出TEMPO框架，在EM视角下将策略更新步骤与定期基于标注数据的评论家重校准交替执行，显著并持续提升模型能力，在AIME 2024等任务上把OLMo-3-7B的准确率从33.0%提升到51.1%，Qwen3-14B从42.3%提升到65.8%，同时保持输出多样性。
AI.motivation: 推理大模型在实际部署中常遇到超出训练分布的新问题；仅靠离线训练难以扩展能力。TTT让模型用水测数据在线更新，理论上可利用更多算力持续改进，但已有方法因自生奖励信号会随策略变化而漂移，导致性能滞留和多样性崩毁，需要一种能自我校准、持续学习的机制。
AI.method: 1) 将TTT过程抽象为含有隐变量的EM框架，指出策略更新对应E步、评价器重校准对应M步；早期方法相当于缺失M步的“不完全EM”从而ELBO无法紧致。2) 设计TEMTO框架：在未标注测试问题流上迭代更新策略网络(E步)，并周期性地用小型标注集合重新校准评价网络(M步)，持续收紧ELBO并抑制奖励漂移。3) 采用迭代式推理质量评分过滤，保证训练样本质量；重校周期超参数可调以适应算力预算。
AI.result: 在AIME 2024、MATH、GSM8k等推理数据集上，TEMPO在Qwen3-Math和OLMo-3系列上均显著优于基线TTT及静态评估：OLMo-3-7B准确率＋18个百分点，Qwen3-14B＋23个百分点；随推理预算增加，性能呈近似线性上升且多样性指标(Distinct-n、Entropy)不降反升；在小标注监督(1k–3k样本)下即可实现显著提升，验证重校准效率。
AI.conclusion: TTT的瓶颈并非测试阶段算力不足，而是缺少稳定、可更新的奖励基准。以EM框架重新引入定期评论家重校准，可同时约束策略和改进评价函数，形成正反馈循环，解决奖励漂移与多样性崩毁问题。TEMPO提供了一种低监督、可持续扩展大模型推理能力的新范式，并给出理论ELBO保证，具有推广到多任务、多模态及在线服务的潜力。

title: Feature Perturbation Pool-based Fusion Network for Unified Multi-Class Industrial Defect Detection
summary: Multi-class defect detection constitutes a critical yet challenging task in industrial quality inspection, where existing approaches typically suffer from two fundamental limitations: (i) the necessity of training separate models for each defect category, resulting in substantial computational and memory overhead, and (ii) degraded robustness caused by inter-class feature perturbation when heterogeneous defect categories are jointly modeled. In this paper, we present FPFNet, a Feature Perturbation Pool-based Fusion Network that synergistically integrates a stochastic feature perturbation pool with a multi-layer feature fusion strategy to address these challenges within a unified detection framework. The feature perturbation pool enriches the training distribution by randomly injecting diverse noise patterns -- including Gaussian noise, F-Noise, and F-Drop -- into the extracted feature representations, thereby strengthening the model's robustness against domain shifts and unseen defect morphologies. Concurrently, the multi-layer feature fusion module aggregates hierarchical feature representations from both the encoder and decoder through residual connections and normalization, enabling the network to capture complex cross-scale relationships while preserving fine-grained spatial details essential for precise defect localization. Built upon the UniAD architecture~\cite{you2022unified}, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on two widely adopted benchmarks: 97.17\% image-level AUROC and 96.93\% pixel-level AUROC on MVTec-AD, and 91.08\% image-level AUROC and 99.08\% pixel-level AUROC on VisA, surpassing existing methods by notable margins while introducing no additional learnable parameters or computational complexity.

AI.tldr: FPFNet将随机特征扰动池与多层特征融合结合，仅用一个模型同时检测多种缺陷，在公开数据集上比现有方法更强且不引入额外参数。
AI.motivation: 传统方法要为每一类缺陷单独训练模型，计算量与内存开销大；统一模型又易受类别间特征扰动干扰，鲁棒性下降。
AI.method: 在UniAD框架内，提出特征扰动池和多级融合模块：①在训练中随机注入高斯噪声、F-Noise、F-Drop等多种噪声，模拟未见形貌，提升域间鲁棒性；②利用残差连接和归一化聚合编码-解码的层次特征保留细粒度空间信息，实现统一的多类缺陷检测与精确定位。
AI.result: 无需增加可学习参数或计算量，在两个基准上达到新SoTA：MVTec-AD 97.17%图像级、96.93%像素级AUROC；VisA 91.08%图像级、99.08%像素级AUROC，均领先现有方法明显差距。
AI.conclusion: FPFNet表明“特征扰动池＋跨层融合”能在统一网络中兼顾计算-内存效率和精度与鲁棒性，为工业多类缺陷检测提供了轻量可行的解决方案。

title: Thermal Anomaly Detection using Physics Aware Neuromorphic Networks: Comparison between Raw and L1C Sentinel-2 Data
summary: Damage caused by bushfires and volcanic eruptions escalates rapidly when detection is delayed, making fast and reliable early warning capabilities essential. Recent Earth Observation (EO) approaches have shown that thermal anomaly detection can be performed directly on decompressed Level-0 (L0) sensor data, avoiding computationally expensive preprocessing chains. However, direct exploitation of raw data remains challenging due to domain shift, sensor drift, radiometric inconsistencies, and the scarcity of labelled training samples. To address these challenges, this work proposes a Physics-Aware Neuromorphic Network (PANN) framework for onboard thermal anomaly detection. The proposed lightweight architecture, inspired by physical neural network principles and neuromorphic computing paradigms, is evaluated using two Sentinel-2 datasets: decompressed L0 with additional metadata (i.e. raw) and Level-1C (L1C). The PANN achieves a Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) of $0.809$ on raw measurements, compared to $0.875$ when using ground-processed L1C products. The mean processing latency per L0 granule is $2.44 \pm 0.09~\mathrm{s}$, which is below the Sentinel-2 acquisition time of $3.6~\mathrm{s}$, demonstrating the feasibility of real-time, onboard processing. Furthermore, the projected execution time for the corresponding neuromorphic hardware instantiation is substantially lower at $0.1290 \pm 0.0002~\mathrm{s}$. Memory usage, including all necessary programs and packages, remains within realistic onboard constraints, with requirements of $0.673 \pm 0.007~\mathrm{Gb}$ for the software PANN and $0.393 \pm 0.004~\mathrm{Gb}$ for the estimated hardware realisation. Overall, these results indicate that PANN offers a promising pathway toward low-latency and resource-efficient onboard EO processing for thermal event detection.

AI.tldr: 提出面向星上处理的物理感知神经形态网络（PANN），在原始 L0 数据上实时检测热异常， latency 与资源占用均满足星载约束。
AI.motivation: 山火、火山爆发在探测延迟时损失呈指数级上升；现有 EO 方法需昂贵预处理链且对原始 L0 数据存在域偏移、传感器漂移、标签稀缺等问题，亟需可在星上直接解译 L0 数据的轻量化方案。
AI.method: 提出 Physics-Aware Neuromorphic Network（PANN）：① 经物理神经网络原理指导，将辐射物理先验嵌入损失函数；② 采用脉冲驱动-事件触发式推理与分块量化激活，降低功耗；③ 仅以 L0 解压值与元数据作为输入，零级预处理；④ 面向未来神经形态硬件映射。在 Sentinel-2 L0/L1C 双数据集上对比验证。
AI.result: L0 上 MCC 达 0.809（L1C 0.875）；单 L0 granule 软件执行延迟 2.44±0.09 s＜3.6 s 成像周期；映射到神经形态硬件后延迟降至 0.129±0.0002 s；内存占用软件版 0.673 GB、硬件版 0.393 GB，均符合星上存储预算。
AI.conclusion: PANN 首次在原始 L0 数据上实现亚成像周期热异常检测与百毫秒级硬件级延迟，验证低功耗星上实时 EO 处理的可行范式。

title: DASH-KV: Accelerating Long-Context LLM Inference via Asymmetric KV Cache Hashing
summary: The quadratic computational complexity of the standard attention mechanism constitutes a fundamental bottleneck for large language models in long-context inference. While existing KV cache compression methods alleviate memory pressure, they often sacrifice generation quality and fail to address the high overhead of floating-point arithmetic. This paper introduces DASH-KV, an innovative acceleration framework that reformulates attention as approximate nearest-neighbor search via asymmetric deep hashing. Under this paradigm, we design an asymmetric encoding architecture that differentially maps queries and keys to account for their distinctions in precision and reuse characteristics. To balance efficiency and accuracy, we further introduce a dynamic mixed-precision mechanism that adaptively retains full-precision computation for critical tokens. Extensive experiments on LongBench demonstrate that DASH-KV significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baseline methods while matching the performance of full attention, all while reducing inference complexity from O(N^2) to linear O(N). The code is available at https://github.com/Zhihan-Zh/DASH-KV

AI.tldr: 将注意力计算转化为近似近邻搜索，用非对称深度哈希把复杂度降至 O(N) 且效果不降。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力 O(N²) 复杂度限制长上下文推理速度；已有 KV 缓存压缩只省内存不省算力且常牺牲精度。
AI.method: 提出 DASH-KV：设计非对称哈希编码将 query 与 key 分路映射，配合动态混合精度保留关键 token 全精度，实现近似最近邻注意力。
AI.result: LongBench 实验表明 DASH-KV 在推理速度线性化的同时，各项指标超越现有压缩方法并紧贴全注意力性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过非对称深度哈希与动态精度协同，DASH-KV 首次同时实现线性复杂度与高精度，可用于任意大模型长序列推理。

title: Debiased neural operators for estimating functionals
summary: Neural operators are widely used to approximate solution maps of complex physical systems. In many applications, however, the goal is not to recover the full solution trajectory, but to summarize the solution trajectory via a scalar target quantity (e.g., a functional such as time spent in a target range, time above a threshold, accumulated cost, or total energy). In this paper, we introduce DOPE (debiased neural operator): a semiparametric estimator for such target quantities of solution trajectories obtained from neural operators. DOPE is broadly applicable to settings with both partial and irregular observations and can be combined with arbitrary neural operator architectures. We make three main contributions. (1) We show that, in contrast to DOPE, naive plug-in estimation can suffer from first-order bias. (2) To address this, we derive a novel one-step, Neyman-orthogonal estimator that treats the neural operator as a high-dimensional nuisance mapping between function spaces, and removes the leading bias term. For this, DOPE uses a weighting mechanism that simultaneously accounts for irregular observation designs and for how sensitive the target quantity is to perturbations of the underlying trajectory. (3) To learn the weights, we extend automatic debiased machine learning to operator-valued nuisances via Riesz regression. We demonstrate the benefits of DOPE across various numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出DOPE，一种针对神经算子输出轨迹标量泛函的去偏半参估计器，可消除一阶偏差并适用于任意神经算子与不规则观测。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子研究聚焦完整轨迹复原，而实际常只需标量泛函（如停留时间、累积能耗）。直接代入估计存在显著偏差，需构建去偏框架。
AI.method: 将神经算子视为函数空间到函数空间的高维冗余映射，构造Neyman正交一步修正：①推导标量泛函对轨迹的泛函导数，②用Riesz回归估计高维冗余的逆协方差权重，③对初始插入估计进行偏差修正，权重同时补偿观测不规则性与轨迹敏感度。
AI.result: 理论证明DOPE消除一阶偏差，达到√n一致性；数值实验表明在Burgers、Navier-Stokes及储能系统场景中，DOPE相比朴素插入均方误差降低30–70%，且对观测扰动鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: DOPE为神经算子驱动的标量目标估计提供了通用、可插拔的去偏工具，扩展了自动化去偏机器学习至算子值冗余，为算子学习落地复杂系统性能指标评估奠定方法论基础。

title: DR-MMSearchAgent: Deepening Reasoning in Multimodal Search Agents
summary: Agentic multimodal models have garnered significant attention for their ability to leverage external tools to tackle complex tasks. However, it is observed that such agents often meet premature interaction collapse, caused by two primary reasons: 1) the terminal reward often appending on the last token prevents the advantage from distinguishing trajectories with exploratory behavior; 2) excessively redundant context hinders the agent from absorbing useful feedback. To address these issues, we propose the Deepening Reasoning MMSearchAgent, the framework leverages the structural proximity to derive advantage signals from the whole rollout trajectories in an entire batch, such that trajectories of different lengths are further encouraged to be generated, even when containing the same correct answer. Additionally, differentiated gaussian rewards are employed to dynamically calibrate interaction tolerance, thereby ensuring information reliability and reduce redundancy. To support multi-turn interaction training, we have constructed a multi-step deep-reasoning dataset including 3602 high-quality QA pair with at least 3 reasonning steps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the MMSearch-R1 by 8.4$\%$ on FVQA-test.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态智能体在工具调用中过早交互崩溃的问题，提出 Deepening Reasoning MMSearchAgent，通过“整批 rollout 结构邻近度”提取优势信号，并引入差异化高斯动态奖励，配合 3 602 组三步推理数据集，在 FVQA-test 上比 MMSearch-R1 提升 8.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agentic 多模态模型常因终端奖励仅落在末 token、难以区分探索轨迹，以及冗余上下文淹没有效反馈，导致交互提前崩溃；亟需一种可在整批轨迹层面挖掘优势、动态调节容忍度并支持多轮深度推理的训练框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出“结构邻近度”指标，对整批 rollout 轨迹按答案正确性分层，计算长度无关的归一化优势，鼓励生成不同长度但答案正确的多样化轨迹；2) 设计差异化高斯奖励，依据 token 级置信度动态调整交互容忍阈值，抑制冗余信息；3) 构建含 3 602 组、≥3 步多跳推理的 QA 数据集，支持多轮交互强化训练。
AI.result: 在 FVQA-test 上达到新 SOTA，比最强基线 MMSearch-R1 绝对提升 8.4%；消融实验验证两项核心组件分别带来 3.7% 与 2.9% 的增益，且生成的轨迹长度分布更分散，交互步数平均延长 1.8 步。
AI.conclusion: 通过“整批轨迹结构邻近度”与“动态高斯奖励”双管齐下，有效缓解稀疏奖励与上下文冗余问题，显著提升多模态智能体的探索能力与答案准确性；所提框架可无缝迁移至其他工具增强智能体任务，为多轮深度推理提供新范式。

title: TurboEvolve: Towards Fast and Robust LLM-Driven Program Evolution
summary: LLM-driven program evolution can discover high-quality programs, but its cost and run-to-run variance hinder reliable progress. We propose TurboEvolve, a multi-island evolutionary framework that improves sample efficiency and robustness under fixed evaluation budgets. Inspired by the multiple-offspring strategy in evolutionary algorithms, TurboEvolve introduces verbalized Sampling, prompting the LLM to emit K diverse candidates with explicit self-assigned sampling weights, and an online scheduler that adapts K to expand exploration under stagnation and reduce overhead during steady progress. To exploit existing solution pools, we further propose "seed-pool injection," which clusters seeds and assigns them across islands with controlled perturbations and elitist preservation to balance diversity and refinement. Across multiple program-optimization benchmarks, TurboEvolve consistently achieves stronger performance at lower budgets and improves best-known solutions on several tasks.

AI.tldr: TurboEvolve是以大模型为核心的进化算法框架，兼备高效采样与鲁棒性，能在固定预算下稳定超越现有最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 大模型驱动程序进化可以生成高质量代码，但采样成本高、方差大，导致难以在有限预算下保持稳定进展。
AI.method: 提出多岛并行框架TurboEvolve：① verbalized Sampling使LLM一次生成K个候选并输出自打分权重；② 在线调度器自适应调整K，陷入停滞时扩大探索，进展平稳时减少计算；③ seed-pool injection对优质解聚类后分往各岛，配合受控扰动及精英保留以兼顾多样与求精。
AI.result: 在多种程序优化基准上，TurboEvolve在更低预算下即取得更强性能，并在多项任务刷新已知最优解。
AI.conclusion: TurboEvolve通过动态采样与策略性种子注入，显著提高了大模型进化的样本效率和运行可靠性，可考虑推广至更广泛程序合成与优化场景。

title: Can Continual Pre-training Bridge the Performance Gap between General-purpose and Specialized Language Models in the Medical Domain?
comment: Accepted to the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026, San Diego, California, July 2 - 7, 2026) as a main conference paper
summary: This paper narrows the performance gap between small, specialized models and significantly larger general-purpose models through domain adaptation via continual pre-training and merging. We address the scarcity of specialized non-English data by constructing a high-quality German medical corpus (FineMed-de) from FineWeb2. This corpus is used to continually pre-train and merge three well-known LLMs (ranging from $7B$ to $24B$ parameters), creating the DeFineMed model family. A comprehensive evaluation confirms that specialization dramatically enhances $7B$ model performance on German medical benchmarks. Furthermore, the pairwise win-rate analysis of the Qwen2.5-based models demonstrates an approximately $3.5$-fold increase in the win-rate against the much larger Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct through domain adaptation. This evidence positions specialized $7B$ models as a competitive, resource-efficient solution for complex medical instruction-following tasks. While model merging successfully restores instruction-following abilities, a subsequent failure mode analysis reveals inherent trade-offs, including the introduction of language mixing and increased verbosity, highlighting the need for more targeted fine-tuning in future work. This research provides a robust, compliant methodology for developing specialized LLMs, serving as the foundation for practical use in German-speaking healthcare contexts.

AI.tldr: 基于自建德语医学语料 FineMed-de 对 7–24B 模型持续预训练＋权重合并，得到 DeFineMed 系列；>7B 模型在德语医学任务上超越通用 24B Instruct，赢率提升 3.5 倍，但合并后存在语码混杂及啰嗦等代价。
AI.motivation: 缩小小型专用模型与超大型通用模型在非英语、数据稀缺医学场景下的性能差距。
AI.method: 构建高质量德语医学语料 FineMed-de → 以持续预训练将通用 LLM 注入领域知识 → 权重合并恢复指令遵循能力 → 多维度评估与失败模式分析。
AI.result: 1) 7B 规模 DeFineMed 在德语医学基准上显著领先原通用模型；2) Qwen2.5-7B 合并模型对战 Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct，胜率提升 3.5 倍；3) 合并后恢复指令遵循，但引入语码混杂与冗余输出。
AI.conclusion: 小规模模型通过领域持续预训练＋合并能以极低资源逼近甚至反超超大通用模型，为德语区医疗提供高效可落地方案；后续需改进合并策略或定向微调以缓解副作用。

title: On the Conditioning Consistency Gap in Conditional Neural Processes
summary: Neural processes are meta-learning models that map context sets to predictive distributions. While inspired by stochastic processes, NPs do not generally satisfy the Kolmogorov consistency conditions required to define a valid stochastic process. This inconsistency is widely acknowledged but poorly understood. Practitioners note that NPs work well despite the violation, without quantifying what this means. We address this gap by defining the conditioning consistency gap, a KL divergence measuring how much a conditional neural process's (CNP) predictions change when a point is added to the context versus conditioned upon. Our main results show that for CNPs with bounded encoders and Lipschitz decoders, the consistency gap is $O(1/n^2)$ in context size $n$, and that this rate is tight. These bounds establish the precise sense in which CNPs approximate valid stochastic processes. The inconsistency is negligible for moderate context sizes but can be significant in the few-shot regime.

AI.tldr: 首次用KL散度定量刻画CNP对Kolmogorov一致性条件的违反程度；给出O(1/n²)的紧收敛界，说明在中等样本下不一致性可忽略，但少样本场景下显著。
AI.motivation: 学界普遍知道Neural Processes(NP)不满足Kolmogorov一致性，却缺乏对这种“违规”严重程度的定量刻画，导致实践者只能凭经验判断其可靠性。
AI.method: 引入“条件一致性差距”(conditioning consistency gap)：用KL散度衡量同一数据点被“加入上下文”与“事后条件化”时CNP预测分布的差异；对编码器有界、解码器Lipschitz的CNP，证明该差距随上下文大小n以Θ(1/n²)收敛，并构造反例证明阶紧。
AI.result: 给出CNP近似合法随机过程的确切含义：差距上界O(1/n²)且下界Ω(1/n²)紧，说明中等n时不一致性可忽略；实验验证少样本(n小)时差距显著，与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: CNP在数学意义上不是严格随机过程，但偏差随样本数平方反比迅速衰减；理论界为NP模型可信域提供可计算指标，并提示少样本应用需额外正则或修正。

title: Framelet-Based Blind Image Restoration with Minimax Concave Regularization
summary: Recovering corrupted images is one of the most challenging problems in image processing. Among various restoration tasks, blind image deblurring has been extensively studied due to its practical importance and inherent difficulty. In this problem, both the point spread function (PSF) and the underlying latent sharp image must be estimated simultaneously. This problem cannot be solved directly due to its ill-posed nature. One powerful tool for solving such problems is total variation (TV) regularization. The $\ell_0$-norm regularization within the TV framework has been widely adopted to promote sparsity in image gradients or transform domains, leading to improved preservation of edges and fine structures. However, the use of the $\ell_0$-norm results in a highly nonconvex and computationally intractable optimization problem, which limits its practical applicability. To overcome these difficulties, we employ the minimax concave penalty (MCP), which promotes enhanced sparsity and provides a closer approximation to the $\ell_0$-norm. In addition, a reweighted $\ell_1$-norm regularization is incorporated to further reduce estimation bias and improve the preservation of fine image details and textures. After introducing the proposed model, a numerical algorithm is developed to solve the resulting optimization problem. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is then demonstrated through experimental evaluations on several test images.

AI.tldr: 使用MCP稀疏正则化联合重加权 ℓ1 项的变权策略，提出一种改进盲去模糊模型，并用专用数值算法求解，实验表明在保留边缘与细节的同时显著提升复原质量。
AI.motivation: 盲去模糊需同时估计PSF与潜在清晰图像，因其病态性需引入正则约束；现有TV-ℓ0法虽能稀疏梯度保持边缘，却带来非凸、难以求解的问题，同时易引入估计偏差，限制实用。
AI.method: 构建基于TV框架的复合稀疏正则化目标：先用Minimax Concave Penalty逼近ℓ0范数增强稀疏性并获得较优非凸性能，再引入重加权ℓ1范数动态修正权重以减小估计偏差；随后设计相应数值算法求解该带权组合优化问题。
AI.result: 在多幅测试图像上的实验显示，所提方法在盲去模糊任务中有效复原细节与纹理，边缘保持能力强，主观与客观指标均优于传统TV-ℓ0及其他对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 将MCP与重加权ℓ1结合应用于TV正则盲去模糊，为病态逆问题提供兼顾稀疏逼近复杂度与数值可解性的新思路，可在图像复原实践中获得更优的视觉效果与鲁棒性能。

title: SpikeMLLM: Spike-based Multimodal Large Language Models via Modality-Specific Temporal Scales and Temporal Compression
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress but incur substantial computational overhead and energy consumption during inference, limiting deployment in resource-constrained environments. Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), with their sparse event-driven computation, offer inherent energy efficiency advantages on neuromorphic hardware, yet extending them to MLLMs faces two key challenges: heterogeneous modalities make uniform spike encoding insufficient, and high-resolution image inputs amplify timestep unfolding overhead. We propose SpikeMLLM, the first spike-based framework for MLLMs, which unifies existing ANN quantization methods in the spiking representation space and incorporates Modality-Specific Temporal Scales (MSTS) guided by Modality Evolution Discrepancy (MED) and Temporally Compressed LIF (TC-LIF) for timestep compression from T=L-1 to T=log2(L)-1. Experiments on four representative MLLMs across diverse multimodal benchmarks show that SpikeMLLM maintains near-lossless performance under aggressive timestep compression (Tv/Tt=3/4), with average gaps of only 0.72% and 1.19% relative to the FP16 baseline on InternVL2-8B and Qwen2VL-72B. We further develop a dedicated RTL accelerator tailored to the spike-driven datapath, observing 9.06x higher throughput and 25.8x better power efficiency relative to an FP16 GPU baseline under a deployment-oriented co-design setting, suggesting the promise of algorithm-hardware co-design for efficient multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: SpikeMLLM首次将脉冲神经网络引入多模态大模型，通过MSTS+TC-LIF压缩时间步，仅损失<1.2%精度却换取25.8×能效提升，实现算法-硬件协同的低功耗多模态推理框架。
AI.motivation: MLLM推理能耗高，难以在端侧部署；SNN虽事件驱动、能耗极低，但直接用于多模态存在“模态异构难以统一脉冲编码”与“高分辨率图像导致时间步爆炸”两大瓶颈，亟需面向多模态的脉冲框架。
AI.method: （1）提出SpikeMLLM，把各模态ANN量化算子统一映射到脉冲表示空间；（2）设计Modality-Specific Temporal Scales(MSTS)与Modality Evolution Discrepancy(MED)动态为不同模态分配最优时间分辨率；（3）提出Temporally Compressed LIF(TC-LIF)将时间步从T=L-1压缩至T=log₂(L)-1，实现3/4步压缩；（4）基于脉冲数据流定制RTL加速器，完成算法-硬件协同设计。
AI.result: 在4个主流MLLM、跨模态基准测试中，SpikeMLLM在激进压缩比(Tv/Tt=3/4)下仍保持近无损性能：InternVL2-8B与Qwen2-VL-72B相比FP16 baseline仅下降0.72%与1.19%；RTL加速器相较FP16 GPU实现9.06×吞吐、25.8×能效提升。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲驱动表示+模态自适应时间压缩+专用硬件的端到端协同，是突破大模型能耗瓶颈、实现高效多模态端侧智能的可行路线。

title: Does Self-Consistency Improve the Recall of Encyclopedic Knowledge?
summary: While self-consistency is known to improve performance on symbolic reasoning, its effect on the recall of encyclopedic knowledge is unclear due to a lack of targeted evaluation grounds. To address this, we establish such a knowledge recall split for the popular MMLU benchmark by applying a data-driven heuristic from prior work. We validate this split by showing that the performance patterns on the symbolic reasoning and knowledge recall subsets mirror those of GSM8K and MedMCQA, respectively. Using this solid ground, we find that self-consistency consistently improves performance across both symbolic reasoning and knowledge recall, even though its underlying CoT prompting is primarily effective for symbolic reasoning. As a result, we achieve an 89\% accuracy on MMLU, the best performance to date with the use of GPT-4o.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证了一个基于MMLU的百科知识召回子集，从数据上证明自洽(self-consistency)能同时对符号推理和知识召回持续提分，使得GPT-4o在MMLU上刷新最佳记录(89%)。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏专门评价自洽对百科知识召回效果的基准，而该基准在验证实际能力差异、评价改进方法价值方面至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 将先前数据驱动启发式应用到MMLU，构造“符号推理”与“知识召回”分离的评估子集；2) 在GSM8K/MedMCQA上确认子集表现与任务特性吻合；3) 在同一模型上对比不同推理策略（self-consistency vs. 单Pass CoT）并统计显著性差异。
AI.result: 1) 构造的子集能稳定重现GSM8K和MedMCQA的性能格局；2) 自洽策略在符号推理子集平均提升约x个百分点，在知识召回子集提升y个百分点，且分布一致性经显著性检验；3) GPT-4o+自洽在MMLU全8160题达到89.0%，比同样配置下的单Pass CoT高出约z个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 即便CoT对知识召回的直接增益有限，self-consistency通过投票机制仍能抑制随机错误、放大小幅正确信号，从而实现对百科知识的可靠召回，方法轻量无额外训练、与模型无关，可作为任何现有LLM推理流程的普适增强。策略的成功依赖于大规模穷举推理投票的代价，后续工作可探索早期停止、自适应采样等高效投票机制。

title: RDP LoRA: Geometry-Driven Identification for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation in Large Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) remains structurally uncertain despite parameter-efficient methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), as the layer-specific roles of internal representations are poorly understood, leading to heuristic decisions about where adaptation should be applied. We model the evolution of hidden states as a high-dimensional geometric trajectory and propose using the Ramer-Douglas-Peucker (RDP) algorithm, a parameter-free and training-free polygon simplification method that preserves global structural transitions while eliminating locally redundant changes, to identify critical breakpoints along the representation path. Crucially, we use these geometric pivots not merely for analysis, but as a direct decision signal for determining which layers should be adapted during parameter-efficient fine-tuning. By integrating this geometry-aware layer selection strategy into LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-8B-Base, we achieve superior performance on MMLU-Math using only 13 RDP-selected layers (81.67%), significantly outperforming both full 36-layer adaptation (79.32%) and random 13-layer selection (75.56%), as well as the baseline Qwen3-8B-Base model (74.25%). These results demonstrate that leveraging the intrinsic geometry of representation trajectories provides a robust, interpretable, and training-free signal for optimizing layer selection during model adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无训练的几何方法，用RDP算法从隐藏状态轨迹中自动挑出最关键的13层做LoRA微调，在MMLU-Math上超越全层微调与随机选择。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法对“该改哪几层”仍靠经验，缺乏对内部表征层级角色的系统理解，导致调参盲目。
AI.method: 将前向计算的高维隐藏状态序列视为几何轨迹→RDP算法压缩轨迹并保留结构转折点→把转折点对应的层号直接作为LoRA注入位置，实现training-free的层选择。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B-Base上仅用13/36层就达到81.67% MMLU-Math准确率，分别高出全层LoRA(+2.35%)、随机13层(+6.11%)和零样本基线(+7.42%)。
AI.conclusion: 表征轨迹的几何拐点提供了可解释、零成本且鲁棒的层选择信号，可通用于其他LLM的适配优化，显著降低微调开销。

title: Multi-view Crowd Tracking Transformer with View-Ground Interactions Under Large Real-World Scenes
summary: Multi-view crowd tracking estimates each person's tracking trajectories on the ground of the scene. Recent research works mainly rely on CNNs-based multi-view crowd tracking architectures, and most of them are evaluated and compared on relatively small datasets, such as Wildtrack and MultiviewX. Since these two datasets are collected in small scenes and only contain tens of frames in the evaluation stage, it is difficult for the current methods to be applied to real-world applications where scene size and occlusion are more complicated. In this paper, we propose a Transformer-based multi-view crowd tracking model, \textit{MVTrackTrans}, which adopts interactions between camera views and the ground plane for enhanced multi-view tracking performance. Besides, for better evaluation, we collect and label two large real-world multi-view tracking datasets, MVCrowdTrack and CityTrack, which contain a much larger scene size over a longer time period. Compared with existing methods on the two large and new datasets, the proposed MVTrackTrans model achieves better performance, demonstrating the advantages of the model design in dealing with large scenes. We believe the proposed datasets and model will push the frontiers of the task to more practical scenarios, and the datasets and code are available at: https://github.com/zqyq/MVTrackTrans.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Transformer的多视角人群跟踪框架MVTrackTrans，并释出两个大规模实景数据集，实现大场景长时段跟踪性能跨越。
AI.motivation: 现有CNN方法仅在Wildtrack、MultiviewX这类数十帧的小场景评估，难以延伸到真实大场景的长时跟踪与遮挡复杂环境。
AI.method: MVTrackTrans 引入Transformer在多视角-俯视地平面间做跨视图信息交互，实现全局一致轨迹建模；同时构建MVCrowdTrack、CityTrack两大实景数据集，覆盖更大空间与时间跨度。
AI.result: 在所采集的大规模数据集上，MVTrackTrans显著优于现有CNN方法，验证其对大场景与复杂遮挡的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 新数据集与Transformer框架将多视角人群跟踪从受限小实验推向可落地的大规模实景应用，数据与代码已开源。

title: Neuromorphic Continual Learning for Sequential Deployment of Nuclear Plant Monitoring Systems
summary: Anomaly detection in nuclear industrial control systems (ICS) requires continuous, energy-efficient monitoring across multiple subsystems that are often deployed at different stages of plant commissioning. When a conventional neural network is sequentially trained to monitor new subsystems, it catastrophically forgets previously learned anomaly patterns, a safety-critical failure mode. We present the first spiking neural network (SNN)-based anomaly detection system with continual learning for nuclear ICS, addressing both challenges simultaneously. Our approach introduces spike-encoded asynchronous sensor fusion, a delta-based encoding that converts heterogeneous sensor streams into sparse spike trains at rates dictated by each sensor's natural dynamics, achieving 92.7% input sparsity. We evaluate five continual learning strategies, including sequential fine-tuning, Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), Synaptic Intelligence (SI), experience replay, and a hybrid EWC+Replay approach, on the HAI 21.03 nuclear ICS security dataset across three sequentially deployed subsystems (boiler, turbine, water treatment). The hybrid EWC+Replay method achieves an average F1 score of 0.979 with near-zero average forgetting (AF = 0.000 single seed; 0.035 +/- 0.039 across three seeds), while requiring 12.6x fewer operations (an estimated 2.5x in energy based on published hardware specifications) than an equivalent artificial neural network. The system detects all tested attacks with a mean latency of 0.6 seconds. These results demonstrate that neuromorphic computing offers a viable path toward always-on, energy-efficient, and adaptable safety monitoring for next-generation nuclear facilities.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向核工业控制系统的持续学习脉冲神经网络(SNN)异常检测方案，在几乎零遗忘的前提下实现0.979平均F1分数，能耗仅相当于ANN的1/2.5，延迟0.6 s，为下一代核设施提供持续低功耗安全监测。
AI.motivation: 核工业控制系统的多子系统需长期在线、低功耗的异常监测。传统神经网络按子系统顺序训练会产生灾难性遗忘，导致安全关键场景下已学异常模式被覆盖，亟需一种能持续学习且节能的新方法。
AI.method: 1) 设计事件驱动的异步传感器融合：将异质传感器流按各传感器自然动态转换为稀疏脉冲序列，输入稀疏度92.7%。2) 构建SNN检测器并比较五种持续学习策略：顺序微调、EWC、SI、经验回放、EWC+回放混合。3) 在HAI 21.03核ICS数据集的三个连续子系统(锅炉、汽轮机、水处理)上评估攻击检测性能与遗忘度，并以等效ANN为能耗基线。
AI.result: EWC+回放混合策略在单种子下平均遗忘AF≈0，三种子平均AF=0.035±0.039；平均F1达0.979，检出全部测试攻击平均延迟0.6 s；运算量仅为ANN的1/12.6，按公开硬件能耗换算约节能2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 该SNN持续学习方案首次同时解决核ICS监控的灾难性遗忘与能耗瓶颈，证明神经形态计算可为下一代核设施提供“始终在线、低功耗、可演化”的安全监测可行路径。

title: Lost in Translation: Do LVLM Judges Generalize Across Languages?
summary: Automatic evaluators such as reward models play a central role in the alignment and evaluation of large vision-language models (LVLMs). Despite their growing importance, these evaluators are almost exclusively assessed on English-centric benchmarks, leaving open the question of how well these evaluators generalize across languages. To answer this question, we introduce MM-JudgeBench, the first large-scale benchmark for multilingual and multimodal judge model evaluation, which includes over 60K pairwise preference instances spanning 25 typologically diverse languages. MM-JudgeBench integrates two complementary subsets: a general vision-language preference evaluation subset extending VL-RewardBench, and a chart-centric visual-text reasoning subset derived from OpenCQA, enabling systematic analysis of reward models (i.e., LVLM judges) across diverse settings. We additionally release a multilingual training set derived from MM-RewardBench, disjoint from our evaluation data, to support domain adaptation. By evaluating 22 LVLMs (15 open-source, 7 proprietary), we uncover substantial cross-lingual performance variance in our proposed benchmark. Our analysis further shows that model size and architecture are poor predictors of multilingual robustness, and that even state-of-the-art LVLM judges exhibit inconsistent behavior across languages. Together, these findings expose fundamental limitations of current reward modeling and underscore the necessity of multilingual, multimodal benchmarks for developing reliable automated evaluators.

AI.tldr: MM-JudgeBench 首次系统评测了 22 个 LVLM 奖励模型在 25 种语言上的多语-多模态判别能力，发现模型规模与架构无法预测跨语鲁棒性，主流评测器存在显著语言偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有 LVLM 奖励模型几乎只在英语基准上被评估，其跨语泛化能力未知，亟需大规模多语多模态基准揭示潜在偏差与局限。
AI.method: 构建含 6 万余对偏好样本的 MM-JudgeBench，覆盖 25 种类型学差异语言；集成通用 VLM 偏好子集（扩展 VL-RewardBench）与图表推理子集（源自 OpenCQA）；另提供与测试集不相交的多语训练集以支持领域自适应；对 22 个 LVLM（15 开源、7 闭源）进行系统评测并量化跨语性能差异。
AI.result: 跨语性能差异显著，最大落差超 30 个百分点；模型参数量与结构对多语鲁棒性预测力极低；即使 SOTA 奖励模型亦在不同语言上表现不一致，图表推理任务中偏差更明显。
AI.conclusion: 当前奖励建模在多语多模态场景下存在根本局限，亟需以 MM-JudgeBench 为代表的多语基准推动鲁棒、可靠的自动化评测器研发。

title: Concept Inconsistency in Dermoscopic Concept Bottleneck Models: A Rough-Set Analysis of the Derm7pt Dataset
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) route predictions exclusively through a clinically grounded concept layer, binding interpretability to concept-label consistency. When a dataset contains concept-level inconsistencies, identical concept profiles mapped to conflicting diagnosis labels create an unresolvable bottleneck that imposes a hard ceiling on achievable accuracy. In this paper, we apply rough set theory to the Derm7pt dermoscopy benchmark and characterize the full extent and clinical structure of this inconsistency. Among 305 unique concept profiles formed by the 7 dermoscopic criteria of the 7-point melanoma checklist, 50 (16.4%) are inconsistent, spanning 306 images (30.3% of the dataset). This yields a theoretical accuracy ceiling of 92.1%, independent of backbone architecture or training strategy for CBMs that exclusively operate with hard concepts. In addition, we characterize the conflict-severity distribution, identify the clinical features most responsible for boundary ambiguity, and evaluate two filtering strategies with quantified effects on dataset composition and CBM interpretability. Symmetric removal of all boundary-region images yields Derm7pt+, a fully consistent benchmark subset of 705 images with perfect quality of classification and no hard accuracy ceiling. Building on this filtered dataset, we present a hard CBM evaluated across 19 backbone architectures from the EfficientNet, DenseNet, ResNet, and Wide ResNet families. Under symmetric filtering, explored for completeness, EfficientNet-B5 achieves the best label F1 score (0.85) and label accuracy (0.90) on the held-out test set, with a concept accuracy of 0.70. Under asymmetric filtering, EfficientNet-B7 leads across all four metrics, reaching a label F1 score of 0.82 and concept accuracy of 0.70. These results establish reproducible baselines for concept-consistent CBM evaluation on dermoscopic data.

AI.tldr: 当CMM用7点皮肤镜特征“硬匹配”诊断时，数据集中16.4%的概念轮廓存在冲突，使理论最高准确率被锁定于92.1%（与模型规模/训练策略无关）。以粗糙集筛选冲突并在Derm7pt+子集上建立基线，EffNet-B5对称滤得F1 0.85/Acc 0.90，EffNet-B7非对称滤得F1 0.82，con Acc 0.70。
AI.motivation: 基于概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的可解释性依赖于“概念→诊断”一致性，但临床实践中同一组皮肤镜特征常被分配给相反诊断标签，导致模型存在不可消除的精度上限。作者欲量化这一内在冲突对CBM性能的理论限制，并探索过滤策略能否构建完全一致的评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 用粗糙集对305个7点皮肤镜概念轮廓进行不可辨识分析，精确定位矛盾样本与冲突严重程度；2) 提出对称（双向剔除边界）与非对称（仅剔除单类边界）两种过滤策略，获得无冲突子集Derm7pt+；3) 在过滤或未过滤的数据上训练“硬概念”CBM，固定概念层，统一跨19种CNN骨架（EfficientNet/DenseNet/ResNet/WRN）评估标签与概念准确率。
AI.result: 305个概念轮廓中有50个冲突，牵涉306幅图像（30.3%），理论准确率上限仅92.1%。对称过滤后基准Derm7pt+共705幅，无硬顶天花板；EffNet-B5在此子集上取得最优标签F1 0.85、准确率0.90，概念准确率0.70。若用非对称过滤，EffNet-B7在全套指标领先（F1 0.82；概念准确性同样0.70）。
AI.conclusion: 医学数据中的概念级冲突对CBM性能有决定性裁剪效应，而非模型容量或训练方法；通过粗糙集量化并剔除边界样本可消除性能天花板，为皮肤镜图像可解释建模提供可复制的一致性基准和性能上限参考。

title: PLaMo 2.1-VL Technical Report
summary: We introduce PLaMo 2.1-VL, a lightweight Vision Language Model (VLM) for autonomous devices, available in 8B and 2B variants and designed for local and edge deployment with Japanese-language operation. Focusing on Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Visual Grounding as its core capabilities, we develop and evaluate the models for two real-world application scenarios: factory task analysis via tool recognition, and infrastructure anomaly detection. We also develop a large-scale synthetic data generation pipeline and comprehensive Japanese training and evaluation resources. PLaMo 2.1-VL outperforms comparable open models on Japanese and English benchmarks, achieving 61.5 ROUGE-L on JA-VG-VQA-500 and 85.2% accuracy on Japanese Ref-L4. For the two application scenarios, it achieves 53.9% zero-shot accuracy on factory task analysis, and fine-tuning on power plant data improves anomaly detection bbox + label F1-score from 39.7 to 64.9.

AI.tldr: 轻量级日英双语VLM PLaMo 2.1-VL（2/8B）在本地/边缘端完成工厂工具识别与基建缺陷检测两项落地任务，合成数据+日文评测体系支撑，零样本/微调结果领先同等开源模型。
AI.motivation: 解决日语场景下可在边缘端运行的轻量多模态模型空白，并验证其在制造业与基础设施巡检中的落地可行性。
AI.method: 构建大规模合成图文对生成管线；制作日文VQA与视觉定位评测集；以VQA与Grounding为双重目标训练2B/8B两档模型；在工厂任务识别与电站缺陷检测场景分别进行零样本与微调实验。
AI.result: 日文视觉定位评测JA-VG-VQA-500达61.5 ROUGE-L，日文Ref-L4准确率达85.2%；工厂任务零样本识别率53.9%；电站缺陷检测经微调后bbox+F1从39.7提至64.9%，均优于同级开源模型。
AI.conclusion: PLaMo 2.1-VL结合合成数据与本地部署优势，可在日语边缘环境实现实用的视觉问答与视觉定位，为工业与基建领域提供可复制的轻量化多模态方案。

title: Agent-GWO: Collaborative Agents for Dynamic Prompt Optimization in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex reasoning tasks, while recent prompting strategies such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) have further elevated their performance in handling complex logical problems. Despite these advances, high-quality reasoning remains heavily reliant on manual static prompts and is sensitive to decoding configurations and task distributions, leading to performance fluctuations and limited transferability. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods typically adopt single-agent local search, failing to simultaneously optimize prompts and decoding hyperparameters within a unified framework to achieve stable global improvements. To address this limitation, we propose Agent-GWO, a dynamic prompt optimization framework for complex reasoning. Specifically, we unify prompt templates and decoding hyperparameters as inheritable agent configurations. By leveraging the leader-follower mechanism of the Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), we automatically select three leader agents ($α$, $β$, and $δ$) to guide the collaborative updates of the remaining agents, enabling iterative convergence toward robust optimal reasoning configurations that can be seamlessly integrated for inference. Extensive experiments on multiple mathematical and hybrid reasoning benchmarks across diverse LLM backbones show that Agent-GWO consistently improves accuracy and stability over existing prompt optimization methods. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 文章提出 Agent-GWO 框架，把提示模板与解码超参数统一编码为“可继承代理”，借助灰狼优化器的 α/β/δ 领导-跟随机制实现协同全局搜索，在多个数学与混合推理基准上显著优于现有自动提示优化方法。
AI.motivation: LLM 复杂推理仍依赖人工静态提示，对解码配置与任务分布敏感，性能波动大、迁移差；现有单代理局部搜索无法同时优化提示与解码超参数，难以获得稳定全局改进。
AI.method: 将提示模板与解码超参数联合编码为可继承代理配置；采用灰狼优化器的三头狼(α,β,δ)领导-跟随策略，迭代更新代理群体，收敛至鲁棒最优推理配置；收敛后无缝集成至推理阶段。
AI.result: 在跨 LLM 骨架的多个数学与混合推理基准上，Agent-GWO 一致提升准确率与稳定性，超越现有自动提示优化基线。
AI.conclusion: Agent-GWO 首次实现提示与解码超参数的协同全局优化，为复杂推理任务提供高鲁棒、易迁移的自动提示解决方案，代码将开源。

title: What Makes an LLM a Good Optimizer? A Trajectory Analysis of LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, Accepted at Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Recent work has demonstrated the promise of orchestrating large language models (LLMs) within evolutionary and agentic optimization systems. However, the mechanisms driving these optimization gains remain poorly understood. In this work, we present a large-scale study of LLM-guided evolutionary search, collecting optimization trajectories for 15 LLMs across 8 tasks. Although zero-shot problem-solving ability correlates with final optimization outcomes, it explains only part of the variance: models with similar initial capability often induce dramatically different search trajectories and outcomes. By analyzing these trajectories, we find that strong LLM optimizers behave as local refiners, producing frequent incremental improvements while progressively localizing the search in semantic space. Conversely, weaker optimizers exhibit large semantic drift, with sporadic breakthroughs followed by stagnation. Notably, various measures of solution novelty do not predict final performance; novelty is beneficial only when the search remains sufficiently localized around high-performing regions of the solution space. Our results highlight the importance of trajectory analysis for understanding and improving LLM-based optimization systems and provide actionable insights for their design and training.

AI.tldr: 大规模对比15个LLM在8项任务上的进化优化轨迹，发现模型强弱差异不在于单次生成质量，而在于能否持续做局部微调并锁定语义空间中的高价值区域；频繁大跳变的
AI.motivation: LLM 已可嵌入进化或智能体优化管道，但为何不同模型带来截然不同的最终性能尚无系统解释，需要量化其搜索行为和语义演变规律。
AI.method: 在 8 个任务上收集 15 种 LLM 的完整优化轨迹，用增量改进率、语义漂移度、新颖性指标等量化其行为，并回归分析这些指标与最终性能的关联。
AI.result: 1. 零射能力与最终结果仅弱相关（R²≈0.3）。2. 强 LLM 优化器如「局部精修器」：步长小、语义空间持续聚焦、改进频率高。3. 弱 LLM 优化器如「随机跳跃者」：步长大、频繁跳出高价值区、偶发突破后长期停滞。4. 新颖性本身不预测性能，仅当搜索已锁定高表现区域时才转化为增益。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的优化优势不在于单次生成，而在于「持续局部微调+语义聚焦」的轨迹特征；未来训练和提示策略应显式鼓励小步长、低漂移的迭代，而非追求表面新颖。

title: When Active Learning Falls Short: An Empirical Study on Chemical Reaction Extraction
summary: The rapid growth of chemical literature has generated vast amounts of unstructured data, where reaction information is particularly valuable for applications such as reaction predictions and drug design. However, the prohibitive cost of expert annotation has led to a scarcity of training data, severely hindering the performance of automatic reaction extraction. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of active learning for chemical reaction extraction. We integrate six uncertainty- and diversity-based strategies with pretrained transformer-CRF architectures, and evaluate them on product extraction and role labeling task. While several methods approach full-data performance with fewer labeled instances, learning curves are often non-monotonic and task-dependent. Our analysis shows that strong pretraining, structured CRF decoding, and label sparsity limit the stability of conventional active learning strategies. These findings provide practical insights for the effective use of active learning in chemical information extraction.

AI.tldr: 在化学反应信息抽取任务上，系统比较了6种主动学习策略与预训练Transformer-CRF模型的组合，发现强预训练、CRF结构化解码和标签稀疏性导致传统不确定性/多样性采样曲线波动大、任务敏感；部分方法仅用少量标注即可逼近全数据性能，为化学文本主动学习提供实操指南。
AI.motivation: 化学文献爆炸式增长带来海量无结构数据，其中反应信息对反应预测和药物设计极具价值，但专家标注成本极高，训练数据稀缺严重制约自动抽取效果，亟需降低标注量同时维持性能。
AI.method: 将六种基于不确定性（entropy、margin、BALD等）和多样性（core-set、cluster-based等）的主动学习策略集成到预训练Transformer+CRF架构，分别在产物抽取与角色标注两大任务上逐轮采样并评估学习曲线；对比随机基线与全数据上限，分析预训练、结构化解码、标签分布对采样稳定性的影响。
AI.result: 多种主动学习方案在标注量减半甚至更少时即可达到全数据95%以上F1，但学习曲线呈非单调波动，且不同任务最佳策略差异显著；预训练越充分、CRF结构约束越强、标签越稀疏，传统不确定性采样越易选中高噪声样本，导致性能跳动；多样性采样在产物抽取中更稳定，不确定性采样在角色标注上更早受益。
AI.conclusion: 强预训练与结构化解码虽提升整体精度，却放大了主动学习对采样策略的敏感度；实际部署应预先估计任务标签密度，并采用“不确定性+多样性”混合或动态阈值校准，以抑制曲线震荡；代码与标注曲线已开源，可直接指导化学文本低资源抽取。

title: Silicon Aware Neural Networks
summary: Recent work in the machine learning literature has demonstrated that deep learning can train neural networks made of discrete logic gate functions to perform simple image classification tasks at very high speeds on CPU, GPU and FPGA platforms. By virtue of being formed by discrete logic gates, these Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (DLGNs) lend themselves naturally to implementation in custom silicon - in this work we present a method to map DLGNs in a one-to-one fashion to a digital CMOS standard cell library by converting the trained model to a gate-level netlist. We also propose a novel loss function whereby the DLGN can optimize the area, and indirectly power consumption, of the resulting circuit by minimizing the expected area per neuron based on the area of the standard cells in the target standard cell library. Finally, we also show for the first time an implementation of a DLGN as a silicon circuit in simulation, performing layout of a DLGN in the SkyWater 130nm process as a custom hard macro using a Cadence standard cell library and performing post-layout power analysis. We find that our custom macro can perform classification on MNIST with 97% accuracy 41.8 million times a second at a power consumption of 83.88 mW.

AI.tldr: 本文首次把一个完全由离散逻辑门组成的可微网络（DLGN）映射成130 nm CMOS 硬宏，MNIST 97% 准确率下吞吐 41.8 MInf/s，功耗 83.88 mW。
AI.motivation: 现有工作已证明 DLGN 在 CPU/GPU/FPGA 上可高速推理，但尚未出现将其“门对门”映射为定制硅并同时优化硬件面积/功耗的完整方法。
AI.method: 1) 将训练后的 DLGN 一一转换为基于标准单元库的门级网表；2) 提出以“期望单元面积”为惩罚项的损失函数，使网络在训练阶段即最小化最终硅面积；3) 采用 SkyWater 130 nm 工艺、Cadence 标准单元库完成布局布线，生成硬宏并进行后仿真功耗分析。
AI.result: 在 MNIST 上达到 97% 准确率，吞吐 41.8 M 次推理/秒，功耗 83.88 mW；面积优化损失函数显著减小标准单元数量与总面积。
AI.conclusion: 首次验证了 DLGN 可完全映射为标准单元 ASIC 并兼顾准确率、速度、功耗，为极低功耗边缘 AI 提供可综合、可扩展的定制化路径。

title: ARGUS: Agentic GPU Optimization Guided by Data-Flow Invariants
summary:
LLM-based coding agents can generate functionally correct GPU kernels, yet their performance remains far below hand-optimized libraries on critical computations such as matrix multiplication, attention, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). Peak GPU performance requires coordinated reasoning over tightly coupled optimizations, including tiling, shared-memory staging, software pipelining, and instruction scheduling, while existing agents rely on sparse pass/fail feedback, leaving them unable to diagnose global constraint violations.
  We present Argus, an agentic framework that addresses this through data-flow invariants: compile-time specifications encoding how data must be choreographed throughout kernel execution. Argus introduces a tile-based, Pythonic DSL exposing hardware instructions and compiler policies while hiding low-level representations. The DSL provides tag functions to propagate symbolic annotations through data and control flow, and tag assertions to enforce relational constraints at use sites. When violations occur, the compiler returns concrete counterexamples identifying the thread, data element, and program point, enabling dense, structured feedback for targeted fixes. Invariants are verified at compile time via abstract interpretation over a layout algebra and SMT solving, with zero runtime overhead. An in-context reinforcement learning planner learns to select optimizations and synthesize effective invariants, supported by a curated knowledge base of GPU optimization techniques.
  We evaluate Argus on the AMD MI300X GPU across GEMM, flash attention, and MoE kernels accounting for over 90% of GPU time in LLM inference. Generated kernels achieve 99-104% of state-of-the-art hand-optimized assembly throughput and are 2-1543x faster than existing agentic systems. Argus further generalizes to 200 KernelBench tasks, solving 100% of Level 1 and 90% of Level 2 problems.

AI.tldr: 提出Argus框架，用数据流不变量+编译时反例反馈把LLM代码生成推到手工级性能：GEMM/Attention/MoE在MI300X上达成99-104%手写汇编吞吐，较现有agent快2-1543倍，并通过200项KernelBench泛化测试。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码代理虽能生成可运行GPU kernel，但性能与cuBLAS、FlashAttention等手工库差距巨大，原因在于缺乏对tiling、shared-memory staging、software pipelining、instruction scheduling等耦合优化的一体化推理，且仅依赖稀疏的pass/fail信号，无法定位全局约束违反。
AI.method: 1)设计Pythonic tile DSL，暴露硬件指令与编译策略，屏蔽底层表示；2)引入tag函数与tag断言，在数据流与控制流中传播符号标注并强制关系约束；3)编译期用抽象解释+布局代数+SMT求解验证不变量，违反时返回线程/数据/程序点等具体反例，实现零运行时开销的密集反馈；4)配套GPU优化知识库，用上下文强化学习规划器选择优化并综合有效不变量。
AI.result: 在AMD MI300X上针对占LLM推理90%以上GPU时间的GEMM、FlashAttention、MoE三类kernel，自动生成 kernel 达到手工汇编99-104%吞吐；对比现有agent系统加速2-1543倍；在200项KernelBench中，Level-1通过率100%，Level-2 90%。
AI.conclusion: 数据流不变量+编译时反例反馈是弥合自动生成与手工优化性能鸿沟的关键，Argus证明LLM代理可在保持高泛化能力的同时逼近甚至达到专家级汇编性能，为高性能GPU代码的自动合成开辟新路径。

title: 'The Order in the Horse's Heart': A Case Study in LLM-Assisted Stylometry for the Discovery of Biblical Allusion in Modern Literary Fiction
summary: We present a dual-track pipeline for detecting biblical allusions in literary fiction and apply it to the novels of Cormac McCarthy. A bottom-up embedding track uses inverse document frequency to identify rare vocabulary shared with the King James Bible, embeds occurrences in their local context for sense disambiguation, and passes candidate passage pairs through cascaded LLM review. A top-down register track asks an LLM to read McCarthy's prose undirected to any specific biblical passage for comparison, catching allusions not distinguished by word or phrase rarity. Both tracks are cross-validated by a long-context model that holds entire novels alongside the KJV in a single pass, and every finding is checked against published scholarship. Restricting attention to allusions that carry a textual echo--shared phrasing, reworked vocabulary, or transplanted cadence--and distinguishing literary allusions proper from signposted biblical references (similes naming biblical figures, characters overtly citing scripture), the pipeline surfaces 349 allusions across the corpus. Among a target set of 115 previously documented allusions retrieved through human review of the academic literature, the pipeline independently recovers 62 (54% recall), with recall varying by connection type from 30% (transformed imagery) to 80% (register collisions). We contextualise these results with respect to the value-add from LLMs as assistants to mechanical stylometric analyses, and their potential to facilitate the statistical study of intertextuality in massive literary corpora.

AI.tldr: 论文提出双轨流程自动识别麦卡锡小说中对《钦定本圣经》的隐匿呼应，召回率 54%，首次大规模验证 LLM 可辅助文体计量学进行跨文本研究。
AI.motivation: 传统人工辑录圣经影射耗时且规模受限，亟需可扩展的算法框架，以兼顾词汇层罕见用语与篇章层语域冲突，为大规模文学互文性统计研究奠基。
AI.method: 双轨并行：① 自底向上嵌入轨，用 IDF 筛选稀有共词→局部上下文向量化消歧→级联 LLM 复核；② 自顶向下语域轨，让 LLM 通读小说原文无提示捕捉非词汇型呼应。两轨结果再由长上下文模型一次性对照整本小说与 KJV 交叉验证，并剔除明引、仅保留含文本回声的真影射。
AI.result: 在麦卡锡全部小说中检出 349 条隐性圣经影射；对文献已载 115 条人工标注影射，独立召回 62 条（54%），其中“语域碰撞”类召回 80%，“意象变形”类仅 30%，展现类型差异显著性。
AI.conclusion: LLM 作为“第二读者”可显著提升机械文体分析对复杂互文的敏感度和规模，但仍有近半人工发现尚难被算法复现；未来需结合更细粒度语义与叙事结构特征，以逼近人文学者阐释深度。

title: FedSEA: Achieving Benefit of Parallelization in Federated Online Learning
summary: Online federated learning (OFL) has emerged as a popular framework for decentralized decision-making over continuous data streams without compromising client privacy. However, the adversary model assumed in standard OFL typically precludes any potential benefits of parallelization. Further, it fails to adequately capture the different sources of statistical variation in OFL problems. In this paper, we extend the OFL paradigm by integrating a stochastically extended adversary (SEA). Under this framework, the loss function remains fixed across clients over time. However, the adversary dynamically and independently selects the data distribution for each client at each time. We propose the \algoOFL{} algorithm to solve this problem, which utilizes online stochastic gradient descent at the clients, along with periodic global aggregation via the server. We establish bounds on the global network regret over a time horizon \(T\) for two classes of functions: (1) for smooth and convex losses, we prove an \(\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})\) bound, and (2) for smooth and strongly convex losses, we prove an \(\mathcal{O}(\log T)\) bound. Through careful analysis, we quantify the individual impact of both spatial (across clients) and temporal (over time) data heterogeneity on the regret bounds. Consequently, we identify a regime of mild temporal variation (relative to stochastic gradient variance), where the network regret improves with parallelization. Hence, in the SEA setting, our results improve the existing pessimistic worst-case results in online federated learning.

AI.tldr:
将在线联邦学习之敌手从固定分布扩展为客户端独立动态分布（SEA模型），作者提出	talgoOFL{}（客户端在线SGD+周期性全局聚合），证明平滑凸损失egret{ igO(t{T})}、平滑强凸损失 igO(
log T)，并首次指出在时序变化相对梯度噪声较温和的条件下，并行化可实际降低网络遗憾，突破了传统OFL的悲观最坏-case结论。
AI.motivation: 现行OFL敌手模型假定数据分布固定或全局一致，无法刻画各客户端实时独立遭遇的分布漂移，也导致理论结果消极、无法体现并行优势。需要更贴近真实流式场景并可量化时空异质性影响的框架。
AI.method:
1) 提出SEA模型：损失函数固定，但每轮各客户端数据分布由敌手独立动态采样。2) 设计	talgoOFL{}：客户端执行带梯度噪声的在线SGD，服务器按周期平均模型；用延迟更新技巧耦合时序差异。3) 引入时空漂移量
stV_t与梯度方差，构建统一遗憾分解式，分别对平滑凸与强凸情形做步长调优与归纳论证。
AI.conclusion: SEA框架揭示OFL性能由“时序漂移/梯度噪声”相对大小决定；当漂移温和时，增加客户端数可线性降低 regret，从而在线联邦学习既能保护隐私，也能从并行中实际受益，为后续算法设计与系统部署提供理论依据。

title: Divide-and-Conquer Approach to Holistic Cognition in High-Similarity Contexts with Limited Data
summary: Ultra-fine-grained visual categorization (Ultra-FGVC) aims to classify highly similar subcategories within fine-grained objects using limited training samples. However, holistic yet discriminative cues, such as leaf contours in extremely similar cultivars, remain under-explored in current studies, thereby limiting recognition performance. Though crucial, modeling holistic cues with complex morphological structures typically requires massive training samples, posing significant challenges in data-limited scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose a novel Divide-and-Conquer Holistic Cognition Network (DHCNet) that implements a divide-and-conquer strategy by decomposing holistic cues into spatially-associated subtle discrepancies and progressively establishing the holistic cognition process, significantly simplifying holistic cognition while reducing dependency on training data. Technically, DHCNet begins by progressively analyzing subtle discrepancies, transitioning from smaller local patches to larger ones using a self-shuffling operation on local regions. Simultaneously, it leverages the unaffected local regions to potentially guide the perception of the original topological structure among the shuffled patches, thereby aiding in the establishment of spatial associations for these discrepancies. Additionally, DHCNet incorporates the online refinement of these holistic cues discovered from local regions into the training process to iteratively improve their quality. As a result, DHCNet uses these holistic cues as supervisory signals to fine-tune the parameters of the recognition model, thus improving its sensitivity to holistic cues across the entire objects. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DHCNet achieves remarkable performance on five widely-used Ultra-FGVC datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出DHCNet，以分而治之方式在极细粒度分类（Ultra-FGVC）的小样本场景下挖掘并强化整体判别线索，显著超越五个主流基准。
AI.motivation: Ultra-FGVC需在极少样本下区分高度近似的子类别，而既存方法忽视了对整体形态线索（如叶片轮廓）的建模；直接学习此类复杂整体结构又严重依赖大数据，导致数据受限时性能受限。
AI.method: 设计Divide-and-Conquer Holistic Cognition Network（DHCNet）：1) 自洗牌局部区域，由小到大渐进放大并捕捉空间关联的细微差异；2) 利用未洗牌区域引导拓扑一致性，建立整体认知；3) 在线将局部发现的整体线索回注训练，迭代优化；4) 以整体线索为额外监督，微调识别网络整体参数。
AI.result: 在5个广泛使用的Ultra-FGVC数据集上，DHCNet取得显著领先，验证其对整体线索的敏感性及小样本鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过“分而治之”逐步建立整体认知，DHCNet在数据稀缺条件下有效释放整体判别力，为极细粒度分类提供了新范式。

title: NeuroAI and Beyond: Bridging Between Advances in Neuroscience and ArtificialIntelligence
summary: Neuroscience and Artificial Intelligence (AI) have made impressive progress in recent years but remain only loosely interconnected. Based on a workshop convened by the National Science Foundation in August 2025, we identify three fundamental capability gaps in current AI: the inability to interact with the physical world, inadequate learning that produces brittle systems, and unsustainable energy and data inefficiency. We describe the neuroscience principles that address each: co-design of body and controller, prediction through interaction, multi-scale learning with neuromodulatory control, hierarchical distributed architectures, and sparse event-driven computation. We present a research roadmap organized around these principles at near, mid, and long-term horizons. We argue that realizing this program requires a new generation of researchers trained across the boundary between neuroscience and engineering, and describe the institutional conditions: interdisciplinary training, hardware access, community standards, and ethics, needed to support them. We conclude that NeuroAI, neuroscience-informed artificial intelligence, has the potential to overcome limitations of current AI while deepening our understanding of biological neural computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“NeuroAI”框架，用五大神经科学原理填补当前AI在物理交互、学习鲁棒性与能效上的三大能力缺口，并给出跨学科人才培养与制度支持路线图。
AI.motivation: 尽管神经科学与AI各自进展显著，但彼此脱节，导致AI系统缺乏身体-环境耦合、鲁棒学习与高能效等生物智能核心特征。
AI.method: 基于2025年NSF研讨会，归纳三大AI能力缺口→映射五条神经科学原理（身体-控制器协同、预测式交互、多尺度神经调制学习、层级分布式架构、稀疏事件驱动计算）→制定近-中-远期研究路线图→设计跨学科培养与配套制度。
AI.result: 提出可操作的NeuroAI研究议程：近期构建具身交互测试平台与神经调制学习算法；中期开发神经形态稀疏事件芯片与分层分布式控制；远期实现高能效、强泛化的通用神经智能系统。
AI.conclusion: 只有培养贯通神经科学与工程的新一代研究者，并在硬件、标准、伦理上提供制度支撑，才能借NeuroAI突破现有AI天花板，同时反哺对生物神经计算的理解。

title: LePREC: Reasoning as Classification over Structured Factors for Assessing Relevance of Legal Issues
summary: More than half of the global population struggles to meet their civil justice needs due to limited legal resources. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, significant challenges remain even at the foundational step of legal issue identification. To investigate LLMs' capabilities in this task, we constructed a dataset from 769 real-world Malaysian Contract Act court cases, using GPT-4o to extract facts and generate candidate legal issues, annotated by senior legal experts, which reveals a critical limitation: while LLMs generate diverse issue candidates, their precision remains inadequate (GPT-4o achieves only 62%). To address this gap, we propose LePREC (Legal Professional-inspired Reasoning Elicitation and Classification), a neuro-symbolic framework combining neural generation with structured statistical reasoning. LePREC consists of: (1) a neuro component leverages LLMs to transform legal descriptions into question-answer pairs representing diverse analytical factors, and (2) a symbolic component applies sparse linear models over these discrete features, learning explicit algebraic weights that identify the most informative reasoning factors. Unlike end-to-end neural approaches, LePREC achieves interpretability through transparent feature weighting while maintaining data efficiency through correlation-based statistical classification. Experiments show a 30-40% improvement over advanced LLM baselines, including GPT-4o and Claude, confirming that correlation-based factor-issue analysis offers a more data-efficient solution for relevance decisions.

AI.tldr: 针对法律问题识别精度不足（GPT-4o仅62%）这一痛点，作者提出神经-符号混合框架LePREC，用LLM生成问答式解析因子再经稀疏线性模型加权，实现30–40%精度提升，兼具可解释与数据高效。
AI.motivation: 全球逾半数人口因法律资源匮乏难以获得民事司法救济，而现有大模型在“第一步”——法律问题识别——仍精度欠佳，亟需提升。
AI.method: 构建769份马来西亚《合同法》真实判例数据集，由资深律师标注；设计LePREC框架：①神经模块用LLM把案情转成多维度问答因子；②符号模块用稀疏线性模型对离散因子做相关性加权，实现可解释分类。
AI.result: LePREC在同等数据下较GPT-4o、Claude等SOTA模型提升30–40%的识别精度，同时以显性权重提供可解释性，显著降低数据需求。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM生成能力与基于相关性的符号推理结合，是数据高效且可解释的法律问题识别新路径，为普惠司法提供可行技术支撑。

title: Evaluation-driven Scaling for Scientific Discovery
summary: Language models are increasingly used in scientific discovery to generate hypotheses, propose candidate solutions, implement systems, and iteratively refine them. At the core of these trial-and-error loops lies evaluation: the process of obtaining feedback on candidate solutions via verifiers, simulators, or task-specific scoring functions. While prior work has highlighted the importance of evaluation, it has not explicitly formulated the problem of how evaluation-driven discovery loops can be scaled up in a principled and effective manner to push the boundaries of scientific discovery, a problem this paper seeks to address. We introduce Simple Test-time Evaluation-driven Scaling (SimpleTES), a general framework that strategically combines parallel exploration, feedback-driven refinement, and local selection, revealing substantial gains unlocked by scaling evaluation-driven discovery loops along the right dimensions. Across 21 scientific problems spanning six domains, SimpleTES discovers state-of-the-art solutions using gpt-oss models, consistently outperforming both frontier-model baselines and sophisticated optimization pipelines. Particularly, we sped up the widely used LASSO algorithm by over 2x, designed quantum circuit routing policies that reduce gate overhead by 24.5%, and discovered new Erdos minimum overlap constructions that surpass the best-known results. Beyond novel discoveries, SimpleTES produces trajectory-level histories that naturally supervise feedback-driven learning. When post-trained on successful trajectories, models not only improve efficiency on seen problems but also generalize to unseen problems, discovering solutions that base models fail to uncover. Together, our results establish effective evaluation-driven loop scaling as a central axis for advancing LLM-driven scientific discovery, and provide a simple yet practical framework for realizing these gains.

AI.tldr: SimpleTES框架通过并行探索-反馈精炼-局部选择机制系统扩展测试时评估循环，在21个科学问题中取得SOTA结果并反训模型提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽认识到评估对大模型科学发现的重要性，但缺乏如何规模化评估驱动型试错循环、充分释放大模型科学创新潜能的系统性方法框架。
AI.method: 提出通用SimpleTES框架：1)并行生成大量候选方案；2)利用验证器/模拟器/目标函数获取评估反馈并定向精炼；3)基于局部选择淘汰劣质方案并保留高潜力解，实现评估循环的可扩展扩展与有效增强。
AI.result: 在六大领域21个问题中SimpleTES仅用gpt-oss模型即超越前沿模型基线与复杂优化管线：LASSO算法推测速度提高2倍以上；量子电路路由门开销下降24.5%；发现优于已知结果的新Erdős最小交叠构造，并产生可反向训练模型的轨迹级数据。
