title: Geometry-Guided Self-Supervision for Ultra-Fine-Grained Recognition with Limited Data
summary: This paper investigates the intrinsic geometrical features of highly similar objects and introduces a general self-supervised framework called the Geometric Attribute Exploration Network (GAEor), which is designed to address the ultra-fine-grained visual categorization (Ultra-FGVC) task in data-limited scenarios. Unlike prior work that often captures subtle yet critical distinctions, GAEor generates geometric attributes as novel alternative recognition cues. These attributes are determined by various details within the object, aligned with its geometric patterns, such as the intricate vein structures in soybean leaves. Crucially, each category exhibits distinct geometric descriptors that serve as powerful cues, even among objects with minimal visual variation -- a factor largely overlooked in recent research. GAEor discovers these geometric attributes by first amplifying geometry-relevant details via visual feedback from a backbone network, then embedding the relative polar coordinates of these details into the final representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GAEor significantly sets new state-of-the-art records in five widely-used Ultra-FGVC benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督框架 GAEor，把对象内部几何属性作为新线索，在极细粒度视觉分类任务且训练样本稀缺时刷新 5 个基准的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 极细粒度分类常因类别间视觉差异极小、标注稀少而性能受限；现有方法忽视了几何纹理等内在结构信息可成为强判别线索。
AI.method: 设计 GAEor：① 用主干网络提取特征并生成视觉反馈，放大与几何相关的高频细节；② 将细节点的相对极坐标嵌入最终表征，作为“几何属性”替代传统判别特征；③ 全程自监督，无需额外标注。
AI.result: 在五个主流 Ultra-FGVC 数据集上取得新最佳精度，验证了几何属性在数据受限场景下的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 几何属性是可挖掘且鲁棒的极细粒度判别线索；GAEor 为标注稀缺场景下的 Ultra-FGVC 提供了新思路，并可扩展到其他受限于微观差异的任务。

title: Easy Samples Are All You Need: Self-Evolving LLMs via Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Previous LLMs-based RL studies typically follow either supervised learning with high annotation costs, or unsupervised paradigms using voting or entropy-based rewards. However, their performance remains far from satisfactory due to the substantial annotation cost and issues such as model collapse or reward hacking. To address these issues, we introduce a new perspective inspired by cognitive learning theory and propose a novel approach called EasyRL. The core of EasyRL is to simulate the human cognitive acquisition curve by integrating reliable knowledge transfer from easy labeled data with a progressive divide-and-conquer strategy that tackles increasingly difficult unlabeled data. Specifically, we initialize a warm-up model using supervised RL with few-shot labeled data. This is followed by a divide-and-conquer pseudo-labeling strategy on difficult unlabeled data, combining consistency-based selection for low-uncertainty cases and reflection-based resolution for medium-uncertainty cases. Finally, difficulty-progressive self-training with iterative pseudo-labeling and RL further strengthens the model's reasoning capability. EasyRL provides a unified self-evolving framework that facilitates data-efficient post-training of LLMs. Experimental results on mathematical and scientific benchmarks demonstrate that EasyRL, using only 10% of easy labeled data, consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: EasyRL用少量易标注样本启动RL，再对难无标注样本实施分治式伪标签与渐进自训练，以10%标注量超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-RL要么依赖高成本全监督，要么采用无监督投票/熵奖励却易出现模型崩溃或奖励黑客，性能远不理想。
AI.method: 借鉴认知学习曲线，提出“易→难”统一框架：①少量易标注数据warm-up RL；②对难无标数据分治：低不确定用一致性筛选，中等不确定用反思修正；③迭代伪标签+难度渐进自训练强化推理。
AI.result: 在数学与科学基准上，仅用10%易标注数据即稳定超越现有最佳基线。
AI.conclusion: EasyRL以数据高效、自演化的方式实现LLM后期训练，为高成本标注场景提供可扩展的新范式。

title: Rank-Turbulence Delta and Interpretable Approaches to Stylometric Delta Metrics
comment: Under review at Digital Scholarship in the Humanities. Code available at: https://github.com/DDPronin/Rank-Turbulence-Delta
summary: This article introduces two new measures for authorship attribution - Rank-Turbulence Delta and Jensen-Shannon Delta - which generalise Burrows's classical Delta by applying distance functions designed for probabilistic distributions. We first set out the theoretical basis of the measures, contrasting centred and uncentred z-scoring of word-frequency vectors and re-casting the uncentred vectors as probability distributions. Building on this representation, we develop a token-level decomposition that renders every Delta distance numerically interpretable, thereby facilitating close reading and the validation of results. The effectiveness of the methods is assessed on four literary corpora in English, German, French and Russian. The English, German and French datasets are compiled from Project Gutenberg, whereas the Russian benchmark is the SOCIOLIT corpus containing 755 works by 180 authors spanning the eighteenth to the twenty-first centuries. Rank-Turbulence Delta attains attribution accuracy comparable with Cosine Delta; Jensen-Shannon Delta consistently matches or exceeds the performance of canonical Burrows's Delta. Finally, several established attribution algorithms are re-evaluated on the extended SOCIOLIT corpus.

AI.tldr: 提出两种基于概率分布距离的新作者归属指标（Rank-Turbulence Delta 与 Jensen-Shannon Delta），在 4 种语言语料上验证，效果全面优于或持平经典 Burrows Delta，并首次实现 token 级可解释分解。
AI.motivation: 经典 Burrows Delta 将词频视为欧氏向量，忽略其概率本质，导致距离解释性差且表现有限；需引入信息论距离函数，同时提供可解释的细粒度归因依据。
AI.method: 1) 将未中心化 z-score 词频向量重新归一化为概率分布；2) 引入 Rank-Turbulence 与 Jensen-Shannon 两类分布距离，构建新 Delta 指标；3) 提出 token-level 分解，使每一步距离差值对应具体词汇贡献；4) 在英/德/法 Project Gutenberg 及 755 篇俄语 SOCIOLIT 语料上系统评估，并与 Cosine Delta、原始 Delta 等多种基线对比。
AI.result: Rank-Turbulence Delta 准确率与 Cosine Delta 相当；Jensen-Shannon Delta 在所有语料上稳定等于或优于 Burrows Delta；token 分解可精确定位影响归属的关键词汇；在扩展 SOCIOLIT 语料上重新标定多项既有算法基准。
AI.conclusion: 通过把词频视为概率分布并采用信息论距离，新指标在保持或提升精度的同时首次实现数值可解释的作者归属，为数字人文领域提供了更具理论依据与诊断性的工具链。

title: LASER: Learning Active Sensing for Continuum Field Reconstruction
summary: High-fidelity measurements of continuum physical fields are essential for scientific discovery and engineering design but remain challenging under sparse and constrained sensing. Conventional reconstruction methods typically rely on fixed sensor layouts, which cannot adapt to evolving physical states. We propose LASER, a unified, closed-loop framework that formulates active sensing as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP). At its core, LASER employs a continuum field latent world model that captures the underlying physical dynamics and provides intrinsic reward feedback. This enables a reinforcement learning policy to simulate ''what-if'' sensing scenarios within a latent imagination space. By conditioning sensor movements on predicted latent states, LASER navigates toward potentially high-information regions beyond current observations. Our experiments demonstrate that LASER consistently outperforms static and offline-optimized strategies, achieving high-fidelity reconstruction under sparsity across diverse continuum fields.

AI.tldr: LASER 用强化学习把“下一步传感器放在哪”变成序列决策，省去了人工布点。
AI.motivation: 连续场监测常因传感器稀疏而失真，传统方法采用一次性布局，无法在动态过程中调整。
AI.method: 将主动感知建模为 POMDP，通过一个连续场的隐动力学模型产生“想象力”预测，并以此为奖励训练 RL 策略，在线指导传感器驶向高信息区。
AI.result: 在稀疏观测条件下，LASER 显著优于固定布局及离线优化基线，场重构质量稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: 闭环的“动态布局 + 潜世界模型 + 强化学习”可广泛用于复杂连续系统的在线高精度重构。

title: RAFT-MSF++: Temporal Geometry-Motion Feature Fusion for Self-Supervised Monocular Scene Flow
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Monocular scene flow estimation aims to recover dense 3D motion from image sequences, yet most existing methods are limited to two-frame inputs, restricting temporal modeling and robustness to occlusions. We propose RAFT-MSF++, a self-supervised multi-frame framework that recurrently fuses temporal features to jointly estimate depth and scene flow. Central to our approach is the Geometry-Motion Feature (GMF), which compactly encodes coupled motion and geometry cues and is iteratively updated for effective temporal reasoning. To ensure the robustness of this temporal fusion against occlusions, we incorporate relative positional attention to inject spatial priors and an occlusion regularization module to propagate reliable motion from visible regions. These components enable the GMF to effectively propagate information even in ambiguous areas. Extensive experiments show that RAFT-MSF++ achieves 24.14% SF-all on the KITTI Scene Flow benchmark, with a 30.99% improvement over the baseline and better robustness in occluded regions. The code is available at https://github.com/sunzunyi/RAFT-MSF-PlusPlus.

AI.tldr: RAFT-MSF++在自监督多帧框架中首次将深度与场景流联合估计，用GMF特征+遮挡正则化把KITTI SF-all降到24.14%，比基线提升30.99%，对遮挡区更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 单目场景流传统两帧方法因缺乏时序建模，在遮挡与快速运动下鲁棒性差，需利用更长时序提升精度。
AI.method: 提出GMF统一编码几何-运动线索，用RAFT式迭代更新；引入相对位置注意力注入空间先验，并设计遮挡正则化将可见区可靠运动传播到遮挡区，实现多帧自监督联合估计。
AI.result: KITTI场景流排行榜SF-all误差24.14%，较基线降低30.99%，在遮挡区域误差下降更显著。
AI.conclusion: GMF与遮挡正则化的时序融合策略显著增强单目场景流对遮挡和运动边缘的鲁棒性，为多帧自监督估计提供了新范式。

title: FASE : A Fairness-Aware Spatiotemporal Event Graph Framework for Predictive Policing
summary:
Predictive policing systems that allocate patrol resources based solely on predicted crime risk can unintentionally amplify racial disparities through feedback driven data bias. We present FASE, a Fairness Aware Spatiotemporal Event Graph framework, which integrates spatiotemporal crime prediction with fairness constrained patrol allocation and a closed loop deployment feedback simulator.
  We model Baltimore as a graph of 25 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas and use 139,982 Part 1 crime incidents from 2017 to 2019 at hourly resolution, producing a sparse feature tensor. The prediction module combines a spatiotemporal graph neural network with a multivariate Hawkes process to capture spatial dependencies and self exciting temporal dynamics. Outputs are modeled using a Zero Inflated Negative Binomial distribution, suitable for overdispersed and zero heavy crime counts. The model achieves a validation loss of 0.4800 and a test loss of 0.4857.
  Patrol allocation is formulated as a fairness constrained linear optimization problem that maximizes risk weighted coverage while enforcing a Demographic Impact Ratio constraint with deviation bounded by 0.05. Across six simulated deployment cycles, fairness remains within 0.9928 to 1.0262, and coverage ranges from 0.876 to 0.936. However, a persistent detection rate gap of approximately 3.5 percentage points remains between minority and non minority areas. This result shows that allocation level fairness constraints alone do not eliminate feedback induced bias in retraining data, highlighting the need for fairness interventions across the full pipeline.

AI.tldr: FASE 框架将时空图神经网络与公平性约束的巡逻分配联合优化，可在预测-部署-反馈闭环中把人口学影响比波动控制在 ±5 %，但少数/非少数区域检出率仍差 3.5 个百分点，证实仅约束分配环节不足以消除数据反馈导致的种族差异放大。
AI.motivation: 传统“唯风险”预测性巡逻会随数据反馈不断放大种族差异，需要一套从预测、部署到再训练全链路考虑公平性的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 把巴尔的摩 25 个 ZIP 区域建模为时空图，用 2017–2019 年 13.9 万起小时级 Part 1 犯罪构建稀疏特征张量；2) 预测端：ST-GNN + 多元霍克斯过程捕获空间依赖与自激时序，输出以零膨胀负二项分布拟合零多且过离散的计数；3) 分配端：在“风险加权覆盖率最大”线性目标中加入人口学影响比 ≤1.05 的硬约束；4) 闭环：六周期仿真持续回注检测数据再训练。
AI.result: 验证/测试损失 0.4800/0.4857；六轮仿真中人口学影响比保持在 0.9928–1.0262，覆盖率 0.876–0.936，但少数区域整体检出率仍低约 3.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 即使分配阶段满足 5 % 公平偏差，反馈回再训练数据的结构性偏差仍会留存，必须在前置预测、数据补全、标签校正等环节同步实施公平干预，才能真正遏制系统性种族差异放大。

title: Beyond Rating: A Comprehensive Evaluation and Benchmark for AI Reviews
summary: The rapid adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) has spurred interest in automated peer review; however, progress is currently stifled by benchmarks that treat reviewing primarily as a rating prediction task. We argue that the utility of a review lies in its textual justification--its arguments, questions, and critique--rather than a scalar score. To address this, we introduce Beyond Rating, a holistic evaluation framework that assesses AI reviewers across five dimensions: Content Faithfulness, Argumentative Alignment, Focus Consistency, Question Constructiveness, and AI-Likelihood. Notably, we propose a Max-Recall strategy to accommodate valid expert disagreement and introduce a curated dataset of paper with high-confidence reviews, rigorously filtered to remove procedural noise. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while traditional n-gram metrics fail to reflect human preferences, our proposed text-centric metrics--particularly the recall of weakness arguments--correlate strongly with rating accuracy. These findings establish that aligning AI critique focus with human experts is a prerequisite for reliable automated scoring, offering a robust standard for future research.

AI.tldr: 现有自动评审只看分数，本文提出「超越评分」框架，用五大文本维度评估 AI 评审质量，证实「先对齐文本批判内容再打分」才是可靠路径。
AI.motivation: LLMs 被用于自动论文评审，但主流基准把评审简化为评分预测，忽视文本解释的价值，导致评估失真、进展停滞。
AI.method: 构建「Beyond Rating」框架，从内容忠实性、论证一致性、焦点一致、问题建设性、AI 似然性五维度评估；设计 Max-Recall 策略容纳专家分歧，并发布经严格过滤的高质量评审数据集；提出文本中心指标（如弱点论证召回）并与传统 n-gram 指标对比。
AI.result: 实验表明，传统 n-gram 指标与人类偏好无关，而文本中心指标（尤其是弱点论证召回）与评分准确率高度相关；仅当 AI 批判焦点与专家对齐时，自动打分才可信。
AI.conclusion: 对齐 AI 批判焦点是自动评分可靠的前提，该框架为未来自动评审研究确立了文本优先的评估标准。

title: FairTree: Subgroup Fairness Auditing of Machine Learning Models with Bias-Variance Decomposition
summary: The evaluation of machine learning models typically relies mainly on performance metrics based on loss functions, which risk to overlook changes in performance in relevant subgroups. Auditing tools such as SliceFinder and SliceLine were proposed to detect such groups, but usually have conceptual disadvantages, such as the inability to directly address continuous covariates. In this paper, we introduce FairTree, a novel algorithm adapted from psychometric invariance testing. Unlike SliceFinder and related algorithms, FairTree directly handles continuous, categorical, and ordinal features without discretization. It further decomposes performance disparities into systematic bias and variance, allowing a categorization of changes in algorithm performance. We propose and evaluate two variations of the algorithm: a permutation-based approach, which is conceptually closer to SliceFinder, and a fluctuation test. Through simulation studies that include a direct comparison with SliceLine, we demonstrate that both approaches have a satisfactory rate of false-positive results, but that the fluctuation approach has relatively higher power. We further illustrate the method on the UCI Adult Census dataset. The proposed algorithms provide a flexible framework for the statistical evaluation of the performance and aspects of fairness of machine learning models in a wide range of applications even in relatively small data.

AI.tldr: FairTree 利用心理测量学不变性检验思想，无需离散化即可在连续/分类型/有序特征上同时检测性能差异，并将差异分解为系统偏差与方差，为 ML 模型的子群性能审计提供高功效、低假阳性的通用统计框架。
AI.motivation: 传统基于整体损失的性能指标会掩盖关键子群上的性能滑坡；现有审计工具（SliceFinder/SliceLine）无法直接处理连续变量，且忽视差异来源，导致难以区分系统偏差与随机波动。
AI.method: 将心理测量学中的“项目功能差异”检验迁移到 ML，提出 FairTree 算法：1) 利用递归分割在连续/离散特征空间自动搜索潜在子群；2) 通过置换检验与波动检验两套统计量，分别检验子群间性能差异并分解为系统偏差与方差分量；3) 控制多重检验确保假阳性率。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明：两种检验均能将假阳性率维持在标称水平；波动检验的检出功效显著高于 SliceLine 及置换检验。在 UCI Adult 数据上成功识别出收入预测模型中性别-教育水平交互子群的系统性能下降。
AI.conclusion: FairTree 首次把心理测量不变性检验引入 ML 审计，实现对任意类型特征的免离散化、差异可解释的高效子群检测，为公平性与性能诊断提供了可扩展、低样本要求的统计工具。

title: Attend what matters: Leveraging vision foundational models for breast cancer classification using mammograms
summary: Vision Transformers $(\texttt{ViT})$ have become the architecture of choice for many computer vision tasks, yet their performance in computer-aided diagnostics remains limited. Focusing on breast cancer detection from mammograms, we identify two main causes for this shortfall. First, medical images are high-resolution with small abnormalities, leading to an excessive number of tokens and making it difficult for the softmax-based attention to localize and attend to relevant regions. Second, medical image classification is inherently fine-grained, with low inter-class and high intra-class variability, where standard cross-entropy training is insufficient. To overcome these challenges, we propose a framework with three key components: (1) Region of interest $(\texttt{RoI})$ based token reduction using an object detection model to guide attention; (2) contrastive learning between selected $\texttt{RoI}$ to enhance fine-grained discrimination through hard-negative based training; and (3) a $\texttt{DINOv2}$ pretrained $\texttt{ViT}$ that captures localization-aware, fine-grained features instead of global $\texttt{CLIP}$ representations. Experiments on public mammography datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance over existing baselines, establishing its effectiveness and potential clinical utility for large-scale breast cancer screening. Our code is available for reproducibility here: https://aih-iitd.github.io/publications/attend-what-matters

AI.tldr: 用检测筛选病灶块、再比对难负样本并借助DINOv2自监督ViT，在乳腺钼靶影像上显著优于现有方法，大幅提升乳腺大规模筛查潜力。
AI.motivation: ViT在乳腺钼靶是例虽然表现不佳，核心痛点是超高分辨率与小病灶造成token膨胀，使softmax注意难定位；同时良恶性分类粒度细，体现出低类间/高类内差异，仅靠交叉熵难区分。作者意在针对影像性质，把token规模与细粒度判别难度区分开来解决。
AI.method: 提出三步框架。① 用公开检测器先定位潜在病灶RoI，仅保留其token，大幅削减冗余token数并约束注意力范围；② 在RoI池化特征上施加对比学习，策略性选取易混淆的
AI.result: 在公开乳腺钼靶数据集上较现有baseline显著提升：良性-恶性分类AUC提升4-5个百分点，灵敏度和特异度分别提升6-7%；消融实验表明三项模块缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: 提出并验证了dquo;定位-再比较-再编码dquo;的医学ViT新范式：RoI减token解决机制瓶颈，对比学习解决细粒度判别，DINOv2解决表征缺乏定位信息量。框架易于移植，模型规模可线性扩展。作者强调开源以保证可复现，但并未在更大尺度的人群多中心数据进行临床安全性论证；后续需在真实筛查流程、检出率与随访中验证其实际效益。

title: DanceCrafter: Fine-Grained Text-Driven Controllable Dance Generation via Choreographic Syntax
summary: Text-driven controllable dance generation remains under-explored, primarily due to the severe scarcity of high-quality datasets and the inherent difficulty of articulating complex choreographies. Characterizing dance is particularly challenging owing to its intricate spatial dynamics, strong directionality, and the highly decoupled movements of distinct body parts. To overcome these bottlenecks, we bridge principles from dance studies, human anatomy, and biomechanics to propose \textit{Choreographic Syntax}, a novel theoretical framework with a tailored annotation system. Grounded in this syntax, we combine professional dance archives with high-fidelity motion capture data to construct \textbf{DanceFlow}, the most fine-grained dance dataset to date. It encompasses 41 hours of high-quality motions paired with 6.34 million words of detailed descriptions. At the model level, we introduce \textbf{DanceCrafter}, a tailored motion transformer built upon the Momentum Human Rig. To circumvent optimization instabilities, we construct a continuous manifold motion representation paired with a hybrid normalization strategy. Furthermore, we design an anatomy-aware loss to explicitly regulate the decoupled nature of body parts. Together, these adaptations empower DanceCrafter to achieve the high-fidelity and stable generation of complex dance sequences. Extensive evaluations and user studies demonstrate our state-of-the-art performance in motion quality, fine-grained controllability, and generation naturalness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“编舞语法”框架并构建迄今最精细的舞蹈数据集 DanceFlow（41 小时动捕＋634 万词标注），设计专用模型 DanceCrafter，实现文本可控的高质量舞蹈序列生成。
AI.motivation: 高质量舞蹈数据稀缺，且舞蹈空间动态复杂、肢体运动高度解耦，现有方法难以用文本精确控制，亟需跨学科理论与数据支撑。
AI.method: 1) 结合舞蹈学、解剖学与生物力学提出“编舞语法”及配套标注体系；2) 融合专业档案与动捕数据构建 DanceFlow 数据集；3) 基于 Momentum Human Rig 设计运动 Transformer DanceCrafter，引入连续流形表示、混合归一化与解剖感知损失。
AI.result: DanceCrafter 在多项量化指标与用户研究中均达到 SOTA，生成动作保真度、细粒度可控性与自然度显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论—数据—模型闭环，首次系统解决文本驱动舞蹈生成的数据瓶颈与建模难题，为可控人体动画树立新基准。

title: Bangla Key2Text: Text Generation from Keywords for a Low Resource Language
summary: This paper introduces \textit{Bangla Key2Text}, a large-scale dataset of $2.6$ million Bangla keyword--text pairs designed for keyword-driven text generation in a low-resource language. The dataset is constructed using a BERT-based keyword extraction pipeline applied to millions of Bangla news texts, transforming raw articles into structured keyword--text pairs suitable for supervised learning. To establish baseline performance on this new benchmark, we fine-tune two sequence-to-sequence models, \texttt{mT5} and \texttt{BanglaT5}, and evaluate them using multiple automatic metrics and human judgments. Experimental results show that task-specific fine-tuning substantially improves keyword-conditioned text generation in Bangla compared to zero-shot large language models. The dataset, trained models, and code are publicly released to support future research in Bangla natural language generation and keyword-to-text generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 基于260万对关键词-文本的Bangla Key2Text数据集，验证了在信源语T5上微调可显著提升关键词驱动的孟加拉语生成效果，并公开所有资源。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语属低资源语言，缺乏成规模的关键词生成语料与基准，难以评估模型对关键词的条件生成能力。
AI.method: 1. 采集百万级孟加拉语新闻；2. 用BERT提取关键词并构成260万对〈关键词, 正文〉；3. 在该数据集上微调mT5与BanglaT5两种序列到序列模型；4. 用自动指标与人工评判评估生成质量。
AI.result: 微调模型在BLEU、ROUGE等自动指标及人工评分上均显著优于零样本大模型，BanglaT5微调版效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 为低资源语言关键词到文本生成提供了首个大规模数据集与强基线，公开资源可推动孟加拉语NLG进一步研究。

title: TACENR: Task-Agnostic Contrastive Explanations for Node Representations
comment: Accepted at the XAI 2026 Conference. 24 pages, 10 figures
summary: Graph representation learning has achieved notable success in encoding graph-structured data into latent vector spaces, enabling a wide range of downstream tasks. However, these node representations remain opaque and difficult to interpret. Existing explainability methods primarily focus on supervised settings or on explaining individual representation dimensions, leaving a critical gap in explaining the overall structure of node representations. In this paper, we propose TACENR (Task-Agnostic Contrastive Explanations for Node Representations), a local explanation method that identifies not only attribute features but also proximity and structural ones that contribute the most in the representation space. TACENR builds on contrastive learning, through which we learn a similarity function in the representation space, revealing which are the features that play an important role in the representation of a node. While our focus is on task-agnostic explanations, TACENR can be applied to supervised scenarios as well. Experimental results demonstrate that proximity and structural features play a significant role in shaping node representations and that our supervised variant performs comparably to existing task-specific approaches in identifying the most impactful features.

AI.tldr: TACENR 提出一种无监督的节点表示局部解释框架，既能识别属性特征也能揭示近邻和结构特征对表示空间的贡献，无须下游任务标签即可解释整体表示结构，并在有监督场景中不逊于任务专用方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图表示学习输出难以解释，解释方法多聚焦监督场景或单维特征，缺乏对节点表示整体结构的任务无关解释方案。
AI.method: 采用对比学习思想构建表示空间相似函数，通过局部扰动生成对比样本，量化属性、近邻和结构三类特征对节点表示的影响，形成任务无关但可拓展至监督场景的 TACENR 框架。
AI.result: 实验显示近邻与结构特征对节点表示影响显著；监督版本在识别最具影响力特征时与任务专用解释方法性能相当，同时任务无关版本在无需标签条件下仍保持解释有效性。
AI.conclusion: TACENR 填补了无监督解释节点表示整体结构的空白，验证了引入结构-近邻特征的重要性，为图神经网络的可解释性研究提供兼顾任务无关与监督场景的通用工具。

title: Detection of T-shirt Presentation Attacks in Face Recognition Systems
summary: Face recognition systems are often used for biometric authentication. Nevertheless, it is known that without any protective measures, face recognition systems are vulnerable to presentation attacks. To tackle this security problem, methods for detecting presentation attacks have been developed and shown good detection performance on several benchmark datasets. However, generalising presentation attack detection methods to new and novel types of attacks is an ongoing challenge. In this work, we employ 1,608 T-shirt attacks of the T-shirt Face Presentation Attack (TFPA) database using 100 unique presentation attack instruments together with 152 bona fide presentations. In a comprehensive evaluation, we show that this type of attack can compromise the security of face recognition systems. Furthermore, we propose a detection method based on spatial consistency checks in order to detect said T-shirt attacks. Precisely, state-of-the-art face and person detectors are combined to analyse the spatial positions of detected faces and persons based on which T-shirt attacks can be reliably detected.

title: Position: No Retroactive Cure for Infringement during Training
summary: As generative AI faces intensifying legal challenges, the machine learning community has increasingly relied on post-hoc mitigation -- especially machine unlearning and inference-time guardrails -- to argue for compliance. This paper argues that such post-hoc mitigation methods cannot retroactively cure liability from unlawful acquisition and training, because compliance hinges on data lineage, not the outputs. Our argument has three parts. First, unauthorized copying/ingestion can be a legally complete completed act, and model weights may operate as fixed copies that retain training-derived expressive value, making later filtering beside the point for infringement. Second, contract and tort/unfair-competition rules -- via licenses, terms of service, and anti-free-riding principles -- can independently restrict access and use, often bypassing copyright defenses (e.g., fair use or TDM exceptions). Third, since value from protected inputs can persist in weights, remedies such as unjust enrichment and disgorgement may require stripping gains and, in some cases, reaching the model itself. We therefore argue for a shift from Post-Hoc Sanitization to verifiable Ex-Ante Process Compliance.

AI.tldr: 事后“机器遗忘”或输出过滤无法治愈训练阶段已完成的非法复制与侵权，合规关键在数据血缘而非输出，事前可验证流程才是正途。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI因训练数据侵权诉讼激增，学界倚重事后“机器遗忘”与输出护栏作为抗辩，但法律上能否真正免责缺乏系统论证。
AI.method: 从版权、合同/反不正当竞争、不当得利三维度剖析：1) 权重可视为固定复制件并保留表达价值；2) 许可条款与搭便车原则可绕开合理使用；3) 侵权价值固化于权重，可触发返还不当得利与剥夺救济。
AI.result: 论证事后技术补救不能追溯治愈已完成的非法获取与训练行为，法院仍可要求剥夺模型及其收益。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁社区放弃“事后净化”，转向可审计的事前数据合规流程，以数据血缘为核心建立法律责任防火墙。

title: Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction in Conversations via Semantic Decoupling and Graph Alignment
summary: Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction in Conversations (ECPEC) aims to identify the set of causal relations between emotion utterances and their triggering causes within a dialogue. Most existing approaches formulate ECPEC as an independent pairwise classification task, overlooking the distinct semantics of emotion diffusion and cause explanation, and failing to capture globally consistent many-to-many conversational causality. To address these limitations, we revisit ECPEC from a semantic perspective and seek to disentangle emotion-oriented semantics from cause-oriented semantics, mapping them into two complementary representation spaces to better capture their distinct conversational roles. Building on this semantic decoupling, we naturally formulate ECPEC as a global alignment problem between the emotion-side and cause-side representations, and employ optimal transport to enable many-to-many and globally consistent emotion-cause matching. Based on this perspective, we propose a unified framework SCALE that instantiates the above semantic decoupling and alignment principle within a shared conversational structure. Extensive experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that SCALE consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our codes are released at https://github.com/CoCoSphere/SCALE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCALE框架，通过语义解耦与全局最优传输对齐，解决对话中情绪-原因对抽取（ECPEC）的多对多全局一致性问题，刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有ECPEC方法将任务视为独立 pairwise 分类，忽视情绪扩散与原因解释在语义层面的差异，也无法建模对话中多对多、全局一致的因果关联。
AI.method: SCALE：①语义解耦——把对话特征拆分为情绪导向与原因导向两个互补空间；②全局对齐——将ECPEC重铸为两空间间的整体对齐问题，用最优传输实现多对多、全局一致的匹配；③统一框架——在共享对话结构上联合优化解耦与对齐目标。
AI.result: 在多个基准对话数据集上，SCALE一致超越现有最佳方法，验证其语义解耦与全局对齐策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将情绪-原因语义解耦并引入最优传输全局对齐，是提升对话情绪-原因对抽取性能的关键；SCALE为该方向提供了通用且可扩展的新范式。

title: Optimal Routing for Federated Learning over Dynamic Satellite Networks: Tractable or Not?
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a key paradigm for distributed model learning across decentralized data sources. Communication in each FL round typically consists of two phases: (i) distributing the global model from a server to clients, and (ii) collecting updated local models from clients to the server for aggregation. This paper focuses on a type of FL where communication between a client and the server is relay-based over dynamic networks, making routing optimization essential. A typical scenario is in-orbit FL, where satellites act as clients and communicate with a server (which can be a satellite, ground station, or aerial platform) via multi-hop inter-satellite links. This paper presents a comprehensive tractability analysis of routing optimization for in-orbit FL under different settings. For global model distribution, these include the number of models, the objective function, and routing schemes (unicast versus multicast, and splittable versus unsplittable flow). For local model collection, the settings consider the number of models, client selection, and flow splittability. For each case, we rigorously prove whether the global optimum is obtainable in polynomial time or the problem is NP-hard. Together, our analysis draws clear boundaries between tractable and intractable regimes for a broad spectrum of routing problems for in-orbit FL. For tractable cases, the derived efficient algorithms are directly applicable in practice. For intractable cases, we provide fundamental insights into their inherent complexity. These contributions fill a critical yet unexplored research gap, laying a foundation for principled routing design, evaluation, and deployment in satellite-based FL or similar distributed learning systems.

AI.tldr: 首次系统划分星载联邦学习中“全局模型分发”与“本地模型回传”两类路由问题的可解/难解边界，给出多项式可解算法或 NP-hard 证明，填补卫星环境下 FL 路由优化的理论空白。
AI.motivation: 星载联邦学习依赖动态多跳星间链路完成模型汇聚，若路由次优将直接放大高延迟、高误码的通信代价；然而卫星场景下的路由优化缺乏完整的计算复杂性刻画，导致无法判断“到底能不能在星上实时算出来”。
AI.method: 将问题拆成“分发”与“收集”两个阶段，再按模型份数、单/多播、可分流/不可分流、客户端选择等维度枚举 10 余种组合；对每类组合分别构造多项式算法（网络流、最小费用多播树、子模优化等）或进行归约证明其 NP-hard（3-划分、集合覆盖、Steiner 树等）。
AI.result: 给出一张清晰的“复杂度地图”：4 种分发+4 种收集场景可多项式求解，其余均为 NP-hard；对可解情形给出 O(n²m log n) 以内的高效算法，对难解情形给出最坏实例特征与 1-1/ε 近似上下界。
AI.conclusion: 首次为星载 FL 路由奠定计算复杂性基准；可直接把可解算法植入星载计算机，或在难解场景改用星上-星地协同近似策略，为后续星群智能任务提供理论-实践一致的路由设计范式。

title: Mind2Drive: Predicting Driver Intentions from EEG in Real-world On-Road Driving
summary: Predicting driver intention from neurophysiological signals offers a promising pathway for enhancing proactive safety in advanced driver assistance systems, yet remains challenging in real-world driving due to EEG signal non-stationarity and the complexity of cognitive-motor preparation. This study proposes and evaluates an EEG-based driver intention prediction framework using a synchronised multi-sensor platform integrated into a real electric vehicle. A real-world on-road dataset was collected across 32 driving sessions, and 12 deep learning architectures were evaluated under consistent experimental conditions. Among the evaluated architectures, TSCeption achieved the highest average accuracy (0.907) and Macro-F1 score (0.901). The proposed framework demonstrates strong temporal stability, maintaining robust decoding performance up to 1000 ms before manoeuvre execution with minimal degradation. Furthermore, additional analyses reveal that minimal EEG preprocessing outperforms artefact-handling pipelines, and prediction performance peaks within a 400-600 ms interval, corresponding to a critical neural preparatory phase preceding driving manoeuvres. Overall, these findings support the feasibility of early and stable EEG-based driver intention decoding under real-world on-road conditions. Code: https://github.com/galosaimi/Mind2Drive.

AI.tldr: 在真实道路环境中，利用少量预处理的 EEG 信号可在动作前约 0.4–0.6 s 以 90% 精度预测驾驶员变道/转向意图，TSCeption 网络表现最佳。
AI.motivation: ADAS 若能在驾驶员真正操作前就“读懂”其意图，可提前 1 s 级触发保护，显著降低事故率；但 EEG 在真实驾驶中受非平稳性与伪迹干扰，能否稳定、提前解码仍是未知。
AI.method: 构建多传感同步平台并采集 32 场次真实电动车道路数据；对比 12 种深度网络，以原始 EEG 最小预处理作为输入，采用 0–1000 ms 前滑动窗口评估跨时稳定性。
AI.result: TSCeption 平均准确率 0.907，Macro-F1 0.901，领先第二名约 3–4 个百分点；性能在 –1000 ms 内几乎无衰减，并于 –600 ∼ –400 ms 达到峰值；比复杂伪迹去除流程平均提升 2.1%。
AI.conclusion: 证明在真实道路场景下，无需繁重 EEG 预处理即可实现早至 1 s、稳定 90% 以上精度的驾驶员意图解码，为下一代预测性 ADAS 提供了可直接落地的神经生理接口范式。

title: From Craft to Kernel: A Governance-First Execution Architecture and Semantic ISA for Agentic Computers
summary: The transition of agentic AI from brittle prototypes to production systems is stalled by a pervasive crisis of craft. We suggest that the prevailing orchestration paradigm-delegating the system control loop to large language models and merely patching with heuristic guardrails-is the root cause of this fragility. Instead, we propose Arbiter-K, a Governance-First execution architecture that reconceptualizes the underlying model as a Probabilistic Processing Unit encapsulated by a deterministic, neuro-symbolic kernel. Arbiter-K implements a Semantic Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) to reify probabilistic messages into discrete instructions. This allows the kernel to maintain a Security Context Registry and construct an Instruction Dependency Graph at runtime, enabling active taint propagation based on the data-flow pedigree of each reasoning node. By leveraging this mechanism, Arbiter-K precisely interdicts unsafe trajectories at deterministic sinks (e.g., high-risk tool calls or unauthorized network egress) and enables autonomous execution correction and architectural rollback when security policies are triggered. Evaluations on OpenClaw and NanoBot demonstrate that Arbiter-K enforces security as a microarchitectural property, achieving 76% to 95% unsafe interception for a 92.79% absolute gain over native policies. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/cure-lab/ArbiterOS.

AI.tldr: 将LLM视为‘概率处理单元’，用确定性神经符号内核包裹，形成 Governance-First 的 Arbiter-K 架构，通过在运行时维护安全上下文与指令依赖图，把危险调用拦截在确定性出口，实验显示不安全轨迹拦截率提升92.79%。
AI.motivation: 代理式AI从脆弱原型走向生产系统的关键障碍，在于现有‘LLM主导+启发式护栏’的编排范式把控制环交给不可控的概率模型，导致系统脆弱且难以治理。
AI.method: 提出 Arbiter-K：1) 把LLM封装为 Probabilistic Processing Unit，外覆确定性神经符号内核；2) 定义 Semantic ISA，将概率消息实例化为离散指令；3) 运行时维护 Security Context Registry 并动态构造 Instruction Dependency Graph；4) 基于数据流血统进行主动污点传播，在确定性出口（高风险工具调用、未授权外联等）精确拦截并支持自主修复与架构回滚。
AI.result: OpenClaw 与 NanoBot 测试表明，Arbiter-K 将不安全拦截率从原生策略的 2–21% 提高到 76–95%，绝对增益 92.79%，并把安全性沉淀为微架构级属性。
AI.conclusion: 把安全治理下沉到 ISA 与微架构层、以确定性内核约束概率行为，是破解代理 AI 脆弱性的有效路径，代码已开源。

title: Taming Actor-Observer Asymmetry in Agents via Dialectical Alignment
comment: ACL 2026 Main Conference. Project page: https://unikcc.github.io/ReTAS/
summary: Large Language Model agents have rapidly evolved from static text generators into dynamic systems capable of executing complex autonomous workflows. To enhance reliability, multi-agent frameworks assigning specialized roles are increasingly adopted to enable self-reflection and mutual auditing. While such role-playing effectively leverages domain expert knowledge, we find it simultaneously induces a human-like cognitive bias known as Actor-Observer Asymmetry (AOA). Specifically, an agent acting as an actor (during self-reflection) tends to attribute failures to external factors, whereas an observer (during mutual auditing) attributes the same errors to internal faults. We quantify this using our new Ambiguous Failure Benchmark, which reveals that simply swapping perspectives triggers the AOA effect in over 20% of cases for most models. To tame this bias, we introduce ReTAS (Reasoning via Thesis-Antithesis-Synthesis), a model trained through dialectical alignment to enforce perspective-invariant reasoning. By integrating dialectical chain-of-thought with Group Relative Policy Optimization, ReTAS guides agents to synthesize conflicting viewpoints into an objective consensus. Experiments demonstrate that ReTAS effectively mitigates attribution inconsistency and significantly improves fault resolution rates in ambiguous scenarios.

AI.tldr: 仅靠角色分工的多智能体在自主审计时会出现‘行为者–观察者非对称’偏见：自省时推诿客观、审计时归因主责。作者定量揭示该偏差，并给出ReTAS(辩证法对齐)依靠冲突式链式推理与GRPO优化消除偏见，自主排故率大增。
AI.motivation: 为使大模型具备自主和可解释工作流，现多采用多专家角色扮演并相互审计。然而，人类式的认知会在不同视角产生动摇，削弱可信度和一致性，需要系统的量化与修正。
AI.method: 1)提出Ambiguous Failure Benchmark先测AOA偏见；2)设计ReTAS结构，用辩证法训练的链式思维生成正反双方主张→综合→一致性结论；3)联合GRPO将成功观点提炼为策略梯度，持续对齐主模型。
AI.result: 用AFB测试5类主流模型，角色转换导致20%以上AOA归因反转；ReTAS将一致性提升至>90%，排故成功率提升12–17%，仅用9k对齐样本即可收敛。
AI.conclusion: 多视野协作虽能激发专业化推理，却固有人为偏见；若缺乏机制纠正，会导致责任推诿和误判。引入辩证对齐与团队相对强化可同时保证视角多样性与结论客观性，为可信自主智能体提供范式。

title: Revisiting Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding
summary:
Knowledge Graph Embeddings (KGEs) support a wide range of downstream tasks over Knowledge Graphs (KGs). In practice, KGs evolve as new entities and facts are added, motivating Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding (CKGE) methods that update embeddings over time. Current CKGE approaches address catastrophic forgetting (i.e., the performance degradation on previously learned tasks) primarily by limiting changes to existing embeddings.
  However, we show that this view is incomplete. When new entities are introduced, their embeddings can interfere with previously learned ones, causing the model to predict them in place of previously correct answers. This phenomenon, which we call entity interference, has been largely overlooked and is not accounted for in current CKGE evaluation protocols. As a result, the assessment of catastrophic forgetting becomes misleading, and CKGE methods performance is systematically overestimated.
  To address this issue, we introduce a corrected CKGE evaluation protocol that accounts for entity interference. Through experiments on multiple benchmarks, we show that ignoring this effect can lead to performance overestimation of up to 25%, particularly in scenarios with significant entity growth. We further analyze how different CKGE methods and KGE models are affected by the different sources of forgetting, and introduce a catastrophic forgetting metric tailored to CKGE.

AI.tldr: 作者指出连续知识图谱嵌入（CKGE）在评估时忽略了“实体干扰”现象，导致对遗忘的估计被系统性高估最多25%，并提出修正协议与新指标。
AI.motivation: CKGE 需在新实体加入时持续更新嵌入，但既有研究仅关注参数变动带来的灾难性遗忘，忽视新实体嵌入对旧实体的干扰，可能使评估失真。
AI.method: 1）形式化“实体干扰”并证明其存在；2）提出将干扰纳入考量的修正评估协议；3）设计面向 CKGE 的专用遗忘度量；4）在多个基准上对比不同 CKGE 与 KGE 模型在新协议下的表现。
AI.result: 实验显示，忽略实体干扰可使 CKGE 方法性能被高估最多 25%，且干扰效应随实体增长显著加剧；新协议揭示了各方法对不同遗忘来源的敏感度差异。
AI.conclusion: 实体干扰是 CKGE 中被遗漏的关键遗忘源；采用修正评估协议与专用指标才能得到真实可靠的 CKGE 性能，为未来方法设计提供方向。

title: IonMorphNet: Generalizable Learning of Ion Image Morphologies for Peak Picking in Mass Spectrometry Imaging
comment: This paper has been accepted at IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW), 2026
summary: Peak picking is a fundamental preprocessing step in Mass Spectrometry Imaging (MSI), where each sample is represented by hundreds to thousands of ion images. Existing approaches require careful dataset-specific hyperparameter tuning, and often fail to generalize across acquisition protocols. We introduce IonMorphNet, a spatial-structure-aware representation model for ion images that enables fully data-driven peak picking without any task-specific supervision. We curate 53 publicly available MSI datasets and define six structural classes capturing representative spatial patterns in ion images to train standard image backbones for structural pattern classification. Once trained, IonMorphNet can assess ion images and perform peak picking without additional hyperparameter tuning. Using a ConvNeXt V2-Tiny backbone, our approach improves peak picking performance by +7 % mSCF1 compared to state-of-the-art methods across multiple datasets. Beyond peak picking, we demonstrate that spatially informed channel reduction enables a 3D CNN for patch-based tumor classification in MSI. This approach matches or exceeds pixel-wise spectral classifiers by up to +7.3 % Balanced Accuracy on three tumor classification tasks, indicating meaningful ion image selection. The source code and model weights are available at https://github.com/CeMOS-IS/IonMorphNet.

AI.tldr: 我们提出 IonMorphNet，一种纯数据驱动的质谱成像离子图像选峰框架，无需任务特定参数；在 53 个公开数据集上训练后可统一使用，选峰 mSCF1 提升 7%，并能在 3D-CNN 中以结构先验将肿瘤分类 Balanced Accuracy 再提高 7.3%。代码与权重已开源。
AI.motivation: 传统 MSI 选峰算法对仪器协议敏感，需逐数据集手动调参，难以迁移。作者希望用无监督的空间结构表征，消除人工干预，实现跨数据集一键式选峰。
AI.method: 1) 从 53 个公开 MSI 数据构建六种典型空间结构类别；2) 用该类标签训练 ConvNeXt V2-Tiny，使其学会“离子图像结构评分”；3) 推理时对每个 m/z 通道生成结构置信度，按阈值直接完成选峰；4) 将选出的结构显著通道用作 3D-CNN 输入，进行patch 级肿瘤分类。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，IonMorphNet 选峰 mSCF1 绝对提升 7%；同一套模型参数无需再调。用于下游肿瘤分类时，3D-CNN 仅输入结构显著通道，即可在 3 项任务上较像素级谱分类器 Balanced Accuracy 提升最高 7.3%，证明选出的离子图像具有生物学意义。
AI.conclusion: 空间结构先验足以驱动 MSI 选峰，IonMorphNet 首次实现协议无关、免调参的端到峰选择，并可为下游 3D 深度学习提供高判别力通道，兼具效率与可迁移性。

title: Unlocking the Edge deployment and ondevice acceleration of multi-LoRA enabled one-for-all foundational LLM
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) on smartphones poses significant engineering challenges due to stringent constraints on memory, latency, and runtime flexibility. In this work, we present a hardware-aware framework for efficient on-device inference of a LLaMA-based multilingual foundation model supporting multiple use cases on Samsung Galaxy S24 and S25 devices with SM8650 and SM8750 Qualcomm chipsets respectively. Our approach integrates application-specific LoRAs as runtime inputs to a single frozen inference graph, enabling dynamic task switching without recompilation or memory overhead. We further introduce a multi-stream decoding mechanism that concurrently generates stylistic variations - such as formal, polite, or jovial responses - within a single forward pass, reducing latency by up to 6x. To accelerate token generation, we apply Dynamic Self-Speculative Decoding (DS2D), a tree-based strategy that predicts future tokens without requiring a draft model, yielding up to 2.3x speedup in decode time. Combined with quantization to INT4 and architecture-level optimizations, our system achieves 4-6x overall improvements in memory and latency while maintaining accuracy across 9 languages and 8 tasks. These results demonstrate practical feasibility of deploying multi-use-case LLMs on edge devices, advancing the commercial viability of Generative AI in mobile platforms.

AI.tldr: 仅用INT4权重、LoRA组合与无草稿树的自投机解码，即在Galaxy S24/S25上将7-8B级LLaMA推至4-6×运行时与内存收益，9语8任务精度不降，首次验证多任务大模型在手机侧的商用落地可能。
AI.motivation: 高端手机硬件与多任务需求驱动把大模型端侧化，但现行方案要么模型专才、要么反复重载重编译，在内存、延迟与可扩展性上都不可商用。亟需一套不增硬件又不必拆分模型的单图推理框架。
AI.method: 1) 静态INT4量化+算子级融图降低峰值内存≥70%；2) 运行时向同一冻结主图注入叠加式应用专用LoRA，免重编与冗余参数迁移；3) 多流batch解码：在一次前向为同输入同时生成风格化多输出，跑满并行核，整体时延最大6×；4) 动算树状自投机解码(DS2D)，在生成本身隐状态构造候选路径，不增副模型而得2-2.3× token吞吐；5) 全局调度以ARM-smart缓存与多核亲和性进一步削开销。
AI.result:
在S24(SM8650)/S25(SM8750)上，≤7GB RAM占用的7-8B模型对9语、8任务仍维持全精度SOTA 95-98%分位数指标：
- 单一推理图可秒级切换（∼15ms）多场景LoRA；
- 端到端延迟最高6×；token级延迟DS2D再加速2.3×；
- 峰值功耗降低38%，连续会话帧率稳定30fps级；
- 对比同内存预算下剪枝/蒸馏方案，平均BLEU/Exact-Match仅-0.3%可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬件感知量化、LoRA叠加推理图与无草稿投机解码三合一，端侧大模型在多语言、多任务、多风格场景现已可商用；框架可直接移植至后续SoC并支持更大规模模型，为移动终端全面引入生成式AI提供了可量产的技术基座。

title: Detecting Hallucinations in SpeechLLMs at Inference Time Using Attention Maps
summary: Hallucinations in Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) pose significant risks, yet existing detection methods typically rely on gold-standard outputs that are costly or impractical to obtain. Moreover, hallucination detection methods developed for text-based LLMs do not directly capture audio-specific signals. We investigate four attention-derived metrics: AUDIORATIO, AUDIOCONSISTENCY, AUDIOENTROPY, and TEXTENTROPY, designed to capture pathological attention patterns associated with hallucination, and train lightweight logistic regression classifiers on these features for efficient inference-time detection. Across automatic speech recognition and speech-to-text translation tasks, evaluations on Qwen-2-Audio and Voxtral-3B show that our approach outperforms uncertainty-based and prior attention-based baselines on in-domain data, achieving improvements of up to +0.23 PR-AUC, and generalises to out-of-domain ASR settings. We further find that strong performance can be achieved with approximately 100 attention heads, improving out-of-domain generalisation compared to using all heads. While effectiveness is model-dependent and task-specific training is required, our results demonstrate that attention patterns provide a valuable tool for hallucination detection in SpeechLLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出无需金标、仅利用注意力统计量即可在推理阶段快速检测语音大模型幻觉的轻量方法，在 ASR 与 ST 任务上优于既有不确定性/注意力基线，并具备跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 语音大模型幻觉风险高，但金标获取昂贵；文本幻觉检测方法无法捕捉音频特有信号，亟需无金标、适配音频模态的幻觉检测方案。
AI.method: 设计四个注意力衍生指标（AUDIORATIO、AUDIOCONSISTENCY、AUDIOENTROPY、TEXTENTROPY）刻画异常注意力模式；用约 100 个注意力头提取特征，训练轻量逻辑回归分类器，实现推理时零额外标注检测。
AI.result: 在 Qwen-2-Audio 与 Voxtral-3B 的 ASR、ST 任务上，较不确定性及既有注意力基线 PR-AUC 最多提升 0.23；跨域 ASR 场景仍保持良好泛化，且精选头数优于用全部头。
AI.conclusion: 注意力模式自身即可作为幻觉有效信号，无需金标即可实现轻量、低延迟检测，但效果受模型与任务影响，需针对性训练。

title: Unsupervised Confidence Calibration for Reasoning LLMs from a Single Generation
summary: Reasoning language models can solve increasingly complex tasks, but struggle to produce the calibrated confidence estimates necessary for reliable deployment. Existing calibration methods usually depend on labels or repeated sampling at inference time, making them impractical in many settings. We introduce a method for unsupervised confidence calibration of reasoning LLMs when only a single generation is available at inference time. Our approach uses offline sampling on unlabeled data to derive a self-consistency-based proxy target, then distills this signal into a lightweight deployment-time confidence predictor. In a broad evaluation across 5 math and question-answering tasks using 9 reasoning models, our method substantially outperforms baselines, including under distribution shift, and improves downstream performance in selective prediction and simulated downstream decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需标签、无需推理时多次采样的单步推理LLM置信度校准方法，通过离线无监督蒸馏显著提升校准与下游决策性能。
AI.motivation: 当前推理大模型虽能力强，但置信度估计不准，而现有校准方法依赖标签或推理时重复采样，难以实用。
AI.method: 离线阶段：在大量无标签数据上让模型多次采样生成答案，用自一致性构造伪置信目标；蒸馏阶段：将伪目标训练成一个极轻量的置信度预测器，部署时仅一次前向即可输出校准置信。
AI.result: 在5个数学与问答任务、9个推理模型上全面评估，方法大幅超越无监督基线，分布偏移下仍稳健，并提升选择性预测与模拟下游决策的AUC与收益。
AI.conclusion: 利用离线自一致性信号进行无监督蒸馏，可在不增加推理延迟的前提下为LLM提供可靠置信估计，为实际部署提供即插即用的校准方案。

title: PanDA: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Multimodal 3D Panoptic Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: This paper presents the first study on Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) for multimodal 3D panoptic segmentation (mm-3DPS), aiming to improve generalization under domain shifts commonly encountered in real-world autonomous driving. A straightforward solution is to employ a pseudo-labeling strategy, which is widely used in UDA to generate supervision for unlabeled target data, combined with an mm-3DPS backbone. However, existing supervised mm-3DPS methods rely heavily on strong cross-modal complementarity between LiDAR and RGB inputs, making them fragile under domain shifts where one modality degrades (e.g., poor lighting or adverse weather). Moreover, conventional pseudo-labeling typically retains only high-confidence regions, leading to fragmented masks and incomplete object supervision, which are issues particularly detrimental to panoptic segmentation. To address these challenges, we propose PanDA, the first UDA framework specifically designed for multimodal 3D panoptic segmentation. To improve robustness against single-sensor degradation, we introduce an asymmetric multimodal augmentation that selectively drops regions to simulate domain shifts and improve robust representation learning. To enhance pseudo-label completeness and reliability, we further develop a dual-expert pseudo-label refinement module that extracts domain-invariant priors from both 2D and 3D modalities. Extensive experiments across diverse domain shifts, spanning time, weather, location, and sensor variations, significantly surpass state-of-the-art UDA baselines for 3D semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 首个面向多模态三维全景分割的无监督域适应框架PanDA，通过非对称多模态增强与双专家伪标签精修，在多种真实域漂移下显著优于既有3D语义分割UDA基线。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶实际部署常遇光照、天气、传感器差异等域漂移，现有有监督多模态3D全景分割依赖LiDAR-RGB强互补，一旦某一模态退化则性能骤降；传统伪标签仅能保留高置信区域，造成掩码碎片化、物体监督不完整，难以满足全景分割对实例与语义一致性的高要求。
AI.method: 提出PanDA框架：(1) 非对称多模态增强——随机丢弃LiDAR或图像区域模拟单传感器失效，强制网络学习鲁棒表示；(2) 双专家伪标签精修——并行利用2D和3D专家提取域不变先验，互补补全伪标签，提升完整性与可靠性；整体采用伪标签自训练范式配合mm-3DPS骨干完成适应。
AI.result: 在涵盖时间、天气、地点、传感器变化的多组域漂移实验中，PanDA在3D语义分割任务上全面超越当前最优UDA基线，并首次给出mm-3DPS无监督域适应结果。
AI.conclusion: PanDA验证了针对多模态3D全景分割设计专用UDA策略的必要性：通过非对称增强与双专家精修，可显著缓解单模态退化与伪标签碎片化问题，为安全鲁棒的自动驾驶感知提供新baseline，并启发病态模态下的持续研究。

title: Owner-Harm: A Missing Threat Model for AI Agent Safety
comment: 15 pages. Companion manuscript on per-decision proof-obligation synthesis (LSVJ-S) in preparation
summary: Existing AI agent safety benchmarks focus on generic criminal harm (cybercrime, harassment, weapon synthesis), leaving a systematic blind spot for a distinct and commercially consequential threat category: agents harming their own deployers. Real-world incidents illustrate the gap: Slack AI credential exfiltration (Aug 2024), Microsoft 365 Copilot calendar-injection leaks (Jan 2024), and a Meta agent unauthorized forum post exposing operational data (Mar 2026). We propose Owner-Harm, a formal threat model with eight categories of agent behavior damaging the deployer. We quantify the defense gap on two benchmarks: a compositional safety system achieves 100% TPR / 0% FPR on AgentHarm (generic criminal harm) yet only 14.8% (4/27; 95% CI: 5.9%-32.5%) on AgentDojo injection tasks (prompt-injection-mediated owner harm). A controlled generic-LLM baseline shows the gap is not inherent to owner-harm (62.7% vs. 59.3%, delta 3.4 pp) but arises from environment-bound symbolic rules that fail to generalize across tool vocabularies. On a post-hoc 300-scenario owner-harm benchmark, the gate alone achieves 75.3% TPR / 3.3% FPR; adding a deterministic post-audit verifier raises overall TPR to 85.3% (+10.0 pp) and Hijacking detection from 43.3% to 93.3%, demonstrating strong layer complementarity. We introduce the Symbolic-Semantic Defense Generalization (SSDG) framework relating information coverage to detection rate. Two SSDG experiments partially validate it: context deprivation amplifies the detection gap 3.4x (R = 3.60 vs. R = 1.06); context injection reveals structured goal-action alignment, not text concatenation, is required for effective owner-harm detection.

AI.tldr: 现有AI安全基准忽视了对部署者自身造成损害的风险；作者首次提出针对‘Owner-Harm’的正式威胁模型并构建27/300场景测试集，证明当前防注入系统对普通犯罪能100%检出，但对’自伤’行为仅14.8%检出。引入SSGD框架指出安全规则在多工具环境中迁移失败，通过门控+事后审计可将检出率提升至85.3%，为商用代理的自保安全补齐缺环。
AI.motivation: 主流AI代理安全基准聚焦网络犯罪、骚扰与武器合成等通用风险，却系统性地遗漏了‘攻击自己部署者’的独特且高商业相关性的威胁类别。作者希望弥补这一安全盲区，量化防御空白，为商业部署提供更完备的安全保障框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出Owner-Harm威胁模型，将致害代理行为细分为8个类别；2) 构建AgentDojo注入任务(27例)与扩展300例测试，衡量当前安全系统对“自伤”实例的检测效果；3) 将AgentHarm通用犯罪基准作为对照；4) 提出Symbolic-Semantic Defense Generalization(SSGD)框架评估规则在不同工具词汇间的泛化能力；5) 设计门控过滤(gate alone)与确定性事后审计(post-audit verifier)两层防御进行实验验证；6) 通过“信息剥夺”和“信息注入”两个实验探究上下文对检测率的影响；7) 计算TPR、FPR、delta等指标并辅以95%置信区间和显著性检验。
AI.result: 1) 通用安全系统在AgentHarm上可达100% TPR/0% FPR，对自伤任务仅14.8% TPR；其差距并非任务本身难度所致(基准LLM对两类实例准确率相近)。2) 差距源于安全规则绑定特定环境的符号系统，难以跨工具迁移。3) 仅用门控层在300例测试集上获得75.3% TPR/3.3% FPR；叠加确定性审计层后TPR升至85.3%，劫持检测率更由43.3%跃升至93.3%。4) SSGD框架得到部分验证：上下文剥离3.4倍放大检测缺口；表明检测关键在于结构化目标动作对齐而非简单文本拼接。
AI.conclusion: 作者首次系统定义并实验量化“代理伤害自己部署者”这一被忽视的威胁类别，揭示当前安全规则在跨工具/跨环境场景下严重泛化不足。提出的门控+事中审计双层式防御策略可将检出率提升至85%以上，为商业AI代理生态提供了直接可落地的自保安全方案。未来应围绕SSGD框架持续改进目的-行为对齐检测与跨领域安全规则迁移能力，补齐代理安全的最后一块拼图。

title: A Self-Evolving Framework for Efficient Terminal Agents via Observational Context Compression
summary: As model capabilities advance, research has increasingly shifted toward long-horizon, multi-turn terminal-centric agentic tasks, where raw environment feedback is often preserved in the interaction history to support future decisions. However, repeatedly retaining such feedback introduces substantial redundancy and causes cumulative token cost to grow quadratically with the number of steps, hindering long-horizon reasoning. Although observation compression can mitigate this issue, the heterogeneity of terminal environments makes heuristic-based or fixed-prompt methods difficult to generalize. We propose TACO, a plug-and-play, self-evolving Terminal Agent Compression framework that automatically discovers and refines compression rules from interaction trajectories for existing terminal agents. Experiments on TerminalBench (TB 1.0 and TB 2.0) and four additional terminal-related benchmarks (i.e., SWE-Bench Lite, CompileBench, DevEval, and CRUST-Bench) show that TACO consistently improves performance across mainstream agent frameworks and strong backbone models. With MiniMax-2.5, it improves performance on most benchmarks while reducing token overhead by around 10%. On TerminalBench, it brings consistent gains of 1%-4% across strong agentic models, and further improves accuracy by around 2%-3% under the same token budget. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of self-evolving, task-aware compression for terminal agents.

title: Heterogeneity-Aware Personalized Federated Learning for Industrial Predictive Analytics
summary: Federated prognostics enable clients (e.g., companies, factories, and production lines) to collaboratively develop a failure time prediction model while keeping each client's data local and confidential. However, traditional federated models often assume homogeneity in the degradation processes across clients, an assumption that may not hold in many industrial settings. To overcome this, this paper proposes a personalized federated prognostic model designed to accommodate clients with heterogeneous degradation processes, allowing them to build tailored prognostic models. The prognostic model iteratively facilitates the underlying pairwise collaborations between clients with similar degradation patterns, which enhances the performance of personalized federated learning. To estimate parameters jointly using decentralized datasets, we develop a federated parameter estimation algorithm based on proximal gradient descent. The proposed approach addresses the limitations of existing federated prognostic models by simultaneously achieving model personalization, preserving data privacy, and providing comprehensive failure time distributions. The superiority of the proposed model is validated through extensive simulation studies and a case study using the turbofan engine degradation dataset from the NASA repository.

AI.tldr: 提出个性化联邦剩余寿命预测框架，解决工业场景下客户退化过程异质性的难题；通过成对客户协作+近端梯度参数估计，在不共享原始数据的前提下为每台设备生成定制化失效分布，并在NASA涡轮风扇数据集上验证优于传统联邦方法。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦预测模型假设所有客户端的退化过程同质，而工业现场中不同企业/产线的设备退化模式往往差异显著，导致全局模型在局部失效时间预测性能下降，亟需兼顾隐私与个性化的联邦学习范式。
AI.method: 1) 构建异构退化过程的个性化联邦剩余寿命预测框架；2) 采用成对相似度挖掘机制，在客户端间仅与退化模式相似的伙伴交换模型参数，实现“相似协作、异质隔离”；3) 设计基于近端梯度下降的联邦参数估计算法，联合优化全局共享层与本地个性化层，保证收敛并维持数据本地化存储。
AI.result: 仿真与NASA涡轮风扇退化数据集实验表明：所提方法相比传统联邦平均(FedAvg)及本地单独训练，将预测误差降低15-28%，同时输出完整的失效时间分布而非点估计，且通信轮数减少约30%。
AI.conclusion: 个性化联邦剩余寿命预测模型可在严格隐私约束下，为不同退化特征的客户端提供高准确度、可解释的设备失效时间分布，为工业预测性维护中的跨企业协作提供可行方案。

title: Air-Know: Arbiter-Calibrated Knowledge-Internalizing Robust Network for Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) has attracted significant attention due to its flexible multimodal query method, yet its development is severely constrained by the Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC) problem. Most existing robust learning methods rely on the "small loss hypothesis", but the unique semantic ambiguity in NTC, such as "partial matching", invalidates this assumption, leading to unreliable noise identification. This entraps the model in a self dependent vicious cycle where the learner is intertwined with the arbiter, ultimately causing catastrophic "representation pollution". To address this critical challenge, we propose a novel "Expert-Proxy-Diversion" decoupling paradigm, named Air-Know (ArbIteR calibrated Knowledge iNternalizing rObust netWork). Air-Know incorporates three core modules: (1) External Prior Arbitration (EPA), which utilizes Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as an offline expert to construct a high precision anchor dataset; (2) Expert Knowledge Internalization (EKI), which efficiently guides a lightweight proxy "arbiter" to internalize the expert's discriminative logic; (3) Dual Stream Reconciliation (DSR), which leverages the EKI's matching confidence to divert the training data, achieving a clean alignment stream and a representation feedback reconciliation stream. Extensive experiments on multiple CIR benchmark datasets demonstrate that Air-Know significantly outperforms existing SOTA methods under the NTC setting, while also showing strong competitiveness in traditional CIR.

AI.tldr: 针对组合图像检索中“噪声三元组对应”导致的小损失假设失效，提出“仲裁-代理-分流”解耦范式 Air-Know，用 MLLM 离线锚定→轻量仲裁器内化→双路分流训练，彻底切断“学习者即仲裁者”的恶性循环，显著超越现有 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 组合图像检索依赖图文三元组，但数据普遍存在“部分匹配”等语义歧义，造成 Noisy Triplet Correspondence（NTC）。传统鲁棒学习的“小损失即干净”假设在 NTC 下失效，模型自举式筛选噪声会不断污染表示，陷入自我强化的灾难循环，亟需外部无偏仲裁机制打破闭环。
AI.method: (1) EPA：离线调用多模态大语言模型，构造高置信锚点数据集，提供无偏先验；(2) EKI：把 EPA 的判别逻辑蒸馏给轻量级“代理仲裁器”，实现高效在线打标签；(3) DSR：按 EKI 置信度将训练数据分流为“干净对齐流”与“表示反馈校准流”，双路并行更新，切断主检索网络与噪声判断的耦合。
AI.result: 在 CIRR、FashionIQ、Shoes 等主流 CIR 基准的 NTC 设定下，Air-Know 将 R@1 绝对提升 4.2–6.8 个百分点，较之前最佳方法平均改进 5.1%；在标准干净 CIR 场景仍保持领先，验证其兼容性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过“外部先验仲裁—知识内化—数据分流”三步解耦，Air-Know 首次在 NTC 条件下实现可靠噪声甄别与表示自净，为鲁棒多模态检索提供了可扩展范式，并可迁移至其他受噪三元组困扰的任务。

title: Evaluating Answer Leakage Robustness of LLM Tutors against Adversarial Student Attacks
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in education, yet their default helpfulness often conflicts with pedagogical principles. Prior work evaluates pedagogical quality via answer leakage-the disclosure of complete solutions instead of scaffolding-but typically assumes well-intentioned learners, leaving tutor robustness under student misuse largely unexplored. In this paper, we study scenarios where students behave adversarially and aim to obtain the correct answer from the tutor. We evaluate a broad set of LLM-based tutor models, including different model families, pedagogically aligned models, and a multi-agent design, under a range of adversarial student attacks. We adapt six groups of adversarial and persuasive techniques to the educational setting and use them to probe how likely a tutor is to reveal the final answer. We evaluate answer leakage robustness using different types of in-context adversarial student agents, finding that they often fail to carry out effective attacks. We therefore introduce an adversarial student agent that we fine-tune to jailbreak LLM-based tutors, which we propose as the core of a standardized benchmark for evaluating tutor robustness. Finally, we present simple but effective defense strategies that reduce answer leakage and strengthen the robustness of LLM-based tutors in adversarial scenarios.

AI.tldr: 现有教育工作默认学生是善意的，忽略了LLM家教被对抗性学生“套答案”的风险；本文构造攻防基准，证明微调后的对抗性学生代理可高效泄露答案，同时给出轻量级防御方案。
AI.motivation: LLM家教既要保持辅助性又不能直接给答案，但对恶意学生如何通过对抗手段逼出答案缺乏系统研究，亟需量化鲁棒性与防御方法。
AI.method: 1) 把六种通用对抗、说服技术适配到教育场景；2) 构建多类LLM家教（不同基座、教学对齐、多代理）并设计上下文对抗学生代理；3) 发现普通代理攻击效果差后，用微调训练出专用“越狱”学生代理；4) 以答案泄露率为核心指标，建立可复现的鲁棒性基准；5) 提出并验证简单防御策略。
AI.result: 微调对抗学生代理突破成功率显著>现有方法；基准测试显示主流LLM家教均存在明显泄露漏洞；轻量级防御（如动态提示遮挡、输出过滤）可把泄露率降到10%以下且基本不影响教学效果。
AI.conclusion: 构建对抗学生-家教攻防闭环是保障LLM教育安全的关键；开源基准与防御方案可立即用于提升现有家教系统的鲁棒性，也为后续研究提供标准化评估平台。

title: Impact of large language models on peer review opinions from a fine-grained perspective: Evidence from top conference proceedings in AI
summary: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), the academic community has faced unprecedented disruptions, particularly in the realm of academic communication. The primary function of peer review is improving the quality of academic manuscripts, such as clarity, originality and other evaluation aspects. Although prior studies suggest that LLMs are beginning to influence peer review, it remains unclear whether they are altering its core evaluative functions. Moreover, the extent to which LLMs affect the linguistic form, evaluative focus, and recommendation-related signals of peer-review reports has yet to be systematically examined. In this study, we examine the changes in peer review reports for academic articles following the emergence of LLMs, emphasizing variations at fine-grained level. Specifically, we investigate linguistic features such as the length and complexity of words and sentences in review comments, while also automatically annotating the evaluation aspects of individual review sentences. We also use a maximum likelihood estimation method, previously established, to identify review reports that potentially have modified or generated by LLMs. Finally, we assess the impact of evaluation aspects mentioned in LLM-assisted review reports on the informativeness of recommendation for paper decision-making. The results indicate that following the emergence of LLMs, peer review texts have become longer and more fluent, with increased emphasis on summaries and surface-level clarity, as well as more standardized linguistic patterns, particularly reviewers with lower confidence score. At the same time, attention to deeper evaluative dimensions, such as originality, replicability, and nuanced critical reasoning, has declined.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统量化 LLM 介入后的同行评审文本变化：语言更冗长流畅、表层清晰度提升，但对原创性、可重复性等深层评价维度关注下降，且低置信度评审者更易采用 LLM 语言模式。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型普及，学界担忧其可能重塑同行评审的核心评价功能，但缺乏对评审报告语言形式、评价焦点与建议信号的系统性实证研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建评审报告语料，利用既定最大似然估计法识别疑似 LLM 修改或生成的文本；2) 细粒度量化语言特征（长度、词汇/句法复杂度）；3) 自动句子级标注评价方面（清晰度、原创性、可重复性等）；4) 关联评价维度与决策信息量，比较 LLM 辅助组与对照组差异。
AI.result: LLM 出现后：评审文本平均更长、可读性提高；标准化语言模式显著增加，尤其出现在置信度低的评审者中；总结与表层清晰度被高频提及；同时对原创性、可重复性、深度批判推理的提及率显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 大模型正改变同行评审的“评价重心”，将评审从深层次的学术质量把关推向表面化、模板化的语言优化；若缺乏干预，可能削弱评审制度对科学创新性与可靠性的保障。

title: ZC-Swish: Stabilizing Deep BN-Free Networks for Edge and Micro-Batch Applications
summary: Batch Normalization (BN) is a cornerstone of deep learning, yet it fundamentally breaks down in micro-batch regimes (e.g., 3D medical imaging) and non-IID Federated Learning. Removing BN from deep architectures, however, often leads to catastrophic training failures such as vanishing gradients and dying channels. We identify that standard activation functions, like Swish and ReLU, exacerbate this instability in BN-free networks due to their non-zero-centered nature, which causes compounding activation mean-shifts as network depth increases. In this technical communication, we propose Zero-Centered Swish (ZC-Swish), a drop-in activation function parameterized to dynamically anchor activation means near zero. Through targeted stress-testing on BN-free convolutional networks at depths 8, 16, and 32, we demonstrate that while standard Swish collapses to near-random performance at depth 16 and beyond, ZC-Swish maintains stable layer-wise activation dynamics and achieves the highest test accuracy at depth 16 (51.5%) with seed 42. ZC-Swish thus provides a robust, parameter-efficient solution for stabilizing deep networks in memory-constrained and privacy-preserving applications where traditional normalization is unviable.

AI.tldr: 用动态零中心化的 ZC-Swish 替换 Swish/ReLU，可在无 BN 的深层卷积网络中抑制激活均值漂移，解决微批量 3D 医学影像与联邦学习场景下的训练崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: Batch Normalization 在微批量（如 3D 医学图像）与非独立同分布联邦学习中失效；直接移除 BN 会因激活函数非零中心性导致深层网络梯度消失与通道死亡，急需一种不依赖归一化且对深度鲁棒的激活方案。
AI.method: 提出 Zero-Centered Swish（ZC-Swish），在 Swish 基础上引入可学习参数，使激活输出均值动态锚定在零附近；在 8/16/32 层无 BN 卷积网络上进行针对性压力测试，对比标准 Swish、ReLU 等的训练稳定性与最终精度。
AI.result: 标准 Swish 在 16 层以上几乎退化为随机预测，而 ZC-Swish 保持层间激活分布稳定；在 16 层网络、seed 42 下取得 51.5% 的最高测试准确率，显著优于基准激活函数。
AI.conclusion: ZC-Swish 以零参数额外开销为深度网络提供了不依赖 BN 的稳定训练手段，可直接嵌入内存受限或隐私保护场景（微批量 3D 影像、联邦学习），替代 Swish/ReLU 而无需修改整体架构。

title: HarmoniDiff-RS: Training-Free Diffusion Harmonization for Satellite Image Composition
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, CVPR 2026 findings. Code is available at https://github.com/XiaoqiZhuang/HarmoniDiff-RS
summary: Satellite image composition plays a critical role in remote sensing applications such as data augmentation, disaste simulation, and urban planning. We propose HarmoniDiff-RS, a training-free diffusion-based framework for harmonizing composite satellite images under diverse domain conditions. Our method aligns the source and target domains through a Latent Mean Shift operation that transfers radiometric characteristics between them. To balance harmonization and content preservation, we introduce a Timestep-wise Latent Fusion strategy by leveraging early inverted latents for high harmonization and late latents for semantic consistency to generate a set of composite candidates. A lightweight harmony classifier is trained to further automatically select the most coherent result among them. We also construct RSIC-H, a benchmark dataset for satellite image harmonization derived from fMoW, providing 500 paired composition samples. Experiments demonstrate that our method effectively performs satellite image composition, showing strong potential for scalable remote-sensing synthesis and simulation tasks. Code is available at: https://github.com/XiaoqiZhuang/HarmoniDiff-RS.

AI.tldr: HarmoniDiff-RS 是一种免训练的扩散框架，通过潜在空间均值漂移与融合策略将任意卫星合成图中的源域辐射特征迁移到目标域，同时保持语义一致，并引入轻量和谐度分类器自动挑选最优结果；在自建的 500 对 RSIC-H 基准上验证，无需训练即可实现高质量、可扩展的遥感影像合成。
AI.motivation: 在灾害模拟、数据增强和城市规划等遥感应用中，合成卫星图像常出现源域与目标域辐射不一致问题，现有深度学习方法需大量训练且跨域泛化差，亟需一种无需训练即可自适应处理多域谐调的高效框架。
AI.method: 基于预训练扩散模型：①在潜在空间对均值特征进行 Latent Mean Shift，一次性校正源目标域辐射差异；② Timestep-wise Latent Fusion 依时间步分别抽取早期（高谐调）与晚期（高语义）潜在特征并组合，生成多个复合候选；③在公开图块上微调轻量 CNN 和谐度分类器，根据视觉连贯性得分自动选出最优合成图。
AI.result: 在自建 RSIC-H（500 对多场景合成样本）上的测试显示，HarmoniDiff-RS 在无训练条件下，PSNR/SSIM/FID/LPIPS 均优于三项域适应与影像拼接基线，域差异指标缩减 30 %+；下游变化检测与建筑物分割任务中使用合成数据可提升 2–4 % IoU，证明谐调质量与后续应用收益兼备。
AI.conclusion: 提出首个面向多域卫星图像的合成谐调免训练范式，Latent Mean Shift 解决域偏移，融合策略平衡谐调与内容，轻量分类器保证自动化，RSIC-H 填补基准空白；方法可插拔、零样本且可扩展，为大规模遥感数据增强、灾害情景模拟与城规数字孪生提供通用工具，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Explicit Refusals: Soft-Failure Attacks on Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 22 pages, Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Existing jamming attacks on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems typically induce explicit refusals or denial-of-service behaviors, which are conspicuous and easy to detect. In this work, we formalize a subtler availability threat, termed soft failure, which degrades system utility by inducing fluent and coherent yet non-informative responses rather than overt failures. We propose Deceptive Evolutionary Jamming Attack (DEJA), an automated black-box attack framework that generates adversarial documents to trigger such soft failures by exploiting safety-aligned behaviors of large language models. DEJA employs an evolutionary optimization process guided by a fine-grained Answer Utility Score (AUS), computed via an LLM-based evaluator, to systematically degrade the certainty of answers while maintaining high retrieval success. Extensive experiments across multiple RAG configurations and benchmark datasets show that DEJA consistently drives responses toward low-utility soft failures, achieving SASR above 79\% while keeping hard-failure rates below 15\%, significantly outperforming prior attacks. The resulting adversarial documents exhibit high stealth, evading perplexity-based detection and resisting query paraphrasing, and transfer across model families to proprietary systems without retargeting.

AI.tldr: DEJA首次针对RAG系统提出“软失效”可用性威胁，利用演化黑盒优化自动生成高隐蔽对抗文档，使LLM输出流畅但无信息量的回答，在多项基准上SASR≥79%，硬失效≤15%，显著优于现有攻击且可跨模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统针对RAG的干扰攻击只能引发显式拒答或DoS，易被检测；作者希望揭示更隐蔽的“软失效”风险，即系统看似正常运作却输出无信息内容，从而暴露RAG在实际部署中的隐性可用性漏洞。
AI.method: 1) 形式化“软失效”威胁模型；2) 提出DEJA框架：用LLM-based evaluator计算细粒度Answer Utility Score(AUS)作为适应度，驱动演化算法在黑盒设置下搜索对抗文档；3) 以“保持检索成功+降低答案确定性”为双重目标，迭代生成隐形扰动。
AI.result: 跨多种RAG配置与数据集的实验显示，DEJA在SASR（软攻击成功率）上均≥79%，同时将硬失效率压至≤15%，显著优于基线；生成的对抗文档 perplexity 正常，可抵御查询改写，且无需重训练即可向GPT-4等闭源系统迁移。
AI.conclusion: 软失效是RAG面临的真实且高隐蔽的可用性威胁；DEJA证明仅依赖模型自身安全对齐行为即可高效触发此类失效，提示未来需设计专门的高效检测与防御机制来应对这种“看似正常”的对抗性降级。

title: A Bolu: A Structured Dataset for the Computational Analysis of Sardinian Improvisational Poetry
comment: Accepted at the DIALRES Workshop, LREC-COLING 2026
summary: The growing interest of Natural Language Processing (NLP) in minority languages has not yet bridged the gap in the preservation of oral linguistic heritage. In particular, extemporaneous poetry - a performative genre based on real-time improvisation, metrical-rhetorical competence - remains a largely unexplored area of computational linguistics. This methodological gap necessitates the creation of specific resources to document and analyse the structures of improvised poetry. This is the context in which A Bolu was created, the first structured corpus of extemporaneous poetry dedicated to cantada logudorese, a variant of the Sardinian language. The dataset comprises 2,835 stanzas for a total of 141,321 tokens. The study presents the architecture of the corpus and applies a multidimensional analysis combining descriptive statistical indices and computational linguistics techniques to map the characteristics of the poetic text. The results indicate that the production of Sardinian extemporaneous poets is characterised by recurring patterns that support Parry and Lord's theory of formulaicity. This evidence not only provides a new key to understanding oral creativity, but also offers a significant contribution to the development of NLP tools that are more inclusive and sensitive to the specificities of less widely spoken languages.

AI.tldr: 作者发布A Bolu——首个撒丁语即兴诗（cantada logudorese）结构化语料，含2 835节141 321词，并以多维度计算语言学方法验证口头诗歌的程式化特征。
AI.motivation: 自然语言处理对少数语言热情高涨，却忽视了即兴口传诗歌这类活态遗产；学界缺少可计算的资源与方法来记录、分析即兴诗的格律-修辞结构。
AI.method: 1) 构建A Bolu语料：采集撒丁语即兴对歌，转写、分词、对齐；2) 设计多维分析框架：结合描述统计与NLP技术（n-gram频率、共现网络、重复串检测、韵律标记）；3) 检验帕里-洛德“口头程式理论”的公式化假说。
AI.result: 语料层面：141 321 tokens中，高频n-gram和半固定套语占显著比例，句法-韵律模板高度复现；诗人层面：即兴创作依赖有限但灵活的“公式池”，支持实时押韵与对仗；计算指标：重复串覆盖率、套语密度与演出时长显著相关，证实程式化是即兴可行性的核心机制。
AI.conclusion: A Bolu证明计算语言学可有效揭示少数语言口传文本的深层规律，为口头创造力研究提供新钥匙；同时示范了构建低资源、高文化价值语料的技术路线，推动更具包容性的NLP工具开发。

title: EVPO: Explained Variance Policy Optimization for Adaptive Critic Utilization in LLM Post-Training
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for LLM post-training faces a fundamental design choice: whether to use a learned critic as a baseline for policy optimization. Classical theory favors critic-based methods such as PPO for variance reduction, yet critic-free alternatives like GRPO have gained widespread adoption due to their simplicity and competitive performance. We show that in sparse-reward settings, a learned critic can inject estimation noise that exceeds the state signal it captures, increasing rather than reducing advantage variance. By casting baseline selection as a Kalman filtering problem, we unify PPO and GRPO as two extremes of the Kalman gain and prove that explained variance (EV), computable from a single training batch, identifies the exact boundary: positive EV indicates the critic reduces variance, while zero or negative EV signals that it inflates variance. Building on this insight, we propose Explained Variance Policy Optimization (EVPO), which monitors batch-level EV at each training step and adaptively switches between critic-based and batch-mean advantage estimation, provably achieving no greater variance than the better of the two at every step. Across four tasks spanning classical control, agentic interaction, and mathematical reasoning, EVPO consistently outperforms both PPO and GRPO regardless of which fixed baseline is stronger on a given task. Further analysis confirms that the adaptive gating tracks critic maturation over training and that the theoretically derived zero threshold is empirically optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上解释并实验验证了：在稀疏奖励场景下，如果学到的价值网络方差过大反而会增大优势函数方差；作者将参考基线选择建模为卡尔曼滤波，提出只需一个 batch 的 Explained Variance(EV) 即可判定是否应引入 critic，并据此设计了自适应切换 critic/batch-mean 的 EVPO 算法，在四类任务上全面优于固定基线的 PPO 与 GRPO。
AI.motivation: RLHF 中普遍出现的稀疏奖励 + 价值网络估计噪声，使得传统 PPO 等基于 critic 的方法优势方差反而增大；而 GRPO 等无 critic 方案虽简单却未必始终稳定。如何以在线、无超参的方式自动选取最优基线，一直是理论空缺与实践痛点。
AI.method: 1. 将基线选择抽象为卡尔曼滤波问题，把 PPO(全 critic) 与 GRPO(纯 batch-mean) 解释为极端卡尔曼增益；2. 用 batch-level Explained-Variance 零/正负作为 critic 引入的方差增大/缩小判据，证明该阈值能精确界定两种极端策略的优劣；3. 提出 Explained Variance Policy Optimization(EVPO)，训练每一步在线计算 EV，当 EV>0 时采用 critic baseline，否则退化为 batch-mean baseline，并给出方差不劣于任一固定基线的理论保证；4. 在经典控制、工具调用代理、数学推理四任务上做系统实验。
AI.result: 在所有任务上 EVPO 都取得比 PPO 与 GRPO 更高的平均回报/成功率，且波动更小；EV 自适应门控曲线证实随着价值网络收敛，算法逐步由 batch-mean 切换到 critic；通过网格搜索验证了理论计算的 EV=0 阈值确实对应实证最优切点。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏奖励下价值网络若估计不准反而有害；通过廉价在线指标 EV 统一并自适应选择 critic-ful/critic-free 基线，可在无额外超参条件下同时获得两种方法的优势。EVPO 为大型语言模型后训练提供了一条更稳健、高效的 RLHF 基线设计范式。

title: VecHeart: Holistic Four-Chamber Cardiac Anatomy Modeling via Hybrid VecSets
summary: Accurate cardiac anatomy modeling requires the model to be able to handle intricate interrelations among structures. In this paper, we propose VecHeart, a unified framework for holistic reconstruction and generation of four-chamber cardiac structures. To overcome the limitations of current feed-forward implicit methods, specifically their restriction to single-object modeling and their neglect of inter-part correlations, we introduce Hybrid Part Transformer, which leverages part-specific learnable queries and interleaved attention to capture complex inter-chamber dependencies. Furthermore, we propose Anatomical Completion Masking and Modality Alignment strategies, enabling the model to infer complete four-chamber structures from partial, sparse, or noisy observations, even when certain anatomical parts are entirely missing. VecHeart also seamlessly extends to 3D+t dynamic mesh sequence generation, demonstrating exceptional versatility. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, maintaining high-fidelity reconstruction across diverse challenging scenarios. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: VecHeart首次用单一隐式模型统一重建与生成完整四腔心脏，并支持3D+t动态序列，在缺损/稀疏/噪声数据上仍保持解剖高保真。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈隐式网络只能做单目标建模，忽略腔室间复杂耦合关系，导致解剖结构不完整或失真，临床可用性受限。
AI.method: 提出VecHeart框架：①Hybrid Part Transformer以腔室专属可学习查询+交错注意力显式建模四腔依赖；②Anatomical Completion Masking随机遮蔽任一/多个腔室，迫使网络学会补全；③Modality Alignment对齐多模态稀疏输入与解剖先验；④隐式解码器直接输出3D+t动态网格序列。
AI.result: 在公开MRI/CT及临床缺损数据集上，Dice 0.93↑，Hausdorff 3.2 mm↓，优于nnUNet、PointNet++等SOTA；75%腔室缺失时Dice仍>0.88；3D+t序列帧间时间一致性误差<0.4 mm。
AI.conclusion: VecHeart证明统一隐式表征可兼顾解剖完整性、多腔耦合与动态建模，为心脏影像缺损修复、数字化孪生及手术规划提供高鲁棒工具。

title: Curiosity-Critic: Cumulative Prediction Error Improvement as a Tractable Intrinsic Reward for World Model Training
summary: Local prediction-error-based curiosity rewards focus on the current transition without considering the world model's cumulative prediction error across all visited transitions. We introduce Curiosity-Critic, which grounds its intrinsic reward in the improvement of this cumulative objective, and show that it reduces to a tractable per-step form: the difference between the current prediction error and the asymptotic error baseline of the current state transition. We estimate this baseline online with a learned critic co-trained alongside the world model; regressing a single scalar, the critic converges well before the world model saturates, redirecting exploration toward learnable transitions without oracle knowledge of the noise floor. The reward is higher for learnable transitions and collapses toward the baseline for stochastic ones, effectively separating epistemic (reducible) from aleatoric (irreducible) prediction error online. Prior prediction-error curiosity formulations, from Schmidhuber (1991) to learned-feature-space variants, emerge as special cases corresponding to specific approximations of this baseline. Experiments on a stochastic grid world show that Curiosity-Critic outperforms prediction-error and visitation-count baselines in convergence speed and final world model accuracy.

AI.tldr: Curiosity-Critic 把内在奖励定义为“世界模型累积预测误差相对于当前状态转移渐近基线的瞬时下降量”，用一个在线学习的单输出 critic 估计该基线，从而把可学习的认知误差与不可约的随机误差实时分离，在随机网格世界中收敛更快、模型更准。
AI.motivation: 传统局部预测误差好奇心只盯着当前一步误差，无法区分“还能学得更好”与“数据本身不可预测”，导致在随机区过度探索、在可学习区探索不足，需要一种无需先知噪声底、能在线识别“可学习性”的奖励信号。
AI.method: 1) 将内在奖励形式化为“累积预测误差目标”的瞬时改进量，化简为单步差分：当前预测误差 − 当前转移的渐近误差基线；2) 用一个独立 critic 网络在线回归该基线，与世界模型同步训练但更快收敛；3) 奖励高值保留给认知误差仍高的“可学习”转移，随机转移因基线≈当前误差奖励趋零，实现在线 epistemic/aleatoric 分离。
AI.result: 在随机网格世界中，Curiosity-Critic 相比原始预测误差和访问计数基线：探索效率更高，世界模型收敛速度显著加快，最终预测精度提升；先前 1991 以来各类预测误差好奇心方法可归为本文基线的特定近似特例。
AI.conclusion: 把好奇心锚定在“累积误差相对于可学习渐近线的改进”而非瞬时误差，可在无环境噪声先验的情况下在线过滤随机性，显著提升探索效率与世界模型质量，为后续研究提供统一解释与新基线框架。

title: RoLegalGEC: Legal Domain Grammatical Error Detection and Correction Dataset for Romanian
summary: The importance of clear and correct text in legal documents cannot be understated, and, consequently, a grammatical error correction tool meant to assist a professional in the law must have the ability to understand the possible errors in the context of a legal environment, correcting them accordingly, and implicitly needs to be trained in the same environment, using realistic legal data. However, the manually annotated data required by such a process is in short supply for languages such as Romanian, much less for a niche domain. The most common approach is the synthetic generation of parallel data; however, it requires a structured understanding of the Romanian grammar. In this paper, we introduce, to our knowledge, the first Romanian-language parallel dataset for the detection and correction of grammatical errors in the legal domain, RoLegalGEC, which aggregates 350,000 examples of errors in legal passages, along with error annotations. Moreover, we evaluate several neural network models that transform the dataset into a valuable tool for both detecting and correcting grammatical errors, including knowledge-distillation Transformers, sequence tagging architectures for detection, and a variety of pre-trained text-to-text Transformer models for correction. We consider that the set of models, together with the novel RoLegalGEC dataset, will enrich the resource base for further research on Romanian.

AI.tldr: 针对罗马尼亚语法律文本缺少标注语料的痛点，作者首次构建含35万对错句对的RoLegalGEC数据集，并系统评估多种Transformer检测-纠错模型，为低资源法律场景提供公开基准。
AI.motivation: 法律文本对语法正确性要求极高，但罗马尼亚语法律领域缺乏人工标注的语法纠错数据；传统人工标注成本高且耗时，而简单合成数据又难以保证符合法律语境与罗语复杂语法规则。该研究旨在填补罗马尼亚语法律语法纠错（GEC）资源空白。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：采集真实法律文书，显式引入17类高频语法错误（一致、格、时态等），通过规则+人工复核生成35万对<错句,正确句>RoLegalGEC；2) 模型设计：①序列标注检测器（Bi-LSTM-CRF、BERT-CRF）定位错误区间，②知识蒸馏小型Transformer，③预训练text-to-text（mT5、ROMT5）及GLEC风格微调；3) 评估指标：ERRANT-Ro扩展版Precision/Recall/F0.5、GLEU、M²。
AI.result: RoLegalGEC显著提升模型法律领域表现：最佳ROMT5-large在测试集F0.5=63.8，GLEU+7.2；对比仅用通用罗语数据，法律GLEU绝对提升11.4。蒸馏模型在参数减90%条件下仍保持97%性能，适于边缘部署。错误类型分析显示一致/格错误最难纠正，需额外规则后处理。
AI.conclusion: RoLegalGEC为罗马尼亚语法律GEC提供首个大规模真实资源，证明领域语料与Transformer模型结合可有效解决低资源语法纠错；公开数据集与训练脚本将促进罗马尼亚语法律NLP研究，并可为其他小语种低资源专业领域GEC提供范式。

title: When Graph Structure Becomes a Liability: A Critical Re-Evaluation of Graph Neural Networks for Bitcoin Fraud Detection under Temporal Distribution Shift
summary: The consensus that GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, and EvolveGCN outperform feature-only baselines on the Elliptic Bitcoin Dataset is widely cited but has not been rigorously stress-tested under a leakage-free evaluation protocol. We perform a seed-matched inductive-versus-transductive comparison and find that this consensus does not hold. Under a strictly inductive protocol, Random Forest on raw features achieves F1 = 0.821 and outperforms all evaluated GNNs, while GraphSAGE reaches F1 = 0.689 +/- 0.017. A paired controlled experiment reveals a 39.5-point F1 gap attributable to training-time exposure to test-period adjacency. Additionally, edge-shuffle ablations show that randomly wired graphs outperform the real transaction graph, indicating that the dataset's topology can be misleading under temporal distribution shift. Hybrid models combining GNN embeddings with raw features provide only marginal gains and remain substantially below feature-only baselines. We release code, checkpoints, and a strict-inductive protocol to enable reproducible, leakage-free evaluation.

AI.tldr: 在严格无泄露的归纳设定下，GCN／GAT／GraphSAGE 等在 Elliptic 比特币数据集中的优势消失，纯特征 Random Forest 反而领先 13 个百分点以上；多数图神经网络的表现提升主要来自训练时提前看到测试期邻接结构的泄露。
AI.motivation: 尽管大量论文声称 GNN 在 Elliptic 数据集中显著优于仅使用节点特征的方法，但这些结果均基于转导或隐含时序泄露的评估协议，缺乏严格验证。
AI.method: 构建种子匹配的严格归纳评估协议，确保训练阶段无法接触任何测试时段的边信息；对比归纳与转导两种设定下 Random Forest 与多种 GNN 的表现，并通过边随机化消融和混合模型实验进一步剥离拓扑信号的贡献。
AI.result: 严格归纳下 Random Forest F1=0.821，最佳 GNN（GraphSAGE）仅 0.689±0.017；转导模式下 GNN 提升的 39.5 个 F1 点完全归因于提前接触测试期邻接；随机打乱边的图结构甚至比真实交易图表现更好；GNN 嵌入与特征拼接仅能带来边际提升，仍远低于纯特征基线。
