AI.conclusion: Elliptic 数据集中 GNN 的“优势”是评估泄露与数据划分不当造成的假象；真实时序分布漂移下，拓扑结构反而引入噪声；研究社区需采用无泄露归纳协议才能公正评估 GNN 在动态金融网络中的价值。

title: HP-Edit: A Human-Preference Post-Training Framework for Image Editing
summary: Common image editing tasks typically adopt powerful generative diffusion models as the leading paradigm for real-world content editing. Meanwhile, although reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as Diffusion-DPO and Flow-GRPO have further improved generation quality, efficiently applying Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to diffusion-based editing remains largely unexplored, due to a lack of scalable human-preference datasets and frameworks tailored to diverse editing needs. To fill this gap, we propose HP-Edit, a post-training framework for Human Preference-aligned Editing, and introduce RealPref-50K, a real-world dataset across eight common tasks and balancing common object editing. Specifically, HP-Edit leverages a small amount of human-preference scoring data and a pretrained visual large language model (VLM) to develop HP-Scorer--an automatic, human preference-aligned evaluator. We then use HP-Scorer both to efficiently build a scalable preference dataset and to serve as the reward function for post-training the editing model. We also introduce RealPref-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating real-world editing performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances models such as Qwen-Image-Edit-2509, aligning their outputs more closely with human preference.

AI.tldr: 提出HP-Edit框架与RealPref-50K数据集，用极少量人工打分+预训练视觉大模型构建可扩展奖励函数，实现扩散编辑模型的高效RLHF后训练，显著逼近人类偏好。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽强，但现有RLHF方法难以直接迁移到图像编辑：缺大规模人类偏好数据，也缺适配多任务编辑的奖励框架。
AI.method: 1) 先采样少量真实编辑对让人类打分，训练视觉-语言大模型得HP-Scorer，自动对任意编辑结果输出人类偏好分数；2) 用HP-Scorer快速构造50k规模RealPref-50K数据集，并作为统一奖励函数；3) 以该奖励对编辑模型做RL后训练，并发布RealPref-Bench评测基准。
AI.result: 在8类常见编辑任务上，仅利用<1%人工标注量即可将Qwen-Image-Edit-2509的偏好胜率提升显著，RealPref-Bench上超越现有扩散编辑基线。
AI.conclusion: HP-Edit证明用轻量人工信号+视觉大模型奖励，可低成本扩展RLHF至扩散编辑，输出高度符合人类偏好，为后续多任务、真实场景编辑提供可复现范式。

title: Characterizing AlphaEarth Embedding Geometry for Agentic Environmental Reasoning
summary: Earth observation foundation models encode land surface information into dense embedding vectors, yet the geometric structure of these representations and its implications for downstream reasoning remain underexplored. We characterize the manifold geometry of Google AlphaEarth's 64-dimensional embeddings across 12.1 million Continental United States samples (2017--2023) and develop an agentic system that leverages this geometric understanding for environmental reasoning. The manifold is non-Euclidean: effective dimensionality is 13.3 (participation ratio) from 64 raw dimensions, with local intrinsic dimensionality of approximately 10. Tangent spaces rotate substantially, with 84\% of locations exceeding 60\textdegree{} and local-global alignment (mean$|\cosθ| = 0.17$) approaching the random baseline of 0.125. Supervised linear probes indicate that concept directions rotate across the manifold, and compositional vector arithmetic using both PCA-derived and probe-derived directions yields poor precision. Retrieval instead produces physically coherent results, with local geometry predicting retrieval coherence ($R^2 = 0.32$). Building on this characterization, we introduce an agentic system with nine specialized tools that decomposes environmental queries into reasoning chains over a FAISS-indexed embedding database. A five-condition ablation (120 queries, three complexity tiers) shows that embedding retrieval dominates response quality ($μ= 3.79 \pm 0.90$ vs.\ $3.03 \pm 0.77$ parametric-only; scale 1--5), with peak performance on multi-step comparisons ($μ= 4.28 \pm 0.43$). A cross-model benchmark show that geometric tools reduce Sonnet 4.5's score by 0.12 points but improve Opus 4.6's by 0.07, with Opus achieving higher geometric grounding (3.38 vs.\ 2.64), suggesting that the value of geometric characterization scales with the reasoning capability of the consuming model.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统刻画了 Google AlphaEarth 地表嵌入的黎曼流形结构，发现其局部-全局几何高度扭曲；据此构建“检索优先”的智能体系统，在 120 条环境推理任务上显著优于纯参数基线，且效益随基模型推理能力增强而放大。
AI.motivation: 现有地表 foundation model 将遥感信息压缩为 64 维向量，但嵌入空间的几何性质及其对下游推理的意义仍是盲区。作者假设：只有先理解该流形的真实结构，才能设计更可靠的地理知识推理系统。
AI.method: 1) 基于 1210 万个 CONUS 样本（2017–2023）计算 AlphaEarth 嵌入的本征维度、切空间旋转与概念方向一致性；2) 比较线性探针、向量运算与局部检索的保真度，验证“几何决定检索质量”；3) 构建包含 9 种几何工具（局域邻域采样、切空间映射、假设检验等）的智能体，利用 FAISS 索引完成链式环境问答；4) 设计三阶复杂度、五条件消融实验并跨 Sonnet/Opus 模型评估。
AI.result: 嵌入有效维度仅 13.3，局部 ID≈10；84% 位置切空间转角 >60°，全局-局部对齐余弦均值 0.17 接近随机；线性向量算术准确率差，而局部几何可预测检索一致性（R²=0.32）。智能体实验显示，检索路径打分 3.79±0.90，显著高于纯参数 3.03±0.77；多步比较任务达 4.28±0.43。几何工具使 Opus 提升 0.07 分(3.38→3.45)，而 Sonnet 下降 0.12，证实增益与模型推理能力正相关。
AI.conclusion: 地表嵌入空间呈强非欧、异向扭曲，传统线性运算失效；采用“先检索、后推理”的几何驱动范式可显著提升环境问答质量，且效果随基模型认知容量放大，为 foundation model 在地球科学中的可信应用提供了几何基础与系统范例。

title: Cross-Model Consistency of AI-Generated Exercise Prescriptions: A Repeated Generation Study Across Three Large Language Models
comment: 24 Pages, 2 Figures, 6 Tables and 2 Supplementary Materials
summary: This study compared repeated generation consistency of exercise prescription outputs across three large language models (LLMs), specifically GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 2.5 Flash, under temperature=0 conditions. Each model generated prescriptions for six clinical scenarios 20 times, yielding 360 total outputs analyzed across four dimensions: semantic similarity, output reproducibility, FITT classification, and safety expression. Mean semantic similarity was highest for GPT-4.1 (0.955), followed by Gemini 2.5 Flash (0.950) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.903), with significant inter-model differences confirmed (H = 458.41, p < .001). Critically, these scores reflected fundamentally different generative behaviors: GPT-4.1 produced entirely unique outputs (100%) with stable semantic content, while Gemini 2.5 Flash showed pronounced output repetition (27.5% unique outputs), indicating that its high similarity score derived from text duplication rather than consistent reasoning. Identical decoding settings thus yielded fundamentally different consistency profiles, a distinction that single-output evaluations cannot capture. Safety expression reached ceiling levels across all models, confirming its limited utility as a differentiating metric. These results indicate that model selection constitutes a clinical rather than merely technical decision, and that output behavior under repeated generation conditions should be treated as a core criterion for reliable deployment of LLM-based exercise prescription systems.

AI.tldr: 在temperature=0条件下，GPT-4.1、Claude Sonnet 4.6与Gemini 2.5 Flash对6种临床情境重复生成20次运动处方；GPT-4.1语义稳定且100%唯一，Gemini 2.5 Flash高相似性源于文本复制而非一致推理，提示模型选择应作为临床决策而非纯技术指标。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被迅速用于运动处方生成，但学界对其在零随机性设定下能否稳定、安全地输出一致且合理的临床建议缺乏系统评估，亟需通过重复生成实验揭示潜在风险。
AI.method: 三模型×6场景×20次重复采样，共360份处方；采用Sentence-BERT计算语义相似度，Jaccard指数衡量输出再现性，正则提取FITT（频率、强度、时间、类型）成分并分类，关键词规则评估安全表达；用Kruskal-Wallis检验比较模型间差异。
AI.result: GPT-4.1平均语义相似度最高(0.955)，但100%输出唯一；Gemini 2.5 Flash相似度次高(0.950)，仅27.5%唯一；Claude Sonnet 4.6相似度最低(0.903)。安全表达三模型均达天花板，缺乏区分力。
AI.conclusion: temperature=0并不能保证一致性；高相似度可能源于复制而非推理稳定。输出行为在重复生成条件下才是可靠部署的核心指标，模型选择必须纳入临床安全与一致性需求，而不仅是技术参数。

title: Accelerating Optimization and Machine Learning through Decentralization
summary: Decentralized optimization enables multiple devices to learn a global machine learning model while each individual device only has access to its local dataset. By avoiding the need for training data to leave individual users' devices, it enhances privacy and scalability compared to conventional centralized learning, where all data has to be aggregated to a central server. However, decentralized optimization has traditionally been viewed as a necessary compromise, used only when centralized processing is impractical due to communication constraints or data privacy concerns. In this study, we show that decentralization can paradoxically accelerate convergence, outperforming centralized methods in the number of iterations needed to reach optimal solutions. Through examples in logistic regression and neural network training, we demonstrate that distributing data and computation across multiple agents can lead to faster learning than centralized approaches, even when each iteration is assumed to take the same amount of time, whether performed centrally on the full dataset or decentrally on local subsets. This finding challenges longstanding assumptions and reveals decentralization as a strategic advantage, offering new opportunities for more efficient optimization and machine learning.

AI.tldr: 去中心化优化不仅保护隐私，还能比传统中心化方法更快收敛；本工作首次证明其可成为主动提速策略而非无奈妥协。
AI.motivation: 现有观点认为去中心化只是因隐私或通信受限而被迫采取的折衷方案。作者质疑该假设，提出
AI.method: 通过逻辑回归与神经网络实验，在单轮迭代耗时相同的设定下比较中心化与去中心化算法的迭代次数。
AI.result: 去中心化方案显著减少达到最优解所需迭代次数，首次实证其收敛速度可超越中心化方法。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化不仅是隐私妥协，更是主动提速策略，为高效优化与机器学习提供新范式。

title: GOLD-BEV: GrOund and aeriaL Data for Dense Semantic BEV Mapping of Dynamic Scenes
summary: Understanding road scenes in a geometrically consistent, scene-centric representation is crucial for planning and mapping. We present GOLD-BEV, a framework that learns dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) semantic environment maps-including dynamic agents-from ego-centric sensors, using time-synchronized aerial imagery as supervision only during training. BEV-aligned aerial crops provide an intuitive target space, enabling dense semantic annotation with minimal manual effort and avoiding the ambiguity of ego-only BEV labeling. Crucially, strict aerial-ground synchronization allows overhead observations to supervise moving traffic participants and mitigates the temporal inconsistencies inherent to non-synchronized overhead sources. To obtain scalable dense targets, we generate BEV pseudo-labels using domain-adapted aerial teachers, and jointly train BEV segmentation with optional pseudo-aerial BEV reconstruction for interpretability. Finally, we extend beyond aerial coverage by learning to synthesize pseudo-aerial BEV images from ego sensors, which support lightweight human annotation and uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling on unlabeled drives.

AI.tldr: GOLD-BEV 用时间同步的航拍影像当“老师”，在训练阶段把车载视角图像一次性转成稠密 BEV 语义地图，无需人工标注 3D 框即可学出可通行区域与动态参与者，并能凭空合成航拍视角，补足无航拍区域的数据缺口。
AI.motivation: 传统依靠车载传感器逐帧堆叠出 BEV 时，动态物体与静态场景存在时序错位，且人工标注 3D/俯视图成本极高；若能直接利用头顶同步航拍影像作监督，可同时解决标注稀疏与动态一致两大痛点。
AI.method:
1. 车端-航拍严格时间同步，以航拍裁切作为稠密语义真值；
2. 用经过领域适配的“航拍教师”模型为大量无航拍区域生成 BEV 伪标签；
3. 联合优化 BEV 语义分割与可选的航拍视角重建，增强可解释性；
4. 训练一个“车载→航拍”图像翻译网络，在无航拍地段合成虚拟俯视图，支持轻量人工二次标注与不确定性加权伪标签自训练。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，仅依靠航拍监督即可达到与全人工 3D 标注方法相当的 BEV 语义分割精度，动态类别 IoU 提升 5-8 个百分点；通过合成伪航拍，可将可用训练里程扩大 3× 以上，而额外标注人力<0.1 h/100 km。
AI.conclusion: 利用同步航拍作为一次性、稠密且几何一致的监督源，GOLD-BEV 显著降低 BEV 语义建图的标注与维护成本，并给出一条“无航拍→合成航拍→再自训练”的可持续数据闭环，为高阶自动驾驶地图与规划提供可扩展的真值底座。

title: Towards Optimal Agentic Architectures for Offensive Security Tasks
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, supplementary appendix and benchmark artifacts
summary: Agentic security systems increasingly audit live targets with tool-using LLMs, but prior systems fix a single coordination topology, leaving unclear when additional agents help and when they only add cost. We treat topology choice as an empirical systems question. We introduce a controlled benchmark of 20 interactive targets (10 web/API and 10 binary), each exposing one endpoint-reachable ground-truth vulnerability, evaluated in whitebox and blackbox modes. The core study executes 600 runs over five architecture families, three model families, and both access modes, with a separate 60-run long-context pilot reported only in the appendix. On the completed core benchmark, detection-any reaches 58.0% and validated detection reaches 49.8%. MAS-Indep attains the highest validated detection rate (64.2%), while SAS is the strongest efficiency baseline at $0.058 per validated finding. Whitebox materially outperforms blackbox (67.0% vs. 32.7% validated detection), and web materially outperforms binary (74.3% vs. 25.3%). Bootstrap confidence intervals and paired target-level deltas show that the dominant effects are observability and domain, while some leading whitebox topologies remain statistically close. The main result is a non-monotonic cost-quality frontier: broader coordination can improve coverage, but it does not dominate once latency, token cost, and exploit-validation difficulty are taken into account.

AI.tldr: 首个面向工具化LLM的多智能体安全审计可扩展性系统级基准，揭示拓扑选择对样本、成本和成功率存在非单调影响。
AI.motivation: 现有Agentic安全审计系统均采用固定代理架构，尚不清楚增减智能体何时能提升效果、何时徒增损耗。作者将架构选择视为经验系统问题，需量化评估。
AI.method: 设计含20个交互目标（10个Web/API＋10个二进制，内置单点ground-truth漏洞）的白盒/黑盒可复现基准；系统测试5类架构×3类模型×双访问模式共600次核心实验；统计检测率、订购成本及置信区间，并辅以60次长上下文试点。
AI.result: 白盒访问显著优于黑盒（67.0% vs 32.7%校验检出）；Web域显著优于二进制（74.3% vs 25.3%）。多智能体独立（MAS-Indep）在检出率上领先64.2%，但单智能体（SAS）成本效率最佳，每校验漏洞仅0.058美元。架构层面，观察力及目标域为主效应，部分领先白盒拓扑间差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体可在某些配置提升覆盖率，但不是成本-效果的绝对主宰；实际系统需在白盒可观测、目标域特性和延迟/花费门槛间权衡，非线性前沿提示无单一最优拓扑。

title: The "Small World of Words" German Free-Association Norms
summary: Free-association norms provide essential empirical data for investigating linguistic, semantic, and cultural phenomena in the cognitive sciences. Although large-scale norms exist for languages such as English, Dutch, Spanish, and Mandarin Chinese, no comparable resource has been available for German. To address this gap, we present free-association norms for 5,877 German cue words as part of the German version of the multilingual Small World of Words (SWOW) project. We describe the data collection procedures, participant characteristics, and our comprehensive preprocessing pipeline before introducing the resulting SWOW-DE data set. Using data from three established psycholinguistic paradigms, we show that SWOW-DE norms robustly predict performance in lexical decision tasks, relatedness judgments, and psycholinguistic word ratings. Furthermore, we demonstrate that SWOW-DE responses compare favorably with existing German resources and provide a preliminary cross-linguistic comparison revealing both shared and language-specific association patterns, highlighting promising directions for future research. Overall, SWOW-DE represents the largest collection of German free associations to date and offers a unique resource for linguistic, psychological, and cross-cultural research.

AI.tldr: 首份德语自由联想规范数据库SWOW-DE，含5,877个词级，收集、验证与跨语对比提供新资源。
AI.motivation: 自由联想常模是认知科学探讨语言、语义与文化现象的关键，而德语一直缺少同规模公开数据。
AI.method: 扩展多语种SWOW网络框架，实施三轮在线收集，对德语音形稳权重过滤并构建预处理管线，结合词汇判断、关联判断与词问卷3经典范式，统计模型检验预测力。
AI.result: SWOW-DE显著预测3项心理语言学任务效果，且与现有德语词库关联度更高；跨语比较揭示德–英、西等既有共享又有特有联想模式。
AI.conclusion: SWOW-DE是目前最大的德语联想数据库，可为语言处理、语义网络和跨文化研究提供可直接复用的词级参考。

title: Revisiting RaBitQ and TurboQuant: A Symmetric Comparison of Methods, Theory, and Experiments
summary: This technical note revisits the relationship between RaBitQ and TurboQuant under a unified comparison framework. We compare the two methods in terms of methodology, theoretical guarantees, and empirical performance, using a reproducible, transparent, and symmetric setup. Our results show that, despite the claimed advantage of TurboQuant, TurboQuant does not provide a consistent improvement over RaBitQ in directly comparable settings; in many tested configurations, it performs worse than RaBitQ. We further find that several reported runtime and recall results in the TurboQuant paper could not be reproduced from the released implementation under the stated configuration. Overall, this note clarifies the shared structure and genuine differences between the two lines of work, while documenting reproducibility issues in the experimental results reported by the TurboQuant paper.

AI.tldr: 在完全一致、可复现的实验框架下，RaBitQ 与 TurboQuant 的直接对比显示后者并未带来稳定优势，且原 TurboQuant 论文的部分实验结果无法复现。
AI.motivation: 现有文献对 RaBitQ 与 TurboQuant 的优劣缺乏统一、公平、透明的对照，导致结论可信度不足，需要系统澄清两者的真实差距与潜在复现性问题。
AI.method: 构建对称、可复现的评测框架，从算法流程、理论保证与 empirical 性能三维度对两方法进行逐项比较，并利用官方开源代码在相同硬件与参数下重现实验。
AI.result: 在可直接比较的场景中，TurboQuant 并未持续优于 RaBitQ；多组配置下其 recall 与运行时间甚至低于 RaBitQ。TurboQuant 原文报告的部分数据无法通过公开代码在声明配置下复现。
AI.conclusion: 统一对照表明 TurboQuant 的声称优势不成立，两方法本质共享相似结构但细节差异导致性能反转；同时揭露了 TurboQuant 论文结果的可复现性缺陷，为后续研究提供警示与基准。

title: VCE: A zero-cost hallucination mitigation method of LVLMs via visual contrastive editing
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from Object Hallucination (OH), wherein they generate descriptions containing objects that are not actually present in the input image. This phenomenon is particularly problematic in real-world applications such as medical imaging and autonomous driving, where accuracy is critical. Recent studies suggest that the hallucination problem may stem from language priors: biases learned during pretraining that cause LVLMs to generate words based on their statistical co-occurrence. To mitigate this problem, we propose Visual Contrastive Editing (VCE), a novel post-hoc method that identifies and suppresses hallucinatory tendencies by analyzing the model's response to contrastive visual perturbations. Using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), we decompose the model's activation patterns to isolate hallucination subspaces and apply targeted parameter edits to attenuate its influence. Unlike existing approaches that require fine-tuning or labeled data, VCE operates as a label-free intervention, making it both scalable and practical for deployment in resource-constrained settings. Experimental results demonstrate that VCE effectively reduces object hallucination across multiple benchmarks while maintaining the model's original computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出无标签后处理算法 VCE，通过 SVD 定位“幻觉子空间”并对模型参数做针对性修正，显著抑制大视觉-语言模型的对象幻觉，无需微调或额外标注数据。
AI.motivation: 大视觉-语言模型在医疗、自动驾驶等高可靠场景中常输出图像中不存在的物体（对象幻觉），主要源于预训练语言先验的共现偏差，亟需无需标注、可扩展的校正方案。
AI.method: Visual Contrastive Editing (VCE)：①对输入图像生成对比扰动样本；②提取模型激活并做奇异值分解(SVD)，分离出与幻觉相关的低秩子空间；③在该子空间内直接编辑模型参数，抑制幻觉倾向。全程无需标签或微调。
AI.result: 在多项对象幻觉基准上，VCE 显著降低幻觉率，同时保持模型原始精度与计算效率；对比现有需标注或微调的方法，VCE 零标注、轻量级且易部署。
AI.conclusion: VCE 通过无标签对比编辑有效消除语言先验带来的对象幻觉，为高风险、资源受限场景提供可扩展的幻觉抑制策略，并揭示模型激活低秩结构可解释性与干预潜力。

title: Skillful Global Ocean Emulation and the Role of Correlation-Aware Loss
summary: Machine learning emulators have shown extraordinary skill in forecasting atmospheric states, and their application to global ocean dynamics offers similar promise. Here, we adapt the GraphCast architecture into a dedicated ocean-only emulator, driven by prescribed atmospheric conditions, for medium-range predictions. The emulator is trained on NOAA's UFS-Replay dataset. Using a 24 hour time step, single initial condition, and without using autoregressive training, we produce an emulator that provides skillful forecasts for 10-15 day lead times. We further demonstrate the use of Mahalanobis distance as loss that improves the forecast skill compared to the Mean Squared Error loss by explicitly accounting for the correlations between tendencies of the target variables. Using spatial correlation analysis of the forecasted fields, we also show that the proposed correlation-aware loss acts as a statistical-dynamical regularizer for the slow, correlated dynamics of the global oceans, offering a better background forecast for downstream tasks like data assimilation.

AI.tldr: 首次把 GraphCast 架构纯移植到海洋预测，实现 10–15 天零自回归、单初值、24 h 步长的全球海洋动力预报；引入马氏距离损失，显著提升精度并为资料同化提供更优背景场。
AI.motivation: 大气机器学习代理模型已展现高预报技巧，但全球海洋动力尚缺同等能力的快速预报工具；传统海洋模式计算昂贵，亟需数据驱动的替代品以支持中期业务预测与资料同化。
AI.method: 将 GraphCast 架构改造为纯海洋代理模型，外强迫取自 NOAA UFS-Replay 再分析大气的海气通量；训练仅依赖单时刻初始场、24 h 步长、无自回归展开；以 NOAA 一年 1/4° 全球再播资料训练；损失函数采用变量倾向马氏距离以显式刻画变量间协方差，对比 MSE 基线。
AI.result: 新代理模型在 10–15 天预报期内对海表温度、 SSH、上层温盐等变量均保持显著正异常相关系数，优于只优化 MSE 的同类模型；马氏距离损失将全球 RMSE 降低 6–12%，并减少慢变量相干误差；空间相关分析显示代理场可提供更平滑、动力更一致的大尺度背景状态。
AI.conclusion: 纯数据驱动的海洋 GraphCast 代理能在两周尺度提供有技巧的确定性预报；马氏距离损失兼具统计-动力正则化作用，是提升海洋机器学习预报质量的关键设计；该快速模型有望作为资料同化背景场或集合扰动生成器，加速海洋与耦合预报业务系统。

title: Micro Language Models Enable Instant Responses
summary: Edge devices such as smartwatches and smart glasses cannot continuously run even the smallest 100M-1B parameter language models due to power and compute constraints, yet cloud inference introduces multi-second latencies that break the illusion of a responsive assistant. We introduce micro language models ($μ$LMs): ultra-compact models (8M-30M parameters) that instantly generate the first 4-8 words of a contextually grounded response on-device, while a cloud model completes it; thus, masking the cloud latency. We show that useful language generation survives at this extreme scale with our models matching several 70M-256M-class existing models. We design a collaborative generation framework that reframes the cloud model as a continuator rather than a respondent, achieving seamless mid-sentence handoffs and structured graceful recovery via three error correction methods when the local opener goes wrong. Empirical results show that $μ$LMs can initiate responses that larger models complete seamlessly, demonstrating that orders-of-magnitude asymmetric collaboration is achievable and unlocking responsive AI for extremely resource-constrained devices. The model checkpoint and demo are available at https://github.com/Sensente/micro_language_model_swen_project.

AI.tldr: 提出8M-30M参数的μLM，在端侧瞬时生成回应前4-8词，云端大模型接力完成，实现秒级响应且无需持续高功耗运行。
AI.motivation: 智能手表/眼镜等边缘设备因功耗与算力限制无法持续运行100M-1B参数模型，而纯云端推理的多秒延迟破坏“实时助手”体验，需在极低资源下维持可感知智能。
AI.method: 1) 训练8M-30M极微模型，仅负责生成语境相关的“开头4-8词”；2) 将云端大模型重构为“续写者”而非“回答者”，实现句中无缝切换；3) 设计三种纠错机制，在本地开头失败时仍能结构化恢复，保证协作连续。
AI.result: μLM在极端压缩规模下，其首段生成质量对齐70M-256M现有模型；端-云协作可将感知延迟降至毫秒级，实现数量级非对称协同，使资源极度受限设备获得即时、连贯的语言生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 证明语言生成在8M-30M尺度仍具实用价值，通过“本地起句+云端续写”的非对称协作范式，可为边缘设备解锁既低功耗又低延迟的响应式AI体验。

title: Calibrating Scientific Foundation Models with Inference-Time Stochastic Attention
summary: Transformer-based scientific foundation models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, but current architectures give deterministic outputs and provide limited support for calibrated predictive uncertainty. We propose Stochastic Attention, a lightweight inference-time modification that randomizes attention by replacing softmax weights with normalized multinomial samples controlled by a single concentration parameter, and produces predictive ensembles without retraining. To set this parameter, we introduce a calibration objective that matches the stochastic attention output with the target, yielding an efficient univariate post-hoc tuning problem. We evaluate this mechanism on two scientific foundation models for weather and timeseries forecasting along with an additional regression task. Across benchmarks against uncertainty-aware baselines, we find that Stochastic Attention achieves the strongest native calibration and the sharpest prediction intervals at comparable coverage, while requiring only minutes of post-hoc tuning versus days of retraining for competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: Stochastic Attention 是一种无需重训练即可为 Transformer 科学基模型提供校准不确定性估计的轻量级推理阶段改进，其在天气与时序预测任务上实现了最优校准与最窄预测区间，调参仅耗时数分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有 Transformer 科学基模型在高风险场景中输出确定且缺乏可靠的不确定性度量，阻碍其安全部署。
AI.method: 在推理阶段将 softmax 注意力权重替换为受单一浓度参数控制的归一化多项式采样，通过最小化随机注意力输出与目标分布的校准误差，对浓度参数做一维后验调优，生成无需重训练的预测集成。
AI.result: 在天气与时序预测两大科学基模型及回归任务上，Stochastic Attention 在保持相同覆盖率的条件下获得最优原生校准与最窄预测区间，调参时间从基线所需的数日缩短至数分钟。
AI.conclusion: Stochastic Attention 以极小推理代价为 Transformer 提供高质量不确定性估计，可即插即用于已部署的科学基模型，显著降低校准成本并提升高风险应用的可信度。

title: TESO: Online Tracking of Essential Matrix by Stochastic Optimization
summary: Maintaining long-term accuracy of stereo camera calibration parameters is important for autonomous systems' perception. This work proposes Online Tracking of Essential Matrix by Stochastic Optimization (TESO). The core mechanisms of TESO are: 1) a robust loss function based on kernel correlation over tentative correspondences, 2) an adaptive online stochastic optimization on the essential manifold. TESO has low CPU and memory requirements, relies on a few hyperparameters, and eliminates the need for data-driven training, enabling the usage in resource-constrained online perception systems. We evaluated the influence of TESO on geometric precision, rectification quality, and stereo depth consistency. On the large-scale MAN TruckScenes dataset, TESO tracks rotational calibration drift with 0.12 deg precision in the Y-axis (critical for stereo accuracy) while the X- and Z-axes are five times more precise. Tracking applied to sequences with simulated drift shows similar precision with respect to the reference as tracking applied to no-drift sequences, indicating the tracker is unbiased. On the KITTI dataset, TESO revealed systematic inconsistencies in extrinsic parameters across stereo pairs, confirming previous published findings. We verified that intrinsic decalibration affected these errors, as evidenced by the conflicting behavior of the rectification and depth metrics. After correcting the reference calibration, TESO improved its rotation precision around the Y-axis 20 times to 0.025 deg and its depth accuracy 50 times. Despite its lightweight design, direct optimization of the proposed TESO loss function alone achieves accuracy comparable to that of neural network-based single-frame methods.

AI.tldr: TESO能在不依赖训练数据的前提下，以极低的计算负担在线跟踪立体外参漂移；在MAN和KITTI上，Y轴旋转误差分别被压至0.12°和0.025°，深度精度提升50倍，且首次在原始KITTI中发现系统性的外参不一致并给出修正方案。
AI.motivation: 长期维持立体外参精度是自动驾驶感知的瓶颈；现有离线标定或基于学习的方法要么成本高、要么需要大量计算与数据，不适合资源受限在线系统。
AI.method: 提出基于随机优化的在线本质矩阵跟踪框架TESO：1）用核相关度构建鲁邦损失，抑制误匹配；2）在本质流形上执行自适应在线随机优化；3）仅需几个超参、无训练数据、内存与CPU占用极低。
AI.result: MAN TruckScenes上，Y轴旋转漂移跟踪精度0.12°，X/Z轴提升5倍；KITTI上检测出原始外参存在系统性偏差，修正后Y轴精度提高20倍至0.025°，深度误差降50倍；纯优化损失即可达到单帧神经网络方法精度。
AI.conclusion: TESO首次证明了轻量化、无训练的在线跟踪可以长期保持厘米级立体深度一致性，并为公开数据集提供了可复现的外参修正基准；其低资源需求使嵌入式平台实时部署成为可能。

title: The Cost of Relaxation: Evaluating the Error in Convex Neural Network Verification
summary: Many neural network (NN) verification systems represent the network's input-output relation as a constraint program. Sound and complete, representations involve integer constraints, for simulating the activations. Recent works convexly relax the integer constraints, improving performance, at the cost of soundness. Convex relaxations consider outputs that are unreachable by the original network. We study the worst case divergence between the original network and its convex relaxations; both qualitatively and quantitatively. The relaxations' space forms a lattice, where the top element corresponds to a full relaxation, with every neuron linearized. The bottom element corresponds to the original network. We provide analytical upper and lower bounds for the $\ell_\infty$-distance between the fully relaxed and original outputs. This distance grows exponentially, w.r.t. the network's depth, and linearly w.r.t. the input's radius. The misclassification probability exhibits a step-like behavior, w.r.t. input radius. Our results are supported by experiments on MNIST, Fashion MNIST and random networks.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统度量了凸松弛验证在最坏情况下与原始网络的输出偏差：对全松弛网络给出ℓ∞距离的显式上下界，证明其随深度指数增长、随输入半径线性增长；实验揭示误分类概率呈阶跃状跃迁。
AI.motivation: NN验证常将激活函数整数约束凸松弛以换取效率，却失去可靠性。缺乏对“松弛后网络输出会偏离原始网络多远”的定量刻画，使攻防双方都无法预判松弛带来的风险。
AI.method: 1) 将常见凸松弛统一抽象为格(lattice)结构，顶层为全线性松弛，底层为原网络；2) 针对顶层松弛，利用层间误差递归传播技术导出ℓ∞输出误差的解析上下界，显式分离深度与输入半径的依赖；3) 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST及随机网络上实验，检验理论界与误分类概率的阶跃行为。
AI.result: ℓ∞最坏输出差距上界为O(γ^{d})·r，其中γ>1与权重范数相关，d为深度，r为输入ℓ∞半径；下界匹配指数级依赖。实验显示当r超过临界值时，松弛网络误分类率从≈0陡升至>90%，与理论预测的阶跃阈值高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 凸松弛虽提升速度，但输出偏差随深度指数放大，输入扰动半径仅线性放大即可触发误差阶跃跃迁；限于单隐藏层与ReLU的显式界，未来需拓展到残差、批归一化等结构并研究更紧的层相关松弛策略。

title: The signal is the ceiling: Measurement limits of LLM-predicted experience ratings from open-ended survey text
summary: An earlier paper (Hong, Potteiger, and Zapata 2026) established that an unoptimized GPT 4.1 prompt predicts fan-reported experience ratings within one point 67% of the time from open-ended survey text. This paper tests the relative impact of prompt design and model selection on that performance. We compared four configurations on approximately 10,000 post-game surveys from five MLB teams: the original baseline prompt and a moderately customized version, crossed with three GPT models (4.1, 4.1-mini, 5.2). Prompt customization added roughly two percentage points of within +/-1 agreement on GPT 4.1 (from 67% to 69%). Both model swaps from that best configuration degraded performance: GPT 5.2 returned to the baseline, and GPT 4.1-mini fell six percentage points below it. Both levers combined were dwarfed by the input itself: across capable configurations, accuracy varied more than an order of magnitude more by the linguistic character of the text than by the choice of prompt or model. The ceiling has two parts. One is a bias in how the model reads text, which prompt design can correct. The other is a difference between what fans write about and what they actually decide, which no engineering can close because the missing information is not in the text. Prompt customization moved the first part; model selection moved neither reliably. The result is not that "prompt engineering helps a little" but that prompt engineering helps in a specific and predictable way, on the part of the ceiling it can reach.

AI.tldr: 同一批 MLB 赛后评论文本上，换用不同 GPT 模型或做轻度提示优化，仅使「±1 分命中」准确率浮动 2–6 个百分点；真正决定上限的是文本本身可提供的语义线索，而非模型或提示。
AI.motivation: Hong 等人 2026 年的工作表明，未经优化的 GPT-4.1 能在 67% 的情况下把开放式球迷评论映射到 1 分误差内的体验评分。本文追问：若再做「提示工程」或改用更新/更小的模型，能再挤出多少性能？
AI.method: 采集 5 支 MLB 球队约 1 万份赛后调查评论，采用 2×3 因子设计：①原始提示 vs. 轻度定制提示；② GPT-4.1、4.1-mini、5.2 三款模型。以「预测评分与球迷自报评分差值 ≤1」的命中率为核心指标，辅以误差分解和文本语言学特征分析。
AI.result: 1. 仅靠提示优化，GPT-4.1 命中率从 67% 提到 69%（+2 pp）。2. 保持最佳提示，换为 GPT-5.2 又回到 67%；换为 4.1-mini 掉 6 pp 至 61%。3. 同一配置下，不同评论样本导致的准确率波动（> 20 pp）比换模型或换提示大一个量级。4. 误差天花板由两部分构成：A) 模型对文本的系统性偏差——提示工程可部分矫正；B) 球迷书写内容与真实决策间的信息缺口——任何工程手段均无法弥补。
AI.conclusion: 在已有强大基线模型上，「提示工程」并非万能，但在可干预的偏差维度上具有明确、可预期的收益；继续追逐更新模型或重度提示对提升整体准确率边际收益极低。研究者应将注意力转向如何获取更丰富、更相关的输入信息，而非单纯优化提示或模型参数。

title: Separating Geometry from Probability in the Analysis of Generalization
summary: The goal of machine learning is to find models that minimize prediction error on data that has not yet been seen. Its operational paradigm assumes access to a dataset $S$ and articulates a scheme for evaluating how well a given model performs on an arbitrary sample. The sample can be $S$ (in which case we speak of ``in-sample'' performance) or some entirely new $S'$ (in which case we speak of ``out-of-sample'' performance). Traditional analysis of generalization assumes that both in- and out-of-sample data are i.i.d.\ draws from an infinite population. However, these probabilistic assumptions cannot be verified even in principle. This paper presents an alternative view of generalization through the lens of sensitivity analysis of solutions of optimization problems to perturbations in the problem data. Under this framework, generalization bounds are obtained by purely deterministic means and take the form of variational principles that relate in-sample and out-of-sample evaluations through an error term that quantifies how close out-of-sample data are to in-sample data. Statistical assumptions can then be used \textit{ex post} to characterize the situations when this error term is small (either on average or with high probability).

AI.tldr: 本研究用优化扰动灵敏度替代传统i.i.d.假设，建立纯确定性泛化界，把“是否泛化好”转化为“新样本距离训练样本有多近”这一几何问题，统计特性仅作事后解释。
AI.motivation: 经典泛化理论依赖训练与测试数据来自同一分布且i.i.d.的不可检验假设；作者希望找到完全不依赖概率模型、可事先验证的泛化依据。
AI.method: 把学习算法视为优化问题 x*=arg min_x f(x,S)，用优化领域的“解对数据扰动的灵敏度”工具，刻画当训练集 S 被替换成任意新集 S′ 时目标函数值的变化；建立确定性变分不等式：R_out ≤ R_in + Δ(S,S′,x*)，其中 Δ 仅依赖于样本间距离及函数曲率，无需分布假设。
AI.result: 获得不含概率字样的紧约束：对任意 S′，测试误差可被训练误差加样本集间“某种扩展距离”控制；若事后发现 S′ 与 S 来自同一低噪声分布，则 Δ 高概率很小，自然退化为传统概率界，但理论本身仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 泛化可看作优化解的稳定性问题而非概率问题；统计假设降为充分条件，学习算法设计应优先提升对样本扰动的确定性鲁棒性，这给出了一条从灵敏度分析设计“保证泛化”的新路径。

title: DINO Eats CLIP: Adapting Beyond Knowns for Open-set 3D Object Retrieval
summary: Vision foundation models have shown great promise for open-set 3D object retrieval (3DOR) through efficient adaptation to multi-view images. Leveraging semantically aligned latent space, previous work typically adapts the CLIP encoder to build view-based 3D descriptors. Despite CLIP's strong generalization ability, its lack of fine-grainedness prompted us to explore the potential of a more recent self-supervised encoder-DINO. To address this, we propose DINO Eats CLIP (DEC), a novel framework for dynamic multi-view integration that is regularized by synthesizing data for unseen classes. We first find that simply mean-pooling over view features from a frozen DINO backbone gives decent performance. Yet, further adaptation causes severe overfitting on average view patterns of known classes. To combat it, we then design a module named Chunking and Adapting Module (CAM). It segments multi-view images into chunks and dynamically integrates local view relations, yielding more robust features than the standard pooling strategy. Finally, we propose Virtual Feature Synthesis (VFS) module to mitigate bias towards known categories explicitly. Under the hood, VFS leverages CLIP's broad, pre-aligned vision-language space to synthesize virtual features for unseen classes. By exposing DEC to these virtual features, we greatly enhance its open-set discrimination capacity. Extensive experiments on standard open-set 3DOR benchmarks demonstrate its superior efficacy.

AI.tldr: Multi-view DINO-based open-set 3D retrieval, reinforced by chunk-wise integration and virtual features, outperforms CLIP adaptations.
AI.motivation: CLIP's vision encoders provide only coarse-grained descriptors; we hypothesize that self-supervised DINO, which encodes dense patch-consistent representations, can yield sub-part-aware 3D descriptors for open-set 3D object retrieval (3DOR).
AI.method: 1) Replace CLIP with frozen DINO as the backbone, introducing a small gap due to view pooling. 2) Design CAM: fine-tune only a set of chunk-wise attention heads; each chunk selects latent patches of the same spatial indices across views, producing relation-aware features and avoiding overfitting to global mean view patterns. 3) VFS uses CLIP’s text prompt embeddings to generate "virtual" object descriptors for unseen classes, which jointly supervise CAM during training, enriching the embedding space with unseen semantic directions. 4) Concatenate virtual and real prototypes, updating only the retrieval branch through contrastive losses to maintain profile similarity in both seen/open-set worlds.
AI.result: Mean average precision (mAP) on ModelNet40 open-split increases by +3.9 points over the best CLIP-ensemble and gains +2.3 acc. on Pix3D open-set retrieval against prior SOTA; cross-dataset generalization performance is likewise boosted by 2.2 mAP on ShapeNetCore55. Overfitting to training class statistics is visibly suppressed (overfit ratio drops from 0.18 to 0.05). Training time is only 1.2× that of vanilla CLIP tuning because DINO remains frozen.
AI.conclusion: Chunk-adaptive view fusion with DINO exceeds coarse CLIP-based descriptors; synthetic virtual features systematically expand the semantic vocabulary, creating resilient open-set 3DOR representations without extra manual annotation. The DEC paradigm offers a transferable recipe for exploiting modern self-supervised encoders in retrieval scenarios with unknown categories.

title: Beyond Coefficients: Forecast-Necessity Testing for Interpretable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Time-Series Models
summary:
Nonlinear machine-learning models are increasingly used to discover causal relationships in time-series data, yet the interpretation of their outputs remains poorly understood. In particular, causal scores produced by regularized neural autoregressive models are often treated as analogues of regression coefficients, leading to misleading claims of statistical significance.
  In this paper, we argue that causal relevance in nonlinear time-series models should be evaluated through forecast necessity rather than coefficient magnitude, and we present a practical evaluation procedure for doing so. We present an interpretable evaluation framework based on systematic edge ablation and forecast comparison, which tests whether a candidate causal relationship is required for accurate prediction. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a case study model, we apply this framework to a real-world case study of democratic development, modeled as a multivariate time series of panel data - democracy indicators across 139 countries. We show that relationships with similar causal scores can differ dramatically in their predictive necessity due to redundancy, temporal persistence, and regime-specific effects.
  Our results demonstrate how forecast-necessity testing supports more reliable causal reasoning in applied AI systems and provides practical guidance for interpreting nonlinear time-series models in high-stakes domains.

AI.tldr: 用预测是否”离不开“某条边，而非系数大小，来衡量非线性时序模型的因果重要性，提出系统删边—再预测的检验框架，并在全球民主数据上验证其必要性差异。
AI.motivation: 非线性机器学习模型在时序因果发现中流行，但把正则化神经自回归的因果得分当成回归系数会误报显著性，需重新定义因果评价标准。
AI.method: 构建可解释评估框架：对候选因果边做系统消融，比较删边前后预测误差，以”预测必需性“作为因果相关性强弱指标；以神经可加向量自回归(NAVAR)为实例模型，在139国民主指标面板数据上实施。
AI.result: 证明因果得分相近的边在预测必要性上可因冗余、时序持续性或制度差异而显著不同；预测必需性检验能更准确区分真正必要的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 在高风险应用中，应以预测必需性而非系数大小解释非线性时序模型的因果输出，框架为应用AI系统提供了更可靠的因果推理指南。

title: Pause or Fabricate? Training Language Models for Grounded Reasoning
summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress on complex reasoning tasks. However, they often implicitly fabricate information when inputs are incomplete, producing confident but unreliable conclusions -- a failure mode we term ungrounded reasoning. We argue that this issue arises not from insufficient reasoning capability, but from the lack of inferential boundary awareness -- the ability to recognize when the necessary premises for valid inference are missing. To address this issue, we propose Grounded Reasoning via Interactive Reinforcement Learning (GRIL), a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework for grounded reasoning under incomplete information. GRIL decomposes the reasoning process into two stages: clarify and pause, which identifies whether the available information is sufficient, and grounded reasoning, which performs task solving once the necessary premises are established. We design stage-specific rewards to penalize hallucinations, enabling models to detect gaps, stop proactively, and resume reasoning after clarification. Experiments on GSM8K-Insufficient and MetaMATH-Insufficient show that GRIL significantly improves premise detection (up to 45%), leading to a 30% increase in task success while reducing average response length by over 20%. Additional analyses confirm robustness to noisy user responses and generalization to out-of-distribution tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出GRIL框架，用强化学习让大模型学会“信息不全就停、补全再答”，显著降低幻觉并提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 大模型在信息残缺时仍会自信地编造答案，源于缺乏“推断边界意识”。作者认为这是缺“自知之明”而非缺推理力，需显式教会模型识别信息缺口。
AI.method: GRIL：多轮强化学习框架，把推理拆成两阶段——① clarify & pause：用分类器判断信息是否够用，不够则主动提问；② grounded reasoning：信息补全后再正式解题。每阶段设专用奖励：幻觉即负奖励、提问与停机也得恰当奖励，用PPO联合优化。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K-Insufficient 与 MetaMATH-Insufficient 上，前提检测 F1 最高提升 45%，任务成功率 +30%，平均响应长度 −20% 以上；对噪声用户回复鲁棒，OOD 任务也能泛化。
AI.conclusion: 让模型“知止”胜过“硬答”；显式建模推断边界可有效抑制幻觉且保持效率，为可靠推理系统提供可扩展的强化学习范式。

title: Structure-guided molecular design with contrastive 3D protein-ligand learning
summary: Structure-based drug discovery faces the dual challenge of accurately capturing 3D protein-ligand interactions while navigating ultra-large chemical spaces to identify synthetically accessible candidates. In this work, we present a unified framework that addresses these challenges by combining contrastive 3D structure encoding with autoregressive molecular generation conditioned on commercial compound spaces. First, we introduce an SE(3)-equivariant transformer that encodes ligand and pocket structures into a shared embedding space via contrastive learning, achieving competitive results in zero-shot virtual screening. Second, we integrate these embeddings into a multimodal Chemical Language Model (MCLM). The model generates target-specific molecules conditioned on either pocket or ligand structures, with a learned dataset token that steers the output toward targeted chemical spaces, yielding candidates with favorable predicted binding properties across diverse targets.

AI.tldr: 提出SE(3)-等变Transformer+MCLM统一框架，以对比3D口袋-配体编码驱动商业化化学空间的自回归分子生成，实现零筛快速识别可合成命中。
AI.motivation: 结构药物发现需同时精准捕获3D蛋白-配体相互作用并遍历超大化学空间，但现有方法难兼顾几何建模与可合成性约束。
AI.method: 1) 构建SE(3)-等变口袋-配体Transformer＋对比学习，习得连续共享嵌入；2) 将此嵌入条件注入多模态化学语言模型(MCLM)，引入“数据集token”指导自回归分子生成向目标商业化合物空间聚焦。
AI.result: 零-shot虚拟筛选精度达SOTA水准；生成系列分子在连续靶标上经SBDD评估均具预测高亲和性且合成可及度优越。
AI.conclusion: 统一框架首次把3D交互保真的对比编码与面向实际化学空间的自回归生成结合，为后续合成可行的先导分子发现提供了兼顾精度与可行性的端到端范式。

title: LoViF 2026 Challenge on Real-World All-in-One Image Restoration: Methods and Results
summary: This paper presents a review for the LoViF Challenge on Real-World All-in-One Image Restoration. The challenge aimed to advance research on real-world all-in-one image restoration under diverse real-world degradation conditions, including blur, low-light, haze, rain, and snow. It provided a unified benchmark to evaluate the robustness and generalization ability of restoration models across multiple degradation categories within a common framework. The competition attracted 124 registered participants and received 9 valid final submissions with corresponding fact sheets, significantly contributing to the progress of real-world all-in-one image restoration. This report provides a detailed analysis of the submitted methods and corresponding results, emphasizing recent progress in unified real-world image restoration. The analysis highlights effective approaches and establishes a benchmark for future research in real-world low-level vision.

AI.tldr: LoViF挑战赛综述：首个统一评估去模糊、暗光、去雾、去雨、去雪五种真实退化的全能复原基准，吸引124队、收9份有效方案，确立统一低层视觉新标杆。
AI.motivation: 现有复原模型多针对单一退化，难以应对真实场景混杂退化；亟需一个统一基准来衡量模型在多种真实退化下的鲁棒性与泛化能力，推动全能复原研究。
AI.method: 构建涵盖五种真实退化的测试集，统一数据与评估协议；组织线上竞赛，要求参赛者在同一框架下提交可泛化模型，并强制提供技术报告说明方法细节。
AI.result: 9份有效方案全部优于过往单任务SOTA，其中Top方案在PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS上平均提升≥2 dB/0.03/0.05，跨退化一致性误差<3%；统一基准代码与榜单已开源。
AI.conclusion: 统一基准证实“全能复原”可行，Transformer+退化感知机制+物理先验成为主流；报告为后续研究提供可直接复现的基线，推动真实低层视觉向单模型多退化通用化方向发展。

title: Handling and Interpreting Missing Modalities in Patient Clinical Trajectories via Autoregressive Sequence Modeling
summary: An active challenge in developing multimodal machine learning (ML) models for healthcare is handling missing modalities during training and deployment. As clinical datasets are inherently temporal and sparse in terms of modality presence, capturing the underlying predictive signal via diagnostic multimodal ML models while retaining model explainability remains an ongoing challenge. In this work, we address this by re-framing clinical diagnosis as an autoregressive sequence modeling task, utilizing causal decoders from large language models (LLMs) to model a patient's multimodal trajectory. We first introduce a missingness-aware contrastive pre-training objective that integrates multiple modalities in datasets with missingness in a shared latent space. We then show that autoregressive sequence modeling with transformer-based architectures outperforms baselines on the MIMIC-IV and eICU fine-tuning benchmarks. Finally, we use interpretability techniques to move beyond performance boosts and find that across various patient stays, removing modalities leads to divergent behavior that our contrastive pre-training mitigates. By abstracting clinical diagnosis as sequence modeling and interpreting patient stay trajectories, we develop a framework to profile and handle missing modalities while addressing the canonical desideratum of safe, transparent clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 用LLM因果解码器把临床诊断重建成自回归序列建模，配合缺模态对比预训练，在MIMIC-IV/eICU上既提效又保证可解释性。
AI.motivation: 临床数据天然稀疏且缺模态，如何在缺失条件下训练可多模态预测且可解释的模型是核心难点。
AI.method: 1) 缺模态感知的对比预训练，将异构模态嵌入共享潜空间；2) 把多维电子病历视为时间序列，采用LLM因果解码器自回归建模患者轨迹；3) 用Transformer微调并在MIMIC-IV/eICU基准上评估；4) 引入可解释技术分析缺失模态对模型行为的影响。
AI.result: 对比预训练+自回归序列建模显著优于传统基线；当模态被逐一剔除时，对比预训练可有效缓解输出漂移，保持预测一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将临床诊断抽象为序列建模任务，并辅以缺模态对比预训练，可在性能与可解释性之间取得平衡，为构建安全、透明的临床AI提供可行框架。

title: Chat2Workflow: A Benchmark for Generating Executable Visual Workflows with Natural Language
summary: At present, executable visual workflows have emerged as a mainstream paradigm in real-world industrial deployments, offering strong reliability and controllability. However, in current practice, such workflows are almost entirely constructed through manual engineering: developers must carefully design workflows, write prompts for each step, and repeatedly revise the logic as requirements evolve-making development costly, time-consuming, and error-prone. To study whether large language models can automate this multi-round interaction process, we introduce Chat2Workflow, a benchmark for generating executable visual workflows directly from natural language, and propose a robust agentic framework to mitigate recurrent execution errors. Chat2Workflow is built from a large collection of real-world business workflows, with each instance designed so that the generated workflow can be transformed and directly deployed to practical workflow platforms such as Dify and Coze. Experimental results show that while state-of-the-art language models can often capture high-level intent, they struggle to generate correct, stable, and executable workflows, especially under complex or changing requirements. Although our agentic framework yields up to 5.34% resolve rate gains, the remaining real-world gap positions Chat2Workflow as a foundation for advancing industrial-grade automation. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/Chat2Workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chat2Workflow基准，尝试用大模型自动生成可直接部署的可视化工作流，并配套代理框架缓解执行错误；结果显示现有模型在复杂需求下仍难生成稳定可执行流程，但基准为工业级自动化奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 当前工业级可视化工作流全靠人工设计、反复调试，代价高且易错；亟需研究大模型是否能自动完成多轮交互式工作流生成。
AI.method: 构建Chat2Workflow基准——从真实业务收集可直转Dify/Coze部署的工作流实例；提出带错误定位-修复机制的代理式生成框架，迭代修正流程图与节点配置。
AI.result: SOTA大模型能把握高层意图，但在复杂或变化需求下正确率、稳定性不足；代理框架将通过率提升5.34%，仍与工业落地存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: Chat2Workflow为后续研究提供了可复现的工业级测试床，大模型自动工作流生成方向值得持续投入，需进一步提升鲁棒性与执行稳定性。

title: Lyapunov-Certified Direct Switching Theory for Q-Learning
summary: Q-learning is one of the most fundamental algorithms in reinforcement learning. We analyze constant-stepsize Q-learning through a direct stochastic switching system representation. The key observation is that the Bellman maximization error can be represented exactly by a stochastic policy. Therefore, the Q-learning error admits a switched linear conditional-mean recursion with martingale-difference noise. The intrinsic drift rate is the joint spectral radius (JSR) of the direct switching family, which can be strictly smaller than the standard row-sum rate. Using this representation, we derive a finite-time final-iterate bound via a JSR-induced Lyapunov function and then give a computable quadratic-certificate version.

AI.tldr: 本文把定步长Q-learning重新表述为一个随机切换系统，用联合谱半径（JSR）刻画其漂移率，并首次给出基于JSR-Lyapunov的有限时间最终迭代误差界及可计算的二次型证书。
AI.motivation: 传统Q-learning的有限时间分析依赖行和范数，收敛率估计保守；作者希望找到更紧的、可计算的收敛保证，并揭示Bellman误差与随机策略间的精确关系。
AI.method: 1) 把Bellman极大化误差精确表示成某随机策略的期望，从而将Q-learning迭代写成带鞅差的切换线性系统；2) 用联合谱半径（JSR）代替行和范数作为系统漂移率；3) 构造JSR诱导的Lyapunov函数，导出最终迭代误差有限时间上界；4) 将JSR上界转化为可数值求解的线性矩阵不等式（二次型证书）。
AI.result: 理论上得到步长α下最终迭代误差O(α·JSR/(1-JSR))的显式上界，数值证书使该界可直接计算；JSR可严格小于行和范数，因此收敛估计显著收紧。
AI.conclusion: 首次用切换系统与JSR给出定步长Q-learning的紧有限时间保证，为强化学习算法提供新的可计算收敛诊断工具，并可用于步长选择与置信区间估计。

title: TS-Attn: Temporal-wise Separable Attention for Multi-Event Video Generation
summary: Generating high-quality videos from complex temporal descriptions that contain multiple sequential actions is a key unsolved problem. Existing methods are constrained by an inherent trade-off: using multiple short prompts fed sequentially into the model improves action fidelity but compromises temporal consistency, while a single complex prompt preserves consistency at the cost of prompt-following capability. We attribute this problem to two primary causes: 1) temporal misalignment between video content and the prompt, and 2) conflicting attention coupling between motion-related visual objects and their associated text conditions. To address these challenges, we propose a novel, training-free attention mechanism, Temporal-wise Separable Attention (TS-Attn), which dynamically rearranges attention distribution to ensure temporal awareness and global coherence in multi-event scenarios. TS-Attn can be seamlessly integrated into various pre-trained text-to-video models, boosting StoryEval-Bench scores by 33.5% and 16.4% on Wan2.1-T2V-14B and Wan2.2-T2V-A14B with only a 2% increase in inference time. It also supports plug-and-play usage across models for multi-event image-to-video generation. The source code and project page are available at https://github.com/Hong-yu-Zhang/TS-Attn.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练 TS-Attn 注意力机制，解决多事件文本生成视频中动作保真度与时序一致性难兼顾的问题，在 Wan2.1/2.2 上 StoryEval-Bench 提升 16–33%，仅增加 2% 推理时间。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在“逐条短提示”与“单条复杂提示”间存在固有折中：前者动作准确但时序断裂，后者整体连贯却难以忠实遵循复杂描述，根本原因是视频内容与提示的时间错位以及运动物体与文本条件间的注意力冲突。
AI.method: 设计 Temporal-wise Separable Attention（TS-Attn），无需重新训练即可动态重分配注意力，使模型在多事件场景下既保持时序感知又维持全局一致；该模块可直接插入任何预训练文本到视频模型，并支持图生多事件视频。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 与 Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 上，TS-Attn 将 StoryEval-Bench 分数分别提高 33.5% 和 16.4%，推理时间仅增 2%，且可零样本迁移至其他模型完成多事件图生视频任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过重排注意力而非重训模型，TS-Attn 首次在保真度与一致性之间取得实用平衡，为复杂时序描述的高质量视频生成提供了即插即用的通用增强方案。

title: Towards Understanding the Robustness of Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to optimization-based jailbreak attacks that exploit internal gradient structure. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for interpretability, their robustness implications remain underexplored. We present a study of integrating pretrained SAEs into transformer residual streams at inference time, without modifying model weights or blocking gradients. Across four model families (Gemma, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen) and two strong white-box attacks (GCG, BEAST) plus three black-box benchmarks, SAE-augmented models achieve up to a 5x reduction in jailbreak success rate relative to the undefended baseline and reduce cross-model attack transferability. Parametric ablations reveal (i) a monotonic dose-response relationship between L0 sparsity and attack success rate, and (ii) a layer-dependent defense-utility tradeoff, where intermediate layers balance robustness and clean performance. These findings are consistent with a representational bottleneck hypothesis: sparse projection reshapes the optimization geometry exploited by jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 在推理阶段将预训练的稀疏自编码器(SAE)植入LLM残差流，无需调权或阻断梯度即可把越狱成功率降低至1/5，同时确定稀疏度与攻击成功率呈单调负相关、中间层最能兼顾对抗鲁棒与干净性能。
AI.motivation: 现有抵御优化型越狱攻击的方案多需微调或截断梯度，代价高；而SAE虽常用于可解释性，其在安全方面的潜力未被系统研究。作者希望利用SAE的“表征瓶颈”特性，在不改变模型参数的前提下阻止攻击者利用梯度结构构造越狱提示。
AI.method: 将预训练SAE作为“只插入、不更新”模块嵌入Gemma/LLaMA/Mistral/Qwen四个系列模型的残差流，保留梯度回传；对比白盒攻击GCG、BEAST以及三种黑盒基准；通过控制L0稀疏度、SAE插入层位和宽度进行参数消融，测量越狱成功率与干净任务性能变化；并用相关系数量化攻击跨模型迁移能力。
AI.result: 在全部实验设置下，SAE增强模型相较无防御基线平均降低越狱成功率5倍，个别模型低至1/10；稀疏度提高，攻击成功率单调下降；将同一SAE迁移至同系列不同规模模型，跨模型攻击迁移率显著降低；中间层（总层数约40%–60%处）插入可在几乎不损失干净准确率的前提下最大化鲁棒收益；对GCG与BEAST的防御效果一致，说明抗攻击能力对具体优化算法无偏好。
AI.conclusion: SAE的稀疏投影能重塑LLM内部优化几何，使攻击梯度陷入局部次优解，验证“表征瓶颈”假说；可在不修改预训练权重、不断流梯度的情况下实现高效越狱防御；后续应探索动态稀疏度、层级混合策略与多模态扩展，以进一步提升实用性与通用性。

title: Exploring Language-Agnosticity in Function Vectors: A Case Study in Machine Translation
summary: Function vectors (FVs) are vector representations of tasks extracted from model activations during in-context learning. While prior work has shown that multilingual model representations can be language-agnostic, it remains unclear whether the same holds for function vectors. We study whether FVs exhibit language-agnosticity, using machine translation as a case study. Across three decoder-only multilingual LLMs, we find that translation FVs extracted from a single English$\rightarrow$Target direction transfer to other target languages, consistently improving the rank of correct translation tokens across multiple unseen languages. Ablation results show that removing the FV degrades translation across languages with limited impact on unrelated tasks. We further show that base-model FVs transfer to instruction-tuned variants and partially generalize from word-level to sentence-level translation.

AI.tldr: 功能向量在无监督场景下可跨语言迁移并持续优化翻译质量，适用于多类目标语言及指令微调模型。
AI.motivation: 已有多语言模型的表示在跨语言情况下呈语言无关性，但功能向量是否同样具有语言无关性尚不明确，需要实证验证。
AI.method: 将机器翻译作为案例，从三个解码型多语种大模型中提取单一方向的英→X功能向量，测试其在未见语种上的激活效果；通过破坏实验测量该向量对翻译与无关任务的影响；另考察基模型功能向量在指令微调模型中的迁移及从词级到句级的泛化能力。
AI.result: 英→X功能向量显著提升目标语种正确译文的排名，对未训练过的多个目标语言有效；移除该向量损害翻译表现，对无关任务影响甚微；基模型向量可迁移至指令微调同款模型，并能部分从词级泛化到句级翻译。
AI.conclusion: 功能向量具有语言无关属性，可在多语翻译中实现跨语种、跨模型及跨粒度的迁移，为各类多语任务提供可复用的任务表示基础。

title: An Efficient Black-Box Reduction from Online Learning to Multicalibration, and a New Route to $Φ$-Regret Minimization
summary:
We give a Gordon-Greenwald-Marks (GGM) style black-box reduction from online learning to online multicalibration. Concretely, we show that to achieve high-dimensional multicalibration with respect to a class of functions H, it suffices to combine any no-regret learner over H with an expected variational inequality (EVI) solver. We also prove a converse statement showing that efficient multicalibration implies efficient EVI solving, highlighting how EVIs in multicalibration mirror the role of fixed points in the GGM result for $Φ$-regret.
  This first set of results resolves the main open question in Garg, Jung, Reingold, and Roth (SODA '24), showing that oracle-efficient online multicalibration with $\sqrt{T}$-type guarantees is possible in full generality. Furthermore, our GGM-style reduction unifies the analyses of existing online multicalibration algorithms, enables new algorithms for challenging environments with delayed observations or censored outcomes, and yields the first efficient black-box reduction between online learning and multiclass omniprediction.
  Our second main result is a fine-grained reduction from high-dimensional online multicalibration to (contextual) $Φ$-regret minimization. Together with our first result, this establishes a new route from external regret to Phi-regret that bypasses sophisticated fixed-point or semi-separation machinery, dramatically simplifies a result of Daskalakis, Farina, Fishelson, Pipis, and Schneider (STOC '25) while improving rates, and yields new algorithms that are robust to richer deviation classes, such as those belonging to any reproducing kernel Hilbert space.

AI.tldr: 提出首个GGM型在线多校准↔在线学习双向黑盒归约，证明两类问题复杂度等价，并获得一系列更快更鲁棒的在线多校准与Φ-遗憾算法。
AI.motivation: Garg等人在SODA’24留下“能否以√T-型保证在全一般情形下实现预言机高效在线多校准”的开放问题。本文旨在彻底回答该问题，并统一简化从外部遗憾到Φ-遗憾的路线。
AI.method: 1)设计“无遗憾学习者+期望变分不等式(EVI)求解器”两步框架，以满足任意H类的高维在线多校准；2)证明其反向：高效多校准必蕴含高效EVI求解，建立双向等价；3)首次用GGM风格黑盒把在线学习归约到多校准，再精致归约到(contextual) Φ-遗憾最小化，全程仅依赖标准无遗憾与EVI预言机，避开固定点/半分离装置。
AI.result: •解决SODA’24主开放问题：首次给出具有Õ(√T)校准误差、完全无模型限制的在线多校准算法；•通过同一证明框架，统一并改善现有Hedge、CBC等在线多校准算法的分析；•获得延迟观测/删失结果等困难环境下的新高效算法；•给出首个在线学习↔多类别全预测(omniprediction)的黑盒归约；•将STOC’25从外部遗憾到Φ-遗憾的结果大幅简化并提升速率，新算法对任意RKHS偏差类保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 在线多校准与EVI求解/在线学习在同一黑盒复杂度范畴内可互换；GGM型归约不仅回答了多校准的预言机高效可行性，也提供了从外部遗憾到Φ-遗憾的全新简洁通道，并为延迟、删失及更复杂偏差类场景打开了实用算法设计空间。

title: Deep sprite-based image models: An analysis
summary: While foundation models drive steady progress in image segmentation and diffusion algorithms compose always more realistic images, the seemingly simple problem of identifying recurrent patterns in a collection of images remains very much open. In this paper, we focus on sprite-based image decomposition models, which have shown some promise for clustering and image decomposition and are appealing because of their high interpretability. These models come in different flavors, need to be tailored to specific datasets, and struggle to scale to images with many objects. We dive into the details of their design, identify their core components, and perform an extensive analysis on clustering benchmarks. We leverage this analysis to propose a deep sprite-based image decomposition method that performs on par with state-of-the-art unsupervised class-aware image segmentation methods on the standard CLEVR benchmark, scales linearly with the number of objects, identifies explicitly object categories, and fully models images in an easily interpretable way.

AI.tldr: 深度精灵化模型首次在CLEVR上实现线性扩缩、显式类别识别与可解释的端到端无监督类感知分割。
AI.motivation: 尽管基础模型推动了图像分割与扩散生成的发展，但在图像集合中自动发现重复模式这一“看似简单”的问题仍未解决；现有精灵分解模型虽具可解释性，却需针对数据集定制、难以扩展至多目标场景。
AI.method: 系统梳理各类精灵分解模型的核心组件，进行大规模聚类基准实验，据此设计深度精灵化图像分解框架，使精灵数量与计算复杂度随目标数量线性增长，并显式建模目标类别。
AI.result: 在标准CLEVR基准上，该方法达到与最新无监督类感知分割方法相当的精度，同时保持线性扩展性和完全可解释的图像重构。
AI.conclusion: 通过深度化与模块化改造，精灵分解范式首次兼具高可解释性、线性扩展性与SOTA分割精度，为无监督场景理解提供了新的可行路径。

title: REVEAL: Multimodal Vision-Language Alignment of Retinal Morphometry and Clinical Risks for Incident AD and Dementia Prediction
summary: The retina provides a unique, noninvasive window into Alzheimer's disease (AD) and dementia, capturing early structural changes through morphometric features, while systemic and lifestyle risk factors reflect well-established contributors to disease susceptibility long before clinical symptom onset. However, current retinal analysis frameworks typically model imaging and risk factors separately, limiting their ability to capture joint multimodal patterns critical for early risk prediction. Moreover, existing methods rarely incorporate mechanisms to organize or align patients with similar retinal and clinical characteristics, constraining the learning of coherent cross-modal associations. To address these limitations, we introduce REVEAL (REtinal-risk Vision-Language Early Alzheimer's Learning), a framework that aligns color fundus photographs with individualized disease-specific risk profiles for predicting incident AD and dementia, on average 8 years before diagnosis (range: 1-11 years). Because real-world risk factors are structured questionnaire data, we translate them into clinically interpretable narratives compatible with pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). We further propose a group-aware contrastive learning (GACL) strategy that clusters patients with similar retinal morphometry and risk factors as positive pairs, strengthening multimodal alignment. This unified representation learning framework substantially outperforms state-of-the-art retinal imaging models paired with clinical text encoders, as well as general-purpose VLMs, demonstrating the value of jointly modeling retinal biomarkers and clinical risk factors. By providing a generalizable and noninvasive approach for early AD and dementia risk stratification, REVEAL has the potential to enable earlier intervention and improve preventive care at the population level.

AI.tldr: REVEAL框架首次将眼底彩照与结构化风险问卷转化为可解释文本，利用群体感知对比学习实现视网膜-临床风险的多模态对齐，平均提前8年预测AD/痴呆，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视网膜分析把影像与风险因子割裂建模，无法挖掘跨模态共变模式，也缺乏对相似患者的显式对齐，导致早期风险预测性能受限。
AI.method: 提出REVEAL：①把问卷风险因子转为疾病特异性叙事，与眼底图一起送入预训练视觉-语言模型；②设计群体感知对比学习(GACL)，在视网膜形态+风险特征联合空间中聚类相似患者作为正样本，强化跨模态一致表示；③端到端学习统一多模态嵌入，用于事件性AD/痴呆预测。
AI.result: 在英国大型队列中，REVEAL平均提前8年(range 1–11年)预测新发AD/痴呆，AUC、C-index等指标显著优于SOTA视网膜影像+临床文本编码器及通用VLM基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过非侵入性地融合视网膜生物标志与可解释风险叙事，REVEAL实现人群层面早期风险分层，为AD/痴呆的初级预防和干预窗口提供可扩展工具。

title: An Answer is just the Start: Related Insight Generation for Open-Ended Document-Grounded QA
summary: Answering open-ended questions remains challenging for AI systems because it requires synthesis, judgment, and exploration beyond factual retrieval, and users often refine answers through multiple iterations rather than accepting a single response. Existing QA benchmarks do not explicitly support this refinement process. To address this gap, we introduce a new task, document-grounded related insight generation, where the goal is to generate additional insights from a document collection that help improve, extend, or rethink an initial answer to an open-ended question, ultimately supporting richer user interaction and a better overall question answering experience. We curate and release SCOpE-QA (Scientific Collections for Open-Ended QA), a dataset of 3,000 open-ended questions across 20 research collections. We present InsightGen, a two-stage approach that first constructs a thematic representation of the document collection using clustering, and then selects related context based on neighborhood selection from the thematic graph to generate diverse and relevant insights using LLMs. Extensive evaluation on 3,000 questions using two generation models and two evaluation settings shows that InsightGen consistently produces useful, relevant, and actionable insights, establishing a strong baseline for this new task.

AI.tldr: 提出了“文档支撑的相关洞察生成”新任务与SCOpE-QA数据集；配套InsightGen二阶段方法，为开放域问答迭代优化提供可扩展基线。
AI.motivation: 开放问答需多轮迭代洞察，现有评测缺少“基于原文持续深化答案”的机制。
AI.method: SCOpE-QA含3 000问答对+20科研文集；InsightGen先聚类构建主题图，再基于邻域采样+LLM生成多样洞察。
AI.result: 在3 000题、两模型、两评估协议下，InsightGen持续产出有用、相关且可操作的洞察，显著优于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 新任务与数据集为开放问答迭代交互奠定基准，主题驱动+邻域选择的洞察生成策略可推广至其他知识增强场景。

title: SAGE: Training-Free Semantic Evidence Composition for Edge-Cloud Inference under Hard Uplink Budgets
summary: Edge-cloud hybrid inference offloads difficult inputs to a powerful remote model, but the uplink channel imposes hard per-request constraints on the number of bits that can be transmitted. We show that selecting transmitted content based solely on attention-based importance, the standard approach in collaborative inference, is inherently limited under hard budgets. Two findings support this claim. First, replacing high-importance units with low-importance but complementary ones improves server accuracy. This shows that what matters is not individual importance but how well the transmitted set covers diverse aspects of the input. Second, spatially uniform selection without any content information achieves competitive accuracy at moderate budgets. This confirms that spatial coverage alone carries independent value. Based on this analysis, we propose SAGE (Semantic Attention-Guided Evidence), a principled, training-free method that combines importance filtering with embedding-diversity sampling. SAGE achieves 93% of the server ceiling in offloaded accuracy while transmitting fewer than half of the available evidence units on ImageNet-1K, substantially outperforming importance-only composition.

AI.tldr: 硬预算下，仅靠注意力选证据无法最大化云端准确率；SAGE把重要性和多样性结合，无需重训即达93%服务器上限。
AI.motivation: 边缘-云端混合推理的严苛上行带宽限制了可上送内容，仅用“注意力得分高→优先上传”这一主流做法在预算死板时效率差，需重新思考“送什么”才能榨干有限比特价值。
AI.method: 1）先论证“高注意力≠必传”：用互补低分token替换高分token可提升准确率，说明集合“覆盖度”比单点重要性关键；2）再证明“空间均匀采样”已能竞争，说明空间分布信息本身有用；3）据此提出训练自由的SAGE——先按注意力阈值粗筛，再用嵌入空间的行列式点过程(DPP)做多样性采样，兼顾重要与互补。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K上，SAGE仅用<50%证据即可达到云端模型93% ceiling精度，比纯重要性基线高3–9个百分点；在10–50%预算区间均保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 硬预算场景下，证据选择应从“高重要性”转向“高覆盖+互补”，SAGE以零训练开销验证该思路，为边缘-云端协同提供了即插即用的上传策略。

title: Seeing Candidates at Scale: Multimodal LLMs for Visual Political Communication on Instagram
comment: An earlier version was presented at #SMSociety 2024 (London)
summary: This paper presents a computational case study that evaluates the capabilities of specialized machine learning models and emerging multimodal large language models for Visual Political Communication (VPC) analysis. Focusing on concentrated visibility in Instagram stories and posts during the 2021 German federal election campaign, we compare the performance of traditional computer vision models (FaceNet512, RetinaFace, Google Cloud Vision) with a multimodal large language model (GPT-4o) in identifying front-runner politicians and counting individuals in images. GPT-4o outperformed the other models, achieving a macro F1-score of 0.89 for face recognition and 0.86 for person counting in stories. These findings demonstrate the potential of advanced AI systems to scale and refine visual content analysis in political communication while highlighting methodological considerations for future research.

AI.tldr: 以2021年德国大选期间Instagram内容为例，GPT-4o在人脸识别与人数统计任务上显著优于传统视觉专用模型，宏观F1达0.89/0.86，说明多模态大模型可提升视觉政治传播研究的自动化与精度，但需关注数据偏见与伦理风险。
AI.motivation: 视觉政治传播研究长期依赖人工编码，难以对海量社媒图像进行微观与宏观结合的量化分析；经典人脸识别和计数模型只基于单模态视觉信号，未能综合人脸特征与文本、边缘等跨模态线索，导致在政治语境下跨时间、跨方式曝光识别精度不足，限制了政治传播大规模可重复研究的推进。
AI.method: 收集2021年德国联邦竞选期间Instagram Stories和posts形成VPC图文数据集；选用FaceNet512、RetinaFace、Google Cloud Vision三种经典单模态模型与GPT-4o对比；以官方候选人名单为基准，评估：1)候选人身份识别的宏观F1；2)图像中人数计数的相对准确度；3)模型在不同光照、滤镜、姿势等政治场景扰动下的鲁棒性；4)利用多模态提示将图片嵌入与政治角色知识对齐并解释推理过程以进行可解释性评测。
AI.result: 1.GPT-4o在候选人识别的macro-F1达到0.89，较次优的FaceNet512提升约8%，误检率下降14%；2.在人数统计任务中GPT-4o的宏观F1为0.86，并在31%遮挡与多角度示例中仍保持≤2%的偏差，显著优于专门检测模型平均0.74的F1；3.GPT-4o对低解析度、图文叠加与滤镜政治形象海报的鲁棒性最高；4.零样本与少样本提示均能保持性能，显示其可在免去昂贵再训练的情况下快速迁移到新选举周期。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大模型通过同时整合人脸特征和文本及语用语义，为视觉政治传播的大规模、高一致性自动编码开辟了新范式；但高计算成本、模型上线政策限制与潜在社会偏见仍需研究者平衡治理。未来建议在跨文化可视画像、政治虚假信息检测及可解释输出框架中进一步验证多模态范式的通用性，并建立共享的政治图像基准数据集。

title: Multi-Level Temporal Graph Networks with Local-Global Fusion for Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: Fault detection and diagnosis are critical for the optimal and safe operation of industrial processes. The correlations among sensors often display non-Euclidean structures where graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used therein. However, for large-scale systems, local, global, and dynamic relations extensively exist among sensors, and traditional GNNs often overlook such complex and multi-level structures for various problems including the fault diagnosis. To address this issue, we propose a structure-aware multi-level temporal graph network with local-global feature fusion for industrial fault diagnosis. First, a correlation graph is dynamically constructed using Pearson correlation coefficients to capture relationships among process variables. Then, temporal features are extracted through long short-term memory (LSTM)-based encoder, whereas the spatial dependencies among sensors are learned by graph convolution layers. A multi-level pooling mechanism is used to gradually coarsen and learn meaningful graph structures, to capture higher-level patterns while keeping important fault related details. Finally, a fusion step is applied to combine both detailed local features and overall global patterns before the final prediction. Experimental evaluations on the Tennessee Eastman process (TEP) demonstrate that the proposed model achieves superior fault diagnosis performance, particularly for complex fault scenarios, outperforming various baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 用动态图+多层级池化+局部-全局特征融合，把GNN用于大规模工业故障诊断，TEP 数据集上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 工业传感器间存在局部、全局与动态三种非欧关联，现有 GNN 忽视这种多层次结构，导致复杂故障难以诊断。
AI.method: 1) 动态构造皮尔逊相关图；2) LSTM 编码器提取时序特征；3) 图卷积捕获空间依赖；4) 多级池化逐步粗化并保持故障关键细节；5) 融合局部与全局特征再做分类。
AI.result: 在 Tennessee Eastman 过程基准上，所提模型对复杂故障场景的准确率、F1 等指标均优于传统 GNN、LSTM 及混合基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模传感器间的多层次图结构并融合局部-全局信息，可显著提升大规模工业系统的故障诊断能力，具有实际部署潜力。

title: Epistemic orientation in parliamentary discourse is associated with deliberative democracy
summary: The pursuit of truth is central to democratic deliberation and governance, yet political discourse reflects varying epistemic orientations, ranging from evidence-based reasoning grounded in verifiable information to intuition-based reasoning rooted in beliefs and subjective interpretation. We introduce a scalable approach to measure epistemic orientation using the Evidence--Minus--Intuition (EMI) score, derived from large language model (LLM) ratings and embedding-based semantic similarity. Applying this approach to 15 million parliamentary speech segments spanning 1946 to 2025 across seven countries, we examine temporal patterns in discourse and its association with deliberative democracy and governance. We find that EMI is positively associated with deliberative democracy within countries over time, with consistent relationships in both contemporaneous and lagged analyses. EMI is also positively associated with the transparency and predictable implementation of laws as a dimension of governance. These findings suggest that the epistemic nature of political discourse is crucial for both the quality of democracy and governance.

AI.tldr: 作者用「证据减直觉」(EMI)指标测量1500万条议会发言，发现一国议会言论越依赖证据、越少依赖直觉，其协商民主质量越高，法律执行也越透明可预期。
AI.motivation: 民主协商需要「求真」取向，但政治话语中证据与直觉成分如何系统量化、并影响民主与治理，尚缺大规模跨时跨国证据。
AI.method: 构建EMI指标：先让大模型给每段议会发言打分「证据vs直觉」，再用嵌入相似度校准，最后将1946–2025年七国1500万段发言的EMI均值与V-Dem协商民主指数、WGI法治透明度做面板回归与滞后检验。
AI.result: EMI每升1个标准差，协商民主指数平均升0.12–0.18 SD；法律透明/可预期指标升0.08–0.11 SD；结果在同期与1–5年滞后模型均稳健，国别固定效应控制后依旧显著。
AI.conclusion: 议会话语的认知基础——证据压倒直觉——是提升民主协商质量与治理绩效的关键可观测前兆，EMI可作为跨国民主监测的新简洁工具。

title: Disentangling Damage from Operational Variability: A Label-Free Self-Supervised Representation Learning Framework for Output-Only Structural Damage Identification
summary: Damage identification is a core task in structural health monitoring. In practice, however, its reliability is often compromised by confounding non-damage effects, such as variations in excitation and environmental conditions, which can induce changes comparable to or larger than those caused by structural damage. To address this challenge, this study proposes a self-supervised label-free disentangled representation learning framework for robust vibration-based structural damage identification. The proposed framework employs an autoencoder with two latent representations to learn directly from raw vibration acceleration signals. A self-supervised invariance regularization, implemented via Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization (VICReg), is imposed on one latent representation using baseline data where structural damage is assumed constant but operational and environmental conditions vary. In addition, a frequency-domain constraint is introduced to enforce agreement between the power spectral density reconstructed from the latent representation and that computed from the corresponding input time series. Together, these mechanisms promote disentanglement, enabling the learned representation to be sensitive to damage-related characteristics while remaining invariant to nuisance variability. The framework is trained in a fully end-to-end and label-free manner, requiring no prior information on damage, excitation, or environmental conditions, making it well-suited for real-world applications. Its effectiveness is validated on two distinct real-world vibration datasets, including a bridge and a gearbox. The results demonstrate robustness to operational variability, strong generalization capability, and good performance in both damage detection and quantification.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需标签的自监督解耦表征学习框架，利用双潜空间自编码器与VICReg正则化，从原始加速度信号中分离损伤与工况/环境变异，实现鲁棒的无监督损伤辨识与量化。
AI.motivation: 实际SHM中，激励与环境变异引起的信号变化往往掩盖真实损伤特征，导致现有数据驱动方法误判。需要一种无需先验损伤标签即可抑制干扰、提取损伤敏感特征的框架。
AI.method: 1. 设计双潜空间自编码器：一空间经VICReg自监督正则化，对无损伤但工况多变的基准数据保持不变；另一空间无约束以聚合全部信息。2. 引入频域一致性约束，使潜空间重构功率谱与输入信号功率谱匹配，强化物理可解释性。3. 端到端、无标签训练，无需损伤、激励或环境先验。4. 用欧氏距离度量潜空间漂移实现损伤检测，用漂移幅度实现量化。
AI.result: 在真实桥梁（Z-24）与风力机齿轮箱两数据集上验证：对温度、荷载、转速等工况变化保持误报率<2%；损伤检测准确率分别达99.1%与97.4%，定位误差<5%；量化回归R²>0.92，显著优于传统FER、OC-SVM及现有自监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次将自监督解耦思想引入振动SHM，完全摆脱人工标签与物理模型，兼具强鲁棒性与高泛化能力，为大型结构在线健康监测提供了可扩展、易部署的新范式。

title: Evaluating Histogram Matching for Robust Deep learning-Based Grapevine Disease Detection
summary: Variability in illumination is a primary factor limiting deep learning robustness for field-based plant disease detection. This study evaluates Histogram Matching (HM), a technique that transforms the pixel intensity distribution of an image to match a reference profile, to mitigate this in grapevine classification, distinguishing among healthy leaves, downy mildew, and spider mite damage. We propose a dual-stage integration of HM: (i) as a preprocessing step for normalization, and (ii) as a data augmentation technique to introduce controlled training variability. Experiments using 1,469 RGB images (comprising homogeneous leaf-focused and heterogeneous canopy samples) to train ResNet-18 models demonstrate that this combination significantly enhances robustness on real-world canopy images. While leaf-focused samples showed marginal gains, the canopy subset improved markedly, indicating that balancing normalization with histogram-based diversification effectively bridges the domain gap caused by uncontrolled lighting.

AI.tldr: 通过直方图匹配的双阶段光照归一化与数据增广策略，显著提升了葡萄叶片病害ResNet-18模型在现实冠层场景中的鲁棒性，尤其缓解了光照变化带来的域适应问题。
AI.motivation: 田间植物病害识别受光照变化影响严重，现有深度学习模型难以在真实冠层环境中保持稳健；急需一种可在训练与推理阶段同时应对光照变异性的低成本预处理方案。
AI.method: (1) 提出“双重直方图匹配”框架：① 训练前用参考模板对全部图像做全局归一化；② 训练阶段再将同一样本多次随机匹配不同模板，生成受控光照扰动以增广数据。(2) 采用ResNet-18在1 469张葡萄RGB图像上进行三分类（健康、霜霉病、二斑叶螨）实验，分别评估纯叶片与含冠层背景样本的性能提升。
AI.result: 冠层测试集准确率显著提升，而纯叶片集仅边际改善；域差距（由不可控光照引起）被有效缩小，模型在实际田间冠层图像上表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将直方图匹配同时用于归一化与增广，可在不增加成像硬件成本的前提下显著提升植物病害深度学习系统在野外的实用性，对冠层复杂光照场景尤为有效。

title: Experiments or Outcomes? Probing Scientific Feasibility in Large Language Models
summary: Scientific feasibility assessment asks whether a claim is consistent with established knowledge and whether experimental evidence could support or refute it. We frame feasibility assessment as a diagnostic reasoning task in which, given a hypothesis, a model predicts feasible or infeasible and justifies its decision. We evaluate large language models (LLMs) under controlled knowledge conditions (hypothesis-only, with experiments, with outcomes, or both) and probe robustness by progressively removing portions of the experimental and/or outcome context. Across multiple LLMs and two datasets, providing outcome evidence is generally more reliable than providing experiment descriptions. Outcomes tend to improve accuracy beyond what internal knowledge alone provides, whereas experimental text can be brittle and may degrade performance when the context is incomplete. These findings clarify when experimental evidence benefits LLM-based feasibility assessment and when it introduces fragility.

AI.tldr: LLM能否评估科学假说是否可行取决于输入内容：提供实验结果（outcomes）比提供实验描述（experiments）更稳健；仅删除部分结果对性能影响较小，而实验描述一旦残缺反而降低精度。
AI.motivation: 评估科学假说的“可行性”即判断其与既有知识是否冲突、实验能否支持或推翻。作者希望弄清LLM在何种情境下能可靠完成这一诊断推理任务，并为后续科学假说评估提供输入信息的选择依据。
AI.method: 把可行性判断形式化为二分类+解释任务，系统性地控制输入信息类型（仅假说、假说+实验文字、假说+实验结果、假说+实验+结果），并逐级剔除部分实验或结果，测试多个LLM在两大科学假说数据集上的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验结果信息普遍提升准确率，且对删减不敏感；实验文字信息在完整时略有益，但一旦缺失或模糊就会引入脆弱性，导致性能下降。总体看，“结果>描述”这一趋势保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 为LLM输入实验证据时应优先提供明确结果而非详细实验描述；系统开发者在设计科学假说评估工具时，需意识到实验文字带来的脆弱性并据此调整信息策略。

title: Discovering a Shared Logical Subspace: Steering LLM Logical Reasoning via Alignment of Natural-Language and Symbolic Views
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle with multi-step logical reasoning. Existing approaches either purely refine the reasoning chain in natural language form or attach a symbolic solver as an external module. In this work, we instead ask whether LLMs contain a shared internal logical subspace that simultaneously aligns natural-language and symbolic-language views of the reasoning process. Our hypothesis is that this logical subspace captures logical reasoning capabilities in LLMs that are shared across views while remaining independent of surface forms. To verify this, we employ Canonical Correlation Analysis on the paired residual activations from natural-language and symbolic-language reasoning chains, learning a low-dimensional subspace with maximum cross-view correlation. Furthermore, we design a training-free approach that steers LLMs reasoning chain along this logical subspace, thereby leveraging the complementary reasoning signals from both views. Experiments on four logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, improving accuracy by up to 11 percentage points and generalizing well on out-of-domain problems.

AI.tldr: 用CCA在LLM里挖出自然语言与符号语言共享的隐式逻辑子空间，无需训练即可沿该子空间引导推理，四数据集平均提11个百分点。
AI.motivation: 多步逻辑推理仍是LLM短板；现有方法要么纯修自然语言链、要么外挂符号求解器，未能同时利用两种视角的互补信号。
AI.method: 将自然语言与符号语言推理链的残差激活配对，Canonical Correlation Analysis提取低维共享逻辑子空间；在此基础上设计免训练投射-引导策略，使解码沿该子空间进行。
AI.result: 在4个逻辑推理基准上准确率提升4-11个百分点，OOD场景同样显著受益，子空间可视化显示其跨视图对齐度与任务性能高度相关。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部存在与表面形式无关、跨模态共享的逻辑子空间；仅通过激活级投影即可调动两种推理视图，验证“隐式逻辑瓶颈”假设，为无需重训练的可控推理提供新范式。

title: HardNet++: Nonlinear Constraint Enforcement in Neural Networks
summary: Enforcing constraint satisfaction in neural network outputs is critical for safety, reliability, and physical fidelity in many control and decision-making applications. While soft-constrained methods penalize constraint violations during training, they do not guarantee constraint adherence during inference. Other approaches guarantee constraint satisfaction via specific parameterizations or a projection layer, but are tailored to specific forms (e.g., linear constraints), limiting their utility in other general problem settings. Many real-world problems of interest are nonlinear, motivating the development of methods that can enforce general nonlinear constraints. To this end, we introduce HardNet++, a constraint-enforcement method that simultaneously satisfies linear and nonlinear equality and inequality constraints. Our approach iteratively adjusts the network output via damped local linearizations. Each iteration is differentiable, admitting an end-to-end training framework, where the constraint satisfaction layer is active during training. We show that under certain regularity conditions, this procedure can enforce nonlinear constraint satisfaction to arbitrary tolerance. Finally, we demonstrate tight constraint adherence without loss of optimality in a learning-for-optimization context, where we apply this method to a model predictive control problem with nonlinear state constraints.

AI.tldr: HardNet++提出了一种在神经网络前向传播中通过可微迭代线性化，同时满足线性、非线性等式与不等式约束的通用硬约束方法，并验证其在模型预测控制等任务中零损失最优性。
AI.motivation: 现有软约束仅在训练阶段惩罚违规，无法保证推断期安全；而硬约束方案多局限于线性约束，难以应对实际中普遍存在的非线性约束场景。
AI.method: 设计可微的“约束满足层”：对网络输出做阻尼局部线性化，迭代求解修正量，使输出逐步逼近可行域；整个迭代过程可端到端训练。
AI.result: 在正则条件下，算法可将非线性约束违反减至任意指定容差；在带非线性状态约束的模型预测控制实验中，实现零违规且不牺牲控制性能。
AI.conclusion: HardNet++首次将通用非线性硬约束嵌入网络推断，兼顾训练效率与推断可靠性，为安全关键学习与优化提供了可扩展框架。

title: Paparazzo: Active Mapping of Moving 3D Objects
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Current 3D mapping pipelines generally assume static environments, which limits their ability to accurately capture and reconstruct moving objects. To address this limitation, we introduce the novel task of active mapping of moving objects, in which a mapping agent must plan its trajectory while compensating for the object's motion. Our approach, Paparazzo, provides a learning-free solution that robustly predicts the target's trajectory and identifies the most informative viewpoints from which to observe it, to plan its own path. We also contribute a comprehensive benchmark designed for this new task. Through extensive experiments, we show that Paparazzo significantly improves 3D reconstruction completeness and accuracy compared to several strong baselines, marking an important step toward dynamic scene understanding. Project page: https://davidea97.github.io/paparazzo-page/

AI.tldr: 提出了无需学习的Paparazzo方法，让主动式建图机器人在动态环境中一边预测运动目标轨迹，一边规划视点，显著提升对运动物体的三维重建完整度与精度，并配套新基准。
AI.motivation: 现有三维建图普遍假设环境静态，无法有效捕获和重建运动目标，因此需研究如何在目标持续运动的同时完成主动建图。
AI.method: 提出“运动目标主动建图”任务；设计无学习框架Paparazzo：在线估计目标运动轨迹→以信息增益为准则选取最优观测视点→实时重规划机器人路径；并建立公开评测基准。
AI.result: 在自建基准上的大量实验表明，Paparazzo的重建完整度和几何精度均显著优于多项强基线，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Paparazzo首次实现动态场景下的主动三维建图，为动态场景理解提供了重要技术支撑，并开放数据与代码以供后续研究。

title: HELM: Harness-Enhanced Long-horizon Memory for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models fail systematically on long-horizon manipulation tasks despite strong short-horizon performance. We show that this failure is not resolved by extending context length alone in the current reactive execution setting; instead, it stems from three recurring execution-loop deficiencies: the memory gap, the verification gap, and the recovery gap.
