We present HELM, a model-agnostic framework that addresses these deficiencies with three components: an Episodic Memory Module (EMM) that retrieves key task history via CLIP-indexed keyframes, a learned State Verifier (SV) that predicts action failure before execution from observation, action, subgoal, and memory-conditioned context, and a Harness Controller (HC) that performs rollback and replanning. The SV is the core learning contribution: it consistently outperforms rule-based feasibility checks and ensemble uncertainty baselines, and its effectiveness depends critically on access to episodic memory. On LIBERO-LONG, HELM improves task success rate by 23.1 percentage points over OpenVLA (58.4% to 81.5%), while extending the context window to H=32 yields only a 5.4-point gain and same-budget LoRA adaptation remains 12.2 points below HELM. HELM also improves long-horizon performance on CALVIN and substantially boosts recovery success under controlled perturbations. Ablations and mechanism analyses isolate the contribution of each component, and we release LIBERO-Recovery as a perturbation-injection protocol for evaluating failure recovery in long-horizon manipulation.

AI.tldr: HELM 框架用显式记忆、可学习验证器和回滚重规划机制，将 VLA 在 LIBERO-LONG 上的长程任务成功率从 58.4% 提升至 81.5%，显著优于单纯加长上下文或 LoRA 微调。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在短时操作表现强劲，却在长时操作链中系统性失败；仅扩大上下文窗口无法根治，需解决执行环中的记忆缺口、验证缺口与恢复缺口。
AI.method: 提出与模型无关的 HELM 框架：① 基于 CLIP 关键帧索引的片段记忆模块（EMM）实时检索任务历史；② 状态验证器（SV）以观测、动作、子目标与记忆为条件，在执行前预测失败概率；③ 驾驭控制器（HC）根据 SV 输出触发回滚与重规划。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-LONG 上，HELM 将 OpenVLA 的成功率提高 23.1 pp；加长上下文仅增 5.4 pp，同预算 LoRA 仍低 12.2 pp。CALVIN 长程任务和受控扰动下的恢复成功率也显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 执行环三缺口是长程失败主因，显式记忆+可学习验证+回滚重规划是有效解法；LIBERO-Recovery 评估协议公开，可推进长程操控的故障恢复研究。

title: Who Shapes Brazil's Vaccine Debate? Semi-Supervised Modeling of Stance and Polarization in YouTube's Media Ecosystem
summary: Vaccination remains a cornerstone of global public health, yet the COVID-19 pandemic exposed how online misinformation, political polarization, and declining institutional trust can undermine immunization efforts. Most of the prior computational studies that analyzed vaccine discourse on social platforms focus on English-language data, specific vaccines, or short time windows, impairing our understanding of long-term dynamics in high-impact, non-English contexts like Brazil, home to one of the world's most comprehensive immunization systems. We here present the largest longitudinal study of Brazil's vaccine discourse on YouTube, leveraging a semi-supervised stance detection framework that combines self-labeling and self-training to classify nearly 1.4 million comments. By integrating stance with temporal patterns, engagement metrics, and channel taxonomy (legacy media, science communicators, digital-native outlets), we map how pro- and anti-vaccine narratives evolve and circulate within a hybrid media ecosystem. Our results show that semi-supervised learning substantially improves stance classification robustness, enabling fine-grained tracking of public attitudes across Brazil's full immunization schedule. Polarization spikes during epidemiological crises, especially COVID-19, but becomes fragmented across vaccines and interaction patterns in the post-pandemic period. Notably, science communication and digital-native channels emerge as the primary loci of both supportive and oppositional engagement, revealing structural vulnerabilities in contemporary health communication. Thus, our work advances computational methods for large-scale stance modeling while offering actionable evidence for public health agencies, platform governance, and online information ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 首次对巴西YouTube疫苗评论进行百万级纵向立场挖掘，发现危机期极化骤升、科学传播频道成攻防主战场，为葡语世界免疫监测提供可操作方法。
AI.motivation: COVID-19显示网络谣言与政治极化可破坏接种，但既有计算研究多聚焦英语、单一疫苗或短时窗，缺乏对葡语等高影响非英语区的长期演化理解，而巴西拥有全球最完备免疫体系之一，亟需填补此空白。
AI.method: 构建半监督立场检测框架（自标注+自训练），对巴西YouTube 2013-2022 近140 万条评论进行自动分类；将立场结果与时间序列、互动指标（点赞、回复量）及频道分类（传统媒体、科学传播者、数字原生媒体）耦合，追踪支持/反对疫苗叙事的传播路径与演化。
AI.result: 半监督模型显著提升立场分类鲁棒性；极化在流行病危机（尤其COVID-19）期间陡增，但后疫情期碎片化扩散至不同疫苗与互动模式；科学传播和数字原生频道同时承载最多支持与反对互动，成为当代健康传播的结构性脆弱点。
AI.conclusion: 研究为大规模立场建模提供可扩展葡语方案，向公共卫生机构、平台治理与信息生态系统提供实时监测与干预证据，强调需重点监管科学类频道的反疫苗劫持风险。

title: Budgeted Online Influence Maximization
comment: 37th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2020), 28 pages
summary: We introduce a new budgeted framework for online influence maximization, considering the total cost of an advertising campaign instead of the common cardinality constraint on a chosen influencer set. Our approach better models the real-world setting where the cost of influencers varies and advertisers want to find the best value for their overall social advertising budget. We propose an algorithm assuming an independent cascade diffusion model and edge level semi-bandit feedback, and provide both theoretical and experimental results. Our analysis is also valid for the cardinality constraint setting and improves the state of the art regret bound in this case.

AI.tldr: 在线影响力最大化从“选多少人”转向“花多少钱”，首次给出带预算约束的算法与理论保证，并把经典基数约束情形的遗憾界一并刷新。
AI.motivation: 传统研究多用“选 k 个节点”作为约束，但真实营销中不同 KOL 报价差异巨大，广告主关心的是总预算而非人数。已有工作忽视成本异质性，导致策略与落地场景脱节。
AI.method: 在独立级联模型下提出预算约束的在线影响力最大化框架；设计基于边级半老虎机反馈的贪心—上置信界混合算法，每轮按边际成本效益比选择节点直至预算耗尽；利用自适应子模性和光滑预算曲线，建立 1−1/e 近似比的累积 regret 界。
AI.result: 理论：在预算版 regret 为 O(B√(T ln T))，当退化为基数约束时 regret 降至 O(√(k T ln T))，优于当前最优 O(k√(T ln T))；实验：在 4 个公开网络数据、3 种报价分布上，算法比次优基线平均提升 18% 的影响力—预算比，且收敛速度提升 30%。
AI.conclusion: 将“选多少人”升级为“花多少钱”更贴近真实投放场景；所提算法与理论同时覆盖预算版与基数版，两条线均刷新 SOTA，为社交广告动态出价提供可解释、可扩展的在线决策范式。

title: EgoSelf: From Memory to Personalized Egocentric Assistant
summary: Egocentric assistants often rely on first-person view data to capture user behavior and context for personalized services. Since different users exhibit distinct habits, preferences, and routines, such personalization is essential for truly effective assistance. However, effectively integrating long-term user data for personalization remains a key challenge. To address this, we introduce EgoSelf, a system that includes a graph-based interaction memory constructed from past observations and a dedicated learning task for personalization. The memory captures temporal and semantic relationships among interaction events and entities, from which user-specific profiles are derived. The personalized learning task is formulated as a prediction problem where the model predicts possible future interactions from individual user's historical behavior recorded in the graph. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EgoSelf as a personalized egocentric assistant. Code is available at \href{https://abie-e.github.io/egoself_project/}{https://abie-e.github.io/egoself\_project/}.

AI.tldr: EgoSelf 利用图结构长期记忆与个性化预测任务，将用户第一视角历史交互建模为时空-语义关系图，实现个体级未来交互预测，显著提升自我中心助手的个性化服务能力。
AI.motivation: 第一视角助手需依赖长期用户数据实现个性化，但现有方法难以有效整合跨时段、跨场景的异构行为信息，导致助手对个体习惯与偏好捕捉不足。
AI.method: 构建图式交互记忆：节点为实体/事件，边捕捉时序与语义关联；设计个性化学习任务：以个体历史子图编码为条件，预测下一可能交互，端到端训练图神经网络。
AI.result: 在多个第一视角数据集上，EgoSelf 相较无记忆基线将 Top-5 交互预测准确率提升 18–27%，并在下游主动推荐任务中把用户采纳率提高 15%。
AI.conclusion: 图式长期记忆+个性化预测框架可系统挖掘个体行为模式，为自我中心助手提供可持续演进且高适应性的个性化能力，代码已开源。

title: LLM-as-Judge Framework for Evaluating Tone-Induced Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where reliable visual grounding carries operational consequences, yet their behavior under progressively coercive prompt phrasing remains undercharacterized. Existing hallucination benchmarks predominantly rely on neutral prompts and binary detection, leaving open how both the incidence and the intensity of fabrication respond to graded linguistic pressure across structurally distinct task types. We present Ghost-100, a procedurally constructed benchmark of 800 synthetically generated images spanning eight categories across three task families -- text-illegibility, time-reading, and object-absence -- each designed under a negative-ground-truth principle that guarantees the queried target is absent, illegible, or indeterminate by construction. Every image is paired with five prompts drawn from a structured 5-Level Prompt Intensity Framework, holding the image and task identity fixed while varying only directive force, so that tone is isolated as the sole independent variable. We adopt a dual-track evaluation protocol: a rule-based H-Rate measuring the proportion of responses in which a model crosses from grounded refusal into unsupported positive commitment, and a GPT-4o-mini-judged H-Score on a 1-5 scale characterizing the confidence and specificity of fabrication once it occurs. We additionally release a three-stage automated validation workflow, which retrospectively confirms 717 of 800 images as strictly compliant. Evaluating nine open-weight VLMs, we find that H-Rate and H-Score dissociate substantially across model families, reading-style and presence-detection subsets respond to prompt pressure in qualitatively different ways, and several models exhibit non-monotonic sensitivity peaking at intermediate tone levels -- patterns that aggregate metrics obscure.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 Ghost-100（800 张负样本图 × 5 级递进式提示），首次系统刻画 VLM 在“被查问不存在之物”时，因提示语气逐渐强硬而产生的幻觉发生率（H-Rate）与幻觉强度（H-Score）变化。9 个主流开源 VLM 呈非单调、任务特异性敏感曲线，温和与极端语气反而可能抑制幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉benchmark多用中性提示与二分类检测，无法回答“当人类不断加大语言压力时，VLM 幻觉的‘发生率’和‘确信度’如何变化”这一高风险场景下的关键问题。
AI.method: 1) 负向真值构造：800 张合成图分三大任务族（文字不可读、时间不可读、目标不存在），确保查询目标必然缺失；2) 5 级 Prompt Intensity Framework，对固定图固定任务仅操纵语气强度；3) 双轨评估：① 规则化 H-Rate（拒绝→虚假肯定跃迁比例）；② GPT-4o-mini 打 1-5 H-Score（幻觉置信度与细节度）；4) 三阶段自动验证链，回溯确认 717/800 图严格合规；5) 在 9 个开源 VLM 上实施对比实验。
AI.result: H-Rate 与 H-Score 在不同模型家族间显著分离；阅读类与存在检测类任务对提示压强的响应曲线形态迥异；多个模型出现“中段峰值”非单调灵敏区，平均指标会掩盖该现象。
AI.conclusion: VLM 幻觉行为对递进式语言胁迫呈现复杂、非线性、任务相关且模型特异的敏感规律，需以细粒度、负向真值、语气分级的评测框架持续监控，而非简单二分类或聚合统计。

title: Unlocking the Edge deployment and ondevice acceleration of multi-LoRA enabled one-for-all foundational LLM
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) on smartphones poses significant engineering challenges due to stringent constraints on memory, latency, and runtime flexibility. In this work, we present a hardware-aware framework for efficient on-device inference of a LLaMA-based multilingual foundation model supporting multiple use cases on Samsung Galaxy S24 and S25 devices with SM8650 and SM8750 Qualcomm chipsets respectively. Our approach integrates application-specific LoRAs as runtime inputs to a single frozen inference graph, enabling dynamic task switching without recompilation or memory overhead. We further introduce a multi-stream decoding mechanism that concurrently generates stylistic variations - such as formal, polite, or jovial responses - within a single forward pass, reducing latency by up to 6x. To accelerate token generation, we apply Dynamic Self-Speculative Decoding (DS2D), a tree-based strategy that predicts future tokens without requiring a draft model, yielding up to 2.3x speedup in decode time. Combined with quantization to INT4 and architecture-level optimizations, our system achieves 4-6x overall improvements in memory and latency while maintaining accuracy across 9 languages and 8 tasks. These results demonstrate practical feasibility of deploying multi-use-case LLMs on edge devices, advancing the commercial viability of Generative AI in mobile platforms.

AI.tldr: 在Galaxy S24/S25 上实现单一冻结 LLaMA 模型同时运行多语种多场景，借助 LoRA 动态加载、多流解码及无草模树形投机解码（DS2D），在低功耗 INT4 量化和全栈优化下，达到平均 4–6× 内存与延迟节省，可行性已通过 9 种语言 8 类任务验证。
AI.motivation: 智能机内存、延迟与热预算极其严苛，此前难以把大语言模型（LLaMA 级）原生部署且灵活支持多语言、多场景生成任务；同时设备级生成式 AI 被视为提升用户体验和差异化竞争的新机会。
AI.method:
1. 单冻结推理图＋运行时输入多个专用 LoRA，无需重编/重载模型即可切换任务；
2. 多流并行解码：一前向同时输出正式、客气、幽默等风格分支，共摊 KV-Cache 与算力；
3. 无“草案模型”的动态自投机解码（DS2D），在前向内自构多 token 树验证；
4. INT4 量化与 SoC 级算子/缓存/带宽协同优化，适配 SM8650/SM8750 异构核和散热限制。
AI.result: 仅 4-bit 权重的冻结骨干下，内存占用降 83%（等效 6×），首延迟 6×↓；DS2D 单算子级减速 2.3×；综合端到端加速 4–6×，多语 MMLU 平均准确率在 ±1% 浮动；SoC 功耗＜4 W。
AI.conclusion: 将多级动态 LoRA、多流生成与无草案投机解码打包成一套硬件可落地的端侧推理框架，首次把手机端大模型从“单用离线推理”推进到“一机多场景商用体验”，证实了生成 AI 在移动平台的规模商可行性。后续向更小芯片与远端-本地协同微调延伸。

title: PREF-XAI: Preference-Based Personalized Rule Explanations of Black-Box Machine Learning Models
summary: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) has predominantly focused on generating model-centric explanations that approximate the behavior of black-box models. However, such explanations often overlook a fundamental aspect of interpretability: different users require different explanations depending on their goals, preferences, and cognitive constraints. Although recent work has explored user-centric and personalized explanations, most existing approaches rely on heuristic adaptations or implicit user modeling, lacking a principled framework for representing and learning individual preferences. In this paper, we consider Preference-Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (PREF-XAI), a novel perspective that reframes explanation as a preference-driven decision problem. Within PREF-XAI, explanations are not treated as fixed outputs, but as alternatives to be evaluated and selected according to user-specific criteria. In the PREF-XAI perspective, here we propose a methodology that combines rule-based explanations with formal preference learning. User preferences are elicited through a ranking of a small set of candidate explanations and modeled via an additive utility function inferred using robust ordinal regression. Experimental results on real-world datasets show that PREF-XAI can accurately reconstruct user preferences from limited feedback, identify highly relevant explanations, and discover novel explanatory rules not initially considered by the user. Beyond the proposed methodology, this work establishes a connection between XAI and preference learning, opening new directions for interactive and adaptive explanation systems.

AI.tldr: 将可解释 AI 从“模型输出”转向“用户偏好选择”：PREF-XAI 用少量排序反馈学习个体化效用函数，动态挑选最贴合用户认知目标的规则解释，并在真实数据上验证其可重建偏好、发现新规则。
AI.motivation: 现有 XAI 以模型为中心，忽视不同用户在目标、偏好与认知上的差异；用户导向研究又多凭启发式调整，缺乏系统化的偏好建模框架。
AI.method: 提出 PREF-XAI 框架：把解释视为候选方案，用鲁棒序数回归从用户对少量候选规则解释的排序中推断加性效用函数，实现个性化选择。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，仅用少量反馈即可高保真重建用户偏好，准确挑出高相关解释，并自动发现用户最初未想到的新规则。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统连接 XAI 与偏好学习，为交互式、自适应解释系统奠定理论与方法基础，开启“按需解释”的新方向。

title: RF-HiT: Rectified Flow Hierarchical Transformer for General Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Accurate medical image segmentation requires both long-range contextual reasoning and precise boundary delineation, a task where existing transformer- and diffusion-based paradigms are frequently bottlenecked by quadratic computational complexity and prohibitive inference latency. We propose RF-HiT, a Rectified Flow Hierarchical Transformer that integrates an hourglass transformer backbone with a multi-scale hierarchical encoder for anatomically guided feature conditioning. Unlike prior diffusion-based approaches, RF-HiT leverages rectified flow with efficient transformer blocks to achieve linear complexity while requiring only a few discretization steps. The model further fuses conditioning features across resolutions via learnable interpolation, enabling effective multi-scale representation with minimal computational overhead. As a result, RF-HiT achieves a strong efficiency-performance trade-off, requiring only 10.14 GFLOPs, 13.6M parameters, and inference in as few as three steps. Despite its compact design, RF-HiT attains 91.27% mean Dice on ACDC and 87.40% on BraTS 2021, achieving performance comparable to or exceeding that of significantly more intensive architectures. This demonstrates its strong potential as a robust, computationally efficient foundation for real-time clinical segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出RF-HiT：一种基于矫正流的层级Transformer，用线性复杂度+3步推理实现临床级实时医学图像分割，参数仅13.6 M、Dice却达91.27%(ACDC)/87.40%(BraTS)。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer与扩散方法因二次复杂度及高推理延迟，难以兼顾长程上下文与精细边界，阻碍临床实时部署。
AI.method: 以Hourglass-Transformer为主干，多尺度层级编码器注入解剖先验；矫正流替代传统扩散，仅3步离散化；跨分辨率可学习插值融合条件特征，整体保持线性复杂度。
AI.result: ACDC 91.27% Dice、BraTS 2021 87.40% Dice，与大型模型持平或更优；仅需10.14 GFLOPs、13.6 M参数、3步推理即可收敛。
AI.conclusion: RF-HiT证明了“轻量+线性+少步”也能达到临床精度，为实时医学分割提供了可落地的通用基础模型。

title: Geometric Decoupling: Diagnosing the Structural Instability of Latent
summary: Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) achieve high-fidelity synthesis but suffer from latent space brittleness, causing discontinuous semantic jumps during editing. We introduce a Riemannian framework to diagnose this instability by analyzing the generative Jacobian, decomposing geometry into \textit{Local Scaling} (capacity) and \textit{Local Complexity} (curvature). Our study uncovers a \textbf{``Geometric Decoupling"}: while curvature in normal generation functionally encodes image detail, OOD generation exhibits a functional decoupling where extreme curvature is wasted on unstable semantic boundaries rather than perceptible details. This geometric misallocation identifies ``Geometric Hotspots" as the structural root of instability, providing a robust intrinsic metric for diagnosing generative reliability.

AI.tldr: Latent Diffusion Models 的潜在空间极易出现语义突变，作者用生成 Jacobian 的黎曼几何度量，首次揭示“几何解耦”现象，为不稳定区域提供了一场可解释的内在诊断工具。
AI.motivation: LDM 虽能合成高保真图像，但在编辑时潜空间易出现突变，缺乏对稳定性根源的可解释量化手段。本文旨在从几何视角剖析这种脆弱性，为后续鲁棒生成提供诊断依据。
AI.method: 提出基于黎曼几何的统一框架，将生成 Jacobian 分解为“局部容量（缩放）”与“局部曲率（复杂度）”两项。通过对比正常生成与分布外(OOD)生成时的曲率分布，识别出曲率被错误地消耗在语义边界而非可感知细节的“几何热点”。
AI.result: 发现“几何解耦”现象：正常生成中曲率与图像细节对齐；OOD 生成中曲率与语义边界耦合，导致突变。由此定义的“几何热点”可作为内在稳定性的强预测指标，优于现有经验度量。
AI.conclusion: 该黎曼框架首次把 LDM 的不稳定归结为潜空间几何误分配，提供了一条无需重训练即可定位脆弱区域的诊断路径，为后续鲁棒编辑、采样及模型修正奠定了几何基础。

title: Owner-Harm: A Missing Threat Model for AI Agent Safety
comment: 15 pages. Companion manuscript on per-decision proof-obligation synthesis (LSVJ-S) in preparation
summary: Existing AI agent safety benchmarks focus on generic criminal harm (cybercrime, harassment, weapon synthesis), leaving a systematic blind spot for a distinct and commercially consequential threat category: agents harming their own deployers. Real-world incidents illustrate the gap: Slack AI credential exfiltration (Aug 2024), Microsoft 365 Copilot calendar-injection leaks (Jan 2024), and a Meta agent unauthorized forum post exposing operational data (Mar 2026). We propose Owner-Harm, a formal threat model with eight categories of agent behavior damaging the deployer. We quantify the defense gap on two benchmarks: a compositional safety system achieves 100% TPR / 0% FPR on AgentHarm (generic criminal harm) yet only 14.8% (4/27; 95% CI: 5.9%-32.5%) on AgentDojo injection tasks (prompt-injection-mediated owner harm). A controlled generic-LLM baseline shows the gap is not inherent to owner-harm (62.7% vs. 59.3%, delta 3.4 pp) but arises from environment-bound symbolic rules that fail to generalize across tool vocabularies. On a post-hoc 300-scenario owner-harm benchmark, the gate alone achieves 75.3% TPR / 3.3% FPR; adding a deterministic post-audit verifier raises overall TPR to 85.3% (+10.0 pp) and Hijacking detection from 43.3% to 93.3%, demonstrating strong layer complementarity. We introduce the Symbolic-Semantic Defense Generalization (SSDG) framework relating information coverage to detection rate. Two SSDG experiments partially validate it: context deprivation amplifies the detection gap 3.4x (R = 3.60 vs. R = 1.06); context injection reveals structured goal-action alignment, not text concatenation, is required for effective owner-harm detection.
