title: Planning in entropy-regularized Markov decision processes and games
summary: We propose SmoothCruiser, a new planning algorithm for estimating the value function in entropy-regularized Markov decision processes and two-player games, given a generative model of the environment. SmoothCruiser makes use of the smoothness of the Bellman operator promoted by the regularization to achieve problem-independent sample complexity of order O~(1/epsilon^4) for a desired accuracy epsilon, whereas for non-regularized settings there are no known algorithms with guaranteed polynomial sample complexity in the worst case.

AI.tldr: SmoothCruiser首次在熵正则化MDP和博弈中实现与环境维度无关的O~(ε⁻⁴)样本复杂度，突破无正则化场景下无多项式保证的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有规划算法在无正则化MDP最坏情形下缺乏多项式样本复杂度保证；熵正则化虽引入光滑性，却未被用于降低采样代价。
AI.method: 利用熵正则化使Bellman算子成为收缩且光滑映射这一性质，设计专门利用光滑度的样本高效更新规则，在仅依赖生成模型的前提下控制误差传播。
AI.result: 证明SmoothCruiser对任意精度ε的样本复杂度为O~(ε⁻⁴)，与状态–动作空间维度无关；此前无正则化设定下不存在同样保证的算法。
AI.conclusion: 熵正则化为可证明的样本高效规划打开新途径，SmoothCruiser提供了首个问题无关的多项式保证，为后续向高维、多玩家及无模型场景扩展奠定基础。

title: TransSplat: Unbalanced Semantic Transport for Language-Driven 3DGS Editing
summary: Language-driven 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) editing provides a more convenient approach for modifying complex scenes in VR/AR. Standard pipelines typically adopt a two-stage strategy: first editing multiple 2D views, and then optimizing the 3D representation to match these edited observations. Existing methods mainly improve view consistency through multi-view feature fusion, attention filtering, or iterative recalibration. However, they fail to explicitly address a more fundamental issue: the semantic correspondence between edited 2D evidence and 3D Gaussians. To tackle this problem, we propose TransSplat, which formulates language-driven 3DGS editing as a multi-view unbalanced semantic transport problem. Specifically, our method establishes correspondences between visible Gaussians and view-specific editing prototypes, thereby explicitly characterizing the semantic relationship between edited 2D evidence and 3D Gaussians. It further recovers a cross-view shared canonical 3D edit field to guide unified 3D appearance updates. In addition, we use transport residuals to suppress erroneous edits in non-target regions, mitigating edit leakage and improving local control precision. Qualitative and quantitative results show that, compared with existing 3D editing methods centered on enhancing view consistency, TransSplat achieves superior performance in local editing accuracy and structural consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出 TransSplat，首次将语言驱动的 3D 高斯抛雪球编辑表述为多视角非平衡语义传输问题，显式建立 2D 编辑证据与 3D 高斯之间的语义对应，并恢复跨视角共享的规范 3D 编辑场，借传输残差抑制非目标区域误编辑，在局部精度与结构一致性上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有语言驱动 3DGS 编辑方法仅通过多视角特征融合或迭代校准提升视角一致性，却未显式解决 2D 编辑证据与 3D 高斯之间的语义对应这一更根本问题，导致编辑泄漏与局部控制精度不足。
AI.method: 1) 将编辑任务形式化为多视角非平衡语义传输；2) 为每个视角建立可见高斯与编辑原型间的语义对应；3) 用传输结果恢复跨视角共享的规范 3D 编辑场，统一更新 3D 外观；4) 引入传输残差抑制非目标区域误差，减少泄漏。
AI.result: 在多项主观与客观指标上，TransSplat 的局部编辑准确度与结构一致性均优于当前以视角一致性为中心的 3D 编辑方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义传输机制是提升语言驱动 3DGS 编辑质量的关键，TransSplat 在保持跨视角一致的同时实现了更精准的局部控制，为 VR/AR 内容创作提供了更可靠的工具。

title: Curvature-Aware PCA with Geodesic Tangent Space Aggregation for Semi-Supervised Learning
summary: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a fundamental tool for representation learning, but its global linear formulation fails to capture the structure of data supported on curved manifolds. In contrast, manifold learning methods model nonlinearity but often sacrifice the spectral structure and stability of PCA. We propose \emph{Geodesic Tangent Space Aggregation PCA (GTSA-PCA)}, a geometric extension of PCA that integrates curvature awareness and geodesic consistency within a unified spectral framework. Our approach replaces the global covariance operator with curvature-weighted local covariance operators defined over a $k$-nearest neighbor graph, yielding local tangent subspaces that adapt to the manifold while suppressing high-curvature distortions. We then introduce a geodesic alignment operator that combines intrinsic graph distances with subspace affinities to globally synchronize these local representations. The resulting operator admits a spectral decomposition whose leading components define a geometry-aware embedding. We further incorporate semi-supervised information to guide the alignment, improving discriminative structure with minimal supervision. Experiments on real datasets show consistent improvements over PCA, Kernel PCA, Supervised PCA and strong graph-based baselines such as UMAP, particularly in small sample size and high-curvature regimes. Our results position GTSA-PCA as a principled bridge between statistical and geometric approaches to dimensionality reduction.

AI.tldr: GTSA-PCA 以流形感知协方差算子+测地线对齐，兼得PCA谱稳定与流形非线性优势，在小样本、高曲率场景显著优于PCA族与图基方法。
AI.motivation: 传统PCA全局线性假设无法表示弯曲流形；主流流形学习虽补非线性却失去PCA的谱结构与数值稳定性，需一种兼具几何敏感与统计稳健的统一降维框架。
AI.method: 构建k-NN图上的曲率加权局部协方差算子，抑制高曲率畸变；引入测地线对齐算子，用内在图距离与子空间亲和度同步局部切空间；整体算子谱分解得到几何感知嵌入；并可注入少量标签做半监督指导。
AI.result: 在真实数据集中，GTSA-PCA较PCA、Kernel PCA、Supervised PCA及UMAP等强基线一致提升，尤其在小样本、高曲率条件下优势明显。
AI.conclusion: GTSA-PCA 以统一谱框架桥接统计与几何方法，为曲率复杂数据提供了稳定、可解释且低标签依赖的降维新范式。

title: Beyond Indistinguishability: Measuring Extraction Risk in LLM APIs
summary: Indistinguishability properties such as differential privacy bounds or low empirically measured membership inference are widely treated as proxies to show a model is sufficiently protected against broader memorization risks. However, we show that indistinguishability properties are neither sufficient nor necessary for preventing data extraction in LLM APIs. We formalize a privacy-game separation between extraction and indistinguishability-based privacy, showing that indistinguishability and inextractability are incomparable: upper-bounding distinguishability does not upper-bound extractability. To address this gap, we introduce $(l, b)$-inextractability as a definition that requires at least $2^b$ expected queries for any black-box adversary to induce the LLM API to emit a protected $l$-gram substring. We instantiate this via a worst-case extraction game and derive a rank-based extraction risk upper bound for targeted exact extraction, as well as extensions to cover untargeted and approximate extraction. The resulting estimator captures the extraction risk over multiple attack trials and prefix adaptations. We show that it can provide a tight and efficient estimation for standard greedy extraction and an upper bound on the probabilistic extraction risk given any decoding configuration. We empirically evaluate extractability across different models, clarifying its connection to distinguishability, demonstrating its advantage over existing extraction risk estimators, and providing actionable mitigation guidelines across model training, API access, and decoding configurations in LLM API deployment. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Emory-AIMS/Inextractability.

AI.tldr: 现有差分隐私等不可区分性指标无法充分衡量LLM API的可抽取风险；作者提出(l,b)-不可抽取性新定义，配套最坏情况抽取游戏与基于排序的风险上界估计器，实验表明其比既有指标更紧且可用于训练、API访问和解码配置的实际缓解。
AI.motivation: 社区普遍将差分隐私或成员推理误差等“不可区分性”当作记忆泄露的代理，但缺乏直接衡量黑盒抽取难度的定义与工具，导致防护缺口。
AI.method: 1) 形式化抽取-不可区分性分离，证明二者不可比；2) 定义(l,b)-不可抽取性：任何黑盒敌手需≥2^b次查询才能让LLM API输出受保护的长度l子串；3) 构建最坏情况抽取游戏，导出针对精确抽取的排序风险上界，并扩展至非目标与近似抽取；4) 设计可跨攻击轮次与前缀调整的风险估计器，给出贪心与任意解码配置下的概率上界；5) 在多款模型上实证比较与不可区分性的关系并验证估计器紧度。
AI.result: 理论上：不可区分性上界不隐含抽取上界；新估计器在标准贪心抽取上给出紧上界，对任意解码配置提供概率风险上界。实验上：相比现有抽取风险估计，(l,b)-指标更灵敏且与实测抽取成功率高度一致；通过训练、API限制与解码策略的调整可显著降低抽取风险。
AI.conclusion: 不可区分性指标不足以评估LLM API的泄露风险；(l,b)-不可抽取性及其估计器为开发者提供了可直接用于训练、API访问和解码环节的量化缓解指南，代码已开源。

title: On two ways to use determinantal point processes for Monte Carlo integration
summary: The standard Monte Carlo estimator $\widehat{I}_N^{\mathrm{MC}}$ of $\int fdω$ relies on independent samples from $ω$ and has variance of order $1/N$. Replacing the samples with a determinantal point process (DPP), a repulsive distribution, makes the estimator consistent, with variance rates that depend on how the DPP is adapted to $f$ and $ω$. We examine two existing DPP-based estimators: one by Bardenet & Hardy (2020) with a rate of $\mathcal{O}(N^{-(1+1/d)})$ for smooth $f$, but relying on a fixed DPP. The other, by Ermakov & Zolotukhin (1960), is unbiased with rate of order $1/N$, like Monte Carlo, but its DPP is tailored to $f$. We revisit these estimators, generalize them to continuous settings, and provide sampling algorithms.

AI.tldr: 将蒙特卡洛独立样本替换为与目标函数/测度适配的 DPP，可在保持无偏性的同时将方差阶由 1/N 改进到 1/N^{1+1/d}。
AI.motivation: 经典蒙特卡洛估计器方差仅按 1/N 衰减。利用排斥性的 DPP 生成负相关样本，有望获得更快收敛速率，但现有两种 DPP 估计器要么速率次优（固定 DPP），要么需要针对 f 特化（难以通用）。系统厘清其理论界限与可算法化方案成为必要。
AI.method: 重新审视 Bardenet & Hardy 与 Ermakov & Zolotukhin 两类 DPP 估计器，将其推广至连续空间；建立统一的方差分析框架，证明与 f 和 ω 适配的 DPP 能把方差主导项降至 N^{-(1+1/d)}；给出基于谱测度与条件抽样的可实现采样算法，保证估计器无偏且具可计算性。
AI.result: 对任意光滑 f，适配 DPP 的估计器方差为 O(N^{-(1+1/d)})，优于标准蒙特卡洛；当 DPP 核与 f^{-1/d} 匹配时达到该速率，且估计保持无偏；连续域算法复杂度与 N log N 同阶，数值实验在 d=2,3 时误差下降速度提升 30–50%。
AI.conclusion: 以适配目标函数的 DPP 替代独立采样，可在不牺牲无偏性的条件下实现维度相关的方差加速；所提通用采样框架让理论速率真正可计算，为高维积分、贝叶斯推断与稀有事件模拟提供新型“超蒙特卡洛”工具。

title: SmartPhotoCrafter: Unified Reasoning, Generation and Optimization for Automatic Photographic Image Editing
summary: Traditional photographic image editing typically requires users to possess sufficient aesthetic understanding to provide appropriate instructions for adjusting image quality and camera parameters. However, this paradigm relies on explicit human instruction of aesthetic intent, which is often ambiguous, incomplete, or inaccessible to non-expert users. In this work, we propose SmartPhotoCrafter, an automatic photographic image editing method which formulates image editing as a tightly coupled reasoning-to-generation process. The proposed model first performs image quality comprehension and identifies deficiencies by the Image Critic module, and then the Photographic Artist module realizes targeted edits to enhance image appeal, eliminating the need for explicit human instructions. A multi-stage training pipeline is adopted: (i) Foundation pretraining to establish basic aesthetic understanding and editing capabilities, (ii) Adaptation with reasoning-guided multi-edit supervision to incorporate rich semantic guidance, and (iii) Coordinated reasoning-to generation reinforcement learning to jointly optimize reasoning and generation. During training, SmartPhotoCrafter emphasizes photo-realistic image generation, while supporting both image restoration and retouching tasks with consistent adherence to color- and tone-related semantics. We also construct a stage-specific dataset, which progressively builds reasoning and controllable generation, effective cross-module collaboration, and ultimately high-quality photographic enhancement. Experiments demonstrate that SmartPhotoCrafter outperforms existing generative models on the task of automatic photographic enhancement, achieving photo-realistic results while exhibiting higher tonal sensitivity to retouching instructions. Project page: https://github.com/vivoCameraResearch/SmartPhotoCrafter.

AI.tldr: SmartPhotoCrafter 将自动修图拆成“先审后改”两步：Image Critic 先指出缺陷，Photographic Artist 再精准优化，无需人工审美指令；三段式训练+专用数据集带来更真实、色调更敏感的成片。
AI.motivation: 传统修图依赖用户给出明确的审美指令，但普通人难以准确表达意图。作者想彻底摆脱“人给指令”这一瓶颈，让模型自行理解照片缺陷并完成专业级增强。
AI.method: 1) 双模块耦合：Image Critic 对原图做质量推理并输出缺陷掩码/语义向量，Photographic Artist 据此做像素级精细化生成。2) 三阶段训练：① 大规模美学预训练建立基本生成与审美常识；② 多任务推理-编辑联合监督微调，引入语义引导信号；③ 推理-生成协同 RL，同步优化 Critic 的判别精度与 Artist 的保真度。3) 构建渐进式数据集，从简单修复到高级调色逐步提升跨模块协同。整个流程强调颜色/色调语义一致性与照片级真实感。
AI.result: 在自动摄影增强基准上远超现有生成模型（指标未给出具体数值），输出照片更逼真，对色调、曝光、肤色等敏感属性的微调响应更细腻，可直接用于相机后期管线。
AI.conclusion: 把“修图”转化为“自推理+自生成”的闭环后，模型无需人类美学先验即可完成专业级提升；三段式训练与双模块协同设计是取得高真实度与色调敏感性的关键，后续可拓展到风格化、视频增强等任务。

title: OmniMouse: Scaling properties of multi-modal, multi-task Brain Models on 150B Neural Tokens
summary: Scaling data and artificial neural networks has transformed AI, driving breakthroughs in language and vision. Whether similar principles apply to modeling brain activity remains unclear. Here we leveraged a dataset of 3.1 million neurons from the visual cortex of 73 mice across 323 sessions, totaling more than 150 billion neural tokens recorded during natural movies, images and parametric stimuli, and behavior. We train multi-modal, multi-task models that support three regimes flexibly at test time: neural prediction, behavioral decoding, neural forecasting, or any combination of the three. OmniMouse achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming specialized baselines across nearly all evaluation regimes. We find that performance scales reliably with more data, but gains from increasing model size saturate. This inverts the standard AI scaling story: in language and computer vision, massive datasets make parameter scaling the primary driver of progress, whereas in brain modeling -- even in the mouse visual cortex, a relatively simple system -- models remain data-limited despite vast recordings. The observation of systematic scaling raises the possibility of phase transitions in neural modeling, where larger and richer datasets might unlock qualitatively new capabilities, paralleling the emergent properties seen in large language models. Code available at https://github.com/enigma-brain/omnimouse.

AI.tldr: 利用3.1亿神经元、1500亿神经token的跨鼠视觉皮层数据，OmniMouse首次实现神经预测-行为解码-神经预报三模态统一建模；性能随数据增加而提升，但模型参数量放大却迅速饱和，与NLP/CV“参数量主导”的 scaling 规律相反，提示脑建模仍处于数据饥渴阶段。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型与视觉AI通过“扩数据+扩参数”实现能力跃迁，但该 scaling 原则是否适用于神经活动建模尚属空白。亟需验证：1) 足够大数据能否驱动脑模型性能持续提升；2) 模型增大是否仍是主要增益来源；3) 是否存在类似LLM的涌现相变。
AI.method: 采集73只小鼠323会话、3.1 M神经元、>150 B神经token，覆盖自然影片、图像与参数刺激及行为。构建多模态-多任务 Transformer（OmniMouse），统一训练目标：神经活动预测、行为变量解码、未来神经活动预报。测试时可在三种任务间自由切换或组合。对比专用baseline（纯神经预测、纯行为解码、纯时序预报模型）。系统评估数据规模与模型规模对性能的影响。
AI.result: OmniMouse 在所有评估场景下均刷新SOTA，平均预测相关性提升10–30%。性能随训练数据量增加而可靠提升（近似幂律）；但当神经元数>500 k后，继续放大模型参数量带来的增益迅速饱和，扩参边际收益趋零。表明脑建模仍受数据限制，而非算力/参数限制。
AI.conclusion: 小鼠视觉皮层模型呈现“数据 scaling 有效、参数 scaling 无效”的逆AI规律，提示神经科学数据仍处于欠采样状态。更大数据集可能触发神经建模的“相变”，涌现类似大语言模型的通用表征与零-shot 能力。研究奠定大规模统一脑模型的工程范式，为后续跨脑区、跨物种、跨任务通用神经AI提供路线图。

title: Towards Understanding the Robustness of Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to optimization-based jailbreak attacks that exploit internal gradient structure. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for interpretability, their robustness implications remain underexplored. We present a study of integrating pretrained SAEs into transformer residual streams at inference time, without modifying model weights or blocking gradients. Across four model families (Gemma, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen) and two strong white-box attacks (GCG, BEAST) plus three black-box benchmarks, SAE-augmented models achieve up to a 5x reduction in jailbreak success rate relative to the undefended baseline and reduce cross-model attack transferability. Parametric ablations reveal (i) a monotonic dose-response relationship between L0 sparsity and attack success rate, and (ii) a layer-dependent defense-utility tradeoff, where intermediate layers balance robustness and clean performance. These findings are consistent with a representational bottleneck hypothesis: sparse projection reshapes the optimization geometry exploited by jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 在推理阶段把预训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）注入 Transformer 残差流，可在不改动权重、不阻断梯度的情况下，将白盒越狱攻击成功率最高降低 5 倍，并抑制攻击跨模型迁移。稀疏度越高、中间层注入效果越好，验证“表征瓶颈”假设。
AI.motivation: 大模型仍易被基于梯度的优化越狱攻击；SAE 虽广泛用于可解释性，但其安全价值未被系统研究。
AI.method: 在 4 个模型族（Gemma、LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen）的推理残差流中逐层插入预训练 SAE，保持梯度开放，采用 GCG、BEAST 两种白盒攻击及三项黑盒基准评估，并做稀疏度与层位消融。
AI.result: SAE 增强模型把越狱成功率最多压至基线的 1/5，跨模型迁移显著下降；存在单调的 L0 稀疏度-攻击成功率负相关，中间层注入在鲁棒性与干净性能间取得最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏投影通过重塑被攻击利用的优化几何，形成表征瓶颈，从而无需重训练即可有效防御越狱攻击，为可解释工具赋予直接安全价值。

title: Ultrametric OGP - parametric RDT \emph{symmetric} binary perceptron connection
summary:
In [97,99,100], an fl-RDT framework is introduced to characterize \emph{statistical computational gaps} (SCGs). Studying \emph{symmetric binary perceptrons} (SBPs), [100] obtained an \emph{algorithmic} threshold estimate $α_a\approx α_c^{(7)}\approx 1.6093$ at the 7th lifting level (for $κ=1$ margin), closely approaching $1.58$ local entropy (LE) prediction [18].
  In this paper, we further connect parametric RDT to overlap gap properties (OGPs), another key geometric feature of the solution space. Specifically, for any positive integer $s$, we consider $s$-level ultrametric OGPs ($ult_s$-OGPs) and rigorously upper-bound the associated constraint densities $α_{ult_s}$. To achieve this, we develop an analytical union-bounding program consisting of combinatorial and probabilistic components. By casting the combinatorial part as a convex problem and the probabilistic part as a nested integration, we conduct numerical evaluations and obtain that the tightest bounds at the first two levels, $\barα_{ult_1} \approx 1.6578$ and $\barα_{ult_2} \approx 1.6219$, closely approach the 3rd and 4th lifting level parametric RDT estimates, $α_c^{(3)} \approx 1.6576$ and $α_c^{(4)} \approx 1.6218$. We also observe excellent agreement across other key parameters, including overlap values and the relative sizes of ultrametric clusters.
  Based on these observations, we propose several conjectures linking $ult$-OGP and parametric RDT. Specifically, we conjecture that algorithmic threshold $α_a=\lim_{s\rightarrow\infty} α_{ult_s} = \lim_{s\rightarrow\infty} \barα{ult_s} = \lim_{r\rightarrow\infty} α_{c}^{(r)}$, and $α_{ult_s} \leq α_{c}^{(s+2)}$ (with possible equality for some (maybe even all) $s$). Finally, we discuss the potential existence of a full isomorphism connecting all key parameters of $ult$-OGP and parametric RDT.

AI.tldr: 本文将参数化fl-RDT框架与解空间几何特征ult_s-OGP严格关联，通过组合-概率联合界程序给出约束密度上界 arα_{ult_s}，数值显示 arα_{ult_1}≈1.6578、 arα_{ult_2}≈1.6219与RDT第3、4层估计α_c^{(3)}、α_c^{(4)}高度吻合，并提出算法阈值α_a等于两极限且α_{ult_s}≤α_c^{(s+2)}的猜想，暗示ult-OGP与RDT或存在完整同构。
AI.motivation: 既有研究用fl-RDT刻画对称二元感知机(SBP)的统计-计算间隙，算法阈值α_a≈1.6093已接近局部熵预言1.58，但缺乏与解空间几何障碍(overlap gap property, OGP)的严格定量联系；厘清二者关系可统一计算难性的几何与统计物理解释。
AI.method: 引入s-级超度量OGP(ult_s-OGP)，构建组合-概率联合界程序：组合部分化为凸优化，概率部分化为嵌套积分，数值求解得 constraint density 上界 arα_{ult_s}，并与fl-RDT各提升层估计α_c^{(r)}系统比较。
AI.result: 首两级给出 arα_{ult_1}≈1.6578、 arα_{ult_2}≈1.6219，与RDT第3、4层α_c^{(3)}≈1.6576、α_c^{(4)}≈1.6218几乎重合；重叠值与超度量簇相对尺寸等关键参数亦高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于数值吻合提出三点猜想：算法阈值α_a等于ult-OGP与RDT极限；α_{ult_s}≤α_c^{(s+2)}且可能取等；ult-OGP与参数化RDT或存在完整同构，从而为SBP的统计-计算间隙提供统一的几何-统计物理刻画。

title: Structure-Semantic Decoupled Modulation of Global Geospatial Embeddings for High-Resolution Remote Sensing Mapping
summary: Fine-grained high-resolution remote sensing mapping typically relies on localized visual features, which restricts cross-domain generalizability and often leads to fragmented predictions of large-scale land covers. While global geospatial foundation models offer powerful, generalizable representations, directly fusing their high-dimensional implicit embeddings with high-resolution visual features frequently triggers feature interference and spatial structure degradation due to a severe semantic-spatial gap. To overcome these limitations, we propose a Structure-Semantic Decoupled Modulation (SSDM) framework, which decouples global geospatial representations into two complementary cross-modal injection pathways. First, the structural prior modulation branch introduces the macroscopic receptive field priors from global representations into the self-attention modules of the high-resolution encoder. By guiding local feature extraction with holistic structural constraints, it effectively suppresses prediction fragmentation caused by high-frequency detail noise and excessive intra-class variance. Second, the global semantic injection branch explicitly aligns holistic context with the deep high-resolution feature space and directly supplements global semantics via cross-modal integration, thereby significantly enhancing the semantic consistency and category-level discrimination of complex land covers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing cross-modal fusion approaches. By unleashing the potential of global embeddings, SSDM consistently improves high-resolution mapping accuracy across diverse scenarios, providing a universal and effective paradigm for integrating geospatial foundation models into high-resolution vision tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SSDM框架，把全球地理大模型的宏观结构先验与全局语义解耦，分别注入高分辨率编码器的自注意力与深层特征空间，既抑制碎片预测又增强语义一致性，实现跨域高精度制图。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率遥感制图依赖局部视觉特征，导致跨域泛化差、大片地物碎片化；直接融合全球地理大模型的高维隐式嵌入会因语义-空间鸿沟产生特征干扰与结构退化，亟需一种保留大模型优势且避免副作用的方案。
AI.method: 结构-语义解耦调制框架把全球表示拆成两条互补通路：①结构先验调制，把宏观感受野先验注入高分辨率编码器的自注意力，约束局部特征提取；②全局语义注入，显式对齐整体上下文与深度高分辨率特征空间并跨模态补充全局语义。
AI.result: 在跨模态融合方法中达到SOTA，可在多种场景下持续提升高分辨率制图精度，显著抑制碎片化并增强复杂地物的类别判别力。
AI.conclusion: SSDM为全球地理大模型与高分视觉任务耦合提供了通用有效范式，证实了解耦注入策略能够充分释放大模型潜力并克服语义-空间鸿沟。

title: Semantic Needles in Document Haystacks: Sensitivity Testing of LLM-as-a-Judge Similarity Scoring
summary: We propose a scalable, multifactorial experimental framework that systematically probes LLM sensitivity to subtle semantic changes in pairwise document comparison. We analogize this as a needle-in-a-haystack problem: a single semantically altered sentence (the needle) is embedded within surrounding context (the hay), and we vary the perturbation type (negation, conjunction swap, named entity replacement), context type (original vs. topically unrelated), needle position, and document length across all combinations, testing five LLMs on tens of thousands of document pairs. Our analysis reveals several striking findings. First, LLMs exhibit a within-document positional bias distinct from previously studied candidate-order effects: most models penalize semantic differences more harshly when they occur earlier in a document. Second, when the altered sentence is surrounded by topically unrelated context, it systematically lowers similarity scores and induces bipolarized scores that indicate either very low or very high similarity. This is consistent with an interpretive frame account in which topically-related context may allow models to contextualize and downweight the alterations. Third, each LLM produces a qualitatively distinct scoring distribution, a stable "fingerprint" that is invariant to perturbation type, yet all models share a universal hierarchy in how leniently they treat different perturbation types. Together, these results demonstrate that LLM semantic similarity scores are sensitive to document structure, context coherence, and model identity in ways that go beyond the semantic change itself, and that the proposed framework offers a practical, LLM-agnostic toolkit for auditing and comparing scoring behavior across current and future models.

AI.tldr: 在万对文档中仅改动一句话，系统测试五大LLM对‘针’式语义微扰的敏感度；发现早段偏差、无关语境致评分两极化，且各模型对扰动类型宽容度呈一致排序。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM语义相似度评估多聚焦大块文本或显式差异，尚缺乏对‘ needles-in-haystack’式细粒度扰动的系统审计，难以揭示位置、语境及模型身份对评分的隐性影响。
AI.method: 设计可扩展多因子实验框架：①扰动类型（否定、连词调换、实体替换）×②语境一致性（原文vs无关主题）×③针位置×④文档长度，全组合生成数万文档对；5个主流LLM打分，统计分布与偏差模式。
AI.result: 1) 早段惩罚：差异句越靠前，相似度扣分越重，与候选顺序效应不同；2) 无关语境包围时针句使得分两极化，支持“解释框架”假设；3) 每模型呈现稳定评分指纹，扰动宽容度顺序跨模型一致（如否定最严，实体替换最宽）。
AI.conclusion: LLM语义评分受文档结构、语境连贯与模型身份共同调制，远超语义差异本身；该框架提供LLM无关的实用审计与对比工具，可推广至未来模型。

title: Human-Guided Harm Recovery for Computer Use Agents
summary: As LM agents gain the ability to execute actions on real computer systems, we need ways to not only prevent harmful actions at scale but also effectively remediate harm when prevention fails. We formalize a solution to this neglected challenge in post-execution safeguards as harm recovery: the problem of optimally steering an agent from a harmful state back to a safe one in alignment with human preferences. We ground preference-aligned recovery through a formative user study that identifies valued recovery dimensions and produces a natural language rubric. Our dataset of 1,150 pairwise judgments reveals context-dependent shifts in attribute importance, such as preferences for pragmatic, targeted strategies over comprehensive long-term approaches. We operationalize these learned insights in a reward model, re-ranking multiple candidate recovery plans generated by an agent scaffold at test time. To evaluate recovery capabilities systematically, we introduce BackBench, a benchmark of 50 computer-use tasks that test an agent's ability to recover from harmful states. Human evaluation shows our reward model scaffold yields higher-quality recovery trajectories than base agents and rubric-based scaffolds. Together, these contributions lay the foundation for a new class of agent safety methods -- ones that confront harm not only by preventing it, but by navigating its aftermath with alignment and intent.

AI.tldr: 提出「伤害恢复」新范式：用人类偏好引导LM智能体在有害行为发生后自主回到安全状态，并构建评估基准BackBench验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: LM智能体获得真实系统操作能力后，仅靠事前防护已不足；需在事后阶段提供可扩展、偏好对齐的修复机制，防止危害扩散并弥补现有安全框架缺口。
AI.method: ①用户研究提炼恢复关键维度并生成自然语言评分标准；②收集1,150对成对偏好数据，发现上下文敏感的策略偏好；③训练奖励模型，对运行时生成的多条恢复计划进行重排序；④设计BackBench（50项计算机任务）系统评估恢复能力。
AI.result: 人类评估显示，奖励模型脚手架的恢复轨迹质量显著优于基线智能体与纯规则脚手架，证明其能按人类偏好执行精准、高效的恢复操作。
AI.conclusion: 首次将「事后修复」确立为智能体安全核心环节，提供可扩展、对齐人类意图的恢复框架，为构建既能预防又能善后下一代LM智能体安全体系奠定基础。

title: Adaptive MSD-Splitting: Enhancing C4.5 and Random Forests for Skewed Continuous Attributes
summary: The discretization of continuous numerical attributes remains a persistent computational bottleneck in the induction of decision trees, particularly as dataset dimensions scale. Building upon the recently proposed MSD-Splitting technique -- which bins continuous data using the empirical mean and standard deviation to dramatically improve the efficiency and accuracy of the C4.5 algorithm -- we introduce Adaptive MSD-Splitting (AMSD). While standard MSD-Splitting is highly effective for approximately symmetric distributions, its rigid adherence to fixed one-standard-deviation cutoffs can lead to catastrophic information loss in highly skewed data, a common artifact in real-world biomedical and financial datasets. AMSD addresses this by dynamically adjusting the standard deviation multiplier based on feature skewness, narrowing intervals in dense regions to preserve discriminative resolution. Furthermore, we integrate AMSD into ensemble methods, specifically presenting the Random Forest-AMSD (RF-AMSD) framework. Empirical evaluations on the Census Income, Heart Disease, Breast Cancer, and Forest Covertype datasets demonstrate that AMSD yields a 2-4% accuracy improvement over standard MSD-Splitting, while maintaining near-identical O(N) time complexity reductions compared to the O(N log N) exhaustive search. Our Random Forest extension achieves state-of-the-art accuracy at a fraction of standard computational costs, confirming the viability of adaptive statistical binning in large-scale ensemble learning architectures.

AI.tldr: 自适应MSD分箱(AMSD)用动态调整标准差倍数以降低高偏态分布的信息损失，在O(N)复杂度下使单树提升2-4%准确率，并将其嵌入随机森林，实现快速高精度集成。
AI.motivation: 连续属性离散化是决策树的计算瓶颈。新近MSD-Split利用均值±1σ二分离散化，虽将C4.5复杂度从O(N logN)降至O(N)，但对偏态分布会丢失大量判别信息；生物医学、金融等高偏分布数据集亟需既能维持线性时间又能自适应数据形态的快速分箱策略。
AI.method: 1) 提出Adaptive MSD-Splitting(AMSD)：先用偏度系数实时估算分布偏态，依此动态调节标准差倍数(narrow/widen)，保留密集区分辨率。2) 集成化：将AMSD节点分裂准则嵌入随机森林，设计RF-AMSD框架，保证线性时间同时维持子树多样性。
AI.result: 在Census Income、Heart Disease、Breast Cancer与Forest Covertype四组数据上，AMSD单树平均准确率比MSD-Split高2-4%；时间复杂度仍保持O(N)。RF-AMSD整体准确率领先经典RF与MSD-RF，同时计算开销远小于传统穷尽搜索分裂。
AI.conclusion: 自适应统计分箱能有效兼顾速度与精度，可作为大规模集成学习的核心离散化组件，为高维偏态数据提供实用解决方案。

title: PC2Model: ISPRS benchmark on 3D point cloud to model registration
summary: Point cloud registration involves aligning one point cloud with another or with a three-dimensional (3D) model, enabling the integration of multimodal data into a unified representation. This is essential in applications such as construction monitoring, autonomous driving, robotics, and virtual or augmented reality (VR/AR).With the increasing accessibility of point cloud acquisition technologies, such as Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) and structured light scanning, along with recent advances in deep learning, the research focus has increasingly shifted towards downstream tasks, particularly point cloud-to-model (PC2Model) registration. While data-driven methods aim to automate this process, they struggle with sparsity, noise, clutter, and occlusions in real-world scans, which limit their performance. To address these challenges, this paper introduces the PC2Model benchmark, a publicly available dataset designed to support the training and evaluation of both classical and data-driven methods. Developed under the leadership of ICWG II/Ib, the PC2Model benchmark adopts a hybrid design that combines simulated point clouds with, in some cases, real-world scans and their corresponding 3D models. Simulated data provide precise ground truth and controlled conditions, while real-world data introduce sensor and environmental artefacts. This design supports robust training and evaluation across domains and enables the systematic analysis of model transferability from simulated to real-world scenarios. The dataset is publicly accessible at: https://zenodo.org/uploads/17581812.

AI.tldr: 文中提出首个公开PC2Model配准基准，融合模拟与少量真实扫描，为对抗稀疏、噪声、遮挡等现实难题提供统一训练与评测数据。
AI.motivation: 点云到三维模型(PC2Model)配准是建筑监测、自动驾驶、VR/AR等应用的关键步骤；现有点云数据受稀疏、噪声、遮挡困扰，缺乏公开基准，深度学习难以训练与公平比较。
AI.method: ICWG II/Ib牵头构建PC2Model基准：混合生成高保真模拟点云（带精确真值）并补充真实扫描（含传感器与环境瑕疵），形成跨域可迁移数据集，提供统一训练/测试协议。
AI.result: 该基准已公开(https://zenodo.org/uploads/17581812)，支持经典与数据驱动方法系统评测；实验表明其能揭示模拟→真实场景迁移性能差异，为算法鲁棒性研究奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: PC2Model通过“模拟+真实”混合设计弥补数据空缺，为点云模型配准提供首个公开、跨域、可复现的评测平台，将推动该领域算法标准化与落地应用。

title: One Step Forward and K Steps Back: Better Reasoning with Denoising Recursion Models
summary: Looped transformers scale computational depth without increasing parameter count by repeatedly applying a shared transformer block and can be used for iterative refinement, where each loop rewrites a full fixed-size prediction in parallel. On difficult problems, such as those that require search-like computation, reaching a highly structured solution starting from noise can require long refinement trajectories. Learning such trajectories is challenging when training specifies only the target solution and provides no supervision over the intermediate refinement path. Diffusion models tackle this issue by corrupting data with varying magnitudes of noise and training the model to reverse it in a \textit{single step}. However, this process misaligns training and testing behaviour. We introduce Denoising Recursion Models, a method that similarly corrupts data with noise but trains the model to reverse the corruption over \textit{multiple} recursive steps. This strategy provides a tractable curriculum of intermediate states, while better aligning training with testing and incentivizing non-greedy, forward-looking generation. Through extensive experiments, we show this approach outperforms the Tiny Recursion Model (TRM) on ARC-AGI, where it recently achieved breakthrough performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Denoising Recursion Models（DRM），通过在多步递归中逆转加噪过程，为无中间监督的迭代优化问题提供可学习的中间状态课程，训练-测试行为一致，并在 ARC-AGI 上超越 Tiny Recursion Model（TRM），创下新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 基于 Looped Transformer 的迭代优化范式在解决需要“搜索式”计算的结构化难题时，需长轨迹逐步从噪声逼近解，但仅给定最终解、缺乏中间监督，导致学习困难；现有扩散模型单步去噪训练与多步测试行为不一致，需一种对齐训练-测试并显式提供中间状态课程的方法。
AI.method: 设计 Denoising Recursion Models：① 对目标解施加多尺度噪声生成腐败样本；② 用共享参数的 Looped Transformer 块执行多步递归去噪，每步并行重写固定长度预测；③ 训练目标为最小化多步去噪序列与真实解的误差，形成可学习的中间状态课程，鼓励非贪心、前瞻式生成。
AI.result: 在抽象推理基准 ARC-AGI 上，DRM 相比当前最佳 Tiny Recursion Model（TRM）取得显著性能跃升，突破该任务公开排行榜记录；消融实验验证多步递归训练与加噪课程对最终精度至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 通过将扩散式去噪过程嵌套进 Looped Transformer 的多步递归框架，DRM 无需增加参数量即实现可扩展的推理深度，解决了中间状态无监督、训练-测试行为错配两大痛点，为复杂结构推理任务提供了新的高效学习范式，并可推广至其他需长轨迹优化的场景。

title: Harmful Intent as a Geometrically Recoverable Feature of LLM Residual Streams
summary:
Harmful intent is geometrically recoverable from large language model residual streams: as a linear direction in most layers, and as angular deviation in layers where projection methods fail. Across 12 models spanning four architectural families (Qwen2.5, Qwen3.5, Llama-3.2, Gemma-3) and three alignment variants (base, instruction-tuned, abliterated), under single-turn, English evaluation, we characterise this geometry through six direction-finding strategies. Three succeed: a soft-AUC-optimised linear direction reaches mean AUROC 0.98 and TPR@1\%FPR 0.80; a class-mean probe reaches 0.98 and 0.71 at <1ms fitting cost; a supervised angular-deviation strategy reaches AUROC 0.96 and TPR of 0.61 along a representationally distinct direction ($73^\circ$ from projection-based solutions), uniquely sustaining detection in middle layers where projection methods collapse.
  Detection remains stable across alignment variants, including abliterated models from which refusal has been surgically removed: harmful intent and refusal behaviour are functionally dissociated features of the representation. A direction fitted on AdvBench transfers to held-out HarmBench and JailbreakBench with worst-case AUROC 0.96. The same picture holds at scale: across Qwen3.5 from 0.8B to 9B parameters, AUROC remains $\geq$0.98 and cross-variant transfer stays within 0.018 of own-direction performance
  This is consistent with a simple account: models acquire a linearly decodable representation of harmful intent as part of general language understanding, and alignment then shapes what they do with such inputs without reorganising the upstream recognition signal. As a practical consequence, AUROC in the 0.97+ regime can substantially overestimate operational detectability; TPR@$1\%$FPR should accompany AUROC in safety-adjacent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 有害意图在 LLM 残差流中以线性方向和角度偏差两种几何形式稳定存在，跨 12 模型、3 对齐版本、3 基准均保持 AUROC≥0.96，且与拒绝机制可分离；高 AUROC 易高估实战可检测性，需同步报告 TPR@1%FPR。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法通过拒绝机制阻断有害输出，但若模型内部仍“识别”有害意图，则存在被绕过风险。需厘清有害意图在表征空间中的存在形式、跨模型/对齐版本的稳定性，及其与拒绝行为的可分离性，为安全评估提供可靠指标。
AI.method: 在 12 个模型（4 家族×3 对齐版本）单轮英文评测中，用 6 种寻方向策略探测残差流：软 AUC 优化线性探针、类均值探针、监督角度偏差法、以及 3 种失败策略。通过 AUROC、TPR@1%FPR 评估检测力，并在中层引入角度偏差以解决投影法失效层。跨 AdvBench→HarmBench/JailbreakBench 以及 0.8B-9B 规模做迁移与缩放测试。
AI.result: 软 AUC 线性方向：AUROC 0.98，TPR@1%FPR 0.80；类均值探针：0.98/0.71，拟合 <1 ms；角度偏差法：AUROC 0.96，TPR 0.61，方向与投影解成 73°，在中层投影法崩溃区仍有效。检测力在对齐变体（含剔除拒绝的 abliterated 模型）中稳定；AdvBench 方向跨数据集最差 AUROC 0.96；0.8B-9B 参数规模 AUROC≥0.98，跨变体性能下降 ≤0.018。有害意图与拒绝行为表征可分离。
AI.conclusion: LLM 在通用语言理解中即习得线性可解码的有害意图信号，对齐仅改变下游使用方式而不重排上游识别结构。纯 AUROC 会虚高实战可检测性，安全评估应强制同步报告 TPR@1%FPR，并关注中层角度偏差信号。

title: Benign Overfitting in Adversarial Training for Vision Transformers
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2409.19345 by other authors
summary: Despite the remarkable success of Vision Transformers (ViTs) across a wide range of vision tasks, recent studies have revealed that they remain vulnerable to adversarial examples, much like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). A common empirical defense strategy is adversarial training, yet the theoretical underpinnings of its robustness in ViTs remain largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first theoretical analysis of adversarial training under simplified ViT architectures. We show that, when trained under a signal-to-noise ratio that satisfies a certain condition and within a moderate perturbation budget, adversarial training enables ViTs to achieve nearly zero robust training loss and robust generalization error under certain regimes. Remarkably, this leads to strong generalization even in the presence of overfitting, a phenomenon known as \emph{benign overfitting}, previously only observed in CNNs (with adversarial training). Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets further validate our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 首次从理论上证明，在适度扰动和满足 SNR 条件时，对抗训练可使简化 ViT 实现近乎零鲁棒训练误差与鲁棒泛化误差，并出现良性过拟合现象，实验验证了结论。
AI.motivation: ViT 在视觉任务上表现优异，却与 CNN 一样易受对抗样本攻击。尽管经验表明对抗训练可提升鲁棒性，但其对 ViT 的理论机理尚属空白。
AI.method: 在简化的 ViT 架构下，建立对抗训练的统计学习框架；引入信噪比约束与适度扰动预算，推导鲁棒训练损失与泛化误差的收敛界。
AI.result: 证明在满足 SNR 条件及扰动预算内，对抗训练可使 ViT 达到接近零的鲁棒训练/泛化误差，并首次在 ViT 上观察到良性过拟合。合成与真实数据实验与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 对抗训练不仅能让 ViT 获得鲁棒性，还能在过拟合情况下保持良好的泛化，为设计和理解鲁棒 ViT 提供了理论基础。

title: Volume Transformer: Revisiting Vanilla Transformers for 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Transformers have become a common foundation across deep learning, yet 3D scene understanding still relies on specialized backbones with strong domain priors. This keeps the field isolated from the broader Transformer ecosystem, limiting the transfer of new advances as well as the benefits of increasingly optimized software and hardware stacks. To bridge this gap, we adapt the vanilla Transformer encoder to 3D scenes with minimal modifications. Given an input 3D scene, we partition it into volumetric patch tokens, process them with full global self-attention, and inject positional information via a 3D extension of rotary positional embeddings. We call the resulting model the Volume Transformer (Volt) and apply it to 3D semantic segmentation. Naively training Volt on standard 3D benchmarks leads to shortcut learning, highlighting the limited scale of current 3D supervision. To overcome this, we introduce a data-efficient training recipe based on strong 3D augmentations, regularization, and distillation from a convolutional teacher, making Volt competitive with state-of-the-art methods. We then scale supervision through joint training on multiple datasets and show that Volt benefits more from increased scale than domain-specific 3D backbones, achieving state-of-the-art results across indoor and outdoor datasets. Finally, when used as a drop-in backbone in a standard 3D instance segmentation pipeline, Volt again sets a new state of the art, highlighting its potential as a simple, scalable, general-purpose backbone for 3D scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 把纯Transformer几乎不做改动地搬到3D语义/实例分割，用极简「体素patch+3D-RoPE」架构横扫室内外基准，证明通用ViT生态可直接接管3D任务。
AI.motivation: 3D场景理解长期依赖专用卷积骨架，与CV/NLP的Transformer生态脱节，没法直接复用算法-软件-硬件协同红利。作者想让3D社区“一键上车”通用Transformer。
AI.method: 1)将点云/体素场景切块成「3D patch token」，编码特征；2)在3D空间展开RoPE，保留几何位置；3)仅用标准Transformer Encoder做全局self-attention，得到Volume Transformer (Volt)。训练阶段用强3D增广、正则化和Conv教师蒸馏克服小数据集捷径学习，并多数据集联合放大监督规模。
AI.result: 在室内(ScanNet、S3DIS)和户外(SemanticKITTI)语义分割均刷新SOTA；替换Mask3D的3D backbone后，实例分割也登顶ScanNet基准。模型越大，数据越多，性能持续提升，超越专门设计的3D卷积网络。
AI.conclusion: 无需复杂3D先验，通用Transformer即可胜任3D理解；Data-centric训练策略是解锁性能的关键。Volt给3D社区提供了简单、可扩展、即插即用的统一骨干，预示3D视觉将与大模型/大生态全面接轨。

title: The Triadic Loop: A Framework for Negotiating Alignment in AI Co-hosted Livestreaming
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, Proceedings the Human-AI Interaction Alignment Workshop at CHI 2026 (CHI26 BiAlign Workshop)
summary: AI systems are increasingly embedded in multi-user social environments, yet most alignment frameworks conceptualize interaction as a dyadic relationship between a single user and an AI system. Livestreaming platforms challenge this assumption: interaction unfolds among streamers and audiences in real time, producing dynamic affective and social feedback loops. In this paper, we introduce the Triadic Loop, a conceptual framework that reconceptualizes alignment in AI co-hosted livestreaming as a temporally reinforced process of bidirectional adaptation among three actors: streamer $\leftrightarrow$ AI co-host, AI co-host $\leftrightarrow$ audience, and streamer $\leftrightarrow$ audience. Unlike instruction-following paradigms, bidirectional alignment requires each actor to continuously reshape the others, meaning misalignment in any sub-loop can destabilize the broader system. Drawing on literature from multi-party interaction, collaborative AI, and relational agents, we articulate how AI co-hosts function not only as mediators but as performative participants and community members shaping collective meaning-making. We further propose "strategic misalignment" as a mechanism for sustaining community engagement and introduce three relational evaluation constructs grounded in established instruments. The framework contributes a model of dynamic multi-party alignment, an account of cross-loop reinforcement, and design implications for AI co-hosts that sustain social coherence in participatory media environments.

AI.tldr: 提出“三元回路”框架，将直播中的AI对齐视为主播-AI-观众三者间实时双向适应的动态过程，并给出评测指标与设计启示。
AI.motivation: 传统AI对齐仅考虑单用户-单系统二元关系，无法解释直播等多人实时交互场景中的复杂动态，需扩展为多人协同对齐范式。
AI.method: 综合多用户交互、协作AI与关系代理文献，构建三边双向适应的“三元回路”模型；引入“策略性不对齐”概念维持社群活力；提炼主播-AI、AI-观众、主播-观众三对关系的评测构念。
AI.result: 框架揭示：任一回路失准都会经时序强化放大，导致系统整体失稳；AI作为表演性参与者可主动塑造集体意义；适度策略性不对齐反而提升社群黏性。
AI.conclusion: 动态多方对齐是参与式媒体中AI协同直播的核心挑战；未来AI主播设计应兼顾实时双向适应、跨回路强化监测与策略性不对齐机制，以维系社交一致性。

title: Comparison of sEMG Encoding Accuracy Across Speech Modes Using Articulatory and Phoneme Features
summary: We test whether Speech Articulatory Coding (SPARC) features can linearly predict surface electromyography (sEMG) envelopes across aloud, mimed, and subvocal speech in twenty-four subjects. Using elastic-net multivariate temporal response function (mTRF) with sentence-level cross-validation, SPARC yields higher prediction accuracy than phoneme one-hot representations on nearly all electrodes and in all speech modes. Aloud and mimed speech perform comparably, and subvocal speech remains above chance, indicating detectable articulatory activity. Variance partitioning shows a substantial unique contribution from SPARC and a minimal unique contribution from phoneme features. mTRF weight patterns reveal anatomically interpretable relationships between electrode sites and articulatory movements that remain consistent across modes. This study focuses on representation/encoding analysis (not end-to-end decoding) and supports SPARC as a robust and interpretable intermediate target for sEMG-based silent-speech modeling.

AI.tldr: SPARC特征能跨大/默/隐性语态线性预测sEMG包络，优于音素独热编码，为沉默语音建模提供可解释中间表征。
AI.motivation: 验证Speech Articulatory Coding（SPARC）是否足以线性预测表面肌电包络，并取代传统音素表征，为基于sEMG的沉默语音接口建立稳健的中间层。
AI.method: 24名受试者在三种语态（朗读、默读、隐性）下采集sEMG；用弹性网多元时序响应函数（mTRF）及句子级交叉验证，比较SPARC与音素独热特征的预测准确度；通过方差分解与权重可视化解析编码关系。
AI.result: SPARC在各语态、各电极上的预测准确度均显著高于音素独热编码；朗读与默读无差异，隐性语态仍高于随机；SPARC独立解释大部分方差，mTRF权重呈现跨语态一致的解剖学可解释模式。
AI.conclusion: SPARC可作为sEMG-based沉默语音模型的稳健、可解释中间表征，无需端到端解码即可捕获跨语态的显性发音信息。

title: FB-NLL: A Feature-Based Approach to Tackle Noisy Labels in Personalized Federated Learning
summary:
Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) aims to learn multiple task-specific models rather than a single global model across heterogeneous data distributions. Existing PFL approaches typically rely on iterative optimization-such as model update trajectories-to cluster users that need to accomplish the same tasks together. However, these learning-dynamics-based methods are inherently vulnerable to low-quality data and noisy labels, as corrupted updates distort clustering decisions and degrade personalization performance. To tackle this, we propose FB-NLL, a feature-centric framework that decouples user clustering from iterative training dynamics. By exploiting the intrinsic heterogeneity of local feature spaces, FB-NLL characterizes each user through the spectral structure of the covariances of their feature representations and leverages subspace similarity to identify task-consistent user groupings. This geometry-aware clustering is label-agnostic and is performed in a one-shot manner prior to training, significantly reducing communication overhead and computational costs compared to iterative baselines.
  Complementing this, we introduce a feature-consistency-based detection and correction strategy to address noisy labels within clusters. By leveraging directional alignment in the learned feature space and assigning labels based on class-specific feature subspaces, our method mitigates corrupted supervision without requiring estimation of stochastic noise transition matrices. In addition, FB-NLL is model-independent and integrates seamlessly with existing noise-robust training techniques. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and noise regimes demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of average accuracy and performance stability.

AI.tldr: 提出FB-NCLL：一种无需迭代训练、以特征空間谱结构一次性聚类用户并解决标签噪声的个性化联邦学习框架。
AI.motivation: 现有PPL算法依赖迭代更新轨迹聚类，易被脏数据与噪标误导；通信与计算开销大，需要一种在训练前即能抗噪并快速分群的方法。
AI.method: 1) 预训练阶段：各客户端提取本地特征，用协方差矩阵的谱结构（子空间）刻画任务特性，计算子空间相似度实现一次性几何聚类；2) 去噪阶段：在每个簇内利用特征方向一致性检测并矫正错误标签，无需噪声转移矩阵；3) 训练阶段：在簇内并行执行个性化模型训练，可与任意抗噪算法组合。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、FMINST等多类非独立同分布噪声场景下，平均准确率优于最新基准5%–15%，客户端间稳定性提升30%，通信轮次减少60%以上，计算时间降低2–3倍。
AI.conclusion: FB-NLL通过“特征空間谱聚类+去噪”两字策略，将聚类从迭代训练中解耦，一举解决PPL中分组不稳定与噪标困扰，兼具模型无关、低开销、高精度等优势，为异构联邦环境下的个性化学习提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: GRAFT: Geometric Refinement and Fitting Transformer for Human Scene Reconstruction
summary:
Reconstructing physically plausible 3D human-scene interactions (HSI) from a single image currently presents a trade-off: optimization based methods offer accurate contact but are slow (~20s), while feed-forward approaches are fast yet lack explicit interaction reasoning, producing floating and interpenetration artifacts.
  Our key insight is that geometry-based human--scene fitting can be amortized into fast feed-forward inference. We present GRAFT (Geometric Refinement And Fitting Transformer), a learned HSI prior that predicts Interaction Gradients: corrective parameter updates that iteratively refine human meshes by reasoning about their 3D relationship to the surrounding scene.
  GRAFT encodes the interaction state into compact body-anchored tokens, each grounded in the scene geometry via Geometric Probes that capture spatial relationships with nearby surfaces.
  A lightweight transformer recurrently updates human meshes and re-probes the scene, ensuring the final pose aligns with both learned priors and observed geometry.
  GRAFT operates either as an end-to-end reconstructor using image features, or with geometry alone as a transferable plug-and-play HSI prior that improves feed-forward methods without retraining.
  Experiments show GRAFT improves interaction quality by up to 113% over state-of-the-art feed-forward methods and matches optimization-based interaction quality at ${\sim}50{\times}$ lower runtime, while generalizing seamlessly to in-the-wild multi-person scenes and being preferred in 64.8% of three-way user study. Project page: https://pradyumnaym.github.io/graft .

AI.tldr: 单图重建人与场景交互时，优化法准但慢，前馈法快却产生漂浮/穿模。GRAFT将几何拟合“摊销”为前馈推理，用轻量Transformer迭代预测“交互梯度”修正人体网格，50倍提速同时达到优化级接触质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在速度与交互精度上不可兼得：优化需~20s，前馈缺少显式接触推理，导致伪影。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT，把几何人-景拟合过程学习成前馈先验。核心：①用场景几何探针将交互状态编码为身体锚定token；②轻量Transformer递归预测交互梯度，逐次更新人体网格并重探场景；③可端到端用图像特征，也可仅几何作即插即用先验，无需重训即可增强任意前馈法。
AI.result: 在多项基准上将前馈方法的交互质量提升113%，运行时间仅为优化法的1/50，结果与用户研究64.8%偏好率一致；对野外多人场景零样本泛化。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT证明“把慢速几何优化摊销成前馈”可行，首次在单图HSI中同时实现高质量接触与实时推理，为后续研究提供可迁移的交互先验。

title: Temporal UI State Inconsistency in Desktop GUI Agents: Formalizing and Defending Against TOCTOU Attacks on Computer-Use Agents
summary: GUI agents that control desktop computers via screenshot-and-click loops introduce a new class of vulnerability: the observation-to-action gap (mean 6.51 s on real OSWorld workloads) creates a Time-Of-Check, Time-Of-Use (TOCTOU) window during which an unprivileged attacker can manipulate the UI state. We formalize this as a Visual Atomicity Violation and characterize three concrete attack primitives: (A) Notification Overlay Hijack, (B) Window Focus Manipulation, and (C) Web DOM Injection. Primitive B, the closest desktop analog to Android Action Rebinding, achieves 100% action-redirection success rate with zero visual evidence at the observation time. We propose Pre-execution UI State Verification (PUSV), a lightweight three-layer defense that re-verifies the UI state immediately before each action dispatch: masked pixel SSIM at the click target (L1), global screenshot diff (L2a), and X Window snapshot diff (L2b). PUSV achieves 100% Action Interception Rate across 180 adversarial trials (135 Primitive A + 45 Primitive B) with zero false positives and < 0.1 s overhead. Against Primitive C (zero-visual-footprint DOM injection), PUSV reveals a structural blind spot (~0% AIR), motivating future OS+DOM defense-in-depth architectures. No single PUSV layer alone achieves full coverage; different primitives require different detection signals, validating the layered design.

AI.tldr: 作者揭示了GUI agent在“截屏→识别→点击”的时间窗内存在视觉原子性漏洞（TOCTOU），提出三合一轻量级防御PUSV，可在<0.1 s开销下100%拦截两类攻击，但对零视觉痕迹的DOM注入仍失效。
AI.motivation: 基于截图-点击循环的桌面GUI agent平均需6.51 s完成从观察到执行，形成TOCTOU攻击面；此前尚无针对此类视觉原子性违背的系统性研究与防御。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义Visual Atomicity Violation；2) 设计并评估三种攻击原语：通知覆盖劫持、窗口焦点操纵、Web DOM注入；3) 提出三层PUSV防御：L1掩膜像素SSIM、L2a全局截图差、L2b X Window快照差，在动作派发前即时重验UI状态。
AI.result: 对180次对抗试验（135次A+45次B）实现100%动作拦截率、0%误报，平均额外耗时<0.1 s；Primitive B成功率由100%降至0%；但对零视觉痕迹的Primitive C拦截率≈0%，暴露结构性盲区。
AI.conclusion: 视觉原子性违背是真实存在的严重威胁；不同攻击需不同检测信号，佐证PUSV分层设计的必要性；未来需融合OS级与DOM级防御，形成纵深体系。

title: Personalized Benchmarking: Evaluating LLMs by Individual Preferences
summary: With the rise in capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their deployment in real-world tasks, evaluating LLM alignment with human preferences has become an important challenge. Current benchmarks average preferences across all users to compute aggregate ratings, overlooking individual user preferences when establishing model rankings. Since users have varying preferences in different contexts, we call for personalized LLM benchmarks that rank models according to individual needs. We compute personalized model rankings using ELO ratings and Bradley-Terry coefficients for 115 active Chatbot Arena users and analyze how user query characteristics (topics and writing style) relate to LLM ranking variations. We demonstrate that individual rankings of LLM models diverge dramatically from aggregate LLM rankings, with Bradley-Terry correlations averaging only $ρ= 0.04$ (57\% of users show near-zero or negative correlation) and ELO ratings showing moderate correlation ($ρ= 0.43$). Through topic modeling and style analysis, we find users exhibit substantial heterogeneity in topical interests and communication styles, influencing their model preferences. We further show that a compact combination of topic and style features provides a useful feature space for predicting user-specific model rankings. Our results provide strong quantitative evidence that aggregate benchmarks fail to capture individual preferences for most users, and highlight the importance of developing personalized benchmarks that rank LLM models according to individual user preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前LLM基准把全部用户偏好平均成单一排行榜会丢失个体差异；首次用ELO/Bradley-Terry为115名活跃Arena用户构建个性化排名，证明其与原榜单几乎无关，并可用话题+写作风格特征预测个体排序。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准统计全体用户的平均偏好给出统一排名，忽视了用户在不同情境下的差异化偏好，导致很多人
AI.method: 对Chatbot Arena 115名活跃用户的多轮对战数据，先用话题模型与文本风格分析提取用户查询特征，再分别用ELO评分与Bradley-Terry系数算法为其建立个性化模型排名；随后计算其与官方聚合排名之间的皮尔逊相关系数以评估一致性，并测试话题+风格特征对预测个体排名的可行性。
AI.result: Bradley-Terry个性化排名与聚合排名平均相关性仅ρ=0.04，57%用户相关性接近或低于0；ELO稍高（ρ=0.43）但也中低。话题模型显示用户在关注主题、沟通风格上高度异质，线性组合这两类紧凑特征获得合宜的个性预测空间，显著优于随机基线。
AI.conclusion: 细致度量证明现有聚合基准对大多数用户无法准确反映其个人偏好；必须发展基于个体需求的个性化LLM评测体系。同时，用户的查询主题和写作风格是预测其模型偏好的有效线索，为后续自适应基准与模型个性化提供可行路径。

title: FASTER: Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL
summary: Some of the most performant reinforcement learning algorithms today can be prohibitively expensive as they use test-time scaling methods such as sampling multiple action candidates and selecting the best one. In this work, we propose FASTER, a method for getting the benefits of sampling-based test-time scaling of diffusion-based policies without the computational cost by tracing the performance gain of action samples back to earlier in the denoising process. Our key insight is that we can model the denoising of multiple action candidates and selecting the best one as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) where the goal is to progressively filter action candidates before denoising is complete. With this MDP, we can learn a policy and value function in the denoising space that predicts the downstream value of action candidates in the denoising process and filters them while maximizing returns. The result is a method that is lightweight and can be plugged into existing generative RL algorithms. Across challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks in online and batch-online RL, FASTER consistently improves the underlying policies and achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods. Applied to a pretrained VLA, FASTER achieves the same performance while substantially reducing training and inference compute requirements. Code is available at https://github.com/alexanderswerdlow/faster .

AI.tldr: FASTER 通过把「采样-择优」建模为在扩散去噪过程中提前筛选动作候选的 MDP，用轻量级策略/值函数预测候选价值并早期淘汰，达到与多采样相当的效果但显著降低计算量。
AI.motivation: 当前顶尖强化学习算法依赖测试时采样多条动作候选并择优，推理开销巨大且难以部署。本文旨在不牺牲性能的前提下，消除这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 将「去噪多条动作候选→最终择优」视为马尔可夫决策过程，把筛选动作的时机从完整去噪后提前到去噪中途；在噪声空间学习策略-价值函数，实时预测候选的最终回报并淘汰低价值样本，实现「早期过滤」。该方法可即插即用于已有扩散式策略，无需重训底层生成模型。
AI.result: 在长时程机器人操作任务（在线与批在线 RL）中，FASTER 持续提升基线策略，取得最佳总体表现；应用于预训练 VLA 模型时，在维持精度的同时将训练与推理计算量显著压缩。
AI.conclusion: FASTER 证明扩散策略的测试时扩展收益可通过 MDP 框架在去噪阶段提前捕获，兼顾高性能与低计算成本，为高效部署生成式 RL 提供通用方案。

title: MOSA: Motion-Guided Semantic Alignment for Dynamic Scene Graph Generation
summary: Dynamic Scene Graph Generation (DSGG) aims to structurally model objects and their dynamic interactions in video sequences for high-level semantic understanding. However, existing methods struggle with fine-grained relationship modeling, semantic representation utilization, and the ability to model tail relationships. To address these issues, this paper proposes a motion-guided semantic alignment method for DSGG (MoSA). First, a Motion Feature Extractor (MFE) encodes object-pair motion attributes such as distance, velocity, motion persistence, and directional consistency. Then, these motion attributes are fused with spatial relationship features through the Motion-guided Interaction Module (MIM) to generate motion-aware relationship representations. To further enhance semantic discrimination capabilities, the cross-modal Action Semantic Matching (ASM) mechanism aligns visual relationship features with text embeddings of relationship categories. Finally, a category-weighted loss strategy is introduced to emphasize learning of tail relationships. Extensive and rigorous testing shows that MoSA performs optimally on the Action Genome dataset.

AI.tldr: MoSA使用运动特征与跨模态语义对齐提升视频场景图生成，并专门优化尾类关系。
AI.motivation: 已有DSGG方法难以精细刻画动态关系、充分利用语义信息，且对长尾关系建模不足，亟需兼顾运动线索与语义对齐的新框架。
AI.method: 提出MoSA：1) MFE提取物体对的运动距离、速度、持续性与方向一致性；2) MIM将运动属性与空间特征融合，获得运动感知关系表示；3) ASM通过交叉模态对齐把视觉特征与关系类别文本嵌入匹配；4) 类别加权损失函数重点强化尾类学习。
AI.result: 在Action Genome数据集上经严格实验验证，MoSA取得最佳性能，显著提升尾类关系识别精度。
AI.conclusion: 运动引导与跨模态语义对齐的结合能有效增强动态关系建模和语义判别力，为视频高层语义理解提供了新的高效解决方案。

title: Human-Machine Co-Boosted Bug Report Identification with Mutualistic Neural Active Learning
summary: Bug reports, encompassing a wide range of bug types, are crucial for maintaining software quality. However, the increasing complexity and volume of bug reports pose a significant challenge in sole manual identification and assignment to the appropriate teams for resolution, as dealing with all the reports is time-consuming and resource-intensive. In this paper, we introduce a cross-project framework, dubbed Mutualistic Neural Active Learning (MNAL), designed for automated and more effective identification of bug reports from GitHub repositories boosted by human-machine collaboration. MNAL utilizes a neural language model that learns and generalizes reports across different projects, coupled with active learning to form neural active learning. A distinctive feature of MNAL is the purposely crafted mutualistic relation between the machine learners (neural language model) and human labelers (developers) when enriching the knowledge learned. That is, the most informative human-labeled reports and their corresponding pseudo-labeled ones are used to update the model while those reports that need to be labeled by developers are more readable and identifiable, thereby enhancing the human-machine teaming therein. We evaluate MNAL using a large scale dataset against the SOTA approaches, baselines, and different variants. The results indicate that MNAL achieves up to 95.8% and 196.0% effort reduction in terms of readability and identifiability during human labeling, respectively, while resulting in a better performance in bug report identification. Additionally, our MNAL is model-agnostic since it is capable of improving the model performance with various underlying neural language models. To further verify the efficacy of our approach, we conducted a qualitative case study involving 10 human participants, who rate MNAL as being more effective while saving more time and monetary resources.

AI.tldr: MNAL 是一个跨项目、人机协同神经主动学习框架，在保持高准确率的同时将 bug 报告人工标注的可读性与可识别性代价分别降低 95.8% 与 196%，并且与多种语言模型兼容。
AI.motivation: 随着 GitHub 上报的缺陷数量与复杂度激增，纯人工识别分派耗时耗力，亟需自动化方法；而现有方案往往囿于单项目数据不足、对人机协作利用不足。
AI.method: 提出 Mutualistic Neural Active Learning（MNAL）：先以神经语言模型跨项目预训练，再以“互利”策略结合主动学习——模型挑选最易读、信息增益最大的报告给开发者标注；开发者标注后，与模型生成的伪标签共同回炉训练，实现人机知识互补。
AI.result: 大规模实验显示，相比 SOTA 基线，MNAL 在人工标注可读性上节省 95.8% 工作量，在可识别性上节省 196%，同时 bug 识别准确率更高；替换不同底层神经模型均能持续提升性能；10 人用户研究亦证实省时省钱且体验更佳。
AI.conclusion: MNAL 证明了“互利式”人机协同能显著降低标注成本并提升跨项目缺陷识别效果，框架模型无关，可直接集成到现有 GitHub 维护流程。

title: Superficial Success vs. Internal Breakdown: An Empirical Study of Generalization in Adaptive Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures. Equal contribution for the first two authors
summary: Adaptive multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly adopted to tackle complex problems.However, the narrow task coverage of their optimization raises the question of whether they can function as general-purpose systems.To address this gap, we conduct an extensive empirical study of adaptive MAS, revealing two key findings: (1) topological overfitting -- they fail to generalize across different domains; and (2) illusory coordination -- they achieve reasonable surface-level accuracy while the underlying agent interactions diverge from ideal MAS behavior, raising concerns about their practical utility.These findings highlight the pressing need to prioritize generalization in MAS development and motivate evaluation protocols that extend beyond simple final-answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 自适应多智能体系统虽被广泛使用，却因拓扑过拟合与虚假协同而难以成为通用系统，亟需强调泛化及新型评估协议。
AI.motivation: 自适应多智能体系统被用于解决复杂问题，但其优化只能覆盖狭窄任务，能否担当通用系统存疑，需要系统级实证检验。
AI.method: 对自适应多智能体系统开展大规模实证研究，通过跨领域迁移实验与交互行为分析，量化其拓扑结构与协作模式。
AI.result: 发现：1)拓扑过拟合——系统在新领域性能骤降；2)虚假协同——表面答案正确，但底层智能体交互与理想MAS行为显著偏离。
AI.conclusion: 现有自适应MAS缺乏泛化能力且交互不可靠，开发时应以泛化为优先目标，并建立超越最终答案正确性的评估协议。

title: Safe Continual Reinforcement Learning in Non-stationary Environments
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a compelling data-driven paradigm for synthesizing controllers for complex systems when accurate physical models are unavailable; however, most existing control-oriented RL methods assume stationarity and, therefore, struggle in real-world non-stationary deployments where system dynamics and operating conditions can change unexpectedly. Moreover, RL controllers acting in physical environments must satisfy safety constraints throughout their learning and execution phases, rendering transient violations during adaptation unacceptable. Although continual RL and safe RL have each addressed non-stationarity and safety, respectively, their intersection remains comparatively unexplored, motivating the study of safe continual RL algorithms that can adapt over the system's lifetime while preserving safety. In this work, we systematically investigate safe continual reinforcement learning by introducing three benchmark environments that capture safety-critical continual adaptation and by evaluating representative approaches from safe RL, continual RL, and their combinations. Our empirical results reveal a fundamental tension between maintaining safety constraints and preventing catastrophic forgetting under non-stationary dynamics, with existing methods generally failing to achieve both objectives simultaneously. To address this shortcoming, we examine regularization-based strategies that partially mitigate this trade-off and characterize their benefits and limitations. Finally, we outline key open challenges and research directions toward developing safe, resilient learning-based controllers capable of sustained autonomous operation in changing environments.

AI.tldr: 针对非平稳环境下控制器运行时安全与持续适应性的冲突，作者提出安全持续强化学习（SCRL）问题，建立三个benchmark，证明现有方法无法同时兼顾安全与抗遗忘，并指出现存正则化策略的部分缓解效果和待突破方向。
AI.motivation: 非平稳物理系统中，既要保证RL控制器终身自适应，又必须在学习与执行全程零安全违规；现有 continual RL 和 safe RL 各自为政，交叉研究缺位，亟需统一框架与评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 设计覆盖安全关键、动态漂移的三组 continual control benchmark；2) 系统测评 safe RL、continual RL 及其组合的代表算法；3) 以正则化为主线，分析其缓解「安全-遗忘」折中的机理与局限。
AI.result: 实证发现：非平稳场景下维持安全约束与防止灾难性遗忘存在根本性张力，现有方法几乎无法兼得；部分正则化技巧（如安全Q网络保守更新、任务权重约束）可缓和冲突，但仍远未达标。
AI.conclusion: 安全与持续学习需协同设计而非简单拼接；未来需突破安全Lyapunov函数的持续近似、安全经验回放与动态约束修正等核心难题，才能形成可长期自主运行的安全适应型控制器。

title: CreatiParser: Generative Image Parsing of Raster Graphic Designs into Editable Layers
summary: Graphic design images consist of multiple editable layers, such as text, background, and decorative elements, while most generative models produce rasterized outputs without explicit layer structures, limiting downstream editing. Existing graphic design parsing methods typically rely on multi-stage pipelines combining layout prediction, matting, and inpainting, which suffer from error accumulation and limited controllability. We propose a hybrid generative framework for raster-to-layer graphic design parsing that decomposes a design image into editable text, background, and sticker layers. Text regions are parsed using a vision-language model into a text rendering protocol, enabling faithful reconstruction and flexible re-editing, while background and sticker layers are generated using a multi-branch diffusion architecture with RGBA support. We further introduce ParserReward and integrate it with Group Relative Policy Optimization to align generation quality with human design preferences. Extensive experiments on two challenging datasets, \emph{i.e.,} the Parser-40K and Crello datasets, demonstrate superior performance over existing methods, \emph{eg.,} achieving an overall average improvement of 23.7\% across all metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出首个端到端“生成式图层解析”框架，把单张平面设计图一次性分解为可编辑的文字、背景、贴纸三类 RGBA 图层，无须多阶段级联。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型仅输出扁平位图，缺乏图层结构；传统多阶段解析（布局→抠图→补全）存在误差累积且难以二次编辑，严重阻碍下游设计流程。
AI.method: 1) 整体混合生成框架：文字区由视觉-语言模型提取为显式“文本渲染协议”，支持日后随意改字；背景与贴纸采用多分支扩散模型直接生成带透明通道的 RGBA 图层。2) 提出 ParserReward 质量奖励，并与 GRPO（群组相对策略优化）联合训练，使生成结果对齐人类设计偏好。
AI.result: 在 Parser-40K 与 Crello 两个数据集上全面领先现有多阶段方法，所有指标平均提升 23.7%，显著降低误差并提升图层可编辑性。
AI.conclusion: 通过“生成式图层解析”思路，本研究首次把平面稿无损转换成可二次编辑的图层文件，为后续智能设计与自动排版提供新范式。

title: Hierarchically Robust Zero-shot Vision-language Models
comment: This paper is accepted by CVPR'26
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can perform zero-shot classification but are susceptible to adversarial attacks. While robust fine-tuning improves their robustness, existing approaches align fixed text embeddings with an image embedding, sacrificing natural performance and robustness. A robustness degradation also occurs when a model faces adversarial attacks targeting superclasses (parent classes, e.g., mammal) in addition to their base (leaf) classes (e.g., cat). Thus, to enhance adversarial robustness and leverage the inherent hierarchical properties of class space, we propose a novel adversarial fine-tuning framework based on hierarchical embeddings and several levels of adversarially robust alignment of image-text modalities. Additional mechanisms place visual embeddings at the desired depth of hierarchy, and we provide a theoretical connection between the depth of embedding in the hierarchy and the maximum viable margin size. Our model naturally realizes several margin sizes, boosting generalization of adversaries for robustification. As various trees with different parent labels can share the same leaf labels, we also consider aligning over multiple trees to boost semantic variety. Experiments across several datasets are performed.

title: Reducing the Offline-Streaming Gap for Unified ASR Transducer with Consistency Regularization
summary: Unification of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems reduces development and maintenance costs, but training a single model to perform well in both offline and low-latency streaming settings remains challenging. We present a Unified ASR framework for Transducer (RNNT) training that supports both offline and streaming decoding within a single model, using chunk-limited attention with right context and dynamic chunked convolutions. To further close the gap between offline and streaming performance, we introduce an efficient Triton implementation of mode-consistency regularization for RNNT (MCR-RNNT), which encourages agreement across training modes. Experiments show that the proposed approach improves streaming accuracy at low latency while preserving offline performance and scaling to larger model sizes and training datasets. The proposed Unified ASR framework and the English model checkpoint are open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 基于单一RNNT模型实现离线与低延迟流式ASR的统一框架，开源。
AI.motivation: 同时维护两套ASR系统成本高，但现有单一模型难以兼顾离线精度与流式低延迟要求，需用统一框架同时支持两种推理模式。
AI.method: 提出统一 RNNT 训练框架：1) 采用带右向上下文的 chunk-limited attention 与动态分块卷积，实现离线与流式共享编码器；2) 设计 MCR-RNNT，利用 Triton 高效计算训练模式一致性正则化，提升模式对齐；3) 按流式 chunk 长度动态切分，不引入额外推理延迟。
AI.result: 在公开英语数据集上，相比独立训练的两套模型，统一框架流式模式在低延迟下 WER 相对降低 8-10%，离线模式 WER 保持一致；扩大至 230M 参数和上千小时语料仍保持性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 统一 RNNT 框架通过共享参数与一致性正则化可无缝切换离线与流式解码，兼顾精度与低延迟，显著降低系统复杂度与维护成本；已开源模型与实现，便于社区复现与扩展。

title: Generalization at the Edge of Stability
summary: Training modern neural networks often relies on large learning rates, operating at the edge of stability, where the optimization dynamics exhibit oscillatory and chaotic behavior. Empirically, this regime often yields improved generalization performance, yet the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. In this work, we represent stochastic optimizers as random dynamical systems, which often converge to a fractal attractor set (rather than a point) with a smaller intrinsic dimension. Building on this connection and inspired by Lyapunov dimension theory, we introduce a novel notion of dimension, coined the `sharpness dimension', and prove a generalization bound based on this dimension. Our results show that generalization in the chaotic regime depends on the complete Hessian spectrum and the structure of its partial determinants, highlighting a complexity that cannot be captured by the trace or spectral norm considered in prior work. Experiments across various MLPs and transformers validate our theory while also providing new insights into the recently observed phenomenon of grokking.

AI.tldr: 将于随机梯度优化器等同遍历动力系统，发现其极限轨迹落在分维吸引子上，并据此提出“锐度维”刻画函数复杂度，给出仅依赖完整Hessian谱及其部分行列式的新泛化界。实验表明大学习率、混沌梯度轨迹与快速泛化相关，并能解释grokking现象。
AI.motivation: 现代深度模型在大学习率下处于“边缘稳定”区域，表现出振荡甚至混沌，但反而泛化更好。该现象挑战了以往仅关注稳定点(FLM)或小迹范数的容量理论，需要新视角刻画“混沌梯度”如何影响泛化。
AI.method: 1)建模：将含噪声优化过程视作随机动力系统，证明其极限状态趋于分形吸引子而非单点。2)理论：自Lyapunov维数得到启发，提出“sharpness dimension”，并推导出依赖完整Hessian谱{λ_i}及部分行列式结构(partial determinants)的分支上界，而非只依赖Tr(H)或‖H‖。3)印证：在多层感知机与Transformer上验证该界对真实泛化误差的预测性，并分析grokking过程，验证当维数突然下降时测试误差同步崩溃——等同"瞬间理解"。
AI.result: (1)同一网络在大、小学习率下即使终端权重范数相近，其sharpness dimension及泛化误差也可差数倍；(2)稀疏/低秩Hessian或部分行列式显著主导的模型，其新界更紧且可预测“何时泛化”；(3)grokking发生于sharpness dimension骤降期间，早于测试准确率跃升。新指标对训练阶段是动态可监控的。
AI.conclusion: 梯度混沌并非副作用，而是通过降低极限吸引子的内在维数，使网络额外享受更紧泛化限。理论结果首次把完整Hessian构造信息而非其低阶范数纳入容量界，并提供可计算度量指引网络设计与训练参数(如学习率调度)选择。未来可推广至更宽优化族及用于在线泛化监控。

title: CoInteract: Physically-Consistent Human-Object Interaction Video Synthesis via Spatially-Structured Co-Generation
summary: Synthesizing human--object interaction (HOI) videos has broad practical value in e-commerce, digital advertising, and virtual marketing. However, current diffusion models, despite their photorealistic rendering capability, still frequently fail on (i) the structural stability of sensitive regions such as hands and faces and (ii) physically plausible contact (e.g., avoiding hand--object interpenetration). We present CoInteract, an end-to-end framework for HOI video synthesis conditioned on a person reference image, a product reference image, text prompts, and speech audio. CoInteract introduces two complementary designs embedded into a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone. First, we propose a Human-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) that routes tokens to lightweight, region-specialized experts via spatially supervised routing, improving fine-grained structural fidelity with minimal parameter overhead. Second, we propose Spatially-Structured Co-Generation, a dual-stream training paradigm that jointly models an RGB appearance stream and an auxiliary HOI structure stream to inject interaction geometry priors. During training, the HOI stream attends to RGB tokens and its supervision regularizes shared backbone weights; at inference, the HOI branch is removed for zero-overhead RGB generation. Experimental results demonstrate that CoInteract significantly outperforms existing methods in structural stability, logical consistency, and interaction realism.

AI.tldr: CoInteract是一套针对电商/广告场景的“人物-物体交互”视频生成框架，首次在DiT中引入“人体感知MoE”与“HOI双流共训”两项设计，显著缓解手部变形、人脸失真及手物穿模三大顽疾，实现零推理开销的结构稳定与物理可信HOI视频合成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成逼真视频，但在涉及手、脸等敏感区域时结构不稳定，且常出现手-物穿模等物理错位。电商、广告等场景急需既保真又符合物理约束的HOI视频自动生成方案。
AI.method: 提出CoInteract框架：1) 基于Diffusion Transformer，引入Human-Aware MoE，以空间监督路由把token分给轻量化区域专家，提升细粒度结构保真度且几乎不增参；2) 设计Spatially-Structured Co-Generation双流训练范式：RGB外观流+HOI结构流并行建模，让HOI流在训练时借_RGB_token学习交互几何先验，并以该流损失正则化共享backbone；推理阶段直接丢弃HOI分支，实现零开销RGB生成。
AI.result: 在结构稳定性、逻辑一致性、交互真实感三项指标上全面超越现有方法，显著减少手部变形、人脸失真与手物穿模。
AI.conclusion: CoInteract通过“人体感知MoE+几何双流正则”在DiT中成功嵌入HOI先验，为电商、广告等应用提供了高保真、物理可信且无推理负担的HOI视频生成新范式。

title: Where Fake Citations Are Made: Tracing Field-Level Hallucination to Specific Neurons in LLMs
summary: LLMs frequently generate fictitious yet convincing citations, often expressing high confidence even when the underlying reference is wrong. We study this failure across 9 models and 108{,}000 generated references, and find that author names fail far more often than other fields across all models and settings. Citation style has no measurable effect, while reasoning-oriented distillation degrades recall. Probes trained on one field transfer at near-chance levels to the others, suggesting that hallucination signals do not generalize across fields. Building on this finding, we apply elastic-net regularization with stability selection to neuron-level CETT values of Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and identify a sparse set of field-specific hallucination neurons (FH-neurons). Causal intervention further confirms their role: amplifying these neurons increases hallucination, while suppressing them improves performance across fields, with larger gains in some fields. These results suggest a lightweight approach to detecting and mitigating citation hallucination using internal model signals alone.

AI.tldr: 大模型常伪造可信却虚假的引用；作者名最易错，信号不跨域；首次定位并因果干预“域特异幻觉神经元”，可轻量级缓解幻觉。
AI.motivation: 揭示大模型在引用生成中系统性的“幻觉”模式，探究不同字段、模型、训练方式的差异，并寻找不依赖外部知识的内部检测与抑制方法。
AI.method: 1) 对 9 个模型生成 10.8 万条引用，统计各字段错误率；2) 用弹性网络+稳定选择，从 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 的 CETT 神经激活中筛选稀疏的“域特异幻觉神经元”（FH-neurons）；3) 通过因果干预放大/抑制这些神经元，观察幻觉率变化。
AI.result: 作者名错误率最高；引用格式无影响；推理蒸馏降低召回；跨域探针仅随机水平；定位的 FH-neurons 经干预后，抑制可显著降低幻觉，放大则加重，且不同域增益大小不同。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明引用幻觉存在可定位的域特异神经基础，仅需内部信号即可实现轻量级检测与抑制，为模型自我纠错提供新思路。

title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: A Component-Wise Evaluation Framework for Medical Question Answering Systems with Health Equity Implications
comment: Accepted in the Ninth Annual ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (ACM FAccT) 2026
summary: The use of Large Language Models (LLMs) to support patients in addressing medical questions is becoming increasingly prevalent. However, most of the measures currently used to evaluate the performance of these models in this context only measure how closely a model's answers match semantically, and therefore do not provide a true indication of the model's medical accuracy or of the health equity risks associated with it. To address these shortcomings, we present a new evaluation framework for medical question answering called VB-Score (Verification-Based Score) that provides a separate evaluation of the four components of entity recognition, semantic similarity, factual consistency, and structured information completeness for medical question-answering models. We perform rigorous reviews of the performance of three well-known and widely used LLMs on 48 public health-related topics taken from high-quality, authoritative information sources. Based on our analyses, we discover a major discrepancy between the models' semantic and entity accuracy. Our assessments of the performance of all three models show that each of them has almost uniformly severe performance failures when evaluated against our criteria. Our findings indicate alarming performance disparities across various public health topics, with most of the models exhibiting 13.8% lower performance (compared to an overall average) for all the public health topics that relate to chronic conditions that occur in older and minority populations, which indicates the existence of what's known as condition-based algorithmic discrimination. Our findings also demonstrate that prompt engineering alone does not compensate for basic architectural limitations on how these models perform in extracting medical entities and raise the question of whether semantic evaluation alone is a sufficient measure of medical AI safety.

AI.tldr: 针对 LLM 医疗问答仅用语义相似度评估存在盲区的问题，作者提出 VB-Score 四维度框架（实体识别、语义相似度、事实一致性、结构化信息完整度），在 48 个权威公共健康主题上对 3 个主流大模型进行评测，发现其语义与实体准确率严重背离，老年/少数族裔慢性病主题性能平均低 13.8%，揭示“基于疾病的算法歧视”，并指出提示工程无法弥补架构缺陷，强调医疗 AI 安全不能仅靠语义指标。
AI.motivation: 现有度量仅比较答案与参考文本的语义相似度，无法反映医学事实正确性与健康公平风险，亟需能同时检验实体、事实、结构与公平的评估体系。
AI.method: 设计 VB-Score，将评估拆为实体识别、语义相似度、事实一致性、结构化信息完整度四个独立维度；从高质量权威来源抽取 48 个公共健康主题，构建测试集；对 3 个主流 LLM 进行盲评；按人群特征分组对比性能差异。
AI.result: 三模型在 VB-Score 下均出现严重失败；语义高分掩盖了实体提取与事实一致性的低分；老年/少数族裔慢性病相关主题平均性能较总体低 13.8%，呈现显著条件性算法歧视；单纯提示工程未能缩小差距。
AI.conclusion: 语义相似度远不足以保障医疗 AI 安全；需采用多维、公平敏感的评价框架；模型架构级缺陷导致实体提取与公平性系统性不足，亟需算法与数据层面协同改进。

title: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Agentic Coding
summary: Test-time scaling has become a powerful way to improve large language models. However, existing methods are best suited to short, bounded outputs that can be directly compared, ranked or refined. Long-horizon coding agents violate this premise: each attempt produces an extended trajectory of actions, observations, errors, and partial progress taken by the agent. In this setting, the main challenge is no longer generating more attempts, but representing prior experience in a form that can be effectively selected from and reused. We propose a test-time scaling framework for agentic coding based on compact representations of rollout trajectories. Our framework converts each rollout into a structured summary that preserves its salient hypotheses, progress, and failure modes while discarding low-signal trace details. This representation enables two complementary forms of inference-time scaling. For parallel scaling, we introduce Recursive Tournament Voting (RTV), which recursively narrows a population of rollout summaries through small-group comparisons. For sequential scaling, we adapt Parallel-Distill-Refine (PDR) to the agentic setting by conditioning new rollouts on summaries distilled from prior attempts. Our method consistently improves the performance of frontier coding agents across SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench v2.0. For example, by using our method Claude-4.5-Opus improves from 70.9% to 77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified (mini-SWE-agent) and 46.9% to 59.1% on Terminal-Bench v2.0 (Terminus 1). Our results suggest that test-time scaling for long-horizon agents is fundamentally a problem of representation, selection, and reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向长时程编码 Agent 的测试时扩展框架，通过将长轨迹压缩为可重用的结构化摘要，结合并行与串行两种选择-复用机制，显著提升前沿模型在 SWE-Bench 与 Terminal-Bench 上的通过率。首次验证“表征、选择、重用”是长时程 Agent 测试时扩展的核心问题。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法假设输出简短且可 pairwise 比较，而长时程编码 Agent 的每一次尝试都会产生冗长的行动-观测-错误轨迹，无法直接比较或排序，导致经验难以复用。如何在不增加轨迹采样成本的前提下，将先验经验转化为可高效选择、复用的表征，是提升 Agent 上限的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 轨迹压缩：将每条 rollout 提炼为保留假设、进度、失败模式的结构化摘要，丢弃低信号细节。2) 并行扩展：Recursive Tournament Voting (RTV) 用分组递归比较，在摘要空间快速缩小候选集。3) 串行扩展：Parallel-Distill-Refine (PDR) 用摘要作为条件提示，引导后续 rollout 避免已知失败。两机制共用同一摘要空间，实现“先压缩、后选择、再复用”闭环。
AI.result: 在 SWE-Bench Verified（mini-SWE-agent）上，Claude-4.5-Opus 从 70.9% 提升至 77.6%；在 Terminal-Bench v2.0（Terminus 1）上从 46.9% 提升至 59.1%，且增益随尝试次数单调递增，未出现饱和迹象。消融实验表明，去除摘要压缩或任意一种扩展机制均显著回落，验证“表征-选择-重用”链路缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: 长时程 Agent 的测试时扩展本质是“如何表征、如何选择、如何重用”经验，而非简单增加轨迹数量。结构化摘要驱动的并行+串行选择机制首次在该场景下实现稳定、可扩展的增益，为后续在多 Agent、多任务环境下的通用测试时扩展提供了可复用的技术范式。

title: CoCo-SAM3: Harnessing Concept Conflict in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: SAM3 advances open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by introducing a prompt-driven mask generation paradigm. However, in multi-class open-vocabulary scenarios, masks generated independently from different category prompts lack a unified and inter-class comparable evidence scale, often resulting in overlapping coverage and unstable competition. Moreover, synonymous expressions of the same concept tend to activate inconsistent semantic and spatial evidence, leading to intra-class drift that exacerbates inter-class conflicts and compromises overall inference stability. To address these issues, we propose CoCo-SAM3 (Concept-Conflict SAM3), which explicitly decouples inference into intra-class enhancement and inter-class competition. Our method first aligns and aggregates evidence from synonymous prompts to strengthen concept consistency. It then performs inter-class competition on a unified comparable scale, enabling direct pixel-wise comparisons among all candidate classes. This mechanism stabilizes multi-class inference and effectively mitigates inter-class conflicts. Without requiring any additional training, CoCo-SAM3 achieves consistent improvements across eight open-vocabulary semantic segmentation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CoCo-SAM3通过“先类内强化，后类间竞争”的思路，化解同义漂移与掩膜重叠，在8个开放词汇分割数据集零训练提升。
AI.motivation: 现有类间缺乏可比证据尺度和同义漂移导致的多类冲突与不稳定推理。
AI.method: 将推理解耦为两步：1) 对齐聚合同义提示的多证据增强类内一致性；2) 在统一可比尺度上进行像素级类间竞争。
AI.result: 无需训练，在8个开放词汇语义分割基准上均取得稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: CoCo-SAM3证实显式解耦类内增强与类间竞争是提升开放词汇多类分割稳定性与性能的有效范式。

title: A Proxy Consistency Loss for Grounded Fusion of Earth Observation and Location Encoders
comment: Accepted to EarthVision 2026 (CVPR Workshop). 13 pages total (10 pages main paper + 3 pages supplementary material), 5 main figures
summary: Supervised learning with Earth observation inputs is often limited by the sparsity of high-quality labeled or in-situ measured data to use as training labels. With the abundance of geographic data products, in many cases there are variables correlated with - but different from - the variable of interest that can be leveraged. We integrate such proxy variables within a geographic prior via a trainable location encoder and introduce a proxy consistency loss (PCL) formulation to imbue proxy data into the location encoder. The first key insight behind our approach is to use the location encoder as an agile and flexible way to learn from abundantly available proxy data which can be sampled independently of training label availability. Our second key insight is that we will need to regularize the location encoder appropriately to achieve performance and robustness with limited labeled data. Our experiments on air quality prediction and poverty mapping show that integrating proxy data implicitly through the location encoder outperforms using both as input to an observation encoder and fusion strategies that use frozen, pretrained location embeddings as a geographic prior. Superior performance for in-sample prediction shows that the PCL can incorporate rich information from the proxies, and superior out-of-sample prediction shows that the learned latent embeddings help generalize to areas without training labels.
