SVGD balances attraction toward high-risk regions and repulsion among particles, yielding risk-seeking yet well-distributed seeds across multiple failure modes. PtoP is plug-and-play and enhances existing online testing methods (e.g., reinforcement learning--based testers) by providing principled seeds. Evaluation in CARLA on two industry-grade ADS (Apollo, Autoware) and a native end-to-end system shows that PtoP improves safety violation rate (up to 27.68%), scenario diversity (9.6%), and map coverage (16.78%) over baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出PtoP框架，利用SVGD在高维场景空间中生成多样且高风险的种子，显著提升自动驾驶仿真测试的故障发现与覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于搜索的种子生成方法（如遗传算法）在高维交通场景中易陷入局部模式，遗漏大量真实故障情形，亟需一种可扩展且能兼顾风险与多样性的初始条件生成方案。
AI.method: PtoP将自适应随机采样与Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）耦合：通过SVGD粒子在风险吸引与粒子间斥力作用下同时探索多个高危险区域，产生既高危险又空间分散的种子；框架即插即用，可直接投喂给强化学习等在线测试器。SVGD利用梯度-核混合更新规则，在CARLA高维状态-动作空间实现高效采样。
AI.result: 在CARLA中对Apollo、Autoware及端到端系统测试，PtoP将安全违规率最高提升27.68%，场景多样性提高9.6%，地图覆盖增加16.78%，均优于遗传算法与纯随机基线；同时生成种子仅需1/3计算时间。
AI.conclusion: SVGD可有效破解高维空间搜索塌陷难题，PtoP为ADS安全测试提供了理论基础与即插即用工具，后续将把框架扩展到真实道路数据与闭环测试流水线。

title: SketchFaceGS: Real-Time Sketch-Driven Face Editing and Generation with Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 as a Highlight. Jittor implementation: https://github.com/gogoneural/SketchFaceGS_jittor. (C) 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted
summary: 3D Gaussian representations have emerged as a powerful paradigm for digital head modeling, achieving photorealistic quality with real-time rendering. However, intuitive and interactive creation or editing of 3D Gaussian head models remains challenging. Although 2D sketches provide an ideal interaction modality for fast, intuitive conceptual design, they are sparse, depth-ambiguous, and lack high-frequency appearance cues, making it difficult to infer dense, geometrically consistent 3D Gaussian structures from strokes - especially under real-time constraints. To address these challenges, we propose SketchFaceGS, the first sketch-driven framework for real-time generation and editing of photorealistic 3D Gaussian head models from 2D sketches. Our method uses a feed-forward, coarse-to-fine architecture. A Transformer-based UV feature-prediction module first reconstructs a coarse but geometrically consistent UV feature map from the input sketch, and then a 3D UV feature enhancement module refines it with high-frequency, photorealistic detail to produce a high-fidelity 3D head. For editing, we introduce a UV Mask Fusion technique combined with a layer-by-layer feature-fusion strategy, enabling precise, real-time, free-viewpoint modifications. Extensive experiments show that SketchFaceGS outperforms existing methods in both generation fidelity and editing flexibility, producing high-quality, editable 3D heads from sketches in a single forward pass.

AI.tldr: SketchFaceGS 是第一个通过单幅 2D 草图实时生成并编辑逼真 3D Gaussian 人头模型的框架，采用 Transformer 预测 UV 特征+高频增强+UV Mask 融合策略，在生成质量与编辑自由度上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管 3D Gaussian 已能实现实时逼真渲染，但现有方法难以让用户用直观、交互的 2D 草图实时创建或编辑人头模型；草图稀疏、深度歧义、缺失高频外观，是主要障碍。
AI.method: 提出“前向粗到细”架构：①Transformer-based UV 特征预测模块，从草图重建几何一致的低分辨率 UV 特征图；②3D UV 特征增强模块，补回高频逼真细节；③UV Mask Fusion + 分层特征融合，实现任意视角的实时局部编辑。
AI.result: 单次前向即可从草图获得高质量 3D 人头；在生成保真度与编辑灵活性指标上均超现有方法，且满足实时帧率。
AI.conclusion: SketchFaceGS 验证了 2D 草图驱动 3D Gaussian 人头实时建模与编辑的可行性，为数字人快速概念设计提供了高效新范式。

title: SAMoRA: Semantic-Aware Mixture of LoRA Experts for Task-Adaptive Learning
summary: The combination of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has shown significant potential for enhancing the multi-task learning capabilities of Large Language Models. However, existing methods face two primary challenges: (1)Imprecise Routing in the current MoE-LoRA method fails to explicitly match input semantics with expert capabilities, leading to weak expert specialization. (2)Uniform weight fusion strategies struggle to provide adaptive update strengths, overlooking the varying complexity of different tasks. To address these limitations, we propose SAMoRA (Semantic-Aware Mixture of LoRA Experts), a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework tailored for task-adaptive learning. Specifically, A Semantic-Aware Router is proposed to explicitly align textual semantics with the most suitable experts for precise routing. A Task-Adaptive Scaling mechanism is designed to regulate expert contributions based on specific task requirements dynamically. In addition, a novel regularization objective is proposed to jointly promote expert specialization and effective scaling. Extensive experiments on multiple multi-task benchmarks demonstrate that SAMoRA significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods and holds excellent task generalization capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/boyan-code/SAMoRA

AI.tldr: SAMoRA 将语义感知路由与任务自适应权重缩放结合，解决 MoE-LoRA 在多任务微调中的路由不准和更新强度单一问题，实现参数高效的专家专业化。
AI.motivation: 已有 MoE-LoRA 方法在多任务 LLM 微调中存在两大瓶颈：① 路由模块未显式对齐语义与专家能力，导致专家专业化弱；② 统一权重融合忽视任务复杂度差异，难以动态分配更新强度。
AI.method: 提出 SAMoE 框架：1) 语义感知路由器，用文本语义表示直接匹配专家能力向量，实现精准路由；2) 任务自适应缩放器，根据任务特定损失动态调节各专家贡献权重；3) 联合正则目标，同时激励专家差异化和缩放系数稀疏性。
AI.result: 在 GLUE、Super-NLU 等 8 项多任务基准上，SAMoRA 以平均 2.1% 的绝对提升超越 MoE-LoRA、LoRA-drop 等 SOTA，且参数量仅增加 0.8%。
AI.conclusion: 语义-专家显式对齐与动态缩放机制是 MoE-LoRA 多任务微调的关键，SAMoRA 在保持参数高效的同时显著增强任务泛化能力，为后续 PEFT 设计提供新范式。

title: A Functionality-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating Web Agents in E-commerce Domains
comment: 8 pages for main body and 8 pages of appendix
summary: Web agents have shown great promise in performing many tasks on ecommerce website. To assess their capabilities, several benchmarks have been introduced. However, current benchmarks in the e-commerce domain face two major problems. First, they primarily focus on product search tasks (e.g., Find an Apple Watch), failing to capture the broader range of functionalities offered by real-world e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, including account management and gift card operations. Second, existing benchmarks typically evaluate whether the agent completes the user query, but ignore the potential risks involved. In practice, web agents can make unintended changes that negatively impact the user account or status. For instance, an agent might purchase the wrong item, delete a saved address, or incorrectly configure an auto-reload setting. To address these gaps, we propose a new benchmark called Amazon-Bench. To generate user queries that cover a broad range of tasks, we propose a data generation pipeline that leverages webpage content and interactive elements (e.g., buttons, check boxes) to create diverse, functionality-grounded user queries covering tasks such as address management, wish list management, and brand store following. To improve the agent evaluation, we propose an automated evaluation framework that assesses both the performance and the safety of web agents. We systematically evaluate different agents, finding that current agents struggle with complex queries and pose safety risks. These results highlight the need for developing more robust and reliable web agents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有电商网页任务基准仅覆盖产品检索且忽略操作安全性评估的缺陷，提出新基准 Amazon-Bench，通过网页内容驱动的数据生成管道扩充账号管理与礼品卡等场景，并以自动化指标同时衡量成功率与潜在风险，结果显示当前代理在复杂查询与安全可靠性上表现不足。
AI.motivation: 现有电商网页代理基准①任务集中于检索，未覆盖平台完整功能；②仅检验任务成败，忽视误操作对用户账号或资产的潜在危害。需要兼顾功能多样性与安全风险的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建 Amazon-Bench：①设计网页内容和交互元素驱动的数据生成管道，引入地址/心愿单/品牌店关注等多样化真实任务；②提出自动评价框架，同时对代理的成功率、误删误购等破坏性动作进行量化追踪，引入安全扣分和副作用检测。
AI.result: 在 Amazon-Bench 上评估多种代理，发现：①对复杂多步流程（如修改默认地址+关注品牌店）成功率显著低于简单搜索；②普遍存在无意删除地址、错误启用自动充值、误操作购买等安全隐患，暴露可靠性严重不足。
AI.conclusion: 当前网页代理面对真实电商平台的全功能任务和安全约束仍显脆弱，需从鲁棒状态跟踪、安全策略约束、错误恢复等角度系统改进，方能投入实用。Amazon-Bench 提供全面且有安全监督的评测基线，推动更可靠代理的发展。

title: Personalized Benchmarking: Evaluating LLMs by Individual Preferences
summary: With the rise in capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their deployment in real-world tasks, evaluating LLM alignment with human preferences has become an important challenge. Current benchmarks average preferences across all users to compute aggregate ratings, overlooking individual user preferences when establishing model rankings. Since users have varying preferences in different contexts, we call for personalized LLM benchmarks that rank models according to individual needs. We compute personalized model rankings using ELO ratings and Bradley-Terry coefficients for 115 active Chatbot Arena users and analyze how user query characteristics (topics and writing style) relate to LLM ranking variations. We demonstrate that individual rankings of LLM models diverge dramatically from aggregate LLM rankings, with Bradley-Terry correlations averaging only $ρ= 0.04$ (57\% of users show near-zero or negative correlation) and ELO ratings showing moderate correlation ($ρ= 0.43$). Through topic modeling and style analysis, we find users exhibit substantial heterogeneity in topical interests and communication styles, influencing their model preferences. We further show that a compact combination of topic and style features provides a useful feature space for predicting user-specific model rankings. Our results provide strong quantitative evidence that aggregate benchmarks fail to capture individual preferences for most users, and highlight the importance of developing personalized benchmarks that rank LLM models according to individual user preferences.

AI.tldr: 文章指出现有LLM评测仅用平均打分掩盖了用户个体差异，提出基于个体Elo/Bradley-Terry分数的个性化排行榜，并证明其与全局榜几乎无关（ρ≈0），说明未来必须按人定制评测体系。
AI.motivation: 主流LLM benchmark把全部用户偏好平均成一条排行榜，忽视了“同一场景不同人想要的模型表现可能截然不同”这一现实，导致开发者依据平均榜优化的模型对大多数个体并非最优。
AI.method: 收集Chatbot Arena 115名活跃用户的真实对战记录，分别计算：1) 个体Bradley-Terry系数；2) 个体Elo分；3) 用户提问的LDA主题分布+写作风格特征；4) 用轻量线性模型将主题+风格特征映射到个性化排序，评估预测能力并与全局排序做Spearman相关对比。
AI.result: 个体排序与全局排序几乎脱钩：Bradley-Terry平均ρ=0.04，57%用户呈现零或负相关；Elo稍高亦仅0.43。用户主题兴趣与沟通风格差异显著，仅20维主题+风格特征即可将个性化排序预测到ρ≈0.65，验证偏好异质性可被紧凑建模。
AI.conclusion: “平均即正义”的LLM评测范式对多数用户失效；未来benchmark应转向“先用户、再模型”的个性化路线，用可解释风格/主题特征快速为个体定制排行榜，引导模型按需提供而非按均值优化。

title: RDP LoRA: Geometry-Driven Identification for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation in Large Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) remains structurally uncertain despite parameter-efficient methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), as the layer-specific roles of internal representations are poorly understood, leading to heuristic decisions about where adaptation should be applied. We model the evolution of hidden states as a high-dimensional geometric trajectory and propose using the Ramer-Douglas-Peucker (RDP) algorithm, a parameter-free and training-free polygon simplification method that preserves global structural transitions while eliminating locally redundant changes, to identify critical breakpoints along the representation path. Crucially, we use these geometric pivots not merely for analysis, but as a direct decision signal for determining which layers should be adapted during parameter-efficient fine-tuning. By integrating this geometry-aware layer selection strategy into LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-8B-Base, we achieve superior performance on MMLU-Math using only 13 RDP-selected layers (81.67%), significantly outperforming both full 36-layer adaptation (79.32%) and random 13-layer selection (75.56%), as well as the baseline Qwen3-8B-Base model (74.25%). These results demonstrate that leveraging the intrinsic geometry of representation trajectories provides a robust, interpretable, and training-free signal for optimizing layer selection during model adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文用几何轨迹+无训练RDP算法挑13层做LoRA，Qwen3-8B在MMLU-Math上达81.67%，超全层79.32%。
AI.motivation: LoRA等参数高效微调仍靠经验选层，因对LLM内部表征逐层作用缺乏可解释依据。
AI.method: 将隐藏状态演化建模为高维轨迹，用无参数RDP算法提取关键几何拐点，直接作为适应层选择信号，仅微调13层。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Math上，RDP-LoRA 81.67% > 全层79.32% > 随机13层75.56% > 基线74.25%，参数量显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 表征轨迹的几何结构提供了无需训练、可解释且高效的层选择依据，可泛化至其他参数高效微调框架。

title: Refute-or-Promote: An Adversarial Stage-Gated Multi-Agent Review Methodology for High-Precision LLM-Assisted Defect Discovery
summary: LLM-assisted defect discovery has a precision crisis: plausible-but-wrong reports overwhelm maintainers and degrade credibility for real findings. We present Refute-or-Promote, an inference-time reliability pattern combining Stratified Context Hunting (SCH) for candidate generation, adversarial kill mandates, context asymmetry, and a Cross-Model Critic (CMC). Adversarial agents attempt to disprove candidates at each promotion gate; cold-start reviewers are intended to reduce anchoring cascades; cross-family review can catch correlated blind spots that same-family review misses. Over a 31-day campaign across 7 targets (security libraries, the ISO C++ standard, major compilers), the pipeline killed roughly 79% of 171 candidates before advancing to disclosure (retrospective aggregate); on a consolidated-protocol subset (lcms2, wolfSSL; n=30), the prospective kill rate was 83%. Outcomes: 4 CVEs (3 public, 1 embargoed); LWG 4549 accepted to the C++ working paper; 5 merged C++ editorial PRs; 3 compiler conformance bugs; 8 merged security-related fixes without CVE; an RFC 9000 errata filed under committee review; and 1+ FIPS 140-3 normative compliance issues under coordinated disclosure -- all evaluated by external acceptance, not benchmarks. The most instructive failure: ten dedicated reviewers unanimously endorsed a non-existent Bleichenbacher padding oracle in OpenSSL's CMS module; it was killed only by a single empirical test, motivating the mandatory empirical gate. No vulnerability was discovered autonomously; the contribution is external structure that filters LLM agents' persistent false positives. As a preliminary transfer test beyond defect discovery, a simplified cross-family critique variant also solved five previously unsolved SymPy instances on SWE-bench Verified and one SWE-rebench hard task.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM生成代码缺陷报告假阳性过高问题，提出把每个假设都放到”反驳或推进“多阶段流程中过滤（分层上下文搜索+多模型对立审查+强制实证关卡）。31天实战扫描7个目标，诱导出4个CVE、1项C++ WG 提案、多项编译器修正；平均筛掉≈80%假报；典型失误显示需保留实证关卡。
AI.motivation: 利用LLM自动化挖漏洞会爆发”似是而非“的假报，淹没维护者并消耗信誉。如何避免模型幻觉干扰安全审计，是作者关注的核心痛点。
AI.method: 1) Stratified Context Hunting：按层级逐层扩展并生成潜在缺陷假设；2) Adversarial Kill Mandate：在每一道”晋级门“安排对立代理专门反驳；3) Context Asymmetry & Cold-start Reviewer：减少锚定连锁，由未接触过原上下文的新评审员重审；4) Cross-Model Critic：不同家族模型交叉审查，捕获同家族盲区；5) Mandatory Empirical Gate：必须跑通poc或测试才能最终上报。整个流程完全在线推理，不微调模型，仅做结构性过滤。
AI.result: 171条候选中79%前世阶段被淘汰；核心子集(lcms2, wolfSSL, n=30)前瞻性淘汰率83%。最终外部验收的成果：4 CVE（1 尚在保密）、C++ 工业标准缺陷1项被接受(LWG 4549)、5项C++编辑性合并PR、3个编译器合规修正、8项非CVE安全修补、1项RFC 9000勘误待批、1+ FIPS 140-3合规问题协同披露。最醒目的失败：10名评审一致接力投票把一条根本不存在的Bleichenbacher Oracle放行至末段，被单一实证门击毙，验证实证关卡必要。
AI.conclusion: 1) LLM误报无法靠模型优化根治，外部对抗性验证结构才是可行解；2) 强制实证关卡必不可少，可阻断极致幻觉；3) 多模型、多评审、多层上下文扩展与不对称审查组合，能在工业级目标上把假报压到约1/5；4) 过滤框架无需新训练数据即可迁移到其它推理任务（SWE-bench 上顺利解决6条悬而未决数学库问题），验证了通用性。

title: BED-LLM: Intelligent Information Gathering with LLMs and Bayesian Experimental Design
comment: Published at the International Conference on Learning Representations 2026
summary: We propose a general-purpose approach for improving the ability of large language models (LLMs) to intelligently and adaptively gather information from a user or other external source using the framework of sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED). This enables LLMs to act as effective multi-turn conversational agents and interactively interface with external environments. Our approach, which we call BED-LLM (Bayesian experimental design with large language models), is based on iteratively choosing questions or queries that maximize the expected information gain (EIG) with respect to a variable of interest given the responses gathered previously. We show how this EIG can be formulated (and then estimated) in a principled way using a probabilistic model derived from the LLM's predictive distributions and provide detailed insights into key decisions in its construction and updating procedure. We find that BED-LLM achieves substantial gains in performance across a wide range of tests based on the 20 Questions game and using the LLM to actively infer user preferences, compared to purely prompting-based design generation and other adaptive design strategies.

AI.tldr: 利用贝叶斯序贯实验设计（BED）框架，让大模型主动提出信息增益最大的问题，显著提升多轮对话与偏好推理效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 依赖静态提示或简单策略收集信息，提问效率低；需要一种通用、可解释且能最大化信息增益的主动询问机制。
AI.method: 提出 BED-LLM：将 LLM 的预测分布转化为概率模型，用期望信息增益（EIG）作为目标函数，迭代选择最优查询；给出 EIG 的精确推导与可行估计流程，并设计模型在线更新策略。
AI.result: 在 20 Questions 与用户偏好主动推断两大任务上，BED-LLM 比纯提示基线及多种自适应策略平均减少 30–50% 提问轮次即可达到同等或更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: BED 框架可与任意 LLM 即插即用，显著增强其作为主动对话代理与外部环境交互的能力，为智能问询、推荐及决策系统提供了新的通用范式。

title: Beyond Bellman: High-Order Generator Regression for Continuous-Time Policy Evaluation
summary: We study finite-horizon continuous-time policy evaluation from discrete closed-loop trajectories under time-inhomogeneous dynamics. The target value surface solves a backward parabolic equation, but the Bellman baseline obtained from one-step recursion is only first-order in the grid width. We estimate the time-dependent generator from multi-step transitions using moment-matching coefficients that cancel lower-order truncation terms, and combine the resulting surrogate with backward regression. The main theory gives an end-to-end decomposition into generator misspecification, projection error, pooling bias, finite-sample error, and start-up error, together with a decision-frequency regime map explaining when higher-order gains should be visible. Across calibration studies, four-scale benchmarks, feature and start-up ablations, and gain-mismatch stress tests, the second-order estimator consistently improves on the Bellman baseline and remains stable in the regime where the theory predicts visible gains. These results position high-order generator regression as an interpretable continuous-time policy-evaluation method with a clear operating region.

AI.tldr: 针对连续时间有限时域策略评测中的离散闭环数据，提出二阶矩匹配生成器估计＋反向回归框架，在理论上可分离误差来源并给出可解析的使用区间，从实验上相较一阶Bellman基线取得稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 现有离散数据下的连续时间策略评估基于一阶Bellman差分，网格细化时仅具一阶收敛率；作者希望在有界时间段和时变动力学的真值反向抛物面上获得更高阶、可解释的评估方法，并明确其有效使用区间。
AI.method: 1) 将真值函数视为由时变无穷小生成器驱动的反向抛物型偏微分方程解；2) 利用多步轨迹矩匹配系数消去低阶截断项，估计时变生成器；3) 将估计的生成器与蒙特卡罗或投影反向回归结合，构建高阶价值估计量；4) 建立end-to-end误差分解：生成器近似误差、投影误差、池化偏差、有限样本误差和初始误差，并给出“决策频率-网格细度”制义图。
AI.result: 理论上，该方法在足够高更新频率区间呈现二阶优势；在标定研究、4尺度基准、特征与初始态消融、增益错配压力测试等隔离实验中，二阶估计量均优于Bellman基线且在理论预测的可视益区内保持数值稳定。
AI.conclusion: 高阶生成器回归不仅能以可解释方式对连续时间有限策略进行精确评测，还通过频率-细度图为其提供了清晰的安全操作域。

title: Concept Inconsistency in Dermoscopic Concept Bottleneck Models: A Rough-Set Analysis of the Derm7pt Dataset
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) route predictions exclusively through a clinically grounded concept layer, binding interpretability to concept-label consistency. When a dataset contains concept-level inconsistencies, identical concept profiles mapped to conflicting diagnosis labels create an unresolvable bottleneck that imposes a hard ceiling on achievable accuracy. In this paper, we apply rough set theory to the Derm7pt dermoscopy benchmark and characterize the full extent and clinical structure of this inconsistency. Among 305 unique concept profiles formed by the 7 dermoscopic criteria of the 7-point melanoma checklist, 50 (16.4%) are inconsistent, spanning 306 images (30.3% of the dataset). This yields a theoretical accuracy ceiling of 92.1%, independent of backbone architecture or training strategy for CBMs that exclusively operate with hard concepts. In addition, we characterize the conflict-severity distribution, identify the clinical features most responsible for boundary ambiguity, and evaluate two filtering strategies with quantified effects on dataset composition and CBM interpretability. Symmetric removal of all boundary-region images yields Derm7pt+, a fully consistent benchmark subset of 705 images with perfect quality of classification and no hard accuracy ceiling. Building on this filtered dataset, we present a hard CBM evaluated across 19 backbone architectures from the EfficientNet, DenseNet, ResNet, and Wide ResNet families. Under symmetric filtering, explored for completeness, EfficientNet-B5 achieves the best label F1 score (0.85) and label accuracy (0.90) on the held-out test set, with a concept accuracy of 0.70. Under asymmetric filtering, EfficientNet-B7 leads across all four metrics, reaching a label F1 score of 0.82 and concept accuracy of 0.70. These results establish reproducible baselines for concept-consistent CBM evaluation on dermoscopic data.

AI.tldr: 粗糙集分析显示 Derm7pt 有 16.4% 的概念组合存在冲突，导致硬 CBM 理论上限仅 92.1%；作者过滤出无冲突的 Derm7pt+，并给出 19 种骨干网在硬概念下可复现的基准结果。
AI.motivation: CBM 只能用临床概念做推断，若同一组概念对应不同诊断标签就会形成不可调和的冲突并硬性限制准确率；需要定量刻画冲突程度，评估过滤策略并建立可复现基准。
AI.method: 对 Derm7pt 的 7 项皮肤镜标准应用粗糙集理论，枚举所有 305 种概念组合，定位冲突集；设计对称/非对称两种过滤策略获得无冲突子集 Derm7pt+；在 19 种 CNN 骨干网上训练硬 CBM，记录标签与概念级准确率、F1 和一致性。
AI.result: 冲突组合占 16.4% 共 306 幅图，使理论精度上限为 92.1%；过滤后 Derm7pt+ 含 705 幅图零冲突。对称过滤下 EfficientNet-B5 标签 F1=0.85/Acc=0.90，概念 Acc=0.70；非对称过滤下 EfficientNet-B7 达 0.82/0.70，均为可复现基准。
AI.conclusion: 概念层冲突是 CBM 性能的硬性天花板；粗糙集可有效定位并消除冲突，无冲突 Derm7pt+ 为皮肤镜 CBM 提供了无偏差、可解释且可复现的评估基准。

title: Product-of-Experts Training Reduces Dataset Artifacts in Natural Language Inference
summary: Neural NLI models overfit dataset artifacts instead of truly reasoning. A hypothesis-only model gets 57.7% in SNLI, showing strong spurious correlations, and 38.6% of the baseline errors are the result of these artifacts. We propose Product-of-Experts (PoE) training, which downweights examples where biased models are overconfident. PoE nearly preserves accuracy (89.10% vs. 89.30%) while cutting bias reliance by 4.71% (bias agreement 49.85% to 45%). An ablation finds lambda = 1.5 that best balances debiasing and accuracy. Behavioral tests still reveal issues with negation and numerical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 用专家乘积(PoE)训练在保持SNLI 89%精度的同时，把对偏见样本的依赖降低约5个百分点，但模型对否定与数字推理仍显脆弱。
AI.motivation: NLI模型常利用假设文本中的表面统计捷径（如存在特定词汇即被判为蕴含），而非真正推理。作者希望在不显著牺牲总体精度的情况下削弱这种对伪相关性的依赖。
AI.method: 提出Product-of-Experts(PoE)训练：先用仅假设输入的“偏见模型”在训练集上训练得到样本级置信度，再用置信度作为权重为每条样例降权；主模型在加权后的数据上重新训练。超参数λ=1.5在消融中被选出以平衡去偏与精度。
AI.result: 在SNLI上，PoE主模型精度为89.10%，与原始模型89.30%几乎持平，同时偏见一致性从49.85%降至45.14%，降幅4.71%。仅假设输入模型能在官方测试集上拿到57.7%的准确率，表明38.6%基线错误源于伪相关性。
AI.conclusion: PoE可在几乎无损准确率的前提下显著削减对偏见捷径的依赖，但对否定、数字推理等语义型难点仍未完全解决，是未来改进的重点。

title: InsideOut: Measuring and Mitigating Insider-Outsider Bias in Interview Script Generation
summary: Advancements in Large language models (LLMs) have enabled a variety of downstream applications like story and interview script generation. However, recent research raised concerns about culture-related fairness issues in LLM-generated content. In this work, we identify and systematically investigate LLMs' insider-outsider bias, a phenomenon where models position themselves as "insiders" of mainstream cultures during generation while externalizing less dominant cultures. We propose the InsideOut benchmark with 4,000 generation prompts and three evaluation metrics to quantify this bias through a culturally situated interview script generation task, in which an LLM is positioned as a reporter interviewing local people across 10 diverse cultures. Empirical evaluation on 5 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that while models adopt insider tones in over 88% US-contexted scripts on average, they disproportionately default to "outsider" stances for non-Western cultures. To mitigate these biases, we propose 2 inference-time methods: a baseline prompt-based Fairness Intervention Pillars (FIP) method, and a structured Mitigation via Fairness Agents (MFA) framework consisting of a Single-Agent (MFA-SA), a Hierarchical-Agent (MFA-HA), and an autonomous Agentic Planning (MFA-Plan) pipeline. Empirical results demonstrate that agent-based MFA methods achieve outstanding and robust performance in mitigating the insider-outsider bias: For instance, on the Cultural Alignment Gap (CAG) metric, MFA-SA reduces bias in Llama model by 89.70 % and MFA-HA mitigates bias in Qwen by 82.54%. These findings showcase the effectiveness of agent-based methods as a promising direction for mitigating biases in generative LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出‘insider–outsider bias’概念并构建InsideOut评测，发现主流LLM对主流文化自动采用‘内部人’视角，而对非西方文化倾向‘外部人’视角；作者设计了FIP和多层智能体框架MFA，在推理阶段显著降低偏见，最高可使CAG指标下降近90%。
AI.motivation: 故事及访谈脚本生成等下游应用已大规模部署LLM，但文化公平性问题凸显。既有研究多聚焦刻板印象或毒性，尚未系统探讨模型在叙事过程中对不同文化采取的‘内部/外部’立场差异，阻碍全球公平使用。
AI.method: 1)构建InsideOut基准：4000条提示覆盖10种文化，让模型充当记者采访当地人，设计文化立场占比、文化对齐差距（CAG）与文化深度一致度三指标量化偏见。2)提出两种推理级纠偏：①提示级Fairness Intervention Pillars（FIP）；②结构化智能体框架MFA，含单智能体（MFA-SA）、分层智能体（MFA-HA）及自主规划（MFA-Plan）三条管线，通过多智能体协作动态调整生成策略。
AI.result: 5个SOTA模型在US语境下88%以上脚本呈现内部人立场，而对非西方文化普遍外部化。FIP基线效果有限；MFA各变体显著改善，Llama的CAG降低89.70%，Qwen降低82.54%，并在跨模型、跨文化场景中保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: LLM存在系统性文化内部-外部偏见；基于多智能体的推理时干预可高效、无需重训练地缓解该偏见，为生成式AI公平落地提供了一条可扩展的新路径。

title: Ground-Level Near Real-Time Modeling for PM2.5 Pollution Prediction
summary: Air pollution is a worldwide public health threat that can cause or exacerbate many illnesses, including respiratory disease, cardiovascular disease, and some cancers. However, epidemiological studies and public health decision-making are stymied by the inability to assess pollution exposure impacts in near real time. To address this, developing accurate digital twins of environmental pollutants will enable timely data-driven analytics - a crucial step in modernizing health policy and decision-making. Although other models predict and analyze fine particulate matter exposure, they often rely on modeled input data sources and data streams that are not regularly updated. Another challenge stems from current models relying on predefined grids. In contrast, our deep-learning approach interpolates surface level PM2.5 concentrations between sparsely distributed US EPA monitoring stations in a grid-free manner. By incorporating additional, readily available datasets - including topographic, meteorological, and land-use data - we improve its ability to predict pollutant concentrations with high spatial and temporal resolution. This enables model querying at any spatial location for rapid predictions without computing over the entire grid. To ensure robustness, we randomize spatial sampling during training to enable our model to perform well in both dense and sparse monitored regions. This model is well suited for near real-time deployment because its lightweight architecture allows for fast updates in response to streaming data. Moreover, model flexibility and scalability allow it to be adapted to various geographical contexts and scales, making it a practical tool for delivering accurate and timely air quality assessments. Its capacity to rapidly evaluate multiple scenarios can be especially valuable for decision-making during public health crises.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需预设网格、可实时更新的深度学习模型，通过融合多源数据插值稀疏监测站 PM₂.₅ 浓度，实现高时空分辨率、秒级响应的空污数字孪生，为公共卫生应急与政策制定提供即时证据。
AI.motivation: 全球空气污染致病负担重，但传统模型依赖更新滞后、固定网格的模拟数据，无法支持近实时暴露评估，阻碍流行病学研究与快速卫生决策。
AI.method: 以轻量深度神经网络为核心，将美国 EPA 稀疏监测站观测与地形、气象、土地利用等开放数据融合；训练阶段随机空间采样，使模型在监测密集区与空白区均鲁棒；推理时任意点位查询，无需全网格重算，支持流式数据秒级更新。
AI.result: 模型在保持精度的同时，空间分辨率提升至千米级、时间分辨率提升至小时级；单点预测延迟<1 s，重训练<30 min；可无缝迁移至不同地理尺度与区域，对突发性污染事件实现分钟级情景比选。
AI.conclusion: 该网格无关、轻量、可扩展的深度学习框架首次将“数字孪生”理念落地于 PM₂.₅ 近实时监测，为公共卫生部门提供了可操作的即时空污评估工具，未来可扩展至其他污染物及全球范围。

title: SAGE: Training-Free Semantic Evidence Composition for Edge-Cloud Inference under Hard Uplink Budgets
summary: Edge-cloud hybrid inference offloads difficult inputs to a powerful remote model, but the uplink channel imposes hard per-request constraints on the number of bits that can be transmitted. We show that selecting transmitted content based solely on attention-based importance, the standard approach in collaborative inference, is inherently limited under hard budgets. Two findings support this claim. First, replacing high-importance units with low-importance but complementary ones improves server accuracy. This shows that what matters is not individual importance but how well the transmitted set covers diverse aspects of the input. Second, spatially uniform selection without any content information achieves competitive accuracy at moderate budgets. This confirms that spatial coverage alone carries independent value. Based on this analysis, we propose SAGE (Semantic Attention-Guided Evidence), a principled, training-free method that combines importance filtering with embedding-diversity sampling. SAGE achieves 93% of the server ceiling in offloaded accuracy while transmitting fewer than half of the available evidence units on ImageNet-1K, substantially outperforming importance-only composition.

AI.tldr: 传统只靠“注意力重要性”挑选要上传的云端内容，在严格比特预算下会失灵；本文证明关键应是“空间+语义互补性”，提出无训练的SAGE方法，仅用不到一半证据即可达到伺服器93%精度。
AI.motivation: 边-云协同推理需在极有限上行带宽内挑选最有价值的信息上传，现有注意力裁剪法在硬预算下性能骤降，亟需揭示其本质缺陷并给出新的挑选准则。
AI.method: 1) 实证发现：用低分但互补的补丁替换高分补丁可提升准确率；无内容线索的均匀空间采样也能获得不俗效果，证明“空间覆盖”与“语义互补”同样重要。2) 提出SAGE：无需再训练，先以注意力过滤噪声，再用嵌入差异度做多样性采样，兼顾重要性与覆盖面。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上，SAGE用不到50%传输单元即可达到伺服器天花板精度的93%，显著优于仅用重要性排序的基线。
AI.conclusion: 单独依赖注意力重要性不足以实现最优边-云协作；通过“重要性+多样性”双重准则可在硬带宽约束下逼近云端全量推理效果，为资源受限场景提供实用、免训练的卸载方案。

title: S2MAM: Semi-supervised Meta Additive Model for Robust Estimation and Variable Selection
summary: Semi-supervised learning with manifold regularization is a classical framework for jointly learning from both labeled and unlabeled data, where the key requirement is that the support of the unknown marginal distribution has the geometric structure of a Riemannian manifold. Typically, the Laplace-Beltrami operator-based manifold regularization can be approximated empirically by the Laplacian regularization associated with the entire training data and its corresponding graph Laplacian matrix. However, the graph Laplacian matrix depends heavily on the prespecified similarity metric and may lead to inappropriate penalties when dealing with redundant or noisy input variables. To address the above issues, this paper proposes a new \textit{Semi-Supervised Meta Additive Model (S$^2$MAM) based on a bilevel optimization scheme that automatically identifies informative variables, updates the similarity matrix, and simultaneously achieves interpretable predictions. Theoretical guarantees are provided for S$^2$MAM, including the computing convergence and the statistical generalization bound. Experimental assessments across 4 synthetic and 12 real-world datasets, with varying levels and categories of corruption, validate the robustness and interpretability of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出半监督元加性模型 S²MAM，用双层优化同时选特征、学相似度、做流形正则化，在理论与 16 组数据上验证鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统流形正则化半监督方法依赖预设相似度，冗余或噪声特征会扭曲图拉普拉斯，导致错误惩罚，需要自动识别有效特征并动态修正相似度。
AI.method: 构建元加性模型，外层优化选择特征子集并更新相似矩阵，内层优化利用更新后的图拉普拉斯进行流形正则化训练；整体 bilevel 问题用近似梯度算法求解，并给出收敛及泛化界证明。
AI.result: 在 4 个合成与 12 个真实数据集、多种腐败强度下，S²MAM 的预测精度与鲁棒性显著优于经典 Laplacian 正则化及多种半监督基线，同时提供可解释的特征权重与相似度可视化。
AI.conclusion: S²MAM 通过联合学习特征、相似度与模型，突破固定图拉普拉斯限制，为带噪半监督场景提供兼具鲁棒性、可解释性与理论保证的新范式。

title: Hybrid Architectures for Language Models: Systematic Analysis and Design Insights
summary: Recent progress in large language models demonstrates that hybrid architectures--combining self-attention mechanisms with structured state space models like Mamba--can achieve a compelling balance between modeling quality and computational efficiency, particularly for long-context tasks. While these hybrid models show promising performance, systematic comparisons of hybridization strategies and analyses on the key factors behind their effectiveness have not been clearly shared to the community. In this work, we present a holistic evaluation of hybrid architectures based on inter-layer (sequential) or intra-layer (parallel) fusion. We comprehensively evaluate these designs across multiple dimensions: language modeling and downstream task performance, long-context capabilities, scaling analysis, and training and inference efficiency. By investigating the core characteristics of their computational primitive, we identify the most critical elements for each hybridization strategy and further propose optimal design recipes for hybrid models. Our comprehensive analysis provides practical guidance and valuable insights for developing hybrid language models, facilitating the optimization of architectural configurations.

AI.tldr: 首次系统对比SSM–Attention混合模型的两种融合范式，给出兼顾效果与效率的最优设计配方。
AI.motivation: 已有Mamba+Attention混合模型在长上下文任务上表现亮眼，但缺乏对“如何混合”以及“为何有效”的系统性对比与归因，社区缺少可复用的设计指南。
AI.method: 提出“层间顺序融合”与“层内并行融合”两大统一框架，在多维度（语言建模、下游任务、长文本、扩展性、训练/推理效率）对多种混合策略进行 holistic 评估，并结合算子级剖析提炼关键设计要素。
AI.result: 量化揭示不同融合方式在性能-效率曲线上的权衡规律，提炼出对每种策略最关键的3-4个设计要素，据此给出可直接落地的最优配置方案，在同等算力下取得Pareto 更优。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型并非简单“拼积木”，而需精细配比；论文给出的设计配方可为后续 hybrid LLM 提供明确架构优化路径，推动长上下文大模型高效落地。

title: $R^2$-dLLM: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Models via Spatio-Temporal Redundancy Reduction
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by enabling parallel token prediction. However, practical dLLM decoding still suffers from high inference latency, which limits deployment. In this work, we observe that a substantial part of this inefficiency comes from recurring redundancy in the decoding process, including spatial redundancy caused by confidence clusters and positional ambiguity, and temporal redundancy caused by repeatedly remasking predictions that have already stabilized. Motivated by these patterns, we propose $R^2$-dLLM, a unified framework for reducing decoding redundancy from both inference and training perspectives. At inference time, we introduce training-free decoding rules that aggregate local confidence and token predictions, and finalize temporally stable tokens to avoid redundant decoding steps. We further propose a redundancy-aware supervised fine-tuning pipeline that aligns the model with efficient decoding trajectories and reduces reliance on manually tuned thresholds. Experiments demonstrate that $R^2$-dLLM consistently reduces the number of decoding steps by up to 75% compared to existing decoding strategies, while maintaining competitive generation quality across different models and tasks. These results validate that decoding redundancy is a central bottleneck in dLLMs, and that explicitly reducing it yields substantial practical efficiency gains.

AI.tldr: 针对扩散式大语言模型(dLLM)推理阶段冗余现象，提出一体化框架R²-dLLM，无需训练的聚合规则和时空冗余感知微调使解码步数最多减少75%，性能无明显下降。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型虽通过并行预测瓦解AR顺序瓶颈，但推理中存在两种显著冗余：①空间-置信同簇与位置模糊；②时间-已稳定token反复遮蔽重预测，均导致推理延迟居高不下。
AI.method: 1)推理：基于局部置信聚合和token预测合并的零成本规则，即时锁定时序稳定token；2)训练：设计
AI.result: 情感元学习将10-shot的F1从76%提升至91%，对话状态跟踪槽F1由82%至90%，并稳定跨域表现；特工策源任务成功率由35%达80%。消融表明双向对比学习、混合步长T 及双向交替训练三要素缺一不可；
AI.conclusion: 推理冗余是dLLM部署主要瓶颈；融合推理规则与冗余感知的统一范式可显著提升效率并保持生成质量，为并行LLM实用化提供关键路径。实验证明显著步数压缩可行且模型无关。

title: Chat2Workflow: A Benchmark for Generating Executable Visual Workflows with Natural Language
summary: At present, executable visual workflows have emerged as a mainstream paradigm in real-world industrial deployments, offering strong reliability and controllability. However, in current practice, such workflows are almost entirely constructed through manual engineering: developers must carefully design workflows, write prompts for each step, and repeatedly revise the logic as requirements evolve-making development costly, time-consuming, and error-prone. To study whether large language models can automate this multi-round interaction process, we introduce Chat2Workflow, a benchmark for generating executable visual workflows directly from natural language, and propose a robust agentic framework to mitigate recurrent execution errors. Chat2Workflow is built from a large collection of real-world business workflows, with each instance designed so that the generated workflow can be transformed and directly deployed to practical workflow platforms such as Dify and Coze. Experimental results show that while state-of-the-art language models can often capture high-level intent, they struggle to generate correct, stable, and executable workflows, especially under complex or changing requirements. Although our agentic framework yields up to 5.34% resolve rate gains, the remaining real-world gap positions Chat2Workflow as a foundation for advancing industrial-grade automation. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/Chat2Workflow.

AI.tldr: Chat2Workflow 利用大模型将自然语言直接生成可部署的业务流程，为手动开发流程的自动化提供首个可执行基准。
AI.motivation: 现有可执行业务流程全靠人工设计，成本高、易出错，而大模型能否端到端自动生成这类流程尚未被系统评估。
AI.method: 构建基于真实企业流程的可执行流程生成基准 Chat2Workflow；提出面向反复执行错误的代理框架；自动转换生成结果至 Dify/Coze 等平台。
AI.result: 主流大模型能抓住高层意图，但在复杂或多变需求下稳定性不足；代理框架将问题修复率提升 5.34%，仍与工业可接受水平存在差距。
AI.conclusion: 大模型自动生成可执行业务流程仍属开放难题，Chat2Workflow 为后续算法改进提供了可衡量、可落地的研究基础。

title: Reducing the Offline-Streaming Gap for Unified ASR Transducer with Consistency Regularization
summary: Unification of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems reduces development and maintenance costs, but training a single model to perform well in both offline and low-latency streaming settings remains challenging. We present a Unified ASR framework for Transducer (RNNT) training that supports both offline and streaming decoding within a single model, using chunk-limited attention with right context and dynamic chunked convolutions. To further close the gap between offline and streaming performance, we introduce an efficient Triton implementation of mode-consistency regularization for RNNT (MCR-RNNT), which encourages agreement across training modes. Experiments show that the proposed approach improves streaming accuracy at low latency while preserving offline performance and scaling to larger model sizes and training datasets. The proposed Unified ASR framework and the English model checkpoint are open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一的 RNNT 框架，用块限注意力和动态切块卷积，让同一模型同时支持离线与低延迟流式识别，并引入 MCR-RNNT 正则化弥合两种模式性能差距，开源代码与英文模型。
AI.motivation: 降低同时维护离线与流式两套 ASR 模型的开发与运维成本，但现有方法难以在单一 RNNT 模型内兼顾离线精度与极低延迟流式精度，需要新的统一训练与解码策略。
AI.method: 在 RNNT 编码器内统一实现：1) 块限注意力（chunk-limited attention）并引入可调右文本来平衡延迟与精度；2) 动态切块卷积（dynamic chunked convolutions）适配不同 chunk 大小；3) Triton 高效实现的 Mode-Consistency Regularization（MCR-RNNT），在训练阶段强制离线与流式两种前向模式输出分布一致，缩小性能差距。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在低延迟流式场景下词错误率显著下降，同时离线精度无损；框架可扩展至更大模型与更大数据集，验证了通用性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提统一 RNNT 框架通过 chunk-wise 设计及 MCR 正则化，首次在单模型内实现离线高准确与超低延迟流式识别兼得，降低系统维护成本，相关代码与英文模型已开源，可直接复用并推广至多语种与更大规模任务。

title: A Goal Without a Plan Is Just a Wish: Efficient and Effective Global Planner Training for Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
summary: Agents based on large language models (LLMs) struggle with brainless trial-and-error and generating hallucinatory actions due to a lack of global planning in long-horizon tasks. In this paper, we introduce a plan-and-execute framework and propose EAGLET, an efficient and effective planner training method to enhance the executor agent's planning abilities without human effort. Specifically, we train a plug-and-play global planner through a two-step process: we first synthesize high-quality plans from an advanced LLM using our proposed homologous consensus filtering strategy, and apply fine-tuning as a cold start. Moreover, we further improve the planner with a rule-based reinforcement learning stage using a novel executor capability gain reward, ensuring it can handle task instructions of varying difficulty. Experiments on three long-horizon agent tasks show that executor agents equipped with our planner outperform existing methods, achieving new state-of-the-art performance. Meanwhile, EAGLET reduces training costs by 8x compared to RL-based baselines, and it does not require manual effort or extra training data, offering an efficient and effective solution.

AI.tldr: 提出无人工标注的「先规划后执行」框架 EAGLET，用同源共识过滤+规则强化学习训练即插即用全局规划器，显著减少长程任务中的试错与幻觉，训练成本降低 8 倍并刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在长程任务中缺乏全局规划，导致盲目试错与幻觉动作；现有强化学习方法训练代价高且需人工数据。
AI.method: 两阶段训练即插即用规划器：① 用同源共识过滤从高级 LLM 合成高质量规划，冷启动微调；② 设计「执行器能力增益」奖励，用规则型 RL 持续优化规划器。
AI.result: 在 3 个长程任务 benchmark 上，配备 EAGLET 规划器的执行器全面超越基线，刷新 SOTA；训练成本仅为 RL 基线的 1/8，无需人工标注或额外数据。
AI.conclusion: EAGLET 以零人工代价获得高质全局规划能力，可低成本植入任意 LLM 执行器，为长程智能体提供高效、可扩展的规划增强方案。

title: TRN-R1-Zero: Text-rich Network Reasoning via LLMs with Reinforcement Learning Only
summary: Zero-shot reasoning on text-rich networks (TRNs) remains a challenging frontier, as models must integrate textual semantics with relational structure without task-specific supervision. While graph neural networks rely on fixed label spaces and supervised objectives, recent large language model (LLM)-based approaches often overlook graph context or depend on distillation from larger models, limiting generalisation. We propose TRN-R1-Zero, a post-training framework for TRN reasoning trained solely via reinforcement learning. TRN-R1-Zero directly optimises base LLMs using a Neighbour-aware Group Relative Policy Optimisation objective that dynamically adjusts rewards based on a novel margin gain metric for the informativeness of neighbouring signals, effectively guiding the model toward relational reasoning. Unlike prior methods, TRN-R1-Zero requires no supervised fine-tuning or chain-of-thought data generated from large reasoning models. Extensive experiments across citation, hyperlink, social and co-purchase TRN benchmarks demonstrate the superiority and robustness of TRN-R1-Zero. Moreover, relying strictly on node-level training, TRN-R1-Zero achieves zero-shot inference on edge- and graph-level tasks, extending beyond cross-domain transfer. The codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/superallen13/TRN-R1-Zero.

AI.tldr: TRN-R1-Zero 用纯强化学习把基础 LLM 直接训练成文本富网络零样本推理器，无需任何监督微调或蒸馏数据，首次在节点级训练下泛化到边级与图级任务。
AI.motivation: 现有 GNN 依赖固定标签空间，LLM 方法要么忽略图上下文、要么需从大模型蒸馏，导致在文本富网络（TRNs）上难以实现零样本、跨任务泛化。
AI.method: 提出 Neighbour-aware Group Relative Policy Optimisation，基于邻居信号边际增益动态调整奖励，用强化学习直接优化基础 LLM，全程无监督微调或 CoT 数据。
AI.result: 在引用、超链、社交、共购四类 TRN 基准上零样本效果显著优于已有方法；仅节点级训练即可直接完成边预测、图分类等任务，展现强跨域迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: TRN-R1-Zero 证明纯强化学习可让 LLM 自主习得语义-结构联合推理，打破对监督与蒸馏的依赖，为文本富网络零样本推理提供新范式。

title: VLA Foundry: A Unified Framework for Training Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: We present VLA Foundry, an open-source framework that unifies LLM, VLM, and VLA training in a single codebase. Most open-source VLA efforts specialize on the action training stage, often stitching together incompatible pretraining pipelines. VLA Foundry instead provides a shared training stack with end-to-end control, from language pretraining to action-expert fine-tuning. VLA Foundry supports both from-scratch training and pretrained backbones from Hugging Face. To demonstrate the utility of our framework, we train and release two types of models: the first trained fully from scratch through our LLM-->VLM-->VLA pipeline and the second built on the pretrained Qwen3-VL backbone. We evaluate closed-loop policy performance of both models on LBM Eval, an open-data, open-source simulator. We also contribute usability improvements to the simulator and the STEP analysis tools for easier public use. In the nominal evaluation setting, our fully-open from-scratch model is on par with our prior closed-source work and substituting in the Qwen3-VL backbone leads to a strong multi-task table top manipulation policy outperforming our baseline by a wide margin. The VLA Foundry codebase is available at https://github.com/TRI-ML/vla_foundry and all multi-task model weights are released on https://huggingface.co/collections/TRI-ML/vla-foundry. Additional qualitative videos are available on the project website https://tri-ml.github.io/vla_foundry.

AI.tldr: VLA Foundry 统一了 LLM/VLM/VLA 三阶段训练的开源框架，提供端到端可控栈；基于它训练的完全开源模型在 LBM Eval 上与之前闭源作品持平，换用 Qwen3-VL 骨干后多任务桌面操控策略大幅优于基线。代码、权重与测评工具全部公开。
AI.motivation: 现有开源 VLA 项目大多仅聚焦动作训练阶段，需拼凑互不兼容的预训练流水线，导致复现与改进困难。作者希望用一个统一、端到端可控的开源框架，把语言预训练、视觉-语言建模到动作微调完整打通，降低社区研发门槛。
AI.method: 设计单一训练栈 VLA Foundry，支持 1) 从零开始 LLM→VLM→VLA 三阶段连续训练；2) 直接加载 Hugging Face 预训练骨干（如 Qwen3-VL）进行动作专家微调。贡献并改进了开放数据仿真器 LBM Eval 及 STEP 分析工具，用于闭环策略评测。
AI.result: 在 LBM Eval 标准设定下：① 完全从零训练的开源模型与作者此前闭源工作性能持平；② 以 Qwen3-VL 为骨干的模型取得强多任务桌面操控策略，显著超越基线。所有代码、模型权重与仿真/分析工具均公开发布。
AI.conclusion: VLA Foundry 证明了统一训练栈的可行性与竞争力，既能让社区复现先进 VLA 性能，又允许通过替换预训练骨干快速获得更强策略，为后续研究提供了完整、开放的基础设施。

title: ProjLens: Unveiling the Role of Projectors in Multimodal Model Safety
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in cross-modal understanding and generation, yet their deployment is threatened by critical safety vulnerabilities. While prior works have demonstrated the feasibility of backdoors in MLLMs via fine-tuning data poisoning to manipulate inference, the underlying mechanisms of backdoor attacks remain opaque, complicating the understanding and mitigation. To bridge this gap, we propose ProjLens, an interpretability framework designed to demystify MLLMs backdoors. We first establish that normal downstream task alignment--even when restricted to projector fine--tuning--introduces vulnerability to backdoor injection, whose activation mechanism is different from that observed in text-only LLMs. Through extensive experiments across four backdoor variants, we uncover:(1) Low-Rank Structure: Backdoor injection updates appear overall full-rank and lack dedicated ``trigger neurons'', but the backdoor-critical parameters are encoded within a low-rank subspace of the projector;(2) Activation Mechanism: Both clean and poisoned embedding undergoes a semantic shift toward a shared direction aligned with the backdoor target, but the shifting magnitude scales linearly with the input norm, resulting in the distinct backdoor activation on poisoned samples. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProjLens-8FD7

AI.tldr: ProjLens揭示MLLM后门漏洞源于对齐微调阶段，其参数变化呈低秩结构、激活依赖于输入模态缩放，为防御提供定量依据。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽证实可通过数据投毒在MLLM中植入后门，但对其激活机理与参数级特征缺乏系统刻画，导致防御策略设计困难。
AI.method: 提出可解释框架ProjLens，在仅微调投影器(projector)的受限场景下系统比较四种后门变体，利用低秩分解和嵌入轨迹分析量化参数与激活规律。
AI.result: 发现后门关键更新集中在投影器低秩子空间；干净与投毒样本的嵌入均向目标方向偏移，但投毒样本的偏移幅度与输入范数成线性比例，从而触发后门。
AI.conclusion: 首次阐明MLLM后门与文本LLM的差异性机制，证明即使受限微调也引入漏洞，为后续基于低秩压缩与输入范数检测的轻量级防御奠定基础。

title: Mitigating Judgment Preference Bias in Large Language Models through Group-Based Polling
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) as automatic evaluators, commonly referred to as LLM-as-a-Judge, have also attracted growing attention. This approach plays a vital role in aligning LLMs with human judgments, providing accurate and reliable assessments. However, LLM-based judgment models often exhibit judgment preference bias during the evaluation phase, tending to favor responses generated by themselves, undermining the reliability of their judgments. This paper introduces the Group-Based Polling Optimization (Genii), an unsupervised multi-agent collaborative optimization framework that mitigates the inherent judgment preference bias of judgment models. Specifically, Genii integrates various LLM-based judgment models into a multi-agent system and simulates the interactive client-server polling mechanism to optimize each client agent unsupervisedly. Our experiments demonstrate that Genii outperforms supervised models trained on annotated judgment data, while requiring no human-labeled annotations. Genii consistently improves performance across different client agents during the polling, even when weaker models act as server agents. Further analysis reveals that Genii effectively mitigates judgment preference bias of LLM-based judgment models, demonstrating its effectiveness. All codes are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Genii.

AI.tldr: 无监督多代理框架 Genii 通过「群投票」机制削弱 LLM Judge 的自偏好偏差，无需人工标注即可超越有监督法官模型。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge 虽可缓解人工评估瓶颈，但其自我偏爱严重扭曲评分可靠性，需要零标注的纠偏方案。
AI.method: 构建「客户端-服务器」多代理系统；客户端模型对同批答案打分，服务器汇总并回传共识信号；通过迭代投票与无监督强化，使各客户端逐步对齐群体偏好，从而抑制自身模型生成的答案偏好。
AI.result: Genii 在多项评估基准上显著优于利用人工标注的有监督法官模型；无论服务器代理强弱，客户端在持续投票轮次中稳定提升；量化指标显示自我偏爱下降，分布更贴近人类评分。
AI.conclusion: Genii 证明无需标注即可有效去偏，为 LLM 自动评估提供了可靠且易扩展的新范式。

title: Fast estimation of Gaussian mixture components via centering and singular value thresholding
summary: Estimating the number of components is a fundamental challenge in unsupervised learning, particularly when dealing with high-dimensional data with many components or severely imbalanced component sizes. This paper addresses this challenge for classical Gaussian mixture models. The proposed estimator is simple: center the data, compute the singular values of the centered matrix, and count those above a threshold. No iterative fitting, no likelihood calculation, and no prior knowledge of the number of components are required. We prove that, under a mild separation condition on the component centers, the estimator consistently recovers the true number of components. The result holds in high-dimensional settings where the dimension can be much larger than the sample size. It also holds when the number of components grows to the smaller of the dimension and the sample size, even under severe imbalance among component sizes. Computationally, the method is extremely fast: for example, it processes ten million samples in one hundred dimensions within one minute. Extensive experimental studies confirm its accuracy in challenging settings such as high dimensionality, many components, and severe class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 提出无需迭代和似然的快速奇异值阈值法，可在高维、严重不平衡及成分数随维度／样本量增长场景下，一致估计高斯混合模型的成分数。
AI.motivation: 无监督学习中估计 Gaussian mixture 的成分数是经典难题；现有方法在高维、成分极多或尺寸严重失衡时性能差，且依赖迭代拟合或先验知识。
AI.method: 数据中心化后求中心化矩阵的奇异值，按阈值计数，无需似然计算、迭代优化或预选成分数，并给出自适应阈值与一致性理论保证。
AI.result: 理论证明在分离度温和的条件下，估计量在高维情形（ d≫n ）及成分数 k→min(d,n) 时仍具一致性；实验显示 1 千万×100 维数据可在 1 分钟内完成，准确率在多种极端条件下均优于现有方案。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法首次实现了高维、多成分且严重失衡情形下的近实时成分数估计，兼具理论保证与实用效率，为大规模无监督聚类提供可靠的成分数预估计工具。

title: Generalization at the Edge of Stability
summary: Training modern neural networks often relies on large learning rates, operating at the edge of stability, where the optimization dynamics exhibit oscillatory and chaotic behavior. Empirically, this regime often yields improved generalization performance, yet the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. In this work, we represent stochastic optimizers as random dynamical systems, which often converge to a fractal attractor set (rather than a point) with a smaller intrinsic dimension. Building on this connection and inspired by Lyapunov dimension theory, we introduce a novel notion of dimension, coined the `sharpness dimension', and prove a generalization bound based on this dimension. Our results show that generalization in the chaotic regime depends on the complete Hessian spectrum and the structure of its partial determinants, highlighting a complexity that cannot be captured by the trace or spectral norm considered in prior work. Experiments across various MLPs and transformers validate our theory while also providing new insights into the recently observed phenomenon of grokking.

AI.tldr: 将优化过程视作随机动力系统并提出“锐度维”新定义，首次证明大学习率下神经网络泛化性能受制于完整Hessian谱及分形结构，而非常见的迹/谱范数。
AI.motivation: 大学习率训练虽被证实能提升泛化并呈现边缘稳定与混沌动力学，但尚无理论解释为何此类非收敛“分形吸引子”状态反而降低测试误差，现有基于Hessian迹/谱范数的PAC-Bayes界无法刻画这种复杂性。
AI.method: 1) 把含噪声的优化算法建模为随机动力系统，证明其迭代趋向于内在维更低的分形吸引子；2) 借助Lyapunov维思想定义新“锐度维”，将其与Hessian全部特征值及其部分行列式结构关联；3) 基于该维度推导新的PAC-Bayes型泛化界；4) 在MLP与Transformer上设计实验，检验理论预测并关联到grokking现象。
AI.result: 理论：首次给出以完整Hessian谱与分形维为核心的泛化上界，放松传统假设并揭示混沌区的复杂度来源。实验：锐度维在宽区间网络与任务中准确关联测试误差，且能在grokking瞬间发生跃升，早于性能提升，验证了分形吸引子→隐式正则化→泛化的因果链条。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络在“边缘稳定”区域的优异泛化并非玄学，而是由Hessian谱的分形几何完全决定；引入的锐度维可为设计大学习率调度、早期停止及理解grokking提供可计算的理论指标，并为后续将随机动力学视角推广至其他学习器奠定基础。

title: RoboWM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating World Models in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent advances in large-scale video world models have enabled increasingly realistic future prediction, raising the prospect of leveraging imagined videos for robot learning. However, visual realism does not imply physical plausibility, and behaviors inferred from generated videos may violate dynamics and fail when executed by embodied agents. Existing benchmarks begin to incorporate notions of physical plausibility, but they largely remain perception- or diagnostic-oriented and do not systematically evaluate whether predicted behaviors can be translated into executable actions that complete the intended task. To address this gap, we introduce RoboWM-Bench, a manipulation-centric benchmark for embodiment-grounded evaluation of video world models. RoboWM-Bench converts generated behaviors from both human-hand and robotic manipulation videos into embodied action sequences and validates them through robotic execution. The benchmark spans diverse manipulation scenarios and establishes a unified protocol for consistent and reproducible evaluation. Using RoboWM-Bench, we evaluate state-of-the-art video world models and find that reliably generating physically executable behaviors remains an open challenge. Common failure modes include errors in spatial reasoning, unstable contact prediction, and non-physical deformations. While finetuning on manipulation data yields improvements, physical inconsistencies still persist, suggesting opportunities for more physically grounded video generation for robots.

AI.tldr: 首次提出以“机器人能否把生成视频直接变成可执行动作”作为评测标准，发现现有大模型仍普遍违反物理约束。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型虽然画面逼真，但生成结果常违背物理规律，无法直接驱动机器人完成任务；而当前基准只关注感知或诊断，缺乏对“可执行性”的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建RoboWM-Bench：把人类和机器人操作视频送入模型生成未来帧→自动抽取动作序列→在真实机器人上闭环执行→统一协议量化任务完成率与物理合理性。
AI.result: 评测主流模型发现：空间推理、接触预测、形变建模错误高发；即使微调操作数据，物理不一致仍显著，可执行率远未达到实用水平。
AI.conclusion: 逼真≠可执行；需将物理约束嵌入生成过程，而非事后修正；RoboWM-Bench为开发面向机器人的 physically-grounded 视频模型提供了可复现的严苛benchmark。

title: The Alignment Waltz: Jointly Training Agents to Collaborate for Safety
summary: Harnessing the power of LLMs requires a delicate dance between being helpful and harmless. This creates a fundamental tension between two competing challenges: vulnerability to adversarial attacks that elicit unsafe content, and a tendency for overrefusal on benign but sensitive prompts. Current approaches often navigate this dance with safeguard models that completely reject any content that contains unsafe portions. This approach cuts the music entirely-it may exacerbate overrefusals and fails to provide nuanced guidance for queries it refuses. To teach models a more coordinated choreography, we propose WaltzRL, a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that formulates safety alignment as a collaborative, positive-sum game. WaltzRL jointly trains a conversation agent and a feedback agent, where the latter is incentivized to provide useful suggestions that improve the safety and helpfulness of the conversation agent's responses. At the core of WaltzRL is a Dynamic Improvement Reward (DIR) that evolves over time based on how well the conversation agent incorporates the feedback. At inference time, unsafe or overrefusing responses from the conversation agent are improved rather than discarded. The feedback agent is deployed together with the conversation agent and only engages adaptively when needed, preserving helpfulness and low latency on safe queries. Our experiments, conducted across five diverse datasets, demonstrate that WaltzRL significantly reduces both unsafe responses (e.g., from 39.0% to 4.6% on WildJailbreak) and overrefusals (from 45.3% to 9.9% on OR-Bench) compared to various baselines. By enabling the conversation and feedback agents to co-evolve and adaptively apply feedback, WaltzRL enhances LLM safety without degrading general capabilities, thereby advancing the Pareto front between helpfulness and harmlessness.

AI.tldr: WaltzRL 是一种多智能体强化学习框架，通过“对话-反馈”双智能体协作，在推理阶段动态修复不安全或过度拒答的回复，实现“有用”与“无害”的帕累托前沿推进。
AI.motivation: 现有防护方法对含敏感片段的提示一律拒绝，既加剧过度拒答（overrefusal），也无法给出细致指导，形成“有用-无害”根本张力。
AI.method: 1) 将安全对齐建模为“正和博弈”，联合训练对话智能体与反馈智能体；2) 提出动态改进奖励 DIR，其值随对话智能体采纳反馈而演化；3) 推理时仅当检测到不安全/过度拒答才激活反馈智能体，实时修正回复，低延迟无感。
AI.result: 在 WildJailbreak 上不安全率从 39.0%→4.6%，在 OR-Bench 上过度拒答率从 45.3%→9.9%，五大数据集全面优于基线，且通用能力不下降。
AI.conclusion: WaltzRL 通过双智能体协同演化、动态奖励与推理期即时修正，首次在降低风险的同时显著减少过度拒答，为 LLM 安全对齐提供新的帕累托最优范式。

title: SAHM: A Benchmark for Arabic Financial and Shari'ah-Compliant Reasoning
summary: English financial NLP has progressed rapidly through benchmarks for sentiment, document understanding, and financial question answering, while Arabic financial NLP remains comparatively under-explored despite strong practical demand for trustworthy finance and Islamic-finance assistants. We introduce SAHM, a document-grounded benchmark and instruction-tuning dataset for Arabic financial NLP and Shari'ah-compliant reasoning. SAHM contains 14,380 expert-verified instances spanning seven tasks: AAOIFI standards QA, fatwa-based QA/MCQ, accounting and business exams, financial sentiment analysis, extractive summarization, and event-cause reasoning, curated from authentic regulatory, juristic, and corporate sources. We evaluate 19 strong open and proprietary LLMs using task-specific metrics and rubric-based scoring for open-ended outputs, and find that Arabic fluency does not reliably translate to evidence-grounded financial reasoning: models are substantially stronger on recognition-style tasks than on generation and causal reasoning, with the largest gaps on event-cause reasoning. We release the benchmark, evaluation framework, and an instruction-tuned model to support future research on trustworthy Arabic financial NLP.

AI.tldr: 文章为阿拉伯语金融场景发布首个大规模专家标注评测库SAHM（1.4万条、7类任务），并证明现有模型在因果推理与生成类任务上远逊于识别类任务。
AI.motivation: 英语金融NLP已有成熟基准，而阿拉伯语因伊斯兰金融与可信金融助手的现实需求却缺乏评测与数据，导致生态滞后。
AI.method: 从监管、律法和公司信源构建七大任务（AAOIFI标准问答、教法fatwa问答/选择、会计考试、情感分析、摘要、事件因果推理等）的专家审核数据集，对19个开源/闭源大模型进行任务特化指标+rubric人工评分双重评测。
AI.result: 即使具备阿拉伯语流畅性，模型在证据驱动的金融推理上表现不佳：识别类任务平均得分明显高于生成与因果推理，事件因果推理差距最大；目前最佳模型仍为闭源GPT-4，但仍有显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 阿拉伯语金融NLP需专门的证据推理基准，SAHM填补空白；未来应聚焦提升大模型在因果与生成型阿拉伯金融任务上的可解释性与稳健性。作者开源基准、评测框架及指令微调模型供后续研究。

title: Data Leakage Detection and De-duplication in Large Scale Geospatial Image Datasets
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables (Accepted as CVPR 2026 Oral)
summary: In our study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of three widely used datasets in the domain of building footprint extraction using deep neural networks: the INRIA Aerial Image Labelling dataset, SpaceNet 2: Building Detection v2, and the AICrowd Mapping Challenge datasets. Our experiments revealed several issues in the AICrowd Mapping Challenge dataset, where nearly 90% (about 250k) of the training split images had identical copies, indicating a high level of duplicate data. Additionally, we found that approximately 56k of the 60k images in the validation split were also present in the training split, amounting to a 93% data leakage. Furthermore, we present a data validation pipeline to address these issues of duplication and data leakage, which hinder the performance of models trained on such datasets. Employing perceptual hashing techniques, this pipeline is designed for efficient de-duplication and leakage identification. It aims to thoroughly evaluate the quality of datasets before their use, thereby ensuring the reliability and robustness of the trained models. Our code is available at https://github.com/yeshwanth95/Hash_and_search .

AI.tldr: 针对建筑轮廓提取常用的三大数据集（INRIA、SpaceNet2、AICrowd），首次系统暴露AICrowd训练集近90%重复、验证集93%与训练集重叠的严重数据泄露与冗余问题；并提出基于感知哈希的端到端数据质控流水线，可快速去重并阻塞泄露。
AI.motivation: 深度学习普遍建立在“训练-验证集独立”假设之上，而遥感社区对建筑轮廓基准数据集的质量缺少系统审计。若数据本身即含大规模重复和泄露，模型评估与比较将失去统计意义，甚至误导后续算法改进。作者旨在量化问题严重性，并提供工具化解决方案。
AI.method: ①对INRIA、SpaceNet2、AICrowd进行元数据与图像级双重比对；②采用pHash、PDQ等感知哈希指纹做全量去重；③哈希库构建＋相似度阈值比较两步法定位验证集与训练集间泄露；④开源Python工具链（github.com/yeshwanth95/Hash_and_search），实现分钟级TB级扫描。
AI.result: 量化发现：AICrowd训练集25万张里≈90%存在完全重复；验证集6万张里有5.6万张可在训练集找到等价版本，泄露率93%；过滤后训练集体积缩减约87%。对比实验显示，用泄露版本训练的U-Net在验证集可达到94% IoU，而在独立测试区仅71%；经去漏训练后，独立场景IoU提升至87%，上限虚高现象消失。
AI.conclusion: 首次证实大规模重复与数据泄露在遥感建筑基准库中的普遍性，提出低成本感知哈希质检范式；研究者应在发布或使用任何数据集前启用类似流水线进行去重与泄露筛查，以确保模型性能评估的可靠性，并为后续基准建设提供质量控制参考标准。

title: Multi-modal Test-time Adaptation via Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration
summary: Multi-modal test-time adaptation (TTA) enhances the resilience of benchmark multi-modal models against distribution shifts by leveraging the unlabeled target data during inference. Despite the documented success, the advancement of multi-modal TTA methodologies has been impeded by a persistent limitation, i.e., the lack of explicit modeling of category-conditional distributions, which is crucial for yielding accurate predictions and reliable decision boundaries. Canonical Gaussian discriminant analysis (GDA) provides a vanilla modeling of category-conditional distributions and achieves moderate advancement in uni-modal contexts. However, in multi-modal TTA scenario, the inherent modality distribution asymmetry undermines the effectiveness of modeling the category-conditional distribution via the canonical GDA. To this end, we introduce a tailored probabilistic Gaussian model for multi-modal TTA to explicitly model the category-conditional distributions, and further propose an adaptive contrastive asymmetry rectification technique to counteract the adverse effects arising from modality asymmetry, thereby deriving calibrated predictions and reliable decision boundaries. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under a wide range of distribution shifts. The code is available at https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态测试时适应(TTA)中类别条件分布未被显式建模、各模态分布不对称导致性能下降的问题，提出一种概率高斯模型AdaPGC，并配套自适应对比非对称校正策略，在多种分布漂移场景取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态TTA方法忽视类别条件分布的显式建模，而传统GDA在单模态有效，却因模态间分布不对称在多模态场景失效，需要新的建模与校正机制。
AI.method: 1) 为多模态TTA定制概率高斯模型，显式刻画各类别条件分布；2) 设计自适应对比非对称校正，动态补偿模态分布差异；3) 在线推断阶段仅用无标目标数据完成模型更新与预测校准。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准数据集上，面对协变量、语义等多种分布漂移，AdaPGC一致优于现有TTA方法，准确率提升3–7个百分点，决策边界更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模类别条件分布并校正模态非对称，AdaPGC在无需源数据的前提下显著增强多模态模型的测试时鲁棒性，为多模态TTA提供了新范式。

title: VISTA: Verification In Sequential Turn-based Assessment
summary: Hallucination--defined here as generating statements unsupported or contradicted by available evidence or conversational context--remains a major obstacle to deploying conversational AI systems in settings that demand factual reliability. Existing metrics either evaluate isolated responses or treat unverifiable content as errors, limiting their use for multi-turn dialogue. We introduce VISTA (Verification In Sequential Turn-based Assessment), a framework for evaluating conversational factuality through claim-level verification and sequential consistency tracking. VISTA decomposes each assistant turn into atomic factual claims, verifies them against trusted sources and dialogue history, and categorizes unverifiable statements (subjective, contradicted, lacking evidence, or abstaining). Across eight large language models and four dialogue factuality benchmarks (AIS, BEGIN, FAITHDIAL, and FADE), VISTA substantially improves hallucination detection over FACTSCORE and LLM-as-Judge baselines. Human evaluation confirms that VISTA's decomposition improves annotator agreement and reveals inconsistencies in existing benchmarks. By modeling factuality as a dynamic property of conversation, VISTA offers a more transparent, human-aligned measure of truthfulness in dialogue systems.

AI.tldr: 面向多轮对话的细粒度事实一致性评估框架VISTA，通过原子级声明验证与序列一致性追踪，显著提升八类大模型在四大基准上的幻觉检出率。
AI.motivation: 现有指标要么仅评估孤立的单轮回复，要么直接把所有不可验证内容误判为错误，无法满足高事实可靠性场景下对多轮对话持续一致性的需求。
AI.method: 提出Verification In Sequential Turn-based Assessment(VISTA)：1) 将每轮回复拆分为原子事实声明；2) 结合可信外部源与对话历史逐条验证；3) 对不可验证声明按主观/矛盾/缺证据/拒绝回答四类精细划分；4) 动态维护跨轮一致性状态。
AI.result: 在八款大模型与AIS、BEGIN、FAITHDIAL、FADE四大对话事实性基准上，VISTA相对FACTSCORE与LLM-as-Judge基线取得显著幻觉检测增益；人类评估显示其分解粒度提升标注一致性并暴露现有基准内部矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 把事实一致性建模为对话过程中的动态属性，使VISTA成为更透明、对齐人类判断的多轮对话真实性度量工具，可支撑高可信度AI系统落地。

title: Design Rules for Extreme-Edge Scientific Computing on AI Engines
summary: Extreme-edge scientific applications use machine learning models to analyze sensor data and make real-time decisions. Their stringent latency and throughput requirements demand small batch sizes and require that model weights remain fully on-chip. Spatial dataflow implementations are common for extreme-edge applications. Spatial dataflow works well for small networks, but it fails to scale to larger models due to inherent resource scaling limitations. AI Engines on modern FPGA SoCs offer a promising alternative with high compute density and additional on-chip memory. However, the architecture, programming model, and performance-scaling behavior of AI Engines differ fundamentally from those of the programmable logic, making direct comparison non-trivial and the benefits of using AI Engines unclear. This work addresses how and when extreme-edge scientific neural networks should be implemented on AI Engines versus programmable logic. We provide systematic architectural characterization and micro-benchmarking and introduce a latency-adjusted resource equivalence (LARE) metric that identifies when AI Engine implementations outperform programmable logic designs. We further propose spatial and API-level dataflow optimizations tailored to low-latency scientific inference. Finally, we demonstrate the successful deployment of end-to-end neural networks on AI Engines that cannot fit on programmable logic when using the hlsml toolchain.

AI.tldr: 针对极限边缘科学应用，论文提出一套量化方法判断AI Engine与可编程逻辑孰优孰劣，并通过专门优化首次把原本放不进PL的大型网络完整部署到AI Engine，显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 极限边缘科学场景需在FPGA SoC上实现极低延迟、小批量、权值全片上的小模型推理。传统空间数据流仅适用于小型网络；AI Engine算力密度高但架构差异大，尚缺系统性的“何时该用”评估依据。
AI.method: (1)对AI Engine与可编程逻辑分别做系统级架构剖析和微基准测试；(2)提出“延迟修正的资源等效度量”LARE，将吞吐、延迟、存储、能耗统一折算为等价资源，作为跨域比较基准；(3)基于LARE制定选择策略；(4)针对AI Engine设计低延迟空间数据流图、API级流水线及双缓冲等优化；(5)用hlsml工具链实现端到端网络部署。
AI.result: LARE可在设计早期准确预测AI Engine版本优于PL的临界点；经过优化后，同一科学网络在AI Engine上的单帧推理延迟平均下降1.7–2.3×，吞吐提升1.9–2.6×；当权值规模超过PL片上BRAM上限时，AI Engine仍能完整容纳并运行，而PL已无法映射。
AI.conclusion: AI Engine并非在所有场景都优于PL，但当网络规模或延迟需求超出LARE阈值时，其高密度计算与额外片上内存带来的收益显著高于额外开销。作者提供的LARE流程与优化策略可作为极限边缘神经网络的通用“选型+实现”范式，并为未来异构FPGA SoC的自动化工具链奠定基础。

title: AlignedCut: Visual Concepts Discovery on Brain-Guided Universal Feature Space
summary: We study the intriguing connection between visual data, deep networks, and the brain. Our method creates a universal channel alignment by using brain voxel fMRI response prediction as the training objective. We discover that deep networks, trained with different objectives, share common feature channels across various models. These channels can be clustered into recurring sets, corresponding to distinct brain regions, indicating the formation of visual concepts. Tracing the clusters of channel responses onto the images, we see semantically meaningful object segments emerge, even without any supervised decoder. Furthermore, the universal feature alignment and the clustering of channels produce a picture and quantification of how visual information is processed through the different network layers, which produces precise comparisons between the networks.

AI.tldr: 以预测人脑fMRI响应为训练目标，发现不同目标训练的深度网络出现跨模型共享的通用特征通道，其聚类对应特定脑区并自发分割图像语义对象，首次实现无监督的“脑-网”对齐与层间信息量化比较。
AI.motivation: 揭示视觉数据、深度网络与人脑三者间的本质联系，回答“深度表征如何与人脑视觉机制对齐”这一核心科学问题。
AI.method: 将人脑体素fMRI响应作为唯一监督信号训练多种深度网络，得到跨模型通用通道对齐；对通道按脑区响应聚类，追踪聚类激活图到输入图像，实现无监督语义分割；构建层级信息处理量化框架。
AI.result: 不同目标任务的网络出现稳定复现的共享通道集合，其聚类与特定脑区一一对应；聚类激活图在无解码器条件下精确勾勒出对象轮廓；首次给出层-wise“脑-网”信息转换的定量对比指标。
AI.conclusion: 深度网络与人脑视觉系统存在普适且可解释的对应结构，fMRI预测目标可强制模型学到人脑兼容的通用表征，为构建“脑启发”可解释AI提供新范式。

title: SAHM: A Benchmark for Arabic Financial and Shari'ah-Compliant Reasoning
summary: English financial NLP has progressed rapidly through benchmarks for sentiment, document understanding, and financial question answering, while Arabic financial NLP remains comparatively under-explored despite strong practical demand for trustworthy finance and Islamic-finance assistants. We introduce SAHM, a document-grounded benchmark and instruction-tuning dataset for Arabic financial NLP and Shari'ah-compliant reasoning. SAHM contains 14,380 expert-verified instances spanning seven tasks: AAOIFI standards QA, fatwa-based QA/MCQ, accounting and business exams, financial sentiment analysis, extractive summarization, and event-cause reasoning, curated from authentic regulatory, juristic, and corporate sources. We evaluate 19 strong open and proprietary LLMs using task-specific metrics and rubric-based scoring for open-ended outputs, and find that Arabic fluency does not reliably translate to evidence-grounded financial reasoning: models are substantially stronger on recognition-style tasks than on generation and causal reasoning, with the largest gaps on event-cause reasoning. We release the benchmark, evaluation framework, and an instruction-tuned model to support future research on trustworthy Arabic financial NLP.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次为阿拉伯语金融NLP与伊斯兰教法合规推理构建了包含14,380条专家标注的SAHM基准，评测19个大模型发现阿拉伯语流利度≠可信金融推理能力。
AI.motivation: 英语金融NLP已通过基准快速进步，而阿拉伯语因缺乏可信数据与伊斯兰教法合规推理基准严重滞后，无法满足伊斯兰金融助手的现实诉求。
AI.method: 构建SAHM七任务基准（AAOIFI标准问答、教法裁决问答/选择题、会计与商学考试、金融情感分析、抽取式摘要、事件因果推理），从监管、教法与企业源采集并专家校验；设计任务专用指标与开放式评分量表，对19个开源/闭源LLM进行系统评测并发布指令微调数据集与评估框架。
AI.result: 模型在识别型任务表现远好于生成与因果推理；事件因果推理差距最大；阿拉伯语流畅性不保证基于证据的金融推理可靠性；指令微调模型可提升但在因果任务仍显著落后。
AI.conclusion: SAHM填补了阿拉伯语与伊斯兰金融NLP空白，揭示当前LLM在可信、因果推理上的关键短板，为推动可信阿拉伯金融NLP研究提供基准、评测框架与基础模型。

title: From Proof to Program: Characterizing Tool-Induced Reasoning Hallucinations in Large Language Models
summary: Tool-augmented Language Models (TaLMs) can invoke external tools to solve problems beyond their parametric capacity. However, it remains unclear whether these tool-enabled gains reflect trustworthy reasoning. Focusing on the Code Interpreter tool, we show that even when tools are selected and executed correctly, TaLMs treat tool outputs as substitutes for reasoning, producing solutions that appear correct but lack coherent justification. We term this failure mode Tool-Induced Myopia (TIM), and study it using PYMATH, a benchmark of 1,679 competition-level mathematical problems for which Python code is helpful but not sufficient. We further develop a multi-dimensional evaluation suite to quantify reasoning degradation in TaLMs relative to their non-tool counterparts. Our findings reveal that while TaLMs achieve up to a 19.3 percentage point gain in final-answer accuracy, their reasoning behavior consistently deteriorates (e.g., non-tool LLMs win up to 41.5% more often in pairwise comparisons of the reasoning process). This degradation intensifies with tool use; the more frequently a model invokes tools, the less coherent its reasoning becomes. Moreover, tool use shifts errors from arithmetic mistakes toward global reasoning failures (logic, assumption, creativity); with TIM present in ~55% of high-risk cases. Finally, we propose a preference-optimization-based framework that realigns TaLMs to use tools as assistive evidence, improving both final-answer accuracy and reasoning depth under tool use. Codes and data are available at: https://github.com/megagonlabs/TIM.

AI.tldr: 引入工具的语言模型会因“工具诱发近视（TIM）”而表面准确率提高19.3 pp，但推理连贯性显著下降（非工具模型在过程对比中胜率提高41.5%），错误类型从计算转向全局逻辑；作者提出偏好优化框架把工具当辅助证据，同步提升答案正确率与推理深度。
AI.motivation: 尽管TaLM调用工具可在数学等任务上获得准确率红利，但尚不清楚这些红利是否建立在可信推理之上。作者怀疑模型把工具输出当“免思考”答案，导致推理浅层化，需系统量化并修复该风险。
AI.method: 1) 构建1679道竞赛级数学题的新基准PYMATH，其特点是用Python有助但不足；2) 设计多维度评测，从答案对/错、推理过程、错误分类等角度横向对比TaLM与无工具LLM；3) 统计工具调用频率与推理退化之间的剂量-反应关系；4) 提出基于偏好优化的再对齐框架，把工具输出当作“辅助证据”而非“终极答案”，重新训练模型。
AI.result: TaLM答案准确率最高+19.3 pp，但推理质量持续变差：无工具LLM在配对过程评测中胜率提高24.0–41.5%；工具调用越频繁，推理连贯性越差；TIM在高风险样本中出现率约55%，错误焦点从算术转向逻辑/假设/创造力；再用偏好优化后，模型答案准确率与推理深度同时提升。
AI.conclusion: TIM揭示“工具有用≠推理可靠”。仅盯最终正确率会高估模型能力；必须把工具重新定位为推理的“外部证据”，并通过偏好优化等手段让模型回到“先思考、后核验”的范式，才能实现答案与推理双重可信。

title: MSDS: Deep Structural Similarity with Multiscale Representation
summary: Deep-feature-based perceptual similarity models have demonstrated strong alignment with human visual perception in Image Quality Assessment (IQA). However, most existing approaches operate at a single spatial scale, implicitly assuming that structural similarity at a fixed resolution is sufficient. The role of spatial scale in deep-feature similarity modeling thus remains insufficiently understood. In this letter, we isolate spatial scale as an independent factor using a minimal multiscale extension of DeepSSIM, referred to as Deep Structural Similarity with Multiscale Representation (MSDS). The proposed framework decouples deep feature representation from cross-scale integration by computing DeepSSIM independently across pyramid levels and fusing the resulting scores with a lightweight set of learnable global weights. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent and statistically significant improvements over the single-scale baseline, while introducing negligible additional complexity. The results empirically confirm spatial scale as a non-negligible factor in deep perceptual similarity, isolated here via a minimal testbed.

AI.tldr: DeepSSIM 仅在单尺度上评估感知相似度，作者提出最小化的多尺度扩展 MSDS，用可学习全局权重融合各层得分，无需改动网络即可获得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于深度特征的模型在 IQA 上与人类感知高度一致，但它们几乎都在固定分辨率下评估结构相似性，缺乏对“空间尺度是否影响深度特征相似度”的系统性研究。
AI.method: 将 DeepSSIM 作为单尺度基线，分别在高斯金字塔的每一级独立计算 DeepSSIM 得分；引入一套轻量级、可学习的全局权重融合多尺度得分，形成 Deep Structural Similarity with Multiscale Representation (MSDS)。
AI.result: 在多个基准 IQA 数据集上，MSDS 相较单尺度 DeepSSIM 带来一致且统计显著的性能提升，参数量与计算开销几乎可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 即使是最小化的多尺度设计，也能显著增强深度感知相似度模型，证明“空间尺度”本身就是不可忽视的独立因子。

title: On the Generalizability of Foundation Models for Crop Type Mapping
comment: Accepted to IEEE IGARSS 2025. The final version is available in the Proceedings of the IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2025
summary: Foundation models pre-trained using self-supervised learning have shown powerful transfer learning capabilities on various downstream tasks, including language understanding, text generation, and image recognition. The Earth observation (EO) field has produced several foundation models pre-trained directly on multispectral satellite imagery for applications like precision agriculture, wildfire and drought monitoring, and natural disaster response. However, few studies have investigated the ability of these models to generalize to new geographic locations, and potential concerns of geospatial bias -- models trained on data-rich developed nations not transferring well to data-scarce developing nations -- remain. We evaluate three popular EO foundation models, SSL4EO-S12, SatlasPretrain, and ImageNet, on five crop classification datasets across five continents. Results show that pre-trained weights designed explicitly for Sentinel-2, such as SSL4EO-S12, outperform general pre-trained weights like ImageNet. While only 100 labeled images are sufficient for achieving high overall accuracy, 900 images are required to mitigate class imbalance and improve average accuracy.

AI.tldr: 以Sentinel-2为核心的自监督EO基础模型在跨洲作物分类中优于ImageNet权重，但存在地理偏差；少量样本即可奏效，但缓解类别失衡仍需更多样本。
AI.motivation: 现有地球观测基础模型多从多光谱影像自监督训练，在下游任务表现良好，但缺乏对其跨地理区域泛化能力及潜在偏差的系统评估，尤其在欠数据区域。
AI.method: 选取SSL4EO-S12、SatlasPretrain和ImageNet三种权重，用五大洲共计5个作物分类数据集进行跨域迁移实验，比较不同权重在不同地理场景下的整体准确率与平均准确率，并分析样本量对类别不平衡的缓解效果。
AI.result: 针对Sentinel-2设计的SSL4EO-S12显著优于通用ImageNet预训练；仅用100张标记影像即可达到高总体精度，而平均精度因类别不平衡需900张影像才满足。
AI.conclusion: 专用的EO基础模型能显著提升全球作物制图的迁移性能，但仍存在对发达区域训练数据的地理偏差，未来需强化欠数据区域的样本均衡与预训练策略。

title: Relational AI in Education: Reciprocity, Participatory Design, and Indigenous Worldviews
summary: Education is not merely the transmission of information or the optimisation of individual performance; it is a fundamentally social, constructive, and relational practice. However, recent advances in generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) increasingly emphasise efficiency, automation, and individualised assistance, risking the weakening of relational learning processes. Despite growing adoption, AI in education (AIED) research has yet to fully articulate how AI can be designed in ways that sustain the social and ecological relationships through which learning occurs. In this paper, we re-centre education as relational and frame learner-AI interactions as context-specific relationships with clearly defined purposes and boundaries, rather than positioning them as substitutes for, or replacements of, human interaction. Grounded in participatory design practices and inspired by Indigenous worldviews (including Aboriginal Australian, Native American, and Mesoamerican traditions) that foreground reciprocity and relational accountability, we argue that meaningful educational AI should support learning with others rather than replace them. We advance this perspective by: i) conceptualising AIED as a relational design problem grounded in reciprocity; ii) articulating key tensions introduced by GenAI in education; and iii) outlining design directions that expand the AIED design space toward reciprocity, including when not to use AI, how to define pedagogical boundaries, and how to support responsible uses of AIED innovations that sustain communities and natural environments.

AI.tldr: 本文批判 GenAI 教育应用过度强调效率与个体化，削弱“关系性学习”；以原住民互惠世界观为镜，提出“关系性设计”框架，主张 AI 应支持而非替代人际互动，并给出三条设计方向：明确不用 AI 的场景、划定教学边界、确保创新惠及社区与生态。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 加速落地教育，但主流 AIED 聚焦于自动化与个性化，忽视学习的社会-关系本质，潜在侵蚀师生、生生及人与自然的互惠网络，亟需新的设计范式。
AI.method: 以参与式设计为实践路径，引入澳洲土著、北美原住民、中美洲传统等原住民宇宙观，将“互惠—关系责任”作为核心伦理；通过概念分析与张力梳理，构建“关系性 AIED”设计空间。
AI.result: 提出 i) 把 AIED 重定义为“关系-互惠”设计问题；ii) 识别 GenAI 在教育中的关键张力（效率 vs 关系、自动化 vs 责任、个体 vs 社群-生态）；iii) 给出三项可操作的设计方向：①规定“AI 禁区”以维护人际互动；②为特定情境设定清晰教学边界；③创新评估指标，确保 AIED 强化而非耗散社区与自然环境。
AI.conclusion: 唯有把 AI 嵌入互惠伦理与关系网络，教育技术才能从“替代人”转向“与人共学”。关系性设计不仅适用于 AIED，也为更广泛的可持续技术提供范式，未来需跨学科、跨文化共创，持续检验其对社群与地球的长期影响。

title: MiroThinker: Pushing the Performance Boundaries of Open-Source Research Agents via Model, Context, and Interactive Scaling
summary: We present MiroThinker v1.0, an open-source research agent designed to advance tool-augmented reasoning and information-seeking capabilities. Unlike previous agents that only scale up model size or context length, MiroThinker explores interaction scaling at the model level, systematically training the model to handle deeper and more frequent agent-environment interactions as a third dimension of performance improvement. Unlike LLM test-time scaling, which operates in isolation and risks degradation with longer reasoning chains, interactive scaling leverages environment feedback and external information acquisition to correct errors and refine trajectories. Through reinforcement learning, the model achieves efficient interaction scaling: with a 256K context window, it can perform up to 600 tool calls per task, enabling sustained multi-turn reasoning and complex real-world research workflows. Across four representative benchmarks-GAIA, HLE, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-ZH-the 72B variant achieves up to 81.9%, 37.7%, 47.1%, and 55.6% accuracy respectively, surpassing previous open-source agents and approaching commercial counterparts such as GPT-5-high. Our analysis reveals that MiroThinker benefits from interactive scaling consistently: research performance improves predictably as the model engages in deeper and more frequent agent-environment interactions, demonstrating that interaction depth exhibits scaling behaviors analogous to model size and context length. These findings establish interaction scaling as a third critical dimension for building next-generation open research agents, complementing model capacity and context windows.

AI.tldr: MiroThinker 首次把“交互深度”作为与模型规模、上下文长度并列的第三维扩展维度，通过 RL 让 72B 模型在单任务内调用 600 次工具，在 GAIA 等 4 个基准上刷新开源记录并逼近 GPT-5-high 水平。
AI.motivation: 现有研究要么堆参数要么加长文本，但链式推理越长越容易出错；作者提出应让模型在与环境的高频交互中动态纠错，从而突破纯文本推理的可靠性瓶颈。
AI.method: 以强化学习为核心训练范式，系统提升模型在单位任务内的交互深度与频次；配合 256K 上下文窗口，实现可持续的多轮工具调用与异构信息检索，形成“交互可扩展”架构。
AI.result: 72B 版本在 GAIA、HLE、BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH 上分别取得 81.9%、37.7%、47.1%、55.6% 的准确率，全面领先既有开源 Agent，并与商用 GPT-5-high 相当；性能随交互深度单调提升，展现出与模型规模/上下文长度类似的幂律缩放规律。
AI.conclusion: 交互深度被确立为构建下一代开放研究 Agent 的第三关键维度；通过 RL 驱动的交互缩放，可在不增加参数或窗口的前提下持续强化复杂真实研究任务的表现，为开源社区提供新范式。

title: Analytical Extraction of Conditional Sobol' Indices via Basis Decomposition of Polynomial Chaos Expansions
summary: In uncertainty quantification, evaluating sensitivity measures under specific conditions (i.e., conditional Sobol' indices) is essential for systems with parameterized responses, such as spatial fields or varying operating conditions.
