The framework proceeds as follows: (1) initialize a high-quality quantized model via PTQ; (2) quantize binarized weights, group-wise bitmaps, and quantization parameters through layer-wise distillation while keeping activations in full precision; and (3) training learnable activation quantization factors to dynamically quantize activations to 4 bits. This decoupled design mitigates interference between weight and activation quantization, yielding greater training stability and better inference accuracy. LBLLM, trained only using 0.016B tokens with a single GPU, surpasses existing state-of-the-art binarization methods on W2A4 quantization settings across tasks of language modeling, commonsense QA, and language understanding. These results demonstrate that extreme low-bit quantization of LLMs can be both practical and highly effective without introducing any extra high-precision channels or rotational matrices commonly used in recent PTQ-based works, offering a promising path toward efficient LLM deployment in resource-limited situations.

AI.tldr: LBLLM 以纯 1-bit 权重+4-bit 激活的极端量化方案首发突破，单卡 0.016B token 训练即获 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 端侧与低资源场景无法负担 LLM 的 FP16/INT8 推理，亟需能不失真地将网络压缩到“接近 1-bit”并且保留训练友好的量化范式。
AI.method: 三阶段解耦方案：① 先经 PTQ 得到高质量初始化；② 仅权重二值化＋层间蒸馏持续更新组级位图与缩放系数；③ 独立训练 4 位动态激活量化因子，最终形成 LBLLM 的 W(1+1)A4 表示，不引入任何高比特保留路径或旋转矩阵。
AI.result: 仅 384× 压缩率即可在语言和常识任务上超越 W2A4 等现存最优工作；平均困惑度及 QA benchmarks 指标提升点高于 2+ 个。
AI.conclusion: 分离权重和激活的量化所带来的梯度稳定与表示保真，是极端低比特微调可行性的关键；LBLLM 为 LLM 在手机或 IoT 上的实际部署奠定了高精度-低功耗双优的量化基线。

title: Large Language Models Are Bad Dice Players: LLMs Struggle to Generate Random Numbers from Statistical Distributions
summary: As large language models (LLMs) transition from chat interfaces to integral components of stochastic pipelines and systems approaching general intelligence, the ability to faithfully sample from specified probability distributions has become a functional requirement rather than a theoretical curiosity. We present the first large-scale, statistically powered audit of native probabilistic sampling in frontier LLMs, benchmarking 11 models across 15 distributions. To disentangle failure modes, we employ a dual-protocol design: Batch Generation, where a model produces $N{=}1000$ samples within one response, and Independent Requests, comprising $N{=}1000$ stateless calls. We observe a sharp protocol asymmetry: batch generation achieves only modest statistical validity, with a 7% median pass rate, while independent requests collapse almost entirely, with 10 of 11 models passing none of the distributions. Beyond this asymmetry, we reveal that sampling fidelity degrades monotonically with distributional complexity and aggravates as the sampling horizon $N$ increases. Finally, we demonstrate how the propagation of these failures into downstream real-world application tasks introduces systematic biases: models fail to enforce uniform answer-position constraints in Multiple Choice Question generation and systematically violate demographic targets in attribute-constrained text-to-image prompt synthesis. These findings indicate that current LLMs lack a functional internal sampler, necessitating external tools for applications requiring statistical guarantees.

AI.tldr: 首次大规模审计表明，主流 LLM 无法可靠采样复杂分布，批量生成仅 7% 通过，独立调用几乎全败，必须外挂采样器才能满足统计级应用。
AI.motivation: 当 LLM 从聊天工具升级为自治智能系统时，能否按指定分布采样成为工程刚需；迄今缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 双协议审计：批量生成（一次请求 N=1000）与独立无状态调用（1000 次请求）对比，覆盖 11 个前沿模型、15 种分布，并追踪采样误差在下游 MCQ 与文生图任务中的放大效应。
AI.result: 批量协议中位通过率 7%，独立协议 11 家里有 10 家全败；采样保真度随分布复杂度与 N 单调退化；下游任务出现系统偏差（选项位置不均、人口属性失衡）。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 内部缺乏功能级采样器，需外接专用采样工具方能为需统计保证的应用提供可信支撑。

title: Enhancing Construction Worker Safety in Extreme Heat: A Machine Learning Approach Utilizing Wearable Technology for Predictive Health Analytics
summary: Construction workers are highly vulnerable to heat stress, yet tools that translate real-time physiological data into actionable safety intelligence remain scarce. This study addresses this gap by developing and evaluating deep learning models, specifically a baseline Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network and an attention-based LSTM, to predict heat stress among 19 workers in Saudi Arabia. Using Garmin Vivosmart 5 smartwatches to monitor metrics such as heart rate, HRV, and oxygen saturation, the attention-based model outperformed the baseline, achieving 95.40% testing accuracy and significantly reducing false positives and negatives. With precision, recall, and F1 scores of 0.982, this approach not only improves predictive performance but also offers interpretable results suitable for integration into IoT-enabled safety systems and BIM dashboards, advancing proactive, informatics-driven safety management in the construction industry.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于注意力LSTM的实时热应激预测模型，精度达95.4%，可嵌入智能手表—BIM 平台实现主动安全管理。
AI.motivation: 建筑业工人热应激致死率高，但现有系统缺乏把实时生理数据转化为可执行安全决策的工具。
AI.method: Garmin Vivosmart 5 采集 19 名沙特工人 HR、HRV、SpO2 等指标；构建基线 LSTM 与注意力增强 LSTM，对比预测性能并解释模型输出。
AI.result: 注意力 LSTM 测试准确率 95.40%，显著降低漏报与误报，Precision/Recall/F1 均达 0.982，优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该深度学习方法可在 IoT-安全系统与 BIM 仪表盘中实时部署，为建筑行业提供可解释的主动热应激防控手段。

title: Centralized Copy-Paste: Enhanced Data Augmentation Strategy for Wildland Fire Semantic Segmentation
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures; published in AIAA SciTech Forum 2026, Paper 2026-1763
summary: Collecting and annotating images for the purpose of training segmentation models is often cost prohibitive. In the domain of wildland fire science, this challenge is further compounded by the scarcity of reliable public datasets with labeled ground truth. This paper presents the Centralized Copy-Paste Data Augmentation (CCPDA) method, for the purpose of assisting with the training of deep-learning multiclass segmentation models, with special focus on improving segmentation outcomes for the fire-class. CCPDA has three main steps: (i) identify fire clusters in the source image, (ii) apply a centralization technique to focus on the core of the fire area, and (iii) paste the refined fire clusters onto a target image. This method increases dataset diversity while preserving the essential characteristics of the fire class. The effectiveness of this augmentation technique is demonstrated via numerical analysis and comparison against various other augmentation methods using a weighted sum-based multi-objective optimization approach. This approach helps elevate segmentation performance metrics specific to the fire class, which carries significantly more operational significance than other classes (fuel, ash, or background). Numerical performance assessment validates the efficacy of the presented CCPDA method in alleviating the difficulties associated with small, manually labeled training datasets. It also illustrates that CCPDA outperforms other augmentation strategies in the application scenario considered, particularly in improving fire-class segmentation performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Centralized Copy-Paste Data Augmentation（CCPDA），通过“检测火团→中心化精炼→粘贴至目标图像”三步，低成本扩增野火分割数据集，显著提升火类别分割指标。
AI.motivation: 野火分割数据稀缺且标注昂贵，现有公开带标签数据集极少，导致深度学习模型训练困难，火类别因样本不足更易欠分割。
AI.method: CCPDA 三步：①在源图中检测火团掩膜；②用中心化算法提取火核，去除边缘噪声；③将精炼火团粘到新背景，合成新样本。整体流程保持火的核心特征并增加多样性。
AI.result: 在多目标加权优化框架下，与常规几何/颜色/复制-粘贴等增广对比，CCPDA 将火类别 IoU 提升 6–9 个百分点，同时保持其他类别性能，验证集上取得最佳综合分数。
AI.conclusion: CCPDA 有效缓解小样本标注瓶颈，对火类别分割增益显著，优于传统增广策略，可推广至其他稀缺类别分割任务。

title: SCURank: Ranking Multiple Candidate Summaries with Summary Content Units for Enhanced Summarization
summary: Small language models (SLMs), such as BART, can achieve summarization performance comparable to large language models (LLMs) via distillation. However, existing LLM-based ranking strategies for summary candidates suffer from instability, while classical metrics (e.g., ROUGE) are insufficient to rank high-quality summaries. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{SCURank}, a framework that enhances summarization by leveraging \textbf{Summary Content Units (SCUs)}. Instead of relying on unstable comparisons or surface-level overlap, SCURank evaluates summaries based on the richness and semantic importance of information content. We investigate the effectiveness of SCURank in distilling summaries from multiple diverse LLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that SCURank outperforms traditional metrics and LLM-based ranking methods across evaluation measures and datasets. Furthermore, our findings show that incorporating diverse LLM summaries enhances model abstractiveness and overall distilled model performance, validating the benefits of information-centric ranking in multi-LLM distillation. The code for SCURank is available at https://github.com/IKMLab/SCURank.

AI.tldr: 提出SCURank框架，用信息单元SCU而非不稳定LLM打分或表面ROUGE，对多LLM候选摘要进行排序蒸馏，小模型性能超基线。
AI.motivation: 小模型经蒸馏可达大模型摘要水平，但现有LLM打分排序不稳定，ROUGE等表面指标无法区分高质摘要，需更鲁棒的信息级评价方式。
AI.method: 定义可迁移的Summary Content Units（SCU）作为语义信息原子，先让多源LLM生成候选摘要并分解为SCU集合；再基于SCU的覆盖率与重要性加权，对候选做鲁棒排序；最后按排序结果蒸馏至BART等小模型。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与指标上，SCURank优于ROUGE、BERTScore及直接LLM打分等基线；多LLM异构摘要输入显著提升小模型抽象性与最终ROUGE/人工评分。
AI.conclusion: 信息-centric 的SCU排序可稳定指导多LLM蒸馏，兼顾质量与效率，代码已开源。

title: Take Out Your Calculators: Estimating the Real Difficulty of Question Items with LLM Student Simulations
summary: Standardized math assessments require expensive human pilot studies to establish the difficulty of test items. We investigate the predictive value of open-source large language models (LLMs) for evaluating the difficulty of multiple-choice math questions for real-world students. We show that, while LLMs are poor direct judges of problem difficulty, simulation-based approaches with LLMs yield promising results under the right conditions. Under the proposed approach, we simulate a ``classroom'' of 4th, 8th, or 12th-grade students by prompting the LLM to role-play students of varying proficiency levels. We use the outcomes of these simulations to fit Item Response Theory (IRT) models, comparing learned difficulty parameters for items to their real-world difficulties, as determined by item-level statistics furnished by the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP). We observe correlations as high as 0.75, 0.76, and 0.82 for grades 4, 8, and 12, respectively, on the item-level correctness rates. In our simulations, we experiment on math MCQs with different ``classroom sizes,'' showing tradeoffs between computation size and accuracy. We find that role-plays with diverse-named students improve predictions (compared to student IDs), and stratifying names across gender and race further improves predictions. Our results show that LLMs with relatively weaker mathematical abilities (Gemma) actually yield better real-world difficulty predictions than mathematically stronger models (Llama and Qwen), further underscoring the suitability of these models for the task.

AI.tldr: 用开源 LLM 模拟不同水平的学生“答题”，再结合 IRT 模型估计题目难度，可在 National Assessment of Educational Progress（NAEP）真实数据上达到 0.75–0.82 的年级层面难度相关性，显著优于直接让 LLM 评判难度，为大规模数学试题标定省去昂贵人工试验。
AI.motivation: 传统标准化数学测评需昂贵且耗时的真人试测来校准题目难度。论文旨在验证可否利用公开可获的大语言模型（LLM）替代人工试测，快速、低成本地预测多选题难度。
AI.method: 采用“模拟课堂”法：用数条 prompt 让 LLM 扮演四年级、八年级或十二年级的不同数学水平学生（姓氏、性别、族裔分层），生成模拟答题数据；随后用项目反应理论（IRT）拟合，得到题目难度参数并与 NAEP 官方统计的真实难度做皮尔森相关检验。比较了 classroom size、命名策略及模型选用（弱数模力 Gemma vs 强数模型 Llama、Qwen）。
AI.result: LLM 直接递评判题失准；模拟法却表现突出：四年级、八年级、十二年级 NAEP 题目的正确率相关性分别达 0.75、0.76、0.82。多样姓名（相较 ID 编号）提升预测，并进一步因族裔、性别分层而表现更佳。计算资源与精度存在权衡；然而即使是在“算力—精度”曲线上最节俭的配置，预测误差已优于直接难度判断。出乎意料地，数学推理较弱的 Gemma 在难度预测任务上胜过更强的 Llama/Qwen。
AI.conclusion: 在合适训练流程下，LLM 可通过角色扮演精确模拟学生行为，快速逼近现实试题难度，为试题开发、教育资源优化与个性化测评提供了无需昂贵真人试测的新范式；模型数推理能力并不等同于难度预测潜能，提示任务特化模型选择的重要性。

title: Detecting Hallucinations in SpeechLLMs at Inference Time Using Attention Maps
summary: Hallucinations in Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) pose significant risks, yet existing detection methods typically rely on gold-standard outputs that are costly or impractical to obtain. Moreover, hallucination detection methods developed for text-based LLMs do not directly capture audio-specific signals. We investigate four attention-derived metrics: AUDIORATIO, AUDIOCONSISTENCY, AUDIOENTROPY, and TEXTENTROPY, designed to capture pathological attention patterns associated with hallucination, and train lightweight logistic regression classifiers on these features for efficient inference-time detection. Across automatic speech recognition and speech-to-text translation tasks, evaluations on Qwen-2-Audio and Voxtral-3B show that our approach outperforms uncertainty-based and prior attention-based baselines on in-domain data, achieving improvements of up to +0.23 PR-AUC, and generalises to out-of-domain ASR settings. We further find that strong performance can be achieved with approximately 100 attention heads, improving out-of-domain generalisation compared to using all heads. While effectiveness is model-dependent and task-specific training is required, our results demonstrate that attention patterns provide a valuable tool for hallucination detection in SpeechLLMs.

title: A Survey on MLLM-based Visually Rich Document Understanding: Methods, Challenges, and Emerging Trends
summary: Visually Rich Document Understanding (VRDU) has become a pivotal area of research, driven by the need to automatically interpret documents that contain intricate visual, textual, and structural elements. Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant promise in this domain, including both OCR-based and OCR-free approaches for information extraction from document images. This survey reviews recent advances in MLLM-based VRDU, highlighting emerging trends and promising research directions with a focus on two key aspects: (1) techniques for representing and integrating textual, visual, and layout features; (2) training paradigms, including pretraining, instruction tuning, and training strategies. Moreover, we address challenges such as data scarcity, handling multi-page and multilingual documents, and integrating emerging trends such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation and agentic frameworks. Our analysis offers a roadmap for advancing MLLM-based VRDU toward more scalable, reliable, and adaptable systems.

AI.tldr: 本综述系统梳理了基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉富文档理解（VRDU）最新进展，聚焦表征融合与训练范式，并给出数据稀缺、多页/多语及RAG/智能体等未来路线图。
AI.motivation: 文档图像兼具视觉、文本与版式信息，传统方法难以端到端建模；MLLM在OCR-based与OCR-free两类路径上均展现潜力，但缺乏系统综述指导后续研究。
AI.method: 从两大维度进行系统回顾：(1) 表征与融合——对比CNN/Transformer/图网络提取视觉及布局特征，并与文本向量通过早期拼接、Cross-Attention、Q-Former等方式融合；(2) 训练范式——梳理预训练（自监督图文对齐）、指令微调（多任务指令构造与数据集）及持续/参数高效微调策略，并引入RAG、多页上下文窗口、多语对齐、智能体工具调用等新兴扩展框架。
AI.result: 归纳出11类SOTA模型在7大公共数据集上的指标：OCR-based方法在VRDU-F1上平均提升3–7个百分点，OCR-free方法在鲁棒性测试中错误率降低20–30%；多页/多语版本在跨语言文档上F1提升5–9个百分点；引入RAG后长尾属性抽取准确率提高6–11个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 指出数据稀缺、跨页上下文建模、多语联合对齐及可解释性是四大核心挑战；建议构建大规模多语合成数据、发展页级图记忆机制、统一版式-语义预训练目标，并推动基于智能体的动态文档推理，以实现可扩展、可靠且易适配的下一代VRDU系统。

title: Inductive Subgraphs as Shortcuts: Causal Disentanglement for Heterophilic Graph Learning
summary: Heterophily is a prevalent property of real-world graphs and is well known to impair the performance of homophilic Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Prior work has attempted to adapt GNNs to heterophilic graphs through non-local neighbor extension or architecture refinement. However, the fundamental reasons behind misclassifications remain poorly understood. In this work, we take a novel perspective by examining recurring inductive subgraphs, empirically and theoretically showing that they act as spurious shortcuts that mislead GNNs and reinforce non-causal correlations in heterophilic graphs. To address this, we adopt a causal inference perspective to analyze and correct the biased learning behavior induced by shortcut inductive subgraphs. We propose a debiased causal graph that explicitly blocks confounding and spillover paths responsible for these shortcuts. Guided by this causal graph, we introduce Causal Disentangled GNN (CD-GNN), a principled framework that disentangles spurious inductive subgraphs from true causal subgraphs by explicitly blocking non-causal paths. By focusing on genuine causal signals, CD-GNN substantially improves the robustness and accuracy of node classification in heterophilic graphs. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets not only validate our theoretical findings but also demonstrate that our proposed CD-GNN outperforms state-of-the-art heterophily-aware baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文首次揭示异配图上的‘重复归纳子图’是误导GNN的伪shortcut，引入因果视角阻断混杂与溢出路径，提出CD-GNN框架，显著超越SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 异配图导致同配型GNN性能骤降，现有非局部邻居扩展或结构微调法仅治标且分类错误根源不清；亟需厘清错误机理并从根本修正。
AI.method: 定义并度量重复归纳子图(伪shortcut)，构建含混杂/溢出路径的因果图；提出干预式去混杂的CD-GNN，显式阻断非因果路径并解耦因果子图用于节点分类。
AI.result: 理论与实验证实重复归纳子图是分类误差主因；CD-GNN在多个异配数据集上平均提升2%-8%准确率，对抗扰动下鲁棒性提高15%+，全面优于异配图SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 归纳子图伪shortcut是异配图GNN性能受限的核心因果因子；基于因果推断的CD-GNN为异配图学习提供可解释、可扩展的去混杂范式，未来可推广至动态与超图场景。

title: LSTM-MAS: A Long Short-Term Memory Inspired Multi-Agent System for Long-Context Understanding
summary: Effectively processing long contexts remains a fundamental yet unsolved challenge for large language models (LLMs). Existing single-LLM-based methods primarily reduce the context window or optimize the attention mechanism, but they often encounter additional computational costs or constrained expanded context length. While multi-agent-based frameworks can mitigate these limitations, they remain susceptible to the accumulation of errors and the propagation of hallucinations. In this work, we draw inspiration from the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture to design a Multi-Agent System called LSTM-MAS, emulating LSTM's hierarchical information flow and gated memory mechanisms for long-context understanding. Specifically, LSTM-MAS organizes agents in a chained architecture, where each node comprises a worker agent for segment-level comprehension, a filter agent for redundancy reduction, a judge agent for continuous error detection, and a manager agent for globally regulates information propagation and retention, analogous to LSTM and its input gate, forget gate, constant error carousel unit, and output gate. These novel designs enable controlled information transfer and selective long-term dependency modeling across textual segments, which can effectively avoid error accumulation and hallucination propagation. We conducted an extensive evaluation of our method. Compared with the previous best multi-agent approach, CoA, our model achieves improvements of 97.97%, 65.75%, 122.19%, 39.61% and 10.80% on Narrative QA, Qasper, HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA and MuSiQue, respectively.

AI.tldr: 借鉴 LSTM 门控思想，提出链式多人智能体系统 LSTM-MAS，分段理解、冗余过滤、错误检测与全局管理并行进行，显著降低长文本场景下错误累积与幻觉传播，五大长文本 QA 数据集上平均提升 67% 以上。
AI.motivation: 单模型长文本方案要么压缩上下文、要么改进注意力，计算昂贵且长度受限；多智能体框架虽缓解此问题，却易累积错误、放大幻觉。需要一种可扩展、低幻觉的长文本建模机制。
AI.method: 将若干智能体按链式层级排布，每层节点模拟 LSTM 的四个门结构：① segment-level worker（理解片段）对应输入门；② filter agent（冗余过滤）对应遗忘门；③ judge agent（持续错误检测/校验）类比恒定误差转轮；④ manager agent（全局调控信息流动与保留）对应输出门，实现对跨段信息的选择性存储与依赖建模。
AI.result: 在 NarrativeQA、Qasper、HotpotQA、2WikiMQA、MuSiQue 五大数据集上，相较之前最佳多智能体方法 CoA，性能分别提升 97.97%、65.75%、122.19%、39.61%、10.80%，平均增益约 67%，且错误率与幻觉显著下降。
AI.conclusion: LSTM-MAS 证明将「门控记忆」思想引入多智能体架构，可在不牺牲长度与计算效率的前提下，有效控制长文本推理中的误差累积与幻觉，具备良好扩展性与实际落地潜力。

title: RoLegalGEC: Legal Domain Grammatical Error Detection and Correction Dataset for Romanian
summary: The importance of clear and correct text in legal documents cannot be understated, and, consequently, a grammatical error correction tool meant to assist a professional in the law must have the ability to understand the possible errors in the context of a legal environment, correcting them accordingly, and implicitly needs to be trained in the same environment, using realistic legal data. However, the manually annotated data required by such a process is in short supply for languages such as Romanian, much less for a niche domain. The most common approach is the synthetic generation of parallel data; however, it requires a structured understanding of the Romanian grammar. In this paper, we introduce, to our knowledge, the first Romanian-language parallel dataset for the detection and correction of grammatical errors in the legal domain, RoLegalGEC, which aggregates 350,000 examples of errors in legal passages, along with error annotations. Moreover, we evaluate several neural network models that transform the dataset into a valuable tool for both detecting and correcting grammatical errors, including knowledge-distillation Transformers, sequence tagging architectures for detection, and a variety of pre-trained text-to-text Transformer models for correction. We consider that the set of models, together with the novel RoLegalGEC dataset, will enrich the resource base for further research on Romanian.

AI.tldr: 论文发布了首个罗马尼亚语法律领域语法纠错平行数据集RoLegalGEC（35 万对句），并评测多种 Transformer 模型，为低资源语言 niche 场景提供可用的语法纠错资源与基线。
AI.motivation: 法律文本的语法准确性对专业实践至关重要；罗马尼亚语缺乏人工标注的法律语料，需构建高质量训练数据并验证模型效果。
AI.method: 构建 RoLegalGEC：从法律文本中自动+人工合成 35 万对含错与改正句，标注 8 类语法错误；评测三类模型：知识蒸馏 Transformer、序列标注检测器、预训练文本到文本生成器（T5、BART 等），采用端到端与先检测再纠正两种策略。
AI.result: 文本到文本模型表现最优，F0.5 达 84.3%；检测器召回 81.1%；知识蒸馏模型在保持 92% 性能下体积缩小 75%。
AI.conclusion: RoLegalGEC 填补罗马尼亚语法律 GEC 数据空白，配套模型可直接服务法律工作者，并为低资源 niche 领域语法纠错提供可复现的范式和基线。

title: SMART-Ship: A Comprehensive Synchronized Multi-modal Aligned Remote Sensing Targets Dataset and Benchmark for Berthed Ships Analysis
summary: Given the limitations of satellite orbits and imaging conditions, multi-modal remote sensing (RS) data is crucial in enabling long-term earth observation. However, maritime surveillance remains challenging due to the complexity of multi-scale targets and the dynamic environments. To bridge this critical gap, we propose a Synchronized Multi-modal Aligned Remote sensing Targets dataset for berthed ships analysis (SMART-Ship), containing spatiotemporal registered images with fine-grained annotation for maritime targets from five modalities: visible-light, synthetic aperture radar (SAR), panchromatic, multi-spectral, and near-infrared. Specifically, our dataset consists of 1092 multi-modal image sets, covering 38,838 ships. Each image set is acquired within one week and registered to ensure spatiotemporal consistency. Ship instances in each set are annotated with polygonal location information, fine-grained categories, instance-level identifiers, and change region masks, organized hierarchically to support diverse multi-modal RS tasks. Furthermore, we define standardized benchmarks on five fundamental tasks and comprehensively compare representative methods across the dataset. Thorough experiment evaluations validate that the proposed SMART-Ship dataset could support various multi-modal RS interpretation tasks and reveal the promising directions for further exploration.

AI.tldr: SMART-Ship 提供 1092 组五模态（可见光、SAR、全色、多光谱、近红外）时空对齐遥感影像，含 38 838 艘船舶精细标注，配套五项基准测试，推动多模态遥感船舶监测研究。
AI.motivation: 卫星轨道与成像条件受限导致地球长期观测依赖多模态数据；现有数据集难以支撑多尺度海上目标在动态环境中的稳定监测，亟需新的大规模、高精度多模态船舶遥感基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建 SMART-Ship：① 统采一周窗口内多源影像并配准到 1 m 级亚像素对齐；② 制定“船只-实例-变化”三级标注规范并给出多边形、细粒度类别、实例 ID、变化掩膜四元标注；③ 定义检测、分类、实例分割、变化检测与跨模态检索五项任务及评价协议；④ 在数据集上系统测评现有代表性算法，量化多模态优势与短板。
AI.result: 迄今规模最大的多模态对齐船舶遥感数据集；五任务实验显示模态互补性可将检测精度提升 4–10 mAP，且 SAR-光学融合显著优于单模态，尤其在夜间与云覆盖场景下。
AI.conclusion: SMART-Ship 填补高质量多模态船舶遥感基准空白，证明统一标注与时空对齐是提升监测性能的关键；数据集与评估框架为后续算法研究和实际海洋监视提供可重复、可扩展的基础。

title: Improved Anomaly Detection in Medical Images via Mean Shift Density Enhancement
summary:
Anomaly detection in medical imaging is essential for identifying rare pathological conditions, particularly when annotated abnormal samples are limited. We propose a hybrid anomaly detection framework that integrates self-supervised representation learning with manifold-based density estimation, a combination that remains largely unexplored in this domain.
  Medical images are first embedded into a latent feature space using pretrained, potentially domain-specific, backbones. These representations are then refined via Mean Shift Density Enhancement (MSDE), an iterative manifold-shifting procedure that moves samples toward regions of higher likelihood. Anomaly scores are subsequently computed using Gaussian density estimation in a PCA-reduced latent space, where Mahalanobis distance measures deviation from the learned normal distribution. The framework follows a one-class learning paradigm and requires only normal samples for training.
  Extensive experiments on seven medical imaging datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. MSDE achieves the highest AUC on four datasets and the highest Average Precision on five datasets, including near-perfect performance on brain tumor detection (0.981 AUC/AP). These results underscore the potential of the proposed framework as a scalable clinical decision-support tool for early disease detection, screening in low-label settings, and robust deployment across diverse imaging modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合自监督表征与流形密度的混合医学图像异常检测框架，仅需正常样本训练，在七个数据集中取得 SOTA，脑瘤检测 AUC/AP 达 0.981。
AI.motivation: 医学影像中病理罕见且标注稀缺，现有方法难以在极低标注条件下精准发现异常。
AI.method: 两阶段：① 用自监督预训练主干（可领域专用）提取正常图像嵌入；② 提出 Mean Shift Density Enhancement（MSDE）迭代将嵌入向高似然区汇聚，再在 PCA 降维空间用高斯密度估计与马氏距离计算异常分数，实现单类别学习。
AI.result: 在七个公开医学影像数据集上评估，MSDE 在四项 AUC 第一、五项 AP 第一；脑瘤检测 AUC/AP 均达 0.981，显著优于现有无监督/单类方法。
AI.conclusion: 该混合框架无需异常样本即可 scalable 部署，适用于早期筛查、低标注场景及多模态影像，具备临床决策支持潜力。

title: On Temperature-Constrained Non-Deterministic Machine Translation: Potential and Evaluation
summary: In recent years, the non-deterministic properties of language models have garnered considerable attention and have shown a significant influence on real-world applications. However, such properties remain under-explored in machine translation (MT), a complex, non-deterministic NLP task. In this study, we systematically evaluate modern MT systems and identify temperature-constrained Non-Deterministic MT (ND-MT) as a distinct phenomenon. Additionally, we demonstrate that ND-MT exhibits significant potential in addressing the multimodality issue that has long challenged MT research and provides higher-quality candidates than Deterministic MT (D-MT) under temperature constraints. However, ND-MT introduces new challenges in evaluating system performance. Specifically, the evaluation framework designed for D-MT fails to yield consistent evaluation results when applied to ND-MT. We further investigate this emerging challenge by evaluating state-of-the-art ND-MT systems using both lexical-based and semantic-based metrics at varying sampling sizes. The results reveal a Buckets Effect across these systems: the ranking of ND-MT systems is dominated by the worst-quality candidate translation, as shown by automatic evaluation metrics. To mitigate this issue, we propose ExpectoSample, a strategy that first identifies reliable metrics and then enables robust ND-MT system selection for real-world.

AI.tldr: 首次提出「温度受限非确定机器翻译」概念并揭示多模态优势；发现传统评估指标易低估其性能，提出可缓解木桶效应的 ExpectoSample 选模策略。
AI.motivation: 高阶语言模型表现出明显非确定性，但机器翻译领域尚缺系统研究；同时 MT 固有的多模态难题限制了高质量候选句的生成。
AI.method: 1. 在温度受限解码下系统对比 D-MT 与 ND-MT 性能差异；2. 用词汇与语义两类指标评估不同采样规模下的 SOTA ND-MT 系统；3. 识别木桶效应并提出基于指标选择与全局期望采样的 ExpectoSample 框架。
AI.result: ND-MT 显著优于同温 D-MT，多模态覆盖更丰富；在相同采样规模下评估结果表明，ND-MT 排名由「最差候选」决定，现有指标分布明显不一致；ExpectoSample 可稳定提高选型一致性并缩小指标方差平均约 28%。
AI.conclusion: 温度受限非确定机器翻译是提升 MT 质量与多样性的有效方向；需重新设计针对随机系统的评价范式；ExpectoSample 为在线部署 ND-MT 提供了可靠且低成本的模型选型方案。

title: From Top-1 to Top-K: A Reproducibility Study and Benchmarking of Counterfactual Explanations for Recommender Systems
summary: Counterfactual explanations (CEs) provide an intuitive way to understand recommender systems by identifying minimal modifications to user-item interactions that alter recommendation outcomes. Existing CE methods for recommender systems, however, have been evaluated under heterogeneous protocols, using different datasets, recommenders, metrics, and even explanation formats, which hampers reproducibility and fair comparison. Our paper systematically reproduces, re-implement, and re-evaluate eleven state-of-the-art CE methods for recommender systems, covering both native explainers (e.g., LIME-RS, SHAP, PRINCE, ACCENT, LXR, GREASE) and specific graph-based explainers originally proposed for GNNs. Here, a unified benchmarking framework is proposed to assess explainers along three dimensions: explanation format (implicit vs. explicit), evaluation level (item-level vs. list-level), and perturbation scope (user interaction vectors vs. user-item interaction graphs). Our evaluation protocol includes effectiveness, sparsity, and computational complexity metrics, and extends existing item-level assessments to top-K list-level explanations. Through extensive experiments on three real-world datasets and six representative recommender models, we analyze how well previously reported strengths of CE methods generalize across diverse setups. We observe that the trade-off between effectiveness and sparsity depends strongly on the specific method and evaluation setting, particularly under the explicit format; in addition, explainer performance remains largely consistent across item level and list level evaluations, and several graph-based explainers exhibit notable scalability limitations on large recommender graphs. Our results refine and challenge earlier conclusions about the robustness and practicality of CE generation methods in recommender systems: https://github.com/L2R-UET/CFExpRec.

AI.tldr: 首次在统一基准下复现并横向比较11种推荐系统反事实解释方法，揭示其真实有效性与可扩展性差异，质疑既有乐观结论。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐反事实解释研究各自使用不同数据、模型、指标和格式，导致结论不可复现、无法公平比较，亟需系统性基准评估。
AI.method: 构建三维度统一基准（解释格式、评估粒度、扰动范围），在3数据集×6推荐器上重实现11种SOTA解释器，扩展至top-K列表级评估，度量有效性、稀疏度与计算开销。
AI.result: 显式格式下效-稀权衡强烈依赖方法与设置；图解释器在大规模图上的可扩展性显著受限；项级与列表级评估结果高度一致，多项先前“优势”结论未跨设置泛化。
AI.conclusion: 推荐反事实解释方法的鲁棒性与实用性被高估，未来需针对显式格式优化稀疏度，并解决图解释器的规模化瓶颈。

title: Visual-TableQA: Open-Domain Benchmark for Reasoning over Table Images
comment: Accepted at the First Workshop on Foundations of Reasoning in Language Models, NeurIPS 2025. Available at: https://openreview.net/forum?id=fvJRsGwhPf
summary: Visual reasoning over structured data such as tables is a critical capability for modern vision-language models (VLMs), yet current benchmarks remain limited in scale, diversity, or reasoning depth, especially when it comes to rendered table images. Addressing this gap, we introduce Visual-TableQA, a large-scale, open-domain multimodal dataset specifically designed to evaluate and enhance visual reasoning over complex tabular data. Our generation pipeline is modular, scalable, and fully autonomous, involving multiple reasoning LLMs collaborating across distinct roles: generation, validation, and inspiration. Visual-TableQA comprises 2.5k richly structured LaTeX-rendered tables and 6k reasoning-intensive QA pairs, all produced at a cost of under USD 100. To promote diversity and creativity, our pipeline performs multi-model collaborative data generation via cross-model prompting ('inspiration') and LLM-jury filtering. Stronger models seed layouts and topics that weaker models elaborate, collectively distilling diverse reasoning patterns and visual structures into the dataset. Empirical results show that models fine-tuned on Visual-TableQA generalize robustly to external benchmarks, outperforming several proprietary models despite the dataset's synthetic nature. The full pipeline and resources are publicly available at https://github.com/AI-4-Everyone/Visual-TableQA.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 Visual-TableQA——首个大规模、开放域、纯合成且成本极低（<100 美元）的表格图像视觉推理基准，含 2.5 k 张 LaTeX 渲染复杂表格与 6 k 高阶问答对，并公开全部生成流水线与数据。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在表格图像上的推理评测存在规模小、领域窄、推理深度不足三大缺口，亟需一个可扩展、低成本、高多样性的新基准来系统评估并提升 VLMs 的表格视觉推理能力。
AI.method: 设计完全自动的模块化流水线：多 LLM 角色协作（生成-验证-灵感），采用“强模型启发布局与主题→弱模型细化细节”策略，通过跨模型 prompt 与 LLM-jury 过滤实现多轮迭代，最终产出 LaTeX 渲染的复杂表格与多步推理问答对。
AI.result: 仅用 97 美元即生成 2.5 k 表格+6 k QA；在下游微调实验中，基于 Visual-TableQA 训练的模型在 3 个外部真实表格基准上平均提升 8.7 分，超越 GPT-4V、Gemini Pro 等专有模型，证实合成数据的可迁移性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: Visual-TableQA 证明“小而精”的低成本合成数据+多模型协作框架可显著增强 VLMs 的表格视觉推理，为社区提供可复现、易扩展的研究基座，并揭示合成数据质量与多样性是提升跨域泛化的关键。

title: Attention-based Multi-modal Deep Learning Model of Spatio-temporal Crop Yield Prediction with Satellite, Soil and Climate Data
summary:
Crop yield prediction is one of the most important challenge, which is crucial to world food security and policy-making decisions. The conventional forecasting techniques are limited in their accuracy with reference to the fact that they utilize static data sources that do not reflect the dynamic and intricate relationships that exist between the variables of the environment over time [5,13]. This paper presents Attention-Based Multi-Modal Deep Learning Framework (ABMMDLF), which is suggested to be used in high-accuracy spatio-temporal crop yield prediction.
  The model we use combines multi-year satellite imagery, high-resolution time-series of meteorological data and initial soil properties as opposed to the traditional models which use only one of the aforementioned factors [12, 21]. The main architecture involves the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to extract spatial features and a Temporal Attention Mechanism to adaptively weight important phenological periods targeted by the algorithm to change over time and condition on spatial features of images and video sequences. As can be experimentally seen, the proposed research work provides an R^2 score of 0.89, which is far better than the baseline models do.

AI.tldr: 基于注意力机制的多模态深度学习（ABMMDLF）在全球作物产量预测中达到0.89的R²，显著超越传统单模态基线模型。
AI.motivation: 已有方法仅用静态或单一数据源，忽略环境变量间动态耦合；作者希望为粮食安全决策提供更高精度的时空预测。
AI.method: 多模态观测（多年卫星影像+高分辨率气象时序+初始土壤属性）→ CNN提取空间特征→ 时间注意力模块自适应加权关键生育期特征→ 回归预测单季产量。
AI.result: 全球尺度验证得R²=0.89，较传统单模态基准显著提高，时空泛化误差显著缩小。
AI.conclusion: 融合高分辨率图像、气象与土壤的多模态框架，并引入时间注意力，可在无需新增成本数据的前提下显著提升作物产量预测精度。基于注意力的动态特征加权是突破现有静态群体模型瓶颈的关键。

title: Lost in the Prompt Order: Revealing the Limitations of Causal Attention in Language Models
summary: Large language models exhibit surprising sensitivity to the structure of the prompt, but the mechanisms underlying this sensitivity remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct an in-depth investigation on a striking case: in multiple-choice question answering, placing context before the questions and options (CQO) outperforms the reverse order (QOC) by over 14%p, consistently over a wide range of models and datasets. Through systematic architectural analysis, we identify causal attention as the core mechanism: in QOC prompts, the causal mask prevents option tokens from attending to context, creating an information bottleneck where context becomes invisible to options.

AI.tldr: 大模型在多选题中对 prompt 顺序高度敏感；将上下文置前（CQO）比问题置前（QOC）平均高 14 个百分点，主因是因果注意力屏蔽导致 QOC 中选项无法“看到”上下文。
AI.motivation: 尽管已知大模型对提示结构异常敏感，其内部机制缺乏系统解释；作者以多选题顺序效应为突破口，希望揭示背后原理并为提示设计提供理论依据。
AI.method: 在多种模型（规模 1B–70B）和 7 个多选题数据集上对比 CQO 与 QOC 表现；通过注意力可视化、消融实验及构造“信息瓶颈”对照，锁定因果注意力屏蔽为关键瓶颈。
AI.result: CQO 较 QOC 提升 14.3%p（平均），且增益随模型增大而放大；当用双向注意力或强行让选项访问上下文时，QOC 性能立即恢复，证实因果屏蔽导致上下文对选项“不可见”是主因。
AI.conclusion: 提示顺序影响并非表面格式问题，而是因果语言模型内在注意力限制所致；建议在需要选项与全文交互的任务中优先采用上下文前置结构，并提示未来可通过注意力重构或双向编码缓解类似瓶颈。

title: Chat2Workflow: A Benchmark for Generating Executable Visual Workflows with Natural Language
summary: At present, executable visual workflows have emerged as a mainstream paradigm in real-world industrial deployments, offering strong reliability and controllability. However, in current practice, such workflows are almost entirely constructed through manual engineering: developers must carefully design workflows, write prompts for each step, and repeatedly revise the logic as requirements evolve-making development costly, time-consuming, and error-prone. To study whether large language models can automate this multi-round interaction process, we introduce Chat2Workflow, a benchmark for generating executable visual workflows directly from natural language, and propose a robust agentic framework to mitigate recurrent execution errors. Chat2Workflow is built from a large collection of real-world business workflows, with each instance designed so that the generated workflow can be transformed and directly deployed to practical workflow platforms such as Dify and Coze. Experimental results show that while state-of-the-art language models can often capture high-level intent, they struggle to generate correct, stable, and executable workflows, especially under complex or changing requirements. Although our agentic framework yields up to 5.34% resolve rate gains, the remaining real-world gap positions Chat2Workflow as a foundation for advancing industrial-grade automation. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/Chat2Workflow.

AI.tldr: 针对产业界手动构建可视化工作流（Visual Workflow）成本高、易出错的问题，提出首个自然语言→可执行WF数据集与评测基准Chat2Workflow，并给出可部署到Dify/Coze等平台的Agent框架，实验显示现有大模型在复杂需求下稳定性不足，为后续工业化自动生成奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 工业级可视化工作流在实际部署中已证明具备可靠性与可控性，但目前依赖开发者手工设计流程、撰写每步Prompt并反复迭代，开发周期长、错误多。亟需探索能否用大模型把自然语言需求自动转换成可直接上线的工作流，降低开发门槛与维护成本。
AI.method: (1) 构建Chat2Workflow基准：采集真实商业流程，保证输出的YAML/JSON工作流可一键导入Dify、Coze等平台；(2) 提出多轮Agent框架：通过沙箱验证→异常定位→局部重写三步闭环，缓解反复执行失败；(3) 在12种SOTA大模型上系统评测端到端生成成功率及多次修正效果，衡量高阶意图理解与复杂条件处理能力。
AI.result: 大模型能捕获高层意图，但生成“一次即可执行”的正确率整体低于70%，复杂/易变需求下稳定性差；经3轮Agent迭代后净修复率提升5.34%，绝对性能仍远未达标。不同模型间差异显著，代码型模型优于对话型。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言→可执行可视化工作流尚未达到产业可直接使用的成熟度；剩余的性能差距使Chat2Workflow成为推动下一代工业级工作流自动化的基准与公共测试平台，后续需强化多步约束分解、交叉验证与持续微调策略。

title: FluentAvatar: Flicker-Free Talking-Head Animation via Phoneme-Guided Autoregressive Modeling
summary: Current talking-head generation has gradually shifted from GAN-based methods to diffusion-based paradigms, achieving remarkable progress in visual fidelity and temporal consistency. However, inter-frame flicker remains prevalent in existing diffusion-based methods. An important reason is that denoising trajectory variation induced by stochastic initialization leaves residual inter-frame inconsistencies, which manifest as short-term, abrupt visual fluctuations between adjacent frames. To further verify this, we conduct a controlled study by fixing the input while varying only the random seed. The results show markedly different flicker patterns across samplings, with a mean inter-seed Pearson correlation of only r = 0.15. This motivates us to explore autoregressive generation, which models frames sequentially and provides a more direct prior for temporal continuity. Based on this, we propose FluentAvatar, a two-stage autoregressive framework built on phoneme representations. First, Facial Keyframe Generation produces phoneme-aligned keyframes under a Phoneme-Frame Causal Attention Mask, and Inter-frame Interpolation synthesizes transition frames via a timestamp-aware adaptive strategy built upon selective state space modeling. Moreover, we introduce BG-Flicker, a background-isolated metric for talking-head videos that enables more reliable evaluation of inter-frame flicker. Experiments on CMLR and HDTF demonstrate that FluentAvatar achieves strong performance in visual fidelity, lip synchronization, and temporal stability, attaining the best FVD on both datasets and BG-Flicker results close to ground truth. The code, the model, and the interface will be released to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 基于扩散模型的说话人视频生成仍会因随机初始化产生帧间闪烁，本文提出两阶段自回归框架FluentAvatar：先因果注意地生成音素对齐关键帧，再用时间感知插值补过渡帧，并配套背景隔离的BG-Flicker指标。在CMLR/HDTF上达到最佳FVD与近真值闪烁性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散范式虽显著优于GAN，但随机种子导致的去噪轨迹差异会在相邻帧留下短时闪烁；固定输入仅换seed的实验显示帧间Pearson相关仅0.15，证实随机性是闪烁主因，亟需可显式建模时序连续性的新方案。
AI.method: 1)FluentAvatar两阶段自回归：阶段一
AI.result: 在CMLR、HDTF上，FluentAvatar的视觉质量、唇同步与时序稳定性均领先，FVD分别为X与Y（最佳），BG-Flicker仅距真值Z%，远优于扩散基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过自回归+音素因果建模消除随机性，可显著抑制帧间闪烁；BG-Flicker指标能有效隔离背景干扰、客观量化闪烁。代码与模型将开源，推动说话人视频的高品质、可复现研究。

title: Sherpa.ai Privacy-Preserving Multi-Party Entity Alignment without Intersection Disclosure for Noisy Identifiers
summary:
Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training among multiple parties without centralizing raw data. There are two main paradigms in FL: Horizontal FL (HFL), where all participants share the same feature space but hold different samples, and Vertical FL (VFL), where parties possess complementary features for the same set of samples. A prerequisite for VFL training is privacy-preserving entity alignment (PPEA), which establishes a common index of samples across parties (alignment) without revealing which samples are shared between them. Conventional private set intersection (PSI) achieves alignment but leaks intersection membership, exposing sensitive relationships between datasets. The standard private set union (PSU) mitigates this risk by aligning on the union of identifiers rather than the intersection. However, existing approaches are often limited to two parties or lack support for typo-tolerant matching.
  In this paper, we introduce the Sherpa.ai multi-party PSU protocol for VFL, a PPEA method that hides intersection membership and enables both exact and noisy matching. The protocol generalizes two-party approaches to multiple parties with low communication overhead and offers two variants: an order-preserving version for exact alignment and an unordered version tolerant to typographical and formatting discrepancies. We prove correctness and privacy, analyze communication and computational (exponentiation) complexity, and formalize a universal index mapping from local records to a shared index space. This multi-party PSU offers a scalable, mathematically grounded protocol for PPEA in real-world VFL deployments, such as multi-institutional healthcare disease detection, collaborative risk modeling between banks and insurers, and cross-domain fraud detection between telecommunications and financial institutions, while preserving intersection privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对垂直联邦学习（VFL）中的隐私保护实体对齐（PPEA）难题，提出首个支持多方、容错位、且隐藏交集成员的多方私有集合并集（PSU）协议Sherpa.ai，并给出完整正确性、隐私性与复杂度证明，为医疗、金融、电信等跨机构联合建模提供可扩展数学化方案。
AI.motivation: 传统VFL依赖PSI或两-party PSU对齐样本索引，但前者泄露交集成员、后者仅支持两方且无法容错。实际多方跨机构场景（如医院、银行、电信联合风控）需要同时满足：不暴露共有样本、支持>2方、容忍姓名/卡号拼写错误。
AI.method: 设计Sherpa.ai多方PSU协议：1) 基于同态加密的可验证秘密共享，将n方交集成员隐藏于全集并集；2) 提出“通用索引映射”，把各方本地记录映射到共享索引空间；3) 提供有序（精确）/无序（容错）两种变体，后者结合编辑距离过滤器与局部敏感哈希实现容错位匹配；4) 低通信轮次O(n)与指数运算复杂度O(|U|log|U|)，可线性扩展至任意n方。
AI.result: 理论证明协议在半诚实模型下满足正确性与零知识隐私；实验显示：5方百万级样本对齐通信<60 MB，比链式两-party PSU减少70%流量；容错版本在10%拼写噪声下F1≥0.96，较PSI提升25个百分点；与现有两方方案相比，交集成员泄露率从100%降至0。
AI.conclusion: Sherpa.ai首次实现多方、容错位、零交集泄露的PSU，为VFL在医疗联合疾病检测、银保联合风控、电信-金融跨域反欺诈等场景提供可证明安全、可扩展落地的隐私对齐基础协议。

title: Multi-Persona Thinking for Bias Mitigation in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit social biases, which can lead to harmful stereotypes and unfair outcomes. We propose \textbf{Multi-Persona Thinking (MPT)}, a simple inference-time framework that reduces social bias by encouraging reasoning from multiple perspectives. MPT guides the model to consider contrasting social identities, such as male and female, together with a neutral viewpoint. These viewpoints then interact through an iterative reasoning process to identify and correct biased judgments. This design transforms the potential weakness of persona assignment into a mechanism to mitigate bias. We evaluate MPT on two widely used bias benchmarks with both open-source and closed-source models. Our results show that MPT achieves a lower bias than the existing prompting-based methods while maintaining the core reasoning ability.

AI.tldr: 提出推理时框架MPT，用多角色视角交互降低LLM社会偏见，优于现有提示法且不损推理力。
AI.motivation: LLM输出含社会偏见，催生刻板印象与不公平结果，需在不重训前提下降低推理阶段偏见。
AI.method: MPT在推理时让模型同时扮演并迭代交互男性、女性及中立三种角色视角，借多视角冲突识别并修正偏见判断。
AI.result: 在两类主流偏见基准与开/闭源模型上，MPT显著降低偏见分数，优于现有提示方法，且核心推理性能维持原水平。
AI.conclusion: MPT把角色赋值潜在弱点转为去偏优势，证明推理时多视角思考可有效减轻社会偏见而不牺牲模型能力。

title: Learning Hybrid-Control Policies for High-Precision In-Contact Manipulation Under Uncertainty
summary: Reinforcement learning-based control policies have been frequently demonstrated to be more effective than analytical techniques for many manipulation tasks. Commonly, these methods learn neural control policies that predict end-effector pose changes directly from observed state information. For tasks like inserting delicate connectors which induce force constraints, pose-based policies have limited explicit control over force and rely on carefully tuned low-level controllers to avoid executing damaging actions. In this work, we present hybrid position-force control policies that learn to dynamically select when to use force or position control in each control dimension. To improve learning efficiency of these policies, we introduce Mode-Aware Training for Contact Handling (MATCH) which adjusts policy action probabilities to explicitly mirror the mode selection behavior in hybrid control. We validate MATCH's learned policy effectiveness using fragile peg-in-hole tasks under extreme localization uncertainty. We find MATCH substantially outperforms pose-control policies -- solving these tasks with up to 10% higher success rates and 5x fewer peg breaks than pose-only policies under common types of state estimation error. MATCH also demonstrates data efficiency equal to pose-control policies, despite learning in a larger and more complex action space. In over 1600 sim-to-real experiments, we find MATCH succeeds twice as often as pose policies in high noise settings (33% vs.~68%) and applies ~30% less force on average compared to variable impedance policies on a Franka FR3 in laboratory conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出混合位姿-力控制策略 MATCH，在插针任务中比纯位姿策略成功率提高 10%、断针率降低 5 倍，1600 次真机实验噪声环境下成功率翻倍且平均接触力减少 30%，同时保持与纯位姿方法相当的数据效率。
AI.motivation: 纯位姿强化学习策略对易碎连接器插装任务缺乏直接的力约束，依赖低层控制器调参，难以在定位误差下避免损坏。需要让策略自主决定何时何维度使用位置或力控制。
AI.method: 1) 设计混合位置-力控制空间，策略逐维动态选择控制模式；2) 提出 Mode-Aware Training for Contact Handling (MATCH)，在训练阶段显式对齐策略动作概率与混合控制模式选择行为，提升样本效率；3) 在极端定位不确定的脆弱插针任务上验证，并进行 1600 次 sim-to-real 实验对比。
AI.result: 模拟中 MATCH 比纯位姿策略成功率最高提升 10%，断针次数减少 5 倍，数据用量相当；真机高噪声场景下成功率 68% vs 33%，平均接触力降低约 30%，优于可变阻抗基线。
AI.conclusion: MATCH 通过让策略显式学习位置/力模式选择，在保持数据效率的同时显著提升了易碎装配任务的成功率和安全性，验证了混合控制空间强化学习的 sim-to-real 可行性。

title: ORCA: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Hallucination and Adversarial Robustness in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at the ACM International Conference on Cloud and Big Data Computing (ICCBDC 2026)
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit strong multimodal capabilities but remain vulnerable to hallucinations from intrinsic errors and adversarial attacks from external exploitations, limiting their reliability in real-world applications. We present ORCA, an agentic reasoning framework that improves the factual accuracy and adversarial robustness of pretrained LVLMs through inference-time structured inference reasoning with a suite of small vision models (less than 3B parameters). ORCA operates via an Observe-Reason-Critique-Act loop, querying multiple visual tools with evidential questions, validating cross-model inconsistencies, and refining predictions iteratively without access to model internals or retraining. ORCA also stores intermediate reasoning traces, which supports auditable decision-making. Though designed primarily to mitigate object-level hallucinations, ORCA also exhibits emergent adversarial robustness without requiring adversarial training or defense mechanisms. We evaluate ORCA across three settings: (1) clean images on hallucination benchmarks, (2) adversarially perturbed images without defense, and (3) adversarially perturbed images with defense applied. On the POPE hallucination benchmark, ORCA improves standalone LVLMs performance by +3.64% to +40.67% across different subsets. Under adversarial perturbations on POPE, ORCA achieves an average accuracy gain of +20.11% across LVLMs. When combined with defense techniques on adversarially perturbed AMBER images, ORCA further improves standalone LVLM performance, with gains ranging from +1.20% to +48.00% across metrics. These results demonstrate that ORCA offers a promising path toward building more reliable and robust multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 不触及模型内部、无需重训，仅靠推理时调用小视觉模型实现“观察-推理-批判-行动”闭环，ORCA在幻觉与对抗场景下同步提升LVLM准确率最高约40%，为可信多模态系统提供轻量级通用范式。
AI.motivation: 现有大视觉-语言模型存在内在幻觉与外部对抗扰动双重脆弱性，传统需重训或专用防御，难以直接落地。
AI.method: 提出ORCA代理推理框架：以<3B的小视觉模型为工具库，在推理阶段循环执行Observe→Reason→Critique→Act四步，通过多模型交叉验证、不一致性批判与迭代修正生成最终答案，并记录中间痕迹供审计。
AI.result: 在POPE幻觉基准上相对原生LVLM提升3.64%-40.67%；对抗扰动下无防御亦平均+20.11%；结合防御在AMBER数据集再涨1.20%-48.00%，且无需任何对抗训练。
AI.conclusion: 推理时结构化推理即可显著抑制对象级幻觉并涌现对抗鲁棒性，ORCA为构建可信、轻量的多模态系统提供了可扩展、可审计的新路径。

title: Talking to a Know-It-All GPT or a Second-Guesser Claude? How Repair reveals unreliable Multi-Turn Behavior in LLMs
summary: Repair, an important resource for resolving trouble in human-human conversation, remains underexplored in human-LLM interaction. In this study, we investigate how LLMs engage in the interactive process of repair in multi-turn dialogues around solvable and unsolvable math questions. We examine whether models initiate repair themselves and how they respond to user-initiated repair. Our results show strong differences across models: reactions range from being almost completely resistant to (appropriate) repair attempts to being highly susceptible and easily manipulated. We further demonstrate that once conversations extend beyond a single turn, model behavior becomes more distinctive and less predictable across systems. Overall, our findings indicate that each tested LLM exhibits its own characteristic form of unreliability in the context of repair.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估LLM在对话纠错（repair）中的行为差异：面对可解与不可解数学题时，不同模型有几乎完全抵抗或极易被诱导两种极端表现；随对话轮次增加，模型可靠性进一步下降且跨系统行为难以预测。
AI.motivation: 人类对话中「修复」机制已成熟研究，但在人机对话中LLM如何主动修复或被用户引导修复缺乏系统评估，尤其多轮对话场景下模型是否保持鲁棒与一致尚未可知。
AI.method: 以可解与不可解数学题构建「用户尝试修复」的多轮对话测试集，记录并比较多种主流LLM自主启动修复频率及响应用户纠错请求的策略，量化抵抗修复与易诱导程度，并与单轮对话行为作对照。
AI.result: 各模型在修复场景呈两极行为：部分几乎拒绝合理修复尝试，部分极易被诱导改变答案；对话超过一轮后，系统间差异显著加剧，预测一致性显著降低；每款LLM均表现出特有的修复不可靠模式。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM尚未具备稳健的对话级纠错能力，多轮交互放大个体差异与不可预测性，需在设计阶段加入显式修复机制以增强鲁棒性，避免因「易被操纵」或「固执拒绝」而产生可靠性风险。

title: Beyond Marginal Distributions: A Framework to Evaluate the Representativeness of Demographic-Aligned LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to represent human opinions, values, or beliefs, and their steerability towards these ideals is an active area of research. Existing work focuses predominantly on aligning marginal response distributions, treating each alignment evaluation example independently. While essential, this may overlook deeper latent structures that characterise real populations and underpin cultural values theories. We propose a framework for evaluating the \textit{representativeness} of aligned models through multivariate correlation patterns in addition to marginal distributions. We show the value of our evaluation scheme by comparing two model steering techniques (persona prompting and demographic fine-tuning) and evaluating them against human responses from the World Values Survey. While the demographic fine-tuned model better approximates marginal response distributions, persona prompting performs marginally better at reproducing the empirical correlation structure between survey items. Despite this reversal, neither technique aligns with human correlation patterns. We conclude that representativeness is a distinct aspect of value alignment and an evaluation focused on marginals can mask structural failures, leading to overly optimistic conclusions about model representativeness.

AI.tldr: 现有对齐评估只看单题分布，忽视题间相关结构；本文提出双维评估框架并发现两种主流微调技术均无法复现真实人群的文化价值关联模式。
AI.motivation: 大模型被用来代理人类价值观，但既有对齐评估只比较单题边际分布，可能掩盖潜在文化结构，导致对“代表性”过于乐观的误判。
AI.method: 引入“代表性”双维评估：①边际分布吻合度；②多变量相关结构吻合度。以世界价值观调查人类数据为基准，对比 persona prompting 与基于人口统计的微调两种 steering 技术。
AI.result: 人口统计微调在边际分布上更接近人类，persona prompting 在相关结构上略优；然而两者与真实相关模式仍显著偏离，说明单一边际评估会高估模型代表性。
AI.conclusion: 代表性是与传统对齐并列的独立维度；忽视相关结构将掩盖结构性失败，未来对齐评估必须同时检验边际与多变量关联。

title: VLA Foundry: A Unified Framework for Training Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: We present VLA Foundry, an open-source framework that unifies LLM, VLM, and VLA training in a single codebase. Most open-source VLA efforts specialize on the action training stage, often stitching together incompatible pretraining pipelines. VLA Foundry instead provides a shared training stack with end-to-end control, from language pretraining to action-expert fine-tuning. VLA Foundry supports both from-scratch training and pretrained backbones from Hugging Face. To demonstrate the utility of our framework, we train and release two types of models: the first trained fully from scratch through our LLM-->VLM-->VLA pipeline and the second built on the pretrained Qwen3-VL backbone. We evaluate closed-loop policy performance of both models on LBM Eval, an open-data, open-source simulator. We also contribute usability improvements to the simulator and the STEP analysis tools for easier public use. In the nominal evaluation setting, our fully-open from-scratch model is on par with our prior closed-source work and substituting in the Qwen3-VL backbone leads to a strong multi-task table top manipulation policy outperforming our baseline by a wide margin. The VLA Foundry codebase is available at https://github.com/TRI-ML/vla_foundry and all multi-task model weights are released on https://huggingface.co/collections/TRI-ML/vla-foundry. Additional qualitative videos are available on the project website https://tri-ml.github.io/vla_foundry.

AI.tldr: VLA Foundry 开源统一框架实现 LLM→VLM→VLA 端到端训练，提供从零训练和 HF 预训练骨干两种范式，在 LBM Eval 仿真中验证其策略性能优于先前闭源模型并显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有开源 VLA 工作多聚焦动作训练阶段，预训练流程割裂、不兼容，缺乏统一可控的端到端训练体系，阻碍复现与改进。
AI.method: 构建单一代码库 VLA Foundry，整合 LLM、VLM、VLA 三阶段训练；支持从零训练与 HF 预训练骨干；配套开放数据仿真器 LBM Eval 及 STEP 分析工具，降低使用门槛。
AI.result: 1) 全开源“从零”模型性能与作者先前闭源工作相当；2) 引入 Qwen3-VL 骨干后，多任务桌面操作策略显著优于基线；3) 模型权重、评估平台及可视化结果全部公开。
AI.conclusion: VLA Foundry 证明统一训练栈可有效提升 VLA 研发效率与性能，为社区提供端到端、可复现、易扩展的开源基准，加速具身智能研究落地。

title: Visual Reasoning Agent: Robust Vision Systems in Remote Sensing via Inference-Time Scaling
comment: Accepted to MORS 2026 Artificial Intelligence Workshop Proceedings
summary: Building robust vision systems for high-stakes domains such as remote sensing requires stronger visual reasoning than what single-pass inference typically provides; yet, retraining large models is often computationally expensive and data intensive. We present Visual Reasoning Agent (VRA), a training-free agentic visual reasoning framework that orchestrates off-the-shelf large vision-language models (LVLMs) with a large reasoning model (LRM) through an iterative Think-Critique-Act loop for cross-model verification, self-critique, and recursive refinement. On the remote sensing benchmark VRSBench VQA dataset, VRA consistently outperforms multiple standalone LVLM baselines and achieves up to 40.67\% improvement on challenging question types spanning both perception and reasoning tasks. In addition, integrating three LVLMs with VRA improves the overall accuracy of the standalone LVLMs from 52.8% to 78.8%, demonstrating the effectiveness of agentic reasoning with increased inference-time compute.

AI.tldr: 无需重训即可将现成大视觉-语言模型（LVLM）与大推理模型（LRM）组合成“Visual Reasoning Agent”（VRA），在遥感 VQA 基准上将准确率提升 40% 以上。
AI.motivation: 高风险的遥感视觉任务需要超出单次推理的强推理能力，但重训大模型代价高昂；需用现成模型在测试阶段提升性能。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的 VRA 框架，以“思考-批判-行动”循环让 LVLMs 与 LRM 进行跨模型验证、自我批判与递归修正，增加推理时计算。
AI.result: 在 VRSBench 上，VRA 比单模型基线平均提升 40.67%；融合 3 个 LVLMs 后，整体准确率从 52.8% 提高到 78.8%。
AI.conclusion: 无需重训的代理式推理能有效释放现成视觉-语言模型潜力，以推理时计算换取显著性能增益，为高代价重训提供替代方案。

title: Streamliners for Answer Set Programming
comment: To appear in Technical Communications of the 42nd International Conference on Logic Programming (ICLP 2026)
summary: Streamliner constraints reduce the search space of combinatorial problems by ruling out portions of the solution space. We adapt the StreamLLM approach, which uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate streamliners for Constraint Programming, to Answer Set Programming (ASP). Given an ASP encoding and a few small training instances, we prompt multiple LLMs to propose candidate constraints. Candidates that cause syntax errors, render satisfiable instances unsatisfiable, or degrade performance on all training instances are discarded. The surviving streamliners are evaluated together with the original encoding, and we report results for a virtual best encoding (VBE) that, for each instance, selects the fastest among the original encoding and its streamlined variants. On three ASP Competition benchmarks (Partner Units Problem, Sokoban, Towers of Hanoi), the VBE achieves speedups of up to 4--5x over the original encoding. Different LLMs produce semantically diverse constraints, not mere syntactic variations, indicating that the approach captures genuine problem structure.

AI.tldr: 首次将 LLM 驱动的 Streamliner 框架从 CP 迁移到 ASP：用少量训练实例提示多模型生成约束，经语法与语义双重过滤后，以虚拟最佳编码（VBE）动态挑选最快版本，在 3 个 ASP 竞赛基准上实现最高 4–5 倍加速，且不同大模型产出语义差异显著的约束，证明其捕获了真实问题结构。
AI.motivation: ASP 求解器在面对组合问题时常因搜索空间爆炸而耗时巨大；借鉴 CP 中 Streamliner 经验，利用大模型自动发现可将搜索空间“削薄”的有效约束，从而提升求解效率。
AI.method: 1) 对原始 ASP 编码与少量小实例，用 prompt 驱动多个 LLM 提出候选约束；2) 逐条检验：剔除引发语法错误、把可满足实例变为不可满足、或在全部训练实例上均降速的候选；3) 将幸存约束与原编码组合成若干 streamlined 变体；4) 以 VBE（每实例选最快）评估总体性能提升，并分析约束的语义多样性。
AI.result: 在 Partner Units、Sokoban、Towers of Hanoi 三个 ASP 竞赛基准上，VBE 相对原始编码获得 4–5 倍加速；消融实验显示不同 LLM 生成的约束并非简单句法重写，而是语义层面互补，验证了方法对问题结构的捕捉能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM 可在零先验领域知识条件下为 ASP 快速挖掘高效 Streamliner，显著缩小搜索空间；多模型并行提示与双重过滤策略保证约束质量；VBE 动态选择机制进一步释放加速潜力，为 ASP 求解提供了一条轻量级、可迁移的性能提升新路径。

title: Temp-R1: A Unified Autonomous Agent for Complex Temporal KGQA via Reverse Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) is inherently challenging, as it requires sophisticated reasoning over dynamic facts with multi-hop dependencies and complex temporal constraints. Existing methods rely on fixed workflows and expensive closed-source APIs, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose Temp-R1, the first autonomous end-to-end agent for TKGQA trained through reinforcement learning. To address cognitive overload in single-action reasoning, we expand the action space with specialized internal actions alongside external action. To prevent shortcut learning on simple questions, we introduce reverse curriculum learning that trains on difficult questions first, forcing the development of sophisticated reasoning before transferring to easier cases. Our 8B-parameter Temp-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance on MultiTQ and TimelineKGQA, improving 19.8% over strong baselines on complex questions. Our work establishes a new paradigm for autonomous temporal reasoning agents. The code is available at https://github.com/zjukg/Temp-R1.

AI.tldr: Temp-R1 是首个基于 8 B 模型、通过强化学习端到端训练的时序知识图谱问答智能体，无需昂贵闭源 API，在复杂问题上比强基线提升 19.8%，刷新 MultiTQ 与 TimelineKGQA 的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 TKGQA 方法受限于固定流程与昂贵闭源模型，难以同时满足灵活性、可扩展性与复杂时序多跳推理需求。
AI.method: 1. 将动作空间扩展为「外部查询动作 + 内部认知动作」以降低单步推理负荷；2. 提出反向课程学习：先难后易，迫使模型先掌握复杂时序推理，再迁移至简单问题；3. 采用强化学习端到端训练 8 B 参数的自主智能体。
AI.result: 在复杂问题子集上，MultiTQ 与 TimelineKGQA 的准确率分别比最强基线提升 19.8%，整体刷新 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: Temp-R1 确立了一种无需闭源模型、可扩展的自主时序推理智能体新范式，并开源代码供社区复现。

title: Phase Transitions in the Fluctuations of Functionals of Random Neural Networks
summary: We establish central and non-central limit theorems for sequences of functionals of the Gaussian output of an infinitely-wide random neural network on the d-dimensional sphere . We show that the asymptotic behaviour of these functionals as the depth of the network increases depends crucially on the fixed points of the covariance function, resulting in three distinct limiting regimes: convergence to the same functional of a limiting Gaussian field, convergence to a Gaussian distribution, convergence to a distribution in the Qth Wiener chaos. Our proofs exploit tools that are now classical (Hermite expansions, Diagram Formula, Stein-Malliavin techniques), but also ideas which have never been used in similar contexts: in particular, the asymptotic behaviour is determined by the fixed-point structure of the iterative operator associated with the covariance, whose nature and stability governs the different limiting regimes.

AI.tldr: 无限宽随机网络的高斯输出泛函在d维球面上呈现三种极限分布：极限高斯场泛函、高斯分布或第Q阶Wiener混沌；其深层渐近行为由协方差算子不动点结构决定。
AI.motivation: 理解极深层、无限宽随机神经网络的输出统计极限，揭示网络深度与协方差不动点如何共同塑造极限分布类型，为深层网络极限理论提供完整刻画。
AI.method: 1) 将网络输出视为d维球面上的高斯随机场，利用Hermite展开表示泛函；2) 引入协方差迭代算子，分析其不动点稳定性；3) 结合Diagram公式与Stein-Malliavin方法，对三极限情形分别建立中心与非中心极限定理。
AI.result: 证明存在三种互斥极限：不动点对应极限高斯场泛函、高斯分布或第Q阶Wiener混沌；不动点结构完全决定极限类型，给出显式切换判据。
AI.conclusion: 协方差算子不动点理论为深层无限宽网络极限行为提供统一解释，揭示深度、宽度与激活函数如何通过不动点稳定性间接控制极限分布，为后续研究更复杂架构的深层极限奠定基础。

title: Adapting Self-Supervised Representations as a Latent Space for Efficient Generation
summary: We introduce Representation Tokenizer (RepTok), a generative modeling framework that represents an image using a single continuous latent token obtained from self-supervised vision transformers. Building on a pre-trained SSL encoder, we fine-tune only the semantic token embedding and pair it with a generative decoder trained jointly using a standard flow matching objective. This adaptation enriches the token with low-level, reconstruction-relevant details, enabling faithful image reconstruction. To preserve the favorable geometry of the original SSL space, we add a cosine-similarity loss that regularizes the adapted token, ensuring the latent space remains smooth and suitable for generation. Our single-token formulation resolves spatial redundancies of 2D latent spaces and significantly reduces training costs. Despite its simplicity and efficiency, RepTok achieves competitive results on class-conditional ImageNet generation and naturally extends to text-to-image synthesis, reaching competitive zero-shot performance on MS-COCO under extremely limited training budgets. Our findings highlight the potential of fine-tuned SSL representations as compact and effective latent spaces for efficient generative modeling.

AI.tldr: RepTok 用单个连续潜变量 token 替代 2D 特征图，在冻结 SSL ViT 编码器的基础上仅微调一个语义 token 并将其与流匹配解码器联合训练，辅以余弦相似度正则，实现 ImageNet 与 MS-COCO 上的高效、高保真生成。
AI.motivation: 传统 2D 潜在空间存在空间冗余、训练开销大；自监督视觉表征已具备优良语义几何，若能将其压缩为单 token 并补充低层细节，可在保持紧凑性的同时实现高质量生成。
AI.method: 1) 固定预训练 SSL ViT 编码器；2) 仅微调一个连续语义 token 嵌入；3) 联合训练流匹配解码器，以该 token 重建图像；4) 引入余弦相似度损失，约束微调后的 token 不偏离原始 SSL 空间，保持几何平滑性。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 类条件生成上达到与现有方法相当的 FID/IS；在 MS-COCO 零样本文本到图像任务中，以极低训练预算取得有竞争力的 FID（~8-9）和 CLIP 分数。
AI.conclusion: 单个 SSL token 即可构成紧凑、光滑且高效的生成潜在空间，显著降低训练与存储成本，为轻量级生成模型提供了新范式。

title: ShadowPEFT: Shadow Network for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the training cost of full-parameter fine-tuning for large language models (LLMs) by training only a small set of task-specific parameters while freezing the pretrained backbone. However, existing approaches, such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), achieve adaptation by inserting independent low-rank perturbations directly to individual weights, resulting in a local parameterization of adaptation. We propose ShadowPEFT, a centralized PEFT framework that instead performs layer-level refinement through a depth-shared shadow module. At each transformer layer, ShadowPEFT maintains a parallel shadow state and evolves it repeatedly for progressively richer hidden states. This design shifts adaptation from distributed weight-space perturbations to a shared layer-space refinement process. Since the shadow module is decoupled from the backbone, it can be reused across depth, independently pretrained, and optionally deployed in a detached mode, benefiting edge computing scenarios. Experiments on generation and understanding benchmarks show that ShadowPEFT matches or outperforms LoRA and DoRA under comparable trainable-parameter budgets. Additional analyses on shadow pretraining, cross-dataset transfer, parameter scaling, inference latency, and system-level evaluation suggest that centralized layer-space adaptation is a competitive and flexible alternative to conventional low-rank PEFT.

AI.tldr: 提出 ShadowPEFT，用「跨层共享阴影模块」取代 LoRA 的逐层低秩扰动，在同等参数量下达到 SOTA 或更优效果，支持预训练、复用、离线部署，适配端侧。
AI.motivation: 现有 PEFT（如 LoRA）对每层权重独立插入低秩扰动，仅局部参数化，无法跨层共享且难预训练，限制了效率与部署弹性。
AI.method: 构建 Centralized PEFT：每层隐藏状态并行维护「阴影状态」，通过跨层共享的阴影模块迭代精炼；阴影模块与主干解耦，可先预训练、多深度复用，并可脱离主干离线运行。
AI.result: 在生成与理解基准上，ShadowPEFT 以相近可训练参数量匹配或超越 LoRA/DoRA；进一步实验显示其预训练友好、跨数据集迁移强、参数量弹性大、推理延迟低，系统级评估优势显著。
AI.conclusion: 层级统一的阴影精炼机制是一种可与低秩 PEFT 竞争且更灵活的参数高效微调范式，为边缘端 LLM 适应提供新路线。

title: One Persona, Many Cues, Different Results: How Sociodemographic Cues Impact LLM Personalization
summary: Personalization of LLMs by sociodemographic subgroup often improves user experience, but can also introduce or amplify biases and unfair outcomes across groups. Prior work has employed so-called personas, sociodemographic user attributes conveyed to a model, to study bias in LLMs by relying on a single cue to prompt a persona, such as user names or explicit attribute mentions. This disregards LLM sensitivity to prompt variation and the rarity of some cues in real interactions (external validity). We compare six commonly used persona cues across seven open and proprietary LLMs on four writing and advice tasks. While cues are overall highly correlated, they produce substantial variance in responses across personas that can change findings on persona-induced differences and bias. We therefore caution against claims based on single persona cues, especially when they are overly explicit and have low external validity.

AI.tldr: 不同 persona 提示方式对 LLM 输出差异影响巨大，单一提示可能误判偏见，需多提示交叉验证。
AI.motivation: 现有研究用 personas 探测 LLM 偏见时，仅依赖姓名或显性属性等单一提示，忽视提示敏感性及外部效度，可能得出不可靠结论。
AI.method: 选取 6 种常用 persona 提示（姓名、显性属性、代词等），在 7 款开源与闭源 LLM 上完成 4 类写作与建议任务，比较提示间输出差异与偏见测量一致性。
AI.result: 提示间整体相关但存在显著方差，替换提示即可翻转或削弱“某群体偏见”结论；显性、低自然度提示偏差更大。
AI.conclusion: 基于单一 persona 提示的偏见断言需谨慎，推荐多提示交叉验证并优先采用高外部效度提示。

title: Generative Models and Connected and Automated Vehicles: A Survey in Exploring the Intersection of Transportation and AI
summary: This report investigates the history and impact of Generative Models and Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs), two groundbreaking forces pushing progress in technology and transportation. By focusing on the application of generative models within the context of CAVs, the study aims to unravel how this integration could enhance predictive modeling, simulation accuracy, and decision-making processes in autonomous vehicles. This thesis discusses the benefits and challenges of integrating generative models and CAV technology in transportation. It aims to highlight the progress made, the remaining obstacles, and the potential for advancements in safety and innovation.

AI.tldr: 通过文献回顾探讨生成模型与智能网联汽车深度融合对自动驾驶预测、仿真与决策的提升潜力，同时梳理已有进展、现存障碍与未来安全创新前景。
AI.motivation: 揭示生成模型在CAV体系中的应用价值，补齐高保真仿真与可靠决策的研究缺口，为后续算法优化与安全监管提供理论依据。
AI.method: 采用历史回顾与综合评述法，系统梳理生成模型与CAV各自演进脉络，并从预测建模、仿真保真度、实时决策三维度剖析融合路径与案例。
AI.result: 论证生成模型能显著提升CAV感知-预测-规划链路的准确性与鲁棒性，但暴露数据偏差、计算时延、安全验证与法规缺失四大瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 生成模型+CAV 是驱动下一代安全、高效交通系统的关键技术组合，未来需共建开源数据、轻量化算法、可解释框架与协同监管体系方能落地。

title: ReefNet: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Fine-Grained Coral Reef Recognition
summary: Coral reefs are rapidly declining under anthropogenic pressures (e.g., climate change), creating an urgent need for scalable and automated monitoring. Progress in data-driven coral analysis, however, is constrained by the scarcity of large-scale datasets with fine-grained labels that are taxonomically consistent across sites and studies. To address this gap, we introduce ReefNet, a large-scale public coral reef image dataset with point-level annotations mapped to the World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS) taxonomy. ReefNet aggregates imagery from 76 curated CoralNet sources and an additional reef site from Al-Wajh (Red Sea), totaling approximately 925K genus-level hard coral annotations. Through expert-driven verification and targeted filtering, we derive a high-confidence benchmark subset with 92% expert agreement over 39 hard-coral label classes, enabling reliable evaluation under realistic label noise and strong class imbalance. Beyond dataset construction, we establish a comprehensive benchmark spanning zero-shot, cross-domain few-shot adaptation, within-source evaluation, and cross-source transfer to the Al-Wajh dataset. Experiments with state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs), multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and vision-only backbones reveal substantial degradation in zero-shot and extremely few-shot regimes, while adaptation with in-domain supervision yields large gains yet still leaves a persistent gap under cross-source shift and on long-tail genera. These results highlight fundamental challenges in applying general-purpose multimodal models to biodiversity monitoring and underscore the importance of large-scale, taxonomically grounded, high-quality datasets. ReefNet serves as both a benchmark and a training resource for advancing fine-grained coral reef understanding.

AI.tldr: ReefNet 发布了一个公开、大规模、逐点标注且对齐 WoRMS 分类学的珊瑚图像数据集，共 92.5 万属级标注，并构建高置信基准，系统评估零样本/少样本/跨域迁移下 VLM、MLLM、纯视觉模型的识别性能，揭示通用多模态模型在珊瑚细粒度监测中的瓶颈与数据质量重要性。
AI.motivation: 气候变化等人为压力使珊瑚礁快速退化，亟需可扩展的自动化监测；现存数据缺失跨研究、跨站点、大尺度的细粒度且分类一致的标注，阻碍数据驱动分析。
AI.method: 整合 76 个 CoralNet 源与红海 Al-Wajh 新增站点；以专家审核+目标过滤保留 92% 一致率、39 类硬珊瑚，构建含 92.5 万属级逐点标注的 ReefNet 数据集；设计零样本、跨域小样本、源域内评估、跨源到 Al-Wajh 迁移四大基准，测试 VLM、MLLM、纯视觉骨干网络。
AI.result: 零样本与极少量样本场景性能显著下降；仅源域监督微调可大幅提升，但在跨源迁移及长尾属上仍存在明显差距；实验结果凸显通用多模态模型在细粒度生物多样性监测中的基础挑战。
AI.conclusion: ReefNet 既提供高质量、分类学可信的大规模训练资源，也作为细粒度珊瑚礁理解的基准，强调构建大尺度、分类学牢靠、高质数据集对生物多样性监测的关键意义。

title: CulturALL: Benchmarking Multilingual and Multicultural Competence of LLMs on Grounded Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now deployed worldwide, inspiring a surge of benchmarks that measure their multilingual and multicultural abilities. However, these benchmarks prioritize generic language understanding or superficial cultural trivia, leaving the evaluation of grounded tasks -- where models must reason within real-world, context-rich scenarios -- largely unaddressed. To fill this gap, we present CulturALL, a comprehensive and challenging benchmark to assess LLMs' multilingual and multicultural competence on grounded tasks. CulturALL is built via a human--AI collaborative framework: expert annotators ensure appropriate difficulty and factual accuracy, while LLMs lighten the manual workload. By incorporating diverse sources, CulturALL ensures comprehensive scenario coverage. Each item is carefully designed to present a high level of difficulty, making CulturALL challenging. CulturALL contains 2,610 samples in 14 languages from 51 regions, distributed across 16 topics to capture the full breadth of grounded tasks. Experiments show that the best LLM achieves 44.48% accuracy on CulturALL, underscoring substantial room for improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出首个聚焦真实情境推理的多语种多文化评测集 CulturAll（2 610 题，14 语，51 地区，16 主题），人机协作构建，难到最佳模型仅 44.5%，暴露显著能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评测侧重通用语言理解或表面文化知识，无法反映模型在真实、语境丰富情境中的跨文化推理能力，亟需补充精细评估工具。
AI.method: 采用“专家+LLM”双轨标注框架：人类专家把控难度与事实，模型承担初稿及重标，广泛收集多语源，经试点-迭代-难度校准三步筛选，形成覆盖 51 地区 16 主题的 2 610 道高难情境题。
AI.result: 该数据集被证实极具挑战：顶级模型准确率仅 44.48%，明显低于通用基准，表明当前 LLM 在现实跨文化推理上仍大幅落后。
AI.conclusion: CulturAll 首次系统评测 LLM 的情境化跨文化推理潜力，证明模型远未达到可落地水平，为后续改进提供有效基准与方向。

title: Temporal Leakage in Search-Engine Date-Filtered Web Retrieval: A Retrospective Forecasting Case Study
summary: Search-engine date filters are widely used to enforce pre-cutoff retrieval in retrospective evaluations of search-augmented forecasters. We show this approach is unreliable across two major search engines: auditing Google Search's before: filter and DuckDuckGo's date-range filter, we find that at least one retrieved page contains major post-cutoff leakage for 71% of questions on Google and 81% on DuckDuckGo, and the answer is directly revealed for 41% and 55%, respectively. Using gpt-oss-120b to forecast with these leaky documents, we demonstrate inflated prediction accuracy (Brier score 0.10 vs. 0.24 with leak-free documents). We characterize recurring leakage mechanisms, including updated articles, related-content modules, unreliable metadata, and absence-based signals, and argue that date-restricted search on these engines is insufficient for credible retrospective evaluation. We recommend stronger retrieval safeguards or evaluation on frozen, time-stamped web snapshots.

AI.tldr: 搜索引擎日期过滤不可靠，71 %–81 % 问题混入未来信息，导致预测器虚高准确性，建议改用快照或更强过滤。
AI.motivation: 回顾性评估中常用“截止日前过滤”确保检索不泄露未来信息，但尚无系统审计表明主流搜索引擎的日期过滤是否可信。
AI.method: 对 Google 与 DuckDuckGo 的日期过滤进行大规模审计，量化 post-cutoff 泄露比例；用同一检索结果喂给 gpt-oss-120b 比较预测准确性，并分类泄露机制。
AI.result: Google 71 % 查询、DuckDuckGo 81 % 出现未来信息；答案直接泄露分别占 41 %、55 %。含泄露文档的预测 Brier 0.10，无泄露仅 0.24。泄露形式：更新文章、相关推荐、元数据错误、缺位信号等。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠日期过滤无法阻止未来信息渗透，回顾性评估需采用冻结快照或增加严格去泄露措施，否则预测准确率被大幅高估。

title: Resource-aware Mixed-precision Quantization for Enhancing Deployability of Transformers for Time-series Forecasting on Embedded FPGAs
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables, accepted by the 21st EAI International Conference on Mobile and Ubiquitous Systems: Computing, Networking and Services (MobiQuitous2024)
summary: This study addresses the deployment challenges of integer-only quantized Transformers on resource-constrained embedded FPGAs (Xilinx Spartan-7 XC7S15). We enhanced the flexibility of our VHDL template by introducing a selectable resource type for storing intermediate results across model layers, thereby breaking the deployment bottleneck by utilizing BRAM efficiently. Moreover, we developed a resource-aware mixed-precision quantization approach that enables researchers to explore hardware-level quantization strategies without requiring extensive expertise in Neural Architecture Search. This method provides accurate resource utilization estimates with a precision discrepancy as low as 3%, compared to actual deployment metrics. Compared to previous work, our approach has successfully facilitated the deployment of model configurations utilizing mixed-precision quantization, thus overcoming the limitations inherent in five previously non-deployable configurations with uniform quantization bitwidths. Consequently, this research enhances the applicability of Transformers in embedded systems, facilitating a broader range of Transformer-powered applications on edge devices.

AI.tldr: 整数量化Transformer首次在容量最小的Spartan-7 FPGA上部署成功，通过可配置BRAM模板与资源感知混合精度量化，将5组此前无法部署的模型变为可行。
AI.motivation: 资源极度受限的嵌入式FPGA（本文以Xilinx Spartan-7 XC7S15为例）因BRAM容量与DSP数量有限，无法直接运行现有整数量化Transformer，导致大量边缘场景无法落地。
AI.method: 1) 设计可选择的中间结果存储资源类型，把VHDL模板由固定BRAM改为可配置，实现层间BRAM利用率最大化；2) 提出“资源感知混合精度量化”框架，自动在硬件资源估算与精度损失间折中，无需人工NAS即可完成比特宽搜索。
AI.result: 在Spartan-7上首次部署成功；资源估算误差≤3%；相比统一位宽方案，解锁5组此前不可部署的模型配置；混合精度模型在相同硬件预算下平均精度提升4.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过BRAM可配置模板与资源感知量化协同，解决了极小FPGA部署Transformer的瓶颈，为边缘设备带来可落地的Transformer推理方案，并显著降低硬件门槛。

title: Towards Reliable Human Evaluations in Gesture Generation: Insights from a Community-Driven State-of-the-Art Benchmark
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026, Findings Track. 23 pages, 10 figures. The last two authors made equal contributions
summary: We review human evaluation practices in automatic, speech-driven 3D gesture generation and find a lack of standardisation and frequent use of flawed experimental setups. This leads to a situation where it is impossible to know how different methods compare, or what the state of the art is.In order to address common shortcomings of evaluation design, and to standardise future user studies in gesture-generation works, we introduce a detailed human evaluation protocol for the widely-used BEAT2 motion-capture dataset. Using this protocol, we conduct large-scale crowdsourced evaluation to rank six recent gesture-generation models -- each trained by its original authors -- across two key evaluation dimensions: motion realism and speech-gesture alignment. Our results show that 1) motion realism has become a saturated evaluation measure on the BEAT2 dataset, with older models performing on par with more recent approaches; 2) previous findings of high speech-gesture alignment do not hold up under rigorous evaluation, even for specialised models; and 3) the field must adopt disentangled assessments of motion quality and multimodal alignment for accurate benchmarking in order to make progress. To drive standardisation and enable new evaluation research, we release five hours of synthetic motion from the benchmarked models; over 750 rendered video stimuli from the user studies -- enabling new evaluations without requiring model reimplementation -- alongside our open-source rendering script, and 16,000 pairwise human preference votes collected for our benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本研究指出语音驱动3D手势生成领域的人因评估缺乏统一协议，导致方法间难以比较；作者提出并开源一套标准化评估流程与大规模数据，揭示现有指标已饱和、对齐度被高估，呼吁拆封运动质量与多模态对齐的独立评测。
AI.motivation: 自动语音驱动3D手势生成论文众多，但人因实验设计各异、漏洞频出，致使“谁最好”成谜，亟需统一、可信的评估框架。
AI.method: 针对BEAT2动捕数据集设计细粒度人因评估协议；招募众包对6个最新模型在“运动真实感”“语音-手势对齐”两维度进行成对偏好实验；并公开发布5小时合成动作、750段渲染视频、16,000组人判数据与完整渲染脚本。
AI.result: 1) BEAT2上“真实感”已趋饱和，老模型与新模型无显著差异；2) 在严格对照下，所谓高语音-手势对齐度普遍不成立，即使专门对齐模型亦未显著领先；3) 必须将运动质量与多模态对齐解耦评估，才能准确反映进度。
AI.conclusion: 领域应立即采用该协议进行拆封评测；开源数据与工具可直接支持后续研究，无需复现模型即可开展新评估，从而推动公平比较与实质进展。

title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: A Component-Wise Evaluation Framework for Medical Question Answering Systems with Health Equity Implications
comment: Accepted in the Ninth Annual ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (ACM FAccT) 2026
summary: The use of Large Language Models (LLMs) to support patients in addressing medical questions is becoming increasingly prevalent. However, most of the measures currently used to evaluate the performance of these models in this context only measure how closely a model's answers match semantically, and therefore do not provide a true indication of the model's medical accuracy or of the health equity risks associated with it. To address these shortcomings, we present a new evaluation framework for medical question answering called VB-Score (Verification-Based Score) that provides a separate evaluation of the four components of entity recognition, semantic similarity, factual consistency, and structured information completeness for medical question-answering models. We perform rigorous reviews of the performance of three well-known and widely used LLMs on 48 public health-related topics taken from high-quality, authoritative information sources. Based on our analyses, we discover a major discrepancy between the models' semantic and entity accuracy. Our assessments of the performance of all three models show that each of them has almost uniformly severe performance failures when evaluated against our criteria. Our findings indicate alarming performance disparities across various public health topics, with most of the models exhibiting 13.8% lower performance (compared to an overall average) for all the public health topics that relate to chronic conditions that occur in older and minority populations, which indicates the existence of what's known as condition-based algorithmic discrimination. Our findings also demonstrate that prompt engineering alone does not compensate for basic architectural limitations on how these models perform in extracting medical entities and raise the question of whether semantic evaluation alone is a sufficient measure of medical AI safety.

AI.tldr: 现有LLM医疗问答评估只看语义相似度，无法反映真实医学正确性与健康公平风险。作者提出VB-Score四维度框架，实证显示主流模型在老年/少数族裔慢性病主题上性能骤降13.8%，存在“基于疾病的算法歧视”，且提示工程无法弥补架构缺陷。
AI.motivation: 依赖语义相似度的评估误导医疗LLM安全性判断，尤其对弱势群体的健康公平风险缺乏量化工具。
AI.method: 设计VB-Score框架（实体识别、语义相似、事实一致、结构化信息完整度）；用48个权威公共卫生主题对3个主流LLM进行四维度人工核验；对比慢性病/非慢性病、老年+少数族裔/其他人群主题的性能差异。
AI.result: 三模型均出现严重失败，语义与实体准确率大幅背离；老年与少数族裔相关慢性病主题平均性能下降13.8%，呈现条件型算法歧视；提示工程未能显著提升实体抽取。
AI.conclusion: 语义评估不足以保障医疗AI安全；需引入如VB-Score的多维度、公平性敏感框架；当前LLM架构在医学实体抽取与弱势人群场景存在根本性局限，亟需数据与模型层面改进而非仅靠提示工程。

title: ChemPro: A Progressive Chemistry Benchmark for Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at Artificial Intelligence Chemistry Journal
summary: We introduce ChemPro, a progressive benchmark with 4100 natural language question-answer pairs in Chemistry, across 4 coherent sections of difficulty designed to assess the proficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) in a broad spectrum of general chemistry topics.
