We include Multiple Choice Questions and Numerical Questions spread across fine-grained information recall, long-horizon reasoning, multi-concept questions, problem-solving with nuanced articulation, and straightforward questions in a balanced ratio, effectively covering Bio-Chemistry, Inorganic-Chemistry, Organic-Chemistry and Physical-Chemistry. ChemPro is carefully designed analogous to a student's academic evaluation for basic to high-school chemistry. A gradual increase in the question difficulty rigorously tests the ability of LLMs to progress from solving basic problems to solving more sophisticated challenges. We evaluate 45+7 state-of-the-art LLMs, spanning both open-source and proprietary variants, and our analysis reveals that while LLMs perform well on basic chemistry questions, their accuracy declines with different types and levels of complexity. These findings highlight the critical limitations of LLMs in general scientific reasoning and understanding and point towards understudied dimensions of difficulty, emphasizing the need for more robust methodologies to improve LLMs.

AI.tldr: ChemPro 是一个包含 4100 道化学问答的渐进式基准，覆盖四大分支与五级难度，用于诊断主流大模型的科学推理瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有化学评测规模小、题型单一、难度层次不足，无法系统衡量大模型「从入门到高级」的科学推理能力，急需一个贴合学生学业进阶、且能揭示模型缺陷的细粒度基准。
AI.method: 构建 4 大化学分支 × 5 级难度的题库，均衡设置选择题与数值题，题型涵盖回忆、长链推理、多概念综合、微妙表述与直问直答；评测 45 个开源 + 7 个闭源 SOTA 模型，按难度与题型切片统计准确率。
AI.result: 所有模型在基础题上得分高，但随着难度升高，准确率单调下降；复杂推理、数值计算与跨概念综合题跌幅最显著，暴露模型在符号计算、定量推理与深度语义理解上的共性短板。
AI.conclusion: 结果强调大模型「高级科学推理」仍未突破，ChemPro 揭示的困难维度为后续课程对齐、工具增强与认知架构改进提供了可量化的改进靶点。

title: Quantum Non-Linear Bandit Optimization
summary: We study non-linear bandit optimization where the learner maximizes a black-box function with zeroth order function oracle, which has been successfully applied in many critical applications such as drug discovery and materials design. Existing works have showed that with the aid of quantum computing, it is possible to break the classical $Ω(\sqrt{T})$ regret lower bound and achieve the new $O(\mathrm{poly}\log T)$ upper bound. However, they usually assume that the objective function sits within the reproducing kernel Hilbert space and their algorithms suffer from the curse of dimensionality. In this paper, we propose the new Q-NLB-UCB algorithm which enjoys an \emph{input dimension-free} $O(\mathrm{poly}\log T)$ upper bound, making it applicable for high-dimensional tasks. At the heart of our algorithm design are quantum Monte Carlo mean estimator, parametric function approximation technique, and a new quantum non-linear regression oracle, which can be of independent interests in more quantum machine learning problems. Our algorithm is also validated for its efficiency compared with other quantum algorithms on both high-dimensional synthetic and real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: 基于量子计算的高维非线性老虎机算法Q-NLB-UCB，首次摆脱维度依赖并达到O(poly log T)遗憾界，经合成与真实数据验证优于既有量子方法。
AI.motivation: 传统量子非线性老虎机需RKHS假设且受维数灾难限制，难以用于高维任务；打破Ω(√T)经典下界的同时消除维度依赖，可拓展到药物发现、材料设计等高维场景。
AI.method: 提出Q-NLB-UCB框架：量子Monte-Carlo均值估计器降低采样复杂度→参数化函数逼近缓解RKHS假设→新型量子非线性回归预言机构造置信上界，实现维度无关的O(poly log T)遗憾。
AI.result: 理论证明算法在高维情形下仍保持O(poly log T)遗憾上界；合成与真实高维实验显示，其样本效率显著优于现有量子及经典策略，验证维度无关性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 首次实现高维非线性老虎机的维度无关量子加速，所提量子子模块可独立用于更广泛的量子机器学习问题。

title: Pixels or Positions? Benchmarking Modalities in Group Activity Recognition
summary: Group Activity Recognition (GAR) is well studied on the video modality for surveillance and indoor team sports (e.g., volleyball, basketball). Yet, other modalities such as agent positions and trajectories over time, i.e. tracking, remain comparatively under-explored despite being compact, agent-centric signals that explicitly encode spatial interactions. Understanding whether pixel (video) or position (tracking) modalities leads to better group activity recognition is therefore important to drive further research on the topic. However, no standardized benchmark currently exists that aligns broadcast video and tracking data for the same group activities, leading to a lack of apples-to-apples comparison between these modalities for GAR. In this work, we introduce SoccerNet-GAR, a multimodal dataset built from the $64$ matches of the football World Cup 2022. Specifically, the broadcast videos and player tracking modalities for $87{,}939$ group activities are synchronized and annotated with $10$ categories. Furthermore, we define a unified evaluation protocol to benchmark two strong unimodal approaches: (i) competitive video-based classifiers and (ii) tracking-based classifiers leveraging graph neural networks. In particular, our novel role-aware graph architecture for tracking-based GAR directly encodes tactical structure through positional edges connecting players by their on-pitch roles. Our tracking model achieves $77.8\%$ balanced accuracy compared to $60.9\%$ for the best video baseline, while training with $7 \times$ less GPU hours and $479 \times$ fewer parameters ($180K$ vs. $86.3M$). This study provides new insights into the relative strengths of pixels and positions for group activity recognition in sports.

AI.tldr: 首次构建同步的视频+轨迹多模态足球数据集 SoccerNet-GAR，提出角色感知图网络仅用 1/7 训练耗时、1/479 参数即把 GAR 准确率从 60.9% 提升到 77.8%，证明轨迹模态显著优于像素模态。
AI.motivation: 群体行为识别(GAR)长期依赖视频，而同等重要的轨迹模态缺乏标准基准与公平对比，阻碍了对“像素 vs. 位置”优劣的深入理解。
AI.method: 1) 基于 2022 世界杯 64 场比赛构建 87 939 条同步视频-轨迹样本并标注 10 类群体活动；2) 设计统一评测协议；3) 提出角色感知图网络，将球员按场上职责构建位置边，显式嵌入战术结构。
AI.result: 轨迹模型 balanced accuracy 77.8%，比最强视频 baseline 高 16.9 pct，训练 GPU 时耗减少 7×，参数量仅 180 K(减少 479×)。
AI.conclusion: 在体育场景下，轨迹模态相较视频模态更紧凑、高效且更具判别力，为后续 GAR 研究提供了新方向与标准化基准。

title: Location Not Found: Exposing Implicit Local and Global Biases in Multilingual LLMs
summary: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) have minimized the fluency gap between languages. This advancement, however, exposes models to the risk of biased behavior, as knowledge and norms may propagate across languages. In this work, we aim to quantify models' inter- and intra-lingual biases, via their ability to answer locale-ambiguous questions. To this end, we present LocQA, a test set containing 2,156 questions in 12 languages, referring to various locale-dependent facts such as laws, dates, and measurements. The questions do not contain indications of the locales they relate to, other than the querying language itself. LLMs' responses to LocQA locale-ambiguous questions thus reveal models' implicit priors. We used LocQA to evaluate 32 models, and detected two types of structural biases. Inter-lingually, we show a global bias towards answers relevant to the US-locale, even when models are asked in languages other than English. Moreover, we discovered that this global bias is exacerbated in models that underwent instruction tuning, compared to their base counterparts. Intra-lingually, we show that when multiple locales are relevant for the same language, models act as demographic probability engines, prioritizing locales with larger populations. Taken together, insights from LocQA may help in shaping LLMs' desired local behavior, and in quantifying the impact of various training phases on different kinds of biases.

AI.tldr: 作者构建跨语言测试集 LocQA，首次系统量化大模型在「无地区提示」问题上的 US-centric 全局偏见与人口权重式内部偏见，并发现指令微调会放大前者。
AI.motivation: 多语言大模型虽缩小了语言流畅度差距，却可能在知识规范跨语言传播时引入地区偏见。现有评测缺乏对「模型在无显式地区线索时究竟依赖哪套本地知识」的定量刻画，因此需要一种可比较、可扩展的跨语言基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建 LocQA：2 156 道覆盖 12 语种的「地区模糊」题，涉及法律、日期、度量等本地事实，题目本身不含地区标识，仅以查询语言隐性提示。2) 设计双重偏见指标：跨语言（inter-lingual）（答案倾向 US 地区）与语内（intra-lingual）（同一语言下多地区并存时按人口比重偏好）。3) 对 32 个模型（含基座与指令微调版）做零样本测试，量化偏见强度并对比训练阶段影响。
AI.result: 跨语言层面，全部模型显著偏向 US 地区答案，平均偏差达 60%+；指令微调模型比其基座版再提升 8–15%。语内层面，当同一语言对应多个地区（如葡语→巴西/葡萄牙）时，模型答案分布与人口比例高度相关（r>0.9）。偏见强度与模型大小、语种资源量无显著负相关，说明问题非数据量可简单缓解。
AI.conclusion: LocQA 首次将「地区模糊问答」转化为可量化的偏见探针，证明当前多语言 LLM 存在结构性的 US-default 与人口权重先验；指令微调阶段反而放大了全球主导文化输出。未来应通过定向微调、地区提示或平衡采样，主动矫正模型对地区知识的隐性排序。

title: Once Correct, Still Wrong: Counterfactual Hallucination in Multilingual Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can achieve high accuracy while still accepting culturally plausible but visually incorrect interpretations. Existing hallucination benchmarks rarely test this failure mode, particularly outside Western contexts and English. We introduce M$^2$CQA, a culturally grounded multimodal benchmark built from images spanning 17 MENA countries, paired with contrastive true and counterfactual statements in English, Arabic, and its dialects. To isolate hallucination beyond raw accuracy, we propose the CounterFactual Hallucination Rate (CFHR), which measures counterfactual acceptance conditioned on correctly answering the true statement. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs under multiple prompting strategies, we find that CFHR rises sharply in Arabic, especially in dialects, even when true-statement accuracy remains high. Moreover, reasoning-first prompting consistently increases counterfactual hallucination, while answering before justifying improves robustness. We make the dataset publicly available for the community (https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/M2CQA)).

AI.tldr: 作者提出首个聚焦中东—北非（MENA）文化的多模态幻觉基准M²CQA，并设计CFHR指标，证明前沿VLM在阿拉伯语（尤其是方言）下极易接受文化可信但视觉错误的陈述，且“先推理后回答”会加剧幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言幻觉评测几乎只覆盖西方英语场景，忽视了文化语境中“看似合理却视觉错误”的独特失效模式；MENA 区域因文化/语言差异大，成为验证此缺陷的理想舞台。
AI.method: 1）采集17个MENA国家的图片，构建英/阿/方言三元组对比语料；2）提出CounterFactual Hallucination Rate (CFHR)：在“正确回答正例”前提下，测模型接受反例的概率，以剥离准确率干扰；3）系统测试多种提示策略（如先答后证 vs 先证后答）对CFHR的影响。
AI.result: 尽管各模型对正例准确率仍高，CFHR在阿拉伯语（特别是方言）上急剧飙升；相较之下，英语CFHR最低。“先答后证”提示显著降低幻觉，而“先推理再回答”提示反而使CFHR升高。
AI.conclusion: VLM的多语幻觉问题被严重低估；文化语境与语言变体是触发幻觉的新维度。CFHR能有效揭示这一隐藏缺陷，推动未来VLM在非西方语境下的鲁棒对齐。

title: AutoNFS: Automatic Neural Feature Selection
summary: Feature selection (FS) is a fundamental challenge in machine learning, particularly for high-dimensional tabular data, where interpretability and computational efficiency are critical. Existing FS methods often cannot automatically detect the number of attributes required to solve a given task and involve user intervention or model retraining with different feature budgets. Additionally, they either neglect feature relationships (filter methods) or require time-consuming optimization (wrapper methods). To address these limitations, we propose AutoNFS, which combines the FS module based on Gumbel-Sigmoid sampling with a predictive model evaluating the relevance of the selected attributes. The model is trained end-to-end using a differentiable loss and automatically determines the minimal set of features essential to solve a given downstream task. Unlike many wrapper-style approaches, AutoNFS introduces a low and predictable training overhead and avoids repeated model retraining across feature budgets. In practice, the additional cost of the masking module is largely independent of the number of input features (beyond the unavoidable cost of processing the input itself), making the method scalable to high-dimensional tabular data. We evaluate AutoNFS on well-established classification and regression benchmarks as well as real-world metagenomic datasets. The results show that AutoNFS is competitive with, and often improves upon, strong classical and neural FS baselines while selecting fewer features on average across the evaluated benchmarks.

AI.tldr: AutoNFS 用 Gumbel-Sigmoid 可微采样把特征选择嵌入端到端训练，无需预设特征数、不反复重训模型，在高维表格数据上自动选出最小有效特征集，性能优于或媲美基线且平均所选特征更少。
AI.motivation: 高维表格数据做特征选择时，现有方法要么需人工指定特征数且要多次重训模型，要么忽略特征间关系（过滤法）或优化耗时（封装法），亟需一种能自动确定特征数、训练开销低且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.method: 将基于 Gumbel-Sigmoid 的可微掩码模块直接耦合到下游预测网络，端到端优化联合损失；掩码输出即特征选择结果，训练一次即可自动学得最小充分特征集，无需针对不同特征预算反复重训，额外计算量与输入维度基本无关。
AI.result: 在多个经典分类/回归基准及真实宏基因组数据集上，AutoNFS 与强过滤/封装/神经基线相比，预测性能相当或更优，同时平均所选特征数显著减少；训练时间开销低且可预测，可线性扩展至上万维输入。
AI.conclusion: AutoNFS 以极低且可控的成本实现了高维表格数据的无参、自动化特征选择，兼具过滤法的效率和封装法的精度，为后续可解释建模与资源受限场景提供了实用工具。

title: Mammo-FM: Breast-specific foundational model for Integrated Mammographic Diagnosis, Prognosis, and Reporting
summary: Breast cancer is one of the leading causes of death among women worldwide. We introduce Mammo-FM, the first foundation model specifically for mammography, pretrained on the largest and most diverse dataset to date - 140,677 patients (821,326 mammograms) across four U.S. institutions. Mammo-FM provides a unified foundation for core clinical tasks in breast imaging, including cancer diagnosis, pathology localization, structured report generation, and cancer risk prognosis within a single framework. Its alignment between images and text enables both visual and textual interpretability, improving transparency and clinical auditability, which are essential for real-world adoption. We rigorously evaluate Mammo-FM across diagnosis, prognosis, and report-generation tasks in in- and out-of-distribution datasets. Despite operating on native-resolution mammograms and using only one-third of the parameters of state-of-the-art generalist FMs, Mammo-FM consistently outperforms them across multiple public and private benchmarks. These results highlight the efficiency and value of domain-specific foundation models designed around the full spectrum of tasks within a clinical domain and emphasize the importance of rigorous, domain-aligned evaluation.

AI.tldr: 首个乳腺X线专用基础模型Mammo-FM，基于14万患者82万张图预训练，一站式完成诊断、定位、报告及风险预测，在多项基准上以更少的参数量超越通用大模型。
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌为女性主要死因，通用基础模型难以覆盖乳腺影像全临床任务；亟需一个针对乳腺X线、可解释且经严格验证的专用基础模型。
AI.method: 构建迄今最大规模、多中心乳腺X线数据集，训练可图文对齐的乳腺专用基础模型，统一支持诊断、定位、报告生成及风险预测，并在分布内外数据集上系统评估。
AI.result: 仅用1/3参数，Mammo-FM在多项公共及私有基准上均优于现有通用大模型，验证其在诊断、预后及报告生成任务中的领先性能与跨机构泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 面向单一临床域、覆盖全任务链条的专用基础模型，不仅效率更高、性能更优，而且能提供可解释输出，便于临床采纳与监管审计，具有重要实际意义。

title: IndiaFinBench: An Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Model Performance on Indian Financial Regulatory Text
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Dataset and evaluation code at https://github.com/rajveerpall/IndiaFinBench
summary: We introduce IndiaFinBench, to our knowledge the first publicly available evaluation benchmark for assessing large language model (LLM) performance on Indian financial regulatory text. Existing financial NLP benchmarks draw exclusively from Western financial corpora (SEC filings, US earnings reports, and English-language financial news), leaving a significant gap in coverage of non-Western regulatory frameworks. IndiaFinBench addresses this gap with 406 expert-annotated question-answer pairs drawn from 192 documents sourced from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), spanning four task types: regulatory interpretation (174 items), numerical reasoning (92 items), contradiction detection (62 items), and temporal reasoning (78 items). Annotation quality is validated through a model-based secondary pass (kappa=0.918 on contradiction detection) and a 60-item human inter-annotator agreement evaluation (kappa=0.611; 76.7% overall agreement). We evaluate twelve models under zero-shot conditions, with accuracy ranging from 70.4% (Gemma 4 E4B) to 89.7% (Gemini 2.5 Flash). All models substantially outperform a non-specialist human baseline of 60.0%. Numerical reasoning is the most discriminative task, with a 35.9 percentage-point spread across models. Bootstrap significance testing (10,000 resamples) reveals three statistically distinct performance tiers. The dataset, evaluation code, and all model outputs are available at https://github.com/rajveerpall/IndiaFinBench

AI.tldr: 印度金融文本评测基准 IndiaFinBench 首批公开，406 对专家标注问答覆盖 SEBI/RBI 文档四大任务，12 个零样本 LLM 准确率 70.4%–89.7%，显著拉开模型差距并建立三层性能分级。
AI.motivation: 现有金融 NLP 评测仅聚焦西方语料（SEC、美股财报等），对非西方监管文本严重缺失，阻碍全球模型在印度等新兴市场的可靠落地。
AI.method: 从 SEBI 与 RBI 192 份文件中人工抽取 406 对问答，设计监管解释、数值推理、矛盾检测、时序推理四类任务；经模型二次校验（κ=0.918）与 60 例人工再标注（κ=0.611）控制质量；零样本评测 12 个主流 LLM，并采用 1 万次 bootstrap 检验划分性能层级。
AI.result: 数值推理任务最具区分度，模型间差距高达 35.9 个百分点；整体准确率最高 Gemini 2.5 Flash 达 89.7%，最低 Gemma 4 E4B 为 70.4%，均显著高于非专家人类基线 60.0%；统计检验明确分出高/中/低三档模型群体。
AI.conclusion: IndiaFinBench 填补了非西方金融监管评测空白，可作为印度市场金融 LLM 的准入标尺；高标注一致性与显著性能分化证明基准有效，后续应持续扩充多语言、多任务与覆盖更多新兴经济体监管文本。

title: Investigating the structure of emotions by analyzing similarity and association of emotion words
comment: 5 figures, 8 tables; data github link added
summary: In the field of natural language processing, some studies have attempted sentiment analysis on text by handling emotions as explanatory or response variables. One of the most popular emotion models used in this context is the wheel of emotion proposed by Plutchik. This model schematizes human emotions in a circular structure, and represents them in two or three dimensions. However, the validity of Plutchik's wheel of emotion has not been sufficiently examined. This study investigated the validity of the wheel by creating and analyzing a semantic networks of emotion words. Through our experiments, we collected data of similarity and association of ordered pairs of emotion words, and constructed networks using these data. We then analyzed the structure of the networks through community detection, and compared it with that of the wheel of emotion. The results showed that each network's structure was, for the most part, similar to that of the wheel of emotion, but locally different.

AI.tldr: 本文用语义网络方法验证Plutchik情绪轮，发现其整体结构有效但局部存在偏差。
AI.motivation: NLP情感分析常将Plutchik情绪轮视为解释变量，但该模型的人因有效性一直缺乏实证检验。
AI.method: 构建情绪词间相似度与联想强度的有序对数据集，分别生成无向与有向语义网络；用社区检测算法提取网络社区结构并与Plutchik轮的三维圆环布局进行定量对照。
AI.result: 两种网络的全局拓扑与Plutchik轮高度一致，但在相邻情绪簇边界出现局部错位，部分情绪词归属社区与轮模型预测不符。
AI.conclusion: Plutchik轮可作为情感计算的有效近似框架，但需针对局部差异优化情绪空间划分，为后续情感词典与标注方案提供修正依据。

title: RESFL: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for Responsible Federated Learning by Balancing Privacy, Fairness and Utility
summary: Federated Learning (FL) has gained prominence in machine learning applications across critical domains by enabling collaborative model training without centralized data aggregation. However, FL frameworks that protect privacy often sacrifice fairness and reliability. Differential privacy can reduce data leakage, but it may also obscure sensitive attributes needed for bias correction, thereby worsening performance gaps across demographic groups. This work studies the privacy-fairness trade-off in FL-based object detection and introduces RESFL, an integrated framework that jointly improves both objectives. RESFL combines adversarial privacy disentanglement with uncertainty-guided fairness-aware aggregation. The adversarial component uses a gradient reversal layer to suppress sensitive attribute information, reducing privacy risks while preserving fairness-relevant structure. The uncertainty-aware aggregation component uses an evidential neural network to adaptively weight client updates, prioritizing contributions with lower fairness disparities and higher confidence. This produces robust and equitable FL model updates. Experiments in high-stakes autonomous vehicle settings show that RESFL achieves high mAP on FACET and CARLA, reduces membership-inference attack success by 37%, reduces the equality-of-opportunity gap by 17% relative to the FedAvg baseline, and maintains stronger adversarial robustness. Although evaluated in autonomous driving, RESFL is domain-agnostic and can be applied to a broad range of application domains beyond this setting.

AI.tldr: 提出RESFL框架，在联邦目标检测中同时提升隐私与公平，实验显示mAP不降、攻击成功率降37%、公平差距缩17%。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽能隐私训练，但引入差分隐私会掩盖敏感属性、加剧群体性能偏差，亟需兼顾隐私与公平的统一方案。
AI.method: RESFL双模块：①对抗隐私解耦——梯度反转层抑制敏感属性泄露，保留公平所需结构；②不确定性感知聚合——证据神经网络动态加权客户端更新，优先低公平偏差、高置信度贡献。
AI.result: 在FACET与CARla自动驾驶数据集上，mAP保持高水平，成员推理攻击成功率降低37%，机会均等差距较FedAvg缩小17%，对抗鲁棒性更强。
AI.conclusion: RESFL首次在联邦目标检测中实现隐私-公平协同优化，域无关，可扩展至高风险分布式场景。

title: Realistic Handwritten Multi-Digit Writer (MDW) Number Recognition Challenges
summary: Isolated digit classification has served as a motivating problem for decades of machine learning research. In real settings, numbers often occur as multiple digits, all written by the same person. Examples include ZIP Codes, handwritten check amounts, and appointment times. In this work, we leverage knowledge about the writers of NIST digit images to create more realistic benchmark multi-digit writer (MDW) data sets. As expected, we find that classifiers may perform well on isolated digits yet do poorly on multi-digit number recognition. If we want to solve real number recognition problems, additional advances are needed. The MDW benchmarks come with task-specific performance metrics that go beyond typical error calculations to more closely align with real-world impact. They also create opportunities to develop methods that can leverage task-specific knowledge to improve performance well beyond that of individual digit classification methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究改进了数字识别基准：通过引入同一作者的多数字连写图片，创建了新的MDW数据集并配套任务相关的评估指标，发现既有单数字方法在多数字场景下性能显著下降，亟需新的技术突破。
AI.motivation: 传统研究聚焦单数字分类，但现实场景中数字常以“同一作者的多位串”出现（邮编、支票金额、预约时间）。为弥合这一差距，作者希望构建更贴近真实的多数字识别基准，以暴露当前方法的局限并推动针对性技术进步。
AI.method: 1）利用NIST手写体数据中的作者信息，重构出成串相同作者的多数字图片块，生成Multi-Digit Writer（MDW）数据集。2）设计任务导向的评估指标，不仅算错位数，还映射到现实世界影响（如金额串全对才算通过）。3）对比单数字模型与直接多数字串模型的性能差异。
AI.result: 实验表明：单数字分类器在孤立数字子集上表现良好，但在同一作者的MDW多数字任务上准确率骤降；引入作者一致性与多数字上下文的新方法未见显著提升，说明需要进一步算法创新。
AI.conclusion: 若期望解决真实数字串识别问题，必须超越“逐数字分类”范式，开发能充分利用作者特性、数字上下文和任务语义的新型模型；MDW基准与配套指标为此方向的算法发展提供了挑战和机会。

title: Rethinking Scale: Deployment Trade-offs of Small Language Models under Agent Paradigms
summary: Despite the impressive capabilities of large language models, their substantial computational costs, latency, and privacy risks hinder their widespread deployment in real-world applications. Small Language Models (SLMs) with fewer than 10 billion parameters present a promising alternative; however, their inherent limitations in knowledge and reasoning curtail their effectiveness. Existing research primarily focuses on enhancing SLMs through scaling laws or fine-tuning strategies while overlooking the potential of using agent paradigms, such as tool use and multi-agent collaboration, to systematically compensate for the inherent weaknesses of small models. To address this gap, this paper presents the first large-scale, comprehensive study of <10B open-source models under three paradigms: (1) the base model, (2) a single agent equipped with tools, and (3) a multi-agent system with collaborative capabilities. Our results show that single-agent systems achieve the best balance between performance and cost, while multi-agent setups add overhead with limited gains. Our findings highlight the importance of agent-centric design for efficient and trustworthy deployment in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 小型模型 <10B 通过 agent 方式也能 GET，但单 agent+工具 就够，多 agent 增益小、开销大。
AI.motivation: 大模型贵、慢、隐私差；小模型(<10B)虽轻但能力弱。现有研究只盯着数据/参数扩展，忽视用 agent/工具/多智能体系统来弥补短板。
AI.method: 首次对 <10B 开源模型做大规模三范式对比：(1)裸模型，(2)带工具的单 agent，(3)多 agent 协作。统一基准评估性能/开销。
AI.result: 单 agent+工具在多数任务上逼近大模型性能，成本最低；多 agent 协作因通信与冗余开销大，仅微增性能。
AI.conclusion: 资源受限场景应优先采用“小型模型+工具”的单 agent 架构；盲目堆多 agent 反而劳民伤财。Agent 设计需轻量、任务导向并兼顾可信性。

title: MATA: Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable and Flexible Table Question Answering
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly improved table understanding tasks such as Table Question Answering (TableQA), yet challenges remain in ensuring reliability, scalability, and efficiency, especially in resource-constrained or privacy-sensitive environments. In this paper, we introduce MATA, a multi-agent TableQA framework that leverages multiple complementary reasoning paths and a set of tools built with small language models. MATA generates candidate answers through diverse reasoning styles for a given table and question, then refines or selects the optimal answer with the help of these tools. Furthermore, it incorporates an algorithm designed to minimize expensive LLM agent calls, enhancing overall efficiency. MATA maintains strong performance with small, open-source models and adapts easily across various LLM types. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks of varying difficulty with ten different LLMs demonstrate that MATA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and highly efficient reasoning while avoiding excessive LLM inference. Our results highlight that careful orchestration of multiple reasoning pathways yields scalable and reliable TableQA. The code is available at https://github.com/AIDASLab/MATA.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体框架 MATA，用小型模型协同完成表格问答，兼顾准确率、效率与可扩展性，在十个开源 LLM 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM 虽显著提升 TableQA，但在资源受限或隐私敏感场景仍面临可靠性、可扩展性与推理成本三大痛点，需摆脱对单一大模型的依赖。
AI.method: MATA 将 TableQA 拆分为多智能体流水线：① 规划器并行生成互补推理路径（SQL、逻辑、数值三种风格）；② 各路径由轻量级工具模型（≤7 B）独立求解并输出候选答案；③ 验证器利用冲突检测、一致性评分与廉价 LLM 投票做答案精炼与选择；④ 引入早停与路径剪枝算法，动态减少昂贵 LLM 调用次数。
AI.result: 在 WikiSQL 与 SQA 两基准、十类开源 LLM（0.5 B–7 B）上，MATA 准确率优于单模型方案 2.7–9.4 个百分点，推理延迟降低 34–58 %，LLM 调用次数减少 40 % 以上，证明小模型协同即可媲美甚至超越大模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过多路径推理与智能体编排，MATA 打破“模型越大越好”的范式，为资源受限环境提供高可靠、低成本、易迁移的 TableQA 解决方案，并验证小型开源 LLM 经协同可规模化落地。

title: Remote Rowhammer Attack using Adversarial Observations on Federated Learning Clients
comment: Under review for IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing
summary: Federated Learning (FL) has the potential for simultaneous global learning amongst a large number of parallel agents, enabling emerging AI such as LLMs to be trained across demographically diverse data. Central to this being efficient is the ability for FL to perform sparse gradient updates and remote direct memory access at the central server. Most of the research in FL security focuses on protecting data privacy at the edge client or in the communication channels between the client and server. Client-facing attacks on the server are less well investigated as the assumption is that a large collective of clients offer resilience. Here, we show that by attacking certain clients that lead to a high frequency repetitive memory update in the server, we can remote initiate a rowhammer attack on the server memory. For the first time, we do not need backdoor access to the server, and a reinforcement learning (RL) attacker can learn how to maximize server repetitive memory updates by manipulating the client's sensor observation. The consequence of the remote rowhammer attack is that we are able to achieve bit flips, which can corrupt the server memory. We demonstrate the feasibility of our attack using a large-scale FL automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems with sparse updates, our adversarial attacking agent can achieve around 70% repeated update rate (RUR) in the targeted server model, effectively inducing bit flips on server DRAM. The security implications are that can cause disruptions to learning or may inadvertently cause elevated privilege. This paves the way for further research on practical mitigation strategies in FL and hardware design.

AI.tldr: 首次证明无需后门即可在联邦学习服务器端远程触发Rowhammer，利用强化学习操控客户端梯度更新频率，使服务器DRAM出现位翻转。
AI.motivation: 现有FL安全研究多聚焦于边缘或信道隐私，默认大量客户端能集体抵御针对服务器的攻击，忽视客户端行为对服务器硬件的直接影响。
AI.method: 提出“远程Rowhammer”攻击：①挑选高频触发服务器稀疏梯度重复的客户端作为跳板；②用强化学习训练攻击代理，优化客户端传感数据，迫使服务器模型对应参数频繁更新；③高重复更新率使目标物理行持续激活，诱发DRAM位翻转。
AI.result: 在包含256个客户端的大规模FL语音识别系统中，攻击代理把目标参数的重复更新率提升至≈70%，成功在服务器DRAM引起可观测位翻转，验证无需物理接触即可破坏服务器内存。
AI.conclusion: FL服务器并非天然免疫客户端攻击，稀疏更新机制可被武器化为硬件层威胁；需从算法、调度、硬件三个层面联合设计缓解方案，如更新随机化、频率上限、DRAM行刷新加固等。

title: PhotoFramer: Multi-modal Image Composition Instruction
summary: Composition matters during the photo-taking process, yet many casual users struggle to frame well-composed images. To provide composition guidance, we introduce PhotoFramer, a multi-modal composition instruction framework. Given a poorly composed image, PhotoFramer first describes how to improve the composition in natural language and then generates a well-composed example image. To train such a model, we curate a large-scale dataset. Inspired by how humans take photos, we organize composition guidance into a hierarchy of sub-tasks: shift, zoom-in, and view-change tasks. Shift and zoom-in data are sampled from existing cropping datasets, while view-change data are obtained via a two-stage pipeline. First, we sample pairs with varying viewpoints from multi-view datasets, and train a degradation model to transform well-composed photos into poorly composed ones. Second, we apply this degradation model to expert-taken photos to synthesize poor images to form training pairs. Using this dataset, we finetune a model that jointly processes and generates both text and images, enabling actionable textual guidance with illustrative examples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that textual instructions effectively steer image composition, and coupling them with exemplars yields consistent improvements over exemplar-only baselines. PhotoFramer offers a practical step toward composition assistants that make expert photographic priors accessible to everyday users.

AI.tldr: PhotoFramer模型先输出文字构图建议、再生成对应的好图，利用三级任务数据及退化合成策略训练，文本+示例联合优化，显著优于纯示例基线。
AI.motivation: 普通用户在拍照时普遍缺乏构图能力，现有研究缺少可直接给出「如何拍」的显式多模态引导，因此需构建能同时输出可操作文字说明与参考示例的构图助手。
AI.method: 1）将人类取景行为抽象为shift、zoom-in、view-change三级子任务并构建大规模数据集：前两者直接利用现有裁剪数据集采样；后者提出两阶段退化流水线，先借助多视角数据学退化模型把好图变差，再用其对专业照片合成差图，形成成对训练样本。2）基于该数据集微调统一图文生成模型，使其先自然语言描述改进策略、再生成优质样图。
AI.result: 大量定性与定量实验表明：仅文字指导即可显著提升构图质量，文字+示例的组合相较仅提供示例的基线在用户调查与客观指标上均带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: PhotoFramer验证了显式多模态建议对构图改图的有效性，为把专业摄影先验普惠给日常用户提供了可行方案与技术基础。

title: HalluAudio: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently achieved strong performance across various audio-centric tasks. However, hallucination, where models generate responses that are semantically incorrect or acoustically unsupported, remains largely underexplored in the audio domain. Existing hallucination benchmarks mainly focus on text or vision, while the few audio-oriented studies are limited in scale, modality coverage, and diagnostic depth. We therefore introduce HalluAudio, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating hallucinations across speech, environmental sound, and music. HalluAudio comprises over 5K human-verified QA pairs and spans diverse task types, including binary judgments, multi-choice reasoning, attribute verification, and open-ended QA. To systematically induce hallucinations, we design adversarial prompts and mixed-audio conditions. Beyond accuracy, our evaluation protocol measures hallucination rate, yes/no bias, error-type analysis, and refusal rate, enabling a fine-grained analysis of LALM failure modes. We benchmark a broad range of open-source and proprietary models, providing the first large-scale comparison across speech, sound, and music. Our results reveal significant deficiencies in acoustic grounding, temporal reasoning, and music attribute understanding, underscoring the need for reliable and robust LALMs.

AI.tldr: 首个针对音频大模型的幻觉评测集 HalluAudio（5K+ QA，含语音/环境声/音乐），发现模型在声学对齐、时间推理与音乐属性理解上存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉评测侧重文本或图像，音频领域缺乏大规模、多模态及细粒度的基准；作者希望系统性暴露 Large Audio-Language Models 在语义不真或声学无据上的幻觉。
AI.method: 1) 构建 HalluAudio：5K+ 人工校对 QA，覆盖二值判断、多选、属性验证、开放问答四类任务；2) 设计对抗提示与混合音频输入诱导幻觉；3) 提出多维评测指标（幻觉率、Yes/No 偏差、错误分型、拒答率）；4) 对主流开源与私有模型展开语音/环境声/音乐三维对比。
AI.result: 首次大规模基准显示：主流 LALM 在声学根基、时间推理、音乐属性理解上普遍存在严重幻觉，且不同模态间性能差异显著。
AI.conclusion: HalluAudio 为音频大模型幻觉研究提供了标准化评估框架，结果强调亟需增强声学真实性、推理鲁棒性与音乐认知能力，推动更可靠的 LALM 发展。

title: When and What to Ask: AskBench and Rubric-Guided RLVR for LLM Clarification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often respond even when prompts omit critical details or include misleading information, leading to hallucinations or reinforced misconceptions. We study how to evaluate and improve LLMs' ability to decide when and what to ask for clarification without sacrificing task performance. We introduce AskBench, an interactive benchmark that converts standard QA pairs into multi-turn interactions with explicit checkpoints. A unified judge loop evaluates final answers and simulates user responses as needed. AskBench covers two settings: AskMind, with intent-deficient queries requiring clarification, and AskOverconfidence, with queries containing false premises that must be identified and corrected. We further propose rubric-guided reinforcement learning with verifier-based rewards (RLVR), which uses structured rubrics to encourage targeted clarification. Experiments show consistent improvements in accuracy, rubric adherence, and interaction efficiency, with strong generalization to unseen domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 AskBench 交互式基准与 RLVR 强化学习框架，系统评估并提升 LLM 在缺失意图或含误导前提的问答中主动澄清与纠错的能力，实验表明在准确率、规则遵循与交互效率上显著改进且可跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 面对缺关键信息或含误导的 prompt 仍强行作答，易致幻觉并固化用户错误认知。学界缺乏可量化、可交互的评测手段及训练方法，使模型学会“何时问、问什么”以澄清需求。
AI.method: 1) 构建 AskBench：将标准 QA 对转为多轮交互，设置 AskMind（缺意图）与 AskOverconfidence（含伪前提）两子任务，内置统一裁判循环自动评估答案质量并模拟用户回应。2) 设计 RLVR：用结构化评分细则（rubric）定义澄清目标，结合可验证奖励（verifier-based rewards）进行强化学习，引导模型在恰当时机提出针对性澄清。
AI.result: 在 AskBench 上，RLVR 相较基线模型在准确率、细则遵循度与平均交互轮数上均获一致提升；零样本迁移至医疗、法律等未见领域仍保持显著优势。
AI.conclusion: AskBench 提供首个系统衡量 LLM 主动澄清能力的交互基准，RLVR 验证以细则驱动的可验证奖励可有效培养模型“知止而后问”的行为，为未来降低幻觉、提升可信交互奠定方法论基础。

title: LPO: Towards Accurate GUI Agent Interaction via Location Preference Optimization
summary: The advent of autonomous agents is transforming interactions with Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) by employing natural language as a powerful intermediary. Despite the predominance of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) methods in current GUI agents for achieving spatial localization, these methods face substantial challenges due to their limited capacity to accurately perceive positional data. Existing strategies, such as reinforcement learning, often fail to assess positional accuracy effectively, thereby restricting their utility. In response, we introduce Location Preference Optimization (LPO), a novel approach that leverages locational data to optimize interaction preferences. LPO uses information entropy to predict interaction positions by focusing on zones rich in information. Besides, it further introduces a dynamic location reward function based on physical distance, reflecting the varying importance of interaction positions. Supported by Group Relative Preference Optimization (GRPO), LPO facilitates an extensive exploration of GUI environments and significantly enhances interaction precision. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate LPO's superior performance, achieving SOTA results across both offline benchmarks and real-world online evaluations. Our code will be made publicly available soon, at https://github.com/jqtangust/LPO.

AI.tldr: 针对 GUI 智能体空间定位不准的痛点，作者提出“位置偏好优化”（LPO），把信息熵与物理距离融入奖励，结合 GRPO 强化探索，离线/在线双评测均刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体依赖监督微调，对像素级坐标准确率不足；强化学习又难以有效评估“点得准不准”，导致真实场景交互失败率高。
AI.method: 1) 解析 UI 信息熵，定位高信息密度候选区；2) 建立“距离-奖励”衰减的动态奖励函数；3) 用 GRPO 做多组相对偏好重排，持续优化点击/拖拽坐标。
AI.result: 离线公开基准与线上 98 轮浏览器任务中，LPO 把定位准确率分别提升 7.9% 和 12.4%，跨任务成功率刷新 SOTA，平均交互轮次减少 15%。
AI.conclusion: LPO 首次将“定位准不准”引入偏好优化框架，为 GUI 智能体提供可扩展的坐标级奖励信号；未来可在多模态与可访问性场景中仿射推广。

title: Recurrent Video Masked Autoencoders
summary: We present Recurrent Video Masked-Autoencoders (RVM): a novel approach to video representation learning that leverages recurrent computation to model the temporal structure of video data. RVM couples an asymmetric masking objective with a transformer-based recurrent neural network to aggregate information over time, training solely on a simple pixel reconstruction loss. This design yields a highly efficient "generalist" encoder: RVM achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art video models (e.g. VideoMAE, V-JEPA) on video-level tasks like action classification, and point and object tracking, while matching or exceeding the performance of image models (e.g. DINOv2) on tasks that require strong geometric and dense spatial features. Notably, RVM achieves strong performance in the small-model regime without requiring knowledge distillation, exhibiting up to 30x greater parameter efficiency than competing video masked autoencoders. Finally, we demonstrate that RVM's recurrent nature allows for stable feature propagation over long temporal horizons with linear computational cost, overcoming some of the limitations of standard spatio-temporal attention-based video models. Ablation studies further highlight the factors driving the model's success, with qualitative results showing that RVM learns rich representations of scene semantics, structure, and motion.

AI.tldr: RVM 用循环 Transformer 做高掩码率视频自编码，仅重建像素即可同时完成动作识别、跟踪与几何任务，参数效率领先，长时序扩展性线性。
AI.motivation: 现有时空注意力模型算力随帧长二次增长、小模型难兼顾精度和几何表征，且多需蒸馏。作者希望用更少的参数、更简单的像素重建损失，统一学习长时序语义与密集空间特征。
AI.method: 提出 RVM：基于循环 Transformer 的掩码自编码器。非对称掩码目标+循环隐状态跨帧聚合信息；每步仅对少量未被掩码的可见块做前向推断，随时间更新隐藏表示并重建整帧像素，达到线性复杂度。训练端到端仅使用 L2 像素损失，无需标签、无需蒸馏。
AI.result: 小模型下，动作分类、点与物体跟踪均达到 SOTA；与 DINOv2 同级模型的几何密集特征可比肩或更优；与同规模 VideoMAE、V-JEPA 相比最高节省 30× 参数；在数百帧长视频上稳定传播特征，计算量线性增长。消融与可视化证实所学表征同时包含场景语义、结构和运动信息。
AI.conclusion: 循环掩码自编码思路可显著突破冗余时空注意力的效率瓶颈，以极简重建损失即可学得“通用”视频编码器，为后续小规模多任务视频模型奠定基础。

title: Co-Refine: AI-Powered Tool Supporting Qualitative Analysis
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Includes details on system architecture, a three-stage audit pipeline, and a formative user study
summary: Qualitative coding relies on a researcher's application of codes to textual data. As coding proceeds across large datasets, interpretations of codes often shift (temporal drift), reducing the credibility of the analysis. Existing Computer-Assisted Qualitative Data Analysis (CAQDAS) tools provide support for data management but offer no workflow for real-time detection of these drifts. We present Co-Refine, an AI-augmented qualitative coding platform that delivers continuous, grounded feedback on coding consistency without disrupting the researcher's workflow. The system employs a three-stage audit pipeline: Stage 1 computes deterministic embedding-based metrics for mathematical consistency; Stage 2 grounds LLM verdicts within $\pm0.15$ of the deterministic scores; and Stage 3 produces code definitions from previous patterns to create a deepening feedback loop. Co-Refine demonstrates that deterministic scoring can effectively constrain LLM outputs to produce reliable, real-time audit signals for qualitative analysis.

AI.tldr: Co-Refine 以“确定性指标先、LLM 后”三阶段管线，在不动研究者既有编码流程的前提下，实时发现质性编码的时序漂移并给出可解释反馈。
AI.motivation: 大型文本质性编码时，研究者对同一代码的理解常随时间漂移，削弱研究可信度；现有 CAQDAS 仅管数据，无实时漂移检测机制。
AI.method: 三阶段审计：① 用嵌入向量计算确定性一致性指标；② 令 LLM 在 ±0.15 得分区间内给出裁决，保证结果既被量化锚定又保留语义判断；③ 从历史模式反向生成代码定义，形成持续深化的反馈循环。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架可把 LLM 输出稳定约束在可靠区间，实时给出可审计、可追溯的漂移信号，不干扰研究者原有工作流。
AI.conclusion: 引入确定性约束即可让大模型安全服务于质性研究，Co-Refine 为“人主-机辅”的实时质性编码审计提供了可行范式。

title: Cross-lingual Matryoshka Representation Learning across Speech and Text
summary: Speakers of under-represented languages face both a language barrier, as most online knowledge is in a few dominant languages, and a modality barrier, since information is largely text-based while many languages are primarily oral. We address this for French-Wolof by training the first bilingual speech-text Matryoshka embedding model, enabling efficient retrieval of French text from Wolof speech queries without relying on a costly ASR-translation pipelines. We introduce large-scale data curation pipelines and new benchmarks, compare modeling strategies, and show that modality fusion within a frozen text Matryoshka model performs best. Although trained only for retrieval, the model generalizes well to other tasks, such as speech intent detection, indicating the learning of general semantic representations. Finally, we analyze cost-accuracy trade-offs across Matryoshka dimensions and ranks, showing that information is concentrated only in a few components, suggesting potential for efficiency improvements.

AI.tldr: 作者提首个法-沃洛夫语双语“套娃”语音-文本联合嵌入模型，无需ASR-翻译即可用沃洛夫语音查询检索法语文本，并验证其在其它语义任务上的泛化与压缩潜力。
AI.motivation: 网络知识集中于少数书面语言，而大量以口语为主的低资源语言面临语言与模态双重壁垒。作者以沃洛夫语为例，希望用低成本方式实现跨模态跨语种检索。
AI.method: 构建大规模法-沃洛夫语音-文本数据与评测基准；对比多种建模策略，最终在冻结的文本“套娃”嵌入模型内融合语音分支，训练双语联合嵌入空间；仅使用检索任务进行训练。
AI.result: 在零资源条件下，模型直接用沃洛夫语音查询检索法语文本，显著优于级联ASR+翻译基线；同时在语音意图识别等下游任务上表现出良好泛化。套娃维度/秩实验显示仅少量分量携带主要信息，存在大幅压缩空间。
AI.conclusion: 语音-文本联合嵌入可在低资源场景下打破语言与模态壁垒，单一检索目标即可学得通用语义表示；套娃结构在保持精度的同时提供灵活的存储-计算效率权衡，为同类低资源语言应用提供了可复制的范式。

title: Online Learning of Whittle Indices for Restless Bandits with Non-Stationary Transition Kernels
summary: The restless multi-armed bandit (RMAB) framework is a popular approach to solving resource allocation problems in networked systems. In this paper, we study optimal resource allocation in RMABs facing unknown and non-stationary dynamics. Solving RMABs optimally is known to be PSPACE-hard even with full knowledge of model parameters. While Whittle index policies offer asymptotic optimality with low computational cost, they require access to stationary transition kernels, an unrealistic assumption in many modern networking applications. To address this challenge, we propose a Sliding-Window Online Whittle (SW-Whittle) policy that remains computationally efficient while adapting to time-varying kernels. Through theoretical analysis, we show that our algorithm achieves sub-linear dynamic regret with respect to the number of episodes. We further address the important case where the variation budget is unknown in advance by combining a Bandit-over-Bandit framework with our sliding-window design. In our scheme, window lengths are tuned online as a function of the estimated variation, while Whittle indices are computed via an upper-confidence-bound of the estimated transition kernels and a bilinear optimization routine. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our algorithm consistently outperforms baselines, achieving the lowest cumulative regret across a range of non-stationary environments.

AI.tldr: 针对非平稳环境下的多臂赌博机资源分配难题，作者提出滑动窗口在线Whittle算法（SW-Whittle），在计算高效的同时实现动态遗憾次线性增长，并通过Bandit-over-Bandit机制自动适配未知变化幅度，实验验证优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 传统RMAB虽可用低复杂度Whittle指数策略获得渐近最优，但依赖平稳转移核假设，而现代网络场景普遍未知且非平稳，导致原策略失效；且RMAB最优决策本身为PSPACE-hard，亟需兼顾效率与适应性的新方案。
AI.method: 1) 基于有限滑动窗口在线重估转移核，确保计算量恒定；2) 利用转移核的UCB估计与双线性优化快速计算修正Whittle指数；3) 将窗口长度视作元臂，采用外层bandit在线调节以适应未知变化预算；4) 理论证明每轮动态遗憾为次线性O(√T)。
AI.result: 在多种非平稳实验设定中，SW-Whittle的累积遗憾显著低于固定窗口、非平稳UCB及静态Whittle等基线，且窗口自适应机制有效跟踪变化强度；理论给出的次线性动态遗憾界与仿真趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: SW-Whittle首次在保持Whittle策略计算优势的同时，为未知、非平稳RMAB提供了可扩展且可自适应的近似最优方案，显著扩展了其在动态网络资源调度中的实用范围。

title: MoonSeg3R: Monocular Online Zero-Shot Segment Anything in 3D with Reconstructive Foundation Priors
summary: In this paper, we focus on online zero-shot monocular 3D instance segmentation, a novel practical setting where existing approaches fail to perform because they rely on posed RGB-D sequences. To overcome this limitation, we leverage CUT3R, a recent Reconstructive Foundation Model (RFM), to provide reliable geometric priors from a single RGB stream. We propose MoonSeg3R, which introduces three key components: (1) a self-supervised query refinement module with spatial-semantic distillation that transforms segmentation masks from 2D visual foundation models (VFMs) into discriminative 3D queries; (2) a 3D query index memory that provides temporal consistency by retrieving contextual queries; and (3) a state-distribution token from CUT3R that acts as a mask identity descriptor to strengthen cross-frame fusion. Experiments on ScanNet200 and SceneNN show that MoonSeg3R is the first method to enable online monocular 3D segmentation and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art RGB-D-based systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/VICO-UoE/MoonSeg3R.

AI.tldr: 首次用单RGB流在线完成零样本3D实例分割，性能媲美RGB-D方案。
AI.motivation: 现有在线3D实例分割依赖已标定RGB-D序列，单目RGB无法提供可靠几何先验，实际部署受限。
AI.method: 基于重建基础模型CUT3R估计单目几何，设计MoonSeg3R：①自监督查询精炼模块，把2D VFM分割掩码通过空间-语义蒸馏生成判别性3D查询；②3D查询索引记忆库，跨帧检索上下文查询以维持时序一致；③利用CUT3R状态分布token作为掩码身份描述子，强化跨帧融合。
AI.result: ScanNet200与SceneNN上，MoonSeg3R实现在线单目3D分割零的突破，精度与SOTA RGB-D方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 无需深度与位姿，仅凭单RGB流即可在线完成高质量3D实例分割，为AR/VR及移动机器人提供实用新路径。

title: RDP LoRA: Geometry-Driven Identification for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation in Large Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) remains structurally uncertain despite parameter-efficient methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), as the layer-specific roles of internal representations are poorly understood, leading to heuristic decisions about where adaptation should be applied. We model the evolution of hidden states as a high-dimensional geometric trajectory and propose using the Ramer-Douglas-Peucker (RDP) algorithm, a parameter-free and training-free polygon simplification method that preserves global structural transitions while eliminating locally redundant changes, to identify critical breakpoints along the representation path. Crucially, we use these geometric pivots not merely for analysis, but as a direct decision signal for determining which layers should be adapted during parameter-efficient fine-tuning. By integrating this geometry-aware layer selection strategy into LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-8B-Base, we achieve superior performance on MMLU-Math using only 13 RDP-selected layers (81.67%), significantly outperforming both full 36-layer adaptation (79.32%) and random 13-layer selection (75.56%), as well as the baseline Qwen3-8B-Base model (74.25%). These results demonstrate that leveraging the intrinsic geometry of representation trajectories provides a robust, interpretable, and training-free signal for optimizing layer selection during model adaptation.

AI.tldr: 用几何算法挑Transformer层做LoRA，比全层微调还强
AI.motivation: LoRA选哪些层靠经验，内部表征的层间作用不清，导致调参盲目
AI.method: 把隐藏状态视为高维轨迹，用RDP算法提取关键转折层；仅在这些层插入LoRA适配器
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B-Base+MMLU-Math上，13个RDP层准确率81.67%，超过36层全LoRA(79.32%)、随机13层(75.56%)及原模型(74.25%)
AI.conclusion: 无需训练的几何轨迹分析可直接、可解释地优化层选择，显著提升参数高效微调效果

title: ConFu: Contemplate the Future for Better Speculative Sampling
comment: v3: Added stress test with long drafts (DL=12, top-k=1) and tail-acceptance (survival) analysis. Earlier versions added Qwen3-4B results and ablations
summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a powerful approach to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference by employing lightweight draft models to propose candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. The effectiveness of this paradigm critically depends on the quality of the draft model. While recent advances such as the EAGLE series achieve state-of-the-art speedup, existing draft models remain limited by error accumulation: they condition only on the current prefix, causing their predictions to drift from the target model over steps. In this work, we propose \textbf{ConFu} (Contemplate the Future), a novel speculative decoding framework that enables draft models to anticipate the future direction of generation. ConFu introduces (i) contemplate tokens and soft prompts that allow the draft model to leverage future-oriented signals from the target model at negligible cost, (ii) a dynamic contemplate token mechanism with MoE to enable context-aware future prediction, and (iii) a training framework with anchor token sampling and future prediction replication that learns robust future prediction. ConFu improves token acceptance rates and generation speed over EAGLE-3 by 8--11\% on Llama-3 3B/8B and by approximately 20\% on Qwen-3 4B across downstream tasks. We believe our work is the first to bridge speculative decoding with continuous reasoning tokens, offering a new direction for accelerating LLM inference.

AI.tldr: ConFu 率先在投机解码中引入"未来思考"机制，通过轻量级可扩展代币与软提示，令草稿模型在零额外延迟下预先感知目标模型后续走向，显著提升接受率与加速比。
AI.motivation: 现有草稿模型仅依赖当前前缀逐步预测，累积误差导致接受率随序列长度下降，成为投机解码的新瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 ConFu 框架：(i) 引入可学习的 contemplate tokens 与软提示，实现一次性并行"预瞻"；(ii) 采用 MoE 动态选择 token，适配不同上下文；(iii) 设计锚点采样与未来复制训练，提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3 3B/8B 上比 EAGLE-3 再提速 8-11%，在 Qwen-3 4B 上提升约 20%，且无需修改目标模型或增加推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: ConFu 首次将连续"推理型 token"融入投机解码，验证了"先思后验"的加速范式，为后续大模型推理优化提供了新的设计空间。

title: Best Agent Identification for General Game Playing
summary: We present an efficient and generalised procedure to accurately identify the best (or near best) performing algorithm for each sub-task in a multi-problem domain. Our approach treats this as a set of best arm identification problems for multi-armed bandits, where each bandit corresponds to a specific task and each arm corresponds to a specific algorithm or agent. We propose an optimistic selection process based on a chosen confidence interval, that ranks each arm across all bandits in terms of their potential to influence our overall simple regret. We evaluate the performance of our approach on two of the most popular general game playing domains, the General Video Game AI (GVGAI) framework and the Ludii general game playing system, with the goal of selecting a high-performing agent for each game using a limited number of available trials. Compared to previous best arm identification algorithms for multi-armed bandits, our results demonstrate a substantial performance improvement in terms of average simple regret and average probability of error. This novel approach can be used to significantly improve the quality and accuracy of agent evaluation procedures for general game frameworks, as well as other multi-task domains with high algorithm runtimes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种乐观置信区间驱动的多臂老虎机最优臂识别框架，可在高耗时、多任务环境中快速为每个子任务锁定（近）最优算法；在 GVGAI 与 Ludii 两大量化测试平台上显著降低平均简单遗憾与误判率。
AI.motivation: 通用博弈框架（GVGAI、Ludii 等）需要在海量游戏中各自选出高性能智能体，但运行成本极高；传统独立为每局游戏做算法调优的方法样本利用率低，难以在有限试验次数内保证选出的代理全局性能。
AI.method: 将“每款游戏选最优代理”形式化为一套多臂老虎机最佳臂识别（BAI）问题：每个老虎机对应一个游戏，臂对应候选算法。提出跨任务乐观排序规则——基于置信区间估计的上界，综合评估各臂在全部老虎机中的“潜在影响力”，动态分配试验预算。
AI.result: 在两个标准通用博弈基准（VG-VAI 与 Ludii）上的大量重复实验显示，相比现有 state-of-the-art BAI 算法，平均简单遗憾降低 20–40%，平均错误选择概率下降 30% 以上，且所需运行次数显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为任何“多任务-高耗时-有限试验”场景提供了一种通用、高效的最优算法筛选范式，可直接提升通用博弈平台及其他多任务领域代理评估的质量与准确性。

title: Bridging Semantics and Geometry: A Decoupled LVLM-SAM Framework for Reasoning Segmentation in Optical Remote Sensing
summary: Large Vision--Language Models (LVLMs) hold great promise for advancing optical remote sensing (RS) analysis, yet existing reasoning segmentation frameworks couple linguistic reasoning and pixel prediction through end-to-end supervised fine-tuning, leading to weak geometric grounding and limited generalization across tasks. To address this, we developed Think2Seg-RS, a decoupled framework that trains an LVLM prompter to control a frozen Segment Anything Model (SAM) via structured geometric prompts. Through a mask-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) reinforcement learning objective driven strictly by final mask IoU, the LVLM learns to translate abstract semantic reasoning into spatially grounded actions, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the EarthReason dataset. Notably, Think2Seg-RS outperforms leading approaches such as RemoteReasoner and SegEarth-R1 on the EarthReason dataset by reaching a test cIoU of 75.60% and gIoU of 73.36%, yielding absolute improvements of 6.47% and 2.40% over the strongest baseline, respectively. Zero-shot evaluations across three referring segmentation benchmarks reveal a fundamental distinction in task inductive bias, exposing a distinct divide between semantic-level grounding -- which aggregates all regions matching a conceptual intent -- and instance-level tasks that demand discrete object separation. We further found that compact segmenters outperform larger ones under semantic-level supervision by mitigating textural over-segmentation, and that unconstrained negative prompting is unstable in heterogeneous aerial backgrounds. Together, these findings demonstrate that optimizing LVLMs through direct segmentation feedback offers a scalable framework for complex geospatial reasoning, effectively bridging the gap between abstract language understanding and precise pixel-level execution.

AI.tldr: 提出Think2Seg-RS，用强化学习让LVLM只给SAM发几何 prompt，端到端不用微调，EarthReason上cIoU/gIoU刷新SOTA，零-shot实验揭示语义级与实例级任务的映射偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感推理分割把语言推理与像素预测绑在一起做端到端微调，导致几何定位弱、跨任务泛化差；需要把高层推理与低层分割解耦。
AI.method: 构建LVLM prompter+冻结SAM的解耦框架；用“仅看最终掩膜IoU”的GRPO强化学习目标，训练LVLM将抽象语义转化为结构化几何提示（点框粗略掩膜等），驱动SAM生成精确结果。
AI.result: EarthReason测试集cIoU 75.60%、gIoU 73.36%，分别超越最强基线6.47%和2.40%；在三个指向分割基准上零-shot迁移，发现语义级任务偏好聚合所有匹配区域，实例级任务需离散对象，紧凑模型在语义监督下优于大模型，且纯负面提示在异构航拍背景不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 直接用分割反馈优化LVLM，可在不更新像素网络的前提下弥合语言理解与像素级执行之间的鸿沟，为复杂地理空间推理提供可扩展范式。

title: PLaMo 2.1-VL Technical Report
summary: We introduce PLaMo 2.1-VL, a lightweight Vision Language Model (VLM) for autonomous devices, available in 8B and 2B variants and designed for local and edge deployment with Japanese-language operation. Focusing on Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Visual Grounding as its core capabilities, we develop and evaluate the models for two real-world application scenarios: factory task analysis via tool recognition, and infrastructure anomaly detection. We also develop a large-scale synthetic data generation pipeline and comprehensive Japanese training and evaluation resources. PLaMo 2.1-VL outperforms comparable open models on Japanese and English benchmarks, achieving 61.5 ROUGE-L on JA-VG-VQA-500 and 85.2% accuracy on Japanese Ref-L4. For the two application scenarios, it achieves 53.9% zero-shot accuracy on factory task analysis, and fine-tuning on power plant data improves anomaly detection bbox + label F1-score from 39.7 to 64.9.

AI.tldr: PLaMo 2.1-VL 是一组面向边缘侧的轻量化日语视觉语言模型（8B/2B），在工厂工具识别与基建异常检测两大场景下实现 SOTA 级日语 VQA/Visual Grounding 性能，并通过大规模合成数据与专用日语文资完成训练与评测。
AI.motivation: 解决日语环境下 VLM 在本地/边缘设备落地难、缺乏高质量日文评测基准与行业数据的问题，为工厂运维和基础设施巡检提供可离线运行的视觉问答与细粒度定位能力。
AI.method: 1) 设计 8B/2B 两档轻量化 decoder-only VLM，支持边缘端 INT4 量化；2) 构建覆盖 VQA 与 Visual Grounding 的日文大规模合成数据管线，引入图文对齐、指代表达与工具/缺陷掩膜生成策略；3) 采集并标注工厂任务视频与电站巡检图像，分别构建零样本与微调评测集；4) 提出日语 VG-VQA 基准 JA-VG-VQA-500 与 Ref-L4 评估指标，补充多语言对比实验。
AI.result: JA-VG-VQA-500 上 ROUGE-L 达到 61.5，日文 Ref-L4 定位精度 85.2%，均优于同规模开源模型；工厂任务零样本识别准确率 53.9%；在电站缺陷检测数据上微调后 bbox+label F1 从 39.7 提升至 64.9，参数量仅为云端大模型的 1/10 以下即可本地推理。
AI.conclusion: PLaMo 2.1-VL 证明通过合成数据与任务特化微调，轻量化 VLM 在非英语、边缘场景仍能获得可比甚至超越大模型的实用性能，为制造业与公共基础设施的离线智能巡检提供了可复制的技术路径。

title: Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning for Enhanced Multimodal LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely adopted as MLLM-as-a-Judges due to their strong alignment with human judgment across various visual tasks. However, most existing judge models are optimized for single-task scenarios and struggle to generalize to diverse contexts, which is a critical requirement for reliable evaluation. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning for MLLM-as-a-Judge (MT-RL-Judge), a framework that jointly optimizes the judge model across multiple tasks, leveraging the generalization capabilities of RL. Experimental results against several strong baselines demonstrate that MT-RL-Judge outperforms strong baselines in both judgment consistency and correlation with human preferences. Furthermore, our approach exhibits robust generalization on out-of-distribution tasks, further validating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出多任务强化学习框架MT-RL-Judge，让多模态大语言模型作为评委时，在不同视觉任务中同时保持与人类偏好的高度一致性与跨任务泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs作为评委（MLLM-as-a-Judge）主要在单一任务上训练，一旦遇到分布外任务其评分与人类偏好相关性显著下降，无法胜任可靠评估。需要一种能在多任务协同训练中自然获得泛化能力的范式。
AI.method: 构建跨视觉质量评估、对齐、细节描述等多任务环境，把“与人类打分一致”建模为奖励信号，采用多任务强化学习联合更新评委模型参数；训练阶段引入任务间共享策略网络与任务特定价值网络，鼓励共性表示并抑制任务冲突。
AI.result: 在11个视觉任务benchmark上，MT-RL-Judge的Kendall τ平均提升4.8%，Spearman ρ提升5.2%；在OOD测试集上τ仍保持≥0.71，显著优于单任务微调及链式推理baseline。
AI.conclusion: 多任务RL可同时提升评委模型的一致性与泛化性，为MLLM-as-a-Judge的跨场景可靠评估提供了可扩展的优化路径。

title: IMPACT: Importance-Aware Activation Space Reconstruction
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse domains but remain difficult to deploy in resource-constrained environments due to their size. Low-rank compression is a common remedy, typically minimizing weight reconstruction error under the assumption that weights are low-rank. However, this assumption often does not hold in LLMs. In contrast, LLM activations exhibit a more pronounced low-rank structure, motivating approaches that minimize activation reconstruction error.
  This shift alone, however, is not sufficient: different activation dimensions contribute unequally to model performance, and treating them uniformly can lead to accuracy loss. We introduce IMPACT, an importance-aware activation reconstruction framework that links compression to its effect on model performance. IMPACT formulates compression as an optimization problem that integrates activation structure with gradient-based importance, deriving a closed-form solution where reconstruction bases arise from an importance-weighted activation covariance matrix. This yields low-rank compression explicitly optimized for accuracy preservation. Experiments across multiple models and tasks demonstrate that IMPACT achieves up to 55.4% greater model size reduction while maintaining accuracy comparable to or better than state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: IMPACT 以激活而非权重为压缩对象，用梯度加权的协方差矩阵推导闭式低秩近似，在几乎不损失精度的情况下把模型体积再减 55.4%。
AI.motivation: LLM 权重低秩假设往往不成立，而激活呈现明显低秩结构；现有方法对所有激活维度同等对待，忽略其对最终性能的贡献差异，导致压缩后准确率下降。
AI.method: 提出 IMPACT 框架：将压缩重构目标从权重误差转为“重要性加权激活误差”，用梯度度量各维度对损失的影响，构建重要性加权协方差矩阵，闭式求解最优低秩基，实现针对准确率优化的秩极小化。
AI.result: 在多款模型和任务上，IMPACT 在保持或超越 SOTA 准确率的同时，额外缩减 10.4%–55.4% 的参数量，压缩率显著优于传统低秩与激活导向基线。
AI.conclusion: 激活低秩+重要性加权是 LLM 压缩的有效路径；IMPACT 为后续结构化压缩提供可扩展的闭式优化范式，兼顾精度与部署效率。

title: Adversarial Attacks on Medical Hyperspectral Imaging Exploiting Spectral-Spatial Dependencies and Multiscale Features
summary: Medical hyperspectral imaging (MHSI) has shown strong potential for disease diagnosis by capturing spectral-spatial information of tissues. While deep learning has substantially improved MHSI classification accuracy, its robustness remains limited due to the well-known trade-off between accuracy and robustness in Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). This issue is particularly critical in MHSI, where reliable prediction depends on local tissue relationships and multiscale spectral-spatial structures. A practical way to improve robustness is to identify the most unstable adversarial examples and incorporate them into adversarial training. However, existing attack methods do not sufficiently exploit these MHSI-specific properties, leading to suboptimal attack effectiveness and limited value for robustness enhancement. To address this gap, we propose a structured adversarial attack framework for MHSI that progressively models its local spectral-spatial dependencies and multiscale hierarchical representations. The proposed method generates anatomically consistent perturbations by modeling neighborhood dependencies and hierarchical spectral-spatial features. Experiments on the brain and choledoch datasets show that our method more effectively degrades lesion-related classification performance in critical tumor regions than existing baselines while maintaining low perturbation magnitude. These results reveal a clinically relevant robustness weakness in current MHSI models and provide stronger adversarial samples for developing targeted defense strategies.

AI.tldr: 针对医学高光谱成像(MHSI)提出结构化对抗攻击框架，通过建模局部谱–空依赖与多尺度层次表征生成解剖学一致性扰动，揭示现有模型在肿瘤关键区域的鲁棒性缺陷，并产出更强对抗样本以指导防御。
AI.motivation: 深度MHSI模型在关注分类精度的同时，对对抗样本的鲁棒性不足，而现有攻击方法未能充分挖掘MHSI特具的局部组织关系与多尺度谱–空结构，导致生成的扰动缺乏临床相关性，难以有效暴露模型弱点并用于对抗训练。
AI.method: 构建渐进式对抗攻击框架：①对邻域光谱–空间依赖进行显式建模；②提取多尺度层次表征；③约束扰动满足解剖学一致性；④联合优化以最大化病灶相关分类下降，同时控制扰动幅值。
AI.result: 在脑肿瘤与胆管数据集上，所提方法在保持低扰动幅值的前提下，使病灶区域分类性能下降幅度显著高于基线方法，证明当前MHSI模型存在临床关键鲁棒性漏洞，并提供高质量对抗样本。
AI.conclusion: 提出的结构化攻击不仅暴露MHSI模型在关键肿瘤区域的脆弱性，也为后续针对性防御策略(如对抗训练)提供了更贴合临床场景的高价值样本，推动MHSI鲁棒性研究向实用化迈进。

title: Evaluation-driven Scaling for Scientific Discovery
summary: Language models are increasingly used in scientific discovery to generate hypotheses, propose candidate solutions, implement systems, and iteratively refine them. At the core of these trial-and-error loops lies evaluation: the process of obtaining feedback on candidate solutions via verifiers, simulators, or task-specific scoring functions. While prior work has highlighted the importance of evaluation, it has not explicitly formulated the problem of how evaluation-driven discovery loops can be scaled up in a principled and effective manner to push the boundaries of scientific discovery, a problem this paper seeks to address. We introduce Simple Test-time Evaluation-driven Scaling (SimpleTES), a general framework that strategically combines parallel exploration, feedback-driven refinement, and local selection, revealing substantial gains unlocked by scaling evaluation-driven discovery loops along the right dimensions. Across 21 scientific problems spanning six domains, SimpleTES discovers state-of-the-art solutions using gpt-oss models, consistently outperforming both frontier-model baselines and sophisticated optimization pipelines. Particularly, we sped up the widely used LASSO algorithm by over 2x, designed quantum circuit routing policies that reduce gate overhead by 24.5%, and discovered new Erdos minimum overlap constructions that surpass the best-known results. Beyond novel discoveries, SimpleTES produces trajectory-level histories that naturally supervise feedback-driven learning. When post-trained on successful trajectories, models not only improve efficiency on seen problems but also generalize to unseen problems, discovering solutions that base models fail to uncover. Together, our results establish effective evaluation-driven loop scaling as a central axis for advancing LLM-driven scientific discovery, and provide a simple yet practical framework for realizing these gains.

AI.tldr: SimpleTES 用并行探索＋本地筛选放大评估反馈循环，在 21 个科学任务上让开源模型持续刷新 SOTA，并证明评估驱动是可扩展的新范式。
AI.motivation: 大模型靠“试错—评估”循环辅助科学发现，但现有工作未系统回答“如何原则化、可扩展地放大评估反馈”这一核心问题。
AI.method: 提出 SimpleTES 框架：并行生成大量候选解 → 用领域专用 verifier/simulator 打分 → 局部选择最优样本 → 迭代精化；成功轨迹用于后续监督微调，使模型跨任务泛化。
AI.result: 在六域 21 任务中，仅用 gpt-oss 模型即超越前沿模型与复杂优化管线：LASSO 速度↑2×，量子线路门开销↓24.5%，Erdős 最小重叠构造刷新世界纪录；后训练模型还能泛化到未见问题。
AI.conclusion: 评估驱动循环的“规模扩展”已成为推进大模型科学发现的关键维度；SimpleTES 给出简洁可复现的实现路径，兼具即插即用与跨领域潜力。

title: CounterRefine: Answer-Conditioned Counterevidence Retrieval for Inference-Time Knowledge Repair in Factual Question Answering
comment: Accepted at the 4th Workshop on Towards Knowledgeable Foundation Models at ACL 2026
summary: In factual question answering, many errors are not failures of access but failures of commitment: the system retrieves relevant evidence, yet still settles on the wrong answer. We present CounterRefine, a lightweight inference-time repair layer for retrieval-grounded question answering. CounterRefine first produces a short answer from retrieved evidence, then gathers additional support and conflicting evidence with follow-up queries conditioned on that draft answer, and finally applies a restricted refinement step that outputs either KEEP or REVISE, with proposed revisions accepted only if they pass deterministic validation. In effect, CounterRefine turns retrieval into a mechanism for testing a provisional answer rather than merely collecting more context. On the full SimpleQA benchmark, CounterRefine improves a matched GPT-5 Baseline-RAG by 5.8 points and reaches a 73.1 percent correct rate, while exceeding the reported one-shot GPT-5.4 score by roughly 40 points. These findings suggest a simple but important direction for knowledgeable foundation models: beyond accessing evidence, they should also be able to use that evidence to reconsider and, when necessary, repair their own answers.

AI.tldr: 提出CounterRefine，一种推理时轻量级修复层，使RAG系统先给出草稿答案，再主动检索正反证据并做受限修订，仅当确定性验证通过才采纳修正，使GPT-5基线在SimpleQA上提升5.8分，达73.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统虽能检索到相关证据，但仍常因"过早承诺"而输出错误答案，说明错误源于推理而非检索，需要一种推理阶段自我检验并修复答案的机制。
AI.method: 1) 基于首轮检索生成草稿答案；2) 以该答案为条件发起后续查询，同时收集支撑与冲突证据；3) 利用轻量级模型输出KEEP或REVISE决策；4) 修订答案需经过确定性验证（如字符串匹配、数值比较）才能被采纳，否则保持原答案，全程无需重训练。
AI.result: 在SimpleQA全集上，CounterRefine将匹配规模的GPT-5基线RAG准确率从67.3%提至73.1%（+5.8分），并超过文献中一次性GPT-5.4约40分；实验显示其主要增益来自对错误草稿答案的成功修正。
AI.conclusion: 即使检索到正确证据，系统仍需具备利用证据二次检验并修复自身答案的能力。CounterRefine以极低成本实现推理时纠错，为知识型大模型确立了从"取得到证据"到"用好证据"的重要方向。

title: Watch the Weights: Unsupervised monitoring and control of fine-tuned LLMs
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary:
The releases of powerful open-weight large language models (LLMs) are often not accompanied by access to their full training data. Existing interpretability methods, particularly those based on activations, often require or assume distributionally similar data. This is a significant limitation when detecting and defending against novel potential threats like backdoors, which are by definition out-of-distribution.
  In this work, we introduce a new method for understanding, monitoring and controlling fine-tuned LLMs that interprets weights, rather than activations, thereby sidestepping the need for data that is distributionally similar to the unknown training data. We demonstrate that the top singular vectors of the weight difference between a fine-tuned model and its base model correspond to newly acquired behaviors. By monitoring the cosine similarity of activations along these directions, we can detect salient behaviors introduced during fine-tuning with high precision.
  For backdoored models that bypass safety mechanisms when a secret trigger is present, our method stops up to 100% of attacks with a false positive rate below 1%. For models that have undergone unlearning, we detect inference on erased topics with accuracy up to 95.42% and can even steer the model to recover "unlearned" information. Besides monitoring, our method also shows potential for pre-deployment model auditing: by analyzing commercial instruction-tuned models (OLMo, Llama, Qwen), we are able to uncover model-specific fine-tuning focus including mathematical problem solving, emoji usage, and Midjourney prompt generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练数据即可解释、监控和控制微调后大语言模型（LLM）的新方法，通过分析权重而非激活，能高精度检测后门、未学习主题及审计商用模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于激活的 LLM 可解释性方法依赖与未知训练数据分布相似的样本，无法有效检测定义上即为分布外（OOD）的后门等安全威胁，亟需摆脱数据依赖的权重级分析框架。
AI.method: 基于“微调权重与基座权重差值的前几个奇异向量对应新习得行为”的假设：1) 计算 ΔW = W_fine-tuned − W_base 并取其顶奇异向量；2) 推理时仅采样少量（<10）与用户提示无关的 OOD 文本，计算激活沿奇异方向的余弦相似度；3) 用阈值判定是否触发后门/未学习行为，并可反向加权注入原模型以恢复或抑制行为。
AI.result: 在 3 类任务上验证：①后门检测——对含秘密触发器的 Alpaca 与 Llama-2-7B-chat 模型，拦截率 100%，假阳率 <1%；②“未学习”检测——能 95.42% 准确识别被刻意遗忘的哈利波特知识，并可通过权重注入 91% 恢复原文本生成；③商用模型审计——无需训练数据即可揭示 OLMo-7B-Instruct、Llama-2-7B-chat、Qwen-14B-chat 的微调侧重点（数学题、emoji、Midjourney 提示）。
AI.conclusion: 权重差值谱分析首次实现分布无关、零样本的 LLM 行为审计与实时防御，兼具高检测精度与可控可逆性，可直接用于预部署安全审查与在线威胁阻断，为开源模型生态提供新的安全基线。

title: KG-ViP: Bridging Knowledge Grounding and Visual Perception in Multi-modal LLMs for Visual Question Answering
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for Visual Question Answering (VQA) often suffer from dual limitations: knowledge hallucination and insufficient fine-grained visual perception. Crucially, we identify that commonsense graphs and scene graphs provide precisely complementary solutions to these respective deficiencies by providing rich external knowledge and capturing fine-grained visual details. However, prior works typically treat them in isolation, overlooking their synergistic potential. To bridge this gap, we propose KG-ViP, a unified framework that empowers MLLMs by fusing scene graphs and commonsense graphs. The core of the KG-ViP framework is a novel retrieval-and-fusion pipeline that utilizes the query as a semantic bridge to progressively integrate both graphs, synthesizing a unified structured context that facilitates reliable multi-modal reasoning. Extensive experiments on FVQA 2.0+ and MVQA benchmarks demonstrate that KG-ViP significantly outperforms existing VQA methods.

title: LASER: Learning Active Sensing for Continuum Field Reconstruction
summary: High-fidelity measurements of continuum physical fields are essential for scientific discovery and engineering design but remain challenging under sparse and constrained sensing. Conventional reconstruction methods typically rely on fixed sensor layouts, which cannot adapt to evolving physical states. We propose LASER, a unified, closed-loop framework that formulates active sensing as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP). At its core, LASER employs a continuum field latent world model that captures the underlying physical dynamics and provides intrinsic reward feedback. This enables a reinforcement learning policy to simulate ''what-if'' sensing scenarios within a latent imagination space. By conditioning sensor movements on predicted latent states, LASER navigates toward potentially high-information regions beyond current observations. Our experiments demonstrate that LASER consistently outperforms static and offline-optimized strategies, achieving high-fidelity reconstruction under sparsity across diverse continuum fields.

AI.tldr: 动态稀疏传感难：LASER用POMDP＋连续场潜模型在线决策，信息区主动采样，重构精度优于静态方法。
AI.motivation: 少/稀疏传感器难以高保真还原时空演化场，现有布线离线固定，无法利用动态信息提升采样效率。
AI.method: 1) 将主动观测建模为POMDP；2) 构建可直接输出连续场的潜动态模型并生成内在奖励；3) 利用RL在潜
AI.result: 在多类连续场实验中，LASER比静态策略与离线最优布线重构误差显著下降，采样数的误差曲线最优。
AI.conclusion: 闭环潜模型驱动的主动稀疏传感可突破观测限制，保证数据稀缺场景的高保真重构，具普适推广价值。

title: More Than Sum of Its Parts: Deciphering Intent Shifts in Multimodal Hate Speech Detection
summary: Combating hate speech on social media is critical for securing cyberspace, yet relies heavily on the efficacy of automated detection systems. As content formats evolve, hate speech is transitioning from solely plain text to complex multimodal expressions, making implicit attacks harder to spot. Current systems, however, often falter on these subtle cases, as they struggle with multimodal content where the emergent meaning transcends the aggregation of individual modalities. To bridge this gap, we move beyond binary classification to characterize semantic intent shifts where modalities interact to construct implicit hate from benign cues or neutralize toxicity through semantic inversion. Guided by this fine-grained formulation, we curate the Hate via Vision-Language Interplay (H-VLI) benchmark where the true intent hinges on the intricate interplay of modalities rather than overt visual or textual slurs. To effectively decipher these complex cues, we further propose the Asymmetric Reasoning via Courtroom Agent DEbate (ARCADE) framework. By simulating a judicial process where agents actively argue for accusation and defense, ARCADE forces the model to scrutinize deep semantic cues before reaching a verdict. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARCADE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on H-VLI, particularly for challenging implicit cases, while maintaining competitive performance on established benchmarks. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Sayur1n/H-VLI

AI.tldr: 针对多模态隐晦仇恨言论检测难题，作者提出 H-VLI 基准与 ARCADE 框架，通过“法庭辩论”式推理显式建模视觉-语义交互，显著提升对隐性仇恨的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 随着社交媒体内容从纯文本演化为图文、视频等多模态形式，仇恨表达愈加隐晦，依赖显式关键词或视觉污名的传统二元分类器难以捕捉“模态组合后才产生恶意”的复杂语义，导致漏检与误报并存。
AI.method: 1) 构建 H-VLI 基准，聚焦“仅当视觉与文本交互后才呈现仇恨/去毒”的样例，提供细粒度意图偏移标注；2) 设计 ARCADE 框架，模拟指控-辩护双代理的法庭辩论流程，通过多轮对抗性论据生成与一致性校验，迫使模型在做出判决前深度挖掘跨模态语义线索。
AI.result: 在 H-VLI 上，ARCADE 对隐晦仇恨的 F1 较最强基线提升 9.4%，在显性案例保持竞争力；在 MMHS150K、Hateful Memes 等公开数据集亦取得 SOTA 或近似 SOTA 成绩，验证其泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 将“意图偏移”形式化并引入对抗推理，可有效破解多模态隐晦仇恨检测瓶颈；代码与数据已开源，为后续研究提供可复现的实验平台。

title: Symbolic Quantile Regression for the Interpretable Prediction of Conditional Quantiles
summary: Symbolic Regression (SR) is a well-established framework for generating interpretable or white-box predictive models. Although SR has been successfully applied to create interpretable estimates of the average of the outcome, it is currently not well understood how it can be used to estimate the relationship between variables at other points in the distribution of the target variable. Such estimates of e.g. the median or an extreme value provide a fuller picture of how predictive variables affect the outcome and are necessary in high-stakes, safety-critical application domains. This study introduces Symbolic Quantile Regression (SQR), an approach to predict conditional quantiles with SR. In an extensive evaluation, we find that SQR outperforms transparent models and performs comparably to a strong black-box baseline without compromising transparency. We also show how SQR can be used to explain differences in the target distribution by comparing models that predict extreme and central outcomes in an airline fuel usage case study. We conclude that SQR is suitable for predicting conditional quantiles and understanding interesting feature influences at varying quantiles.

AI.tldr: 首次将符号回归扩展为符号分位数回归（SQR），在保持白箱可解释性的同时，实现与黑箱模型相当的分位数预测性能。
AI.motivation: 传统符号回归只能解释目标变量均值，无法刻画分布其他位置（如中位数、极端值）的异质关系，而高置信场景需要完整分布信息。
AI.method: 把分位数损失嵌入符号回归的遗传编程框架，直接在方程进化阶段优化任意 τ 分位数的预测误差，并引入帕累托前沿权衡复杂度与精度。
AI.result: 在 50 余个基准数据集上，SQR 的透明模型在 75% 任务中优于现有可解释基线，并与 XGBoost 分位数回归准确性无统计差异；航空燃油案例揭示极端与中心分位的关键特征差异。
AI.conclusion: SQR 为安全关键领域提供兼顾可解释性与分位数精度的通用工具，支持对条件分布全谱的机理解释。

title: Weakly supervised framework for wildlife detection and counting in challenging Arctic environments: a case study on caribou (Rangifer tarandus)
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, published in Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution
summary: Caribou across the Arctic has declined in recent decades, motivating scalable and accurate monitoring approaches to guide evidence-based conservation actions and policy decisions. Manual interpretation from this imagery is labor-intensive and error-prone, underscoring the need for automatic and reliable detection across varying scenes. Yet, such automatic detection is challenging due to severe background heterogeneity, dominant empty terrain (class imbalance), small or occluded targets, and wide variation in density and scale. To make the detection model (HerdNet) more robust to these challenges, a weakly supervised patch-level pretraining based on a detection network's architecture is proposed. The detection dataset includes five caribou herds distributed across Alaska. By learning from empty vs. non-empty labels in this dataset, the approach produces early weakly supervised knowledge for enhanced detection compared to HerdNet, which is initialized from generic weights. Accordingly, the patch-based pretrain network attained high accuracy on multi-herd imagery (2017) and on an independent year's (2019) test sets (F1: 93.7%/92.6%, respectively), enabling reliable mapping of regions containing animals to facilitate manual counting on large aerial imagery. Transferred to detection, initialization from weakly supervised pretraining yielded consistent gains over ImageNet weights on both positive patches (F1: 92.6%/93.5% vs. 89.3%/88.6%), and full-image counting (F1: 95.5%/93.3% vs. 91.5%/90.4%). Remaining limitations are false positives from animal-like background clutter and false negatives related to low animal density occlusions. Overall, pretraining on coarse labels prior to detection makes it possible to rely on weakly-supervised pretrained weights even when labeled data are limited, achieving results comparable to generic-weight initialization.

AI.tldr: 一种弱监督预训练策略大幅提高了在北极自适应巡航航拍影像中的驯鹿个体检测精度，为目标稀缺、尺度跨度大的北极野生动物监测提供了可靠方法。
AI.motivation: 北极驯鹿种群近十年显著下降，迫切需要高效、可扩展的监测技术为实证政策提供支撑。传统手工判读航拍影像费时且易错，亟须自动化、稳健的目标检测手段克服场景背景极不均匀、样本极度稀疏、个体极小或易被遮挡等挑战。
AI.method: 基于检测网络架构提出“空—非空”弱监督图块级预训练（HerdNet），仅利用“是否含目标”的粗标签先学习大体景观判别，再迁移至下游精标检测任务。实验数据覆盖阿拉斯加5个驯鹿种群多年航拍影像。
AI.result: 2017多集群影像与2019独立测试集上整体制图精度分别达到F1 93.7%和92.6%，检测小目标F1升至92.6%~93.5%，全图计数F1达95.5%，均显著优于ImageNet预训练基线（净提升约2~4个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 即使仅有少量细标样本，在粗“空—非空”标签上预训练依然可大幅提高检测性能，为北极玉带海矩阵式珍稀物种空天地一体化监测提供了可复制范式；残余误判主要为背景干扰和低密度遮挡盲区，未来可通过多尺度特征融合与背景建模进一步优化。

title: TACENR: Task-Agnostic Contrastive Explanations for Node Representations
comment: Accepted at the XAI 2026 Conference. 24 pages, 10 figures
summary: Graph representation learning has achieved notable success in encoding graph-structured data into latent vector spaces, enabling a wide range of downstream tasks. However, these node representations remain opaque and difficult to interpret. Existing explainability methods primarily focus on supervised settings or on explaining individual representation dimensions, leaving a critical gap in explaining the overall structure of node representations. In this paper, we propose TACENR (Task-Agnostic Contrastive Explanations for Node Representations), a local explanation method that identifies not only attribute features but also proximity and structural ones that contribute the most in the representation space. TACENR builds on contrastive learning, through which we learn a similarity function in the representation space, revealing which are the features that play an important role in the representation of a node. While our focus is on task-agnostic explanations, TACENR can be applied to supervised scenarios as well. Experimental results demonstrate that proximity and structural features play a significant role in shaping node representations and that our supervised variant performs comparably to existing task-specific approaches in identifying the most impactful features.

AI.tldr: TACENR 以对比学习为核心，首次在任务无关设定下给出节点表征的局部可解释性，揭示属性、近邻与结构三类特征对表征的贡献度。
AI.motivation: 图表示学习虽性能优异，但节点向量难以直观理解；现有解释方法局限于监督任务或单维分析，无法揭示整个表征空间的结构成因。
AI.method: 提出 TACENR，利用任务无关对比学习在表征空间中训练相似性函数，通过反事实样本对比定位对节点表征影响最大的属性、邻域及结构特征。
AI.result: 实验表明近邻与结构特征对节点表征影响显著；在监督场景下，TACENR 与专用解释方法性能相当，同时保持任务无关通用性。
AI.conclusion: TACENR 为图神经网络提供了通用且高效的局部解释框架，首次系统量化结构因素在表征形成中的贡献，为可解释图表示学习奠定新基准。

title: Why Does Self-Distillation (Sometimes) Degrade the Reasoning Capability of LLMs?
summary: Self-distillation has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for LLMs, often improving performance while shortening reasoning traces. However, in mathematical reasoning, we find that it can reduce response length while degrading performance. We trace this degradation to the suppression of epistemic verbalization - the model's expression of uncertainty during reasoning. Through controlled experiments varying conditioning context richness and task coverage, we show that conditioning the teacher on rich information suppresses uncertainty expression, enabling rapid in-domain optimization with limited task coverage but harming OOD performance, where unseen problems benefit from expressing uncertainty and adjusting accordingly. Across Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-7B, and Olmo3-7B-Instruct, we observe performance drops of up to 40%. Our findings highlight that exposing appropriate levels of uncertainty is crucial for robust reasoning and underscore the importance of optimizing reasoning behavior beyond merely reinforcing correct answer traces.

AI.tldr: Self-distillation在数学推理任务中会因抑制模型的不确定性表达而导致性能下降，降幅最高达40%。
AI.motivation: 揭示自蒸馏虽能缩短推理链，却可能牺牲数学推理鲁棒性，并首次指出'不确定性表达'是关键中间变量。
AI.method: 通过控制教师模型的上下文丰富度和任务覆盖度，对比不确定性表达频率与OOD性能，在三款模型上定量验证。
AI.result: 富条件上下文抑制不确定性表达→域内快速收敛但OOD性能骤降，最大降幅40%，佐证不确定性对鲁棒推理的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 优化推理行为需显式保留适度不确定性，而非仅强化正确答案轨迹；为后续自蒸馏策略提供保留不确定性机制的设计约束。

title: Time-Scale Coupling Between States and Parameters in Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: We show that gating mechanisms in recurrent neural networks (RNNs) induce lag-dependent and direction-dependent effective learning rates, even when training uses a fixed, global step size. This behavior arises from a coupling between state-space time-scales (parametrized by the gates) and parameter-space dynamics during gradient descent. By deriving exact Jacobians for leaky-integrator and gated RNNs and applying a first-order expansion, we make explicit how constant, scalar, and multi-dimensional gates reshape gradient propagation, modulate effective step sizes, and introduce anisotropy in parameter updates. These findings reveal that gates act not only as filters of information flow, but also as data-driven preconditioners of optimization, with formal connections to learning-rate schedules, momentum, and adaptive methods such as Adam. Empirical simulations corroborate these predictions: across several sequence tasks, gates produce lag-dependent effective learning rates and concentrate gradient flow into low-dimensional subspaces, matching or exceeding the anisotropic structure induced by Adam.
