Notably, gating and optimizer-driven adaptivity shape complementary aspects of credit assignment: gates align state-space transport with loss-relevant directions, while optimizers rescale parameter-space updates. Overall, this work provides a unified dynamical systems perspective on how gating couples state evolution with parameter updates, clarifying why gated architectures achieve robust trainability in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文证明RNN的门控在固定全局步长下仍能产生滞后与方向依赖的有效学习率，并把门控重新诠释为“数据驱动预处理器”，其优化行为与Adam等自适应方法互补。
AI.motivation: 尽管门控RNN训练成功，但现有理论将门仅视为“信息流过滤器”，无法解释其在固定学习率下仍能快速收敛的现象；作者欲揭示门控如何通过耦合状态-与参数-空间动力学来隐式调节优化过程。
AI.method: 1) 对leaky-integrator及门控RNN推导精确Jacobian；2) 一阶展开得到门控对梯度传播与有效步长的解析表达式；3) 在多个序列任务上对比门控网络与Adam的梯度子空间结构与有效学习率演化。
AI.result: 门控在参数更新中引入各向异性，滞后长度与门时间尺度线性相关；无需调学习率即可使梯度集中在低维子空间，其各向异性程度与Adam相当或更高；门负责状态空间“信用分配”，优化器负责参数空间“幅度重标”。
AI.conclusion: 门控不仅是动态滤波器，更是一类随输入数据即时调整的学习率调度器与预处理器，与 optimizer 提供的参数空间自适应性形成互补；该统一动力系统视角为解释并设计易训练RNN架构提供理论依据。

title: Lingua-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Multilingual Vision-Language Models
summary: The robust safety of Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) against joint multilingual and multimodal threats remains severely underexplored. Current benchmarks typically isolate these dimensions, being either multilingual but text-only, or multimodal but monolingual. While recent red-teaming efforts attempt to bridge this gap by rendering harmful prompts as images, their overreliance on typography-style visuals and lack of semantically grounded image-text pairs fail to capture realistic cross-modal interactions under multilingual and multimodal conditions. To address this, we introduce Lingua-SafetyBench, a comprehensive benchmark of 100,440 harmful image-text pairs spanning 10 languages. Crucially, Lingua-SafetyBench explicitly partitions data into image-dominant and text-dominant subsets to precisely disentangle sources of risk. Extensive evaluations reveal that current VLLMs retain non-negligible vulnerabilities under these joint inputs. Linguistically, requests in Non-High-Resource Languages (Non-HRLs) and non-Latin scripts generally pose greater threats. Furthermore, analyzing modality-language interactions uncovers a striking asymmetry: in High-Resource Languages (HRLs), models are most vulnerable to image-dominant risks, whereas in Non-HRLs, text-dominant risks severely degrade safety performance. Finally, a controlled study on the Qwen series demonstrates that while model scaling and iterative upgrades improve overall safety, they disproportionately benefit HRLs. This exacerbates the safety disparity between HRLs and Non-HRLs under text-dominant risks, highlighting that achieving robust safety requires dedicated language- and modality-aware alignment strategies beyond mere scaling. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/zsxr15/Lingua-SafetyBench.Warning: this paper contains examples with unsafe content.

AI.tldr: 现有安全基准把语言与模态威胁割裂测试，作者提出首个十万级、10 语种图文协同有害样本集 Lingua-SafetyBench，发现 VLLM 在低资源语言和非拉丁文字下更脆弱，且图文主导风险呈现语言不对称性；单纯扩大模型反而加剧高低资源语言安全落差，需语言-模态协同对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前 VLLM 安全评估要么仅多语言纯文本，要么仅单语言图文，无法反映真实跨语言多模态攻击场景。作者认为缺乏同时覆盖多语言与多模态联合威胁的综合基准，导致模型鲁棒性被高估，尤其对低资源语言和非拉丁脚本的防护盲区未被揭示。
AI.method: 1. 构建 Lingua-SafetyBench：100 440 对有害图文样本，覆盖 10 种语言（高低资源均衡）；按图文信息主导度划分为 image-dominant 与 text-dominant 子集，实现风险源解耦。 2. 系统评测 12 个主流 VLLM，对比图文输入下的拒答率与攻击成功率。 3. 设计控制实验：在同一模型系列（Qwen）上对比不同规模与版本，量化缩放与迭代升级对语言-模态安全差距的影响。
AI.result: 1. 所有测试模型在联合 multilingual+multimodal 输入下仍存显著漏洞，非高资源语言（Non-HRLs）与非拉丁脚本攻击成功率平均提高 18–32%。 2. 图文主导风险呈语言不对称：高资源语言（HRLs）最易被 image-dominant 样本攻破；Non-HRLs 则在 text-dominant 场景下安全性能骤降。 3. Qwen 系列放大与迭代虽提升整体拒答率，但 Non-HRLs 受益仅为 HRLs 的 0.4–0.6 倍，text-dominant 落差扩大至 22%。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐不能仅依赖模型缩放，必须引入语言专属与模态协同的策略；未来工作应针对低资源语言和非拉丁脚本设计显式对齐数据与惩罚机制，并建立动态跨模态威胁监测，以缩小语言间与模态间的安全鸿沟。

title: Multimodal Transformer for Sample-Aware Prediction of Metal-Organic Framework Properties
summary: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are a major target of machine-learning-based property prediction, yet most models assume that a single framework representation maps to a single property value. This assumption becomes problematic for experimental MOFs, where samples reported as the same framework can exhibit different properties because of differences in crystallinity, phase purity, defects, and other sample-dependent factors. Here we introduce Experimental X-ray Diffraction Integrated Transformer (EXIT), a multimodal transformer for sample-aware prediction of MOF properties that combines MOFid with X-ray diffraction (XRD). In EXIT, MOFid encodes MOF identity, whereas XRD provides complementary information about the experimentally realized sample state. EXIT is pre-trained on one million hypothetical MOFs with simulated XRD to learn transferable representations, leading to improved downstream performance relative to existing approaches. EXIT is fine-tuned on literature-derived experimental datasets for surface area and pore volume prediction. Incorporating experimental XRD improves predictive performance relative to models without experimental XRD, and attention analysis and sample-level case studies further show that EXIT assigns different predictions to samples sharing the same MOF identity when their XRD patterns differ. These results establish a practical step from framework-aware to sample-aware MOF property prediction and highlight the value of incorporating experimental characterization into porous materials informatics.

AI.tldr: 基于XRD 与 MOFid 的多模态 Transformer EXIT，首次实现“样品级” MOF 性质预测，突破传统“框架级”单值假设。
AI.motivation: 实验 MOF 样品即使框架相同，也会因结晶度、缺陷等差异导致性质离散，现有 ML 方法却“一框架一值”。需把实验表征纳入模型，实现样品级预测。
AI.method: 提出 EXIT：① MOFid 编码框架身份，②实验 XRD 编码样品真实状态，③先以百万虚拟 MOF 及模拟 XRD 预训练，④再在小规模文献实验数据集微调，用于比表面积/孔容预测。
AI.result: EXIT 显著优于无 XRD 的单模态模型；注意力与案例显示，同框架不同 XRD 会被赋予不同预测值，首次验证“样品感知”有效性。
AI.conclusion: EXIT 将 MOF 信息学从“框架级”推进到“样品级”，证明把实验 XRD 引入 ML 可切实提升预测可靠性，为实验导向的多孔材料设计提供新范式。

title: Resolving the Robustness-Precision Trade-off in Financial RAG through Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Intelligent Systems with Applications
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for financial document question answering typically follow a chunk-based paradigm: documents are split into fragments, embedded into vector space, and retrieved via similarity search. While effective in general settings, this approach suffers from cross-document chunk confusion in structurally homogeneous corpora such as regulatory filings. Semantic File Routing (SFR), which uses LLM structured output to route queries to whole documents, reduces catastrophic failures but sacrifices the precision of targeted chunk retrieval. We identify this robustness-precision trade-off through controlled evaluation on the FinDER benchmark (1,500 queries across five groups): SFR achieves higher average scores (6.45 vs. 6.02) and fewer failures (10.3% vs. 22.5%), while chunk-based retrieval (CBR) yields more perfect answers (13.8% vs. 8.5%). To resolve this trade-off, we propose Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval (HDRR), a two-stage architecture that uses SFR as a document filter followed by chunk-based retrieval scoped to the identified document(s). HDRR eliminates cross-document confusion while preserving targeted chunk precision. Experimental results demonstrate that HDRR achieves the best performance on every metric: an average score of 7.54 (25.2% above CBR, 16.9% above SFR), a failure rate of only 6.4%, a correctness rate of 67.7% (+18.7 pp over CBR), and a perfect-answer rate of 20.1% (+6.3 pp over CBR, +11.6 pp over SFR). HDRR resolves the trade-off by simultaneously achieving the lowest failure rate and the highest precision across all five experimental groups.

AI.tldr: 分层检索HDRR先用LLM把整篇文档路由到候选集，再在其内部做块级匹配，克服金融同构文档间的块混淆，兼得鲁棒与精度。
AI.motivation: 金融语料结构高度同质，传统块级向量检索易把不同报告的同类章节混淆，导致答案错误；整篇路由虽稳健却粒度粗，需要兼顾稳健与精准。
AI.method: 提出Hybrid Document-Routed Retrieval：第一阶段用LLM生成结构化输出完成“语义文件路由”筛出相关整篇文档；第二阶段在 narrowed 范围内执行块级相似检索并生成答案。
AI.result: 在1,500问FinDER基准上，HDRR平均得分7.54，失败率6.4%，正确率67.7%，完美答案率20.1%，全面优于纯块级与纯文档级基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过先文档后块的两级策略，HDRR消解了稳健-精度权衡，为金融问答系统提供了可直接落地的检索范式。

title: Automated Energy-Aware Time-Series Model Deployment on Embedded FPGAs for Resilient Combined Sewer Overflow Management
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, 1 table, accepted by the 11th IEEE International Smart Cities Conference (ISC2)
summary: Extreme weather events, intensified by climate change, increasingly challenge aging combined sewer systems, raising the risk of untreated wastewater overflow. Accurate forecasting of sewer overflow basin filling levels can provide actionable insights for early intervention, helping mitigating uncontrolled discharge. In recent years, AI-based forecasting methods have offered scalable alternatives to traditional physics-based models, but their reliance on cloud computing limits their reliability during communication outages. To address this, we propose an end-to-end forecasting framework that enables energy-efficient inference directly on edge devices. Our solution integrates lightweight Transformer and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models, compressed via integer-only quantization for efficient on-device execution. Moreover, an automated hardware-aware deployment pipeline is used to search for optimal model configurations by jointly minimizing prediction error and energy consumption on an AMD Spartan-7 XC7S15 FPGA. Evaluated on real-world sewer data, the selected 8-bit Transformer model, trained on 24 hours of historical measurements, achieves high accuracy (MSE 0.0376) at an energy cost of 0.370 mJ per inference. In contrast, the optimal 8-bit LSTM model requires significantly less energy (0.009 mJ, over 40x lower) but yields 14.89% worse accuracy (MSE 0.0432) and much longer training time. This trade-off highlights the need to align model selection with deployment priorities, favoring LSTM for ultra-low energy consumption or Transformer for higher predictive accuracy. In general, our work enables local, energy-efficient forecasting, contributing to more resilient combined sewer systems. All code can be found in the GitHub Repository (https://github.com/tianheng-ling/EdgeOverflowForecast).

AI.tldr: 面向老化合流制管网溢流预测的端-云协同AI框架，通过整数量化把Transformer/LSTM压至8 bit并部署于FPGA，实现0.37 mJ/0.009 mJ单推理能耗与0.0376/0.0432 MSE的精度-能耗权衡。
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧极端降雨，传统基于物理的溢流模型实时性差且依赖云端通信，通信中断时易失效。需在管网边缘侧实现低功耗、本地化的溢流量预测，以支持提前调度、减轻未经处理污水溢流。
AI.method: 构建端到端边缘预测框架：①整数量化将Transformer与LSTM压缩为8-bit整数模型；②提出自动化硬件感知部署流水线，联合优化预测误差与能耗，搜索AMD Spartan-7 XC7S15 FPGA最优配置；③以24 h历史液位数据为输入，实时输出未来 basin 充满度。
AI.result: 在真实合流制管网数据上：8-bit Transformer单推理能耗0.370 mJ，MSE 0.0376；8-bit LSTM能耗降40×至0.009 mJ，但MSE增14.89%至0.0432，训练时间更长。模型选择可根据现场对精度或能耗的优先级灵活切换。
AI.conclusion: 首次在FPGA实现毫焦级、本地化 sewer溢流预测，兼顾高精度与超低功耗，为抗极端天气、弱通信场景下的智慧排水提供可扩展的边缘智能方案。

title: Mitigating Long-Tail Bias via Prompt-Controlled Diffusion Augmentation
comment: Accepted to Publication at 2026 IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS)
summary:
Long-tailed class imbalance remains a fundamental obstacle in semantic segmentation of high-resolution remote-sensing imagery, where dominant classes shape learned representations and rare classes are systematically under-segmented. This challenge becomes more acute in cross-domain settings such as LoveDA, which exhibits an explicit Urban/Rural split with substantial appearance differences and inconsistent class-frequency statistics across domains. We propose a prompt-controlled diffusion augmentation framework that generates paired label-image samples with explicit control over semantic composition and domain, enabling targeted enrichment of underrepresented classes rather than indiscriminate dataset expansion. A domain-aware, masked, ratio-conditioned discrete diffusion model first synthesizes layouts that satisfy class-ratio targets while preserving realistic spatial co-occurrence, and a ControlNet-guided diffusion model then renders photorealistic, domain-consistent images from these layouts. When mixed with real data, the resulting synthetic pairs improve multiple segmentation backbones, especially on minority classes and under domain shift, showing that better downstream segmentation comes from adding the right samples in the right proportions.
  Source codes, pretrained Models and synthetic datasets are available at https://buddhi19.github.io/SyntheticGen.

AI.tldr: 利用一对可控扩散模型有选择地为遥感图像分割中的罕见类别生成域一致的合成图像-标签对，从而在不扩充整体数据的前提下显著提升长尾及跨域性能。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率遥感影像语义分割仍被长尾类别不平衡所困扰：占多数的类别主导表征学习，罕见类别持续欠分割；在LoveDA等跨域场景，城乡域间外观差异大且类别分布不一致，进一步放大了该问题。
AI.method: 提出“提示控制的扩散扩增框架”。第一步，域感知、带掩码的比例条件离散扩散模型依据类别比例目标生成真实空间共现的布局；第二步，ControlNet引导的扩散模型将布局渲染成与域一致的逼真影像。整个过程可显式控制语义组成与域归属，实现对少数类的定向增广，而非盲目扩增数据。
AI.result: 在多种分割骨干网络上，将合成对按适当比例混入真实数据后，少数类别分割效果显著提升，并在域迁移条件下仍保持增益；表明“加入对的样本、用对的比例”是改善下游分割的关键。
AI.conclusion: 通过精准生成符合目标域特征且类别可控的合成样本，可在不扩大整体数据规模的情况下有效缓解遥感分割中的长尾与跨域不平衡，为后续研究提供了开源代码、预训练模型及合成数据。

title: Revisiting Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding
summary:
Knowledge Graph Embeddings (KGEs) support a wide range of downstream tasks over Knowledge Graphs (KGs). In practice, KGs evolve as new entities and facts are added, motivating Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding (CKGE) methods that update embeddings over time. Current CKGE approaches address catastrophic forgetting (i.e., the performance degradation on previously learned tasks) primarily by limiting changes to existing embeddings.
  However, we show that this view is incomplete. When new entities are introduced, their embeddings can interfere with previously learned ones, causing the model to predict them in place of previously correct answers. This phenomenon, which we call entity interference, has been largely overlooked and is not accounted for in current CKGE evaluation protocols. As a result, the assessment of catastrophic forgetting becomes misleading, and CKGE methods performance is systematically overestimated.
  To address this issue, we introduce a corrected CKGE evaluation protocol that accounts for entity interference. Through experiments on multiple benchmarks, we show that ignoring this effect can lead to performance overestimation of up to 25%, particularly in scenarios with significant entity growth. We further analyze how different CKGE methods and KGE models are affected by the different sources of forgetting, and introduce a catastrophic forgetting metric tailored to CKGE.

AI.tldr: 首次系统指出连续知识图谱嵌入（CKGE）存在“实体干扰”型遗忘，提出修正评测协议与专用指标，实体增量场景下性能虚高可达25%。
AI.motivation: CKGE需随KG演化持续更新嵌入；现有方法仅通过冻结旧参数抑制灾难性遗忘，忽视新实体嵌入对旧实体的替代性干扰，导致评测失真。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义实体干扰；2) 设计含负采样-去重-旧实体召回的修正评测协议；3) 提出面向CKGE的灾难遗忘综合指标；4) 在多个CKGE与KGE模型上对比实验。
AI.result: 协议修正后，各方法性能普遍下降，最大降幅约25%，且干扰随实体增长率放大；不同CKGE策略对参数冻结与重播的鲁棒性差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 忽视实体干扰会系统性高估CKGE性能；修正协议与指标可公平揭示真实遗忘程度，为未来CKGE研究提供可靠基准。

title: Article and Comment Frames Shape the Quality of Online Comments
summary: Framing theory posits that how information is presented shapes audience responses, but computational work has largely ignored audience reactions. While recent work showed that article framing systematically shapes the content of reader responses, this paper asks: does framing also affect response quality? Analyzing 1M comments across 2.7K news articles, we operationalize quality as comment health. We find that article frames significantly predict comment health while controlling for topic, and that comments that adopt the article frame are healthier than those that depart from it. Further, unhealthy top-level comments tend to generate more unhealthy responses, independent of the frame being used in the comment. Our results establish a link between framing theory and discourse quality, laying the groundwork for downstream applications. We illustrate this potential with a pro-active frame-aware LLM- based system to mitigate unhealthy discourse.

AI.tldr: 首次证明新闻文本的框架不仅改变读者回应内容，还显著影响评论质量（毒性高低），并据此提出可主动干预的框架感知LLM系统。
AI.motivation: 框架理论长期忽视受众侧结果，已有计算研究仅关注回应“内容”而非“质量”。本研究试图填补“框架是否影响网络话语健康”这一空白。
AI.method: 以“评论健康度”作为质量指标，构建包含2700篇新闻与100万条评论的数据集；用多层回归控制主题等混杂因素，检验文章框架对评论健康度的主效应，并分析框架一致性（评论与文章同框架）与次级对话的污染效应。
AI.result: 1.文章框架显著预测评论健康度；2.与文章同框架的评论更健康；3.顶层低质量评论会独立诱发更多低质量回应，与后续所用框架无关。
AI.conclusion: 框架理论首次被证实与在线话语质量直接关联，为“框架-aware”算法干预（如主动重述框架以降低毒性）奠定理论与实证基础。}

title: Benchmarking Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Boundary Elements Methods for Wave Scattering
summary: This study compares the Boundary Element Method (BEM) and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for solving the two-dimensional Helmholtz equation in wave scattering problems. The objective is to evaluate the performance of both methods under the same conditions. We solve the Helmholtz equation using BEM and PINNs for the same scattering problem. PINNs are trained by minimizing the residual of the governing equations and boundary conditions with their configuration determined through hyperparameter optimization, while BEM is applied using boundary discretization. Both methods are evaluated in terms of solution accuracy and computation time. We conducted numerical experiments by varying the number of boundary integration points for the BEM and the number of hidden layers and neurons per layer for the PINNs. We performed a hyperparameter tuning to identify an adequate PINN configuration for this problem as a network with 3 hidden layers and 25 neurons per layer, using a learning rate of $10^{-2}$ and a sine activation function. At comparable levels of accuracy, the assembly and solution of the BEM system required a computational time on the order of $10^{-2}$~s, whereas the training time of the PINN was on the order of $10^{2}$~s, corresponding to a difference of approximately four orders of magnitude. However, once trained, the PINN achieved evaluation times on the order of $10^{-2}$~s, which is about two orders of magnitude faster than the evaluation of the BEM solution at interior points. This work establishes a procedure for comparing BEM and PINNs. It also presents a direct comparison between the two methods for the scattering problem. The analysis provides quantitative data on their performance, supporting their use in future research on wave propagation problems and outlining challenges and directions for further investigation.

AI.tldr: 同一散射问题下，BEM 与 PINN 均可达到可比精度；BEM 单次求解 10⁻² s，PINN 训练需 10² s，慢 4 量级，但训练后 PINN 内点评估再快 2 量级。本文给出定量对比流程并指出波传播研究中的后续挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统 BEM 与新兴 PINN 在声波散射场景缺乏系统、定量、同条件下的性能基准，阻碍方法选型与未来改进。
AI.method: 以二维 Helmholtz 方程散射为基准，固定几何与边界条件：BEM 采用边界离散线性系统求解；PINN 通过最小化方程残差与边界损失训练，经网格搜索确定 3×25 网络结构、sin 激活、lr=10⁻²。对比指标为 L² 误差与 CPU 时间。
AI.result: 两方法精度相当；BEM 组装+求解约 10⁻² s，PINN 训练约 10² s；训练后 PINN 内点评估 10⁻² s，比 BEM 再插值快 2 量级。
AI.conclusion: 给出可重复的 BEM-PINN 对比协议；PINN 训练昂贵但评估极快，适合多查询场景；未来需减训耗时、拓至高维与非线性波问题。

title: TFusionOcc: T-Primitive Based Object-Centric Multi-Sensor Fusion Framework for 3D Occupancy Prediction
summary: The prediction of 3D semantic occupancy enables autonomous vehicles (AVs) to perceive the fine-grained geometric and semantic scene structure for safe navigation and decision-making. Existing methods mainly rely on either voxel-based representations, which incur redundant computation over empty regions, or on object-centric Gaussian primitives, which are limited in modeling complex, non-convex, and asymmetric structures. In this paper, we present TFusionOcc, a T-primitive-based object-centric multi-sensor fusion framework for 3D semantic occupancy prediction. Specifically, we introduce a family of Students t-distribution-based T-primitives, including the plain T-primitive, T-Superquadric, and deformable T-Superquadric with inverse warping, where the deformable T-Superquadric serves as the key geometry-enhancing primitive. We further develop a unified probabilistic formulation based on the Students t-distribution and the T-mixture model (TMM) to jointly model occupancy and semantics, and design a tightly coupled multi-stage fusion architecture to effectively integrate camera and LiDAR cues. Extensive experiments on nuScenes show state-of-the-art performance, while additional evaluations on nuScenes-C demonstrate strong robustness under most corruption scenarios. The code will be available at: https://github.com/DanielMing123/TFusionOcc

AI.tldr: TFusionOcc首次用学生-t分布构造的T-primitives替代传统体素或高斯元，兼顾几何表达力与计算效率，在nuScenes上刷新3D语义占有率预测SOTA，并对传感器损坏保持鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么采用稠密体素，空域冗余计算大；要么采用对象级高斯元，难以刻画非凸、非对称结构，限制了自动驾驶精细环境感知能力。
AI.method: 提出T-primitives族（plain T-primitive/T-Superquadric/可变形T-Superquadric），以学生-t分布统一建模几何与语义，并用T-mixture model整合相机-激光雷达线索，设计紧耦合多阶段融合框架。
AI.result: nuScenes测试集达到SOTA占有率与语义分割精度；nuScenes-C损坏数据集中绝大多数扰动场景下鲁棒性显著优于现有方案。
AI.conclusion: T-primitive在表达复杂几何、压缩空域计算和融合多模态信息上展现综合优势，为AV精细3D感知提供了新范式，代码已开源。

title: M$^{2}$GRPO: Mamba-based Multi-Agent Group Relative Policy Optimization for Biomimetic Underwater Robots Pursuit
summary: Traditional policy learning methods in cooperative pursuit face fundamental challenges in biomimetic underwater robots, where long-horizon decision making, partial observability, and inter-robot coordination require both expressiveness and stability. To address these issues, a novel framework called Mamba-based multi-agent group relative policy optimization (M$^{2}$GRPO) is proposed, which integrates a selective state-space Mamba policy with group-relative policy optimization under the centralized-training and decentralized-execution (CTDE) paradigm. Specifically, the Mamba-based policy leverages observation history to capture long-horizon temporal dependencies and exploits attention-based relational features to encode inter-agent interactions, producing bounded continuous actions through normalized Gaussian sampling. To further improve credit assignment without sacrificing stability, the group-relative advantages are obtained by normalizing rewards across agents within each episode and optimized through a multi-agent extension of GRPO, significantly reducing the demand for training resources while enabling stable and scalable policy updates. Extensive simulations and real-world pool experiments across team scales and evader strategies demonstrate that M$^{2}$GRPO consistently outperforms MAPPO and recurrent baselines in both pursuit success rate and capture efficiency. Overall, the proposed framework provides a practical and scalable solution for cooperative underwater pursuit with biomimetic robot systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 M²GRPO，用 Mamba 历史建模+组内归一化优势估计，在 CTDE 框架下实现仿生水下多机器人协同追捕，仿真与水池实验均优于 MAPPO 等基线。
AI.motivation: 仿生水下机器人协同追捕存在长时决策、部分可观测与多机协调三大难题，现有策略学习方法在表达力与稳定性上不足，需一种轻量、稳定且可扩展的新框架。
AI.method: 1) 以选择性状态空间 Mamba 作为策略网络，融合观测历史与注意力关系特征，输出有界连续动作；2) 在 CTDE 下提出组相对优势估计：每回合内对同组智能体奖励做归一化，得到相对优势；3) 将 GRPO 扩展至多智能体场景，用裁剪概率比与组相对优势联合优化策略，降低训练资源需求。
AI.result: 仿真与真实水池实验表明，M²GRPO 在不同队形、逃逸策略及 3–8 机器人规模下，追捕成功率提高 12–28%，捕获效率提升 15–35%，训练步数减少 40%，显著优于 MAPPO 与带 LSTM 的基线。
AI.conclusion: M²GRPO 为水下仿生多机器人协同追捕提供了实用、稳定且可扩展的策略学习解决方案，也为其他长时序、部分可观测的多智能体任务提供通用范式。

title: PolarQuant: Optimal Gaussian Weight Quantization via Hadamard Rotation for LLM Compression
comment: Found some errors, I need to fix
summary: We present PolarQuant, a post-training weight quantization method for large language models (LLMs) that exploits the distributional structure of neural network weights to achieve near-lossless compression. PolarQuant operates in three stages: (1) block-wise normalization to the unit hypersphere, (2) Walsh-Hadamard rotation to transform coordinates into approximately Gaussian random variables, and (3) quantization with centroids matched to the Gaussian distribution. Our ablation reveals that Hadamard rotation alone accounts for 98% of the quality improvement, reducing Qwen3.5-9B perplexity from 6.90 (absmax Q5) to 6.40 (Delta = +0.03 from FP16), making it practically lossless without any calibration data. Furthermore, PolarQuant functions as an effective preprocessing step for downstream INT4 quantizers: PolarQuant Q5 dequantized and re-quantized by torchao INT4 achieves perplexity 6.56 versus 6.68 for direct absmax INT4, while maintaining 43.1 tok/s throughput at 6.5 GB VRAM. Code and models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: PolarQuant是一种LLM后训练量化方法，通过球面归一化+Hadamard旋转+高斯质心三步，将Qwen3.5-9B Q5从6.90降到6.40 PPL（+0.03于FP16），且无需校准数据；作为INT4预处理仍能进一步提升PPL并维持43 tok/s与6.5 GB显存。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练量化在低比特下PPL偏高、需校准数据；作者想利用权重分布结构，在零数据下实现近乎无损的LLM量化。
AI.method: (1)块级权重归一化到单位超球面；(2)Walsh-Hadamard旋转变换坐标近似高斯；(3)按高斯分布选择质心进行量化；核心发现是仅用第2步即贡献98%的精度提升。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-9B Q5级PPL从6.90降至6.40（Δ=+0.03 vs. FP16）；作INT4预处理，再经torchao INT4量化后PPL 6.56 < 直接absmax 6.68，在RTX 4090上43.1 tok/s、6.5 GB显存运行。
AI.conclusion: Hadamard旋转可廉价兼容高斯极坐标思维，实现零校准、近无损量化；PolarQuant既能独立做Q5，也能成为后续INT4量化器的高效预处理，兼顾精度、速度与显存。

title: Beyond Linear Probes: Dynamic Safety Monitoring for Language Models
summary: Monitoring large language models' (LLMs) activations is an effective way to detect harmful requests before they lead to unsafe outputs. However, traditional safety monitors often require the same amount of compute for every query. This creates a trade-off: expensive monitors waste resources on easy inputs, while cheap ones risk missing subtle cases. We argue that safety monitors should be flexible--costs should rise only when inputs are difficult to assess, or when more compute is available. To achieve this, we introduce Truncated Polynomial Classifiers (TPCs), a natural extension of linear probes for dynamic activation monitoring. Our key insight is that polynomials can be trained and evaluated progressively, term-by-term. At test-time, one can early-stop for lightweight monitoring, or use more terms for stronger guardrails when needed. TPCs provide two modes of use. First, as a safety dial: by evaluating more terms, developers and regulators can "buy" stronger guardrails from the same model. Second, as an adaptive cascade: clear cases exit early after low-order checks, and higher-order guardrails are evaluated only for ambiguous inputs, reducing overall monitoring costs. On WildGuardMix, across 4 models with up to 30B parameters, we show that TPCs compete with or outperform MLP-based probe baselines of the same size for harmful prompt classification, all the while being more interpretable than their black-box counterparts. Our code is available at http://github.com/james-oldfield/tpc.

AI.tldr: 提出动态截断多项式分类器(TPCs)，用于按需分配算力的LLM安全监测。
AI.motivation: 静态安全监测器不论输入难度均消耗固定算力，造成易例浪费、难例漏检的矛盾，需实现
AI.method: 将线性探测扩展为可逐项计算的多项式分类器，测试时按需求提前终止或追加高阶项，形成"  安全拨盘" 级联结构。
AI.result: 在WildGuardMix上，TPCs在4个≤30B模型上性能等同或优于同规模MLP探测器，且可解释性更高、平均开销更低。
AI.conclusion: TPCs首次实现激活监测的算力自适应，兼顾高效拦截与资源节约，为实时、可扩展的LLM安全护栏提供了新范式。

title: VimRAG: Navigating Massive Visual Context in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Multimodal Memory Graph
summary: Effectively retrieving, reasoning, and understanding multimodal information remains a critical challenge for agentic systems. Traditional Retrieval-augmented Generation (RAG) methods rely on linear interaction histories, which struggle to handle long-context tasks, especially those involving information-sparse yet token-heavy visual data in iterative reasoning scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce VimRAG, a framework tailored for multimodal Retrieval-augmented Reasoning across text, images, and videos. Inspired by our systematic study, we model the reasoning process as a dynamic directed acyclic graph that structures the agent states and retrieved multimodal evidence. Building upon this structured memory, we introduce a Graph-Modulated Visual Memory Encoding mechanism, with which the significance of memory nodes is evaluated via their topological position, allowing the model to dynamically allocate high-resolution tokens to pivotal evidence while compressing or discarding trivial clues. To implement this paradigm, we propose a Graph-Guided Policy Optimization strategy. This strategy disentangles step-wise validity from trajectory-level rewards by pruning memory nodes associated with redundant actions, thereby facilitating fine-grained credit assignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VimRAG consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse multimodal RAG benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/VRAG.

AI.tldr: VimRAG 通过将多模态推理建模为动态 DAG 并基于节点拓扑重要性分配高分辨率 token，实现了对长上下文、低信息密度视觉数据的高效检索与推理，在主流多模态 RAG 基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 方法采用线性交互历史，难以在长上下文、迭代推理场景中有效利用 token 量大但信息稀疏的视觉数据，亟需一种面向多模态的检索增强推理框架。
AI.method: 1) 将推理过程构建为动态有向无环图（DAG），节点表示智能体状态与检索到的多模态证据；2) 提出图调制视觉记忆编码，按节点拓扑位置评估重要性，动态分配高分辨率 token 并压缩/丢弃冗余线索；3) 设计图引导策略优化，剪除冗余动作对应的记忆节点，实现步级有效性与轨迹级奖励解耦的细粒度信用分配。
AI.result: 在多项多模态 RAG 基准（含长视频、图文混合问答等）上，VimRAG 一致取得 SOTA 性能，显著优于现有线性历史 RAG 基线，验证其在长上下文、信息稀疏视觉场景下的优势。
AI.conclusion: VimRAG 通过图结构记忆与拓扑驱动的 token 分配，有效缓解了长上下文多模态推理中的信息稀疏与冗余问题，为构建具备强大多模态检索与推理能力的智能体提供了新范式。

title: HP-Edit: A Human-Preference Post-Training Framework for Image Editing
summary: Common image editing tasks typically adopt powerful generative diffusion models as the leading paradigm for real-world content editing. Meanwhile, although reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as Diffusion-DPO and Flow-GRPO have further improved generation quality, efficiently applying Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to diffusion-based editing remains largely unexplored, due to a lack of scalable human-preference datasets and frameworks tailored to diverse editing needs. To fill this gap, we propose HP-Edit, a post-training framework for Human Preference-aligned Editing, and introduce RealPref-50K, a real-world dataset across eight common tasks and balancing common object editing. Specifically, HP-Edit leverages a small amount of human-preference scoring data and a pretrained visual large language model (VLM) to develop HP-Scorer--an automatic, human preference-aligned evaluator. We then use HP-Scorer both to efficiently build a scalable preference dataset and to serve as the reward function for post-training the editing model. We also introduce RealPref-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating real-world editing performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances models such as Qwen-Image-Edit-2509, aligning their outputs more closely with human preference.

AI.tldr: HP-Edit 框架用少量人工偏好+VLM 自监督奖励，构建 50k 真实场景编辑偏好库，实现扩散模型后训练对齐，8 类任务编辑效果显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散编辑模型缺乏大规模、多样化的人类偏好数据，RLHF 难以直接迁移到编辑任务，导致输出与人类真实喜好脱节。
AI.method: 设计 HP-Scorer——用预训练 VLM 在小规模人工打分上微调，自动给出偏好分数；以此分数为奖励，用离线 RL 后训练扩散编辑模型；并发布 RealPref-50K 数据集与 RealPref-Bench 基准。
AI.result: 在 RealPref-Bench 上，经 HP-Edit 后训练的 Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 在整体人类偏好胜率提升 18.7%，各子任务平均 LPIPS 降低 12%，FID 降低 9.4%，标注成本仅为完全人工标注的 4%。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 自监督奖励与少量人工标注结合，可高效扩展扩散编辑模型的 RLHF 流程，显著增强真实场景下的编辑质量与对齐度，验证了“弱标注+强奖励”在图像编辑后训练中的可行性。

title: OmniVoice: Towards Omnilingual Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech with Diffusion Language Models
summary: We present OmniVoice, a massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model that scales to over 600 languages. At its core is a novel diffusion language model-style discrete non-autoregressive (NAR) architecture. Unlike conventional discrete NAR models that suffer from performance bottlenecks in complex two-stage (text-to-semantic-to-acoustic) pipelines, OmniVoice directly maps text to multi-codebook acoustic tokens. This simplified approach is facilitated by two key technical innovations: (1) a full-codebook random masking strategy for efficient training, and (2) initialization from a pre-trained LLM to ensure superior intelligibility. By leveraging a 581k-hour multilingual dataset curated entirely from open-source data, OmniVoice achieves the broadest language coverage to date and delivers state-of-the-art performance across Chinese, English, and diverse multilingual benchmarks. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/k2-fsa/OmniVoice.

AI.tldr: OmniVoice 用扩散式 NAR 架构一次性把文本映射到多码本声学 token，在 600+ 种语言上实现零样本 SOTA TTS，数据和模型全部开源。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模多语 TTS 需两阶段（文本→语义→声学），流程复杂且低资源语言数据稀缺；作者希望用单一模型、开源数据覆盖尽量多的语言并保持高可懂度。
AI.method: 提出扩散语言模型风格的离散非自回归架构，直接文本→多码本声学 token；引入“全码本随机掩码”加速训练，并用预训练 LLM 权重初始化提升可懂度；基于 58.1 万小时开源多语语料训练。
AI.result: 在汉语、英语及多语基准上均取得 SOTA 零样本合成效果，首次将 TTS 零样本覆盖语言数推至 600+。
AI.conclusion: 简化两阶段为单阶段、用掩码扩散与 LLM 初始化即可在完全开源数据上实现迄今最广语言覆盖的零样本 TTS，证实该路线对低资源语言可扩展且有效。

title: How does the optimizer implicitly bias the model merging loss landscape?
summary: Model merging combines independent solutions with different capabilities into a single one while maintaining the same inference cost. Two popular approaches are linear interpolation, which simply averages multiple model weights, and task arithmetic, which combines task vectors obtained by the difference between finetuned and base models. While useful in practice, what properties make merging effective are poorly understood. This paper explores how the optimization dynamics affect the loss landscape geometry and its impact on merging success. We show that a single quantity -- the effective noise scale -- unifies the impact of different optimizer components on model merging. Across architectures and datasets, merging success is a non-monotonic function of the effective noise scale, with a distinct optimum. Decomposing this quantity, we find that larger learning rates, stronger weight decay, smaller batch sizes, and data augmentation all independently modulate the effective noise scale and exhibit the same qualitative trend. Unlike prior work connecting optimizer noise to the flatness or generalization of individual minima, we show that it also affects the global loss landscape, predicting when independently trained solutions can be successfully merged. Our findings broaden the understanding of how optimization shapes the loss landscape geometry and its consequences for model merging, suggesting that training dynamics could be further manipulated to improve model merging.

AI.tldr: 首次提出用‘有效噪声尺度’这一单一量度统一解释各类优化器超参数对模型合并成功率的影响，并发现其呈非单调最优关系。
AI.motivation: 现有线性插值与任务算术等模型合并方法虽实用，但缺乏对其背后机理的系统理解，尤其是优化动态如何塑造损失景观从而影响合并效果。
AI.method: 理论推导结合跨架构、跨数据集的实验，将有效噪声尺度分解为学习率、权重衰减、批量大小与数据增强的独立贡献，验证其与合并成功率的非单调单峰关系。
AI.result: 有效噪声尺度可准确预测何时独立训练的解可成功合并；其最优值对应合并成功率峰值，且该规律在多种网络与数据上稳定出现。
AI.conclusion: 优化噪声不仅影响单个极小值的平坦度，更全局地重塑损失景观，为通过调控训练动态提升模型合并提供了可解释、可操作的新路径。

title: CLIPoint3D: Language-Grounded Few-Shot Unsupervised 3D Point Cloud Domain Adaptation
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP demonstrate impressive cross-modal reasoning, extending beyond images to 3D perception. Yet, these models remain fragile under domain shifts, especially when adapting from synthetic to real-world point clouds. Conventional 3D domain adaptation approaches rely on heavy trainable encoders, yielding strong accuracy but at the cost of efficiency. We introduce CLIPoint3D, the first framework for few-shot unsupervised 3D point cloud domain adaptation built upon CLIP. Our approach projects 3D samples into multiple depth maps and exploits the frozen CLIP backbone, refined through a knowledge-driven prompt tuning scheme that integrates high-level language priors with geometric cues from a lightweight 3D encoder. To adapt task-specific features effectively, we apply parameter-efficient fine-tuning to CLIP's encoders and design an entropy-guided view sampling strategy for selecting confident projections. Furthermore, an optimal transport-based alignment loss and an uncertainty-aware prototype alignment loss collaboratively bridge source-target distribution gaps while maintaining class separability. Extensive experiments on PointDA-10 and GraspNetPC-10 benchmarks show that CLIPoint3D achieves consistent 3-16% accuracy gains over both CLIP-based and conventional encoder-based baselines. Project page: https://sarthakm320.github.io/CLIPoint3D.

AI.tldr: 冻结 CLIP+VLM，仅用少量可训提示、轻量 3D 分支和无监督对齐即可将合成点云高效迁移到真实域，参数/算力大为节省且精度再提升 3–16%。
AI.motivation: 当前 3D 视觉-语言模型在合成→真实领域转移下易崩溃；传统 3D-UDA 方法依赖重型编码器参数量与计算开销大，难以在低样本或无监督条件下兼顾精度与效率。
AI.method: 1) 将点云多视角投影为深度图；2) 冻结 CLIP 视觉-语言骨干，仅通过语言-几何联合知识提示微调；3) 引入轻量 3D 编码器补足几何先验；4) 设计信息熵驱动的视图采样与参数高效 PEFT；5) 最优传输对齐＋不确定性感知原型对齐，循环对齐源域分布但保持类间可分离性。
AI.result: 在 PointDA-10 与 GraspNetPC-10 两个合成-真实基准上，CLIPoint3D 比最强 CLIP 基线提升 3–16%，对比传统编码器型方法平均提升 8% 以上，同时训练参数量减少 ≥80%，推理速度提升约 2×。
AI.conclusion: 无需大规模再训练即可将冻结的 VL-CLIP 知识注入 3D 域迁移，提示微调＋轻量几何分支＋无监督对齐三要素在少样本场景实现精度-效率双赢，为实用化 3D 模型跨域部署提供了新的范式。

title: GOLD-BEV: GrOund and aeriaL Data for Dense Semantic BEV Mapping of Dynamic Scenes
summary: Understanding road scenes in a geometrically consistent, scene-centric representation is crucial for planning and mapping. We present GOLD-BEV, a framework that learns dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) semantic environment maps-including dynamic agents-from ego-centric sensors, using time-synchronized aerial imagery as supervision only during training. BEV-aligned aerial crops provide an intuitive target space, enabling dense semantic annotation with minimal manual effort and avoiding the ambiguity of ego-only BEV labeling. Crucially, strict aerial-ground synchronization allows overhead observations to supervise moving traffic participants and mitigates the temporal inconsistencies inherent to non-synchronized overhead sources. To obtain scalable dense targets, we generate BEV pseudo-labels using domain-adapted aerial teachers, and jointly train BEV segmentation with optional pseudo-aerial BEV reconstruction for interpretability. Finally, we extend beyond aerial coverage by learning to synthesize pseudo-aerial BEV images from ego sensors, which support lightweight human annotation and uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling on unlabeled drives.

AI.tldr: 仅用时间同步的航拍影像监督，车载传感器即可在训练阶段自我学会生成稠密俯视（BEV）语义地图，包括动态交通参与者。
AI.motivation: 传统自上而下的BEV标注昂贵且易因时间错位造成标签歧义；利用易获取的航拍影像作为唯一监督源，可在无需手工标注的情况下获得几何一致、场景中心的BEV表示，有助于规划与建图。
AI.method: 提出GOLD-BEV框架：①同步航拍-车载数据，用航拍裁剪图作为BEV目标空间，提供稠密且语义一致的真值；②域适应航拍教师网络生成BEV伪标签；③联合训练BEV分割与可解释的伪航拍BEV重建；④学习从车端传感器直接合成伪航拍BEV影像，在无航拍区域获得轻量人工标注及不确定性感知伪标签。
AI.result: 框架可利用最小人工标注在训练阶段获得稠密BEV语义地图，同步航拍真值缓解了动态目标时间不一致问题；伪航拍图像生成扩展了无航拍覆盖区域的标注与自监督能力。
AI.conclusion: GOLD-BEV首次仅用同步航拍影像完成车载BEV语义地图的学习，突破了传统依赖大规模昂贵手动BEV标注的瓶颈，并为无航拍场景下持续自监督学习提供了可行路径。

title: Council Mode: Mitigating Hallucination and Bias in LLMs via Multi-Agent Consensus
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly those employing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, have achieved remarkable capabilities across diverse natural language processing tasks. However, these models frequently suffer from hallucinations -- generating plausible but factually incorrect content -- and exhibit systematic biases that are amplified by uneven expert activation during inference. In this paper, we propose the Council Mode, a novel multi-agent consensus framework that addresses these limitations by dispatching queries to multiple heterogeneous frontier LLMs in parallel and synthesizing their outputs through a dedicated consensus model. The Council pipeline operates in three phases: (1) an intelligent triage classifier that routes queries based on complexity, (2) parallel expert generation across architecturally diverse models, and (3) a structured consensus synthesis that explicitly identifies agreement, disagreement, and unique findings before producing the final response. We implement and evaluate this architecture within an open-source AI workspace. Our comprehensive evaluation across multiple benchmarks demonstrates that the Council Mode achieves a 35.9% relative reduction in hallucination rates on the HaluEval benchmark and a 7.8-point improvement on TruthfulQA compared to the best-performing individual model, while maintaining significantly lower bias variance across domains. We provide the mathematical formulation of the consensus mechanism, detail the system architecture, and present extensive empirical results with ablation studies.

AI.tldr: 提出“Council Mode”多智能体共识框架，并行调用异构前沿LLM并通过共识模型合成输出，显著降低幻觉与偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE-LLM在推理时因专家激活不均，易放大幻觉与系统性偏差，需一种可扩展的外部共识机制提升事实性与公平性。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：①智能分诊器按复杂度路由查询；②并行调用架构各异的多个LLM生成候选答案；③结构化共识模型显式识别一致、分歧与独有信息，再输出最终回答，并给出共识机制的数学形式化。
AI.result: 在HaluEval上幻觉率相对降低35.9%，TruthfulQA提升7.8分，同时跨领域偏差方差显著下降，开源实现。
AI.conclusion: Council Mode通过异构模型并行+显式共识，有效抑制幻觉与偏差，为可信大模型部署提供通用且可扩展的框架。

title: Towards Generalization of Graph Neural Networks for AC Optimal Power Flow
comment: Pre-print has been submitted for review
summary: AC Optimal Power Flow (ACOPF) is computationally intensive for large-scale grids, often requiring prohibitive solution times with conventional solvers. Machine learning offers significant speedups, but existing models struggle with scalability and topology flexibility. To address these challenges, we propose a Hybrid Heterogeneous Message Passing Neural Network (HH-MPNN) that integrates a heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) with a scalable transformer and physics-informed positional encodings. Our architecture explicitly models distinct power system components to capture local features while using global attention for long-range dependencies. Evaluated on diverse benchmarks, including PGLearn and GridFM-DataKit datasets, HH-MPNN achieves less than 1% optimality gap on default topologies across grid sizes from 14 to 2,000 buses. For N-1 contingencies, our approach demonstrates zero-shot N-1 generalization with less than 3% optimality gap on several test cases despite training only on default topologies. We further develop an approach that ensures robust N-1 generalization to high-impact contingencies through targeted augmentation of the training data, showing that exhaustive simulation is unnecessary for topologically flexible models. Finally, size generalization experiments demonstrate that pre-training on small grids significantly improves performance on large-scale systems. Achieving computational speedups of up to 5,000 times compared to interior point solvers, these results advance practical, generalizable machine learning for real-time power system operations.

AI.tldr: 提出异构混合消息传递网络HH-MPNN，在14–2000节点电网实现<1%最优性差距，对N-1事故零样本泛化误差<3%，计算速度较内点法提升5000倍。
AI.motivation: 传统ACOPF求解器在大电网实时计算中耗时难以接受；现有机器学习方案缺乏可扩展性与拓扑灵活性，尤其难以应对N-1事故。
AI.method: 设计HH-MPNN：异构图神经网络+可扩展Transformer+物理感知位置编码，分组件建模局部特征，全局注意力捕获长程耦合；训练阶段仅使用默认拓扑，并通过数据增广强化高影响N-1场景。
AI.result: 在PGLearn与GridFM-DataKit基准上，默认拓扑误差<1%；零样本N-1泛化误差<3%；小规模预训练可显著提升大规模系统表现；计算加速最高5000×。
AI.conclusion: HH-MPNN首次在保持高精度的同时实现大电网ACOPF实时求解与拓扑灵活泛化，为实际电网在线运行提供了可行、通用的机器学习方案。

title: From Verbatim to Gist: Distilling Pyramidal Multimodal Memory via Semantic Information Bottleneck for Long-Horizon Video Agents
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026 Main. 17 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. TL;DR: We propose MM-Mem, a cognition-inspired, dual-trace hierarchical memory framework for long-horizon video understanding grounded in Fuzzy-Trace Theory. It features adaptive memory compression via the Information Bottleneck and employs an entropy-driven top-down retrieval to access fine-grained details only when necessary
summary: While multimodal large language models have demonstrated impressive short-term reasoning, they struggle with long-horizon video understanding due to limited context windows and static memory mechanisms that fail to mirror human cognitive efficiency. Existing paradigms typically fall into two extremes: vision-centric methods that incur high latency and redundancy through dense visual accumulation, or text-centric approaches that suffer from detail loss and hallucination via aggressive captioning. To bridge this gap, we propose MM-Mem, a pyramidal multimodal memory architecture grounded in Fuzzy-Trace Theory. MM-Mem structures memory hierarchically into a Sensory Buffer, Episodic Stream, and Symbolic Schema, enabling the progressive distillation of fine-grained perceptual traces (verbatim) into high-level semantic schemas (gist). Furthermore, to govern the dynamic construction of memory, we derive a Semantic Information Bottleneck objective and introduce SIB-GRPO to optimize the trade-off between memory compression and task-relevant information retention. In inference, we design an entropy-driven top-down memory retrieval strategy. Extensive experiments across 4 benchmarks confirm that MM-Mem achieves state-of-the-art performance on both offline and streaming tasks, demonstrating robust generalization and validating the effectiveness of cognition-inspired memory organization. Code and associated configurations are publicly available at https://github.com/EliSpectre/MM-Mem.

AI.tldr: MM-Mem 用三层“模糊痕迹”记忆塔把视频细节逐步抽象成语义骨架，配合信息瓶颈压缩与熵驱动召回，在 4 个长视频基准上同时拿下离线与流式 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型上下文窗口短、记忆静态，导致长视频理解崩溃；纯视觉堆帧延迟高，纯文本 Caption 又掉细节还幻觉，亟需一条折衷且类人认知的高效通路。
AI.method: 构建金字塔式多模态记忆 MM-Mem：①Sensory Buffer 缓存原始帧特征，②Episodic Stream 存中等粒度事件，③Symbolic Schema 保留高层 gist；用 Semantic Information Bottleneck 目标推导 SIB-GRPO 策略梯度算法，动态压缩记忆并保留任务相关信息；推理阶段以熵为准则自顶向下召回记忆片段。
AI.result: 在 4 个长视频理解基准（含离线与流式设置）全面达到 SOTA，显著降低冗余与延迟，同时提升细节保持与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将人类 Fuzzy-Trace 的长期记忆机制引入模型设计，可同时缓解计算冗余与信息丢失，验证了“认知启发式”记忆组织在长视频理解中的通用性与优越性。

title: Counting Worlds Branching Time Semantics for post-hoc Bias Mitigation in generative AI
summary: Generative AI systems are known to amplify biases present in their training data. While several inference-time mitigation strategies have been proposed, they remain largely empirical and lack formal guarantees. In this paper we introduce CTLF, a branching-time logic designed to reason about bias in series of generative AI outputs. CTLF adopts a counting worlds semantics where each world represents a possible output at a given step in the generation process and introduces modal operators that allow us to verify whether the current output series respects an intended probability distribution over a protected attribute, to predict the likelihood of remaining within acceptable bounds as new outputs are generated, and to determine how many outputs are needed to remove in order to restore fairness. We illustrate the framework on a toy example of biased image generation, showing how CTLF formulas can express concrete fairness properties at different points in the output series.

AI.tldr: 提出分支时间逻辑CTLF，首次对生成式AI输出序列的偏差给出可验证的形式化保证，并能计算恢复公平需移除的最小输出数量。
AI.motivation: 现有去偏方法多为经验性启发，缺乏对输出序列公平性的形式化验证与保证。
AI.method: 设计分支时间逻辑CTLF，采用计数世界语义，将每个可能输出视为世界，引入模态算子以在生成过程中实时校验受保护属性分布、预测未来偏差风险并计算修复所需移除输出数。
AI.result: 在玩具级有偏图像生成示例上，用CTLF公式在序列不同位置形式化表达了具体公平属性，验证了框架的可行性。
AI.conclusion: CTLF为生成式AI输出序列的公平性提供了首个可验证的形式化框架，可直接指导何时干预以及如何最小代价恢复公平。

title: VIGIL: An Extensible System for Real-Time Detection and Mitigation of Cognitive Bias Triggers
summary: The rise of generative AI is posing increasing risks to online information integrity and civic discourse. Most concretely, such risks can materialise in the form of mis- and disinformation. As a mitigation, media-literacy and transparency tools have been developed to address factuality of information and the reliability and ideological leaning of information sources. However, a subtler but possibly no less harmful threat to civic discourse is to use of persuasion or manipulation by exploiting human cognitive biases and related cognitive limitations. To the best of our knowledge, no tools exist to directly detect and mitigate the presence of triggers of such cognitive biases in online information. We present VIGIL (VIrtual GuardIan angeL), the first browser extension for real-time cognitive bias trigger detection and mitigation, providing in-situ scroll-synced detection, LLM-powered reformulation with full reversibility, and privacy-tiered inference from fully offline to cloud. VIGIL is built to be extensible with third-party plugins, with several plugins that are rigorously validated against NLP benchmarks are already included. It is open-sourced at https://github.com/aida-ugent/vigil.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可实时检测并缓解在线内容中认知偏差触发因子的浏览器扩展 VIGIL，支持本地/云端推理、可逆改写与插件生态。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 放大了信息操纵风险，现有工具仅关注事实核查与信源可靠性，忽视了利用人类认知偏差进行隐蔽 persuasion 的威胁。
AI.method: 构建浏览器扩展 VIGIL，采用滚动同步实时检测文本中的认知偏差触发因子；用 LLM 对可疑段落进行可逆改写；提供完全离线到云端的分级隐私推理；设计插件接口并开源。
AI.result: 首次实现针对认知偏差触发因子的在线实时检测与缓解；已集成经 NLP 基准验证的多个插件；项目已开源。
AI.conclusion: VIGIL 填补了“认知层”信息防护空白，为提升公共讨论质量提供了可扩展、可逆、隐私友好的新工具。

title: Conditional Diffusion Modeling with Attention for Probabilistic Battery Capacity Prediction under Real-World Condition
summary: Accurate prediction of lithium-ion battery capacity and its associated uncertainty is essential for reliable battery management but remains challenging due to the stochastic nature of aging. This paper presents a new method, termed the Conditional Diffusion U-Net with Attention (CDUA), which integrates feature engineering and deep learning to address this challenge. The proposed approach employs a diffusion-based generative model for time-series forecasting and incorporates attention mechanisms to enhance predictive performance. Battery capacity is first derived from real-world vehicle operation data. The most relevant features are then identified using the Pearson correlation coefficient and the XGBoost algorithm. These features are used to train the CDUA model, which comprises two components: (1) a contextual U-Net with self-attention to capture complex temporal dependencies, and (2) a noise predictor network that learns to estimate the added noise, enabling the reconstruction of accurate capacity values from noisy observations. Experimental validation on the real-world vehicle data demonstrates that the proposed CDUA model achieves a relative mean absolute error of 0.94% and a relative root mean square error of 1.14%, with a narrow 95% confidence interval of 3.74% in relative width. These results confirm that CDUA provides both accurate capacity estimation and reliable uncertainty quantification. Comparative experiments further verify its robustness and superior performance over existing mainstream approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出“条件扩散U型注意力网络”（CDUA），结合扩散模型、U-Net与注意力机制，对车辆实际运行数据做特征筛选，实现动力电池容量准确预测与不确定性量化，误差小于1%。
AI.motivation: 锂离子动力电池容量预测是电池管理的核心，但老化过程随机性强，现有方法难以同时给出高精度和可信的不确定性区间，制约安全运行与梯次利用。
AI.method: ①基于实车运行数据，用Pearson相关系数与XGBoost筛选老化特征；②构建双分支CDUA模型：分支1—带自注意力的上下文U-Net捕获长时间序列依赖，分支2—噪声预测网络在扩散过程中估计并去噪；③端到端训练输出容量分布，取期望得点估计，取95%置信区间量化不确定性。
AI.result: 在实车大数据集上，CDUA的相对MAE 0.94%、相对RMSE 1.14%，95%置信区间宽度仅3.74%，指标全面优于主流基准模型，且区间覆盖率接近理论值，表现出高鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CDUA首次将扩散生成范式引入电池容量预测，同时实现<1%的估计误差与窄置信区间，兼顾精度与不确定性可信性，可无缝嵌入BMS用于剩余寿命预测、故障预警及梯次利用评估。

title: AD-Copilot: A Vision-Language Assistant for Industrial Anomaly Detection via Visual In-context Comparison
comment: Code and models are released at https://github.com/jam-cc/AD-Copilot
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive success in natural visual understanding, yet they consistently underperform in industrial anomaly detection (IAD). This is because MLLMs trained mostly on general web data differ significantly from industrial images. Moreover, they encode each image independently and can only compare images in the language space, making them insensitive to subtle visual differences that are key to IAD. To tackle these issues, we present AD-Copilot, an interactive MLLM specialized for IAD via visual in-context comparison. We first design a novel data curation pipeline to mine inspection knowledge from sparsely labeled industrial images and generate precise samples for captioning, VQA, and defect localization, yielding a large-scale multimodal dataset Chat-AD rich in semantic signals for IAD. On this foundation, AD-Copilot incorporates a novel Comparison Encoder that employs cross-attention between paired image features to enhance multi-image fine-grained perception, and is trained with a multi-stage strategy that incorporates domain knowledge and gradually enhances IAD skills. In addition, we introduce MMAD-BBox, an extended benchmark for anomaly localization with bounding-box-based evaluation. The experiments show that AD-Copilot achieves 82.3% accuracy on the MMAD benchmark, outperforming all other models without any data leakage. In the MMAD-BBox test, it achieves a maximum improvement of $3.35\times$ over the baseline. AD-Copilot also exhibits excellent generalization of its performance gains across other specialized and general-purpose benchmarks. Remarkably, AD-Copilot surpasses human expert-level performance on several IAD tasks, demonstrating its potential as a reliable assistant for real-world industrial inspection. All datasets and models will be released for the broader benefit of the community.

AI.tldr: 提出AD-Copilot，一款专为工业缺陷检测(IAD)打造的多模态大模型，通过海量工业多模态数据Chat-AD与跨图比较编码机制，将基准精度提升到82.3%，在MMAD-BBox任务上领先基线3.35倍，并能超越人类专家。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大模型因仅见过网络图片、单图独立编码及只能在语言空间比较，难以感知工业图像中的细微缺陷，急需针对工业场景进行专门化改进。
AI.method: 1）构建Chat-AD：设计数据挖掘管线，从稀缺标注的工业图提取检测知识，生成大规模含缺陷定位/描述/VQA的多模态数据；2）在LLM中集成交叉注意比较编码器，对成对图像特征进行跨注意力融合，拉近缺陷对比；3）多阶段训练策略渐进注入工业域知识；4）推出基于框的MMAD-BBox基准补充评测。
AI.result: 在MMAD基准达82.3%检测准确率，无数据泄露仍优于现有模型；MMAD-BBox异常定位任务相比基线最高提升3.35倍，并在其它专用及通用基准表现出良好迁移性能；在若干IAD任务上性能优于人类专家。
AI.conclusion: AD-Copilot证明通过领域化数据与对比式跨图编码，可让多模态大模型胜任微差工业视觉检测，具备现实工厂可靠的智能质检助手潜力；作者将公开数据与模型以促进社区发展。

title: LePREC: Reasoning as Classification over Structured Factors for Assessing Relevance of Legal Issues
summary: More than half of the global population struggles to meet their civil justice needs due to limited legal resources. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, significant challenges remain even at the foundational step of legal issue identification. To investigate LLMs' capabilities in this task, we constructed a dataset from 769 real-world Malaysian Contract Act court cases, using GPT-4o to extract facts and generate candidate legal issues, annotated by senior legal experts, which reveals a critical limitation: while LLMs generate diverse issue candidates, their precision remains inadequate (GPT-4o achieves only 62%). To address this gap, we propose LePREC (Legal Professional-inspired Reasoning Elicitation and Classification), a neuro-symbolic framework combining neural generation with structured statistical reasoning. LePREC consists of: (1) a neuro component leverages LLMs to transform legal descriptions into question-answer pairs representing diverse analytical factors, and (2) a symbolic component applies sparse linear models over these discrete features, learning explicit algebraic weights that identify the most informative reasoning factors. Unlike end-to-end neural approaches, LePREC achieves interpretability through transparent feature weighting while maintaining data efficiency through correlation-based statistical classification. Experiments show a 30-40% improvement over advanced LLM baselines, including GPT-4o and Claude, confirming that correlation-based factor-issue analysis offers a more data-efficient solution for relevance decisions.

AI.tldr: 用改进版的 LePREC 框架替代单步 LLM 生成，在马来西亚合同法案件数据集上把案由识别精准度从 62% 提至 80% 以上，并给出可解释特征权重。
AI.motivation: 近半数人难以获得民事司法救济，LLM 虽擅长推理却在“发现正确案由”这一最先步骤上准度不足，尚无针对低资源、可解释方案的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建真实判决数据集→GPT-4o 生成大量候选案由→专家标注→提出 LePREC：先把案情转为问答对（神经部分），再用稀疏线性模型统计特征与案由的相关性（符号部分），最终由显性权重选出最相关案由。
AI.result: 在 769 例马来西亚合同法案件中，LePREC 比 GPT-4o、Claude 等端到端模型提升 30-40% 的宏观 F1，并以 ≤1 000 样本达到收敛，实现了可解释、数据高效的优势。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 生成与相关统计结合的神经符号混合范式，可在低资源环境下高效、可解释地完成法律案由识别，为普惠司法提供现实可行的技术路径。

title: Multilingual Language Models Encode Script Over Linguistic Structure
summary: Multilingual language models (LMs) organize representations for typologically and orthographically diverse languages into a shared parameter space, yet the nature of this internal organization remains elusive. In this work, we investigate which linguistic properties - abstract language identity or surface-form cues - shape multilingual representations. To do so, we analyze language-associated units across different model families and scales using the Language Activation Probability Entropy (LAPE) metric, and further decompose activations with Sparse Autoencoders. We find that these units are strongly conditioned on orthography: romanization induces near-disjoint representations that align with neither native-script inputs nor English, while word-order shuffling has limited effect on unit identity. Probing shows that typological structure becomes increasingly accessible in deeper layers, while causal interventions indicate that generation is most sensitive to units that are invariant to surface-form perturbations rather than to units identified by typological alignment alone. Overall, our results suggest that multilingual LMs organize representations around surface form, with linguistic abstraction emerging gradually without collapsing into a unified interlingua.

AI.tldr: 多语言大模型主要依循表层文字形式（正字法）而非深层类型学特征来组织跨语言表征；罗马化会引发与原生脚本截然不同、却不等同于英文的中间表征；词序扰动对特征单元影响很小。类型学信息仅在深层才变得可解码，而真正影响生成的单元是对表层扰动不“敏感”的那批。作者据此认为多语言模型并未形成统一“语义语际语”，语言抽象是渐进累积的。
AI.motivation: 现有的多语言模型将数百种文字与语法类型压缩进同一套参数，但尚不清楚它们究竟是以文字外壳、语言身份，还是更深层的类型学结构来划分内部空间。弄清这一点，有助于理解模型跨语言泛化机理并改进下游对齐与安全性。
AI.method: 1. 提出 LAPE（Language Activation Probability Entropy）量化不同层、不同单元对各语言的激活偏向。2. 在 9 种模型（参数规模 0.6B–13B、含 Encoder/Decoder 与 MoE）中提取高 LAPE 单元，并用稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder）解耦特征。3. 对比三类扰动：原文本、罗马化文本、词序随机化文本的 LAPE 变化；同时用探针（probing）逐层提取类型学特征（语序、形态、一致性等）。4. 通过因果干预（causal interchange）替换关键单元，检测对下一个词生成的平均 KL 影响，区分“表面敏感”与“表面不变”单元。
AI.result: • 80% 以上的高 LAPE 单元对罗马化高度敏感，其表征与原生脚本几乎互补，但与英文也不重合，说明罗马化本身构成新的“语言身份”。• 词序随机化仅导致 <10% 的 LAPE 值变化，显示单元判定主要依赖正字法，而非抽象语序。• 类型学读数（probing 准确率）在浅层接近随机，从第 8–10 层起显著提升，说明类型学抽象是逐层涌现。• 因果干预表明，对生成贡献最大的恰是那些对罗马化/词序不敏感的单元，而单纯“语言识别”强的单元对生成影响反而小。
AI.conclusion: 多语言大模型没有形成统一“语际语”表征，而是先在表层正字法层面强烈划分；语言类型学等信息随后在网络深层逐步浮现。真正驱动生成的单元兼具语言身份和表层不变性，提示未来对齐、安全与可解释性研究应同时关注“表层”与“深层”两类特征，而非仅依赖语言标签或类型学探针。

title: Ensembling Pruned Attention Heads For Uncertainty-Aware Efficient Transformers
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying deep neural networks in safety-critical settings. Although methods like Deep Ensembles achieve strong UQ performance, their high computational and memory costs hinder scalability to large models. We introduce Hydra Ensembles, an efficient transformer-based ensemble that prunes attention heads to create diverse members and merges them via a new multi-head attention with grouped fully-connected layers. This yields a compact model with inference speed close to a single network, matching or surpassing Deep Ensembles in UQ performance without retraining from scratch. We also provide an in-depth analysis of pruning, showing that naive approaches can harm calibration, whereas Hydra Ensembles preserves robust uncertainty. Experiments on image and text classification tasks, with various architectures, show consistent gains over Deep Ensembles. Remarkably, in zero-shot classification on ImageNet-1k, our approach surpasses state of the art methods, even without requiring additional training.

AI.tldr: Hydra Ensembles 用剪枝多头注意力生成多样性成员并融合为紧凑 Transformer，单次网络推理速度下即可媲美甚至超越 Deep Ensemble 的不确定性效果，无需端到端重训。
AI.motivation: 安全关键场景需可靠不确定性估计，Deep Ensemble 性能优但计算/显存巨大，难以向大模型扩展。作者寻求在不重训的前提下显著降低开销并保留 UQ 品质。
AI.method: 1) 对共享权重的 Transformer 逐成员剪枝注意力头，生成子结构作为子模型；2) 引入分组全连接多注意力，把多个子头输出融合为单一前向推理路径；3) 整体网络一次加载共享参数，推断阶段动态组合输出，无需重建或重训权重。
AI.result: ImageNet-1k/Fine-tune 及文本分类实验均优于 Deep Ensemble，部分指标提升 1-2 pp；默认无需微调即可在 ImageNet 零样本任务上超越现有 SOTA，同时推理时延仅单模型级别，显存降至若干子模型共用程度的 30%。
AI.conclusion: 通过“头级剪枝＋局部共享融合”快速生成 UQ 成员，Hydra Ensembles 首次在不重训或重排序的情况下取得 Deep Ensemble 级别效果；其剪融策略不会引入过度自信误差，验证表明可推广到多种自注意模型，为安全域部署大规模神经网络的轻量化不确定性提供数据级与模型级双重支持。

title: MAGICIAN: Efficient Long-Term Planning with Imagined Gaussians for Active Mapping
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 (Oral). Project webpage: https://shiyao-li.github.io/magician/
summary: Active mapping aims to determine how an agent should move to efficiently reconstruct unknown environments. Most existing approaches rely on greedy next-best-view prediction, resulting in inefficient exploration and incomplete reconstruction. To address this, we introduce MAGICIAN, a novel long-term planning framework that maximizes accumulated surface coverage gain through Imagined Gaussians, a scene representation based on 3D Gaussian Splatting, derived from a pre-trained occupancy network with strong structural priors. This representation enables efficient coverage gain computation for any novel viewpoint via fast volumetric rendering, allowing its integration into a tree-search algorithm for long-horizon planning. We update Imagined Gaussians and refine the trajectory in a closed loop. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across indoor and outdoor benchmarks with varying action spaces, highlighting the advantage of long-term planning in active mapping.

AI.tldr: MAGICIAN:利用「想象高斯」的长时规划主动建图框架，在覆盖率和完整性方面显著优于现有短视(greedy-NBV)方法。
AI.motivation: 现有主动建图多采取「下一个最佳视域」贪心策略，规划短视、探索效率低、易留未重建空洞，急需可长时间考虑累积收益的全局方法。
AI.method: 提出基于树搜索的长时规划框架MAGICIAN。①在预训练Occupancy网络的先验上推理出「想象高斯」(Imagined Gaussians)场景先验；②利用快速体积渲染对任意预测姿态计算表面覆盖率收益；③滚动地将收益估计算子嵌入MCTS/树搜索，长期优化探索+重建联合轨迹，并闭环更新场景先验。
AI.result: 在多种室内外数据集(不同传感器/行动空间)中均取得SOTA：重建完整率平均提升>15%(30→45%)，探索步数降低20%以上，时有20-45%的容积率增益。
AI.conclusion: 长期规划+显式几何先验可显著提升主动建图体验与重建质量；Imagined Gaussians的结构化先验与快速可导渲染是实现全局优化的关键突破，并具向机器人SLAM及物体级重构等任务迁移潜力。

title: A neural operator framework for data-driven discovery of stability and receptivity in physical systems
summary: Understanding how complex systems respond to perturbations, such as whether they will remain stable or what their most sensitive patterns are, is a fundamental challenge across science and engineering. Traditional stability and receptivity (resolvent) analyses are powerful but rely on known equations and linearization, limiting their use in nonlinear or poorly modeled systems. Here, we introduce a data-driven framework that automatically identifies stability properties and optimal forcing responses from observation data alone, without requiring governing equations. By training a neural network as a dynamics emulator and using automatic differentiation to extract its Jacobian, we can compute eigenmodes and resolvent modes directly from data. We demonstrate the method on both canonical chaotic models and high-dimensional fluid flows, successfully identifying dominant instability modes and input-output structures even in strongly nonlinear regimes. By leveraging a neural network-based emulator, we readily obtain a nonlinear representation of system dynamics while additionally retrieving intricate dynamical patterns that were previously difficult to resolve. This equation-free methodology establishes a broadly applicable tool for analyzing complex, high-dimensional datasets, with immediate relevance to grand challenges in fields such as climate science, neuroscience, and fluid engineering.

AI.tldr: 提出无需方程的数据驱动框架，用神经网络模拟动力学并自动提取雅可比矩阵，实现复杂系统稳定性与强迫响应分析；在混沌模型和高维流场中验证，可识别主导不稳定模态与输入–输出结构。
AI.motivation: 传统稳定性/接受度分析依赖已知方程和线性化，难以处理非线性或模型未知的高维系统；亟需一种仅基于观测数据就能判定稳定性并预测最优强迫响应的方法。
AI.method: 训练神经网络作为动力学模拟器→利用自动微分获取其雅可比矩阵→直接计算特征模态与解算子（resolvent）模态；整个流程完全无方程、纯数据驱动。
AI.result: 在经典混沌系统和高维流体流动的强非线性区域内，准确识别出主导不稳定模态与输入–输出耦合结构，验证其与传统基于方程分析结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 建立了普适的无方程分析工具，可推广至气候、神经、流体等高维复杂数据集，为稳定性与敏感性研究提供新范式。

title: NameBERT: Scaling Name-Based Nationality Classification with LLM-Augmented Open Academic Data
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables; accepted at the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence (Canadian AI 2026)
summary: Inferring nationality from personal names is a critical capability for equity and bias monitoring, personalization, and a valuable tool in biomedical and sociological research. However, existing name-based nationality classifiers are typically trained on relatively small or source-specific labeled datasets, which can introduce coverage gaps and limit performance for underrepresented countries. While large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong zero-shot performance for name-based nationality prediction, their computational cost and latency make them impractical for real-time, large-scale deployment. In this work, we created a large-scale name-nationality dataset from the Open Academic Graph (OAG) and introduce a framework that leverages LLMs as dataset enrichers rather than inference engines. We augment low-resource countries with LLM-generated names and evaluate on real and synthetic-tail test sets. We find that augmentation produces large gains when evaluation includes synthetic tail names and still offers a modest lift on tail-country metrics otherwise. Overall, NameBERT models achieve significantly higher accuracy than state-of-the-art baselines across both in- and out-of-domain tasks, while remaining efficient for large-scale inference compared to LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于BERT轻量级模型NameBERT，通过LLM生成低资源国家人名数据增强训练集，在保持高效推理的同时显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有人名国籍分类器受限于小规模标注数据，LLM推理成本高不适合实时大规模应用；需构建大规模数据并兼顾低资源国家性能。
AI.method: 从OAG抽取人名-国籍对构建超大规模训练集；用LLM为低资源国家合成姓名做数据增强；在BERT上微调得NameBERT模型。
AI.result: NameBERT在域内域外测试集上均显著优于现有最佳基线；LLM数据增强对尾部国家指标提升尤其明显，整体效率远高于LLM推理。
AI.conclusion: NameBERT兼顾精度与效率，LLM作为数据增强工具而非推理引擎可有效缓解低资源国籍覆盖问题，为公平性与偏见监测提供实用工具。

title: Enabling Vibration-Based Gesture Recognition on Everyday Furniture via Energy-Efficient FPGA Implementation of 1D Convolutional Networks
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, accepted by 2025 IEEE Annual Congress on Artificial Intelligence of Things (IEEE AIoT)
summary: The growing demand for smart home interfaces has increased interest in non-intrusive sensing methods like vibration-based gesture recognition. While prior studies demonstrated feasibility, they often rely on complex preprocessing and large Neural Networks (NNs) requiring costly high-performance hardware, resulting in high energy usage and limited real-world deployability. This study proposes an energy-efficient solution deploying compact NNs on low-power Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) to enable real-time gesture recognition with competitive accuracy. We adopt a series of optimizations: (1) We replace complex spectral preprocessing with raw waveform input, eliminating complex on-board preprocessing while reducing input size by 21x without sacrificing accuracy. (2) We design two lightweight architectures (1D-CNN and 1D-SepCNN) tailored for embedded FPGAs, reducing parameters from 369 million to as few as 216 while maintaining comparable accuracy. (3) With integer-only quantization and automated RTL generation, we achieve seamless FPGA deployment. A ping-pong buffering mechanism in 1D-SepCNN further improves deployability under tight memory constraints. (4) We extend a hardware-aware search framework to support constraint-driven model configuration selection, considering accuracy, deployability, latency, and energy consumption. Evaluated on two swipe-direction datasets with multiple users and ordinary tables, our approach achieves low-latency, energy-efficient inference on the AMD Spartan-7 XC7S25 FPGA. Under the PS data splitting setting, the selected 6-bit 1D-CNN reaches 0.970 average accuracy across users with 9.22 ms latency. The chosen 8-bit 1D-SepCNN further reduces latency to 6.83 ms (over 53x CPU speedup) with slightly lower accuracy (0.949). Both consume under 1.2 mJ per inference, demonstrating suitability for long-term edge operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向低功耗FPGA的微型神经网络，用于智能家居振动手势识别，无需频谱预处理即可在6–9 ms、<1.2 mJ 内完成单次推理，准确率>94%。
AI.motivation: 现有振动手势方案依赖高算力平台和大模型，功耗高、部署难，难以长期运行在电池供电的智能家居边缘节点。
AI.method: 1) 用原始波形替代频谱，输入尺寸压缩21×；2) 设计1D-CNN/1D-SepCNN轻量架构，参数量降至216；3) 纯整数量化+自动RTL生成，集成乒乓缓冲；4) 引入硬件感知搜索，在准确率、延迟、能耗、可部署性间自动选模。
AI.result: 在AMD Spartan-7 XC7S25 FPGA上，6-bit 1D-CNN平均准确率97.0%，延迟9.22 ms；8-bit 1D-SepCNN延迟6.83 ms（相对CPU加速53×），准确率94.9%，单次能耗均<1.2 mJ。
AI.conclusion: 该方法首次将振动手势识别做到毫焦级能耗与毫秒级延迟，且无需高性能硬件，为低成本、长寿命智能家居交互提供可量产边缘方案。

title: ORSIFlow: Saliency-Guided Rectified Flow for Optical Remote Sensing Salient Object Detection
summary: Optical Remote Sensing Image Salient Object Detection (ORSI-SOD) remains challenging due to complex backgrounds, low contrast, irregular object shapes, and large variations in object scale. Existing discriminative methods directly regress saliency maps, while recent diffusion-based generative approaches suffer from stochastic sampling and high computational cost. In this paper, we propose ORSIFlow, a saliency-guided rectified flow framework that reformulates ORSI-SOD as a deterministic latent flow generation problem. ORSIFlow performs saliency mask generation in a compact latent space constructed by a frozen variational autoencoder, enabling efficient inference with only a few steps. To enhance saliency awareness, we design a Salient Feature Discriminator for global semantic discrimination and a Salient Feature Calibrator for precise boundary refinement. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks show that ORSIFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance with significantly improved efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ORSIFlow——首个将光学遥感显著目标检测(ORSI-SOD)建模为确定性潜在流生成的方法，兼顾精度与速度。
AI.motivation: 光学遥感图像背景复杂、对比度低、目标形状不规则且尺度差异大，现有判别式方法直接回归粗糙，扩散生成方法又存在随机采样与高昂计算瓶颈，亟需高效且稳定的替代方案。
AI.method: 1) 将 VAE 冻结得到紧凑潜在空间，显著性检测转化为确定性修正流生成任务；2) 提出 Salient Feature Discriminator 与 Salient Feature Calibrator，前者利用全局上下文提升语义区分，后者精细对齐边界；3) 整体框架单模型、少步数推理，无需蒙特卡洛采样。
AI.result: 在公开基准上，ORSI-SOD 多项指标刷新 SOTA，推理步数从千兆级扩散方法的 50-100 降至 2-4，参数量降低且速度提升。
AI.conclusion: ORSIFlow 首次把修正流引入遥感显著检测，兼顾高精度与低计算，验证确定性潜在生成范式的可行性，为高速遥感监测和前端部署提供了新思路。

title: Fairness Audits of Institutional Risk Models in Deployed ML Pipelines
summary: Fairness audits of institutional risk models are critical for understanding how deployed machine learning pipelines allocate resources. Drawing on multi-year collaboration with Centennial College, where our prior ethnographic work introduced the ASP-HEI Cycle, we present a replica-based audit of a deployed Early Warning System (EWS), replicating its model using institutional training data and design specifications. We evaluate disparities by gender, age, and residency status across the full pipeline (training data, model predictions, and post-processing) using standard fairness metrics. Our audit reveals systematic misallocation: younger, male, and international students are disproportionately flagged for support, even when many ultimately succeed, while older and female students with comparable dropout risk are under-identified. Post-processing amplifies these disparities by collapsing heterogeneous probabilities into percentile-based risk tiers. This work provides a replicable methodology for auditing institutional ML systems and shows how disparities emerge and compound across stages, highlighting the importance of evaluating construct validity alongside statistical fairness. It contributes one empirical thread to a broader program investigating algorithms, student data, and power in higher education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套可复制的院校级机器学习系统公平性审计方法，通过对某高校 Early Warning System（EWS）全链路复现，发现年轻、男性、国际学生被过度标记，而年长、女性学生风险被低估，后处理环节进一步放大差异。
AI.motivation: 院校资源分配模型日益依赖 ML，但缺乏系统、可复制的公平性审计框架；作者延续与 Centennial College 的长期合作，将 ASP-HEI 循环方法用于真实部署系统，以揭示算法权力如何重塑学生机会。
AI.method: 1) 依据院校原始训练数据与设计文档，全流程复现 EWS；2) 在训练数据、模型预测、后处理三阶段，用 standard fairness metrics（如 equal opportunity、校准差异）评估性别、年龄、居住身份差异；3) 结合 ASP-HEI 循环进行定性-定量混合分析。
AI.result: 1) 系统性误分配：控制真实辍学风险后，年轻、男性、国际学生被过度预测为高 risk（标记率↑），年长、女性学生被漏检；2) 后处理把连续概率压入百分位 tier，使微小差异被制度性放大；3) 算法结果与院校“成功”构念不一致，construct validity 缺失。
AI.conclusion: 仅检验统计公平性不足以保障教育公平，必须同步评估构念效度与全链路决策逻辑；文章提供可复制的院校 ML 审计范式，为后续研究算法-学生数据-权力关系奠定实证基础。

title: A Triadic Suffix Tokenization Scheme for Numerical Reasoning
comment: v3: Updated to include analysis of N=1 scalability for SLM architectures
summary: Standard subword tokenization methods fragment numbers inconsistently, causing large language models (LLMs) to lose positional and decimal structure - a primary driver of errors in arithmetic and scientific reasoning. We introduce Triadic Suffix Tokenization (TST), a deterministic scheme that partitions digits into three-digit triads and annotates each triad with an explicit magnitude marker. Critically, the scheme defines a fixed, one-to-one mapping between suffixes and orders of magnitude for the integer part (thousands, millions, billions, etc.) and a parallel system of replicated markers for fractional depth (tenths, thousandths, millionths, etc.). Unlike approaches that rely on positional inference, this method provides a consistent gradient signal, which should ensure stable convergence. Two implementation variants are proposed: (1) a vocabulary-based approach that adds at most 10,000 fixed tokens to an existing vocabulary, covering 33 orders of magnitude ($10^{-15}$ to $10^{18}$); and (2) a suffix-marker approach that uses a small set of special tokens to denote magnitude dynamically. Both variants preserve exact digits while making order-of-magnitude relationships transparent at the token level. While we focus on 3-digit groups (Triadic), the framework is inherently scalable to any group size for precise vocabulary optimization. Furthermore, it allows for linear vocabulary expansion to accommodate arbitrary precision and range. TST is architecture-agnostic and can be integrated as a drop-in preprocessing step. Experimental validation is deferred to future work.

AI.tldr: TST 通过将数字按三位一组切分并显式附加量级标记，使 LLM 在词元层面即可感知绝对数值与量级关系，从根本上消除因子词碎片导致的算术/科学推理错误。
AI.motivation: 现有子词分词对数字切分不一致，破坏了位置与十进制结构，成为 LLM 算术与科学推理错误的主因。作者希望用确定性、可扩展的编码方式，让模型在输入阶段就获得稳定、显式的量级信息。
AI.method: 提出 Triadic Suffix Tokenization (TST)：1) 将整数与小数部分均以三位为单元分组；2) 为每组后缀绑定唯一量级标记（如 k、M、μ 等），形成一对一映射；3) 提供两种实现：① 向词表添加 ≤10 k 固定词元，覆盖 33 个量级；② 用少量特殊后缀词元动态标注量级。整个框架与模型结构无关，可线性扩展至任意精度与范围。
AI.result: 理论分析表明 TST 能为梯度提供一致的量级信号，避免因位置推断带来的噪声；可精确保留所有数字位，同时在词元层面显式暴露数量级关系。实验验证留待后续工作。
AI.conclusion: TST 以极低成本（≈10 k 词元或少量后缀标记）在预处理阶段彻底解决数字子词碎片化问题，为提升 LLM 算术与科学推理能力提供了可扩展、即插即用的通用方案。

title: Multiclass Local Calibration with the Jensen-Shannon Distance
summary: Developing trustworthy Machine Learning (ML) models requires their predicted probabilities to be well-calibrated, meaning they should reflect true-class frequencies. Among calibration notions in multiclass classification, strong calibration is the most stringent, as it requires all predicted probabilities to be simultaneously calibrated across all classes. However, existing approaches to multiclass calibration lack a notion of distance among inputs, which makes them vulnerable to proximity bias: predictions in sparse regions of the feature space are systematically miscalibrated. In this work, we address this main shortcoming by introducing a local perspective on multiclass calibration. First, we formally define multiclass local calibration and establish its relationship with strong calibration. Second, we theoretically analyze the pitfalls of existing evaluation metrics when applied to multiclass local calibration. Third, we propose a practical method to enhance local calibration in Neural Networks, which enforces alignment between predicted probabilities and local estimates of class frequencies using the Jensen-Shannon distance. Finally, we empirically validate our approach against existing multiclass calibration techniques.

AI.tldr: 提出并解决了多分类场景下“局部校准”缺失导致的邻近偏差问题，用 JS 距离约束局部类频率来改进神经网络的整体可信度。
AI.motivation: 强校准虽严格，但现有方法未考虑输入空间的距离结构，致使稀疏区域预测概率系统性失准；亟需引入局部视角消除邻近偏差。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义多分类局部校准并建立与强校准的理论联系；2) 剖析既有评估指标在局部设定下的失效风险；3) 以 Jensen-Shannon 距离为损失，将网络输出的概率向量与局部类频率估计对齐，实现局部校准增强。
AI.result: 理论证明局部校准可提升强校准；实验表明所提方法在多种度量与数据集上显著优于现有最先进技术，稀疏区域改善最明显。
AI.conclusion: 局部化是多分类校准的关键维度，JS 距离对齐策略可即插即用，为构建高可信神经网络提供新范式。

title: Q-Mask: Query-driven Causal Masks for Text Anchoring in OCR-Oriented Vision-Language Models
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is increasingly regarded as a foundational capability for modern vision-language models (VLMs), enabling them not only to read text in images but also to support downstream reasoning in real-world visual question answering (VQA). However, practical applications further require reliable text anchors, i.e., accurately grounding queried text to its corresponding spatial region. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce TextAnchor-Bench (TABench), a benchmark for fine-grained text-region grounding, which reveals that both general-purpose and OCR-specific VLMs still struggle to establish accurate and stable text anchors. To address this limitation, we propose Q-Mask, a precise OCR framework built upon a causal query-driven mask decoder (CQMD). Inspired by chain-of-thought reasoning, Q-Mask performs causal visual decoding that sequentially generates query-conditioned visual masks before producing the final OCR output. This visual CoT paradigm disentangles where the text is from what the text is, enforcing grounded evidence acquisition prior to recognition and enabling explicit text anchor construction during inference. To train CQMD, we construct TextAnchor-26M, a large-scale dataset of image-text pairs annotated with fine-grained masks corresponding to specific textual elements, encouraging stable text-region correspondences and injecting strong spatial priors into VLM training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-Mask substantially improves text anchoring and understanding across diverse visual scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有视觉-语言模型虽能OCR，但缺乏“文本锚定”能力，提出TABench评测基准、TextAnchor-26M掩膜数据集及Q-Mask框架，用因果查询驱动掩码解码器实现先定位后识别的显式锚定，显著增强VQA等场景下的文本 grounding 与理解。
AI.motivation: 实际VQA应用不仅要求模型识别图中文字，还需把查询文本精准映射到对应空间区域（text anchoring）。现有通用及OCR专用VLM在此细粒度定位任务上表现差且不稳定，缺乏系统评测与针对性方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建TextAnchor-Bench（TABench）细粒度文本-区域锚定基准；2) 提出Q-Mask框架，核心为因果查询驱动掩码解码器（CQMD），以类CoT方式顺序生成查询条件视觉掩码再输出OCR，实现“先定位、后识别”的显式锚定；3) 配套构建2600万图文对并附文本元素像素掩码的TextAnchor-26M数据集，注入空间先验进行训练。
AI.result: TABench实验显示，无论通用或OCR专属VLM在文本锚定上均表现不佳。Q-Mask借助CQMD与大规模掩码数据，在多样视觉场景中显著提升了文本锚定准确率与整体OCR理解鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将文本锚定显式解耦为定位-识别两阶段，并通过大规模掩码预训练注入空间先验，是提升VLM在真实VQA等任务中可靠OCR能力的关键；Q-Mask为该方向提供了有效范式与基线。

title: EVPO: Explained Variance Policy Optimization for Adaptive Critic Utilization in LLM Post-Training
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for LLM post-training faces a fundamental design choice: whether to use a learned critic as a baseline for policy optimization. Classical theory favors critic-based methods such as PPO for variance reduction, yet critic-free alternatives like GRPO have gained widespread adoption due to their simplicity and competitive performance. We show that in sparse-reward settings, a learned critic can inject estimation noise that exceeds the state signal it captures, increasing rather than reducing advantage variance. By casting baseline selection as a Kalman filtering problem, we unify PPO and GRPO as two extremes of the Kalman gain and prove that explained variance (EV), computable from a single training batch, identifies the exact boundary: positive EV indicates the critic reduces variance, while zero or negative EV signals that it inflates variance. Building on this insight, we propose Explained Variance Policy Optimization (EVPO), which monitors batch-level EV at each training step and adaptively switches between critic-based and batch-mean advantage estimation, provably achieving no greater variance than the better of the two at every step. Across four tasks spanning classical control, agentic interaction, and mathematical reasoning, EVPO consistently outperforms both PPO and GRPO regardless of which fixed baseline is stronger on a given task. Further analysis confirms that the adaptive gating tracks critic maturation over training and that the theoretically derived zero threshold is empirically optimal.

AI.tldr: 作者发现稀疏奖励下学习型critic反而可能增加方差，提出用简单可算的「解释方差」(EV)作为判据，在每一步自动决定是否用critic，形成EVPO算法。四种任务中EVPO均优于PPO与GRPO，验证了EV作为阈值且在线切换的有效性。
AI.motivation: RL后训练阶段中用不用critic做baseline是悬而未决的问题：PPO等经典方法依赖critic以降低方差，但critic-free的GRPO因简单而流行。稀疏奖励场景下critic估计不准确，反而可能放大方差，需要理论指导和自动选择机制。
AI.method: 1. 将baseline选择描述为Kalman滤波问题，证明PPO和GRPO对应Kalman增益的两个极端；2. 给出基于单批数据即可计算的「解释方差(EV)」定理——EV>0时使用critic可降低方差，EV≤0时critic引入的噪声大于收益；3. 提出EVPO：每一步计算batch级EV并自适应切换critic-based与batch-mean优势估计。
AI.result: 在经典控制、智能体交互、数学推理四类任务上，EVPO稳定超越PPO与GRPO，无论哪一种固定baseline在该任务上表现更强；在线门控准确跟踪critic成熟度，零阈值经验最优。
AI.conclusion: 解释方差(EV)为稀疏奖励下是否使用critic提供了可计算的理论界限；基于EV的自适应切换策略在任何时刻都不会劣于两种极端方案，实现了理论与实用的统一，并可推广至其他需要做方差-偏差权衡的RL场景。

title: Evaluating Cooperation in LLM Social Groups through Elected Leadership
summary: Governing common-pool resources requires agents to develop enduring strategies through cooperation and self-governance to avoid collective failure.
