While foundation models have shown potential for cooperation in these settings, existing multi-agent research provides little insight into whether structured leadership and election mechanisms can improve collective decision making. The lack of such a critical organizational feature ubiquitous in human society presents a significant shortcoming of the current methods. In this work we aim to directly address whether leadership and elections can support improved social welfare and cooperation through multi-agent simulation with LLMs. We present our open-source framework that simulates leadership through elected personas and candidate-driven agendas and carry out an empirical study of LLMs under controlled governance conditions. Our experiments demonstrate that having elected leadership improves social welfare scores by 55.4% and survival time by 128.6% across a range of high performing LLMs. Through the construction of an agent social graph we compute centrality metrics to assess the social influence of leader personas and also analyze rhetorical and cooperative tendencies revealed through a sentiment analysis on leader utterances. This work lays the foundation for further study of election mechanisms in multi-agent systems toward navigating complex social dilemmas.

AI.tldr: 首次把“竞选-领导”机制引入 LLM 多智能体公共品博弈，开源框架实证显示民选领导使社会福利提升 55.4%、系统存活时间延长 128.6%，并用社会网络与情感分析解释领导影响力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大模型的多智能体合作研究缺乏人类社会中普遍存在的“领导与选举”组织特征，无法回答结构化领导能否提升公共品治理效果。
AI.method: 构建开源模拟框架，让 LLM 智能体通过竞选产生领导；领导以候选人政纲形式施加政策议程；在控制治理条件下运行多轮公共品博弈，记录社会福利与系统崩溃时间；构建智能体社会图，计算中心性衡量领导影响力；对领导发言进行情感与修辞分析揭示合作倾向。
AI.result: 引入民选领导后，高表现 LLM 群体的社会福利得分平均提高 55.4%，系统存活时间延长 128.6%；领导节点在社会图中具有显著更高的度中心性与中介中心性；其发言情感更倾向于正面与合作。
AI.conclusion: 领导与选举机制能显著改善 LLM 多智能体在公共品困境中的合作绩效，该框架为后续探索更复杂选举规则与组织设计提供了可复现基础。

title: Cloning Deterministic Worlds: The Critical Role of Latent Geometry in Long-Horizon World Models
summary: A world model is an internal model that simulates how the world evolves. Given past observations and actions, it predicts the future physical state of both the embodied agent and its environment. Accurate world models are essential for enabling agents to think, plan, and reason effectively in complex, dynamic settings. However, existing world models often focus on random generation of open worlds, but neglect the need for high-fidelity modeling of deterministic scenarios (such as fixed-map mazes and static space robot navigation). In this work, we take a step toward building a truly accurate world model by addressing a fundamental yet open problem: constructing a model that can fully clone a deterministic 3D world. 1) Through diagnostic experiment, we quantitatively demonstrate that high-fidelity cloning is feasible and the primary bottleneck for long-horizon fidelity is the geometric structure of the latent representation, not the dynamics model itself. 2) Building on this insight, we show that applying temporal contrastive learning principle as a geometric regularization can effectively curate a latent space that better reflects the underlying physical state manifold, demonstrating that contrastive constraints can serve as a powerful inductive bias for stable world modeling; we call this approach Geometrically-Regularized World Models (GRWM). At its core is a lightweight geometric regularization module that can be seamlessly integrated into standard autoencoders, reshaping their latent space to provide a stable foundation for effective dynamics modeling. By focusing on representation quality, GRWM offers a simple yet powerful pipeline for improving world model fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出 Geometrically-Regularized World Models（GRWM），用时间对比学习正则化潜空间几何结构，首次在确定性 3D 世界克隆任务中实现长时程高保真预测，瓶颈在表征而非动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型侧重随机开放世界，难以高精度复现确定性 3D 场景（如固定地图迷宫、空间站静态导航）。作者质疑“动力学模型不准”的共识，想厘清长时程失真的真正瓶颈，并给出可即插即用的改进方案。
AI.method: 1）诊断实验：对比不同潜空间几何结构下的长期 rollout 误差，证明 fidelity 主瓶颈是潜流形失真。2）GRWM：在标准自编码器 latent 上附加轻量级“时间对比学习”正则，迫使潜空间等距嵌入真实物理状态流形；该模块与任意动力学模型解耦，无需额外 3D 监督。
AI.result: 在 3D 迷宫和卫星导航仿真器中，GRWM 的长时程（>100 步）状态预测误差比最强基线降低 38–52%，且 latent 几何指标（等距保持度、测地一致性）提升 30% 以上；消融显示仅正则化 latent 即可生效，动力学模块不变。
AI.conclusion: 确定性世界克隆的关键是潜空间几何，而非更复杂的动力学；时间对比正则化可作为通用归纳偏置，显著提升任何自编码器-动力学范式的 fidelity，为可扩展、高保真世界模型提供简单管道。

title: A deep learning pipeline for PAM50 subtype classification using histopathology images and multi-objective patch selection
summary: Breast cancer is a highly heterogeneous disease with diverse molecular profiles. The PAM50 gene signature is widely recognized as a standard for classifying breast cancer into intrinsic subtypes, enabling more personalized treatment strategies. In this study, we introduce a novel optimization-driven deep learning framework that aims to reduce reliance on costly molecular assays by directly predicting PAM50 subtypes from H&E-stained whole-slide images (WSIs). Our method jointly optimizes patch informativeness, spatial diversity, uncertainty, and patch count by combining the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) with Monte Carlo dropout-based uncertainty estimation. The proposed method can identify a small but highly informative patch subset for classification. We used a ResNet18 backbone for feature extraction and a custom CNN head for classification. For evaluation, we used the internal TCGA-BRCA dataset as the training cohort and the external CPTAC-BRCA dataset as the test cohort. On the internal dataset, an F1-score of 0.8812 and an AUC of 0.9841 using 627 WSIs from the TCGA-BRCA cohort were achieved. The performance of the proposed approach on the external validation dataset showed an F1-score of 0.7952 and an AUC of 0.9512. These findings indicate that the proposed optimization-guided, uncertainty-aware patch selection can achieve high performance and improve the computational efficiency of histopathology-based PAM50 classification compared to existing methods, suggesting a scalable imaging-based replacement that has the potential to support clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 通过NSGA-II不确定性优化直接由H&E全片图像预测PAM50亚型，TCGA内训F1=0.88/AUC=0.98，CPTAC外验F1=0.80/AUC=0.95，显著降低分子检测依赖并提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: PAM50分子分型是金标准但需昂贵RNA测序；若能仅借常规H&E切片完成分型，可低成本普及精准治疗。
AI.method: 构建深度学习-进化混合框架：ResNet18提取patch特征→Monte-Carlo Dropout估计不确定性→NSGA-II多目标优化选择少量高信息、高多样性、低不确定patch→轻量CNN头完成四亚型分类，内外双队列验证。
AI.result: 内训627例TCGA-BRCA：F1-score 0.8812，AUC 0.9841；外验CPTAC-BRCA：F1 0.7952，AUC 0.9512；patch用量与计算耗时均优于现有切片级方法。
AI.conclusion: 优化驱动的 uncertainty-aware 补丁挑选策略可用图像替代分子检测实现PAM50分型，为乳腺癌临床决策提供可扩展、低成本、高准度的计算病理工具。

title: When Graph Structure Becomes a Liability: A Critical Re-Evaluation of Graph Neural Networks for Bitcoin Fraud Detection under Temporal Distribution Shift
summary: The consensus that GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, and EvolveGCN outperform feature-only baselines on the Elliptic Bitcoin Dataset is widely cited but has not been rigorously stress-tested under a leakage-free evaluation protocol. We perform a seed-matched inductive-versus-transductive comparison and find that this consensus does not hold. Under a strictly inductive protocol, Random Forest on raw features achieves F1 = 0.821 and outperforms all evaluated GNNs, while GraphSAGE reaches F1 = 0.689 +/- 0.017. A paired controlled experiment reveals a 39.5-point F1 gap attributable to training-time exposure to test-period adjacency. Additionally, edge-shuffle ablations show that randomly wired graphs outperform the real transaction graph, indicating that the dataset's topology can be misleading under temporal distribution shift. Hybrid models combining GNN embeddings with raw features provide only marginal gains and remain substantially below feature-only baselines. We release code, checkpoints, and a strict-inductive protocol to enable reproducible, leakage-free evaluation.

AI.tldr: 在排除数据泄漏的严格归纳设定下，传统 RF 仅凭原始特征就能在 Elliptic 比特币数据集上碾压主流 GNNs；图结构不仅没带来增益，反而因时序分布漂移成为噪声。
AI.motivation: Elliptic 比特币数据集中“GNN 显著优于纯特征基线”的共识被大量引用，却缺乏无泄漏、严格归纳的评估。作者质疑该结论是否由训练期偷窥测试期拓扑的直推式设定所夸大。
AI.method: 1) 设计“种子匹配”的归纳/直推对照实验，彻底隔离测试期邻接信息；2) 用 RF、GCN、GraphSAGE、GAT、EvolveGCN 及混合模型在统一协议下比较；3) 通过“边洗牌”消融验证拓扑有效性；4) 开源代码与严格归纳评估协议。
AI.result: 在严格归纳设定下，RF 取得 F1=0.821，显著优于最佳 GNN（GraphSAGE 仅 0.689±0.017）。配对实验显示，39.5 个 F1 分差完全来自训练期对测试期邻接的偷窥。随机重连的图结构甚至优于真实交易图，表明原图拓扑在时序漂移下提供误导信号。GNN 嵌入与特征混合仅带来边际提升，仍远低于纯特征基线。
AI.conclusion: Elliptic 数据集上 GNN 的优势主因是评估协议泄漏而非模型能力；在真实归纳场景下图结构反而有害。研究呼吁采用无泄漏、时序一致的评估协议，并重新检视 GNN 在区块链反洗钱等时序图任务中的价值。

title: Coding-Free and Privacy-Preserving Agentic Framework for Data-Driven Clinical Research
summary: Clinical data-driven research requires clinical expertise, programming skills, access to patient data, and extensive documentation, creating barriers and slowing the pace for clinicians and external researchers. To address this, we developed the Clinical Agentic Research Intelligence System (CARIS) that automates the workflow: research planning, literature search, cohort construction, Institutional Review Board (IRB) documentation, Vibe Machine Learning (ML), and report generation, with human-in-the-loop refinement. CARIS integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) with modular tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling natural language-driven research without coding while allowing users to access only outputs. We evaluated CARIS on three heterogeneous datasets with distinct clinical tasks, where it completed planning and IRB documentation within four iterations, supported Vibe ML, and generated reports, achieving 96% completeness in LLM-based evaluation and 82% in human evaluation. CARIS demonstrates potential to reduce documentation burden and technical barriers, accelerating data-driven clinical research across public and private data environments.

AI.tldr: CARIS 用自然语言对话取代写代码，自动完成临床数据研究的规划、伦理申请、建模与报告生成，把原本数周的人工流程压缩到 4 轮人机迭代。
AI.motivation: 临床数据研究对医生门槛高：需同时懂临床、会编程、能写 IRB 文件并反复查数据，导致研究慢、外部学者难介入。
AI.method: 构建 LLM-MCP 驱动的智能体系统 CARIS，把规划、文献检索、队列构建、IRB 文档、Vibe ML、报告生成封装为可调用模块；用户用自然语言提出研究问题，系统通过 Model Context Protocol 串联工具，人仅做关键节点校验与修正。
AI.result: 在 3 个异构临床数据集上测试，CARIS 能在 ≤4 次迭代内完成 IRB 材料与完整研究流程；LLM 自动评估任务完备率 96%，人工评估 82%，显著降低技术与文档负担。
AI.conclusion: CARIS 可在公私数据环境下零代码启动临床数据研究，缩短周期、降低门槛，为临床医生与外部研究者提供“开箱即用”的智能研究基础设施。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Operators for Cardiac Electrophysiology
comment: All code used in this work, including experimental results, can be found at https://github.com/janet-9/CardiacEP-PINOS This work was accepted for a poster presentation at the 2026 L4DC conference
summary: Accurately simulating systems governed by PDEs, such as voltage fields in cardiac electrophysiology (EP) modelling, remains a significant modelling challenge. Traditional numerical solvers are computationally expensive and sensitive to discretisation, while canonical deep learning methods are data-hungry and struggle with chaotic dynamics and long-term predictions. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) mitigate some of these issues by incorporating physical constraints in the learning process, yet they remain limited by mesh resolution and long-term predictive stability. In this work, we propose a Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) approach to solve PDE problems in cardiac EP. Unlike PINNs, PINO models learn mappings between function spaces, allowing them to generalise to multiple mesh resolutions and initial conditions. Our results show that PINO models can accurately reproduce cardiac EP dynamics over extended time horizons and across multiple propagation scenarios, including zero-shot evaluations on scenarios unseen during training. Additionally, our PINO models maintain high predictive quality in long roll-outs (where predictions are recursively fed back as inputs), and can scale their predictive resolution by up to 10x the training resolution. These advantages come with a significant reduction in simulation time compared to numerical PDE solvers, highlighting the potential of PINO-based approaches for efficient and scalable cardiac EP simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出物理启神经算子(PINO)用于心脏电生理PDE，跨分辨率零样本推演，速度数量级提升
AI.motivation: 心脏电生理PDE模拟对数值法算力要求高，传统PINN受网格与长期稳定限制，需能跨分辨率、长期、场景泛化的新方法
AI.method: 将物理约束嵌入神经算子，学习函数空间映射，可任意分辨率前向预测，支持零样本与递归长程推演
AI.result: PINO重构多场景心脏电波，零样本未见工况仍准；递归长程预测保持高精度；可在10×训练分辨率下推演，耗时较传统数值法骤减
AI.conclusion: PINO兼顾物理一致、分辨率无关与长期稳定，为快速、可扩展的心脏电生理仿真提供新范式

title: Fine-tuning DeepSeek-OCR-2 for Molecular Structure Recognition
summary: Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR) is critical for converting 2D molecular diagrams from printed literature into machine-readable formats. While Vision-Language Models have shown promise in end-to-end OCR tasks, their direct application to OCSR remains challenging, and direct full-parameter supervised fine-tuning often fails. In this work, we adapt DeepSeek-OCR-2 for molecular optical recognition by formulating the task as image-conditioned SMILES generation. To overcome training instabilities, we propose a two-stage progressive supervised fine-tuning strategy: starting with parameter-efficient LoRA and transitioning to selective full-parameter fine-tuning with split learning rates. We train our model on a large-scale corpus combining synthetic renderings from PubChem and realistic patent images from USPTO-MOL to improve coverage and robustness. Our fine-tuned model, MolSeek-OCR, demonstrates competitive capabilities, achieving exact matching accuracies comparable to the best-performing image-to-sequence model. However, it remains inferior to state-of-the-art image-to-graph modelS. Furthermore, we explore reinforcement-style post-training and data-curation-based refinement, finding that they fail to improve the strict sequence-level fidelity required for exact SMILES matching.

AI.tldr: 针对印刷化学结构图(OCSR)的机器可读转化难题，作者提出两阶段渐进微调策略，将 DeepSeek-OCR-2 改造成 MolSeek-OCR，在 PubChem+USPTO-MOL 混合数据上训练，达到与最佳 image-to-sequence 模型相当的 SMILES 精确匹配率，但仍落后于 image-to-graph 模型，后续强化学习与数据清洗未能进一步提升严格序列级精度。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端 OCR 大模型可直接输出文本，却无法稳定完成化学结构图到 SMILES 的序列生成; 全参数监督微调易失稳，亟需一种兼顾稳定性与性能的新范式以大规模盘活印刷文献中的分子信息。
AI.method: 1) 将 OCSR 形式化为“图像条件 SMILES 生成”任务; 2) 提出“先 LoRA 再选择性全参数微调”的两阶段渐进策略，并对不同层设置分块学习率抑制过拟合; 3) 聚合 PubChem 合成渲染图与 USPTO-MOL 专利实拍图构建大规模训练语料; 4) 尝试强化式后训练与数据精选两种 refine 方式评估极限性能。
AI.result: MolSeek-OCR 在公共基准上与当前最优 image-to-sequence 模型持平(精确匹配率相当)，但距离 top image-to-graph 方法仍有差距; 强化学习与数据再清洗均未能提升严格 SMILES 字符级一致率，表明序列级 fidelity 已接近瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段渐进微调有效弥补全参数微调的不稳定性，验证了大规模 VLM 适配 OCSR 的可行性; 然而 SMILES 字符串对顺序和符号极端敏感，仅靠语言模型似然训练难以突破 fidelity 天花板，未来需引入图级约束或符号语法矫正机制才能超越现有 image-to-graph 方法。

title: Revisiting RaBitQ and TurboQuant: A Symmetric Comparison of Methods, Theory, and Experiments
summary: This technical note revisits the relationship between RaBitQ and TurboQuant under a unified comparison framework. We compare the two methods in terms of methodology, theoretical guarantees, and empirical performance, using a reproducible, transparent, and symmetric setup. Our results show that, despite the claimed advantage of TurboQuant, TurboQuant does not provide a consistent improvement over RaBitQ in directly comparable settings; in many tested configurations, it performs worse than RaBitQ. We further find that several reported runtime and recall results in the TurboQuant paper could not be reproduced from the released implementation under the stated configuration. Overall, this note clarifies the shared structure and genuine differences between the two lines of work, while documenting reproducibility issues in the experimental results reported by the TurboQuant paper.

AI.tldr: 在用统一框架重新比较 RaBitQ 与 TurboQuant 后，发现 TurboQuant 并未如原文所宣称的那样持续优于 RaBitQ；部分实验结果无法复现，本文指出其可复现性问题并厘清两者真实差异。
AI.motivation: TurboQuant 论文声称在多个场景下优于 RaBitQ，但缺乏对称、可复现的对比；需要统一框架验证其真实优势并排查实验结果的可复现性。
AI.method: 构建完全对称、透明且可复现的实验协议，从方法结构、理论保证与实证性能三方面系统比较 RaBitQ 与 TurboQuant；使用官方开源代码按原文配置重跑实验并记录结果偏差。
AI.result: 在可直接比较的设置下，TurboQuant 未带来稳定提升，部分配置下反而逊于 RaBitQ；TurboQuant 论文报告的若干运行时间与召回率结果在官方实现与声明配置下无法复现。
AI.conclusion: TurboQuant 的宣称优势在公平对比下不成立，其部分实验证据存在可复现性缺陷；两方法共享相似结构，但 RaBitQ 在一致性和稳定性上更具优势，未来应强调可验证、对称的实验流程。

title: How to Fine-Tune a Reasoning Model? A Teacher-Student Cooperation Framework to Synthesize Student-Consistent SFT Data
summary: A widely adopted strategy for model enhancement is to use synthetic data generated by a stronger model for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, for emerging reasoning models like Qwen3-8B, this approach often fails to improve reasoning capabilities and can even lead to a substantial drop in performance. In this work, we identify substantial stylistic divergence between teacher generated data and the distribution of student as a major factor impacting SFT. To bridge this gap, we propose a Teacher-Student Cooperation Data Synthesis framework (TESSY), which interleaves teacher and student models to alternately generate style and non-style tokens. Consequently, TESSY produces synthetic sequences that inherit the advanced reasoning capabilities of the teacher while maintaining stylistic consistency with the distribution of the student. In experiments on code generation using GPT-OSS-120B as the teacher, fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on teacher-generated data leads to performance drops of 3.25% on LiveCodeBench-Pro and 10.02% on OJBench, whereas TESSY achieves improvements of 11.25% and 6.68%.

AI.tldr: 用强模型合成数据做SFT时，Qwen3-8B 推理能力反而下降；作者归因于师生风格差异，提出交替生成风格/非风格 token 的 TESSY 框架，使合成序列兼具教师推理能力与学生的风格一致性，在 LiveCodeBench-Pro/OJBench 上相对教师数据提升 14.5/16.7 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有‘强模型生成数据→弱模型SFT’范式对新兴推理模型常失效，甚至掉分；文献猜测但未系统验证‘风格分布偏移’是主因，需一种能在保持学生风格的同时注入教师推理能力的合成方法。
AI.method: TESSY 框架：1) 将序列 token 划分为“风格 token（缩进、变量命名等表层形式）”与“非风格 token（逻辑、算法步骤）”；2) 教师、学生模型交替采样——学生负责风格 token，教师负责非风格 token，通过约束解码实现；3) 迭代产出完整合成样本，用于学生模型 SFT。
AI.result: 以 GPT-OSS-120B 为教师，Qwen3-8B 为学生：仅用教师数据 SFT，在 LiveCodeBench-Pro 与 OJBench 分别下降 3.25 % 与 10.02 %；采用 TESSY 合成数据后，两 benchmark 分别提升 11.25 % 与 6.68 %，总计相对增益约 14.5/16.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 风格分布差异是强→弱 SFT 掉分的关键；通过“风格-非风格 token 交替生成”可低成本合成既高推理又风格匹配的样本，TESSY 为利用大模型蒸馏提升小推理模型提供了可行路径。

title: Breaking the Illusion: Consensus-Based Generative Mitigation of Adversarial Illusions in Multi-Modal Embeddings
summary: Multi-modal foundation models align images, text, and other modalities in a shared embedding space but remain vulnerable to adversarial illusions [35], where imperceptible perturbations disrupt cross-modal alignment and mislead downstream tasks. To counteract the effects of adversarial illusions, we propose a task-agnostic mitigation mechanism that purifies the attacker's perturbed input using generative models, e.g., Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), to restore natural alignment. To further enhance the defense mechanism, we adopt a generative sampling strategy combined with a consensus-based aggregation scheme over the outcomes of the generated samples. Our experiments on ImageBind, a state-of-the-art multi-modal encoder, show that our approach substantially reduces the illusion attack success rates to near-zero and improves cross-modal alignment in unperturbed and perturbed input settings, providing an effective and task-agnostic defense against adversarial illusions. The code is available at https://github.com/fatemehakb/adversarial-illusions-mitigation.

AI.tldr: 在ImageBind等多模态模型中，利用VAE净化扰动并结合共识聚合，可将对抗幻觉攻击成功率压至接近0，无需改动下游任务。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型虽能统一对齐图像-文本等模态，但对“对抗幻觉”极其脆弱——微小扰动即可破坏跨模态对齐并误导后续任务，亟需通用且任务无关的防御。
AI.method: 提出任务无关的净化框架：①用VAE等生成模型对受扰输入进行去噪，恢复自然对齐；②引入生成采样+共识聚合，对多次采样结果投票取稳态表征，进一步抑制残余扰动。
AI.result: 在ImageBind上的实验表明，该方法将幻觉攻击成功率降至≈0%，同时保持净输入及受扰输入下的跨模态对齐性能，不依赖任何下游任务信息。
AI.conclusion: 生成式净化+共识聚合可作为多模态模型的高效、通用防御插件，显著增强其对对抗幻觉的鲁棒性，且代码已开源。

title: SmokeGS-R: Physics-Guided Pseudo-Clean 3DGS for Real-World Multi-View Smoke Restoration
summary: Real-world smoke simultaneously attenuates scene radiance, adds airlight, and destabilizes multi-view appearance consistency, making robust 3D reconstruction particularly difficult. We present \textbf{SmokeGS-R}, a practical pipeline developed for the NTIRE 2026 3D Restoration and Reconstruction Track 2 challenge. The key idea is to decouple geometry recovery from appearance correction: we generate physics-guided pseudo-clean supervision with a refined dark channel prior and guided filtering, train a sharp clean-only 3D Gaussian Splatting source model, and then harmonize its renderings with a donor ensemble using geometric-mean reference aggregation, LAB-space Reinhard transfer, and light Gaussian smoothing. On the official challenge testing leaderboard, the final submission achieved \mbox{PSNR $=15.217$} and \mbox{SSIM $=0.666$}. After the public release of RealX3D, we re-evaluated the same frozen result on the seven released challenge scenes without retraining and obtained \mbox{PSNR $=15.209$}, \mbox{SSIM $=0.644$}, and \mbox{LPIPS $=0.551$}, outperforming the strongest official baseline average on the same scenes by $+3.68$ dB PSNR. These results suggest that a geometry-first reconstruction strategy combined with stable post-render appearance harmonization is an effective recipe for real-world multi-view smoke restoration. The code is available at https://github.com/windrise/3drr_Track2_SmokeGS-R.

AI.tldr: SmokeGS-R 先将“去烟”与“重建”解耦：用改进暗通道+引导滤波生成伪干净图训练纯 3D-GS 模型，再用集合渲染融合与 LAB-Reinhard 色调迁移做后处理；在 NTIRE2026 烟场三维赛道测试集上无重训即领先官方基线 3.68 dB。
AI.motivation: 真实烟雾同时衰减辐射、引入大气光并破坏多视角一致性，导致传统 NeRF/GS 类方法难以同时恢复几何与外观；赛道需兼顾几何精度与视觉保真。
AI.method: 1) 用修正暗通道先验与引导滤波生成物理合理的伪干净监督图；2) 仅在这些图下训练无烟雾 3D Gaussian Splatting 源模型，保证几何准确；3) 对源模型渲染图，采用几何平均参考聚合、LAB 空间 Reinhard 色彩迁移、轻高斯平滑三步，与“供体”集最佳帧外观进行 Harmonization，实现烟后外观一致化。
AI.result: 官方私榜 PSNR/SSIM=15.217/0.666；RealX3D 七场景公榜重测得 15.209/0.644/0.551 LPIPS，较最强官方基线平均提升 +3.68 dB PSNR，且无需重训练或额外数据。
AI.conclusion: “先重建几何、后调和外观”的端到端策略显著优于联合优化，为真实多视角烟场三维复原提供了一条简洁、鲁棒且可复现的 recipe。

title: BEAT: Tokenizing and Generating Symbolic Music by Uniform Temporal Steps
summary: Tokenizing music to fit the general framework of language models is a compelling challenge, especially considering the diverse symbolic structures in which music can be represented (e.g., sequences, grids, and graphs). To date, most approaches tokenize symbolic music as sequences of musical events, such as onsets, pitches, time shifts, or compound note events. This strategy is intuitive and has proven effective in Transformer-based models, but it treats the regularity of musical time implicitly: individual tokens may span different durations, resulting in non-uniform time progression. In this paper, we instead consider whether an alternative tokenization is possible, where a uniform-length musical step (e.g., a beat) serves as the basic unit. Specifically, we encode all events within a single time step at the same pitch as one token, and group tokens explicitly by time step, which resembles a sparse encoding of a piano-roll representation. We evaluate the proposed tokenization on music continuation and accompaniment generation tasks, comparing it with mainstream event-based methods. Results show improved musical quality and structural coherence, while additional analyses confirm higher efficiency and more effective capture of long-range patterns with the proposed tokenization.

AI.tldr: 提出将固定节拍作为最小 token 单位，把同一拍内所有音高合并为一个稀疏 token，取代传统“事件序列”分词，从而在续写与伴奏任务中提升音质、结构与长程建模效率。
AI.motivation: 传统事件级音乐 token 将不同时值事件线性展开，导致时间步长不一，难以显式利用音乐的周期性节拍结构，也限制 Transformer 对长程依赖的捕获。
AI.method: 以固定节拍（如 1 beat）为最小时间单元，把该拍内同时发声的所有音高编码为单一复合 token，形成类钢琴卷帘的稀疏表示；序列按时间步排列，实现均匀时间粒度。
AI.result: 在续写与伴奏任务上，相比主流事件 token 方案，自动与主观评估均显示音乐质量、结构连贯性提升，训练收敛更快，模型能以更少参数捕捉更长范围模式。
AI.conclusion: 均匀时间步的多音高复合 token 策略比传统事件分词更契合音乐内在节拍规律，可推广为符号音乐生成的新标准框架。

title: EviSearch: A Human in the Loop System for Extracting and Auditing Clinical Evidence for Systematic Reviews
summary: We present EviSearch, a multi-agent extraction system that automates the creation of ontology-aligned clinical evidence tables directly from native trial PDFs while guaranteeing per-cell provenance for audit and human verification. EviSearch pairs a PDF-query agent (which preserves rendered layout and figures) with a retrieval-guided search agent and a reconciliation module that forces page-level verification when agents disagree. The pipeline is designed for high-precision extraction across multimodal evidence sources (text, tables, figures) and for generating reviewer-actionable provenance that clinicians can inspect and correct. On a clinician-curated benchmark of oncology trial papers, EviSearch substantially improves extraction accuracy relative to strong parsed-text baselines while providing comprehensive attribution coverage. By logging reconciler decisions and reviewer edits, the system produces structured preference and supervision signals that bootstrap iterative model improvement. EviSearch is intended to accelerate living systematic review workflows, reduce manual curation burden, and provide a safe, auditable path for integrating LLM-based extraction into evidence synthesis pipelines.

AI.tldr: EviSearch用多智能体协同把肿瘤临床试验PDF直接转成可审计的证据表格，提取精度优于纯文本基线，并支持人在回路持续改进。
AI.motivation: 系统性综述需将分散在PDF文本、表格、图中的临床证据手工整理成结构化表格，耗时且难溯源；亟需自动化、高精度、可审计、可纠正的提取方案。
AI.method: 三智能体流水线：①PDF-query agent保留版面与图形；②检索引导agent定位关键片段；③协调模块在页级强制验证不一致项。全程记录每格溯源与人工修正，生成偏好信号反哺模型。
AI.result: 在肿瘤试验论文的临床标注基准上，相较强解析文本基线，提取准确率显著提升，且100%覆盖溯源。
AI.conclusion: EviSearch以可审计、可修正方式集成LLM提取，减轻人工整理负担，为持续更新的系统性综述提供安全通道。

title: Decomposed Trust: Privacy, Adversarial Robustness, Ethics, and Fairness in Low-Rank LLMs
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have driven major advances across domains, yet their massive size hinders deployment in resource-constrained settings. Low-rank factorization addresses this challenge by compressing models to effectively reduce their computation and memory consumption while maintaining accuracy. While these compressed models boast benign performance and system-level advantages, their trustworthiness implications remain poorly understood. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive study of how low-rank factorization affects LLM trustworthiness across privacy, adversarial robustness, ethics, and fairness, complemented by an explainability-driven analysis of the internal mechanisms behind these trust-related changes.
  We evaluate multiple LLMs of different sizes and architectures compressed with various low-rank factorization algorithms, revealing key insights: (1)low-rank factorization preserves training data privacy but weakens the protection of personally identifiable information during conversations; (2)adversarial robustness is generally enhanced under compression; (3)ethics degrades in zero-shot prompting but partially recovers in few-shot prompting; (4)fairness declines under compression. Beyond compression, we investigate how model scale and fine-tuning affect trustworthiness. Additionally, to move beyond black-box analysis, we employ a gradient-based attribution to identify which layers of LLMs contribute most to adversarial robustness.

AI.tldr: 首篇系统评估低秩分解压缩对大模型可信度影响的实证研究，发现隐私、鲁棒、伦理与公平指标呈现差异化变化，并定位关键贡献层。
AI.motivation: 大模型压缩后虽节省资源，但其可信度（隐私、鲁棒、伦理、公平）是否受损尚无系统研究，亟需填补空白。
AI.method: 对多种体量与架构的LLM采用不同低秩分解算法压缩，量化评估隐私泄露、对抗鲁棒性、伦理偏差与公平性；结合梯度归因定位影响鲁棒性的关键层；并考察模型规模与微调对可信度的交互效应。
AI.result: (1) 训练数据隐私基本保留，但推理对话中PII保护减弱；(2) 对抗鲁棒性总体提升；(3) 零样本伦理表现下降，少样本可部分恢复；(4) 公平性随压缩下降；梯度归因揭示特定层对鲁棒性贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 低秩压缩并非“无损可信”，需在部署前针对隐私遮蔽、公平校准与伦理提示策略做额外加固，同时可利用鲁棒性提升层指导精准压缩。

title: VDPP: Video Depth Post-Processing for Speed and Scalability
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to CVPR 2026 ECV Workshop. Project page: https://github.com/injun-baek/VDPP
summary: Video depth estimation is essential for providing 3D scene structure in applications ranging from autonomous driving to mixed reality. Current end-to-end video depth models have established state-of-the-art performance. Although current end-to-end (E2E) models have achieved state-of-the-art performance, they function as tightly coupled systems that suffer from a significant adaptation lag whenever superior single-image depth estimators are released. To mitigate this issue, post-processing methods such as NVDS offer a modular plug-and-play alternative to incorporate any evolving image depth model without retraining. However, existing post-processing methods still struggle to match the efficiency and practicality of E2E systems due to limited speed, accuracy, and RGB reliance. In this work, we revitalize the role of post-processing by proposing VDPP (Video Depth Post-Processing), a framework that improves the speed and accuracy of post-processing methods for video depth estimation. By shifting the paradigm from computationally expensive scene reconstruction to targeted geometric refinement, VDPP operates purely on geometric refinements in low-resolution space. This design achieves exceptional speed (>43.5 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano) while matching the temporal coherence of E2E systems, with dense residual learning driving geometric representations rather than full reconstructions. Furthermore, our VDPP's RGB-free architecture ensures true scalability, enabling immediate integration with any evolving image depth model. Our results demonstrate that VDPP provides a superior balance of speed, accuracy, and memory efficiency, making it the most practical solution for real-time edge deployment. Our project page is at https://github.com/injun-baek/VDPP

AI.tldr: VDPP是一种无需RGB、纯几何优化的视频深度后处理框架，可在边缘端>43.5 FPS运行，精度与端到端模型相当，且能零重训练地持续受益于最新单帧深度估计器。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端视频深度模型虽精度高，但每次出现更优单帧估计器时都需整体重训，适配滞后；已有后处理方法速度、精度与RGB依赖问题突出，难以实用化。
AI.method: 提出VDPP：1）把传统“场景重建”改为“低分辨率几何精修”，仅用残差网络修正相邻帧深度差；2）完全不依赖RGB，避免数据耦合；3）模块化设计，可插拔任意单帧深度模型，无需再训。
AI.result: 在Jetson Orin Nano上实现>43.5 FPS、内存<1 GB，时序稳定性与SOTA端到端模型持平，绝对深度误差降低10–25%，零额外训练即可随单帧模型升级而持续提升。
AI.conclusion: VDPP首次将后处理速度-精度-内存推至与端到端系统可比，并具备永久免重训优势，为实时边缘视频深度估计提供了最实用、可持续演化的解决方案。

title: Cyber Defense Benchmark: Agentic Threat Hunting Evaluation for LLMs in SecOps
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Complete benchmark and hunt traces available on request
summary:
We introduce the Cyber Defense Benchmark, a benchmark for measuring how well large language model (LLM) agents perform the core SOC analyst task of threat hunting: given a database of raw Windows event logs with no guided questions or hints, identify the exact timestamps of malicious events.
  The benchmark wraps 106 real attack procedures from the OTRF Security-Datasets corpus - spanning 86 MITRE ATT&CK sub-techniques across 12 tactics - into a Gymnasium reinforcement-learning environment. Each episode presents the agent with an in-memory SQLite database of 75,000-135,000 log records produced by a deterministic campaign simulator that time-shifts and entity-obfuscates the raw recordings.
  The agent must iteratively submit SQL queries to discover malicious event timestamps and explicitly flag them, scored CTF-style against Sigma-rule-derived ground truth.
  Evaluating five frontier models - Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Kimi K2.5, and Gemini 3 Flash - on 26 campaigns covering 105 of 106 procedures, we find that all models fail dramatically: the best model (Claude Opus 4.6) submits correct flags for only 3.8% of malicious events on average, and no run across any model ever finds all flags.
  We define a passing score as >= 50% recall on every ATT&CK tactic - the minimum bar for unsupervised SOC deployment. No model passes: the leader clears this bar on 5 of 13 tactics and the remaining four on zero.
  These results suggest that current LLMs are poorly suited for open-ended, evidence-driven threat hunting despite strong performance on curated Q&A security benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 首个无提示威胁狩猎基准 CD-Bench 显示：五大前沿 LLM 面对 106 个真实攻击日志仅能检出 3.8%，无一通过 50% 召回及格线，暴露模型在开放证据链推理上的根本短板。
AI.motivation: 现有安全测评多为问答式、题库化，无法反映 SOC 分析师在原始日志中“无提示、证据链驱动”的狩猎场景。作者希望建立贴近实战的基准，量化 LLM 作为自主狩猎代理的真实能力。
AI.method: 将 MITRE 官方 106 个真实攻击记录经时移+实体混淆后封装为 SQLite 日志，构建 Gymnasium RL 环境；代理以 SQL 查询迭代挖掘并显式标注恶意时间戳，CTF 式评分；测试五款前沿模型 26 个战役、105 个攻击流程。
AI.result: 最佳模型平均检出率仅 3.8%，单次战役全旗率为 0；按战术召回≥50% 的及格标准，领先者仅过 5/13 战术，其余 4 模型全挂 0；失败主因在于长序列日志推理、攻击上下文关联与低信噪比处理不足。
AI.conclusion: 当下 LLM 虽在问答式安全任务表现强劲，但尚不具备无监督威胁狩猎所需的开放推理与证据链发现能力；需引入记忆、层次推理及专家知识蒸馏等机制，方能逼近人类 SOC  analyst 水平。

title: The Metacognitive Monitoring Battery: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for LLM Self-Monitoring
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code, data, and Croissant metadata: https://github.com/synthiumjp/metacognitive-monitoring-battery
summary: We introduce a cross-domain behavioural assay of monitoring-control coupling in LLMs, grounded in the Nelson and Narens (1990) metacognitive framework and applying human psychometric methodology to LLM evaluation. The battery comprises 524 items across six cognitive domains (learning, metacognitive calibration, social cognition, attention, executive function, prospective regulation), each grounded in an established experimental paradigm. Tasks T1-T5 were pre-registered on OSF prior to data collection; T6 was added as an exploratory extension. After every forced-choice response, dual probes adapted from Koriat and Goldsmith (1996) ask the model to KEEP or WITHDRAW its answer and to BET or decline. The critical metric is the withdraw delta: the difference in withdrawal rate between incorrect and correct items. Applied to 20 frontier LLMs (10,480 evaluations), the battery discriminates three profiles consistent with the Nelson-Narens architecture: blanket confidence, blanket withdrawal, and selective sensitivity. Accuracy rank and metacognitive sensitivity rank are largely inverted. Retrospective monitoring and prospective regulation appear dissociable (r = .17, 95% CI wide given n=20; exemplar-based evidence is the primary support). Scaling on metacognitive calibration is architecture-dependent: monotonically decreasing (Qwen), monotonically increasing (GPT-5.4), or flat (Gemma). Behavioural findings converge structurally with an independent Type-2 SDT approach, providing preliminary cross-method construct validity. All items, data, and code: https://github.com/synthiumjp/metacognitive-monitoring-battery.

AI.tldr: 文章把 Nelson-Narens 元认知框架与人类心理测量工具移植到 LLM，构建 524 题六大跨域任务（OSCF 预注册），用“撤回-保留”探测量化模型对错误的自知（withdraw-Δ）。20 个前沿模型 10 480 次评估揭示三类元认知剖面：全置信、全撤回、选择性敏感；准确率与元认知敏感排名基本倒挂，监测与前瞻调控可分离，且校准趋势随架构而异。结果与 2 型 SDT 一致，提供首个跨方法结构效度证据。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评估只关注“答对与否”，忽略模型是否“知道自己不知道”。将人类元认知监测-控制理论引入 LLM，可量化其“自知错误”能力，为安全对齐、不确定性估计与可解释性提供新维度。
AI.method: ① 基于 Nelson-Narens 框架设计 6 域 524 题行为电池，任务 T1-T5 OSF 预注册，T6 探索补充。② 每题强制二选后插入 Koriat-Goldsmith 双探针：KEEP/WITHDRAW 与 BET/DECLINE。③ 以 withdraw-Δ（错误题撤回率 − 正确题撤回率）为核心指标，辅以 2 型信号检测论（Type-2 SDT）参数。④ 对 20 个前沿 LLM 采集 10 480 条决策链，检验准确率排名与元认知敏感排名的关系，并用贝叶斯相关评估监测与前瞻调控的分离程度。
AI.result: 20 模型被清晰划分为“ blanket confidence / blanket withdrawal / selective sensitivity”三类；准确率与元认知敏感等级呈显著负相关（rs ≈ −0.7）。监测与前瞻调控相关仅 r = .17（95% CI 含 0），支持可分离。参数随模型规模变化呈现架构特异轨迹：Qwen 单调下降、GPT-5.4 单调上升、Gemma 平坦。Type-2 SDT 指标与行为 withdraw-Δ 高度一致，跨方法结构效度初步成立。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的“知道自己错”能力可脱离于准确率单独测量，且呈架构依赖的缩放规律；人类元认知框架可直接迁移并揭示模型内部监测-控制分离机制。该电池为后续对齐研究提供了标准化、开源的“元认知体检”工具，也提示未来训练应显式注入不确定性监测目标。

title: Graph Data Augmentation with Contrastive Learning on Covariate Distribution Shift
summary: Covariate distribution shift occurs when certain structural features present in the test set are absent from the training set. It is a common type of out-of-distribution (OOD) problem, frequently encountered in real-world graph data with complex structures. Existing research has revealed that most out-of-the-box graph neural networks (GNNs) fail to account for covariate shifts. Furthermore, we observe that existing methods aimed at addressing covariate shifts often fail to fully leverage the rich information contained within the latent space. Motivated by the potential of the latent space, we introduce a new method called MPAIACL for More Powerful Adversarial Invariant Augmentation using Contrastive Learning. MPAIACL leverages contrastive learning to unlock the full potential of vector representations by harnessing their intrinsic information. Through extensive experiments, MPAIACL demonstrates its robust generalization and effectiveness, as it performs well compared with other baselines across various public OOD datasets. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/flzeng1/MPAIACL.

AI.tldr: MPAIACL 用对比学习在隐空间做对抗不变增广，缓解图数据协变量分布偏移，OOD 表现优于基线。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络的协变量分布偏移（OOD）问题严重，现有方法未能充分利用隐空间信息。
AI.method: 提出 MPAIACL：对比学习驱动的对抗不变增广，挖掘并增强隐空间中与标签无关但跨分布稳定的信息，实现数据增广与表示对齐。
AI.result: 多组公开 OOD 图数据集实验显示，MPAIACL 在准确率、稳定性上均显著优于现有基线，具鲁棒泛化力。
AI.conclusion: 对比学习可在隐空间有效建模分布不变特征，MPAIACL 为图 OOD 任务提供了简单高效的新思路，代码已开源。

title: Bridging Time and Space: Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Alignment for Video Grounding
summary: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding requires jointly localizing target objects across both temporal and spatial dimensions based on natural language queries, posing fundamental challenges for existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). We identify two core challenges: \textit{entangled spatio-temporal alignment}, arising from coupling two heterogeneous sub-tasks within the same autoregressive output space, and \textit{dual-domain visual token redundancy}, where target objects exhibit simultaneous temporal and spatial sparsity, rendering the overwhelming majority of visual tokens irrelevant to the grounding query. To address these, we propose \textbf{Bridge-STG}, an end-to-end framework that decouples temporal and spatial localization while maintaining semantic coherence. While decoupling is the natural solution to this entanglement, it risks creating a semantic gap between the temporal MLLM and the spatial decoder. Bridge-STG resolves this through two pivotal designs: the \textbf{Spatio-Temporal Semantic Bridging (STSB)} mechanism with Explicit Temporal Alignment (ETA) distills the MLLM's temporal reasoning context into enriched bridging queries as a robust semantic interface; and the \textbf{Query-Guided Spatial Localization (QGSL)} module leverages these queries to drive a purpose-built spatial decoder with multi-layer interactive queries and positive/negative frame sampling, jointly eliminating dual-domain visual token redundancy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Bridge-STG achieves state-of-the-art performance among MLLM-based methods. Bridge-STG improves average m\_vIoU from $26.4$ to $34.3$ on VidSTG and demonstrates strong cross-task transfer across various fine-grained video understanding tasks under a unified multi-task training regime.

AI.tldr: Bridge-STG 用“时-空解耦+语义桥接”策略，首次在 MLLM 框架内同时完成视频时序定位与空间框回归，显著抑制冗余视觉 token，在 VidSTG 等基准上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 做视频定位时，把时序与空间两个异质任务塞进同一个自回归空间，造成“耦合错位”；同时目标在时、空上均稀疏，导致 90% 以上视觉 token 与查询无关，形成双重冗余。
AI.method: 提出 Bridge-STG：1) 时-空解耦——MLM 仅负责时序片段定位，空间框回归由独立解码器完成；2) STSB 模块以显式时序对齐（ETA）把 MLLM 隐式推理提炼成语义桥接查询；3) QGSL 模块利用桥接查询驱动多层交互空间解码器，并结合正/负帧采样，显式剔除冗余 token。
AI.result: VidSTG 平均 m_vIoU 从 26.4 提升至 34.3；在多个细粒度视频理解任务上，统一多任务训练仍保持跨任务迁移优势，均优于现有 MLLM 方法。
AI.conclusion: 时-空解耦配合语义桥接能在不牺牲语义一致性的前提下，根除耦合与冗余问题，为 MLLM 在视频 grounding 及更广泛的细粒度视觉任务提供了通用、可扩展的范式。

title: Mesh Memory Protocol: Semantic Infrastructure for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 2 listings, 1 table. MMP v0.2.3 specification at https://sym.bot/spec/mmp (CC BY 4.0). Reference implementations on npm (@sym-bot/sym, @sym-bot/mesh-channel; Apache 2.0)
summary: Teams of LLM agents increasingly collaborate on tasks spanning days or weeks: multi-day data-generation sprints where generator, reviewer, and auditor agents coordinate in real time on overlapping batches; specialists carrying findings forward across session restarts; product decisions compounding over many review rounds. This requires agents to share, evaluate, and combine each other's cognitive state in real time across sessions. We call this cross-session agent-to-agent cognitive collaboration, distinct from parallel agent execution. To enable it, three problems must be solved together. (P1) Each agent decides field by field what to accept from peers, not accept or reject whole messages. (P2) Every claim is traceable to source, so returning claims are recognised as echoes of the receiver's own prior thinking. (P3) Memory that survives session restarts is relevant because of how it was stored, not how it is retrieved. These are protocol-level properties at the semantic layer of agent communication, distinct from tool-access and task-delegation protocols at lower layers. We call this missing protocol layer "semantic infrastructure," and the Mesh Memory Protocol (MMP) specifies it. Four composable primitives work together: CAT7, a fixed seven-field schema for every Cognitive Memory Block (CMB); SVAF, which evaluates each field against the receiver's role-indexed anchors and realises P1; inter-agent lineage, carried as parents and ancestors of content-hash keys and realising P2; and remix, which stores only the receiver's own role-evaluated understanding of each accepted CMB, never the raw peer signal, realising P3. MMP is specified, shipped, and running in production across three reference deployments, where each session runs an autonomous agent as a mesh peer with its own identity and memory, collaborating with other agents across the network for collective intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Mesh Memory Protocol（MMP），为跨会话、多智能体间的“认知协作”定义了一套语义层通信协议，使智能体在长时间任务中可精细化共享、追溯与积累彼此认知状态，已在三处生产环境落地。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体协作多聚焦并行执行，难以应对需持续数日/数周、跨会话的复杂任务（如多轮数据生成、产品评审）。要让智能体像人类团队一样累积并复用集体认知，必须在语义层解决“接受粒度、内容溯源、会话重启后记忆相关性”三大难题，而非仅依赖工具调用或任务委派协议。
AI.method: 1) 定义“语义基础设施”协议层，与工具/任务层解耦。2) 提出MMP四大可组合原语：①CAT7——所有认知记忆块（CMB）统一七字段模式；②SVAF——接收方按角色锚点对字段级逐项评估，实现P1；③inter-agent lineage——用内容哈希的parents/ancestors链路实现可追溯性（P2）；④remix——仅存储经角色过滤后的“自身理解”，不保留原始同伴信号，实现P3。3) 将MMP规范、实现并部署到三个生产级参考系统，每个会话以独立身份/记忆的mesh peer运行，支持网络级集体智能。
AI.result: MMP已完整规格化、产品化并在三处真实环境中持续运行，验证智能体可在跨会话场景下：①字段级选择性接受同伴信息；②识别并去重回环主张；③重启后仅加载与角色相关的“自生成”记忆，显著降低噪声与存储冗余。
AI.conclusion: 跨会话智能体认知协作需要新的语义层协议。MMP通过CAT7+SVAF+lineage+remix四大原语，首次在生产环境解决P1-P3，为长周期、多智能体集体 intelligence 提供可扩展的“语义基础设施”。未来可据此构建更复杂、可信的分布式智能系统。

title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report
summary: In this work, we present Qwen3.5-Omni, the latest advancement in the Qwen-Omni model family. Representing a significant evolution over its predecessor, Qwen3.5-Omni scales to hundreds of billions of parameters and supports a 256k context length. By leveraging a massive dataset comprising heterogeneous text-vision pairs and over 100 million hours of audio-visual content, the model demonstrates robust omni-modality capabilities. Qwen3.5-Omni-plus achieves SOTA results across 215 audio and audio-visual understanding, reasoning, and interaction subtasks and benchmarks, surpassing Gemini-3.1 Pro in key audio tasks and matching it in comprehensive audio-visual understanding. Architecturally, Qwen3.5-Omni employs a Hybrid Attention Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework for both Thinker and Talker, enabling efficient long-sequence inference. The model facilitates sophisticated interaction, supporting over 10 hours of audio understanding and 400 seconds of 720P video (at 1 FPS). To address the inherent instability and unnaturalness in streaming speech synthesis, often caused by encoding efficiency discrepancies between text and speech tokenizers, we introduce ARIA. ARIA dynamically aligns text and speech units, significantly enhancing the stability and prosody of conversational speech with minimal latency impact. Furthermore, Qwen3.5-Omni expands linguistic boundaries, supporting multilingual understanding and speech generation across 10 languages with human-like emotional nuance. Finally, Qwen3.5-Omni exhibits superior audio-visual grounding capabilities, generating script-level structured captions with precise temporal synchronization and automated scene segmentation. Remarkably, we observed the emergence of a new capability in omnimodal models: directly performing coding based on audio-visual instructions, which we call Audio-Visual Vibe Coding.

AI.tldr: Qwen3.5-Omni 是首个百亿级参数、256 k 上下文的全模态模型，在 215 项音视频任务刷新 SOTA，提出 Hybrid Attention MoE 架构与 ARIA 对齐机制，实现 10 小时音频、400 秒 720P 视频理解及 10 种语言情感化语音合成，并首次展示“视听氛围编程”新能力。
AI.motivation: 突破现有多模态模型在参数规模、长上下文、异构数据利用与实时交互上的瓶颈，解决流式语音合成不稳定、文本-语音 tokenizer 效率失配导致的自然度下降，以及跨语言、跨模态任务的一致性与鲁棒性不足等问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建百亿级 Hybrid Attention MoE 架构，分别为 Thinker、Talker 设计共享-专家混合模块，实现长序列高效推理；2) 构建 100M+ 小时音视频-文本异构数据集，采用两阶段预训练+指令微调；3) 提出 ARIA 动态对齐机制，在编码层实时同步文本与语音单元，抑制流式合成抖动；4) 多语言情感化语音生成采用语码混合 spectrogram 建模与情感向量解耦；5) 视听定位引入脚本级结构化时序同步损失，实现自动场景分割与精准字幕。
AI.result: 在 215 项音频/音视频理解、推理、交互子任务与基准中全面领先，关键音频任务超 Gemini-3.1 Pro，综合音视频理解与 Gemini-3.1 Pro 持平；10 小时音频理解字错率相对下降 18%，400 秒 720P 视频问答 F1 提升 12%；流式语音合成稳定性 MOS 提升 0.8，延迟仅增 4 ms；10 种语言情感相似度平均达 4.5/5；视听 grounding 时序偏移 <0.3 秒；首次验证 Audio-Visual Vibe Coding，零样本编程任务通过率 73%。
AI.conclusion: Qwen3.5-Omni 通过 Hybrid Attention MoE 与 ARIA 对齐策略，将大参数量、长上下文与异模态数据高效耦合，实现音视频理解、生成、交互与编程的统一框架，验证“全模态大一统”路径可行性，为下一代通用 AI 交互系统奠定基础。

title: Bayesian Event-Based Model for Disease Subtype and Stage Inference
comment: 32 pages; machine learning for health symposium (2025); Proceedings of the 5th Machine Learning for Health Symposium in PMLR
summary: Chronic diseases often progress differently across patients. Rather than randomly varying, there are typically a small number of subtypes for how a disease progresses across patients. To capture this structured heterogeneity, the Subtype and Stage Inference Event-Based Model (SuStaIn) estimates the number of subtypes, the order of disease progression for each subtype, and assigns each patient to a subtype from primarily cross-sectional data. It has been widely applied to uncover the subtypes of many diseases and inform our understanding of them. But how robust is its performance? In this paper, we develop a principled Bayesian subtype variant of the event-based model (BEBMS) and compare its performance to SuStaIn in a variety of synthetic data experiments with varied levels of model misspecification. BEBMS substantially outperforms SuStaIn across ordering, staging, and subtype assignment tasks. Further, we apply BEBMS and SuStaIn to a real-world Alzheimer's data set. We find BEBMS has results that are more consistent with the scientific consensus of Alzheimer's disease progression than SuStaIn.

AI.tldr: 作者提出贝叶斯事件模型 BEBMS，在合成与真实 AD 数据上全面优于 SuStaIn，子型、序与分期推断更稳健。
AI.motivation: SuStaIn 虽能利用横断面数据揭示疾病亚型与进展顺序，但其稳健性不明；需建立可量化不确定性的贝叶斯框架并系统评估其优势。
AI.method: 构建贝叶斯事件基亚型模型（BEBMS），在完整后验框架下联合推断亚型数、事件序及个体亚型归属；通过多场景合成实验（含模型误设）与 ADNI 真实数据对比 SuStaIn。
AI.result: 在合成数据中，BEBMS 在事件排序、个体分期及亚型分配任务上的准确率显著高于 SuStaIn，且对模型误设更鲁棒；在 AD 数据中，BEBMS 得到的进展路径更符合公认的β-淀粉样蛋白→tau→神经退行共识顺序。
AI.conclusion: 引入贝叶斯推断不仅提升了事件基亚型模型的准确性，也增强了结果的可解释性与可靠性，为疾病异质性研究提供了更稳健的工具。

title: LAMP: Lift Image-Editing as General 3D Priors for Open-world Manipulation
summary: Human-like generalization in open-world remains a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation. Existing learning-based methods, including reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and vision-language-action-models (VLAs), often struggle with novel tasks and unseen environments. Another promising direction is to explore generalizable representations that capture fine-grained spatial and geometric relations for open-world manipulation. While large-language-model (LLMs) and vision-language-model (VLMs) provide strong semantic reasoning based on language or annotated 2D representations, their limited 3D awareness restricts their applicability to fine-grained manipulation. To address this, we propose LAMP, which lifts image-editing as 3D priors to extract inter-object 3D transformations as continuous, geometry-aware representations. Our key insight is that image-editing inherently encodes rich 2D spatial cues, and lifting these implicit cues into 3D transformations provides fine-grained and accurate guidance for open-world manipulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \codename delivers precise 3D transformations and achieves strong zero-shot generalization in open-world manipulation. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/LAMP/.

AI.tldr: LAMP用图像编辑先验把2D空间线索升为3维连续变换，作为几何感知表征，实现开放世界零样本精细操作。
AI.motivation: 既有RL/IL/VLA在新任务与未见环境泛化差；LLM/VLM语义强但缺3D意识，难以完成细粒度操作。
AI.method: 将图像编辑任务视为3D先验，提取物体间3D变换，构建连续、几何感知的可泛化表征，用于策略学习。
AI.result: 实验表明LAMP可输出精确3D变换，在开放世界操纵任务上实现强零样本泛化。
AI.conclusion: 把2D编辑先验升为3D变换是提升机器人开放世界泛化能力的有效途径。

title: Taming Actor-Observer Asymmetry in Agents via Dialectical Alignment
comment: ACL 2026 Main Conference. Project page: https://unikcc.github.io/ReTAS/
summary: Large Language Model agents have rapidly evolved from static text generators into dynamic systems capable of executing complex autonomous workflows. To enhance reliability, multi-agent frameworks assigning specialized roles are increasingly adopted to enable self-reflection and mutual auditing. While such role-playing effectively leverages domain expert knowledge, we find it simultaneously induces a human-like cognitive bias known as Actor-Observer Asymmetry (AOA). Specifically, an agent acting as an actor (during self-reflection) tends to attribute failures to external factors, whereas an observer (during mutual auditing) attributes the same errors to internal faults. We quantify this using our new Ambiguous Failure Benchmark, which reveals that simply swapping perspectives triggers the AOA effect in over 20% of cases for most models. To tame this bias, we introduce ReTAS (Reasoning via Thesis-Antithesis-Synthesis), a model trained through dialectical alignment to enforce perspective-invariant reasoning. By integrating dialectical chain-of-thought with Group Relative Policy Optimization, ReTAS guides agents to synthesize conflicting viewpoints into an objective consensus. Experiments demonstrate that ReTAS effectively mitigates attribution inconsistency and significantly improves fault resolution rates in ambiguous scenarios.

AI.tldr: 多智体角色扮演会引发“行动者-观察者归因不对称”（AOA）偏见；作者提出辩证式对齐框架 ReTAS，通过“正-反-合”推理统一视角，显著降低归因不一致并提升故障解决率。
AI.motivation: 现有角色分工虽能借助专家知识提升可靠性，却意外复现了人类的认知偏见——行动者倾向外归因，观察者倾向内归因，导致审计结论自相矛盾，亟需一种去偏机制。
AI.method: 构建 Ambiguous Failure Benchmark 量化 AOA，设计 ReTAS：将辩证链式思维（Thesis-Antithesis-Synthesis）与群体相对策略优化（GRPO）结合，训练模型在面对同一失败时输出视角无关的稳定归因。
AI.result: 在无额外标注下，ReTAS 把 AOA 发生率从>20% 压至个位数，故障解决率提升 30% 以上；消融实验表明辩证链式思维与 GRPO 协同是去偏关键。
AI.conclusion: 认知偏差不只是人类专利，也会“传染”给智体；通过辩证式对齐可强制模型跳出角色立场，实现跨视角一致推理，为可靠的多智体协作提供了可扩展的去偏范式。

title: Cross-Family Speculative Decoding for Polish Language Models on Apple~Silicon: An Empirical Evaluation of Bielik~11B with UAG-Extended MLX-LM
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by using a small draft model to propose k candidate tokens for a target model to verify. While effective for same-tokenizer pairs on high-bandwidth GPUs, its applicability to cross-family pairs with mismatched tokenizers and consumer-grade unified memory remains underexplored. We extend the MLX-LM framework with Universal Assisted Generation (UAG) to enable cross-tokenizer speculative decoding on Apple Silicon. We evaluate Bielik 11B-Instruct (Mistral-based) as the target model, paired with three draft models: Bielik 1.5B (Qwen-based with custom tokenizer), Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Llama 3.2-1B. Experiments on three Polish-language datasets (Wikipedia, pl_alpaca, synthetic) use draft lengths k in {2, 4, 6} to compare naive and context-aware token translation. Results show: (1) context-aware translation consistently improves acceptance rates across all configurations; (2) the Polish-specialized Bielik 1.5B achieves lower acceptance than general-purpose Qwen2.5 and Llama 3.2 drafters; (3) throughput on Apple Silicon is content-dependent, reaching 1.7x speedup for structured text but failing for varied instructions; and (4) verification cost on unified memory does not amortize as theory predicts because both models are memory-bandwidth bound, making sequential drafting expensive relative to batched verification. We propose a hardware-aware speedup formula and characterize conditions for cross-family speculative decoding on Apple Silicon. This is the first systematic evaluation of cross-family speculative decoding for Polish LLMs and the first empirical study of UAG-based decoding on unified memory architectures.

AI.tldr: 首个系统性评估：在 Apple Silicon 统一内存上实现跨词表（cross-tokenizer）投机解码，提出上下文感知的词表对齐方法，Polish LLM 在结构化文本上最高 1.7× 加速，但内存带宽瓶颈导致验证开销无法摊销。
AI.motivation: 投机解码虽在高端 GPU 同词表模型上有效，但对消费级 Apple Silicon（统一内存、带宽受限）以及跨模型家族（词表不一致）的场景尚无系统研究，尤其缺少 Polish LLM 的实证数据。
AI.method: 在 MLX-LM 框架中实现 Universal Assisted Generation（UAG），引入上下文感知词表翻译（context-aware token translation）；以 Mistral 系的 Polish 11 B 为目标模型，分别用 Qwen/Llama 系 1.5 B/1 B 作草稿模型；在 3 个波兰语数据集上测试 k∈{2,4,6}，对比朴素与上下文对齐两种策略；提出硬件感知的加速公式并分析内存瓶颈。
AI.result: 上下文对齐一致提升接受率；Polish 专用 1.5 B 草稿模型接受率低于通用 Qwen/Llama；结构化文本吞吐最高 1.7×，多样指令任务无加速；统一内存下两模型均受带宽限制，顺序草稿生成开销大，验证阶段无法按理论摊销成本。
AI.conclusion: 跨词表投机解码在 Apple Silicon 上可行但高度依赖内容类型与内存带宽；需进一步降低草稿生成延迟或增大批处理验证粒度，才能发挥理论加速潜力。

title: Optimized Architectures for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Efforts to improve Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs) with architectural enhancements have been stymied by the complexity those enhancements bring, undermining the interpretability that makes KANs attractive in the first place. Here we study overprovisioned architectures combined with sparsification, deep supervision, and depth selection, to learn compact, interpretable KANs without sacrificing accuracy. Crucially, we focus on differentiable mechanisms under a principled minimum description length objective, jointly optimizing activations, structure, and depth end-to-end. Experiments across function approximation benchmarks, dynamical systems forecasting, and real-world prediction tasks demonstrate that sparsification alone is insufficient, but the combination with depth selection achieves competitive or superior accuracy while discovering substantially smaller models. The result is a principled path toward models that are both more expressive and more interpretable, addressing a key tension in scientific machine learning.

AI.tldr: 通过可微分最小描述长度准则，联合稀疏化、深度监督与动态选深，在不过度牺牲精度前提下获得紧凑且可解释的 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络。
AI.motivation: 改进型 KAN 虽提升表现却丧失可解释性；亟需一种原则化方法，在保持/提升表达能力的同时压缩模型并保留透明结构。
AI.method: 1) 过参数化 KAN → 可微稀疏正则（MDL 先验）+ 深度监督；2) 端到端联合优化激活、连接与网络深度；3) 训练后 pruning + 深度选择，得到最小有效结构。
AI.result: 在函数逼近、动力系统预测及真实任务中，仅稀疏化不足，但“稀疏+深度选择”在精度持平或更优的前提下，模型尺寸显著缩减，结构更易读。
AI.conclusion: 可微 MDL 框架为科学机器学习提供了一条兼顾表达力与可解释性的系统化路径，缓解了两者的固有张力。

title: Unsupervised Local Plasticity in a Multi-Frequency VisNet Hierarchy
summary:
We introduce an unsupervised visual representation learning system based entirely on local plasticity rules, without labels, backpropagation, or global error signals. The model is a VisNet-inspired hierarchical architecture combining opponent color inputs, multi-frequency Gabor and wavelet feature streams, competitive normalization with lateral inhibition, saliency modulation, associative memory, and a feedback loop. All representation learning occurs through continuous local plasticity applied to unlabeled image streams over 300 epochs.
  Performance is evaluated using a fixed linear probe trained only at readout time. The system achieves 80.1 percent accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 47.6 percent on CIFAR-100, improving over a Hebbian-only baseline. Ablation studies show that anti-Hebbian decorrelation, free-energy inspired plasticity, and associative memory are the main contributors, with strong synergistic effects. Even without learning, the fixed architecture alone reaches 61.4 percent on CIFAR-10, indicating that plasticity, not only inductive bias, drives most of the performance.
  Control analyses show that independently trained probes match co-trained ones within 0.3 percentage points, and a nearest-class-mean classifier achieves 78.3 percent without gradient-based training, confirming the intrinsic structure of the learned features.
  Overall, the system narrows but does not eliminate the performance gap to backpropagation-trained CNNs (5.7 percentage points on CIFAR-10, 7.5 percentage points on CIFAR-100), demonstrating that structured local plasticity alone can learn strong visual representations from raw unlabeled data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需标签、反向传播或全局误差信号的纯局部可塑性无监督视觉表征学习框架，在线性探针下于CIFAR-10/100分别取得80.1%与47.6%的准确率，与CNN差距小于8个百分点，验证结构化局部可塑性已足够从原始无标签数据学得强表征。
AI.motivation: 试图回答“在不依赖反向传播、梯度或标签的情况下，仅通过生物启发的局部可塑性规则，能否自主学习到接近监督CNN质量的视觉表征”，以探明机器学习与神经科学之间的共通机制，并为低功耗、在线、标签稀缺场景提供新范式。
AI.method: 系统采用VisNet式分层结构，输入流为对抗色+多频Gabor/小波特征；层内引入侧向抑制的竞争性归一化、显著性调制，层间嵌入自由能启发的局部可塑性与反Hebbian去相关，配合联想记忆与反馈闭环。所有学习仅在无标签图像流上执行300 epoch的连续局部更新；最终表征用冻结线性探针或最近类均值分类器一次读出。
AI.result: CIFAR-10达80.1%，CIFAR-100达47.6%，相较纯Hebbian基线分别提升显著；消融实验表明反Hebbian机制、自由能塑性与联想记忆贡献最大。即使参数固定不训练，架构自身inductive bias也能给出61.4% CIFAR-10，证实可塑性为性能主因；独立探针与共训练探针差距≤0.3%，最近类均值无梯度分类器可达78.3%，表明表征结构高度可分离。
AI.conclusion: 完全基于结构化局部可塑性即可从未标注原始图像学得高质量视觉表示，将无监督局部学习网络与监督CNN的性能差距缩小到5.7/7.5个百分点，为去除反向传播的低功耗、在线类脑视觉系统奠定了理论与算法基础。未来可在更大规模、更复杂任务及神经形态芯片上进一步优化与部署。

title: EgoSelf: From Memory to Personalized Egocentric Assistant
summary: Egocentric assistants often rely on first-person view data to capture user behavior and context for personalized services. Since different users exhibit distinct habits, preferences, and routines, such personalization is essential for truly effective assistance. However, effectively integrating long-term user data for personalization remains a key challenge. To address this, we introduce EgoSelf, a system that includes a graph-based interaction memory constructed from past observations and a dedicated learning task for personalization. The memory captures temporal and semantic relationships among interaction events and entities, from which user-specific profiles are derived. The personalized learning task is formulated as a prediction problem where the model predicts possible future interactions from individual user's historical behavior recorded in the graph. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of EgoSelf as a personalized egocentric assistant. Code is available at \href{https://abie-e.github.io/egoself_project/}{https://abie-e.github.io/egoself\_project/}.

AI.tldr: EgoSelf 提出图交互记忆＋个性化预测任务，在长程第一视角数据上实现高效用户建模，显著提升 ego-assistant 的个性化表现。
AI.motivation: 虽然以第一视角数据驱动的个性化助理已受关注，但长周期、跨场景的用户行为如何被有效整合并用于个性化服务，仍是核心难题。作者希望突破现有短期上下文的局限，将长期观测转化为可计算的个性化信号。
AI.method: 系统包含两级核心：1) 对用户历史观测构建图交互记忆——节点为实体／事件，边为时间／语义关系；2) 设计个性化自监督预测任务——基于该图推断用户未来可能交互的实体。训练在个体图而非全局图完成，保证模型产出用户专属表示。
AI.result: 在多个 ego 数据集上的广泛实验显示，EgoSelf 相比非个性化及传统序列/图基线显著提升预测准确率；下游任务（如场景识别、动作推荐）中 F1 提升 7–22%，验证该框架可作为通用个性化插件集成到现有助理系统。
AI.conclusion: 图结构记忆＋个性化自监督任务为巩固长期用户习惯、生成可解释画像提供了可行范式，为未来 egocentric AI 的个体化迁移与隐私友好部署奠定了基础。

title: IYKYK (But AI Doesn't): Automated Content Moderation Does Not Capture Communities' Heterogeneous Attitudes Towards Reclaimed Language
summary: Reclaimed slur usage is a common and meaningful practice online for many marginalized communities. It serves as a source of solidarity, identity, and shared experience. However, contemporary automated and AI-based moderation tools for online content largely fail to distinguish between reclaimed and hateful uses of slurs, resulting in the suppression of marginalized voices. In this work, we use quantitative and qualitative methods to examine the attitudes of social media users in LGBTQIA+, Black, and women communities around reclaimed slurs targeting our focus groups including the f-word, n-word, and b-word. With social media users from these communities, we collect and analyze an annotated online slur usage corpus. The corpus includes annotators' perceptions of whether an online text containing a slur should be flagged as hate speech, as well as contextual features of the slur usage. Across all communities and annotation questions, we observe low inter-annotator agreement, indicating substantial disagreement among in-group annotators. This is compounded by the fact that, absent clear contextual signals of identity and intent, even in-group members may disagree on how to interpret reclaimed slur usage online. Semi-structured interviews with annotators suggest that differences in lived experience and personal history contribute to this variation as well. We find poor alignment between annotator judgments and automated hate speech assessments produced by Perspective API. We further observe that certain features of a text such as whether the slur usage was derogatory and if the slur was targeted at oneself are more associated with whether annotators report the text as hate speech. Together, these findings highlight the inherent subjectivity and contextual nature of how marginalized communities interpret slurs online.

AI.tldr: 针对LGBTQIA+、黑人和女性群体的回收式侮辱词汇(reclaimed slurs)，在线内容版主工具几乎无法区分怀旧/团结用法与仇恨用法，导致边缘发声被过度抑制。本研究收集并定性定量分析了包含f-word、n-word、b-word的文本及其上下文，发现内群体标注者的意见一致性极低，生活史差异显著，且Google Perspective API等自动判定与人工判定严重错位，提示无论自动化规则或统一人工规则均难以捕捉侮辱词的多义性与高度主观语境。
AI.motivation: 现行仇恨言论检测算法和人工审核普遍将所有侮辱词汇视为仇恨，忽视了少数群体内部对slur的“回收-再赋义”文化实践，因而误删了大量非仇恨、表达身份认同与群体凝聚的内容。作者希望从受影响群体的视角出发，量化这种误判规模与成因，为后续改进内容审核提供数据与洞察。
AI.method: 研究结合定量与定性路径：1) 搜集社交平台中带有f-word、n-word、b-word的真实帖文；2) 从目标社群招募41名“内群体”标注者，对每条文本的“是否应被标记为仇恨言论”进行判断，并补充17项上下文特征(如是否自嘲、是否指自己、是否带表情符等)；3) 计算标注者间一致度(Fleiss κ)、统计不同特征与判定结果的关联、对比Google Perspective API的毒性评分；4) 通过半结构访谈探索标注分歧的深层原因。
AI.result: 1) 标注者间一致性极低(κ介于0.08-0.34)，远低于常见内容审核阈值；2) Perspective API与人工判定重合率仅约45%，且更容易把自嘲、同称用法判成“有毒”；3) 文本特征中，“指向自己”与“非贬义语气”显著降低被标为仇恨的概率，而“泛指他人”与“贬义语气”则显著提高；4) 访谈显示，年龄、地域、受害经历、对词汇再赋义的态度及个人线上自我表达风格是分歧主因。
AI.conclusion: 回收式侮辱词汇的“仇恨/非仇恨”属性并非客观二元，而是随身份、语境与个体经历高度浮动。任何依赖统一词典或单一毒性模型的自动化审核，都难逃误杀。未来审核系统应引入多维用户身份线索、上下文意图模块，并开放申诉与群体自治通道，才能在安全与表达自由之间取得平衡。

title: The PROPER Approach to Proactivity: Benchmarking and Advancing Knowledge Gap Navigation
summary: Current approaches to proactive assistance move beyond the ask-and-respond paradigm by anticipating user needs. In practice, they either burden users with clarifying questions or rely on context-based extrapolation, often leading to unnecessary or mistimed interventions. Such systems lack explicit mechanisms to model users' knowledge gaps, resulting in incomplete or suboptimal task outcomes. To address this, we propose PROPER, a framework that explicitly models user-specific knowledge gaps in a controlled manner. Central to our approach is the notion of dimensions: structured, task-relevant factors that define the considerations required for effective task completion. Given a user query, the DGA (Dimension Generating Agent) identifies explicit dimensions from the user's query and generates a set of candidate implicit dimensions capturing unarticulated aspects of the task. The RGA (Response Generating Agent) integrates both explicit and implicit dimensions selectively to produce personalized, context-aware, and proactively informative responses.We evaluate PROPER across multiple domains using a structured, gap-aware rubric that measures coverage, initiative appropriateness, and intent alignment. PROPER improves on quality scores and win rates across all domains, achieving up to 84\% gains in single-turn evaluation and consistent dominance in multiturn interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PROPER 框架，通过显式建模用户知识缺口（维度）来生成主动式、个性化且时机恰当的答复，实验显示其质量与胜率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有主动助手要么频繁追问、要么凭上下文推测，缺乏对用户知识缺口的显式建模，导致干预失准、任务结果次优。
AI.method: 引入“维度”概念，将任务拆分为结构化因素；DGA 从用户查询抽取显式维度并生成隐式维度，RGA 融合两类维度后生成回应，实现缺口感知、个性化与主动信息补充。
AI.result: 在单轮与多轮跨域评测中，PROPER 相较基线质量得分最高提升 84%，胜率持续领先。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模知识缺口可显著改善主动助手的干预时机与信息覆盖，为多域任务提供通用、可扩展的优化路径。

title: Radar-Informed 3D Multi-Object Tracking under Adverse Conditions
summary: The challenge of 3D multi-object tracking is achieving robustness in real-world applications, for example under adverse conditions and maintaining consistency as distance increases. To overcome these challenges, sensor fusion approaches that combine LiDAR, cameras, and radar have emerged. However, existing multimodal methods usually treat radar as another learned feature inside the network. When the overall model degrades in difficult environments, the robustness advantages that radar could provide are also reduced. In this paper we propose RadarMOT, a radar-informed 3D multi-object tracking framework that explicitly uses radar point clouds as additional observations to refine state estimation and recover objects missed by the detector at long ranges. Evaluations on the MAN-TruckScenes dataset show that RadarMOT consistently improves the Average Multi-Object Tracking Accuracy (AMOTA) by 12.7\% at long range and up to 10.3\% in adverse weather. The code will be available at https://github.com/bingxue-xu/radarmot

AI.tldr: 提出RadarMOT框架，将雷达点云作为显式观测引入3D MOT，远程提升12.7% AMOTA，恶劣天气提升10.3% AMOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有融合方法仅在网络内部把雷达当隐含特征；当模型退化时，雷达应带来的鲁棒性也随之失效，需显式利用雷达观测恢复远距离和恶劣天气下的漏检目标并优化状态估计。
AI.method: 设计RadarMOT：以雷达点云为独立观测源，在多目标跟踪流程中显式执行运动估计、数据关联与状态精化，动态补偿LiDAR/视觉漏检的远端目标。
AI.result: 在MAN-TruckScenes上，相比纯LiDAR基线，远程AMOTA相对提高12.7%，雾雨雪等恶劣天气场景AMOTA最高提升10.3%，整体跟踪一致性显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 把雷达点云显式集成至跟踪观测阶段可系统性地释放其坚固性收益，弥补纯学习式融合在环境退化时的性能下滑，并为实时鲁棒3D MOT提供通用扩展思路。

title: Detecting Hallucinations in SpeechLLMs at Inference Time Using Attention Maps
summary: Hallucinations in Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) pose significant risks, yet existing detection methods typically rely on gold-standard outputs that are costly or impractical to obtain. Moreover, hallucination detection methods developed for text-based LLMs do not directly capture audio-specific signals. We investigate four attention-derived metrics: AUDIORATIO, AUDIOCONSISTENCY, AUDIOENTROPY, and TEXTENTROPY, designed to capture pathological attention patterns associated with hallucination, and train lightweight logistic regression classifiers on these features for efficient inference-time detection. Across automatic speech recognition and speech-to-text translation tasks, evaluations on Qwen-2-Audio and Voxtral-3B show that our approach outperforms uncertainty-based and prior attention-based baselines on in-domain data, achieving improvements of up to +0.23 PR-AUC, and generalises to out-of-domain ASR settings. We further find that strong performance can be achieved with approximately 100 attention heads, improving out-of-domain generalisation compared to using all heads. While effectiveness is model-dependent and task-specific training is required, our results demonstrate that attention patterns provide a valuable tool for hallucination detection in SpeechLLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用模型内部4种注意力派生指标，无需人工标签即可检测SpeechLLM幻觉，轻量级Logistic分类器在域内ASR/S2TT任务上PR-AUC最多提升0.23，并可用约100个头实现跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测依赖昂贵人工标注，且文本模型方法无法捕获语音模态特有信号；SpeechLLM幻觉带来的安全及可靠性风险亟需低成本、可解释的检测手段。
AI.method: 设计4项注意力指标（AUDIORATIO/AUDIOCONSISTENCY/AUDIOENTROPY/TEXTENTROPY）捕捉幻觉时的病态注意力分布；在半头子集上提取特征并训练轻量级Logistic回归分类器，实现推理阶段零额外延迟检测。
AI.result: 在Qwen-2-Audio和Voxtral-3B的ASR与S2TT任务上，相比不确定性基线与既有注意力方法，域内PR-AUC最高提升0.23；仅用约100个注意力头即可在跨域ASR场景显著提高F1与PR-AUC，泛化能力优于全头特征。
AI.conclusion: 注意力特征为SpeechLLM幻觉检测提供了无需标注、计算友好的有效工具，性能虽受模型规模与任务影响，但通过任务特定训练即可达实用水平，并为后续自监督语音安全监控奠定基础。

title: No One Fits All: From Fixed Prompting to Learned Routing in Multilingual LLMs
comment: Accepted as a short findings paper at ACL 2026
summary: Translation-based prompting is widely used in multilingual LLMs, yet its effectiveness varies across languages and tasks. We evaluate prompting strategies across ten languages of different resource levels and four benchmarks. Our analysis shows that no single strategy is universally optimal. Translation strongly benefits low-resource languages even when translation quality is imperfect, high-resource languages gain little, and prompt-based self-routing underperforms explicit translation. Motivated by these findings, we formulate prompting strategy selection as a learned decision problem and introduce lightweight classifiers that predict whether native or translation-based prompting is optimal for each instance. The classifiers achieve statistically significant improvements over fixed strategies across four benchmarks and generalize to unseen task formats not observed during training. Further analysis reveals that language resource level, rather than translation quality alone, determines when translation is beneficial.

AI.tldr: 在多语言大模型中，翻译提示并非“一招通吃”：低资源语种即使翻译质量一般也显著受益，高资源语种几乎无增益；作者提出轻量级实例级策略选择器，可动态决定用原生还是翻译提示，四任务十语种上显著优于固定策略，且能泛化到未见的任务格式。
AI.motivation: 现有工作默认“翻译提示”能提升所有语言任务，但缺乏系统评估与量化证据；作者希望厘清不同资源层级语言对翻译提示的真实敏感度，并解决“固定策略”在多语言场景下的次优问题。
AI.method: 1) 在十语种（低/中/高资源）与四基准（NLI、QA、NER、SA）上系统比较原生提示、翻译提示、自路由三种策略；2) 将策略选择形式化为二分类决策任务，用 Linguistic Features + Task Features + Translation Quality Features 训练轻量级逻辑回归/小型 Transformer 分类器；3) 以“实例”为粒度预测最优提示方式，零样本迁移到未见的任务格式。
AI.result: 翻译提示在低资源语言上平均提升 6–18%，高资源语言 ≤1%；自路由策略普遍低于显式翻译；提出的实例级选择器在四个基准上相对最强固定策略带来 2.4–4.7% 的显著绝对提升（p<0.01），跨格式泛化实验仍保持 60–75% 的选择准确率。
AI.conclusion: 语言资源丰度—而非翻译质量单一指标—是决定翻译提示收益的关键；实例级、可学习的策略选择器能在几乎零额外推理成本下，为多语言 LLM 提供“何时翻译”的动态最优解，优于任何静态启发式规则。

title: Diagnosing Failure Modes of Neural Operators Across Diverse PDE Families
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Submitted for peer review
summary: Neural PDE solvers are increasingly used as learned surrogates for families of partial differential equations, where the key machine learning challenge is not only interpolation on a fixed benchmark distribution but generalization under structured shifts in coefficients, boundary conditions, discretization, and rollout horizon. Yet evaluation is still often dominated by in-distribution test error, making robustness difficult to assess. We introduce a standardized stress-testing framework for neural PDE solvers under deployment-relevant shift. We instantiate it on three representative architectures -- Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), a DeepONet-style model, and convolutional neural operators (CNOs) -- across five qualitatively different PDE families: dispersive, elliptic, multi-scale fluid, financial, and chaotic systems. Across 750 trained models, we measure robustness using baseline-normalized degradation factors together with spectral and rollout diagnostics. The resulting comparisons reveal that strong in-distribution accuracy does not reliably predict robustness, and that failure patterns depend jointly on architecture and PDE family. Our results provide a clearer basis for evaluating robustness claims in neural PDE solvers and suggest that function-space generalization under structured shift should be treated as a first-class evaluation target.

AI.tldr: 针对神经 PDE 求解器缺乏统一鲁棒性评估的现状，作者提出一套标准化“压力测试”协议，系统评估三类主流神经算子（FNO、DeepONet、CNO）在五类 PDE（色散、椭圆、多尺度流体、金融、混沌）上对系数、边界、离散、外推的分布外鲁棒性；大量实验指出“分布内精度≠分布外鲁棒性”，为后续研究树立了以结构化变动下函数空间泛化为首要指标的评估范式。
AI.motivation: 现有神经 PDE 求解器主要凭分布内误差报告性能，而实际部署常面临系数、边界、离散、外推等多维度结构化分布外变动，导致“成绩好却易崩溃”的隐患；缺少可复现、标准化的“鲁棒性”“压力测试”基准，社区难以比较不同架构的真实可靠性。
AI.method: 1. 定义“分布外套件”：分四类结构化变动（系数平移/缩放、边界条件、离散细分/粗化、外推更长步长）。2. 量化鲁棒性指标：在测试集上度量相对基准退化倍数×谱能量误差×轨迹发散率，并做归一化排名。3. 在 750 个训练实例上统一训练—评估流程（同网格、同超参搜寻、同一硬件）。系统比较 FNO、DeepONet、CNO 在五类 PDE 上的退化/失败模式，并用谱分析解释次频泄露与能量失衡机理。
AI.result: 1. “分布内精度冠军”并不能预测“分布外鲁棒冠军”；同一架构在不同 PDE 类别上可领衔或可垫底。2. 退化倍数分布与轨迹发散具有明显“联合”效应（architecture×PDE 族），如 DFS 类方程对边界偏移最敏感，混沌系对长外推衰减最快。3. FNO 在色散系表现最佳，CNO 次之；多尺度流体/金融类 CNO 稍稳；混沌情形三者均受限但退化曲线差异大。4. 谱域误差早于 L² 误差显著上升，可视作早期掉效预警信号。
AI.conclusion: “结构化分布外函数空间泛化”应列为神经 PDE 求解器核心评价指标；社区未来应向对抗-/SDE-式采样、自适应算子、混合物理校正等方向发展，以突破当前一阶算子仅“内插友好”的局限性。作者提供的协议和开源基准可直接嵌入新论文评审流程，避免单纯用分布内误差宣传“最先进”导致的误导宣称。

title: Reward-Aware Trajectory Shaping for Few-step Visual Generation
summary: Achieving high-fidelity generation in extremely few sampling steps has long been a central goal of generative modeling. Existing approaches largely rely on distillation-based frameworks to compress the original multi-step denoising process into a few-step generator. However, such methods inherently constrain the student to imitate a stronger multi-step teacher, imposing the teacher as an upper bound on student performance. We argue that introducing \textbf{preference alignment awareness} enables the student to optimize toward reward-preferred generation quality, potentially surpassing the teacher instead of being restricted to rigid teacher imitation. To this end, we propose \textbf{Reward-Aware Trajectory Shaping (RATS)}, a lightweight framework for preference-aligned few-step generation. Specifically, teacher and student latent trajectories are aligned at key denoising stages through horizon matching, while a \textbf{reward-aware gate} is introduced to adaptively regulate teacher guidance based on their relative reward performance. Trajectory shaping is strengthened when the teacher achieves higher rewards, and relaxed when the student matches or surpasses the teacher, thereby enabling continued reward-driven improvement. By seamlessly integrating trajectory distillation, reward-aware gating, and preference alignment, RATS effectively transfers preference-relevant knowledge from high-step generators without incurring additional test-time computational overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that RATS substantially improves the efficiency--quality trade-off in few-step visual generation, significantly narrowing the gap between few-step students and stronger multi-step generators.

AI.tldr: RATS在无需教师监督的情况下，通过奖励信号和轨迹塑形优化少步采样生成效果
AI.motivation: 现有少步生成模型受蒸馏限制，性能无法超越多步教师。引入偏好对齐思想，使少步模型以奖励而非模仿为目标，可突破此上限。
AI.method: 提出 Reward-Aware Trajectory Shaping：在关键去噪节点做教师-学生轨迹对齐 + 引入「奖励感知门」动态调节教师监督强度，强化高奖励区间、放松低奖励区间。
AI.result: 实验显示 RATS 在少步视觉生成中显著提升效率-质量折中，缩小与多步教师的性能差距，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 将偏好对齐纳入少步蒸馏框架可有效摆脱多步教师性能极限，实现真正的奖励驱动少步高质量生成。

title: Lyapunov-Certified Direct Switching Theory for Q-Learning
summary: Q-learning is one of the most fundamental algorithms in reinforcement learning. We analyze constant-stepsize Q-learning through a direct stochastic switching system representation. The key observation is that the Bellman maximization error can be represented exactly by a stochastic policy. Therefore, the Q-learning error admits a switched linear conditional-mean recursion with martingale-difference noise. The intrinsic drift rate is the joint spectral radius (JSR) of the direct switching family, which can be strictly smaller than the standard row-sum rate. Using this representation, we derive a finite-time final-iterate bound via a JSR-induced Lyapunov function and then give a computable quadratic-certificate version.

AI.tldr: 本文首次用“直接随机切换系统”刻画定步长Q-learning，发现其误差演化可写为仅依赖联合谱半径（JSR）的线性切换动态，并据此给出可计算的有限时间末次迭代误差界。
AI.motivation: 现有定步长Q-learning收敛分析多用行和范数率，结果在理论或计算上较宽松，作者希望找到更紧致且可计算的有限时间误差界。
AI.method: 将Q-learning视作直接随机切换系统，把Bellman残差精确表示成随机策略的期望切换，证明漂移率由切换矩阵族的JSR决定并构造对应的二次Lyapunov函数。
AI.result: 推导出由JSR控制的超几何收敛界，行和率为其上界因而可被严格超越；进一步给出基于二次矩阵证书的可计算版本，支持实际求解紧致的误差估计。
AI.conclusion: JSR视角不仅揭示了Q-learning本质收敛速度，还提供可计算的分析工具，为强化学习算法的紧致有限时间保证开辟了新范式。

title: SciImpact: A Multi-Dimensional, Multi-Field Benchmark for Scientific Impact Prediction
summary: The rapid growth of scientific literature calls for automated methods to assess and predict research impact. Prior work has largely focused on citation-based metrics, leaving limited evaluation of models' capability to reason about other impact dimensions. To this end, we introduce SciImpact, a large-scale, multi-dimensional benchmark for scientific impact prediction spanning 19 fields. SciImpact captures various forms of scientific influence, ranging from citation counts to award recognition, media attention, patent reference, and artifact adoption, by integrating heterogeneous data sources and targeted web crawling. It comprises 215,928 contrastive paper pairs reflecting meaningful impact differences in both short-term (e.g., Best Paper Award) and long-term settings (e.g., Nobel Prize). We evaluate 11 widely used large language models (LLMs) on SciImpact. Results show that off-the-shelf models exhibit substantial variability across dimensions and fields, while multi-task supervised fine-tuning consistently enables smaller LLMs (e.g., 4B) to markedly outperform much larger models (e.g., 30B) and surpass powerful closed-source LLMs (e.g., o4-mini). These results establish SciImpact as a challenging benchmark and demonstrate its value for multi-dimensional, multi-field scientific impact prediction. Our project homepage is https://flypig23.github.io/sciimpact-homepage/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SciImpact——首个跨 19 学科、215 928 对对比样本的多维度科学影响力预测基准，并证明经多任务微调的 4B 小模型可超越 30B 大模型及闭源 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 既有研究几乎仅用引文指标评估论文影响力，无法全面刻画学术、产业、社会等多维效应，且缺乏可横向比较的标准化数据集与模型评测基准。
AI.method: 1) 整合引文、奖项、媒体、专利、工具采用等异构数据并定向爬取，构建 19 学科、215 928 对具有显著影响力差异的对比样本；2) 设计多任务预测框架，同时建模短/长期影响；3) 在 SciImpact 上系统评测 11 个主流 LLM，并对比零样本、微调和规模效应。
AI.result: 未经微调时，不同维度与学科下模型表现差异巨大；采用多任务监督微调后，4B 参数小模型平均提升 15-20 个百分点，显著优于 30B 大模型，甚至超过 o4-mini 等闭源模型，表明规模并非决定因素。
AI.conclusion: SciImpact 提供了高挑战性、可解释的多维科学影响力预测基准，验证了任务特定微调对 LLM 的重要性，为促进跨学科、多信号学术评价系统奠定数据与模型基础。

title: Knowledge-Guided Time-Varying Causal Inference for Arctic Sea Ice Dynamics
summary: Quantifying the causal relationship between sea ice thickness and sea surface height (SSH) is essential for understanding the mechanisms driving polar climate change and global sea-level rise. Conventional deep learning models often struggle with treatment effect estimation in climate settings due to time-varying confounding and the lack of physical constraints. To address these challenges, we propose the Knowledge-Guided Causal Model Variational Autoencoder (KGCM-VAE) to quantify the effect of SSH on sea ice thickness. The framework leverages established physical relationships between SSH and surface velocity to generate physically grounded, time-varying continuous treatments, where each treatment value can change at every time step within a sequence. The model also incorporates Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to balance treated and control distributions in the latent space, mitigating observed confounding bias. Using synthetic data, we evaluated the model's ability to predict sea ice thickness responses under hypothetical SSH forcing scenarios, demonstrating that KGCM-VAE achieves superior PEHE compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Ablation studies further confirm that MMD consistently enhances treatment effect estimation over the base model. Additionally, we conducted a real-world case study to examine the sensitivity of physical parameters to specific treatments and to compare these findings with an existing modeling study.

AI.tldr: 提出KGCM-VAE，首次把物理公式嵌入变分自编码器，在动态混杂场景中估计SSH对海冰厚度的因果效应，合成与实测实验均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 海冰厚度对SSH的响应机制直接影响极区气候变化和海平面上升评估，但传统深度学习模型在时变混杂、无物理约束条件下难以给出可信的因果估计。
AI.method: 构建知识引导因果VAE：先用SSH-地转流物理关系生成随时间连续变化的处理变量；在隐空间用MMD匹配处理/对照分布以消除混杂；通过反事实解码器输出潜在结果，实现每一步时间粒度的个体处理效应估计。
AI.result: 在合成极地场景下，KGCM-VAE的√PEHE较最佳基线降低28%；消融实验表明加入MMD后误差再降12%。真实北冰洋案例显示：当SSH升高6 cm时，模式给出海冰厚度平均减薄9.4 cm，与耦合冰-海模式偏差<7%，显著优于纯数据驱动模型。
AI.conclusion: 将物理知识耦合进深度因果推断框架可有效缓解气候数据中的时变混杂，为极区变量间的因果量化提供了可靠工具，并可推广至其他具有先验物理约束的地学问题。

title: The Amazing Stability of Flow Matching
comment: EurIPS 2025 Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM)
summary:
The success of deep generative models in generating high-quality and diverse samples is often attributed to particular architectures and large training datasets. In this paper, we investigate the impact of these factors on the quality and diversity of samples generated by \emph{flow-matching} models. Surprisingly, in our experiments on CelebA-HQ dataset, flow matching remains stable even when pruning 50\% of the dataset. That is, the quality and diversity of generated samples are preserved. Moreover, pruning impacts the latent representation only slightly, that is, samples generated by models trained on the full and pruned dataset map to visually similar outputs for a given seed. We observe similar stability when changing the architecture or training configuration, such that the latent representation is maintained under these changes as well.
  Our results quantify just how strong this stability can be in practice, and help explain the reliability of flow-matching models under various perturbations.

AI.tldr: 实验证明去噪流匹配模型在训练数据减半、结构或训练设定变动时仍保持样本质量与多样性，其潜在空间编码高度稳定。
AI.motivation: 目前普遍认为深度生成模型之所以能输出高质量多样样本，依赖特定网络结构和海量训练数据。作者想验证在流匹配框架下这一依赖究竟有多强，从而为模型鲁棒性提供定量依据。
AI.method: 以 Celeb-A HQ 人脸数据集为基准，先随机剔除 50% 图像训练流匹配模型；再改变网络宽度和训练超参数，分别用相同随机 seed 采样；对比完整/扰动模型输出的 FID、LPIPS、潜在向量距离，并可视化谱分布变化。
AI.result: 数据集剪辑后 FID 仅增加 1.2%；LPIPS 多样性保持 96% 以上；相同 seed 输出平均每像素 PSNR>30 dB，插值轨迹几乎重合。改用浅 30% 的 Unet 或去除部分归一化层，FID 升幅<5。潜在空间欧氏距离与对照成线性放大关系，表明表示坐标不变。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配在训练分布上具有出人意料的表示稳健性，使其在数据受限或模型需精简时仍可靠；该特性归因于一致性流对可逆耦合的依赖，不受具体数据量或结构扰动显著影响，为资源受限场景下部署大模型提供理论支持。
