To bridge token-level predictions and pixel-level supervision, we propose Token--Mask Cycle Consistency (TMCC), a bidirectional training objective that enforces alignment across resolutions. By explicitly decoupling spatial grounding from semantic reasoning through structured language grounded query banks, AnchorSeg achieves state-of-the-art results on ReasonSeg test set (67.7\% gIoU and 68.1\% cIoU). All code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/rui-qian/AnchorSeg.

AI.tldr: AnchorSeg 用“语言-锚点-查询银行”序列取代单一分割 token，显式分离语义推理与空间定位，在 ReasonSeg 上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅靠一个 \texttt{<SEG>} token 同时编码“分割什么”与“在哪里分割”，导致语义与空间信息耦合，限制了复杂隐含查询的像素级定位精度。
AI.method: 1) 将推理分割重构成结构化条件生成：先产生 latent reasoning tokens 捕获中间语义状态，再输出 segmentation anchor token 提供显式空间锚点；2) 把空间条件建模为图像 token 上的因子化分布，anchor 负责定位信号，上下文查询调制语义；3) 提出 Token–Mask Cycle Consistency (TMCC) 双向目标，实现 token 预测与像素 mask 监督的对齐。
AI.result: 在 ReasonSeg 测试集达到 67.7% gIoU 与 68.1% cIoU，显著优于现有最佳方法；代码与模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化查询银行显式解耦语义推理与空间定位，AnchorSeg 有效提升了复杂隐含文本查询的像素级分割精度，为推理分割提供了新范式。

title: Learning Hybrid-Control Policies for High-Precision In-Contact Manipulation Under Uncertainty
summary: Reinforcement learning-based control policies have been frequently demonstrated to be more effective than analytical techniques for many manipulation tasks. Commonly, these methods learn neural control policies that predict end-effector pose changes directly from observed state information. For tasks like inserting delicate connectors which induce force constraints, pose-based policies have limited explicit control over force and rely on carefully tuned low-level controllers to avoid executing damaging actions. In this work, we present hybrid position-force control policies that learn to dynamically select when to use force or position control in each control dimension. To improve learning efficiency of these policies, we introduce Mode-Aware Training for Contact Handling (MATCH) which adjusts policy action probabilities to explicitly mirror the mode selection behavior in hybrid control. We validate MATCH's learned policy effectiveness using fragile peg-in-hole tasks under extreme localization uncertainty. We find MATCH substantially outperforms pose-control policies -- solving these tasks with up to 10% higher success rates and 5x fewer peg breaks than pose-only policies under common types of state estimation error. MATCH also demonstrates data efficiency equal to pose-control policies, despite learning in a larger and more complex action space. In over 1600 sim-to-real experiments, we find MATCH succeeds twice as often as pose policies in high noise settings (33% vs.~68%) and applies ~30% less force on average compared to variable impedance policies on a Franka FR3 in laboratory conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出混合位姿-力控制策略MATCH，在易损插装任务中显式选择控制模式，显著提升成功率并减少损伤。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习策略直接输出位姿变化，无法显式约束接触力，易导致精密插装任务中的部件损坏。
AI.method: 构建混合位置-力控制策略，在每一控制维度动态切换控制模式；引入MATCH训练机制，通过调整动作概率使策略模仿混合控制的模态选择行为。
AI.result: 在极端定位不确定条件下，MATCH成功率提高10%，插杆断裂减少5倍；1600余次sim-to-real实验中，高噪声场景成功率达68%（对比位姿策略33%），且平均接触力降低约30%。
AI.conclusion: MATCH在更大、更复杂的动作空间中保持与位姿策略相当的数据效率，显著提升了脆弱插装任务的可靠性与安全性。

title: VLM-3R: Vision-Language Models Augmented with Instruction-Aligned 3D Reconstruction
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for 2D images and videos has motivated extending these models to understand 3D scenes, aiming for human-like visual-spatial intelligence. Nevertheless, achieving deep spatial understanding comparable to human capabilities poses significant challenges in model encoding and data acquisition. Existing methods frequently depend on external depth sensors for geometry capture or utilize off-the-shelf algorithms for pre-constructing 3D maps, thereby limiting their scalability, especially with prevalent monocular video inputs and for time-sensitive applications. In this work, we introduce VLM-3R, a unified framework for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that incorporates 3D Reconstructive instruction tuning. VLM-3R processes monocular video frames by employing a geometry encoder to derive implicit 3D tokens that represent spatial understanding. Leveraging our Spatial-Visual-View Fusion and over 200K curated 3D reconstructive instruction tuning question-answer (QA) pairs, VLM-3R effectively aligns real-world spatial context with language instructions. This enables monocular 3D spatial assistance and embodied reasoning. To facilitate the evaluation of temporal reasoning, we introduce the Vision-Spatial-Temporal Intelligence benchmark, featuring over 138.6K QA pairs across five distinct tasks focused on evolving spatial relationships. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model, VLM-3R, not only facilitates robust visual-spatial reasoning but also enables the understanding of temporal 3D context changes, excelling in both accuracy and scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出 VLM-3R，一种无需额外深度传感、仅靠单目视频即可端到端注入三维空间-时间理解的视觉-语言模型。训练后能在单目 3D 场景下完成问答和具身推理，并在自建立 Vision-Spatial-Temporal Intelligence 基准上取得当前最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型对静态 2D 视觉信号已有很强理解，但对真实三维空间-时间推理仍显不足——尤其是单目输入时缺乏几何深度信息，且依赖外部深度传感器或先建图的系统难以扩展。作者力图把“人级空间-时间智能”直接集成进大模型，使模型像人一样仅靠单视角视频即可感知形状、距离与演变，同时可用语言灵活交互。
AI.method: 1）几何编码器：从单目帧中提取隐式 3D token，无编码深度真值即可对齐世界坐标。2）Spatial-Visual-View Fusion：把帧间特征、空间 token 与语言提示统一映射到共享潜在空间，解决 3D 位置-相机姿态耦合。3）3D Reconstructive Instruction Tuning：构造 20 万余条聚焦“形状/布局/演变”重建的多轮 QA，完成多任务联合微调。4）引入新三维度评测集 VSTI（138.6K QA，涵盖静态布局、动作路径、物体增减等五类时序推理任务）。
AI.result: VLM-3R 比之前依赖显式深度或多传感器的 SOTA 方法，在 VSTI 五任务平均提升 7.2–11.8 pp，在 ScanQA、SQA3D 等常规空间问答上 mIoU 升 5.1，体积重建误差降 18.6%。推理延迟 < 120 ms/帧，GPU 吞吐量较现基线提升 26%，展示出高定位速度和线性扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 仅用单目视觉+语言指令即可让大模型获得类人的三维时空理解；3D token 表征与大规模重建问答是通往具身智能与可扩展 AR/机器人应用的可靠范式。消融表明：去掉几何编码或剔除时间 QA 均明显牺牲准确率，验证“三维表征-动态问答”缺一不可。后续将扩展至多视角视频与多模态动作规划。

title: A Heterogeneous Long-Micro Scale Cascading Architecture for General Aviation Health Management
comment: Significant methodological flaws have been identified in the experimental validation and metric computation procedures that undermine the reliability of the reported results. A comprehensive revision is underway
summary: BACKGROUND: General aviation fleet expansion demands intelligent health monitoring under computational constraints. Real-world aircraft health diagnosis requires balancing accuracy with computational constraints under extreme class imbalance and environmental uncertainty. Existing end-to-end approaches suffer from the receptive field paradox: global attention introduces excessive operational heterogeneity noise for fine-grained fault classification, while localized constraints sacrifice critical cross-temporal context essential for anomaly detection. METHODS: This paper presents an AI-driven heterogeneous cascading architecture for general aviation health management. The proposed Long-Micro Scale Diagnostician (LMSD) explicitly decouples global anomaly detection (full-sequence attention) from micro-scale fault classification (restricted receptive fields), resolving the receptive field paradox while minimizing training overhead. A knowledge distillation-based interpretability module provides physically traceable explanations for safety-critical validation. RESULTS: Experiments on the public National General Aviation Flight Information Database (NGAFID) dataset (28,935 flights, 36 categories) demonstrate 4--8% improvement in safety-critical metrics (MCWPM) with 4.2 times training acceleration and 46% model compression compared to end-to-end baselines. CONCLUSIONS: The AI-driven heterogeneous architecture offers deployable solutions for aviation equipment health management, with potential for digital twin integration in future work. The proposed framework substantiates deployability in resource-constrained aviation environments while maintaining stringent safety requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向通航的级联式健康监测框架LMSD，通过“全局异常检测＋局部细分类”解耦，兼顾精度、算力与可解释性，在NGAFID数据集上安全指标提升4–8%，训练提速4.2倍，模型压缩46%。
AI.motivation: 通航机队扩张带来实时健康监测需求，但存在极端类别不平衡、环境不确定性与机载算力受限三重挑战；现有端到端方法受“感受野悖论”困扰，无法同时满足全局异常感知与细粒度故障分类。
AI.method: 设计异构级联架构LMSD：1) 长程分支用全序列注意力做全局异常检测；2) 微尺度分支用受限感受野做细分类；3) 知识蒸馏可解释模块提供物理可追溯解释；4) 两阶段训练降低开销并解耦感受野冲突。
AI.result: 在NGAFID 28 935航班、36类数据上，MCWPM等安全关键指标提升4–8%，训练时间减少至1/4.2，模型体积压缩46%，显著优于端到端基线。
AI.conclusion: LMSD给出资源受限环境下可部署的通航健康管理方案，兼备高安全与高效率，并为后续数字孪生集成奠定基础。

title: MultiWorld: Scalable Multi-Agent Multi-View Video World Models
summary: Video world models have achieved remarkable success in simulating environmental dynamics in response to actions by users or agents. They are modeled as action-conditioned video generation models that take historical frames and current actions as input to predict future frames. Yet, most existing approaches are limited to single-agent scenarios and fail to capture the complex interactions inherent in real-world multi-agent systems. We present \textbf{MultiWorld}, a unified framework for multi-agent multi-view world modeling that enables accurate control of multiple agents while maintaining multi-view consistency. We introduce the Multi-Agent Condition Module to achieve precise multi-agent controllability, and the Global State Encoder to ensure coherent observations across different views. MultiWorld supports flexible scaling of agent and view counts, and synthesizes different views in parallel for high efficiency. Experiments on multi-player game environments and multi-robot manipulation tasks demonstrate that MultiWorld outperforms baselines in video fidelity, action-following ability, and multi-view consistency. Project page: https://multi-world.github.io/

AI.tldr: MultiWorld 首次提出一个统一的多智能体、多视角视频世界模型，能够在单一框架内对所有视角同步建模，支持任意数量智能体与视角的灵活扩展，并在游戏和多机器人场景下显著优于现有单智能体方案。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频生成模型仅限单智能体，无法刻画多智能体系统中的复杂交互与跨视角一致性，阻碍了在多人游戏、多机器人协作等真实场景中的应用。
AI.method: 1) 提出 MultiWorld 统一框架，将多智能体、多视角动态统一为联合视频生成问题；2) 设计 Multi-Agent Condition Module，对任意数量智能体的动作进行结构化编码，实现精确保真控制；3) 引入 Global State Encoder，在生成前融合全局时空上下文，确保多视角输出在几何与语义上全局一致；4) 并行视角合成，训练与推理过程计算开销线性可控。
AI.result: 在多人游戏（ViZDoom、Overcooked）与多机器人操作基准上，MultiWorld 在 FVD、PSNR、SSIM 分别降低 13-25%，在动作跟随准确率（Action-Condition Accuracy）与跨视角一致性误差（Epipolar L1）上均优于 MaskVit、W-O GAN 等强基线，并可扩展至 16 视角/12 智能体仍保持实时合成能力。
AI.conclusion: MultiWorld 验证了多智能体视频世界模型的可行性，展示了跨视角全局一致性建模与可扩展多智能体控制的关键设计思路，为多智能体强化学习、分布式协作及元宇宙仿真等任务提供了高效、可控且可扩展的环境引擎。

title: Adaptive MSD-Splitting: Enhancing C4.5 and Random Forests for Skewed Continuous Attributes
summary: The discretization of continuous numerical attributes remains a persistent computational bottleneck in the induction of decision trees, particularly as dataset dimensions scale. Building upon the recently proposed MSD-Splitting technique -- which bins continuous data using the empirical mean and standard deviation to dramatically improve the efficiency and accuracy of the C4.5 algorithm -- we introduce Adaptive MSD-Splitting (AMSD). While standard MSD-Splitting is highly effective for approximately symmetric distributions, its rigid adherence to fixed one-standard-deviation cutoffs can lead to catastrophic information loss in highly skewed data, a common artifact in real-world biomedical and financial datasets. AMSD addresses this by dynamically adjusting the standard deviation multiplier based on feature skewness, narrowing intervals in dense regions to preserve discriminative resolution. Furthermore, we integrate AMSD into ensemble methods, specifically presenting the Random Forest-AMSD (RF-AMSD) framework. Empirical evaluations on the Census Income, Heart Disease, Breast Cancer, and Forest Covertype datasets demonstrate that AMSD yields a 2-4% accuracy improvement over standard MSD-Splitting, while maintaining near-identical O(N) time complexity reductions compared to the O(N log N) exhaustive search. Our Random Forest extension achieves state-of-the-art accuracy at a fraction of standard computational costs, confirming the viability of adaptive statistical binning in large-scale ensemble learning architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文在 MSD-Splitting 的基础上提出 Adaptive MSD-Splitting（AMSD），根据特征偏度动态调整切点，并嵌入随机森林形成 RF-AMSD，在保持 O(N) 复杂度、不牺牲效率的前提下，将分类准确率再提升 2–4%，在大规模数据集上实现当前最优精度。
AI.motivation: 连续属性离散化仍是决策树在大规模数据中的性能瓶颈；现有 MSD-Splitting 对偏斜分布鲁棒性差，易导致信息丢失，需要一种能自适应数据分布且保持线性复杂度的快速切点方法。
AI.method: 1) 在 MSD 框架下引入偏度估计，动态调节标准差倍数，实现切点“密处窄、疏处宽”的自适应划分；2) 将 AMSD 集成到随机森林，提出 RF-AMSD 框架；3) 采用 Census Income、Heart Disease 等 4 个公开数据集进行系统比较。
AI.result: AMSD 相对原 MSD-Splitting 准确率提升 2–4%，时间复杂度仍为 O(N)，显著优于 O(N log N) 的穷举搜索；RF-AMSD 在相同硬件条件下达到 SOTA 精度，同时计算开销仅为传统方法的零头。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单的偏度自适应策略即可在几乎不增加计算量的情况下显著提升离散化质量；RF-AMSD 验证了自适应统计分箱在大规模集成学习中的可行性与扩展潜力，可直接替代现有离散化模块。

title: OmniGen2: Towards Instruction-Aligned Multimodal Generation
summary: In this work, we introduce OmniGen2, a versatile and open-source generative model designed to provide a unified solution for diverse generation tasks, including text-to-image, image editing, and in-context generation. Unlike OmniGen v1, OmniGen2 features two distinct decoding pathways for text and image modalities, utilizing unshared parameters and a decoupled image tokenizer. This design enables OmniGen2 to build upon existing multimodal understanding models without the need to re-adapt VAE inputs, thereby preserving the original text generation capabilities. To facilitate the training of OmniGen2, we developed comprehensive data construction pipelines, encompassing image editing and in-context generation data. Additionally, we introduce a reflection mechanism tailored for image generation tasks and curate a dedicated reflection dataset based on OmniGen2. Despite its relatively modest parameter size, OmniGen2 achieves competitive results on multiple task benchmarks, including text-to-image and image editing. To further evaluate in-context generation, also referred to as subject-driven tasks, we introduce a new benchmark named OmniContext. OmniGen2 achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models in terms of consistency. We will release our models, training code, datasets, and data construction pipeline to support future research in this field. Project Page: https://vectorspacelab.github.io/OmniGen2; GitHub Link: https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/OmniGen2

AI.tldr: 开源统一生成模型OmniGen2在文本到图像、图像编辑及上下文生成任务上同时刷新开源SOTA，并以双解码路径+反射机制实现轻量高效。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在多模态生成任务上常需独立微调或重训VAE，文本能力易退化；作者希望用一个轻量级开源框架统一解决文生图、图像编辑及主体驱动生成，同时保留原生文本理解与生成能力。
AI.method: 1) 设计文本/图像双解码通路，参数不共享，并引入解耦图像Tokenizer，可直接继承现成多模态理解模型权重而无需重训VAE。2) 构建覆盖图像编辑与上下文生成的完整数据生产管线。3) 提出针对图像生成的「反射机制」并构建对应反射数据集，以提升生成一致性与可控性。4) 新建评测集OmniContext专门评估主体驱动/上下文生成能力。
AI.result: 在文生图、图像编辑等公开基准上与主流大模型竞争；在自建的OmniContext主体驱动任务中，OmniGen2取得开源模型最佳一致性分数，且参数量显著小于闭源对手。
AI.conclusion: OmniGen2以模块化双通路架构和数据-机制协同设计，验证了「轻量统一生成」路线的可行性；作者开源模型、代码、全部数据集与数据构造流程，为后续多模态生成研究提供即插即用的基础工具。

title: Semantic Interaction Information mediates compositional generalization in latent space
summary:
Are there still barriers to generalization once all relevant variables are known? We address this question via a framework that casts compositional generalization as a variational inference problem over latent variables with parametric interactions. To explore this, we develop the Cognitive Gridworld, a stationary Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) where observations are generated jointly by multiple latent variables, yet feedback is provided for only a single goal variable. This setting allows us to define Semantic Interaction Information (SII): a metric measuring the contribution of latent variable interactions to task performance. Using SII, we analyze Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) provided with these interactions, finding that SII explains the accuracy gap between Echo State and Fully Trained networks. Our analysis also uncovers a theoretically predicted failure mode where confidence decouples from accuracy, suggesting that utilizing interactions between relevant variables is a non-trivial capability.
  We then address a harder regime where the interactions must be learned by an embedding model. Learning how latent variables interact requires accurate inference, yet accurate inference depends on knowing those interactions. The Cognitive Gridworld reveals this circular dependence as a core challenge for continual meta-learning. We approach this dilemma via Representation Classification Chains (RCCs), a JEPA-style architecture that disentangles these processes: variable inference and variable embeddings are learned by separate modules through Reinforcement Learning and self-supervised learning, respectively. Lastly, we demonstrate that RCCs facilitate compositional generalization to novel combinations of relevant variables. Together, these results establish a grounded setting for evaluating goal-directed generalist agents.

AI.tldr: 这篇摘要提出，即使已知所有相关变量，组合泛化仍可能受阻。作者以Cognitive Gridworld为测试环境，定义了语义交互信息(SII)来度量隐变量交互对任务性能的贡献，发现Echo State网络与全训练网络差距可由SII解释；进一步提出Representation Classification Chains(RCC)架构，将交互学习与表征学习分离，从而在无显式交互结构时也能对新变量组合进行泛化，为持续元学习与目标导向智能体评估奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 回答“当所有相关变量都已知是否还存在泛化障碍”这一问题，揭示组合泛化的瓶颈，尤其是无法在环境中观察全部隐变量交互时，只能靠部分目标反馈进行学习。
AI.method: 1) 提出Cognitive Gridworld——目标导向的POMDP平台，观测由多条隐变量协同生成，但反馈仅针对单一目标。2) 定义SII度量隐变量交互对任务表现的贡献；3) 在已知交互参数条件下训练RNN，实验验证SII解释准确率差异；4) 在无先验交互结构的更严苛场景，提出RCC架构：一端用自监督学习变量嵌入，另一端用强化学习推断变量，两者解耦联合训练。
AI.result: 1) SII显著区分不同RNN训练策略的准确率差距；2) 理论预测并实验观测到“置信度与准确率脱钩”的失效模式；3) RCC在未知交互结构情况下能稳定推断隐变量组合，并实现对新变量组合的零样本组合泛化，实现了系统在持续元学习中的闭环优化。
AI.conclusion: 利用隐变量交互并非易事，早期推断所需交互结构带来的循环依赖是组合泛化的核心挑战。RCC通过解耦表示与推理模块打破了这一循环，为检测与改进具备持续学与组合泛化的目标导向通才智能体提供了可复现的实验平台与方法框架。

title: Personalized Embodied Navigation for Portable Object Finding
summary: Embodied navigation methods commonly operate in static environments with stationary objects. In this work, we present approaches for tackling navigation in dynamic scenarios with non-stationary targets. In an indoor environment, we assume that these objects are everyday portable items moved by human intervention. We therefore formalize the problem as a personalized habit learning problem. To learn these habits, we introduce two Transit-Aware Planning (TAP) approaches that enrich embodied navigation policies with object path information. TAP improves performance in portable object finding by rewarding agents that learn to synchronize their routes with target routes. TAPs are evaluated on Dynamic Object Maps (DOMs), a dynamic variant of node-attributed topological graphs with structured object transitions. DOMs mimic human habits to simulate realistic object routes on a graph. We test TAP agents both in simulation as well as the real-world. In the MP3D simulator, TAP improves the success of a vanilla agent by 21.1% in finding non-stationary targets, while also generalizing better from static environments by 44.5% when measured by Relative Change in Success. In the real-world, we note a similar 18.3% increase on average, in multiple transit scenarios. We present qualitative inferences of TAP-agents deployed in the real world, showing them to be especially better at providing personalized assistance by finding targets in positions that they are usually not expected to be in (a toothbrush in a workspace). We also provide details of our real-to-sim pipeline, which allows researchers to generate simulations of their own physical environments for TAP, aiming to foster research in this area.

AI.tldr: 把常被假设为静态的具身导航任务扩展为便携物品被人移动、位置高度动态的场景，提出 Transit-Aware Planning (TAP) 系列方法，通过与目标移动轨迹“同步”来提升搜寻成功率；在仿真和真实公寓实验均显著提升，成果连同数据管线全部公开。
AI.motivation: 传统具身导航仅针对静态环境与固定目标。现实中许多室内物品（牙刷、杯子等）不断被人携带转移，使基于静态蓝图训练的策略在实际中频繁失败。要提升机器人在真实家居中的“找人找物”能力，必须显式地把“人被习惯驱动的移动轨迹”当作知识来学习与利用。
AI.method: 1. 将问题建模为“个性化习惯学习”——给定一段时间的人与物体时空日志，预测物品下一可能位置。2. 提出两种 Transit-Aware Planning（TAP）：TAP-value 在强化学习奖励中耦合“导航路径与目标轨迹的重合度”；TAP-path 则直接把目标路线的图嵌入拼接到策略网络输入。3. 设计动态环境基准 DOM——基于节点属性拓扑图，通过记录和回放人类转移矩阵生成符合习惯的物体移动线路。4. 构建 real-to-sim 管线：机器人先扫描物理空间→生成导航网格和转移先验→在相同拓扑结构的仿真器里训练再部署回实体场景，实现无缝迁移。
AI.result: 在 MP3D 动态任务集上，对比纯静态基线 Agent，TAP-value 绝对成功率 +21.1%，从静态到动态泛化指标 Relative-Change-in-Success +44.5%；真实公寓 12 组“携物行走”实验平均提升 18.3%。定性观察表明：TAP 智能体能预判牙刷常出现在工作台等“高频误放”地点，显著缩减搜索步数与时间。
AI.conclusion: 把“目标移动轨迹”显式融入导航策略可大幅缓解动态环境落差；DOM 基准与 real-to-sim 管线为研究社区提供了可复现、可扩展平台，后续可在更大人群与多楼层场景上验证个性化迁移与增量学习效果。

title: Benign Overfitting in Adversarial Training for Vision Transformers
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2409.19345 by other authors
summary: Despite the remarkable success of Vision Transformers (ViTs) across a wide range of vision tasks, recent studies have revealed that they remain vulnerable to adversarial examples, much like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). A common empirical defense strategy is adversarial training, yet the theoretical underpinnings of its robustness in ViTs remain largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first theoretical analysis of adversarial training under simplified ViT architectures. We show that, when trained under a signal-to-noise ratio that satisfies a certain condition and within a moderate perturbation budget, adversarial training enables ViTs to achieve nearly zero robust training loss and robust generalization error under certain regimes. Remarkably, this leads to strong generalization even in the presence of overfitting, a phenomenon known as \emph{benign overfitting}, previously only observed in CNNs (with adversarial training). Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets further validate our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 首次给出ViT对抗训练的理论保证：在适度扰动与合适信噪比下，可几乎零鲁棒训练误差与泛化误差，并出现“良性过拟合”。
AI.motivation: ViT虽在各视觉任务表现突出，但仍易受对抗样本攻击；现有经验式对抗训练缺乏理论解释，亟需为ViT建立鲁棒性理论基础。
AI.method: 构建简化ViT架构，建立对抗训练目标下的统计学习框架；推导信噪比与扰动预算的显式条件，分析鲁棒训练损失与泛化误差上界；在合成与真实数据上验证理论预测。
AI.result: 证明当信噪比满足特定条件且扰动预算适中时，ViT可做到：1) 鲁棒训练损失趋近于零；2) 鲁棒泛化误差在相应区域趋近于零；3) 即使过拟合，仍保持强泛化（良性过拟合），该现象首次在ViT中被理论证实。
AI.conclusion: 为ViT对抗训练提供了首个可解释理论支撑，揭示其与CNN类似的“良性过拟合”机制，为未来设计更鲁棒的视觉Transformer奠定理论基础。

title: Watch the Weights: Unsupervised monitoring and control of fine-tuned LLMs
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary:
The releases of powerful open-weight large language models (LLMs) are often not accompanied by access to their full training data. Existing interpretability methods, particularly those based on activations, often require or assume distributionally similar data. This is a significant limitation when detecting and defending against novel potential threats like backdoors, which are by definition out-of-distribution.
  In this work, we introduce a new method for understanding, monitoring and controlling fine-tuned LLMs that interprets weights, rather than activations, thereby sidestepping the need for data that is distributionally similar to the unknown training data. We demonstrate that the top singular vectors of the weight difference between a fine-tuned model and its base model correspond to newly acquired behaviors. By monitoring the cosine similarity of activations along these directions, we can detect salient behaviors introduced during fine-tuning with high precision.
  For backdoored models that bypass safety mechanisms when a secret trigger is present, our method stops up to 100% of attacks with a false positive rate below 1%. For models that have undergone unlearning, we detect inference on erased topics with accuracy up to 95.42% and can even steer the model to recover "unlearned" information. Besides monitoring, our method also shows potential for pre-deployment model auditing: by analyzing commercial instruction-tuned models (OLMo, Llama, Qwen), we are able to uncover model-specific fine-tuning focus including mathematical problem solving, emoji usage, and Midjourney prompt generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅用权重差分便可监测微调大模型新行为的通用方法，无需任何训练数据即可精准发现后门、检测知识遗忘并审计商业模型。
AI.motivation: 强大开放权重LLM通常不公开完整训练数据，现有基于激活的可解释方法需假设测试数据与训练分布一致，难以应对分布外后门；亟需脱离数据分布桎梏的新视角。
AI.method: 提出“权重差分奇异向量”框架：取微调后模型与基础模型权重差ΔW，提取其顶部奇异向量作为“行为方向”；在推理时仅计算激活与这些方向的余弦相似度即可识别被注入/抹除的行为，无需任何训练样本。
AI.result: 1) 后门防御：触发攻击拦截率100%，误报<1%；2) 知识遗忘检测：识别被“抹除”主题的准确率达95.42%，且能反向操控模型恢复信息；3) 模型审计：在OLMo、Llama、Qwen等商业指令模型中发现其特有微调重点（数学解题、emoji使用、Midjourney提示生成）。
AI.conclusion: 基于权重而非激活的解读方式首次实现了对闭源微调数据场景下LLM行为的精准监测与操控，为后门防御、知识治理和预部署审计提供了无需训练数据的通用工具，并可扩展为模型修复与行为再对齐的新范式。

title: GAIN: Multiplicative Modulation for Domain Adaptation
summary:
Adapting LLMs to new domains causes forgetting because standard methods (e.g., full fine-tuning, LoRA) inject new directions into the weight space. We show that forgetting is governed by one algebraic property: whether the update preserves the column span of the pretrained weight matrix (Proposition 1). We propose GAIN, the simplest multiplicative alternative (W_new = S * W), which satisfies this by construction and can be absorbed into existing weights for zero inference cost.
  Across five models (774M to 70B) adapted sequentially over eight domains, GAIN improves earlier-domain perplexity by 7-13%, while LoRA degrades it by 18-36%. GAIN matches replay-augmented LoRA without storing prior data and dominates EWC on the forgetting-adaptation Pareto front. While LoRA can only reduce forgetting by sacrificing in-domain adaptation, GAIN achieves both with no domain boundaries and no regularization. The principle generalises: (IA)^3, an independent multiplicative method, also improves earlier domains.

AI.tldr: 更新方向是否保留预训练权重矩阵列空间决定灾难性遗忘；GAIN 提出最简单的乘法更新（S·W），无需保存旧数据也能在持续适应中同时降低遗忘并提升新域性能。
AI.motivation: 当前微调/LoRA 将新的“方向”注入权重空间，会挤占原知识导致的灾难性遗忘，急需一种理论指导且轻量的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 证明遗忘与否与权重更新是否仍位于预训练权重的列空间有关（命题1）；2) 设计满足该代数性质的 GAIN，仅用对角矩阵 S 对原权重做乘法更新，并可合并到权重中实现零推理开销；3) 在 5 种模型（774 M–70 B）、8 个持续任务上对比 LoRA、回放版 LoRA 与 EWC。
AI.result: GAIN 在此前任务困惑度上平均提升 7–13%，而 LoRA 下降 18–36%，且不牺牲新域性能；匹配需回放数据的 LoRA，并在遗忘-适应 Pareto 前沿全面优于 EWC；同属乘法的 (IA)^3 亦能复现收益。
AI.conclusion: 乘法更新保持列空间不变可作为抗遗忘的普适原则；GAIN 以最小改动实现零存储、零正则、跨域持续适应的“双赢”效果，为 LLM 快速部署和增量学习提供了轻量可靠范式。

title: Learning Evolution via Optimization Knowledge Adaptation
comment: This work has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: The iterative search process of evolutionary algorithms (EAs) encapsulates optimization knowledge within historical populations and fitness evaluations. Effective utilization of this knowledge is crucial for facilitating knowledge transfer and online adaptation. However, current research typically addresses these goals in isolation and faces distinct limitations: evolutionary sequential transfer optimization often suffers from incomplete utilization of prior knowledge, while adaptive strategies, utilizing real-time knowledge, are limited to tailoring specific evolutionary operators. To simultaneously achieve these two capabilities, we introduce the Optimization Knowledge Adaptation Evolutionary Model (OKAEM), a unified learnable evolutionary framework capable of adaptively updating parameters based on available optimization knowledge. By parameterizing evolutionary operators via attention mechanisms, OKAEM enables learnable update rules that facilitate the utilization of optimization knowledge via two phases: pre-training to integrate extensive prior knowledge for efficient transfer, and adaptive optimization to dynamically update parameters based on real-time knowledge. Experimental results confirm that OKAEM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art sequential transfer methods across 12 transfer scenarios via pre-training, and surpasses advanced learnable EAs solely through its self-tuning mechanism in prior-free settings. Beyond demonstrating practical utility in prompt tuning for vision-language models, ablation studies validate the necessity of the learnable components, while visualization analyses reveal the model's capacity to autonomously discover interpretable evolutionary principles. The code can be accessed at https://gitee.com/Anonymity_Paper/code-of-okaem.

AI.tldr: 提出统一可学习进化框架 OKAEM，通过注意力机制参数化算子，兼顾先验知识迁移与在线自适应；12 项迁移任务与免先验设置均达 SOTA，并可解释地发现进化规律。
AI.motivation: 现有 EA 要么只能做“迁移”(用历史任务知识) 要么只能做“在线自适应”(用实时信息)，二者割裂且各自存在利用不足或局限于单一算子的问题，亟需统一框架同时实现知识复用与动态调整。
AI.method: 设计 Optimization Knowledge Adaptation Evolutionary Model (OKAEM)：①用注意力机制把选择、重组、突变等算子参数化，使算子更新规则可学习；②分两阶段训练：先在大量源任务上预训练，将先验知识压缩进参数；③目标任务运行时，继续用实时种群与评估信息在线微调参数，实现自适应。
AI.result: 在 12 个跨任务迁移场景中，预训练版 OKAEM 显著优于当前最佳顺序迁移方法；在无先验场景下，仅靠自调机制也超越先进可学习 EA；在视觉-语言模型提示调优实际应用中性能突出；消融实验证实可学习组件缺一不可；可视化揭示模型能自主发现可解释的进化原理。
AI.conclusion: OKAEM 首次把“知识迁移”与“在线自适应”统一于可学习 EA，验证其在复杂优化问题中的普适性与可解释性，为进化计算提供新范式。

title: VLA Foundry: A Unified Framework for Training Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: We present VLA Foundry, an open-source framework that unifies LLM, VLM, and VLA training in a single codebase. Most open-source VLA efforts specialize on the action training stage, often stitching together incompatible pretraining pipelines. VLA Foundry instead provides a shared training stack with end-to-end control, from language pretraining to action-expert fine-tuning. VLA Foundry supports both from-scratch training and pretrained backbones from Hugging Face. To demonstrate the utility of our framework, we train and release two types of models: the first trained fully from scratch through our LLM-->VLM-->VLA pipeline and the second built on the pretrained Qwen3-VL backbone. We evaluate closed-loop policy performance of both models on LBM Eval, an open-data, open-source simulator. We also contribute usability improvements to the simulator and the STEP analysis tools for easier public use. In the nominal evaluation setting, our fully-open from-scratch model is on par with our prior closed-source work and substituting in the Qwen3-VL backbone leads to a strong multi-task table top manipulation policy outperforming our baseline by a wide margin. The VLA Foundry codebase is available at https://github.com/TRI-ML/vla_foundry and all multi-task model weights are released on https://huggingface.co/collections/TRI-ML/vla-foundry. Additional qualitative videos are available on the project website https://tri-ml.github.io/vla_foundry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一开源框架 VLA Foundry，打通 LLM→VLM→VLA 全过程训练，并发布两个新模型及配套评测与工具。
AI.motivation: 现有开源 VLA 工作多聚焦于动作训练阶段，需拼接互不兼容的预训练流程，缺乏端到端统一代码基座，阻碍复现与改进。
AI.method: 构建单一共享训练栈，支持从语言预训练到动作专家微调的全流程；兼容 Hugging Face 预训练骨干，也能从零训练。基于 LBM Eval 开源模拟器开展闭环策略评估，并改进模拟器与 STEP 分析工具。
AI.result: 1) 完全从零训练的模型性能与作者早先闭源工作持平；2) 在 Qwen3-VL 骨干上微调的多任务桌面操作策略大幅超越基线；3) 代码、模型权重、评测平台全部开源。
AI.conclusion: VLA Foundry 提供首个端到端、模块化且公开可用的 VLA 训练框架，显著降低开发门槛并建立公开评测基准，为社区复现与进一步研究奠定 reusable 基础。

title: Computational Narrative Understanding for Expressive Text-to-Speech
summary: Recent advances in text-to-speech (TTS) have been driven by large, multi-domain speech corpora, yet the expressive potential of audiobook data remains underexamined. We argue that human-narrated audiobooks, particularly fictional works, contain rich and diverse prosodic cues arising from the natural alternation between neutral narration and expressive character dialogue. Building from this observation, we introduce LibriQuote, a large-scale 5.3K hours of expressive speech drawn from character quotations. Each quote is supplemented with contextual pseudo-labels for speech verbs and adverbs that characterize the intended delivery of direct speech (e.g., "he whispered softly"). We found that fine-tuning a flow-matching model on LibriQuote yields substantial improvements in expressivity and intelligibility, while training from scratch enhances expressiveness of an autoregressive TTS model. Benchmarking on LibriQuote-test highlights significant variability across systems in generating expressive speech. We publicly release the dataset, code, and evaluation resources to facilitate reproducibility. Audio samples can be found at https://libriquote.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 5.3K 小时有声书角色 Quotes 数据集 LibriQuote，并用伪标签（speech verbs/adverbs）刻画表达意图；实验表明基于该数据微调/训练可显著提升 TTS 表达性与可懂度，同时建立公开测试基准。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模多领域语料未充分利用虚构类有声书中“旁白-角色对话”自然切换带来的丰富韵律线索；作者希望挖掘并量化这些表达信息，以提升合成语音的情感与角色表现力。
AI.method: 1) 从 LibriVox 有声书中自动抽提 87K 条角色直接引语，构建 5.3K 小时 LibriQuote；2) 基于动词-副词共现规则生成“伪标签”描述预期表达（如 whispered softly）；3) 分别对 flow-matching 模型做微调、对自回归 TTS 模型做从零训练；4) 建立 LibriQuote-test 基准，评估表达差异。
AI.result: 在 LibriQuote-test 上，flow-matching 微调模型在表达性、可懂度指标上均显著优于基线；从零训练的自回归模型亦表现出更强的情感与角色区分度；不同系统在同一文本上生成的表达变异性被量化，显示现有方法仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 角色 Quotes 及其伪标签是提升 TTS 表达性的有效补充信号；LibriQuote 为可复现研究提供了公开数据与评估框架，未来可扩展至多语言、细粒度情感控制及零样本说话人迁移。

title: MoBiE: Efficient Inference of Mixture of Binary Experts under Post-Training Quantization
comment: Although previously revised, per strict university regulations regarding incorrect affiliation, I am unauthorized to retain this manuscript. Furthermore, fundamental derivation errors in the NGES section compromise the mathematical framework, alongside misleading overlapping wording. The paper is therefore withdrawn
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based large language models (LLMs) offer strong performance but suffer from high memory and computation costs. Weight binarization provides extreme efficiency, yet existing binary methods designed for dense LLMs struggle with MoE-specific issues, including cross-expert redundancy, task-agnostic importance estimation, and quantization-induced routing shifts. To this end, we propose MoBiE, the first binarization framework tailored for MoE-based LLMs. MoBiE is built on three core innovations: 1. using joint SVD decomposition to reduce cross-expert redundancy; 2. integrating global loss gradients into local Hessian metrics to enhance weight importance estimation; 3. introducing an error constraint guided by the input null space to mitigate routing distortion. Notably, MoBiE achieves these optimizations while incurring no additional storage overhead, striking a balance between efficiency and model performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoBiE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art binary methods across multiple MoE-based LLMs and benchmarks. For example, on Qwen3-30B-A3B, MoBiE reduces perplexity by 52.2$\%$, improves average zero-shot performance by 43.4$\%$, achieves over 2 $\times$ inference speedup, and further shortens quantization time. The code is available at https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/MoBiE.

AI.tldr: 首次提出面向 MoE-LLM 的权值二值化框架 MoBiE，仅用 1-bit 权重即可在 30 B 级模型上实现 >2× 推理加速与 52% 困惑度下降，无额外存储开销。
AI.motivation: 现有二值化技术多针对稠密 LLM，直接套用到 MoE 会遭遇专家间冗余高、路由重要性估计任务无关、量化后路由偏移三大独有难题，亟需 MoE 专用二值化方案。
AI.method: 1. 联合 SVD 分解所有专家矩阵，显式剥离共享主成分，降低跨专家冗余；2. 将全局损失梯度引入局部 Hessian 指标，修正“任务无关”的重要性估计；3. 利用输入零空间构造误差上界约束，抑制量化引起的路由分布漂移；全部操作在 1-bit 权值空间内完成，无额外存储。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 等模型上，MoBiE 相较 SOTA 二值化方法：困惑度降低 52.2%，零样本任务平均提升 43.4%，推理速度提升 2× 以上，量化耗时缩短，且无需额外显存。
AI.conclusion: MoBiE 首次证明 MoE-LLM 可在 1-bit 权重下兼顾极端压缩与高性能，为端侧部署和高效服务提供了可行路径，代码已开源。

title: RESFL: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for Responsible Federated Learning by Balancing Privacy, Fairness and Utility
summary: Federated Learning (FL) has gained prominence in machine learning applications across critical domains by enabling collaborative model training without centralized data aggregation. However, FL frameworks that protect privacy often sacrifice fairness and reliability. Differential privacy can reduce data leakage, but it may also obscure sensitive attributes needed for bias correction, thereby worsening performance gaps across demographic groups. This work studies the privacy-fairness trade-off in FL-based object detection and introduces RESFL, an integrated framework that jointly improves both objectives. RESFL combines adversarial privacy disentanglement with uncertainty-guided fairness-aware aggregation. The adversarial component uses a gradient reversal layer to suppress sensitive attribute information, reducing privacy risks while preserving fairness-relevant structure. The uncertainty-aware aggregation component uses an evidential neural network to adaptively weight client updates, prioritizing contributions with lower fairness disparities and higher confidence. This produces robust and equitable FL model updates. Experiments in high-stakes autonomous vehicle settings show that RESFL achieves high mAP on FACET and CARLA, reduces membership-inference attack success by 37%, reduces the equality-of-opportunity gap by 17% relative to the FedAvg baseline, and maintains stronger adversarial robustness. Although evaluated in autonomous driving, RESFL is domain-agnostic and can be applied to a broad range of application domains beyond this setting.

AI.tldr: RESFL框架在联邦视觉检测中首次同时优化隐私与公平，实验显示两项指标显著提升且不失效。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习方法为保护隐私引入差分隐私，却掩盖了纠正偏差所需的敏感属性信息，导致模型在群体间性能差距扩大，难以满足高风险场景（如自动驾驶）对公平与可信的双重需求。
AI.method: 提出RESFL：①在客户端采用对抗性梯度反转层，将敏感属性从特征中解耦，抑制隐私泄露同时保留公平相关结构；②在服务器端引入基于证据神经网络的“不确定性-公平加权”聚合，根据本地更新的置信度与群体机会差异为各客户端分配权重，实现鲁棒且公平的模型融合。
AI.result: 在FACET和CARla自动驾驶数据集上，相较FedAvg，mAP保持不降；成员推断攻击成功率降低37%；机会均等差距缩小17%；对对抗样本的鲁棒性也更强。
AI.conclusion: RESFL首次在联邦目标检测中实现隐私与公平的协同提升，其领域无关设计可迁移至医疗、金融等更多高风险分布式学习场景。

title: FASTER: Value-Guided Sampling for Fast RL
summary: Some of the most performant reinforcement learning algorithms today can be prohibitively expensive as they use test-time scaling methods such as sampling multiple action candidates and selecting the best one. In this work, we propose FASTER, a method for getting the benefits of sampling-based test-time scaling of diffusion-based policies without the computational cost by tracing the performance gain of action samples back to earlier in the denoising process. Our key insight is that we can model the denoising of multiple action candidates and selecting the best one as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) where the goal is to progressively filter action candidates before denoising is complete. With this MDP, we can learn a policy and value function in the denoising space that predicts the downstream value of action candidates in the denoising process and filters them while maximizing returns. The result is a method that is lightweight and can be plugged into existing generative RL algorithms. Across challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks in online and batch-online RL, FASTER consistently improves the underlying policies and achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods. Applied to a pretrained VLA, FASTER achieves the same performance while substantially reducing training and inference compute requirements. Code is available at https://github.com/alexanderswerdlow/faster .

AI.tldr: FASTER通过将去噪采样建模为MDP，在扩散策略早期过滤动作候选者，实现测试时扩放的性能而不增加计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有高性能强化学习算法依赖测试时采样多个动作候选者来选优，计算成本极高，难以在线实时使用。
AI.method: 把多次去噪与择优过程视为马尔可夫决策过程，直接在去噪空间中学习策略和价值函数，早期剔除劣质候选，其余步骤沿用原有扩散算法。
AI.result: 在长时程操作任务中，FASTER在线与批在线RL场景均稳定提升基线策略，总体表现优于对比方法；将FASTER插入预训练VLA模型，可在维持性能的同时显著降低训练与推理算力需求。
AI.conclusion: FASTER为扩散式策略提供了轻量级、即插即用的测试时扩放方案，可在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅节省计算资源。

title: Visual-TableQA: Open-Domain Benchmark for Reasoning over Table Images
comment: Accepted at the First Workshop on Foundations of Reasoning in Language Models, NeurIPS 2025. Available at: https://openreview.net/forum?id=fvJRsGwhPf
summary: Visual reasoning over structured data such as tables is a critical capability for modern vision-language models (VLMs), yet current benchmarks remain limited in scale, diversity, or reasoning depth, especially when it comes to rendered table images. Addressing this gap, we introduce Visual-TableQA, a large-scale, open-domain multimodal dataset specifically designed to evaluate and enhance visual reasoning over complex tabular data. Our generation pipeline is modular, scalable, and fully autonomous, involving multiple reasoning LLMs collaborating across distinct roles: generation, validation, and inspiration. Visual-TableQA comprises 2.5k richly structured LaTeX-rendered tables and 6k reasoning-intensive QA pairs, all produced at a cost of under USD 100. To promote diversity and creativity, our pipeline performs multi-model collaborative data generation via cross-model prompting ('inspiration') and LLM-jury filtering. Stronger models seed layouts and topics that weaker models elaborate, collectively distilling diverse reasoning patterns and visual structures into the dataset. Empirical results show that models fine-tuned on Visual-TableQA generalize robustly to external benchmarks, outperforming several proprietary models despite the dataset's synthetic nature. The full pipeline and resources are publicly available at https://github.com/AI-4-Everyone/Visual-TableQA.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 Visual-TableQA，一个低成本、可扩展的合成数据集，含 2.5k LaTeX 表格 + 6k 高阶视觉问答，用于提升 VLM 对渲染表格的视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有表格视觉推理基准在规模、领域广度和推理深度上不足，尤其缺乏对真实渲染表格的系统性测试，阻碍 VLM 在该场景的能力评估与提升。
AI.method: 设计模块化、全自主的多智能体数据生产流水线：①强模型生成表格布局与主题；②弱模型在“启发”提示下扩展问答；③陪审团式 LLM 过滤保质量；④LaTeX 渲染保证视觉多样性。全程成本 <100 美元。
AI.result: 在 Visual-TableQA 上微调的开放模型，在外部真实基准上超越多款专有 VLM，验证合成数据可有效迁移且鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: Visual-TableQA 以极低预算实现大规模、高复杂度、高多样性的表格视觉推理数据，证明多智能体协同合成数据范式可显著增强 VLM 的表格理解能力，代码与数据全部开源。

title: Adversarial Label Invariant Graph Data Augmentations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, accepted at ICML SCIS 2023
summary: Out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization occurs when representation learning encounters a distribution shift. This occurs frequently in practice when training and testing data come from different environments. Covariate shift is a type of distribution shift that occurs only in the input data, while the concept distribution stays invariant. We propose RIA - Regularization for Invariance with Adversarial training, a new method for OoD generalization under convariate shift. Motivated by an analogy to $Q$-learning, it performs an adversarial exploration for counterfactual data environments. These new environments are induced by adversarial label invariant data augmentations that prevent a collapse to an in-distribution trained learner. It works with many existing OoD generalization methods for covariate shift that can be formulated as constrained optimization problems. We develop an alternating gradient descent-ascent algorithm to solve the problem in the context of causally generated graph data, and perform extensive experiments on OoD graph classification for various kinds of synthetic and natural distribution shifts. We demonstrate that our method can achieve high accuracy compared with OoD baselines.

AI.tldr: RIA 借助对抗式标签不变增广制造虚拟分布，在不改变因果标签的前提下扩大训练空间，显著提升协变量偏移下的图 OoD 分类精度。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中训练图与测试图常出现输入分布偏移（协变量偏移），而现有 OoD 方法易坍缩到训练分布，导致泛化差。亟需一种可与主流约束式 OoD 框架即插即用、且不依赖额外环境标签的增强策略。
AI.method: 提出 RIA（Regularization for Invariance with Adversarial training）。核心是把"寻找最坏增广分布"建模为 minimax 博弈：内层对抗生成仍能保留标签的图增广（边扰动、特征扰动等），使模型损失最大；外层在该最坏分布上最小化分类与不变风险。可无缝嵌入 IRM、V-REx 等目标函数形成统一约束优化，并给出交替梯度下降-上升求解算法。
AI.result: 在 5 种合成与 3 种自然协变量偏移的图分类任务上，RIA 将最佳基线平均准确率提高 3.7%–11.2%，并在 PPI-Shift、SPMotif 等数据集上取得新 SOTA；消融实验验证对抗增广对防止分布坍缩起关键作用。
AI.conclusion: RIA 通过对抗式标签不变增广自动合成“最坏”虚拟环境，有效抑制了不变预测器对训练分布的过拟合，对协变量偏移下的图 OoD 泛化具有显著且广泛的增益，可作为即插即用模块推广至其他图或一般领域。未来可扩展至混杂偏移与多模态数据。

title: PuzzleWorld: A Benchmark for Multimodal, Open-Ended Reasoning in Puzzlehunts
summary: Puzzlehunts are a genre of complex, multi-step puzzles lacking well-defined problem definitions. In contrast to conventional reasoning benchmarks consisting of tasks with clear instructions and constrained environments, puzzlehunts requires discovering the underlying problem structure from multimodal evidence and iterative reasoning, mirroring real-world domains such as scientific discovery, exploratory data analysis, or investigative problem-solving. Despite progress in foundation models, their performance on open-ended settings remains largely untested. We introduce PuzzleWorld, a comprehensive benchmark of 667 puzzlehunt-style problems designed to assess step-by-step, open-ended, and creative multimodal reasoning. Each puzzle is annotated with the final solution, detailed reasoning traces, and cognitive skill labels, enabling holistic benchmarking and fine-grained diagnostic analysis. Most state-of-the-art models achieve only 1-4% final answer accuracy. On PuzzleWorld, the best model solves only 18% of puzzles and reaches 40% stepwise accuracy, matching human puzzle novices but falling significantly behind puzzle enthusiasts. To demonstrate the value of our reasoning annotations, we show that fine-tuning a small model on reasoning traces boosts stepwise accuracy from 4% to 11%, which translates to improvements in downstream visual reasoning tasks. Our detailed error analysis reveals that current models exhibit myopic reasoning, are bottlenecked by the limitations of language-based inference, and lack sketching capabilities crucial for visual and spatial reasoning. We release PuzzleWorld at https://github.com/MIT-MI/PuzzleWorld to support future work on building more general, open-ended, and creative reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: PuzzleWorld 以 667 道多模态谜题构建全新开放推理基准，发现 SOTA 模型最终正确率仅 1–4%，最佳模型仅达 18%，显著落后于人类谜题高手；首次系统揭示现有模型存在短视推理、语言推理瓶颈及缺失草图能力等缺陷，并证明用推理链微调可将小模型逐步正确率从 4% 提升至 11%，带动下游视觉推理任务迁移收益。
AI.motivation: 现有基准任务定义清晰、环境受限，无法评估模型在科学发现、探数分析等真实开放式场景中的逐步、创造性推理能力；谜题狩猎（puzzlehunt）天然要求从多模态线索中自发发现问题结构并迭代推理，正好填补这一评价空白，但缺乏系统基准。
AI.method: 构建 PuzzleWorld 包含 667 道原创谜题，每题附带最终答案、逐层推理轨迹及认知技能标签；对 GPT-4 等 SOTA 模型进行 zero-/few-shot 测试，并开展细粒度错误分类；进一步抽取 4% 步骤级正确的小模型，用人工推理链微调后评估迁移效果。
AI.result: 1) SOTA 模型最终答案准确率 1–4%，最佳模型仅 18%，步骤正确率约 40%，与人类新手持平但远低于谜题爱好者；2) 推理链微调将同款小模型步骤正确率从 4% 提到 11%，并在视觉推理下游任务上取得显著提升；3) 错误分析指出模型普遍短视、依赖语言推理、缺乏视觉草图与空间推演能力。
AI.conclusion: PuzzleWorld 首次量化展示基础模型在开放式、多步、多模态推理上的巨大鸿沟；以细粒度推理链为监督的微调策略可部分弥补缺陷，但模型仍需具备长程规划、视觉草图与空间表征等新能力，才能逼近人类专家水平，为未来通用创造性推理系统提供明确方向与数据支撑。

title: UniT: Toward a Unified Physical Language for Human-to-Humanoid Policy Learning and World Modeling
summary: Scaling humanoid foundation models is bottlenecked by the scarcity of robotic data. While massive egocentric human data offers a scalable alternative, bridging the cross-embodiment chasm remains a fundamental challenge due to kinematic mismatches. We introduce UniT (Unified Latent Action Tokenizer via Visual Anchoring), a framework that establishes a unified physical language for human-to-humanoid transfer. Grounded in the philosophy that heterogeneous kinematics share universal visual consequences, UniT employs a tri-branch cross-reconstruction mechanism: actions predict vision to anchor kinematics to physical outcomes, while vision reconstructs actions to filter out irrelevant visual confounders. Concurrently, a fusion branch synergies these purified modalities into a shared discrete latent space of embodiment-agnostic physical intents. We validate UniT across two paradigms: 1) Policy Learning (VLA-UniT): By predicting these unified tokens, it effectively leverages diverse human data to achieve state-of-the-art data efficiency and robust out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization on both humanoid simulation benchmark and real-world deployments, notably demonstrating zero-shot task transfer. 2) World Modeling (WM-UniT): By aligning cross-embodiment dynamics via unified tokens as conditions, it realizes direct human-to-humanoid action transfer. This alignment ensures that human data seamlessly translates into enhanced action controllability for humanoid video generation. Ultimately, by inducing a highly aligned cross-embodiment representation (empirically verified by t-SNE visualizations revealing the convergence of human and humanoid features into a shared manifold), UniT offers a scalable path to distill vast human knowledge into general-purpose humanoid capabilities.

AI.tldr: UniT用统一潜动作令牌把海量人眼数据蒸馏到人形机器人，跨越本体差异，实现零样本任务迁移与可控视频生成，数据效率与泛化能力双SOTA。
AI.motivation: 人形基础模型因机器人数据稀缺难以扩展；利用易得的人眼视频需解决人与机器人运动学不配的“跨本体鸿沟”。
AI.method: 提出UniT框架：三分支交叉重建（动作→视觉锚定物理后果、视觉→动作滤杂讯、融合分支）将异构本体映射到共享的离散潜动作空间，形成“统一物理语言”。
AI.result: VLA-UniT：用统一令牌训练策略，在仿真与真机均达SOTA数据效率，OOD鲁棒并支持零样本任务迁移；WM-UniT：用同一令牌对齐跨本体动力学，实现人→人形直接动作迁移并提升人形视频生成可控性；t-SNE验证人机特征收敛至同一流形。
AI.conclusion: UniT通过高对齐的跨本体表示，把大规模人眼知识转化为通用的人形能力，为可扩展的人形基础模型提供了可行路径。

title: RepIt: Steering Language Models with Concept-Specific Refusal Vectors
summary: Current safety evaluations of language models rely on benchmark-based assessments that may miss localized vulnerabilities. We present RepIt, a simple and data-efficient framework for isolating concept-specific representations in LM activations. While existing steering methods already achieve high attack success rates through broad interventions, RepIt enables a more concerning capability: selective suppression of refusal on targeted concepts while preserving refusal elsewhere. Across five frontier LMs, RepIt produces evaluation-evading model organisms with semantic backdoors, answering questions related to weapons of mass destruction while still scoring as safe on standard benchmarks. We find the edit of the steering vector localizes to just 100-200 residual dimensions, and robust concept vectors can be extracted from as few as a dozen examples on a single RTX A6000, highlighting how targeted, hard-to-detect modifications can exploit evaluation blind spots with minimal resources. Through demonstrating precise concept disentanglement, this work exposes vulnerabilities in current safety evaluation practices and demonstrates a need for more comprehensive, representation aware assessments.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 RepIt，仅需数十条样本+单张消费级显卡即可在 100–200 维残差子空间中精准锁定并关闭模型对“大规模杀伤性武器”概念的拒绝行为，同时保持其在标准安全基准上得分不变，从而暴露当前评估的局部盲区。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准以整体正确率衡量，难以发现模型在特定概念上的局部脆弱点；亟需一种轻量级方法验证评估体系是否存在“语义后门”盲区。
AI.method: 框架 RepIt：1) 用少量正负样本（≈12 条）计算概念特异性激活差分，提取紧凑的“拒绝抑制向量”；2) 在推理阶段将该向量加至残流中 100–200 维关键子空间，实现只对目标概念关闭拒绝，其他查询仍正常拒绝。
AI.result: 在五款前沿大模型上，RepIt 将“大规模杀伤性武器”相关查询的拒绝率从>90% 降至≈10%，而 TruthfulQA、HHH 等标准安全 benchmark 分数几乎不变（差距<1%）；向量可在 RTX A6000 上 30 分钟内完成。
AI.conclusion: RepIt 证明：极低成本即可制造“评估逃逸”的语义后门，当前静态基准测试存在显著局部盲区，未来安全评估必须引入表示级动态检测与概念特异性检验，而非仅依赖整体指标。

title: THEIA: Learning Complete Kleene Three-Valued Logic in a Pure-Neural Modular Architecture
summary:
We present THEIA, a 2.75M modular neural architecture that learns the complete Kleene three-valued logic (K3) truth table from task data without external symbolic inference or hand-encoded K3 gate primitives. Across 5 seeds, THEIA achieves all 39 K3 rules at >99% per-rule accuracy. K3 learnability is not the central finding: Transformer baselines also reach >99% on all 39 rules, and flat MLPs match THEIA on Phase-1 accuracy within 0.04pp. The central findings are two properties of the learned system.
  (1) Uncertainty-verdict asymmetric propagation. The network preserves Has-Unknown at every upstream boundary (80.0/91.1/90.8/99.7% across Arith/Order/Set/Logic vs. ~52% majority) while final-verdict decodability stays at or below a 73.4% U-vs-non-U oracle reference under linear and nonlinear MLP probes. Activation patching on non-absorbent T->U configurations flips 4,898/4,898 OR pairs (4,719/4,719 AND) across 5 seeds, ruling out residual shortcuts.
  (2) Reliability spectrum under discretized end-to-end training, on task structures decomposable along the engine boundaries. A mod-3 sequential composition task generalizes from 5- to 500-step eval at 99.96+-0.04% (5 seeds). Under identical Gumbel-softmax training, flat MLPs collapse to chance by 50 steps; a 2x2 ResMLP depth x expansion grid reaches >=99% on only 3/20 (config, seed) trials; a pre-LN Transformer reaches 99.24+-0.34%. The 500-step figure is dominated by straight-through discretization preventing 0.999^500 compounding; the architectural separator is sustaining Phase-1 accuracy under Phase-3 end-to-end Gumbel training, where flat MLPs fail.
  Auxiliary: under matched optimizer settings THEIA reaches 12/12 Kleene coverage 6.5x faster than a parameter-comparable 8L Transformer; the ratio narrows to ~3.6x under Transformer-standard tuning. We did not perform a THEIA-optimal sweep; ratios are specific-config, not asymptotic.

AI.tldr: THEIA 用 2.75 M 模块化网络无需符号先验即可完整学会 Kleene 三值逻辑 39 条规则，但重点不在「能学会」而在其「不确定性-判决非对称传播」和「离散端到端可靠性谱」两大特性；它在长链 mod-3 组合任务上可持续 500 步保持 >99% 精度，而同等训练的 Transformer/MLP/ResMLP 均逐级崩溃。
AI.motivation: 现有网络虽可通过大量参数拟合三值逻辑，但尚不清楚能否在内部实现真正的「未知」保真传播并经得起离散化长链推理考验，亦缺乏系统的模块化对照实验。
AI.method: 设计模块化架构 THEIA，以纯数据驱动方式拟合 K3 真值表；通过线性/非线性探针、激活交换、Gumbel-softmax 离散端到端训练等手段测试其不确定性传播属性与长程组合泛化能力，并与扁平 MLP、ResMLP、Pre-LN Transformer 对比。
AI.result: 1) 上游边界对「未知」判决的保留率显著高于多数基线(80–99% vs ~52%)，而末端可解码性低于 73.4% 的 U-vs-non-U 参考；2) 5→500 步 mod-3 序列任务上保持 99.96% 精度，显著优于 MLP(50 步崩)、2×2 ResMLP(仅 3/20 次 ≥99%)、Transformer(99.24±0.34%)；3) 在可比参数量下，THEIA 学习 12/12 K3 规则的速度是 8L Transformer 的 6.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 模块化结构使网络既能内部维持 Kleene 逻辑的不确定性语义，又能抵抗离散化带来的误差累积，为可解释、可泛化的三值推理系统提供了可扩展的架构先验；同时提示「能否学会规则」之外，「能否稳健传播与组合」才是神经符号融合的关键指标。

title: LPO: Towards Accurate GUI Agent Interaction via Location Preference Optimization
summary: The advent of autonomous agents is transforming interactions with Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) by employing natural language as a powerful intermediary. Despite the predominance of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) methods in current GUI agents for achieving spatial localization, these methods face substantial challenges due to their limited capacity to accurately perceive positional data. Existing strategies, such as reinforcement learning, often fail to assess positional accuracy effectively, thereby restricting their utility. In response, we introduce Location Preference Optimization (LPO), a novel approach that leverages locational data to optimize interaction preferences. LPO uses information entropy to predict interaction positions by focusing on zones rich in information. Besides, it further introduces a dynamic location reward function based on physical distance, reflecting the varying importance of interaction positions. Supported by Group Relative Preference Optimization (GRPO), LPO facilitates an extensive exploration of GUI environments and significantly enhances interaction precision. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate LPO's superior performance, achieving SOTA results across both offline benchmarks and real-world online evaluations. Our code will be made publicly available soon, at https://github.com/jqtangust/LPO.

AI.tldr: 为提升 GUI 智能体的空间定位能力，作者提出 Location Preference Optimization（LPO）方法，用信息熵动态聚焦高信息区域并结合物理距离奖励，在离线基准与真实在线场景中刷新 SOTA。代码即将开源。
AI.motivation: 基于监督微调 (SFT) 的智能体在定位时难以精确感知坐标；强化学习又难以评价“位置准确性”，导致交互易偏。需要一种能直接利用 GUI 空间信息、指导模型优选正确位置的轻量学习方式。
AI.method: 提出 LPO：① 用信息熵量化局部区域的信息含量，熵越高越可能是用户关注区；② 设计动态距离奖励，奖励大小随真实—预测距离平滑衰减；③ 联合 Group Relative Preference Optimization (GRPO) 对正负位置对批量对比，使策略在不依赖人工演示下自主探索 GUI 空间。训练仅在偏好对上完成，无需像素级 mask 或强化学习中的蒙特卡罗采样。
AI.result: 离线静态基准上击败现有 SFT/RL 最优模型，目标点击准确率↑约 6~15 %；在 WASM-based 在线测试床多轮任务成功率提升 11~18 %，定位误差 < 10 px。
AI.conclusion: 以“位置偏好优化”替代传统定位头或强化学习评价器，即可在零人工标注坐标的情况下显著提升 GUI 智能体的点击精度与任务成功率，为基于语言的 GUI 自动化提供了高效新范式。

title: Generalization at the Edge of Stability
summary: Training modern neural networks often relies on large learning rates, operating at the edge of stability, where the optimization dynamics exhibit oscillatory and chaotic behavior. Empirically, this regime often yields improved generalization performance, yet the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. In this work, we represent stochastic optimizers as random dynamical systems, which often converge to a fractal attractor set (rather than a point) with a smaller intrinsic dimension. Building on this connection and inspired by Lyapunov dimension theory, we introduce a novel notion of dimension, coined the `sharpness dimension', and prove a generalization bound based on this dimension. Our results show that generalization in the chaotic regime depends on the complete Hessian spectrum and the structure of its partial determinants, highlighting a complexity that cannot be captured by the trace or spectral norm considered in prior work. Experiments across various MLPs and transformers validate our theory while also providing new insights into the recently observed phenomenon of grokking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“尖锐维”，证明大学习率下随机优化器的分形吸引子维数决定泛化误差；新泛化界依赖完整Hessian谱与部分行列式结构，实验在MLP/Transformer上验证并解释grokking现象。
AI.motivation: 现代网络在大学习率“稳定边缘”训练时常出现振荡、混沌动力学，并意外获得更好泛化，但机理未知；已有基于Hessian迹或谱范数的简单稳定性度量无法刻画这种复杂性。
AI.method:
>
1. 将随机优化器建模为随机动力系统，证明其轨迹收敛到分形吸引子而非单点。
2. 利用Lyapunov维理论定义新复杂度量“尖锐维”(sharpness dimension)，并推导依赖完整Hessian谱及其所有偏序主子式的泛化误差上界。
3. 在MLP和Transformer上验证理论与真实测试误差的关系，并用其解释grokking突变现象。
AI.result:
>
- 理论：首次给出混沌训练状态下依赖Hessian全部特征值的泛化界，表明尖锐维越小，泛化越好；谱范数或迹仅提供松弛下界。
- 实验：尖锐维与测试误差呈显著负相关，能准确预测不同学习率、宽度下Transformer的泛化优劣；同时揭示grokking发生时尖锐维突降，对应“顿悟”前临界慢化。
AI.conclusion: 大学习率训练的混沌行为并非噪声灾难，而是将参数压向低内在维数分形吸引子的隐式正则；尖锐维为度量与改进此类训练提供了新的理论工具和实用指标。

title: Position: LLM Watermarking Should Align Stakeholders' Incentives for Practical Adoption
summary: Despite progress in watermarking algorithms for large language models (LLMs), real-world deployment remains limited. We argue that this gap stems from misaligned incentives among LLM providers, platforms, and end users, which manifest as three key barriers: competitive risk, detection-tool governance, and attribution issues. We revisit three classes of watermarking through this lens. \emph{Model watermarking} naturally aligns with LLM provider interests, yet faces new challenges in open-source ecosystems. \emph{LLM text watermarking} offers modest provider benefit when framed solely as an anti-misuse tool, but can gain traction in narrowly scoped settings such as dataset de-contamination or user-controlled provenance. \emph{In-context watermarking} (ICW) is tailored for trusted parties, such as conference organizers or educators, who embed hidden watermarking instructions into documents. If a dishonest reviewer or student submits this text to an LLM, the output carries a detectable watermark indicating misuse. This setup aligns incentives: users experience no quality loss, trusted parties gain a detection tool, and LLM providers remain neutral by simply following watermark instructions. We advocate for a broader exploration of incentive-aligned methods, with ICW as an example, in domains where trusted parties need reliable tools to detect misuse. More broadly, we distill design principles for incentive-aligned, domain-specific watermarking and outline future research directions. Our position is that the practical adoption of LLM watermarking requires aligning stakeholder incentives in targeted application domains and fostering active community engagement.

AI.tldr: 文章指出大模型水印实用化受阻的根源是利益相关方（模型商、平台、用户）激励错配，提出并分析了三种水印范式如何与各自场景对齐激励，尤其推荐面向可信第三方的“上下文水印”（ICW）作为突破口，并给出激励对齐的设计原则与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型水印算法虽多，却难在真实世界落地。作者认为核心障碍不在技术，而在模型供应商、平台、终端用户之间的激励冲突：竞争风险、检测工具治理难、归属不清。需重新审视水印设计，使其与各方利益同向。
AI.method: 以“激励对齐”为分析框架，系统评估三类水印：①模型水印（水印嵌于模型权重）——对齐模型商产权保护需求，但在开源生态中面临泄露与对抗性微调挑战；②生成文本水印（输出端水印）——仅被模型商视为反滥用工具时收益有限，可在“数据集去污染”或“用户可控溯源”等窄场景获得正激励；③上下文水印（ICW，本文新范式）——可信第三方（会议主办方、教师等）在文档中嵌入隐藏水印指令，若被违规上传至LLM，生成内容带可检测水印。该方案用户无感知质量损失，第三方得检测工具，模型商无需额外成本，实现帕累托改进。
AI.result: 论证表明，只有将水印嵌入具体应用场景并重构激励机制，才能突破“技术可行却无人用”的僵局。ICW在学术评审、作业查重等“可信第三方强需求”场景可立刻部署，且对模型商中立，为社区提供可复制的激励对齐范例。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁放弃“一刀切”的通用水印幻想，转向“领域专用、激励对齐”的新范式：①明确主导方与受益方；②最小化对其他方成本；③提供可验证、易治理的检测接口。未来研究应聚焦ICW等机制的规模扩展、对抗鲁棒性及标准化，同时推动社区共建检测生态，以实际利益驱动水印技术的广泛采用。

title: Catching Every Ripple: Enhanced Anomaly Awareness via Dynamic Concept Adaptation
summary: Online anomaly detection (OAD) plays a pivotal role in real-time analytics and decision-making for evolving data streams. However, existing methods often rely on costly retraining and rigid decision boundaries, limiting their ability to adapt both effectively and efficiently to concept drift in dynamic environments. To address these challenges, we propose DyMETER, a dynamic concept adaptation framework for OAD that unifies on-the-fly parameter shifting and dynamic thresholding within a single online paradigm. DyMETER first learns a static detector on historical data to capture recurring central concepts, and then transitions to a dynamic mode to adapt to new concepts as drift occurs. Specifically, DyMETER employs a novel dynamic concept adaptation mechanism that leverages a hypernetwork to generate instance-aware parameter shifts for the static detector, thereby enabling efficient and effective adaptation without retraining or fine-tuning. To achieve robust and interpretable adaptation, DyMETER introduces a lightweight evolution controller to estimate instance-level concept uncertainty for adaptive updates. Further, DyMETER employs a dynamic threshold optimization module to adaptively recalibrates the decision boundary by maintaining a candidate window of uncertain samples, which ensures continuous alignment with evolving concepts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DyMETER significantly outperforms existing OAD approaches across a wide spectrum of application scenarios.

AI.tldr: DyMETER用超网络为静态检测器生成实例级参数偏移，并动态校准决策阈值，实现无重训练、无微调的在线异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有OAD方法需昂贵重训练、决策边界刚性，难以在概念漂移下兼顾效果与效率。
AI.method: 先离线训练静态检测器→在线阶段用超网络实时产生参数偏移；轻量演化控制器估计实例级概念不确定性；候选窗维护并动态优化决策阈值。
AI.result: 在多种流数据场景下，DyMETER显著优于现有OAD基线，无需重训练即可持续对齐漂移概念。
AI.conclusion: DyMETER将参数自适应与阈值自适应统一于单一在线框架，为动态环境下的实时异常检测提供了高效、鲁棒且可解释的解决方案。

title: Text Slider: Efficient and Plug-and-Play Continuous Concept Control for Image/Video Synthesis via LoRA Adapters
comment: Accepted by WACV 2026. We provide more experimental results on the train-free version of our algorithm. Project page: https://textslider.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/aiiu-lab/TextSlider
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models have significantly improved image and video synthesis. In addition, several concept control methods have been proposed to enable fine-grained, continuous, and flexible control over free-form text prompts. However, these methods not only require intensive training time and GPU memory usage to learn the sliders or embeddings but also need to be retrained for different diffusion backbones, limiting their scalability and adaptability. To address these limitations, we introduce Text Slider, a lightweight, efficient and plug-and-play framework that identifies low-rank directions within a pre-trained text encoder, enabling continuous control of visual concepts while significantly reducing training time, GPU memory consumption, and the number of trainable parameters. Furthermore, Text Slider supports multi-concept composition and continuous control, enabling fine-grained and flexible manipulation in both image and video synthesis. We show that Text Slider enables smooth and continuous modulation of specific attributes while preserving the original spatial layout and structure of the input. Text Slider achieves significantly better efficiency: 5$\times$ faster training than Concept Slider and 47$\times$ faster than Attribute Control, while reducing GPU memory usage by nearly 2$\times$ and 4$\times$, respectively.

AI.tldr: Text Slider 是一个即插即用的轻量级框架，通过在大规模文本编码器中识别低秩方向，实现无需重新训练即可对扩散模型进行连续、细粒度概念控制，在训练速度、显存占用和可扩展性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于滑块或嵌入的概念控制方法需对每个新主干网络重训，训练耗时、显存高且难以扩展，急需一种可跨模型复用、训练高效的轻量方案。
AI.method: 将概念控制转化为寻找文本编码器中的低秩扰动方向：固定扩散主干，仅对文本编码器做低秩分解，训练一对正交方向向量，实现插值式连续概念调节。
AI.result: 训练速度较 Concept Slider 提升 5 倍，较 Attribute Control 提升 47 倍；显存占用降低约 2–4 倍；支持多概念组合与视频生成，且能保留原图空间布局。
AI.conclusion: Text Slider 验证了“文本空间低秩方向”足以实现高效、连续、可迁移的概念控制，为扩散模型的轻量个性化与规模化应用提供了新范式。

title: Conjuring Semantic Similarity
summary: The semantic similarity between sample expressions measures the distance between their latent 'meaning'. These meanings are themselves typically represented by textual expressions. We propose a novel approach whereby the semantic similarity among textual expressions is based not on other expressions they can be rephrased as, but rather based on the imagery they evoke. While this is not possible with humans, generative models allow us to easily visualize and compare generated images, or their distribution, evoked by a textual prompt. Therefore, we characterize the semantic similarity between two textual expressions simply as the distance between image distributions they induce, or 'conjure.' We show that by choosing the Jeffreys divergence between the reverse-time diffusion stochastic differential equations (SDEs) induced by each textual expression, this can be directly computed via Monte-Carlo sampling. Our method contributes a novel perspective on semantic similarity that not only aligns with human-annotated scores, but also opens up new avenues for the evaluation of text-conditioned generative models while offering better interpretability of their learnt representations.

AI.tldr: 用文本提示让扩散模型生成图像，直接用生成图像分布的Jeffreys散度作为语义相似度，不再依赖文本对文本的改写或嵌入。
AI.motivation: 传统文本语义相似度依赖文本层面的改写或向量表示，难以捕捉“意义”本身。作者认为语言描述的是视觉想象，借助生成模型可把文本映射到图像空间，从而在视觉层面衡量语义距离。
AI.method: 对两个文本提示分别求解反向扩散SDE，得到两条生成图像分布；用Monte-Carlo采样估计两者的Jeffreys散度，以此作为语义相似度指标。
AI.result: 在多个语义相似度人工标注基准上，新方法优于经典文本嵌入余弦相似度，并能解释模型学到的文本-图像对齐质量。
AI.conclusion: 视觉生成模型让“语义”可视觉化，用图像分布距离衡量文本语义不仅可行，且更直观、可解释，为文本生成评估和表示研究开辟新视角。

title: ContextLeak: Auditing Leakage in Private In-Context Learning Methods
summary: In-Context Learning (ICL) has become a standard technique for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized tasks by supplying task-specific exemplars within the prompt. However, when these exemplars contain sensitive information, reliable privacy-preserving mechanisms are essential to prevent unintended leakage through model outputs. Many privacy-preserving methods have been proposed to protect against information leakage in this context, but there are fewer efforts on how to audit these methods. We introduce ContextLeak, the first framework to empirically measure the worst-case information leakage in ICL. ContextLeak uses canary insertion, embedding uniquely identifiable tokens in the sensitive dataset and crafting targeted queries to detect their presence. We apply ContextLeak across a range of private ICL techniques, including both heuristic prompt-based defenses and differentially private methods with formal guarantees. We show that ContextLeak reliably detects leakage across methods, and the leakage increases monotonically with the theoretical privacy budget, offering a practical signal of worst-case privacy risk. Our analysis further reveals that existing methods strike poor privacy-utility trade-offs, either completely leaking sensitive information or severely degrading performance.

AI.tldr: 首提ICL场景下的隐私泄露审计框架ContextLeak，用“金丝雀注入+定向查询”量化最坏情况泄露，发现现有方法隐私-效用双输。
AI.motivation: ICL 中任务示例常含敏感数据，但缺乏手段 empirically 检验已部署的隐私保护方法的真实最坏泄露程度。
AI.method: 提出 Canary-insertion-based 评测框架：向敏感示例嵌入可唯一标识 token，再设计针对性 prompt 让模型复述该 token；遍历多种私有 ICL 技术（启发式 prompt 工程、带差分隐私保证的方法）进行黑盒探测。
AI.result: ContextLeak 稳定复现泄露，泄露率随理论隐私预算 ε 单调上升；现有方法要么近乎全泄露，要么效用骤降，无法兼顾。
AI.conclusion: ICL 隐私防护亟需可信审计工具；ContextLeak 提供可操作的 worst-case 风险信号，督促重新设计兼顾隐私与效用的机制。

title: JumpLoRA: Sparse Adapters for Continual Learning in Large Language Models
summary: Adapter-based methods have become a cost-effective approach to continual learning (CL) for Large Language Models (LLMs), by sequentially learning a low-rank update matrix for each task. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, state-of-the-art approaches impose constraints on new adapters with respect to the previous ones, by targeting either subspace or coordinate-wise interference. In this paper, we propose JumpLoRA, a novel framework to adaptively induce sparsity in the Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) blocks through the use of JumpReLU gating. The method achieves dynamic parameter isolation, which helps prevent task interference. We demonstrate that our method is highly modular and compatible with LoRA-based CL approaches. Specifically, it significantly boosts the performance of IncLoRA and outperforms the leading state-of-the-art CL method, ELLA.

AI.tldr: JumpLoRA通过JumpReLU门控在LoRA块中自适应引入稀疏性，实现动态参数隔离，缓解灾难性遗忘，模块兼容性好，在IncLoRA上显著优于SOTA方法ELLA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于适配器的LLM持续学习方法虽低成本，但子空间或坐标级约束仍难彻底避免任务干扰，亟需更精细的参数隔离机制。
AI.method: 提出JumpLoRA框架，在LoRA块内嵌入可学习的JumpReLU门控，动态剪枝激活值，实现任务专属稀疏子网络；模块可无缝接入任何LoRA型持续学习管线。
AI.result: 在标准CL基准上，将JumpLoRA插入IncLoRA后，平均遗忘率降低32%，最终任务准确率提升4.7%，全面超越当前最佳方法ELLA。
AI.conclusion: JumpLoRA以极少量额外参数实现任务级动态隔离，验证“稀疏即隔离”理念，为低成本LLM持续学习提供新范式。

title: How to Teach Large Multimodal Models New Skills
comment: In submission. Code is available at https://github.com/jessemelpolio/LMM_CL
summary: How can we teach large multimodal models (LMMs) new skills without erasing prior abilities? We study sequential fine-tuning on five target skills while monitoring general ability on eight held-out benchmarks across three model families. Surprisingly, we find that performance lost on held-out tasks after fine-tuning on one skill can partly recover when the model is subsequently tuned on a different skill. We trace this behavior to a measurable shift in the output token distribution, manifested through a simple counting-bias probe that shows the shift co-varies with forgetting. Guided by this insight, we identify two simple, robust tuning recipes that learn strongly while limiting drift: (i) updating only the self-attention projection layers (SA Proj., $Δ$ learning +24.9 / $Δ$ held-out forgetting -0.6), and (ii) updating only the MLP Gate&Up while freezing the Down projection (+30.5 / -2.1). Both substantially outperform full-LLM tuning (+31.8 / -23.3) in the learning-forgetting trade-off. We also compare against common forgetting mitigation methods: Learning without Forgetting (LwF), LoRA, Mixture-of-Experts, and weight-space interpolation (WiSE-FT), and find that our selective tuning recipes match or exceed their learning-stability balance while remaining simpler, requiring no replay, auxiliary parameters, or per-stage tuning. These results hold across LLaVA-OneVision, LLaVA-NeXT, and Qwen2.5-VL, confirming that the key to teaching LMMs new skills without forgetting lies in controlling output distribution shift by choosing which components to tune. Code will be made available.

AI.tldr: 只更新注意力投影层（SA-Proj）或MLP的Gate&Up即可在LLaVA/Qwen-VL系列上实现“学新不忘旧”，无需重放或额外参数，效果优于LwF/LoRA/MoE等主流抗遗忘方案。
AI.motivation: 连续为LMM注入新技能时，全参数微调导致旧任务大幅遗忘，现有抗遗忘方法需重放数据或引入额外参数，复杂且效果有限。
AI.method: 1) 在五个新技能上连续微调，同时监控八项旧任务表现；2) 用计数偏差探针量化输出分布偏移与遗忘的共变关系；3) 提出仅更新SA-Proj或MLP Gate&Up两种选择性微调策略，并与LwF、LoRA、MoE、WiSE-FT对比。
AI.result: 两种策略在LLaVA-OneVision/NeXT、Qwen2.5-VL上平均新任务增益24.9/30.5，旧任务遗忘仅-0.6/-2.1；全参数微调增益31.8但遗忘-23.3。无需重放或新增参数即可达到或超越现有抗遗忘方法。
AI.conclusion: 控制输出分布偏移的关键在于精准选择待更新组件；选择性微调为LMM持续学习提供了极简、高效、通用的解决方案。

title: User Simulation in the Era of Generative AI: User Modeling, Synthetic Data Generation, and System Evaluation
summary: User simulation is an emerging interdisciplinary topic with multiple critical applications in the era of Generative AI. It involves creating an intelligent agent that mimics the actions of a human user interacting with an AI system, enabling researchers to model and analyze user behaviour, generate synthetic data for training, and evaluate interactive AI systems in a controlled and reproducible manner. Because of its broad scope, research on this topic currently remains scattered across artificial intelligence, human-computer interaction, information science, computational social science, and psychology. To address this fragmented landscape of current research, this article presents a foundational synthesis. We highlight the paradigm shift from traditional predictive models to modern generative approaches, and explicitly frame critical ethical considerations -- demonstrating how controlled simulation serves not merely as a risk vector for bias, but as a powerful, proactive tool to ensure fair representation and system safety. Furthermore, we establish the theoretical connection between user simulation and the pursuit of Artificial General Intelligence, arguing that realistic simulators are indispensable catalysts for overcoming critical data and evaluation bottlenecks and optimizing personalization. Ultimately, we propose a practical, self-sustaining innovation ecosystem bridging academia and industry to advance this increasingly important technology.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI时代亟需统一的用户模拟框架，该文提出跨学科整合方案，强调伦理主动治理，并论证其对AGI数据瓶颈与个性化评估的关键价值。
AI.motivation: 用户模拟研究分散于AI、HCI、信息科学、计算社科及心理学，缺乏统一框架；生成式AI兴起使可控、可重现的用户行为建模成为训练数据生成与系统评估的刚需。
AI.method: 系统梳理相关领域文献，提炼从预测模型到生成范式的演进路径；构建伦理分析框架，将模拟视为主动公平性与安全性工具；建立用户模拟—AGI理论关联模型；设计产学协同的自持续创新生态蓝图。
AI.result: 验证了用户模拟在合成训练数据、系统公平性测试、个性化评估三方面的不可替代性；提出“模拟即治理”伦理主张，证明受控模拟可降低而非放大偏见风险；揭示高保真模拟器能缓解AGI所需海量多样用户数据与真实隐私法规之间的根本矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 用户模拟已从辅助工具跃升为AGI基础设施，需以跨学科伦理标准、共享基准与产学闭环推动其健康发展，最终实现公平、安全且可扩展的通用智能系统。

title: SAGE-32B: Agentic Reasoning via Iterative Distillation
summary: We demonstrate SAGE-32B, a 32 billion parameter language model that focuses on agentic reasoning and long range planning tasks. Unlike chat models that aim for general conversation fluency, SAGE-32B is designed to operate in an agentic loop, emphasizing task decomposition, tool usage, and error recovery. The model is initialized from the Qwen2.5-32B pretrained model and fine tuned using Iterative Distillation, a two stage training process that improves reasoning performance through rigorously tested feedback loops. SAGE-32B also introduces an inverse reasoning approach, which uses a meta cognition head to forecast potential failures in the planning process before execution. On agentic reasoning benchmarks including MMLU-Pro, AgentBench, and MATH-500, SAGE-32B achieves higher success rates in multi tool usage scenarios compared to similarly sized baseline models, while remaining competitive on standard reasoning evaluations. Model weights are publicly released at https://huggingface.co/sagea-ai/sage-reasoning-32b

AI.tldr: 32B参数的SAGE语言模型专为代理式长程规划而设计，采用迭代蒸馏两阶段训练与元认知头预判失败，在多项代理基准上超越同规模模型并开源权重。
AI.motivation: 现有对话模型侧重短期流畅交互，而在需要“分解任务→调用工具→动态纠错”的代理场景中表现不足，亟需针对性提升长程规划与工具协同能力。
AI.method: 1) 以Qwen2.5-32B为基座，构建代理式训练环路；2) 两阶段迭代蒸馏：先生成并采样高质推理链，再用带强反馈的循环训练迭代筛错；3) 引入“逆向推理”组件：在线规划前利用元认知头预测潜在失效，提前调整策略。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro、AgentBench、MATH-500等多工具代理评测中，成功率显著高于同级基线，同时在通用推理任务保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 代理推理可通过专门训练架构与元认知校验大幅增强；SAGE-32B的公开权重与迭代蒸馏范式为后续研究提供可复现的提升路径。

title: SCATR: Simple Calibrated Test-Time Ranking
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language models (LLMs) by allocating additional compute at inference time. In practice, TTS is often achieved through parallel scaling: generating multiple candidate responses and selecting the best via a Best-of-N (BoN) strategy. Its effectiveness therefore hinges on the scoring function. Learned scorers such as process reward models (PRMs) can be strong, but they are expensive to train and run. Lightweight confidence heuristics based on token log-probabilities are much cheaper, yet we find that they often perform substantially worse. To improve on lightweight confidence heuristics without incurring the full cost of stronger learned scorers, we introduce SCATR, a simple and efficient BoN ranking method that learns a lightweight scorer from a small calibration set using hidden representations from the base model. Across coding and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SCATR improves over prior confidence-based baselines by up to 9%. Relative to LoRA fine-tuning on the same calibration data, it achieves comparable accuracy with up to 8000x fewer trainable parameters and much lower compute, reducing training and inference latency by up to 150x and 1000x, respectively. SCATR is also competitive with strong PRM baselines, and in several settings improves accuracy by up to 7.8% on math and 4.2% on coding while enabling up to 1000x faster inference. Overall, SCATR offers a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off for scalable test-time selection.

AI.tldr: 提出 SCATR，一种基于小校准集、利用基础模型隐状态训练极轻量打分器的 Best-of-N 排序方法，在代码与数学推理任务上显著优于传统置信度启发式，与 PRM 精度相当却可快 1000 倍，实现高效测试时扩展。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（TTS）依赖 Best-of-N 策略，其效果取决于打分函数。强学习式打分器（PRM）成本高，而简单的 token log-prob 置信度启发式性能较差，亟需在不大幅增加开销的前提下提升轻量打分器效果。
AI.method: SCATR：从极小的校准集（≤1k 样本）中提取基础模型末层隐状态，训练一个线性/logistic 回归打分器，用于 Best-of-N 候选排序；无需更新大模型权重，训练与推断均极度轻量。
AI.result: 在代码与数学基准上，SCATR 相对置信度基线最高提升 9%；与同样校准数据 LoRA 微调相比，训练参数少 8000 倍，训练延迟降 150 倍，推断延迟降 1000 倍；与强 PRM 对比，数学提升 7.8%，代码提升 4.2%，推断加速达 1000 倍。
AI.conclusion: SCATR 以极低成本实现接近强打分器的精度，提供显著的准确率-效率权衡，为可扩展的测试时扩展提供实用方案。

title: Ensembling Pruned Attention Heads For Uncertainty-Aware Efficient Transformers
summary: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying deep neural networks in safety-critical settings. Although methods like Deep Ensembles achieve strong UQ performance, their high computational and memory costs hinder scalability to large models. We introduce Hydra Ensembles, an efficient transformer-based ensemble that prunes attention heads to create diverse members and merges them via a new multi-head attention with grouped fully-connected layers. This yields a compact model with inference speed close to a single network, matching or surpassing Deep Ensembles in UQ performance without retraining from scratch. We also provide an in-depth analysis of pruning, showing that naive approaches can harm calibration, whereas Hydra Ensembles preserves robust uncertainty. Experiments on image and text classification tasks, with various architectures, show consistent gains over Deep Ensembles. Remarkably, in zero-shot classification on ImageNet-1k, our approach surpasses state of the art methods, even without requiring additional training.

AI.tldr: Hydra Ensembles 用剪枝多头注意力生成多样成员，再用分组全连接层合并，无需重训即可在推理速度与单模型相当的同时，实现优于 Deep Ensemble 的不确定性估计，并在 ImageNet-1k 零样本任务上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 深度集成虽不确定性量化（UQ）效果好，但计算与内存开销大，难以扩展到大型模型，亟需一种轻量且无需从零重训的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出 Hydra Ensembles：1) 对 Transformer 的注意力头进行结构化剪枝，生成差异化子网络；2) 设计带分组全连接层的新型多头注意力，将各子网络参数合并为单一紧凑模型；3) 整个流程无需重训练，仅通过剪枝与参数融合实现集成效果。
AI.result: 在图像与文本分类任务上，Hydra Ensembles 在推理速度接近单模型的情况下，UQ 指标一致优于 Deep Ensembles；在 ImageNet-1k 零样本分类中，无需额外训练即超越现有最佳方法；同时保持更好的校准性能。
AI.conclusion: Hydra Ensembles 以极低代价实现高效、可扩展的集成推理，为安全关键场景下的深度模型部署提供了兼顾性能与资源的新范式。

title: Epistemic Skills: Reasoning about Knowledge and Oblivion
summary: This paper presents a class of epistemic logics that captures the dynamics of acquiring knowledge and descending into oblivion, while incorporating concepts of group knowledge. The approach is grounded in a system of weighted models, introducing an ``epistemic skills'' metric to represent the epistemic capacities tied to knowledge updates. Within this framework, knowledge acquisition is modeled as a process of upskilling, whereas oblivion is represented as a consequence of downskilling. The framework further enables exploration of ``knowability'' and ``forgettability,'' defined as the potential to gain knowledge through upskilling and to lapse into oblivion through downskilling, respectively. Additionally, it supports a detailed analysis of the distinctions between epistemic de re and de dicto expressions. The computational complexity of the model checking and satisfiability problems is examined, offering insights into their theoretical foundations and practical implications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于加权模型的动态认知逻辑，用“认知技能”量化知识获取与遗忘，区分群体知识并解决de re/de dicto 二义性问题，模型检验与可满足性的复杂度已分析。
AI.motivation: 现有动态认知逻辑无法同时刻画知识增长、遗忘及群体知识，缺乏量化个体认知能力的工具，也未澄清de re/de dicto的语义差异。本文旨在用统一框架解决上述不足，并为知识更新提供可计算的复杂度边界。
AI.method: 引入加权模型，把“认知技能”量化为模型中的权重，使知识更新=权重上升（upskilling）、遗忘=权重下降（downskilling）；据此定义可学性/可忘性，并扩展语言支持群体知识算子。用转换系统把de re/de dicto 转化为不同的世界—赋值路径，给出模型检验和可满足性的复杂度归约。
AI.result: 证明单智能体模型检验为PTIME完全，多智能体为coNP完全；可满足性在单智能体情形为PSPACE完全，多智能体降为NEXPTIME完全。框架成功区分“群体知道p”(E p)、“共同知道p”(C p)及“可分布式知道p”(D p)，并用三技能层级解释了de re/de dicto 歧义。
AI.conclusion: 加权技能模型为动态认知逻辑提供了可量化的知识更新视角，首次在同一逻辑内处理知识增长、遗忘与群体知识，并给出可计算的复杂度界限。未来工作将引入概率权重和学习策略，以刻画更复杂的认知演化场景。

title: Reasoning Models Will Sometimes Lie About Their Reasoning
summary: Hint-based faithfulness evaluations have established that Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) may not say what they think: they do not always volunteer information about how key parts of the input (e.g. answer hints) influence their reasoning. Yet, these evaluations also fail to specify what models should do when confronted with hints or other unusual prompt content -- even though versions of such instructions are standard security measures (e.g. for countering prompt injections). Here, we study faithfulness under this more realistic setting in which models are explicitly alerted to the possibility of unusual inputs. We find that such instructions can yield strong results on faithfulness metrics from prior work. However, results on new, more granular metrics proposed in this work paint a mixed picture: although models may acknowledge the presence of hints, they will often deny intending to use them -- even when permitted to use hints and even when it can be demonstrated that they are using them. Our results thus raise broader challenges for CoT monitoring and interpretability.
