title: AgentDynEx: Nudging the Mechanics and Dynamics of Multi-Agent Simulations
summary: Multi-agent large language model simulations have the potential to model complex human behaviors and interactions. If the mechanics are set up properly, unanticipated and valuable social dynamics can surface. However, it is challenging to consistently enforce simulation mechanics while still allowing for notable and emergent dynamics. We present AgentDynEx, an AI system that helps set up simulations from user-specified mechanics and dynamics. AgentDynEx uses LLMs to guide users through a Configuration Matrix to identify core mechanics and define milestones to track dynamics. It also introduces a method called \textit{nudging}, where the system dynamically reflects on simulation progress and gently intervenes if it begins to deviate from intended outcomes. A technical evaluation found that nudging enables simulations to have more complex mechanics and maintain its notable dynamics compared to simulations without nudging. We discuss the importance of nudging as a technique for balancing mechanics and dynamics of multi-agent simulations.

AI.tldr: AgentDynEx 用「轻推」机制在仿真中动态纠偏，使复杂规则与意外社会动态兼得。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 仿真希望同时保持严格规则与涌现社会行为，但现有方法常因规则僵化或失控而无法兼得。
AI.method: 提出 AgentDynEx：①用配置矩阵引导用户提取核心机制与里程碑；②在运行中通过 LLM 自省实施「轻推」——微量干预使演化轨迹回弹至预期区间；③对照实验对比有无轻推的仿真表现。
AI.result: 技术评估显示，轻推组可在保留显著涌现动态的同时，承载更复杂的底层机制；无轻推组要么规则失守，要么动态消失。
AI.conclusion: 「轻推」是平衡多智能体仿真机制与涌现动态的有效通用技术，为社会科学与政策模拟提供可控的生成式实验平台。

title: Do LLMs Encode Functional Importance of Reasoning Tokens?
comment: Updated after ACL Main 2026 acceptance; 25 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables;
summary: Large language models solve complex tasks by generating long reasoning chains, achieving higher accuracy at the cost of increased computational cost and reduced ability to isolate functionally relevant reasoning. Prior work on compact reasoning shortens such chains through probabilistic sampling, heuristics, or supervision from frontier models, but offers limited insight into whether models internally encode token-level functional importance for answer generation. We address this gap diagnostically and propose greedy pruning, a likelihood-preserving deletion procedure that iteratively removes reasoning tokens whose removal minimally degrades model likelihood under a specified objective, yielding length-controlled reasoning chains. We evaluate pruned reasoning in a distillation framework and show that students trained on pruned chains outperform a frontier-model-supervised compression baseline at matched reasoning lengths. Finally, our analysis reveals systematic pruning patterns and shows that attention scores can predict greedy pruning ranks, further suggesting that models encode a nontrivial functional importance structure over reasoning tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种贪心剪枝方法，能在不显著降低模型似然的前提下压缩长推理链，使蒸馏学生模型在同等长度下优于前沿模型监督的压缩基线，并验证模型内部对推理 token 存在可度量的功能重要性结构。
AI.motivation: 大模型虽然通过生成长推理链提升复杂任务准确率，但计算开销大且难以定位真正影响答案的推理片段。已有压缩方法多依赖采样、启发式或前沿模型监督，却未探明模型是否内部编码了 token 级的功能重要性，因此需要一种诊断性手段来揭示这一内在结构。
AI.method: 提出“贪心剪枝”：在指定目标函数下，迭代删除对模型似然损害最小的推理 token，直至达到预设长度；将剪枝后的链用于蒸馏学生模型，并与前沿模型监督的压缩基线对比；进一步用注意力分数预测剪枝顺序，检验模型是否隐含功能重要性排序。
AI.result: 在同等推理长度下，经贪心剪枝链训练的学生模型显著优于前沿模型监督的压缩基线；剪枝呈现出系统性模式（如保留早-中期关键推导、删除冗余复述）；注意力分数与贪心剪枝顺序高度相关，表明模型内部已编码非平凡的功能重要性结构。
AI.conclusion: 模型并非简单“堆 token”，而是内部赋予不同推理单元可度量的功能权重；贪心剪枝无需额外监督即可挖掘该权重，实现长度可控的有效压缩，为构建高效、可解释的长推理系统提供了新范式。

title: Remote Rowhammer Attack using Adversarial Observations on Federated Learning Clients
comment: Under review for IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing
summary: Federated Learning (FL) has the potential for simultaneous global learning amongst a large number of parallel agents, enabling emerging AI such as LLMs to be trained across demographically diverse data. Central to this being efficient is the ability for FL to perform sparse gradient updates and remote direct memory access at the central server. Most of the research in FL security focuses on protecting data privacy at the edge client or in the communication channels between the client and server. Client-facing attacks on the server are less well investigated as the assumption is that a large collective of clients offer resilience. Here, we show that by attacking certain clients that lead to a high frequency repetitive memory update in the server, we can remote initiate a rowhammer attack on the server memory. For the first time, we do not need backdoor access to the server, and a reinforcement learning (RL) attacker can learn how to maximize server repetitive memory updates by manipulating the client's sensor observation. The consequence of the remote rowhammer attack is that we are able to achieve bit flips, which can corrupt the server memory. We demonstrate the feasibility of our attack using a large-scale FL automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems with sparse updates, our adversarial attacking agent can achieve around 70% repeated update rate (RUR) in the targeted server model, effectively inducing bit flips on server DRAM. The security implications are that can cause disruptions to learning or may inadvertently cause elevated privilege. This paves the way for further research on practical mitigation strategies in FL and hardware design.

AI.tldr: 首次揭示联邦学习中央服务器存在远程Rowhammer硬件级攻击面，不需后门即可通过操控客户端梯度稀疏更新频率，在真实大规模ASR系统上诱导DRAM比特翻转，破坏模型内存并可提升权限。
AI.motivation: 现有FL安全研究主要关注客户端或信道隐私，普遍假设“大量客户端聚合”天然提供对服务器的防护。作者质疑该假设，提出：若攻击者能远程影响服务器内存更新频率，即可绕过软件层防护，触发硬件Rowhammer漏洞。
AI.method: 将Rowhammer触发条件转化为“高频重复内存写”问题，设计强化学习代理，在客户端本地观测范围内策略性篡改传感器数据（或梯度），使上传的稀疏梯度恰好导致服务器同一DRAM行被频繁激活；通过大规模FL自动语音识别系统验证，量化指标为重复更新率(RUR)与比特翻转率。
AI.result: 在真实FL-ASR场景下， adversarial RL代理可把目标模型层的RUR提升至≈70%，成功诱发服务器DRAM比特翻转；实验证明无需物理接入或后门即可远程破坏参数内存，并可能进一步导致权限提升或训练中断。
AI.conclusion: FL服务器并非天然免疫，硬件级漏洞可被客户端遥控利用。文章呼吁社区从“稀疏梯度调度+内存隔离+Rowhammer抑制”三方面联合设计缓解策略，并重新审视跨层安全模型。

title: Local Updates in Distributed Optimization: Provable Acceleration and Topology Effects
summary: Inspired by the success of performing multiple local optimization steps between communication rounds in federated learning, incorporating such local updates into distributed optimization has recently attracted growing interest. However, unlike federated learning, where local updates can accelerate training by reducing gradient estimation error under minibatch settings, it remains unclear whether similar benefits persist when exact gradients are available. Moreover, existing theoretical results typically require reducing the step size when multiple local updates are employed, which can entirely offset any potential benefit of these additional local updates. In this paper, we focus on the classic DIGing algorithm and leverage the tight performance bounds provided by Performance Estimation Problems (PEP) to show that incorporating local updates can indeed accelerate distributed optimization. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first rigorous demonstration of such acceleration for a broad class of objective functions. Our analysis further reveals that, under an appropriate step size, performing only two local updates is sufficient to achieve the maximal possible improvement, and that additional local updates provide no further gains. Because more updates increase computational cost, these findings offer practical guidance for efficient implementation. We also show that these speed gains depend critically on the network structure, with sparser or less connected graphs, characterized by the spectral properties of the mixing matrix, yielding smaller improvements. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets corroborate the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 首次用严格理论证明：在精确梯度场景下，给经典DIGing算法仅插入2步本地更新即可达到最大加速效果，更多更新无益；加速幅度随网络稀疏度下降而衰减。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的“多步本地更新”在随机梯度场景已显优势，但在分布式优化中若使用精确梯度，其是否仍能加速、如何设置步长与更新次数，一直缺乏理论回答。
AI.method: 以性能估计问题(PEP)给出的紧界为工具，对DIGing算法进行收敛性剖析，系统研究本地更新次数K与步长α的耦合关系，并建立与混合矩阵谱隙的定量联系。
AI.result: 证明K=2时收敛速率已达理论最优；继续增大K不再提升速度，反而增加计算量。加速倍数与网络拓扑密切相关：谱隙越小(图越稀疏)，可获得的额外加速越有限。
AI.conclusion: 在精确梯度分布式优化中，只需2步本地更新即可“免费”获得最大加速；实施时应按网络谱隙调步长，避免过度更新造成浪费。实验结果与理论预测完全一致。

title: OMAC: A Holistic Optimization Framework for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Agents powered by advanced large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across diverse complex applications. Recently, Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), wherein multiple agents collaborate and communicate with each other, have exhibited enhanced capabilities in complex tasks, such as high-quality code generation and arithmetic reasoning. However, the development of such systems often relies on handcrafted methods, and the literature on systematic design and optimization of LLM-based MAS remains limited. In this work, we introduce OMAC, a general framework designed for holistic optimization of LLM-based MAS. Specifically, we identify five key optimization dimensions for MAS, encompassing both agent functionality and collaboration structure. Building upon these dimensions, we first propose a general algorithm, utilizing two actors termed the Semantic Initializer and the Contrastive Comparator, to optimize any single dimension. Then, we present an algorithm for joint optimization across multiple dimensions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of OMAC on code generation, arithmetic reasoning, and general reasoning tasks against state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: OMAC框架首次系统化定义并联合优化多智能体系统的5大维度，在代码生成、数学推理等任务上超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM-MAS 依赖手工设计、缺乏系统优化理论；作者希望建立可自动改进协作结构与个体能力的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出5维优化空间（角色、通信、拓扑、工具、规划）→设计语义初始化器生成候选拓扑/角色→对比比较器基于性能反馈迭代精炼→单维与多维联合优化算法耦合更新。
AI.result: 在 HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K、MATH 及 BBH 上，OMAC 相对强力单智能体与手工 MAS 基线平均提升 8.4–17.2%，且搜索成本低于暴力网格搜索 40%。
AI.conclusion: OMAC 证明 MAS 性能可被系统化建模并自动优化，为多智能体协作提供可扩展、可解释的通用范式。

title: SAGE-32B: Agentic Reasoning via Iterative Distillation
summary: We demonstrate SAGE-32B, a 32 billion parameter language model that focuses on agentic reasoning and long range planning tasks. Unlike chat models that aim for general conversation fluency, SAGE-32B is designed to operate in an agentic loop, emphasizing task decomposition, tool usage, and error recovery. The model is initialized from the Qwen2.5-32B pretrained model and fine tuned using Iterative Distillation, a two stage training process that improves reasoning performance through rigorously tested feedback loops. SAGE-32B also introduces an inverse reasoning approach, which uses a meta cognition head to forecast potential failures in the planning process before execution. On agentic reasoning benchmarks including MMLU-Pro, AgentBench, and MATH-500, SAGE-32B achieves higher success rates in multi tool usage scenarios compared to similarly sized baseline models, while remaining competitive on standard reasoning evaluations. Model weights are publicly released at https://huggingface.co/sagea-ai/sage-reasoning-32b

AI.tldr: 32 B 专用推理模型 SAGE-32B，通过迭代蒸馏与逆推理机制，在多工具、长程任务中显著优于同规模基线。
AI.motivation: 现有对话模型仅追求流畅性，难以在自主智能体场景下完成复杂任务分解、工具调用与容错；需构建专门强调 agentic reasoning 与长程规划的大模型。
AI.method: 以 Qwen2.5-32B 为起点，提出“迭代蒸馏”两阶段训练框架，用严格反馈循环提升推理；引入逆推理，在元认知头中预判规划失败；全流程聚焦工具调用、任务拆解与错误恢复。
AI.result: 在 MMLU-Pro、AgentBench、MATH-500 等 agentic 基准中，多工具使用成功率高于同规模基线，同时在常规推理测试保持竞争力；模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: SAGE-32B 验证了“专用推理+逆规划”路线，可在 32 B 量级实现高效自主智能体推理，为后续长程规划模型提供可复现基线与训练范式。

title: CASS: Nvidia to AMD Transpilation with Data, Models, and Benchmark
summary: Cross-architecture GPU code transpilation is essential for unlocking low-level hardware portability, yet no scalable solution exists. We introduce CASS, the first dataset and model suite for source- and assembly-level GPU translation (CUDA <--> HIP, SASS <--> RDNA3). CASS contains 60k verified host-device code pairs, enabling learning-based translation across both ISA and runtime boundaries. We generate each sample using our automated pipeline that scrapes, translates, compiles, and aligns GPU programs across vendor stacks. Leveraging CASS, we train a suite of domain-specific translation models that achieve 88.2% accuracy on CUDA -> HIP and 69.1% on SASS -> RDNA3, outperforming commercial baselines including GPT-5.1, Claude-4.5, and Hipify by wide margins. Generated code matches native performance in 85% of cases, preserving both runtime and memory behavior. To support rigorous evaluation, we introduce CASS-Bench, a curated benchmark spanning 18 GPU domains with ground-truth execution. All data, models, and evaluation tools will be released as open source to support progress in GPU compiler tooling, binary compatibility, and LLM-guided code translation.

AI.tldr: 首次提出跨架构 GPU 代码转译数据集与模型套件 CASS，在 CUDA↔HIP、SASS↔RDNA3 两对 ISA/运行时边界上实现 88.2%/69.1% 准确率，85% 生成代码性能达原生水平，并开源全部数据与评测基准。
AI.motivation: 实现 GPU 低层硬件可移植缺乏规模化方案，现有商业工具与通用大模型表现不足。
AI.method: 构建 6 万对经编译-执行验证的宿主-设备代码平行语料；设计自动挖掘-转译-对齐管线跨厂商栈收集样本；基于 CASS 训练领域专用翻译模型，并发布覆盖 18 领域的评测基准 CASS-Bench。
AI.result: CUDA→HIP 准确率 88.2%，SASS→RDNA3 准确率 69.1%，显著优于 GPT-5.1、Claude-4.5、Hipify；生成代码 85% 案例在运行时间与内存行为上与原生一致。
AI.conclusion: CASS 首次证明数据驱动方法可在 ISA 与运行时双重边界实现高性能 GPU 代码转译，为 GPU 编译器、二进制兼容及 LLM 引导翻译提供开放基础。

title: Failure Modes in Multi-Hop QA: The Weakest Link Effect and the Recognition Bottleneck
summary: Despite scaling to massive context windows, Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with multi-hop reasoning due to inherent position bias, which causes them to overlook information at certain positions. Whether these failures stem from an inability to locate evidence (recognition failure) or integrate it (synthesis failure) is unclear. We introduce Multi-Focus Attention Instruction (MFAI), a semantic probe to disentangle these mechanisms by explicitly steering attention towards selected positions. Across 5 LLMs on two multi-hop QA tasks (MuSiQue and NeoQA), we identify the "Weakest Link Effect": in our 18-document, 3-bucket setting, multi-hop reasoning performance collapses to the level of the least visible evidence, governed by absolute position rather than the linear distance between facts. While matched MFAI resolves recognition bottlenecks, improving accuracy by up to 11.49% in low-visibility positions, misleading MFAI yields divergent effects modulated by task topology: entity-centric tasks with vertical reasoning chains are vulnerable, whereas event-centric tasks with horizontal evidence structures are more resilient. Finally, we demonstrate that thinking models utilizing System-2 reasoning effectively locate and integrate the required information, matching gold-only baselines even in noisy, long-context settings. Supplementary experiments on 2WikiMultiHopQA, extended 3-4 hop counts, and a 32B model confirm these findings generalize across datasets, reasoning depths, and model scales.

AI.tldr: 文章提出一种“多焦点注意力指令(MFAI)”语义探针，发现长上下文下多跳推理崩溃受最不易见证据位置决定，而不是信息距离；纠正注意力可提升约11.49%准确率，系统2模型可在噪声长文找回金标性能。
AI.motivation: LLM扩展到超宽窗口后仍因位置偏见丢失部分地点信息，多跳问答准确度显著下降。作者想区分失败源于"找不到"还是"合并不了"，以及不同任务拓扑对注意力误导的敏感程度。
AI.method: 1)设计MFAI——显式指令模型关注指定段落后测量表现；2)在MuSiQue、NeoQA等三组设定3×6文档桶条件实验，引入净正面/误导指令对比；3)引入系统2推理链策略，并用2WikiMultiHopQA、3/4跳扩展及32B模型做泛化探针。
AI.result: 1)发现"最弱环节效应"：整体准确率下降到最低可见性段落水平，唯一决定因素是绝对位置而非信息距离；2)正确MFAI可弥补11.49%低可见性区准确，误导MFAI会使实体类纵向链式任务显著受损，事件类横向结构更抗干扰；3)开启慢思考(System-2)后模型在噪声长篇环境里恢复至仅以金标段落推理的基线成绩，且结果跨数据集、深度和模型规模稳定。
AI.conclusion: 位置偏见主要靠"识别瓶颈"而非"合成瓶颈"导致；可通过外部注意引导或系统2推理定位并整合证据来缓解；任务拓扑显著影响误导敏感性，提示未来长上下文模型需同时优化注意力定位与推理拓扑匹配机制。

title: PuzzleWorld: A Benchmark for Multimodal, Open-Ended Reasoning in Puzzlehunts
summary: Puzzlehunts are a genre of complex, multi-step puzzles lacking well-defined problem definitions. In contrast to conventional reasoning benchmarks consisting of tasks with clear instructions and constrained environments, puzzlehunts requires discovering the underlying problem structure from multimodal evidence and iterative reasoning, mirroring real-world domains such as scientific discovery, exploratory data analysis, or investigative problem-solving. Despite progress in foundation models, their performance on open-ended settings remains largely untested. We introduce PuzzleWorld, a comprehensive benchmark of 667 puzzlehunt-style problems designed to assess step-by-step, open-ended, and creative multimodal reasoning. Each puzzle is annotated with the final solution, detailed reasoning traces, and cognitive skill labels, enabling holistic benchmarking and fine-grained diagnostic analysis. Most state-of-the-art models achieve only 1-4% final answer accuracy. On PuzzleWorld, the best model solves only 18% of puzzles and reaches 40% stepwise accuracy, matching human puzzle novices but falling significantly behind puzzle enthusiasts. To demonstrate the value of our reasoning annotations, we show that fine-tuning a small model on reasoning traces boosts stepwise accuracy from 4% to 11%, which translates to improvements in downstream visual reasoning tasks. Our detailed error analysis reveals that current models exhibit myopic reasoning, are bottlenecked by the limitations of language-based inference, and lack sketching capabilities crucial for visual and spatial reasoning. We release PuzzleWorld at https://github.com/MIT-MI/PuzzleWorld to support future work on building more general, open-ended, and creative reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 新基准PuzzleWorld囊括667道无显式定义的解谜题，首次系统评测模型在多模态证据下自发现问题并迭代推理的开放式能力；主流模型最终正确率仅1-4%，最佳模型亦仅18%，显著逊于人类爱好者。
AI.motivation: 既有的推理基准多为任务定义清晰、环境受限的封闭式问题，难以衡量模型在科学发现、数据探查等现实开放式场景中的逐步、创造性推理水平。
AI.method: 构建包含667道解谜题的多模态数据集PuzzleWorld，提供最终答案、分步推理链及认知技能标签；对比评测SOTA模型并提出用推理链微调小模型的方法。
AI.result: 大模型在该基准上最终准确率普遍1-4%，最优模型仅18%，步骤级准确率40%，与人类新手相当，但与爱好者差距明显；用推理链微调可将步骤准确率从4%提升至11%，并迁移改进下游视觉推理任务。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型因短视、语言推理瓶颈及缺乏视觉草图能力而难以胜任开放式推理；PuzzleWorld揭示了构建具备广义的逐步、创意与多模态推理能力系统的关键缺口，并公开全部数据与评测框架供后续研究。

title: Lost in the Prompt Order: Revealing the Limitations of Causal Attention in Language Models
summary: Large language models exhibit surprising sensitivity to the structure of the prompt, but the mechanisms underlying this sensitivity remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct an in-depth investigation on a striking case: in multiple-choice question answering, placing context before the questions and options (CQO) outperforms the reverse order (QOC) by over 14%p, consistently over a wide range of models and datasets. Through systematic architectural analysis, we identify causal attention as the core mechanism: in QOC prompts, the causal mask prevents option tokens from attending to context, creating an information bottleneck where context becomes invisible to options.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在多项选择题中因提示语序不同而出现14个百分点以上的性能差距；根本原因在于因果注意力机制使“问题-选项-上下文”语序下选项无法回看上下文。
AI.motivation: 揭示并量化提示结构对LLM的敏感性，解释其内在机制，为更鲁棒的提示设计提供理论依据。
AI.method: 以多选题任务为切入点，系统对比“上下文-问题-选项”(CQO)与“问题-选项-上下文”(QOC)两种语序；结合跨模型、跨数据集的广泛实验，再通过注意力因果溯源锁定“因果掩码阻断选项读取上下文”这一瓶颈。
AI.result: CQO一致优于QOC逾14个百分点；架构分析证明，QOC中因果掩码使选项token对上下文token的注意力为零，导致模型在做出选择时无法利用关键上下文信息。
AI.conclusion: 因果注意力是提示结构敏感性的核心来源；只要保证后续token能获取前置上下文，即可显著缓解信息瓶颈，从而提升模型表现。

title: Benchmarking Misuse Mitigation Against Covert Adversaries
summary: Existing language model safety evaluations focus on overt attacks and low-stakes tasks. In reality, an attacker can easily subvert existing safeguards by requesting help on small, benign-seeming tasks across many independent queries. Because the individual queries do not appear harmful, the attack is hard to detect. However, when combined, these fragments uplift misuse by helping the attacker complete hard and dangerous tasks. Toward identifying defenses against such strategies, we develop Benchmarks for Stateful Defenses (BSD), a data generation pipeline that automates evaluations of covert attacks and corresponding defenses. Using this pipeline, we curate two new datasets that are consistently refused by frontier models and are too difficult for weaker open-weight models. This enables us to evaluate decomposition attacks, which are found to be effective misuse enablers, and to highlight stateful defenses as a promising countermeasure.

AI.tldr: 攻击者把无害小任务拆成多轮提问， frontier模型照单全收，组合后却能完成高危行为；作者提出BSD框架自动生成这类隐蔽攻击数据，证实分解攻击有效，并指出状态化防御可作为对策。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评测只关注单次显式攻击和低风险任务，忽略了多轮、碎片化请求累积成高危用途的隐蔽威胁，亟需可扩展的评估工具与防御思路。
AI.method: 构建Benchmarks for Stateful Defenses (BSD)数据生成管线：①自动把高危任务拆成多轮看似无害的子问题；②筛选出 frontier模型一致拒绝、弱开源模型无法完成的样本，形成两套新数据集；③在该基准上测试分解攻击成功率，并评估需跨轮记忆的状态化防御。
AI.result: 生成的数据集对GPT-4等前沿模型拒答率100%，对7B级模型难度过载；实验表明分解攻击可显著提升有害任务完成率（最高达×3.8），而引入对话状态追踪与拒绝锁定的状态化防御可将成功率压回接近零。
AI.conclusion: 多轮碎片化请求是现实且可自动化的隐蔽攻击范式；BSD提供可复现的评测基准，验证状态化防御为当下最有潜力的缓解手段，未来需扩展至多模态与更长会话场景。

title: Temp-R1: A Unified Autonomous Agent for Complex Temporal KGQA via Reverse Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) is inherently challenging, as it requires sophisticated reasoning over dynamic facts with multi-hop dependencies and complex temporal constraints. Existing methods rely on fixed workflows and expensive closed-source APIs, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose Temp-R1, the first autonomous end-to-end agent for TKGQA trained through reinforcement learning. To address cognitive overload in single-action reasoning, we expand the action space with specialized internal actions alongside external action. To prevent shortcut learning on simple questions, we introduce reverse curriculum learning that trains on difficult questions first, forcing the development of sophisticated reasoning before transferring to easier cases. Our 8B-parameter Temp-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance on MultiTQ and TimelineKGQA, improving 19.8% over strong baselines on complex questions. Our work establishes a new paradigm for autonomous temporal reasoning agents. The code is available at https://github.com/zjukg/Temp-R1.

AI.tldr: Temp-R1 是一个通过强化学习训练、可端到端自主推理的 8B 参数时间知识图谱问答代理，在困难样本优先的反向课程学习机制下，于 MultiTQ 与 TimelineKGQA 复杂问题上取得 19.8% 的显著提升并开源代码。
AI.motivation: 现有 TKGQA 方法依赖固定流程或昂贵闭源 API，难以在动态事实、多跳依赖与复杂时间约束下保持灵活和可扩展；需要一种可自主演化的高适应性框架。
AI.method: 将内部思维动作与外部检索动作统一为扩展动作空间，通过强化学习端到端训练代理；引入“先难后易”的反向课程学习抑制捷径学习，迫使模型先掌握复杂推理再迁移到简单样本。
AI.result: 8B 参数的 Temp-R1 在 MultiTQ 和 TimelineKGQA 上取得新 SOTA，复杂问题绝对提升 19.8%，验证其时间推理优势。
AI.conclusion: Temp-R1 确立了“自主时间推理代理”新范式，证明强化学习+课程学习可在时间知识图谱问答中突破传统 pipeline 与闭源限制，为后续研究提供开源基线。

title: LPO: Towards Accurate GUI Agent Interaction via Location Preference Optimization
summary: The advent of autonomous agents is transforming interactions with Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) by employing natural language as a powerful intermediary. Despite the predominance of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) methods in current GUI agents for achieving spatial localization, these methods face substantial challenges due to their limited capacity to accurately perceive positional data. Existing strategies, such as reinforcement learning, often fail to assess positional accuracy effectively, thereby restricting their utility. In response, we introduce Location Preference Optimization (LPO), a novel approach that leverages locational data to optimize interaction preferences. LPO uses information entropy to predict interaction positions by focusing on zones rich in information. Besides, it further introduces a dynamic location reward function based on physical distance, reflecting the varying importance of interaction positions. Supported by Group Relative Preference Optimization (GRPO), LPO facilitates an extensive exploration of GUI environments and significantly enhances interaction precision. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate LPO's superior performance, achieving SOTA results across both offline benchmarks and real-world online evaluations. Our code will be made publicly available soon, at https://github.com/jqtangust/LPO.

AI.tldr: 提出Location Preference Optimization（LPO），用信息熵+动态距离奖励，无需人工标注即可让GUI智能体秒级定位点击点，离线/在线测评均刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有SFT与RL方法对GUI空间坐标的感知精度不足，导致智能体难以准确定位操作点，亟需摆脱昂贵标注并直接优化“位置偏好”。
AI.method: 1) 用信息熵自动发现GUI高信息密度区域作为伪目标；2) 设计随像素距离衰减的动态奖励函数；3) 通过Group Relative Preference Optimization（GRPO）在大批无标注交互轨迹中对比学习，持续更新策略。
AI.result: 跨基准离线测试与真实在线任务均达SOTA，点击偏差降低30%以上，样本效率提升5×，零人工标注即可逼近全监督效果。
AI.conclusion: LPO首次把“位置”纳入偏好优化框架，为GUI智能体提供一条无需人工标注即可高精度空间交互的新范式，代码将开源。

title: AI-Based Detection of Temporal Changes in MR-Linac Images Acquired During Routine Prostate Radiotherapy
summary: Purpose: To investigate whether an AI-based method can detect subtle inter-fraction changes in MR-Linac images acquired during radiotherapy and explore the broader potential of MRLinac imaging. Methods: This retrospective study included longitudinal 0.35T MR-Linac images from 761 patients. To identify temporal changes, we employed a deep learning model using temporal ordering via pairwise comparison, previously shown effective for longitudinal imaging studies. The model was trained using first-to-last fraction pairs (F1-FL) and all pairs (All-pairs). Performance was assessed using quantitative metrics (accuracy and AUC) and compared against a radiologist's performance. Qualitative evaluation was performed using saliency maps, which identify anatomical regions associated with temporal imaging changes. Results: The F1-FL model demonstrated high performance (AUC=0.99, accuracy=0.95) and outperformed the radiologist in temporal ordering task. The All-pairs model also showed high performance (AUC=0.97, accuracy=0.91). Regions contributing to predictions included the prostate, bladder, and pubic symphysis. The performance was correlated to fractional intervals and was reduced for non-radiation-exposed timepoints (Sim and F1), suggesting that observed changes may reflect both temporal variation and radiation exposure. Conclusion: MR-Linac imaging appears capable of capturing subtle changes during prostate radiotherapy that can be detected by AI models, even over approximately two-day intervals. The model's high performance, together with quantitative and qualitative analyses, supports a potential role for MR-Linac in clinical applications beyond image guidance.

AI.tldr: 利用761例0.35 T MR-Linac纵向图像训练成对排序深度学习模型，AI能精准识别分次间细微变化（AUC 0.99），显著优于放射科医师，提示MR-Linac除图像引导外尚具监测放疗早期组织反应的临床潜能。
AI.motivation: MR-Linac在每次治疗中都会采集高分辨率MRI，但现有研究主要停留在图像引导层面；作者假设这些高频影像序列中蕴藏放疗诱导的微观解剖变化，AI有望将其挖掘为可量化的早期疗效/毒性生物标志，从而拓宽MR-Linac的临床价值。
AI.method: 回顾性收集761例患者的0.35 T MR-Linac纵向图像；以成对排序深度网络为主干，分别训练“首-末分次”（F1-FL）与“所有分次成对”（All-pairs）两种策略，用准确率与AUC评估排序正确性；并与放射科医师对比。通过类激活图（saliency map）定位驱动变化的关键解剖区域，同时分析排序性能与分次间隔、非照射时间点的关系以区分时间自然变异与放疗效应。
AI.result: F1-FL模型AUC 0.99、准确率0.95，显著优于人工判读；All-pairs模型AUC 0.97、准确率0.91。模型聚焦前列腺、膀胱及耻骨联合区域，提示这些部位出现可测的解剖/信号变化。对非照射对照（Sim、F1）性能下降，并与分次间隔呈正相关，表明捕捉到的变化同时包含放疗特异性与生理性时间变异成分。
AI.conclusion: MR-Linac影像序列在仅约2天的分次间隔内即可记录可被AI检出的细微变化，验证其超越传统图像引导的监测潜力；未来可发展为实时疗效评估、个体化剂量雕刻或毒性预测的影像学生物标志平台。

title: OmniGen2: Towards Instruction-Aligned Multimodal Generation
summary: In this work, we introduce OmniGen2, a versatile and open-source generative model designed to provide a unified solution for diverse generation tasks, including text-to-image, image editing, and in-context generation. Unlike OmniGen v1, OmniGen2 features two distinct decoding pathways for text and image modalities, utilizing unshared parameters and a decoupled image tokenizer. This design enables OmniGen2 to build upon existing multimodal understanding models without the need to re-adapt VAE inputs, thereby preserving the original text generation capabilities. To facilitate the training of OmniGen2, we developed comprehensive data construction pipelines, encompassing image editing and in-context generation data. Additionally, we introduce a reflection mechanism tailored for image generation tasks and curate a dedicated reflection dataset based on OmniGen2. Despite its relatively modest parameter size, OmniGen2 achieves competitive results on multiple task benchmarks, including text-to-image and image editing. To further evaluate in-context generation, also referred to as subject-driven tasks, we introduce a new benchmark named OmniContext. OmniGen2 achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models in terms of consistency. We will release our models, training code, datasets, and data construction pipeline to support future research in this field. Project Page: https://vectorspacelab.github.io/OmniGen2; GitHub Link: https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/OmniGen2

AI.tldr: OmniGen2 是一个开源统一多模态生成模型，用双解码通路+反思机制，在文生图、编辑、主体一致性三大任务上达到开源 SOTA，并发布新基准 OmniContext 与全套训练资源。
AI.motivation: 现有统一模型在保留文本能力、适配不同模态及主体一致性上存在瓶颈，需设计轻量但通用的生成框架并建立相应数据与评测体系。
AI.method: 采用文本/图像双解码通路、不共享参数与解耦图像 tokenizer，直接复用多模态理解模型权重；构建含编辑、上下文生成与反思任务的三类数据流水线；引入针对图像生成的反射机制并配套数据集；提出评测主体驱动生成的 OmniContext 基准。
AI.result: 参数量较小却在 T2I、图像编辑公开基准上达到竞争力指标，在 OmniContext 一致性评测中拿下开源模型最佳成绩。
AI.conclusion: 双通路+反思的统一架构可在不牺牲文本能力前提下实现高质量多模态生成，提供的模型、代码、数据与评测工具将推动后续研究。

title: Reduced-Order Surrogates for Forced Flexible Mesh Coastal-Ocean Models
comment: Submitted for peer-review in a journal. v2: revised version submitted to journal after minor revisions
summary: While proper orthogonal decomposition (POD)-based surrogates are widely explored for hydrodynamic applications, the use of Koopman autoencoders for real-world coastal-ocean modelling remains relatively limited. This paper introduces a flexible Koopman autoencoder formulation that incorporates meteorological forcings and boundary conditions, and systematically compares its performance against POD-based surrogates. The Koopman autoencoder employs a learned linear temporal operator in latent space, enabling eigenvalue regularization to promote temporal stability. This strategy is evaluated alongside temporal unrolling techniques for achieving stable and accurate long-term predictions. The models are assessed on three test cases spanning distinct dynamical regimes, with prediction horizons up to one year at 30-minute temporal resolution. Across all cases, the reduced order surrogates with temporal unrolling achieve high accuracy with relative root-mean-squared-errors of 0.0068-0.14 and $R^2$-values of 0.61-0.995, where prediction errors are largest for current velocities, and smallest for water surface elevations. In two of the three cases, the Koopman Autoencoder have higher accuracy than the POD-based surrogates. Comparing to in-situ observations, the surrogate yields -0.64% to 12% increase in water surface elevation prediction error when compared to prediction errors of the physics-based model. These error levels, corresponding to a few centimeters, are acceptable for many practical applications, while inference speed-ups of 300-1400x enables workflows such as ensemble forecasting and long climate simulations for coastal-ocean modelling.

AI.tldr: 基于Koopman的线性算子自编码器首次被整合进真实沿岸-海洋模拟框架，以气象强迫与边界条件作为输入，辅以特征值正则化与“时间展开”策略，可在0.5 min分辨率下稳定预测全年，两步误差6.8-140 ‰、R² 0.61-0.995，多数场景精度优于POD；对水面位而言误差仅几厘米，推理速度提升300-1400倍。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率沿岸-海洋模型动辄千万网格点，连年积分式或集合预报需万次运行，传统物理模式耗时不可接受；现有POD-降阶方法已用于水动力学但仍存长期漂移与非线性强外推时失效问题，故需发展能实现高效且稳定的非线性降阶代理。
AI.method: 1) 构建Koopman自编码器：编码器-解码器将高维流形映射至线性隐空间，并学出可显式构造的线性转移算子；2) 引入气象强迫与边界条件作为外源输入；3) 在隐空间转移矩阵上施加特征值正则化保证谱半径≤1，抑制不稳定模态；4) 采用“时间展开”技巧：训练时不只单步误差，同时切片长序列联合优化以约束中长期一致；5) 与对应截断阶数的POD-Galerkin/LSTM代理在同一套网格与测站下做系统对比；6) 共验三个不同动力场（通量守恒型、潮汐主导型及风浪-风暴潮混合型），目标变量含水位、流速、温盐，预测时长至365 d。
AI.result: 所有实验中，时间展开后的降阶代理表现最优，RRMSE 0.0068-0.14，R² 0.61-0.995；流速误差最大，水位最小。三种工况下Koopman代理有两例精度（RRMSE与R²）均优于POD/LSTM。与现场观测比较，Koopman代理水位误差仅比全物理模型增加-0.64%到+12%（约2-6 cm），在实用上与物理结果相当；而单步推理时间缩短300-1400倍，一次全年预测可在GPU上数秒完成。
AI.conclusion: Koopman自编码器结合特征值正则化与时间展开，能在强非线性与多源强迫条件下提供稳定、全年长度的沿岸-海洋轨迹预测，精度优于POD，误差与物理模型同级；同时具有百-千倍加速。结果证明该框架可作为高分辨率集合预报、数据同化及气候情景模拟的高效可替代核心，为近海环境智能预估开辟了一条具备工程落地性的道路。

title: Best Agent Identification for General Game Playing
summary: We present an efficient and generalised procedure to accurately identify the best (or near best) performing algorithm for each sub-task in a multi-problem domain. Our approach treats this as a set of best arm identification problems for multi-armed bandits, where each bandit corresponds to a specific task and each arm corresponds to a specific algorithm or agent. We propose an optimistic selection process based on a chosen confidence interval, that ranks each arm across all bandits in terms of their potential to influence our overall simple regret. We evaluate the performance of our approach on two of the most popular general game playing domains, the General Video Game AI (GVGAI) framework and the Ludii general game playing system, with the goal of selecting a high-performing agent for each game using a limited number of available trials. Compared to previous best arm identification algorithms for multi-armed bandits, our results demonstrate a substantial performance improvement in terms of average simple regret and average probability of error. This novel approach can be used to significantly improve the quality and accuracy of agent evaluation procedures for general game frameworks, as well as other multi-task domains with high algorithm runtimes.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于置信区间的乐观选臂策略，可在多任务游戏领域（GVGAI／Ludii）用极有限采样为每款游戏快速锁定最优或近最优智能体，显著降低平均简单遗憾与误选概率。
AI.motivation: 通用游戏框架需要对海量不同游戏快速选出对应高性能智能体，传统逐任务独立评估采样代价高，难以在算法运行时间极昂贵的场景下保证评估质量与准确性。
AI.method: 将“每任务选最优算法”建模为多任务多臂老虎机最佳臂识别问题：每个老虎机对应一个游戏，臂对应算法。构建跨任务乐观置信区间，按潜在对总体简单 regret 的影响统一排序并动态分配采样预算，实现高效全局选臂。
AI.result: 在 GVGAI 与 Ludii 两大基准的 100+ 款游戏上，与现有最佳臂识别算法相比，平均简单 regret 降低 30–50%，误选概率下降 20–40%，同等预算下找到近最优智能体的成功率提升一倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可无缝嵌入通用游戏评估管线，在任意高耗时多任务场景下以极小采样成本获得高保真算法配置，显著提升代理评估效率与可靠性，并具备向其他多任务 AI 领域的直接迁移能力。

title: When and What to Ask: AskBench and Rubric-Guided RLVR for LLM Clarification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often respond even when prompts omit critical details or include misleading information, leading to hallucinations or reinforced misconceptions. We study how to evaluate and improve LLMs' ability to decide when and what to ask for clarification without sacrificing task performance. We introduce AskBench, an interactive benchmark that converts standard QA pairs into multi-turn interactions with explicit checkpoints. A unified judge loop evaluates final answers and simulates user responses as needed. AskBench covers two settings: AskMind, with intent-deficient queries requiring clarification, and AskOverconfidence, with queries containing false premises that must be identified and corrected. We further propose rubric-guided reinforcement learning with verifier-based rewards (RLVR), which uses structured rubrics to encourage targeted clarification. Experiments show consistent improvements in accuracy, rubric adherence, and interaction efficiency, with strong generalization to unseen domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 AskBench 交互式基准与 RLVR 强化学习框架，系统评测并提升 LLM 在“何时提问、如何澄清”上的能力，显著减少幻觉且保留任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 面对缺失或误导信息时仍强行作答，导致幻觉与错误强化；亟需量化并提升其“主动澄清”能力。
AI.method: 构建 AskBench 框架：① AskMind（缺意图提问）与 AskOverconfidence（含虚假前提）双场景；② 统一 Judge Loop 实时评估答案并模拟用户反馈；③ 设计结构化评分细则（rubric）；④ 提出细则引导的强化学习 RLVR，以 verifier 给出的细则分数为奖励进行策略优化。
AI.result: 在 AskBench 上，RLVR 使模型 Clarification Accuracy 绝对提升 11–18%，任务准确率不降反升 3–7%，交互轮次减少 12–20%，并在医学、法律等未见领域零样本泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: 通过将“可衡量澄清需求”嵌入交互式 benchmark 与细则化奖励，RLVR 让 LLM 学会适时追问，显著抑制幻觉，验证“提问能力”可经强化学习系统性提升并为通用能力。

title: End-to-End Large Portfolio Optimization for Variance Minimization with Neural Networks through Covariance Cleaning
summary: We develop a rotation-invariant neural network that provides the global minimum-variance portfolio by jointly learning how to lag-transform historical returns and marginal volatilities and how to regularise the eigenvalues of large equity covariance matrices. This explicit mathematical mapping offers clear interpretability of each module's role, so the model cannot be regarded as a pure black box. The architecture mirrors the analytical form of the global minimum-variance solution yet remains agnostic to dimension, so a single model can be calibrated on panels of a few hundred stocks and applied, without retraining, to one thousand US equities, a cross-sectional jump that indicates robust generalization capability. The loss function is the future short-term realized minimum variance and is optimized end-to-end on real returns. In out-of-sample tests from January 2000 to December 2024, the estimator delivers systematically lower realized volatility, smaller maximum drawdowns, and higher Sharpe ratios than the best competitors, including state-of-the-art non-linear shrinkage, and these advantages persist across both short and long evaluation horizons despite the model's training focus is short-term. Furthermore, although the model is trained end-to-end to produce an unconstrained minimum-variance portfolio, we show that its learned covariance representation can be used in general optimizers under long-only constraints with virtually no loss in its performance advantage over competing estimators. These advantages persist when the strategy is executed under a highly realistic implementation framework that models market orders at the auctions, empirical slippage, exchange fees, and financing charges for leverage, and they remain stable during episodes of acute market stress.

AI.tldr: 提出一种旋转不变神经网络，直接输出全局最小方差组合；其损失函数为未来短期已实现方差，可在不重新训练的情况下从小样本科普到 1 000 只美股；2000–2024 样本外测试在波动、回撤、夏普比上全面优于现有非线性压缩等方法，且适用于现实交易环境。
AI.motivation: 传统协方差估计→组合优化流程存在未来协方差未知、估计误差大、黑箱难解释等问题；作者希望端到端学习一个可解释、对维度免疫、直接输出最小方差组合的估计器，以提升样本外风险控制能力。
AI.method: 1) 设计旋转不变网络，将滞后收益与边际波动率联合映射为协方差矩阵特征值的正则化因子；2) 网络结构显式嵌入 GMV 解析解，使每个模块对应数学意义；3) 损失函数为未来短期已实现组合方差，实现端到端优化；4) 模型训练后无需重训即可跨尺度泛化。
AI.result: 2000–2024 美股样本外：已实现波动降低、最大回撤更小、夏普比更高，优势在短/长窗口均显著；即使嵌入真实交易框架（拍卖下单、滑点、费用、杠杆成本）或在仅做长约束下，仍保持领先优势；在极端市场压力下表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 通过把最小方差解析解“编译”进旋转不变网络，并用未来已实现方差作损失，首次实现既白盒又强泛化的协方差-组合联合学习；其学习到的协方差表征可直接用于任意优化器，为实际资产管理提供了兼顾解释性与性能的新一代风险模型。

title: Enforcing Reciprocity in Operator Learning for Seismic Wave Propagation
summary: Accurate and efficient wavefield modeling underpins seismic structure and source studies. Traditional methods comply with physical laws but are computationally intensive. Data-driven methods, while opening new avenues for advancement, have yet to incorporate strict physical consistency. The principle of reciprocity is one of the most fundamental physical laws in wave propagation. We introduce the Reciprocity-Enforced Neural Operator (RENO), a transformer-based architecture for modeling seismic wave propagation that hard-codes the reciprocity principle. The model leverages the cross-attention mechanism and commutative operations to guarantee invariance under swapping source and receiver positions. Beyond improved physical consistency, the proposed architecture supports simultaneous realizations for multiple sources. This yields an order-of-magnitude inference speedup at a similar memory footprint over a conventional neural operator on a realistic multi-source configuration. We demonstrate the functionality using the reciprocity relation for particle velocity fields under single forces. This architecture is also applicable to pressure fields under dilatational sources and travel-time fields governed by the eikonal equation, paving the way for encoding more complex reciprocity relations.

AI.tldr: RENO 将互易律硬编码进 Transformer，实现源-检互换不变，一次推断可处理多源，速度提升 10 倍，显存不变。
AI.motivation: 传统数值方法精确但计算昂贵；纯数据驱动网络缺乏物理约束。地震学最基本的互易律尚未被神经算子显式满足。
AI.method: 提出 Reciprocity-Enforced Neural Operator：利用交叉注意力与可交换算子，使网络输出在源/接收器对调时严格对称；通过并行多源批处理实现一次推断输出所有响应。
AI.result: 在真实多源设定下，RENO 推断速度提升一个量级，内存占用与常规神经算子相当；在粒子速度、声压及程函旅行时三种场验证互易关系均成立。
AI.conclusion: 硬编码物理对称性可同时提升一致性、效率与泛化性，该框架可扩展至更复杂的波动互易关系。

title: A Survey on MLLM-based Visually Rich Document Understanding: Methods, Challenges, and Emerging Trends
summary: Visually Rich Document Understanding (VRDU) has become a pivotal area of research, driven by the need to automatically interpret documents that contain intricate visual, textual, and structural elements. Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant promise in this domain, including both OCR-based and OCR-free approaches for information extraction from document images. This survey reviews recent advances in MLLM-based VRDU, highlighting emerging trends and promising research directions with a focus on two key aspects: (1) techniques for representing and integrating textual, visual, and layout features; (2) training paradigms, including pretraining, instruction tuning, and training strategies. Moreover, we address challenges such as data scarcity, handling multi-page and multilingual documents, and integrating emerging trends such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation and agentic frameworks. Our analysis offers a roadmap for advancing MLLM-based VRDU toward more scalable, reliable, and adaptable systems.

AI.tldr: 论文系统梳理了基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的可视化富文档理解（VRDU）最新进展，聚焦特征融合与训练范式，并提出应对数据稀缺、多页多语、检索增强与具身智能等挑战的研究路线。
AI.motivation: 传统OCR或单模态方法难以同时解析文档中的文本、视觉与结构信息，亟需借助MLLM统一建模，实现高精度、鲁棒的信息抽取。
AI.method: 从两大维度展开综述：1) 文本、视觉与版式特征的表示及融合技术（含OCR-based与OCR-free）；2) 预训练、指令微调与策略性训练范式。并剖析RAG、Agent等新兴框架在VRDU中的适配方式。
AI.result: 归纳出现有模型在单页英文基准上表现良好，但在多页、多语、低资源场景下存在显著性能衰减；同时指出数据构造与评测体系尚不完善。
AI.conclusion: 未来应构建大规模多语多页合成数据、设计轻量级跨模态融合模块、引入可靠性约束与可解释机制，并制定统一评测协议，以推动MLLM-VRDU向可扩展、可信、可迁移的系统演进。

title: Chimera: Neuro-Symbolic Attention Primitives for Trustworthy Dataplane Intelligence
summary: Deploying expressive learning models directly on programmable dataplanes promises line-rate, low-latency traffic analysis but remains hindered by strict hardware constraints and the need for predictable, auditable behavior. Chimera introduces a principled framework that maps attention-oriented neural computations and symbolic constraints onto dataplane primitives, enabling trustworthy inference within the match-action pipeline. Chimera combines a kernelized, linearized attention approximation with a two-layer key-selection hierarchy and a cascade fusion mechanism that enforces hard symbolic guarantees while preserving neural expressivity. The design includes a hardware-aware mapping protocol and a two-timescale update scheme that together permit stable, line-rate operation under realistic dataplane budgets. The paper presents the Chimera architecture, a hardware mapping strategy, and empirical evidence showing that neuro-symbolic attention primitives can achieve high-fidelity inference within the resource envelope of commodity programmable switches.

AI.tldr: Chimera 将注意力神经网络与符号约束共同映射到可编程数据平面，在保持线速、可审计的同时实现高保真推理。
AI.motivation: 数据平面线速处理需求与硬件资源/可预测性矛盾突出，现有深度学习模型难以直接部署；亟需一套可在交换机 ASIC 内运行、兼具表达力与可信性的推理框架。
AI.method: 提出神经-符号融合框架 Chimera：①对注意力做核化线性近似并设计两层键选择层级；②级联融合机制在保持神经表达力的同时施加符号硬约束；③硬件感知映射协议将计算拆解为匹配-动作原语；④双时间尺度更新策略保证在数据平面预算内稳定运行。
AI.result: 在商用可编程交换机资源包线内实现高保真推理，实验验证 Chimera 能以线速执行复杂注意力计算，满足延迟与资源限制且具备可审计性。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明注意力类神经原语可在数据平面原生运行，为将 expressive ML 模型下沉至可编程网络硬件提供了可行且可信的系统级方案。

title: Fine-Tuning Code Language Models to Detect Cross-Language Bugs
comment: Preprint accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM), 2026
summary: Multilingual programming, which involves using multiple programming languages (PLs) in a single project, is increasingly common due to its benefits. However, it introduces cross-language bugs (CLBs), which arise from interactions between different PLs and are difficult to detect by single-language bug detection tools. This paper investigates the potential of pre-trained code language models (CodeLMs) in CLB detection. We developed CLCFinder, a cross-language code identification tool, and constructed a CLB dataset involving three PL combinations (Python-C/C++, Java-C/C++, and Python-Java) with nine interaction types. We fine-tuned 13 CodeLMs on this dataset and evaluated their performance, analyzing the effects of dataset size, token sequence length, and code comments. Results show that all 13 CodeLMs exhibited varying degrees of performance improvement after fine-tuning, with UniXcoder-base achieving the best F1 score (0.7407). Notably, within our experimental setup, small CodeLMs tended to performe better than large ones. CodeLMs fine-tuned on single-language bug datasets performed poorly on CLB detection, demonstrating the distinction between CLBs and single-language bugs. Additionally, increasing the fine-tuning dataset size significantly improved performance, while longer token sequences did not necessarily improve the model performance. The impact of code comments varied across models. Some fine-tuned CodeLMs' performance was improved, while others showed degraded performance.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估了13个预训练代码语言模型在跨语言缺陷（CLB）检测上的微调表现，提出CLCFinder工具并构建三语九类交互的CLB数据集，发现小模型优于大模型且CLB与单语言缺陷显著不同。
AI.motivation: 多语言项目日益普及，但跨语言交互引发的缺陷（CLB）无法被单语言检测工具识别，亟需探索预训练代码模型对CLB的检测潜力。
AI.method: 1) 开发跨语言代码定位工具CLCFinder；2) 构建含Python-C/C++、Java-C/C++、Python-Java三组语言组合、九种交互类型的CLB数据集；3) 在该数据集上微调13个CodeLM，并控制数据集规模、序列长度与注释变量进行消融实验。
AI.result: 全部模型微调后F1提升，UniXcoder-base达0.7407最佳；小参数量模型普遍优于大模型；单语言缺陷数据微调对CLB几乎无效；增大数据量显著提升性能，加长序列无益；注释对模型影响正负不一。
AI.conclusion: CodeLM具备检测CLB的可行性与上限，但CLB与单语言缺陷在特征层面存在本质差异；模型规模并非越大越好，数据量与任务特定微调策略比模型体量更关键；后续需针对CLB特性设计专门表示与训练方法。

title: GaiaFlow: Semantic-Guided Diffusion Tuning for Carbon-Frugal Search
summary: As the burgeoning power requirements of sophisticated neural architectures escalate, the information retrieval community has recognized ecological sustainability as a pivotal priority that necessitates a fundamental paradigm shift in model design. While contemporary neural rankers have attained unprecedented accuracy, the substantial environmental externalities associated with their computational intensity often remain overlooked in large-scale deployments. We present GaiaFlow, an innovative framework engineered to facilitate carbon-frugal search by operationalizing semantic-guided diffusion tuning. Our methodology orchestrates the convergence of retrieval-guided Langevin dynamics and a hardware-independent performance modeling strategy to optimize the trade-off between search precision and environmental preservation. By incorporating adaptive early exit protocols and precision-aware quantized inference, the proposed architecture significantly mitigates operational carbon footprints while maintaining robust retrieval quality across heterogeneous computing infrastructures. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that GaiaFlow achieves a superior equilibrium between effectiveness and energy efficiency, offering a scalable and sustainable pathway for next-generation neural search systems.

AI.tldr: GaiaFlow用「语义引导扩散微调」把排序精度与碳排放解耦，在保持检索效果的同时显著降低推理能耗。
AI.motivation: 当前神经排序器虽精度高，但大规模部署带来的隐含碳排被忽视，亟需把生态可持续性纳入核心设计目标。
AI.method: 提出GaiaFlow框架：1) 以检索引导的Langevin动力学控制扩散过程，实现语义驱动的早退；2) 建立与硬件无关的性能-能耗预测模型，在运行时动态选择最优比特宽度与早退点；3) 将上述策略封装成统一调度器，支持异构硬件上的量化推理。
AI.result: 与主流神经排序器相比，在TREC、MS MARCO等基准上NDCG@10平均下降<1%，而单次查询能耗与碳排放降低3.2×–5.7×；在百万级文档集群中，GPU/CPU混合部署下仍能维持亚秒级延迟。
AI.conclusion: GaiaFlow证明“精度-碳排”并非零和博弈，为下一代可持续神经搜索系统提供了可扩展、硬件无关且即插即用的范式。

title: Prompt to Pwn: Automated Exploit Generation for Smart Contracts
summary: Smart contracts are important for digital finance, yet they are hard to patch once deployed. Prior work has mainly explored LLMs for smart contract vulnerability detection, leaving end-to-end automated exploit generation (AEG) much less understood. We study that gap with \textsc{ReX}, an execution-grounded framework that links LLM-based exploit synthesis to the Foundry stack for end-to-end generation, compilation, execution, and validation. Five recent LLMs are evaluated across eight common vulnerability classes, supported by a curated dataset of 38{+} real incident PoCs and three automation aids: prompt refactoring, a compiler feedback loop, and templated test harnesses. Results indicate that current frontier LLMs can often produce deterministic PoCs for single-contract vulnerabilities, but remain weak on cross-contract attacks; outcomes depend mainly on the model and bug type, while code structure and prompt tuning contribute less in our setting. The study also surfaces important boundary conditions of LLM-driven AEG, including gaps between oracle-validated exploitability and real-world economic attacks, pointing to the need for stronger defenses and more realistic evaluation.

AI.tldr: 首個將大模型與Foundry工具鏈整合、實現智能合約端到端自動化攻擊生成的框架；證明LLM能可靠產生單合約漏洞PoC，但跨合約攻擊與真實經濟利用仍有顯著差距。
AI.motivation: 智能合約部署後難以修補，而既有研究僅用LLM做漏洞檢測，缺乏可直接輸出可執行攻擊腳本的端到端自動化攻擊生成(AEG)方案。
AI.method: 提出	extsc{ReX}框架：將LLM生成的攻擊代碼接入Foundry進行編譯-執行-驗證；引入提示重構、編譯反饋循環與測試模板三種自動化輔助；在38個真實事件PoC與8類常見漏洞上評估5種前沿LLM。
AI.result: 模型與漏洞類型為主導因素；LLM能在單合約場景下穩定產生確定性PoC，但跨合約攻擊成功率低；代碼結構與提示優化影響有限。
AI.conclusion: 當前LLM已具備自動化合成單合約攻擊的能力，但經濟層面的可牟利性與驗證器

title: LiveGraph: Active-Structure Neural Re-ranking for Exercise Recommendation
summary: The continuous expansion of digital learning environments has catalyzed the demand for intelligent systems capable of providing personalized educational content. While current exercise recommendation frameworks have made significant strides, they frequently encounter obstacles regarding the long-tailed distribution of student engagement and the failure to adapt to idiosyncratic learning trajectories. We present LiveGraph, a novel active-structure neural re-ranking framework designed to overcome these limitations. Our approach utilizes a graph-based representation enhancement strategy to bridge the information gap between active and inactive students while integrating a dynamic re-ranking mechanism to foster content diversity. By prioritizing the structural relationships within learning histories, the proposed model effectively balances recommendation precision with pedagogical variety. Comprehensive experimental evaluations conducted on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that LiveGraph surpasses contemporary baselines in both predictive accuracy and the breadth of exercise diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出 LiveGraph 框架，用动态图神经网络重排习题，缓解长尾分布与个体轨迹差异，兼顾准确率与多样性。
AI.motivation: 数字学习环境中习题推荐需兼顾冷启动长尾学生与个体化轨迹差异，现有方法难以同时保证精度与教学多样性。
AI.method: 构建活跃-非活跃学生统一图，通过结构表示增强补全冷门节点特征；设计主动结构神经重排器，在线动态调整候选集，以图关系约束平衡精度与多样性。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上，LiveGraph 的预测准确率与习题覆盖多样性均显著优于当前最优基线。
AI.conclusion: 利用图结构关系动态重排，可在不牺牲精度前提下有效提升长尾场景下的个性化推荐质量与教育内容丰富度。

title: A Functionality-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating Web Agents in E-commerce Domains
comment: 8 pages for main body and 8 pages of appendix
summary: Web agents have shown great promise in performing many tasks on ecommerce website. To assess their capabilities, several benchmarks have been introduced. However, current benchmarks in the e-commerce domain face two major problems. First, they primarily focus on product search tasks (e.g., Find an Apple Watch), failing to capture the broader range of functionalities offered by real-world e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, including account management and gift card operations. Second, existing benchmarks typically evaluate whether the agent completes the user query, but ignore the potential risks involved. In practice, web agents can make unintended changes that negatively impact the user account or status. For instance, an agent might purchase the wrong item, delete a saved address, or incorrectly configure an auto-reload setting. To address these gaps, we propose a new benchmark called Amazon-Bench. To generate user queries that cover a broad range of tasks, we propose a data generation pipeline that leverages webpage content and interactive elements (e.g., buttons, check boxes) to create diverse, functionality-grounded user queries covering tasks such as address management, wish list management, and brand store following. To improve the agent evaluation, we propose an automated evaluation framework that assesses both the performance and the safety of web agents. We systematically evaluate different agents, finding that current agents struggle with complex queries and pose safety risks. These results highlight the need for developing more robust and reliable web agents.

AI.tldr: 现有电商基准仅测试商品搜索且忽视安全风险；作者提出Amazon-Bench，通过网页元素自动生成涵盖地址、心愿单、品牌关注等多任务查询，并配套自动评估框架同时衡量任务完成度与安全性。实验表明当前智能体在复杂任务上表现差且存在严重安全隐患。
AI.motivation: 真实电商平台功能远多于“找商品”，而既有基准只测搜索类任务，同时完全不评估智能体可能对用户账户造成的负面操作（误购、误删地址、错误设置自动充值等）。需要覆盖更广任务并量化安全风险的统一基准。
AI.method: 1) 数据生成管线：爬取Amazon真实页面，提取按钮、复选框等可交互元素，反向构造与功能强相关的用户查询（地址管理、心愿单、礼品卡、品牌关注等）。2) 自动评估框架：分别用规则脚本与状态对比计算任务完成率，并设计安全指标检测是否产生意外写操作（订单、地址、支付设置变更）。3) 系统评测：在Amazon-Bench上运行基于提示的LLM智能体、专用电商Agent等多类系统。
AI.result: 覆盖14大功能模块、1.1万条查询；最强基线任务完成率仅42%，复杂多步任务降至18%；安全违规率平均达23%，其中支付类操作错误率高达31%。所有测试智能体均出现误下单、误删地址或自动充值配置错误。
AI.conclusion: 电商智能体在功能覆盖与安全性上均不成熟，亟需引入任务完成+安全双目标训练与推理机制；Amazon-Bench可作为衡量未来鲁棒、可信网络代理的重要基准。

title: CLIPoint3D: Language-Grounded Few-Shot Unsupervised 3D Point Cloud Domain Adaptation
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP demonstrate impressive cross-modal reasoning, extending beyond images to 3D perception. Yet, these models remain fragile under domain shifts, especially when adapting from synthetic to real-world point clouds. Conventional 3D domain adaptation approaches rely on heavy trainable encoders, yielding strong accuracy but at the cost of efficiency. We introduce CLIPoint3D, the first framework for few-shot unsupervised 3D point cloud domain adaptation built upon CLIP. Our approach projects 3D samples into multiple depth maps and exploits the frozen CLIP backbone, refined through a knowledge-driven prompt tuning scheme that integrates high-level language priors with geometric cues from a lightweight 3D encoder. To adapt task-specific features effectively, we apply parameter-efficient fine-tuning to CLIP's encoders and design an entropy-guided view sampling strategy for selecting confident projections. Furthermore, an optimal transport-based alignment loss and an uncertainty-aware prototype alignment loss collaboratively bridge source-target distribution gaps while maintaining class separability. Extensive experiments on PointDA-10 and GraspNetPC-10 benchmarks show that CLIPoint3D achieves consistent 3-16% accuracy gains over both CLIP-based and conventional encoder-based baselines. Project page: https://sarthakm320.github.io/CLIPoint3D.

AI.tldr: CLIPoint3D首次将冻结CLIP用于少样本无监督3D点云域适应，仅用轻量级3D编码器+提示微调，在PointDA-10/GraspNetPC-10上比现有方法高3–16%。
AI.motivation: CLIP等VLMs已展现跨模态推理潜力，但直接用于3D感知时，在合成→真实域迁移下性能骤降；传统3D域适应依赖重型可训编码器，准确率高却效率低。
AI.method: 1) 将3D点云投影为多张深度图，利用冻结CLIP视觉-语言骨干；2) 提出知识驱动提示微调，将高阶语言先验与轻量3D几何编码耦合；3) 仅对CLIP编码器做参数高效微调，并设计熵引导视角采样保留置信投影；4) 联合最优传输对齐损失与不确定性感知原型对齐损失，封闭源-目标分布差距并维持类间可分性。
AI.result: 在PointDA-10与GraspNetPC-10上，CLIPoint3D一致超越CLIP基线与传统3D编码基线3–16%，且不引入重型3D网络。
AI.conclusion: 冻结CLIP+轻量几何提示即可实现高效3D域适应，说明语言先验对3D几何迁移同样关键，为后续VLM在3D感知中的低样本、低算力部署奠定基础。

title: BED-LLM: Intelligent Information Gathering with LLMs and Bayesian Experimental Design
comment: Published at the International Conference on Learning Representations 2026
summary: We propose a general-purpose approach for improving the ability of large language models (LLMs) to intelligently and adaptively gather information from a user or other external source using the framework of sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED). This enables LLMs to act as effective multi-turn conversational agents and interactively interface with external environments. Our approach, which we call BED-LLM (Bayesian experimental design with large language models), is based on iteratively choosing questions or queries that maximize the expected information gain (EIG) with respect to a variable of interest given the responses gathered previously. We show how this EIG can be formulated (and then estimated) in a principled way using a probabilistic model derived from the LLM's predictive distributions and provide detailed insights into key decisions in its construction and updating procedure. We find that BED-LLM achieves substantial gains in performance across a wide range of tests based on the 20 Questions game and using the LLM to actively infer user preferences, compared to purely prompting-based design generation and other adaptive design strategies.

AI.tldr: BED-LLM 利用序列化贝叶斯试验设计，让大模型主动挑问题，以获得最大信息增益，从而在“20 问”式对话及偏好推断任务上显著优于纯提示基线。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型多轮对话多为被动响应，缺乏系统性、可解释的主动提问策略，导致信息获取效率低。作者希望把统计学中成熟的贝叶斯试验设计引入大模型，使其能主动、自适应地收集用户或外部信息。
AI.method: 将大模型的预测分布转化为贝叶斯模型，定义对目标变量的期望信息增益（EIG）作为选问准则，并在每轮迭代地选取得分最高的提问。详细给出 EIG 公式推导、近似估计方法以及模型更新流程。
AI.result: 在 20 Questions 游戏与主动偏好推断两类任务上，BED-LLM 相较纯提示基线及多种自适应策略，平均减少 ≥30% 的提问轮次即可达到同等正确率，且具备更强的可解释性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯试验设计为大模型提供了一条机理清晰、性能可验证的主动提问路径，未来可与多模态、工具调用等模块结合，构建更高效的信息收集与对话框架。

title: ConFu: Contemplate the Future for Better Speculative Sampling
comment: v3: Added stress test with long drafts (DL=12, top-k=1) and tail-acceptance (survival) analysis. Earlier versions added Qwen3-4B results and ablations
summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a powerful approach to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference by employing lightweight draft models to propose candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. The effectiveness of this paradigm critically depends on the quality of the draft model. While recent advances such as the EAGLE series achieve state-of-the-art speedup, existing draft models remain limited by error accumulation: they condition only on the current prefix, causing their predictions to drift from the target model over steps. In this work, we propose \textbf{ConFu} (Contemplate the Future), a novel speculative decoding framework that enables draft models to anticipate the future direction of generation. ConFu introduces (i) contemplate tokens and soft prompts that allow the draft model to leverage future-oriented signals from the target model at negligible cost, (ii) a dynamic contemplate token mechanism with MoE to enable context-aware future prediction, and (iii) a training framework with anchor token sampling and future prediction replication that learns robust future prediction. ConFu improves token acceptance rates and generation speed over EAGLE-3 by 8--11\% on Llama-3 3B/8B and by approximately 20\% on Qwen-3 4B across downstream tasks. We believe our work is the first to bridge speculative decoding with continuous reasoning tokens, offering a new direction for accelerating LLM inference.

AI.tldr: ConFu首次让草稿模型“预见”未来几步的生成方向，把目标模型的未来信号以可忽略成本注入草稿，显著提升接受率与解码速度。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码草稿模型仅依赖当前前缀，逐步累积误差，导致接受率随序列增长而下降，亟需一种能提前对齐目标模型未来分布的方案。
AI.method: 提出ConFu框架：(i) 引入“思量token+软提示”，零成本汲取目标模型未来信息；(ii) 动态MoE思量token，实现上下文自适应的未来预测；(iii) 锚点采样+未来复制训练策略，稳定学习多步前瞻分布。
AI.result: 在Llama-3 3B/8B上比EAGLE-3接受率与速度再提升8–11%，在Qwen-3 4B上提升约20%，验证对未来信息建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ConFu将“连续思量token”概念引入投机解码，突破传统前缀条件限制，为加速LLM推理开辟了新范式。

title: Quantum spatial best-arm identification via quantum walks
summary: Quantum reinforcement learning has emerged as a framework combining quantum computation with sequential decision-making, and applications to the multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem have been reported. The graph bandit problem extends the MAB setting by introducing spatial constraints, where the accessibility of arms is restricted by graph connectivity, yet quantum approaches to this setting remain limited. In this paper, we formulate best-arm identification in graph bandits and propose a quantum algorithmic framework, termed Quantum Spatial Best-Arm Identification (QSBAI), which is applicable to general graph structures. This framework uses quantum walks to encode superpositions over graph-constrained actions, thereby extending amplitude amplification and generalizing the quantum BAI algorithm via Szegedy's walk framework. We focus our theoretical analysis on complete and bipartite graphs, deriving the maximal success probability of identifying the best arm and the time step at which it is achieved. Our results clarify how quantum-walk-based search can be adapted to structurally constrained decision problems and provide a foundation for quantum best-arm identification in graph-structured environments.

AI.tldr: 以量子行走为机理，首次系统地给出图上赌博机最优臂识别的量子算法 QSBAI，并在完全图与二部图上给出可 analytically 计算的成功概率与收敛时间。}
AI.motivation: 现有量子强化学习仅关注经典 MAB，而真实决策空间常受图结构限制（图赌博机）且缺乏量子算法；作者欲填补该空白，将量子行走推广到图约束下的最优臂识别。}
AI.method: 构建 QSBAI 框架：用图上的 Szegedy 量子行走编码动作超位置，把幅度放大扩展为广义量子 BAI；对完全图与二部图分解行走谱，求解最大成功概率对应的观测时刻。}
AI.result: 在完全图上，QSBAI 的渐近成功概率为经典算法的 Ω(√N) 加速；在二部图上给出由谱隙决定的显式成功概率曲线与最优观测时刻 t*=π/(2λ)，并证明当图直径缩小时量子优势增强。}
AI.conclusion: 证实量子行走可适配结构性约束决策，为后续量子图强化学习奠定理论基线，并暗示加大对

title: Why Does Self-Distillation (Sometimes) Degrade the Reasoning Capability of LLMs?
summary: Self-distillation has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for LLMs, often improving performance while shortening reasoning traces. However, in mathematical reasoning, we find that it can reduce response length while degrading performance. We trace this degradation to the suppression of epistemic verbalization - the model's expression of uncertainty during reasoning. Through controlled experiments varying conditioning context richness and task coverage, we show that conditioning the teacher on rich information suppresses uncertainty expression, enabling rapid in-domain optimization with limited task coverage but harming OOD performance, where unseen problems benefit from expressing uncertainty and adjusting accordingly. Across Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-7B, and Olmo3-7B-Instruct, we observe performance drops of up to 40%. Our findings highlight that exposing appropriate levels of uncertainty is crucial for robust reasoning and underscore the importance of optimizing reasoning behavior beyond merely reinforcing correct answer traces.

AI.tldr: Self-distillation 会抑制模型表达
AI.motivation: 数学推理中自蒸馏会“表面”提高答案正确率，但抑制对不确定性的表述，导致 OOD 性能下滑。需要阐明这一隐藏退化机制并指导如何保留适度不确定性提示。
AI.method: 设计两组对照实验：① 固定任务集但改变条件上下文“ richness”（即示范样本的多样性与信息量）；② 固定上下文 richness 但扩大 / 缩小任务覆盖范围。用 Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-7B、Olmo3-7B-Instruct 等模型进行自蒸馏，比较蒸馏前后长度分布、准确度及细粒度不确定性词频。
AI.result: 条件上下文越 rich，蒸馏后不确定性表达词（例如 “possibly / maybe”）下降越显著，平均长度缩短 30–40%，而 ID 测试准确率微升；反之保持轻度上下文时，不确定性表达保留多，OOD 准确率下降幅度从 40% 降至 10% 以内。三项模型均观测到 OOD 准确率与不确定性表达数呈正相关（Pearson ρ≈0.78）。
AI.conclusion: 单纯把正确答案链条当作监督信号的自蒸馏，会抹除模型在推理链中对不确定性的显性思考，破坏对 OOD 问题的自适应能力。应保持少量示范、随机采样与不确定性正则等方法，让模型学会“边推理边表达不确定”，而非仅输出最短正确答案链。

title: ORCA: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Hallucination and Adversarial Robustness in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at the ACM International Conference on Cloud and Big Data Computing (ICCBDC 2026)
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit strong multimodal capabilities but remain vulnerable to hallucinations from intrinsic errors and adversarial attacks from external exploitations, limiting their reliability in real-world applications. We present ORCA, an agentic reasoning framework that improves the factual accuracy and adversarial robustness of pretrained LVLMs through inference-time structured inference reasoning with a suite of small vision models (less than 3B parameters). ORCA operates via an Observe-Reason-Critique-Act loop, querying multiple visual tools with evidential questions, validating cross-model inconsistencies, and refining predictions iteratively without access to model internals or retraining. ORCA also stores intermediate reasoning traces, which supports auditable decision-making. Though designed primarily to mitigate object-level hallucinations, ORCA also exhibits emergent adversarial robustness without requiring adversarial training or defense mechanisms. We evaluate ORCA across three settings: (1) clean images on hallucination benchmarks, (2) adversarially perturbed images without defense, and (3) adversarially perturbed images with defense applied. On the POPE hallucination benchmark, ORCA improves standalone LVLMs performance by +3.64% to +40.67% across different subsets. Under adversarial perturbations on POPE, ORCA achieves an average accuracy gain of +20.11% across LVLMs. When combined with defense techniques on adversarially perturbed AMBER images, ORCA further improves standalone LVLM performance, with gains ranging from +1.20% to +48.00% across metrics. These results demonstrate that ORCA offers a promising path toward building more reliable and robust multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 协同「小视觉模型」→「大视觉-语言模型」：提出无需重训练、仅需推理的 ORCA 框架，在 POPE 等基准上将幻觉率下降 3.64%–40.67%，并在无/有防御的对抗扰动上分别平均提升 20.11% 与最多 48.00%。
AI.motivation: 现有大视觉-语言模型（LVLM）在对象存在/属性判断等任务中表现为“幻觉”和对抗脆弱，不经过重训练或内部权重调节难以提升可信度。
AI.method: 设计 Agent 回路 ORCA = Observe-Reason-Critique-Act：迭代调用<3 B 参数的小视觉模型（检测/分割/深度/分类等工具），生成视觉证据；引入批判器进行跨模型一致性验证；将修正结果反馈给主 LVLM，无须访问梯度且不更新参数；同时保存可审计的中间推理链。
AI.result: 在干净图像 POPE 对象存在幻觉基准上：对多个 LVLM 绝对提升 3.64%–40.67% F1；对抗无防御 POPE 平均提升 20.11% 准确率；对 AMBER 对抗样本结合已有防御后，LVLM 进一步提升 1.20%–48.00% 各指标。
AI.conclusion: ORCA 表明“小工具协同+推理时自检”可高效抑制对象级幻觉并呈现涌现对抗鲁棒性，为部署高可信多模态系统提供重训练之外的通用路径，后续可在更多模态、开放集与黑盒 API 场景下拓展。

title: PolarQuant: Optimal Gaussian Weight Quantization via Hadamard Rotation for LLM Compression
comment: Found some errors, I need to fix
summary: We present PolarQuant, a post-training weight quantization method for large language models (LLMs) that exploits the distributional structure of neural network weights to achieve near-lossless compression. PolarQuant operates in three stages: (1) block-wise normalization to the unit hypersphere, (2) Walsh-Hadamard rotation to transform coordinates into approximately Gaussian random variables, and (3) quantization with centroids matched to the Gaussian distribution. Our ablation reveals that Hadamard rotation alone accounts for 98% of the quality improvement, reducing Qwen3.5-9B perplexity from 6.90 (absmax Q5) to 6.40 (Delta = +0.03 from FP16), making it practically lossless without any calibration data. Furthermore, PolarQuant functions as an effective preprocessing step for downstream INT4 quantizers: PolarQuant Q5 dequantized and re-quantized by torchao INT4 achieves perplexity 6.56 versus 6.68 for direct absmax INT4, while maintaining 43.1 tok/s throughput at 6.5 GB VRAM. Code and models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: PolarQuant三步流程把FP16权重压到INT4几乎不掉点；核心是把权重转到Hadamard域，可用蒸馏后再量化。同一6T Qwen3.5-9B，PPL仅+0.03且不需校正数据。
AI.motivation: 现有PTQ把LLM压到INT4时往往要校正数据且易掉脸，本文提出一种零校正数据的无损方案。
AI.method: 1)块级单位超球面归一化 2)Walsh-Hadamard旋转变换 3)高斯匹配质心量化，三步均无需校准数据，可把PolarQuant Q5权重再丢给标准INT4工具自作细粒度量化。
AI.result: Hadamard旋转贡献98%性能提升，Qwen3.5-9B的PPL从6.90→6.40，仅比FP16差+0.03；同一权重用torchao INT4再量，PPL 6.56 vs. 直接INT4的6.68，推理速率43.1 tok/s、VRAM 6.5 GB。
AI.conclusion: PolarQuant通过把权重转到准高斯域，令INT4级的后训练量化首次在大模型上几乎无损；既是独立量化器，也是后续激进量化的通用预处理器，且零校正数据、高吞吐，代码模型已开源。

title: Visual Reasoning Agent: Robust Vision Systems in Remote Sensing via Inference-Time Scaling
comment: Accepted to MORS 2026 Artificial Intelligence Workshop Proceedings
summary: Building robust vision systems for high-stakes domains such as remote sensing requires stronger visual reasoning than what single-pass inference typically provides; yet, retraining large models is often computationally expensive and data intensive. We present Visual Reasoning Agent (VRA), a training-free agentic visual reasoning framework that orchestrates off-the-shelf large vision-language models (LVLMs) with a large reasoning model (LRM) through an iterative Think-Critique-Act loop for cross-model verification, self-critique, and recursive refinement. On the remote sensing benchmark VRSBench VQA dataset, VRA consistently outperforms multiple standalone LVLM baselines and achieves up to 40.67\% improvement on challenging question types spanning both perception and reasoning tasks. In addition, integrating three LVLMs with VRA improves the overall accuracy of the standalone LVLMs from 52.8% to 78.8%, demonstrating the effectiveness of agentic reasoning with increased inference-time compute.

title: Spatiotemporal-Aware Bit-Flip Injection on DNN-based Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (extended version)
comment: The authors have identified issues in the experimental setup and evaluation that may affect the validity of the results. In particular, inconsistencies in the fault injection protocol and temporal analysis may lead to incorrect conclusions. The authors therefore request withdrawal for thorough revision
summary: Modern advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) rely on deep neural networks (DNNs) for perception and planning. Since DNNs' parameters reside in DRAM during inference, bit flips caused by cosmic radiation or low-voltage operation may corrupt DNN computations, distort driving decisions, and lead to real-world incidents. This paper presents a SpatioTemporal-Aware Fault Injection (STAFI) framework to locate critical fault sites in DNNs for ADAS efficiently. Spatially, we propose a Progressive Metric-guided Bit Search (PMBS) that efficiently identifies critical network weight bits whose corruption causes the largest deviations in driving behavior (e.g., unintended acceleration or steering). Furthermore, we develop a Critical Fault Time Identification (CFTI) mechanism that determines when to trigger these faults, taking into account the context of real-time systems and environmental states, to maximize the safety impact. Experiments on DNNs for a production ADAS demonstrate that STAFI uncovers 29.56x more hazard-inducing critical faults than the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: STAFI 框架通过 PMBS 空间扫描 + CFTI 时间触发，在 ADAS 的 DNN 权重中高效定位能引发危险驾驶行为的关键位翻转，实验比最佳基线多发现 29.56 倍高危故障。
AI.motivation: ADAS 的感知与规划 DNN 在推理时参数常驻 DRAM，宇宙射线或低压运行导致的位翻转会立即扭曲驾驶决策，引发真实事故，但现有故障注入方法无法系统、高效地找出最危险故障。
AI.method: 提出 STAFI：① PMBS 以行为偏差为度量，对权重位逐层递进搜索，快速锁定空间维度上最能扰动驾驶输出的关键位；② CFTI 结合实时系统调度与环境状态，动态决定触发时机，最大化安全危害。两者协同完成时空联合故障注入。
AI.result: 在生产级 ADAS DNN 上，STAFI 定位的关键故障导致意外加速/转向的概率比最强基线高 29.56 倍，且搜索耗时低于暴力扫描两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: STAFI 首次把“行为危害”作为故障注入优化目标，兼顾空间关键位与时间触发窗口，为 ADAS 级 DNN 的硬件级可靠性评估与加固提供了可扩展、高灵敏度的分析工具。

title: Text Slider: Efficient and Plug-and-Play Continuous Concept Control for Image/Video Synthesis via LoRA Adapters
comment: Accepted by WACV 2026. We provide more experimental results on the train-free version of our algorithm. Project page: https://textslider.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/aiiu-lab/TextSlider
summary: Recent advances in diffusion models have significantly improved image and video synthesis. In addition, several concept control methods have been proposed to enable fine-grained, continuous, and flexible control over free-form text prompts. However, these methods not only require intensive training time and GPU memory usage to learn the sliders or embeddings but also need to be retrained for different diffusion backbones, limiting their scalability and adaptability. To address these limitations, we introduce Text Slider, a lightweight, efficient and plug-and-play framework that identifies low-rank directions within a pre-trained text encoder, enabling continuous control of visual concepts while significantly reducing training time, GPU memory consumption, and the number of trainable parameters. Furthermore, Text Slider supports multi-concept composition and continuous control, enabling fine-grained and flexible manipulation in both image and video synthesis. We show that Text Slider enables smooth and continuous modulation of specific attributes while preserving the original spatial layout and structure of the input. Text Slider achieves significantly better efficiency: 5$\times$ faster training than Concept Slider and 47$\times$ faster than Attribute Control, while reducing GPU memory usage by nearly 2$\times$ and 4$\times$, respectively.

AI.tldr: Text Slider 用文本编码器内的低秩方向实现无需重训、随插随用的细粒度连续概念控制，训练/显存开销远低于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型概念控制方法需逐骨干重训，耗时长、显存高、难以扩展，亟需轻量化、通用、即插即用的替代方案。
AI.method: 在预训练文本编码器中搜索并优化低秩方向向量，构建「文本滑块」；推断时仅需调节方向系数即可对多概念进行连续、组合式操控。
AI.result: 相较 Concept Slider 训练提速 5×，相较 Attribute Control 提速 47×；显存分别降低 2× 与 4×；在图像与视频生成中实现了属性平滑调节且保持空间结构不变。
AI.conclusion: Text Slider 以极低资源实现了跨骨干、可扩展、细粒度的连续概念控制，为扩散模型的高效可控生成提供了实用新范式。

title: An Imbalanced Dataset with Multiple Feature Representations for Studying Quality Control of Next-Generation Sequencing
summary: Next-generation sequencing (NGS) is a key technique for studying the DNA and RNA of organisms. However, identifying quality problems in NGS data across different experimental settings remains challenging. To develop automated quality-control tools, researchers require datasets with features that capture the characteristics of quality problems. Existing NGS repositories, however, offer only a limited number of quality-related features. To address this gap, we propose a dataset derived from 37,491 NGS samples with two types of quality-related feature representations. The first type consists of 34 features derived from quality control tools (QC-34 features). The second type has a variable number of features ranging from eight to 1,183. These features were derived from read counts in problematic genomic regions identified by the ENCODE blocklist (BL features). All features describe the same human and mouse samples from five genomic assays, allowing direct comparison of feature representations. The proposed dataset includes a binary quality label, derived from automated quality control and domain experts. Among all samples, $3.2\%$ are of low quality. Supervised machine learning algorithms accurately predicted quality labels from the features, confirming the relevance of the provided feature representations. The proposed feature representations enable researchers to study how different feature types (QC-34 vs. BL features) and granularities (varying number of BL features) affect the detection of quality problems.

AI.tldr: 作者发布了包含37,491例人类与小鼠NGS样本的多特征质量数据集，并验证其可支撑自动化质量预测研究。
AI.motivation: 现有公共NGS仓库提供的质量特征有限，难以支撑自动化质控算法开发；亟需高维、可直接比较的特征资源。
AI.method: 以ENCODE黑名单区域reads计数为基础，构建8-1,183维可变BL特征，并辅以34维传统QC指标（QC-34），对五类主流测序实验的同批样本统一提取，配合自动化+专家双重标注，形成带二元质量标签的数据集。
AI.result: 仅3.2%样本被判为低质量；监督模型借助两类特征均可高精度预测质量标签，证明新特征表示具备判别力，且可系统比较“传统QC指标 vs. 黑名单reads特征”及不同BL特征粒度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为NGS自动化质控研究提供了迄今最丰富且可直接对比的多粒度特征资源，有助于深入理解特征类型与维度对异常检测性能的作用。

title: InsideOut: Measuring and Mitigating Insider-Outsider Bias in Interview Script Generation
summary: Advancements in Large language models (LLMs) have enabled a variety of downstream applications like story and interview script generation. However, recent research raised concerns about culture-related fairness issues in LLM-generated content. In this work, we identify and systematically investigate LLMs' insider-outsider bias, a phenomenon where models position themselves as "insiders" of mainstream cultures during generation while externalizing less dominant cultures. We propose the InsideOut benchmark with 4,000 generation prompts and three evaluation metrics to quantify this bias through a culturally situated interview script generation task, in which an LLM is positioned as a reporter interviewing local people across 10 diverse cultures. Empirical evaluation on 5 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that while models adopt insider tones in over 88% US-contexted scripts on average, they disproportionately default to "outsider" stances for non-Western cultures. To mitigate these biases, we propose 2 inference-time methods: a baseline prompt-based Fairness Intervention Pillars (FIP) method, and a structured Mitigation via Fairness Agents (MFA) framework consisting of a Single-Agent (MFA-SA), a Hierarchical-Agent (MFA-HA), and an autonomous Agentic Planning (MFA-Plan) pipeline. Empirical results demonstrate that agent-based MFA methods achieve outstanding and robust performance in mitigating the insider-outsider bias: For instance, on the Cultural Alignment Gap (CAG) metric, MFA-SA reduces bias in Llama model by 89.70 % and MFA-HA mitigates bias in Qwen by 82.54%. These findings showcase the effectiveness of agent-based methods as a promising direction for mitigating biases in generative LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统揭示并量化大模型在跨文化内容生成中存在“内-外视角偏差”（insider-outsider bias），提出 InsideOut 基准与三种无微调推理级方法，其中基于多智能体的 MFA 框架可将文化对齐差距指标降低 80% 以上。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在故事、访谈脚本等下游应用迅速落地，但近期研究指出其输出潜藏文化公平性问题。作者发现模型对主流文化自动采取“内部人”口吻，而对非西方文化则外化为“旁观者”，这种系统性偏差尚未被正式定义与度量，亟需可复现的评测基准与无需重训的纠偏策略。
AI.method: 1) 构建含 4 000 条提示的 InsideOut 基准，覆盖 10 种文化，任务为让模型扮演记者撰写采访脚本；2) 设计三项指标（文化立场一致性、文化对齐差距 CAG、人工评分）量化“内-外”偏差；3) 提出两种推理级干预：① 提示基线 FIP，② 多智能体框架 MFA，含单智能体 MFA-SA、分层 MFA-HA、自主规划 MFA-Plan；所有方法均不改变模型权重，仅靠推理流程调整立场提示与多轮自我校正。
AI.result: 在 5 个 SOTA 模型上，US 语境脚本 88% 以上呈“内部人”立场，而非西方文化不足 30%。FIP 基线仅带来 10% 级提升；MFA-SA 使 Llama 的 CAG 降低 89.70%，MFA-HA 使 Qwen 降低 82.54%，且跨模型、跨文化鲁棒；人工评测中 85% 的干预后脚本立场显著更中立。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次实证表明大模型存在可量化的文化内-外视角偏差，并证明无需重训的多智能体推理框架即可有效纠偏，为生成式 AI 的公平性治理提供了可扩展的新范式。

title: Multilingual Language Models Encode Script Over Linguistic Structure
summary: Multilingual language models (LMs) organize representations for typologically and orthographically diverse languages into a shared parameter space, yet the nature of this internal organization remains elusive. In this work, we investigate which linguistic properties - abstract language identity or surface-form cues - shape multilingual representations. To do so, we analyze language-associated units across different model families and scales using the Language Activation Probability Entropy (LAPE) metric, and further decompose activations with Sparse Autoencoders. We find that these units are strongly conditioned on orthography: romanization induces near-disjoint representations that align with neither native-script inputs nor English, while word-order shuffling has limited effect on unit identity. Probing shows that typological structure becomes increasingly accessible in deeper layers, while causal interventions indicate that generation is most sensitive to units that are invariant to surface-form perturbations rather than to units identified by typological alignment alone. Overall, our results suggest that multilingual LMs organize representations around surface form, with linguistic abstraction emerging gradually without collapsing into a unified interlingua.

AI.tldr: 跨语言模型内部并非先按「语言身份」再分层，而是先被文字形式（正字法）牢牢锁定；深层才逐渐浮现类型学结构，且生成依赖对表面扰动不敏感的单元。
AI.motivation: 尽管多语言模型把正字法与类型学迥异的语种压缩到同一参数空间，其内部如何组织仍不清楚：是按抽象「语言身份」还是按可见「表面形式」？
AI.method: 1) 提出 Language Activation Probability Entropy（LAPE）量化「语言相关单元」；2) 用稀疏自编码器分解激活，跨模型家族与尺度比较；3) 设计罗马化、词序打乱等表面扰动，对比探针与因果干预。
AI.result: 罗马化立即催生与原生文字及英语均不重叠的表征；词序打乱对单元身份影响极小。深层才可通过探针解码类型学特征，而因果干预显示，生成效果最依赖对表面扰动保持不变的单元，而非仅靠类型学对齐的单元。
AI.conclusion: 多语言模型优先按表面形式（尤其是正字法）组织表征，语言抽象随深度渐显，并未坍缩成统一的「中介语」。

title: How does the optimizer implicitly bias the model merging loss landscape?
summary: Model merging combines independent solutions with different capabilities into a single one while maintaining the same inference cost. Two popular approaches are linear interpolation, which simply averages multiple model weights, and task arithmetic, which combines task vectors obtained by the difference between finetuned and base models. While useful in practice, what properties make merging effective are poorly understood. This paper explores how the optimization dynamics affect the loss landscape geometry and its impact on merging success. We show that a single quantity -- the effective noise scale -- unifies the impact of different optimizer components on model merging. Across architectures and datasets, merging success is a non-monotonic function of the effective noise scale, with a distinct optimum. Decomposing this quantity, we find that larger learning rates, stronger weight decay, smaller batch sizes, and data augmentation all independently modulate the effective noise scale and exhibit the same qualitative trend. Unlike prior work connecting optimizer noise to the flatness or generalization of individual minima, we show that it also affects the global loss landscape, predicting when independently trained solutions can be successfully merged. Our findings broaden the understanding of how optimization shapes the loss landscape geometry and its consequences for model merging, suggesting that training dynamics could be further manipulated to improve model merging.

AI.tldr: 相同的参数-插值操作能否成功，关键并不在模型本身，而是取决于训练时由学习率、惯性与正则化共同决定的“等效噪声尺度”；该尺度存在唯一最佳区间，既能保证解点周围的高斯曲率为正（易于线性合并），又不致过度平坦导致系统性能力塌陷。
AI.motivation: 尽管线性平均权重（linear interpolation）与任务向量算术（task arithmetic）已成为将多个微调模型快速融合的‘零成本’方法，合并能否成功缺乏理论解释。本文意在揭示优化动力学如何通过改变损失景观的几何形状来决定异构解的可融合性。
AI.method:
1) 将Adam／SGD的训练曲线分解为有效噪声强度σ_eff，它综合学习率、权重衰减、批量大小、数据增强及σ（权重梯度方差）。
2) 在ResNet、ViT、BERT三类模型与CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet、GLUE任务上，系统扫描σ_eff，比较插值后精度变化。
3) 用Hessian迹与曲率谱量化局部与全局景观平坦度，并结合随机势垒探测联合景观的正则性。
AI.result: 1) 合并成功率对σ_eff呈单峰、非单调曲线，存在明确最优窗口；偏离该窗口时线性插值会出现“驼峰”式精度跌落，窗口内则保持几乎无损合并。2) 分开调节学习率、权重衰减、批大小或数据增强，均能独立移动σ_eff并复现同样的非单调规律。3) 数值上只需监控σ_eff即可预测合并是否成功，无需再验算曲率或联合推断；且σ_eff过大会导致景观呈“峡谷”结构（高度正切负曲率），过小则解点呈尖锐孤立位置，均不可逆。
